### [83] [Question-Specific Knowledge Graphs for Efficient Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35942)
*Ting-Chih Chen,Emile van Krieken,Shujian Yu,Filip Ilievski*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出VisKG框架，通过强化学习训练VLM将视觉内容转化为面向问题的知识图谱表示，用于高效视觉问答。该方法在科学、数学和通用视觉理解基准上以更少token实现了与或优于基于标题的基线的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于详细图像标题的视觉问答方法引入了与推理任务无关的视觉细节，增加了输入token数量和计算成本，且GRPO算法在多奖励异构优势分布下存在奖励崩溃风险，纯正例监督的SFT使模型缺乏对错误推理路径的识别能力。

Method: VisKG采用两阶段两rollout的RL训练框架：(1) 标准rollout生成图像描述、KG、CoT推理和答案，获得答案奖励和格式奖励；(2) KG-based rollout基于生成的KG重新进行推理，获得最小性奖励（惩罚KG长度）和充分性奖励。采用GDPO（Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization）替代GRPO，通过解耦归一化避免奖励尺度失衡和方差崩溃。SFT阶段引入正负例rationale样本（PN-Rationales数据集），增强模型对错误推理的识别能力。理论层面，KG生成被解释为信息瓶颈问题：在保留回答所需信息的同时最小化冗余视觉信息。

Result: 在MMMU-Pro、MathVerse和MME cognition子集上的实验表明：(1) VisKG性能与基线相当或更优，KG表示比caption平均短16-20%；(2) GDPO训练比GRPO平均提升2%准确率，且训练曲线更稳定；(3) 正负例结合的SFT(b)优于纯正例SFT(p)和纯负例SFT(n)，增强推理鲁棒性；(4) RL训练显著降低triples overlap ratio，提升KG的问题特异性。基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct和Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct两个骨干模型，使用LoRA(r=16, α=32)在单卡H100上约4天完成训练。

Conclusion: VisKG验证了知识图谱作为结构化视觉中间表示在VQA中的有效性，相比自由形式的caption更紧凑且可选择性丢弃无关内容。GDPO在多模态VQA中首次应用，展现了优于GRPO的稳定性。局限性在于：(1) CoT推理质量仍依赖骨干VLM自身能力；(2) KG偏向实体关系型问题，对其他类型问题增益有限。未来工作将探索KG与CoT的显式耦合以及基于问题类型的自适应表示选择（KG/caption/混合）。

Abstract: Recent work in visual question answering has shown that vision-language models can exhibit strong reasoning capabilities by translating visual inputs into textual representations. The effectiveness of this translation depends on how well visual details are retained; models need to surface and align both explicit and implicit knowledge sufficient to support reasoning, without introducing spurious assumptions. Existing methods that leverage detailed image captions introduce visual details unrelated to the reasoning task, inflating input token counts and increasing computational cost. To address these challenges, we propose VisKG, a reinforcement learning (RL) framework in which models learn to translate visual content into question-specific knowledge graph (KG) representations. This process filters out perceptual noise while preserving the entity-relation structure needed for chain-of-thought reasoning, following the principle of minimum sufficient information. To ensure stable RL post-training, VisKG adopts Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO). In addition, we strengthen the supervision stage with negative rationale samples, exposing the model to incorrect reasoning paths before RL post-training. Experimental results across science, mathematics, and general visual understanding benchmarks show that VisKG achieves performance comparable to or better than baselines, while requiring fewer tokens than caption-based representations. Moreover, training VisKG with GDPO improves accuracy by 2% over its GRPO-trained counterpart on average. These results suggest that KG representations are a promising approach for supporting multi-step reasoning and open up future work on adaptively selecting the most suitable representation for a given task.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 僧伽罗语NLP中Sandhi现象掩盖了词汇边界，但此前没有公开的神经基准研究。Sandhi切分对词法分析、形态还原等下游任务至关重要。

Method: 字符级序列到序列（seq2seq）方法，使用双向LSTM编码器和单向LSTM解码器；输入为原生僧伽罗Unicode；分别在词缀型Sandhi（规则）和词汇化/派生/词源型Sandhi（不规则）两个子集上评估；包含消融实验（双向编码、Unicode vs罗马化）。

Result: 最佳模型在词缀型Sandhi上达到94.00%精确匹配准确率；在困难的词汇化/派生/词源型Sandhi上仅68.40%精确匹配（字符级82.08%）。双向编码贡献最大；原生Sinhala脚本优于罗马化输入；错误多为边界近邻字符替换或语音上合理但错误的替换。

Conclusion: 建立了僧伽罗语Sandhi切分的经验基线，未来工作方向包括：扩大数据规模、引入Sandhi类型条件建模、以及采用基于注意力机制的解码方法。

Abstract: Sinhala Sandhi splitting recovers the constituent words or morphemes hidden inside a phonologically merged surface form. The task is important for Sinhala NLP because Sandhi obscures lexical boundaries, but no prior published work has established a neural benchmark for Sinhala Sandhi splitting. We present a character-level sequence-to-sequence study based on SandhiLex, using native Sinhala Unicode input and evaluating recurrent encoder-decoder models for affixational and more complex lexicalized, derivational, and etymological Sandhi. The central challenge is the hard subset lexicalized, derivational, and etymological Sandhi, where our best model, a bidirectional LSTM encoder with a unidirectional LSTM decoder, reaches only 68.40\% exact-match accuracy (82.08\% character-level accuracy), well below the 94.00\% achieved on the more regular affixational subset. Ablations show that bidirectional encoding is the largest contributor to performance, while native Sinhala script improves exact match accuracy over romanized input. Qualitative analysis indicates that many errors are near misses involving boundary adjacent characters or plausible but incorrect phonological substitutions. These results establish an empirical baseline for Sinhala Sandhi splitting and identify data scale, Sandhi type conditioning, and attention-based decoding as the main directions for future work.

</details>


### [85] [Concept Direction Reliability Across Languages with Different Tokenizer Fertility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36194)
*Muhammad Abdullahi Said,Abass Oguntade,Elisha Komolafe,Babangida Sani,Fatima Muhammad Adam,Muhammad Sammani Sani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出使用"半分一致性"（split-half agreement）指标来评估从语言模型表示中提取的情感方向向量的可复现性，发现预测准确率高并不等于方向一致，并在英语、Hausa语和Yoruba语三种不同分词器fertility的语言上发现了系统性差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概念方向向量（如情感方向）被广泛用于解释和操控语言模型的内部表示，但研究者通常只通过下游分类准确率来验证其有效性，而忽略了从不同样本中提取的方向向量本身是否一致。本文质疑"分类准确即方向可靠"的假设，探讨方向向量的可复现性问题。

Method: 采用半分一致性（split-half agreement）作为核心度量：将主题随机分为两组，分别提取情感方向向量并计算余弦相似度。在四个模型（Gemma 4 E2B/E4B/12B和AfroLlama V1）上评估英语、Hausa语和Yoruba语三种语言的原生与翻译文本，对比最终token表示与均值池化表示，并通过逻辑回归probe对比分类准确率。同时控制句子长度等混杂因素，并分析了分词器fertility与一致性之间的关联。

Result: 关键发现：(1) 使用最终token时，一致性在所有77次完整比较中均保持英语>Hausa>Yoruba的排序，具体范围分别为0.737-0.870、0.589-0.762和0.101-0.399；(2) 尽管Yoruba一致性低，所有probe的分类准确率仍显著高于随机水平，证明预测准确率不等同于方向一致性；(3) 均值池化表示的一致性通常低于最终token；(4) 高一致性可能部分反映句子长度而非情感本身；(5) 均值差方向向量比probe权重向量具有更高的一致性。论文明确指出未建立分词器fertility与跨语言差异之间的因果关系。

Conclusion: 需要在表示可解释性研究中独立于分类性能来衡量向量方向的可复现性。成功的probe分类并不证明所提取的情感方向向量是可复现的，不同主题样本可能包含不同的预测特征，使分类准确但方向向量波动。研究者应同时报告分类准确率和方向一致性，检查句子长度等可识别的影响因素，并使用与评估主题分离的主题集来选择层。确定分词器特征是否直接导致跨语言差异需要受控实验设计。

Abstract: Extracted sentiment directions can vary across samples even when downstream sentiment classification remains accurate. To evaluate direction reproducibility, we measure split-half agreement in English, Hausa, and Yoruba representations across four language models using both native and translated texts. We identify layers selected for agreement using ten topics and evaluate direction agreement across separate groups of fifteen topics. Using the final token, split-half agreement ranges from 0.737 to 0.870 for English, 0.589 to 0.762 for Hausa, and 0.101 to 0.399 for Yoruba, maintaining this language rank order across all 77 complete model comparisons. Classifiers trained on these same layers consistently predict sentiment above chance, demonstrating that predictive accuracy does not imply directional consistency. Furthermore, averaging token representations yields less consistent agreement, and high agreement can partially reflect sentence length. Ultimately, our findings highlight the need to measure vector direction reproducibility independently of classification performance, though they do not establish that tokenizer fertility which is the average number of tokens per whitespace separated word causes cross-lingual differences.

</details>


### [86] [Geometric Representations of African Languages: A Regional Semantic Hub and Cultural Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36205)
*Muhammad Abdullahi Said,Jonathan Shock*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究 Gemma 4 31B 多语言模型对非洲语言的内部表征方式及文化引导响应。研究分为两部分：(1) 对比九种非洲语言与三种控制语言（丹麦语、芬兰语、克丘亚语），通过探针、对比方向和表征相似度测量，发现非洲语言之间的"非洲vs西方"对比方向比对控制语言更为一致，跨家族比较在12层中有5层通过 Holm 阈值；尼日利亚境内的 Yoruba-Igbo 对在11/12层比与 Hausa 的配对更对齐。(2) 使用英语语料构建四个非洲国家（尼日利亚、加纳、肯尼亚、南非）的引导方向，union 评分下与随机方向的归因率差异在 0.63–0.81 之间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非洲语言在语言模型开发和评估中长期代表性不足。现有研究关注多语言表征是否以英语为中心或共享语义空间，但缺乏对非洲语言内部区域模式的系统分析。本文旨在通过几何表征方法检验非洲语言是否存在区域性的语义对齐模式，并测试基于英语文化语料构建的方向能否在生成中引导出特定国家的内容。

Method: 模型：Gemma 4 31B（主模型，60层，5376维），Aya Expanse 32B（对比模型）。Study 1：构建含1628条记录的平行语料（37模板×44实体，含城市、语言、食物、地标四类），用 Gemini 3 Pro 翻译至12种语言；测量包括四类实体探针、Africa vs West 对比方向角度、SVCCA、正交 Procrustes；在12个采样层上进行成对余弦比较，使用 Holm 校正的单侧 Mann-Whitney 检验。Study 2：用800对英语对比句构建四国引导方向，在 L24 层进行激活加法干预（α∈{0,20,...,60}），用 Gemini 3 Pro 作为评判器，以词汇评分表和结构一致性诊断评估归因率和连贯性，以 Jeffreys 后验估计与随机方向的差异。

Result: Study 1：(a) 从英语到目标语言的探针迁移因语言和层而异，L19处丹麦语71%、斯瓦希里语61%、约鲁巴语26%；(b) 非洲语言间 Africa-vs-West 方向对齐在 L14–L24 最强，L19 处非洲组内均值余弦0.746，非洲-控制组仅0.345；(c) 跨家族比较在 L9/L14/L19/L24/L44 通过 Holm 阈值（5/12层），但 Afro-Asiatic 内部比较在任何层均未通过；(d) 尼日利亚境内 Yoruba-Igbo 对在11/12层比与 Hausa 的配对平均更对齐0.116；(e) Aya 模型的 SVCCA 更高，Gemma 的 Procrustes 更高。Study 2：在 union 评分下，尼日利亚89%、南非79%、加纳71%、肯尼亚68%，与随机方向的差异为0.81/0.71/0.66/0.63（95% CrI 均排除零）；结构一致性诊断通过率在α≤50时达100%；高强度下归因率下降但连贯性维持。

Conclusion: Gemma 4 31B 的表征在所选 Africa-vs-West 对比上呈现区域和家族模式：非洲语言间对齐强于与控制语言的对齐，跨家族边界在多层成立，尼日利亚境内同家族配对更对齐。模型间的结果排序取决于所选相似度度量。英语国家方向在生成中能有效引导四国归因，效应显著高于匹配范数的随机方向。然而，通用的非洲语义中心假说、非洲语言中的引导、以及两个研究之间的因果联系仍属未验证——语言对和层间依赖限制了统计推断，翻译和文化内容的混杂效应未被分离。

Abstract: We study how Gemma 4 31B represents African languages and responds to cultural steering. The first study compares nine African languages and three controls using probes, contrast directions, and measures of representation similarity. Transfer from English varies across languages and layers. Directions representing an Africa versus West contrast are more aligned among the African languages than between these languages and the controls at several layers. The comparison across language families passes the reported Holm threshold at five of twelve layers, although dependence between language pairs limits the statistical interpretation. Within Nigeria, Yoruba and Igbo are more aligned than the average of their pairs with Hausa at eleven of twelve layers. The second study uses separate English data to construct directions for Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and South Africa. Under union scoring at the selected strengths, estimated differences in attribution rates from random directions range from 0.63 to 0.81. Most outputs pass the automated structural coherence screen. Comparisons with Aya Expanse 32B show that results depend on the representation measure. Together, the studies document regional and family patterns in the sampled representations and country steering in English.

</details>


### [87] [The Canonical Order Problem: When Large Language Models Are Unreliable Knowledge Bases for Multi-Valued Relations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36209)
*Timo Pierre Schrader,Annemarie Friedrich,Simon Razniewski,Lukas Lange*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发现大语言模型(LLM)在生成多值关系时存在"规范顺序问题"：LLM内部按规范顺序（字母序、时间序、数字序等）组织多值关系，当提示偏离该顺序时，生成集合的可靠性显著下降。机制分析表明集合生成经历检索-排序-选择三阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多关注单值关系抽取，但现实中多数关系是多值的（如所有F1冠军、欧盟官方语言）。当使用LLM作为知识库构建多值关系时，常出现遗漏（召回率问题）和错生成（精确率问题）。本文旨在探究LLM内部如何表示和生成多值关系，揭示其在知识库构建中的局限。

Method: 1）构建37个主题的多值关系数据集，涵盖小（<15）、中（15-50）、大（>50）三类集合，包含各类规范顺序；2）对比四种前缀策略：无前缀、首元素前缀、随机单元素前缀、随机k元素前缀，评估F1值；3）使用logit lens技术对Gemma-3 12B进行机制分析，追踪48个隐藏层中的Spearman秩相关性和绝对秩变化；4）在多模型家族（Gemma-3、Llama、Mistral、GPT-OSS）上验证结论的普适性。

Result: 1）提供规范顺序的首元素作为前缀效果最佳，随机打乱前缀则使F1大幅下降（如Gemma-3 1B的k-random从56.9降至42.2），且集合越大、模型越小，受影响越严重；2）机制分析显示：前约25-30层均匀检索所有相关实体（检索阶段），之后约30层起内部规范排序开始显现（排序阶段），最后选择下一个元素（选择阶段）；3）偏离规范顺序会导致排序混乱，被遗漏元素虽在logit空间中排名靠前但从未被选为top-1；4）F1冠军案例表明，首元素前缀产生近乎对角线的有序生成，而末元素前缀导致无序生成且遗漏更多。

Conclusion: LLM并未以结构化方式存储多值关系，而是学习了反映预训练中规范顺序的概率分布。这限制了LLM作为零样本知识库的可靠性，因为生成正确性依赖于提示是否反映规范顺序。建议在预训练中纳入打乱和扰动的多值关系变体以缓解该问题。未来工作应关注从logit分数检测遗漏元素以提升召回率，以及分析频繁变化集合的LLM行为。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as knowledge bases (KBs) due to the vast amount of knowledge they acquire during pre-training. While many works focus on extracting single relational triples, most real-world relations are multi-valued and require generating sets of entities. In this paper, we investigate how LLMs represent and generate multi-valued relations. We identify the canonical order problem: The probabilistic distributions inside LLMs organize many multi-valued relations according to a canonical ordering (e.g., alphabetical or chronological). Through mechanistic analysis, we show that set generation in LLMs can be thought of in terms of three phases: (1) retrieval of candidate entities, (2) internal sorting, and (3) selection of the next element. As a result, prompts aiming to construct KBs that deviate from this internal canonical ordering lead to a markedly reduced reliability of LLMs when aiming to generate complete sets for multi-valued relations.

</details>


### [88] [Lost in Translation: Measuring the Effect of Non-Native English on End User Performance of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36214)
*Yusheng Zhou,Eleanor Lin,David Jurgens*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了FABLE数据集，系统研究非母语英语提示对大语言模型响应的影响。通过控制五个流利度维度（内容、组织、词汇、语言使用、技巧），发现LLM不会传播表面错误，但会镜像高阶修辞和词汇特征，且提示流利度对响应质量有显著影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM用户中非母语英语者增多，已有研究表明他们获得系统性更低质量的响应。然而，由于流利度本身是机械准确性、词汇使用、组织和话语连贯性的复合体，尚不清楚非母语英语的哪些具体特征导致了这种差距。诊断这一差距对于设计有效干预措施以改善非母语用户的LLM体验至关重要。

Method: 1. 数据构建：从WildChat和ShareLM收集174K真实用户提示（英语和中文），经筛选得到173,726个写作相关任务的提示。基于ESL作文评分量表的五个维度（内容、组织、词汇、语言使用、技巧），使用Qwen3-32B为每个中文提示生成多个符合指定流利度配置的英文翻译变体，最终得到190,911个提示变体。2. 流利度量化：使用基于规则的方法（LanguageTool）和LLM-as-judge（gemma-4-26B-A4B）分别评估表面形式特征和修辞/词汇质量。3. 响应评估：在5000个提示变体上评估34个开源LLM，使用Qwen3.8-27B作为评判模型评估响应质量。4. 统计分析：使用线性回归分析提示流利度对响应流利度和质量的影响。

Result: 1. 表面错误不对称：LLM不会将拼写错误等表面错误传播到响应中，提示流利度对响应表面形式特征的关联较弱。2. 高阶特征镜像：LLM会镜像提示中的修辞和词汇质量，内容、组织和词汇水平更高的提示产生对应更高水平的响应。3. 响应质量影响：提示流畅度每增加1分（4分量表），响应质量增加0.04-0.14分（5分量表）。作为对比，模型规模从1B增至10B仅带来约0.21分的提升。4. 内容与技巧维度的响应质量影响最大。5. 不同写作任务中效应方向大体一致，但各维度相对重要性因任务而异。6. 语义匹配配对分析证实，即使语义意图相似，更流利的提示仍获得更高质量的响应。

Conclusion: 研究发现LLM对非母语英语提示存在显著的性能差异。差异主要源于高阶话语和词汇质量而非表面错误。希望FABLE数据集能帮助未来研究诊断和缓解这一不平等问题。本研究揭示了LLM技术公平可及性的重要问题——那些试图利用LLM弥补英语流利度不足的用户，可能因LLM对其语言特征的"镜像"而仍然获得更低质量、更不流利的响应。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used by people whose first language is not English, yet these users have been shown to receive systematically lower-quality responses than fluent speakers. Which specific features of non-native English drive this gap remains unclear, because fluency is itself a composite of mechanical accuracy, vocabulary use, organization, and discourse coherence. Here, we introduce FABLE, a controlled dataset of 190,911 English prompt variants derived from 174K real user prompts for writing-related tasks. Evaluating responses from 34 open-weight LLMs, we find a clear asymmetry; while models do not propagate surface errors such as misspellings into their outputs, models do mirror higher-level rhetorical and lexical qualities present in the user's prompt. Further, the overall quality of responses differs substantially between the least- and most-fluent prompts. These results highlight a key LLM performance disparity for non-native English LLM users, resulting in both lower-quality and less-fluent answers.

</details>


### [89] [Cognitive Expert Language Models Better Align with the Corresponding Brain Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36239)
*Zhivar Sourati,Mengxuan Helen Wu,Nona Ghazizadeh,Jonas Kaplan,Morteza Dehghani,Samuel A. Nastase*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究构建了六个针对不同认知领域（感觉、空间、数值、推理、社交、抽象）的"专家"大语言模型变体，通过提示和LoRA微调两种方式，在三个基础模型和三个fMRI数据集上测试后发现：每个专家模型与其对应认知领域的脑区活动对齐效果最佳，且这种区域特异性的对齐不会改变整体预测精度，表明大语言模型内部可能已编码了与脑功能专门化系统相对应的表征结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往LLM-脑对齐研究采用"一刀切"方法，用单一模型预测全脑活动并汇总性能，忽视了脑区域的功能专门化。本研究旨在探究：针对特定认知领域专门化的模型是否更好地对齐于该领域对应的脑功能系统。

Method: 1. 通过提示（系统指令）和LoRA微调两种方式，在三个基础模型（LLaMA-3-8B、Qwen3-8B、Phi-4-14B）上构建六个认知领域（感觉、空间、数值、推理、社交、抽象）的专家变体。2. 使用线性编码模型在三个fMRI数据集（LeBel叙事、LPP、Pereira句子）上测量每个专家与各脑区的对齐度。3. 脑区定义来自Neurosynth元分析图谱。4. 构建五类对照组（随机LoRA、仅种子、随机提示、表面形式、关键词）验证认知内容特异性。

Result: 1. 在18种基础模型×干预×数据集组合中，所有专家在其对应脑区的对齐排名均高于随机水平（正位移量），其中12个达到统计显著。2. 对照组（非认知干预）不产生类似的区域特异性对齐，14/18的认知专家配置超过种子对照的95百分位。3. 模型专门化改变了区域对齐但几乎不改变整体预测精度（LPP上LLaMA整体精度变化仅+0.1%和+1.0%），提示全脑汇总指标可能掩盖区域差异。4. 提示与微调效果相当，但各自擅长的专家不同（提示擅长空间，微调擅长数值）。5. 专门化使专家间的表征分离增大，但表征分离越大并不带来更好的脑对齐。

Conclusion: 仅通过文本训练的大语言模型已包含与脑认知专门化系统对应的潜在表征，专门化干预（即使是简单的系统提示）能将这些表征"召唤"出来，使其与对应脑区的活动模式更吻合。专门化LLM可作为可控的模型系统，用于对特定脑功能系统进行硅基实验。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can predict human brain activity across a variety of brain regions during natural language comprehension. Typically, however, LLM-brain alignment is measured using one model for different regions of the brain, and then model performance is summarized across regions. This one-model-fits-all approach ignores the functional specialization of brain regions. In this study, we assess whether a model oriented toward a particular cognitive domain aligns better with the brain system dedicated to that domain. Through prompting and fine-tuning, we first build expert LLM variants for six domains: sensory, spatial, numerical, reasoning, social, and abstract processing. We then examine whether each expert best predicts activity in the brain region associated with the corresponding cognitive domain. Consistent with our hypotheses, each expert's representations align more closely with the brain system most associated with the matching domain than do other experts. This holds under both prompting and fine-tuning, across three base models and three fMRI datasets. In a series of control analyses, we show that this model-brain alignment is specific to cognitive domain interventions; non-cognitive and surface-level interventions do not result in comparable alignment. Specializing models shifts regional alignment while leaving aggregate prediction accuracy largely unchanged, suggesting that summarizing alignment across regions may obscure regional differences in performance for specific models.

</details>


### [90] [Learning from Teacher Continuations at Student States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36246)
*Haojin Wang,Dylan Zhang,Huaibo Chen,Suhao Yu,Yihang Sun,Zhanyang Jin,Jiaying Ye,Dianqi Li,Prasanna Sattigeri,Kamal Youcef-Toumi,Hao Peng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 OLIVE（OnLine InterVEntion）：一种在线蒸馏方法，通过让教师在学生当前生成的前缀基础上继续自回归生成，并以交叉熵损失训练学生，从而解决离线 SFT 的协变量偏移、token 级 OPD 的监督碎片化以及分布匹配蒸馏需要教师 logits 的限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有蒸馏方法存在三大局限：(1) 离线 SFT 在固定教师轨迹上训练，导致序列协变量偏移，学生在自身状态上表现不佳；(2) token 级 OPD 虽在学生策略上采样，但当早期 token 出错时，后续监督仍基于错误前缀，未示范如何纠正；(3) 分布匹配 OPD 需要教师 token 概率，无法用于黑盒教师。这些限制在大能力差距和长视野智能体任务中尤为突出。

Method: OLIVE 包含三个核心设计：(1) 在线收集学生前缀 — 每次更新前由当前学生策略采样 k 个 token（或 k 轮交互）作为前缀；(2) 教师续接 — 教师以自身分布在前缀后自回归生成至多 M 个 token 的续接内容；(3) 后缀交叉熵 — 仅对教师生成部分计算 CE 损失，前缀被掩码。此外引入异步实现，将下一批次学生前缀采样与当前批次教师续接重叠，以异步深度 d 控制策略滞后，使总训练时间相对同步减少 23.8%。方法还扩展到多轮智能体任务，保留完整交互历史，仅对教师动作计算 CE。

Result: 在 RLVE 推理任务上，OLIVE（异步 d=3）相对原始学生提升 pass@8 6–8 点，相对 OPD 提升 avg@8 4.4–5.4 点；在五个 AgentGym 智能体任务（ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、TextCraft、BabyAI、SearchQA）上平均 SR 提升 7–22 点，ScienceWorld 上从近零提升至 7.5%，而 OPD 完全失败。异步实现训练时间比同步减少 23.8%，且比 OPD 减少约 28%。在 ScienceWorld 上，使用 GPT-5.4-mini 作为黑盒教师，5 epoch 后 OLIVE 相对离线 SFT 提升 13%。OLIVE 在通用基准（AIME25、LiveCoding Bench v6、IF-Eval、GPQA Diamond）上平均仅引入 0.9% 性能下降，且在顺序训练多个智能体环境时显著保留学生可塑性。在终端代理 TBLite 子集上，pass@4 从 10.0% 提升至 12.5%，而 OPD 无改善。

Conclusion: OLIVE 是一种基于教师续接的在线语言模型蒸馏方法，通过将监督锚定在学生自身可达状态并随策略更新而刷新，在硬推理和长视野智能体任务上持续优于现有蒸馏方法，同时支持黑盒教师、保留学生通用能力与可塑性。结论指出：蒸馏设计除关注监督形式外，监督的放置位置与是否随学生变化而刷新同样是一个重要设计维度。

Abstract: We present OLIVE (OnLine InterVEntion). At each iteration, the evolving student policy generates a new prefix, the teacher continues it autoregressively, and the student is updated using cross-entropy computed on the teacher-generated tokens. Each design choice targets a corresponding limitation of existing distillation methods: (1) sequential covariate shift in offline supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on fixed teacher trajectories, (2) fragmented supervision under prefix failure in token-level on-policy distillation (OPD), and (3) the need for access to teacher token probabilities in distribution-matching distillation. OLIVE achieves higher reasoning performance than OPD (with a top-16 KL approximation) at comparable GPU-hour cost. Our asynchronous implementation further reduces OLIVE's total training time by 23.8\%. We evaluate OLIVE on both hard reasoning tasks and agentic tasks which reflects modern post-training scenarios, and it consistently outperforms existing distillation methods under the same training budget. By regenerating prefixes from the evolving student, OLIVE continues improving after offline distillation plateaus while better preserving the general capabilities and plasticity of the student. Using only text from GPT-5.4-mini, continuously training with OLIVE outperforms offline SFT from the same teacher by 13\% on ScienceWorld. These results support OLIVE as an effective and efficient approach to online language-model distillation.

</details>


### [91] [DeepRewind: Predicting and Repairing Premature Commitments in Deep Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36344)
*Amirhossein Abaskohi,Amirhossein Dabiriaghdam,Lele Wang,Peter West,Giuseppe Carenini*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DeepRewind是一个用于深度研究智能体的可逆控制层，通过将研究状态建模为类型化图、预测承诺的可逆性、门控阻止风险承诺，并在证据失效时执行依赖感知的部分回滚，从而在DRBench和LiveDRBench上相对Open Deep Research提升3.6个百分点的洞察召回率、降低59.1%的过早承诺率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度研究智能体在长程信息检索中容易过早承诺某个主张、假设或草稿结论，导致后续推理被错误解释锁定并不断强化。已有方法（反思、树搜索、记忆等）虽然能回顾失败或探索替代路径，但既不预测承诺如何改变智能体的认知状态，也无法在承诺失效时识别需要修复的最小下游决策集合。

Method: DeepRewind作为附加控制层叠加在Open Deep Research之上，将智能体的认知状态表示为类型化加权有向图（节点包括Source、Evidence、Claim、Hypothesis、Assumption、Commitment、DraftFragment、PlanStep，边类型包括supports、contradicts、depends_on、used_in、locks_in等）。在每次候选承诺执行前，将序列化图与候选动作送入基于提示的研究状态世界模型（GPT-4o，温度0），预测图变化δG及可逆性元数据：假设收窄度κ、信息损失率、信息损失λ、恢复成本γ、矛盾触发条件θ及触发覆盖度TC。二元控制器根据不可逆风险IRR=clip(α_κκ+α_λλ+α_γγ)或效用U=V(a_t)−η·IRR·(1−TC)在阈值/效用模式下决定commit或not-commit；被争议的claim永不被承诺。一致性监控器在新证据进入图时检查触发条件，若满足且claim信念低于β*，则执行依赖感知的确定性reduced rollback：仅撤销该承诺及其独有支撑，移除承诺特有的依赖边，将下游DraftFragment/PlanStep/Hypothesis标记为stale或retracted，保留独立支持的发现，全部过程无需额外LLM调用。系统还提供默认关闭的初始条件注入（支持/反驳/中性/干扰证据）和备选切换干预钩子用于受控分析。

Result: 在DRBench和LiveDRBench各100个任务上，使用GPT-4o、GPT-5.4、Qwen3.5-27B、DeepSeek-V4 Pro四种骨干的实验中，DeepRewind在所有模型和基准上一致提升精确率与召回率，平均召回率提升3.6个百分点、精确率提升3.1个百分点；GPT-5.4最强，DeepRewind在DRBench上达40.3%召回、在LiveDRBench上达35.6%召回。过早承诺率（被后续证据推翻的承诺占比）相对ODR降低59.1%。在初始证据操控实验中（支持/反驳/干扰证据），DeepRewind平均抗性提升29.5个百分点，其中Early-Counter条件下提升37.8个百分点。在初始信念选择实验中，最劣起点下DeepRewind的精确率提升约6.5、召回率提升约5.0个百分点，过早承诺率降低26.2个百分点。组件消融表明图记录与世界模型预测单独作用有限，reduced rollback可改善最终性能，预承诺门控带来更大增益，二者组合效果最佳。世界模型LLM替换实验（Qwen3.5-27B/DeepSeek-V4 Pro/GPT-5.4）显示结果稳定，对特定世界模型依赖较小。代价方面，DeepRewind平均每任务调用世界模型4.8次，输入token增加6.5%、输出token增加4.2%、挂钟延迟增加14%。

Conclusion: DeepRewind通过显式建模智能体的认知状态图、预测承诺的可逆性、在承诺前门控风险承诺、以及执行依赖感知的局部回滚，有效缓解了深度研究智能体中的过早承诺问题，显著提升长程研究中洞察的精确率与召回率，并增强对误导性初始证据与不利起始信念的鲁棒性。研究表明在长程研究智能体中显式建模承诺可逆性具有重要价值；未来工作可将以提示驱动的世界模型替换为学习得到的图或结构化转移模型，并构建专家标注的研究状态转移数据以进一步评估预测的准确性。

Abstract: Deep-research agents conduct long-horizon investigations through iterative search, evidence evaluation, belief revision, and synthesis. However, they may commit to claims before sufficient evidence is available, causing later reasoning to reinforce an incorrect interpretation. We introduce DeepRewind, an additive control layer for reversible deep research that represents the agent's evolving epistemic state as a typed graph of sources, evidence, claims, hypotheses, assumptions, commitments, plans, and drafts. Before accepting an intermediate conclusion, a prompt-based world model predicts its impact and estimates reversibility based on hypothesis narrowing, information loss, recovery cost, and contradiction-trigger coverage. A binary controller blocks risky commitments, while a consistency monitor performs dependency-aware rollback when later evidence invalidates them. Across DRBench and LiveDRBench, DeepRewind improves insight recall by 3.6 percentage points and reduces premature commitments by 59.1% relative to Open Deep Research.

</details>


### [92] [Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind: Systematically Erasing LLM's Memories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36414)
*Olga Ohrimenko*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究持久化LLM系统中用户信息删除问题，提出DeLLM框架，通过外部存储和来源图（provenance graph）系统性地擦除LLM记忆中用户请求删除的信息及其派生内容，在保持系统实用性的同时实现高删除率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前主流LLM聊天机器人（如ChatGPT、Copilot、Gemini）支持长期记忆，但用户请求删除信息时，信息仍会通过上下文依赖间接留存。简单的语义匹配删除无法满足用户对隐私数据彻底清除的需求，存在隐私泄露风险。

Method: 提出DeLLM框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) 查询处理器Q（无状态的LLM）；(2) 持久化消息存储D（基于PostgreSQL，支持语义搜索）；(3) 来源图G（追踪消息间上下文依赖的有向无环图）。系统动态构建相关上下文（仅检索top-5语义相似消息），并在每次LLM回复后记录依赖关系。删除时，通过遍历来源图找到所有被污染消息并一并删除。

Result: 在DMR、PF和TOFU三个数据集上，DeLLM实现了远高于LLM w/ memory基线的删除率（PF数据集从96%降至2.5%），同时在retain数据上保持甚至提升了实用性（TOFU数据集上retain数据准确率从83.5%提升至89.3%）。相比基于语义阈值的删除方法，DeLLM无需调整数据集相关的阈值即可实现精准删除。

Conclusion: DeLLM是首个支持从LLM对话历史中系统性删除消息及其派生内容的系统，通过来源图追踪信息流解决了消息依赖导致的残留问题。该工作开辟了LLM记忆删除这一新研究方向，与机器遗忘不同，关注的是对话上下文中数据的删除而非模型参数的遗忘。

Abstract: We consider persistent LLMs that accumulate memories of their interactions with a user over time. Such LLMs maintain memories using external storage, which they can query to overcome the limitations of a fixed context window. Such systems have numerous practical applications, as they can draw on all past interactions when responding to user queries. In this paper, we ask whether LLMs can forget information shared with them upon a user's request. We find that current LLMs fail to delete such information---even when they claim to have forgotten it and even when operating with a limited context. To this end, we consider a new direction of study: Deletion of LLM Memories. We show that naively removing messages that match a user's deletion request is insufficient, since conversations naturally introduce message dependencies that cause information to persist. To correctly handle deletion requests, we propose the DeLLM framework. It dynamically constructs relevant context for each LLM query and maintains a provenance graph of messages to determine which ones must be removed during deletion. Our experiments show that DeLLM achieves a high deletion rate while maintaining utility.

</details>


### [93] [MemFold: Learning Compact Soft Memory for Long-Context Personalization via On-Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36435)
*Jingxuan Wu,Yuzhe Yang,Yiqiao Huang,Chengzhi Liu,Qingni Wang,Chengxuan Qian,Shutong Wu,Jiawei Zhang,Xin Eric Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MemFold提出了一种针对长上下文个性化场景的固定预算软记忆方法，通过将查询条件化的文本记忆压缩为K个连续向量作为读者接口，并使用基于读者自身rollout的策略优化（GRPO任务奖励 + 置信度门控的on-policy蒸馏）进行训练，避免了在读者从未生成的序列上打分的传统做法。在三个Qwen骨干上，MemFold在PersonaMem-32K/128K上达到最高准确率，且能零样本迁移到PrefEval和LongMemEval。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程助手需要在用户偏好随时间演化的条件下回答问题。现有方法存在两个割裂：(1) 文本记忆让读者输入随历史增长；(2) 潜在记忆压缩器通常在读者从未生成的序列上训练（文本重建或参考答案模仿），无法优化"压缩后记忆实际支撑何种行为"这一目标。任务奖励虽然评估rollout但仅提供序列级信号，无法定位哪些token未能利用记忆内容。

Method: MemFold包含两个核心组件：(1) 固定预算软记忆接口——使用Perceiver式压缩器将查询条件化的结构化文本记忆M压缩为K个连续向量Z；(2) 策略内记忆优化——在读者自身rollout上联合优化两个目标：GRPO任务奖励（序列级正确性信号）+ 置信度门控的on-policy蒸馏（OPD）。OPD中，冻结的文本记忆教师对学生的采样token重新打分，使用门控ḡ=σ(β(ℓ_T - ℓ_θ))对学生自身token加权——教师从不采样，监督保持在学生当前分布上，推理时完全移除。初始化阶段包括记忆写入器训练、压缩器重建、表示warmup、辅助推理适配和读者初始化五个顺序步骤。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-3B/7B-Instruct和Qwen3-4B三个骨干上，MemFold在PersonaMem-32K和PersonaMem-128K均取得最高准确率（如3B模型从70.0提升至70.0（32K）和88.4 vs 58.4-66.1（128K）），优势在更长历史上扩大。零样本迁移到PrefEval和LongMemEval也取得最优/有竞争力结果。消融实验表明GRPO贡献主要任务增益，OPD提供额外补充增益；记忆干预（shuffled/null memory）证明读者确实依赖实例特定的记忆内容。预算K在128-512范围内表现稳定且峰值在256。

Conclusion: MemFold通过将紧凑个性化记忆的评判标准从"能否重建文本"转变为"能支撑何种行为"，实现了固定预算软记忆的端到端优化。理论分析表明OPD在期望上表现为有界per-token系数的饱和反向KL，且永远不会引入教师自身未在学生support内的选择。这为长程个性化助手的记忆机制设计提供了一个新的优化范式。

Abstract: An assistant that serves the same user over a long horizon has to answer from what that user has revealed: which preferences still hold, which were revised, and which constraints apply now. Retaining that information is not the same as acting on it, and the two are usually optimized as if they were. Keeping the information as text makes the reader's input grow with the retained history, while compressing it into a fixed number of latent vectors bounds the interface but is typically trained to reconstruct text or imitate reference answers, both of which are scored on sequences the reader never produced. We present MemFold, which optimizes a fixed-budget soft memory by the behavior it supports. A query-conditioned textual memory is compressed into K continuous vectors that form the reader's memory interface, and the reader is then trained on its own rollouts under two complementary signals: group-relative rewards for task outcomes, and confidence-gated on-policy distillation in which a frozen textual-memory teacher re-scores the student's sampled tokens under the textual memory. The teacher is never sampled from, so supervision stays on the student's current distribution and adds no autoregressive decoding; at inference it is removed entirely. Across three Qwen backbones, MemFold attains the highest accuracy we measure on PersonaMem-32K and PersonaMem-128K, with margins that widen at the longer history length, and transfers to PrefEval and LongMemEval without target-domain training. Ablations attribute most of the task gain to the reward term and a smaller additional gain to the teacher signal, and memory interventions show that the reader depends on the instance-specific content of its soft memory.

</details>


### [94] [Memory Consolidation Flattens the Temporal Shape of User Facts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36457)
*Sugam Panthi,Muhaiminul Yeamin,Siyan Luo,Rabab Abdelfattah*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了长期记忆系统中存在"体貌扁平化"(aspectual flattening)现象：记忆写入器在将对话转化为存储笔记时，会选择性地丢失动词的时态/体貌信息（如将"我正在开标致"改写为"用户开标致"），从而抹去了"该事实是否仍然有效"的关键线索。基于Lapse基准测试和11个模型配置（含mem0、Graphiti、Letta三个已部署流水线），研究发现：(1)写入器在244/381对配对中将进行体改写为静态体，无一反向；(2)仅修改存储的动词会改变后续读者模型的持久性估计和行动决策（如GLM-5.2在8个月时主动行动比例相差25个百分点）。该研究将"存储什么"与"如何使用"分离，证明了记忆写入阶段会不可逆地擦除下游决策所需的时态证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长期记忆系统关注存储、检索、衰减、矛盾和时间戳等机制，但忽略了用户措辞中蕴含的"该事实是否仍然有效"的体貌（aspect）证据。例如"我正在开标致"（进行体，暗示活动正在进行）vs."我开标致"（一般现在时，暗示稳定状态），两者在存储后可能被改写为相同的笔记"用户开标致"，丢失了对事实有效性的判断线索。论文研究：记忆写入是否保留了体貌证据？后续读者是否会利用这些证据？

Method: 构建Lapse基准测试（Linguistic Aspect Persistence and Stability Evaluation）：使用配对用户语句，仅时态形式不同，其他因素（话题、动词、对话语境carrier、时间间隔）完全一致。设计因素包括：Form（5种：进行体、一般现在时、有限体、完成进行体、完成体）、Frame（8种事实类型：住宿、工作场所、车辆、班级、家庭、设备、附属角色、项目）、Carrier（6种对话语境）、Gap（6种时间间隔）、Task（7种任务类型）。主要测试：进行体vs.一般现在时，life-update语境，245天stale间隔，128对配对/配置。采用确定性规则级联标注写入输出（faithful/coerced-stative/manufacture/residual/witness-dropped），行为输出由规则级联+Seed-OSS-36B-Instruct法官+人工金标集共同标注。三组确认性配置（DeepSeek V4 Flash、GPT-5.6 Luna、GLM-5.2），11个配置含已部署流水线mem0、Graphiti、Letta。统计方法：单侧精确McNemar检验，Holm多重比较校正。读时任务：记忆使用任务、有日期笔记任务、最小编辑任务、验证工具任务（行动vs.询问用户）。

Result: 写入结果：三组确认性配置中，进行体被破坏率81.2%/61.7%/55.2%，简单现在时破坏率0%/0%/8/127，244/381对配对仅进行体被破坏，无反向。所有11个配置中807对仅进行体被破坏，仅2对反向（均来自Claude Sonnet 5）。mem0用DeepSeek时扁平化49/128，Graphiti 15/32，Letta 26/29。框架差异显著：车辆和工作场所扁平化最严重。读取结果：记忆使用任务无法检测（读者在60个已过期事实中使用59-60个）。有日期笔记任务：所有三读者对stale进行体的持久性估计比配对简单现在体低16-32点。最小编辑实验：扁平化57个保留进行体的笔记使所有读者持久性估计上升（DeepSeek +37.3, Luna +18.2, GLM +24.6点）。验证工具任务：GLM-5.2在8个月时，简单现在体笔记主动行动187/291次vs.进行体116/291次（差异+25pp, p=2.8×10⁻¹²）。Gemini 3 Flash在1个月时差异+7pp (p=1.9×10⁻⁵)。当无任何线索存留时（Graphiti 47个扁平化事实中40个字符串相同），读者无可靠差异。

Conclusion: 记忆写入可在保留用户事实的同时移除时态形式的证据。Lapse通过配对语言对比分离了这一损失，并区分了写入器存储的内容与后续读者的使用方式。扁平化程度因框架和写入器而异，暗示将体貌视为单一统一特征是不恰当的。设计建议：存储应分离原始措辞、归一化事实、时态形式和观察时间为独立字段，由后续决策规则综合证据，而非将语法视为过期日期。存储的日期也需从源中正确派生（如Graphiti的valid_at记录学习时间而非事件开始时间，可能误导读者）。该研究为长期记忆系统的可解释性和可靠性提供了重要诊断工具。

Abstract: Long-term memory systems turn conversations into short stored notes. A note can keep a user fact while losing evidence about whether the fact still holds. For example, "I am driving a Peugeot" can become "The user drives a Peugeot," which drops the cue that the activity is ongoing. We call this aspectual flattening and measure it with LAPSE, a benchmark of matched user statements that differ only in temporal form. We find that memory writers flatten aspect selectively. Three writer models flattened the progressive statement but kept its simple-present match in 244 of 381 pairs, never the reverse. The asymmetry holds in all 11 model configurations tested and in the installed pipelines mem0, Graphiti, and Letta. The lost cue matters to later readers. In exploratory tests, changing only the stored verb shifted all three readers' estimates that a fact still holds. When readers could ask the user before acting, two of three acted without asking more often on flattened notes. Our planned memory-use task could not detect this, because readers there acted on almost every stored fact, even expired ones. Memory writing can thus remove evidence that later models use to decide whether to act.

</details>


### [95] [Retrieval Sensitivity to Identity Signals in Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36534)
*Andrew Tang,Nicholas Deas,Kathleen McKeown,Vishal Misra*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究揭示密集检索器对查询中的身份信号（政治意识形态和方言）存在系统性偏见：检索结果倾向于与查询者的政治倾向一致，且对非裔美国人英语（AAL）健康查询的检索质量低于白人主流英语（WME）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检索系统决定了用户和下游大语言模型看到的内容。如果检索器对查询中的身份信号（如政治倾向和方言）敏感，可能加剧政治极化并强化AAL使用者面临的健康不平等。现有研究主要考察中性查询和检索结果中的偏见，而忽略了查询本身的身份信号如何影响检索结果。

Method: 研究在两个领域（政治新闻和消费健康问题）构建了评估集，每个领域包含一个受控的合成查询集（仅改变身份信号）和一个自然查询集。评估了五个密集检索器和BM25稀疏基线。在政治新闻领域使用AllSides合成查询（配对的左/右倾查询，共享同一框架和文章）和Reddit自然查询（来自r/AskALiberal和r/AskConservatives）。在健康领域使用HCMagic合成查询（将WME查询通过形态句法和正字法方法改写为AAL）和HCMagic自然查询。使用两个分析来分离词法和非词法成分：1）通过Monroe-Colaresi-Quinn对数比偏度分控制词法不对称；2）在密集检索器的查询嵌入上训练线性探针（包括条件探针测量超越非上下文嵌入的信息）。

Result: 所有六个检索器均表现出显著的政治"自身倾向"偏见，即倾向于检索与查询政治倾向一致的文章（p < 0.05）。在健康领域，所有检索器对WME查询的MRR均显著高于AAL查询。在受控合成数据集上，控制词法不对称后，偏见差距几乎不变，且线性探针能以约85%（政治）和99%（方言）的F1从查询嵌入中恢复身份信息，且条件探针增益表明这一信号超越了纯词法层面。Back-translation缓解策略仅对部分较弱的检索器有效，无法完全弥合差距。

Conclusion: 密集检索器对查询本身的身份信号敏感，无论是在内容控制的配对设计还是自然发生的查询中，检索都向提问者的政治倾向转变，且对AAL查询的排序低于WME。在内容控制的合成对比中，控制词法不对称后差距依然存在，政治倾向和方言可从查询嵌入中线性恢复，表明偏见追踪的是查询的身份信号而非仅仅是表面词汇。这些转变可能加剧政治极化和AAL使用者面临的健康差距，且跨架构一致，back-translation无法解决，需要表征层面的缓解措施。

Abstract: Dense retrievers decide which documents reach users and the language models that use them, yet they are typically evaluated with neutral queries. We ask whether the identity signals that real users express in their queries---political ideology and dialect---bias what a retriever returns. We design evaluations in two domains, political news and consumer-health questions, each pairing a controlled synthetic set that varies only the identity signal with naturalistic queries. Across five dense retrievers and a sparse baseline, every retriever (i) retrieves articles that align with the query's own political lean and (ii) performs worse for questions written in African American Language (AAL) than in White Mainstream English (WME). Two analyses tie these gaps to queries' identity signals beyond surface vocabulary: partialling out an aggregate lexical-asymmetry score leaves the synthetic gaps largely intact, and linear probes recover lean and dialect from the retrievers' query embeddings beyond token-level features. Left unaddressed, such retrieval biases risk contributing to polarization and reinforcing the health disparities already faced by AAL speakers. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [96] [When Updating Stops Being Learning: Rethinking LLM Self-Evolution via learnable information gain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36535)
*Chenxu Wang,Chaozhuo Li,Xinze Shi,Songyang Liu,Kyrie You Wu,Ziluowen Luo,Shun Zhang,Chenxi Li,Litian Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文针对LLM自演化(self-evolution)中常见的性能退化(先升后降)问题，提出了一种基于"可学习信息增益"(learnable information gain)的系统性诊断框架，并据此设计了ATRI方法。该信息增益在理论上等于两轮数据分布间的KL散度加上熵变化，在实践中通过拟合小型代理模型并用NLL评分来估计。ATRI在轮内按信息增益对样本重加权，在轮间当增益持续低于阈值时停止训练。实验表明该方法在多个推理基准上优于现有自演化基线，并能提前预警性能退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM自演化方法（迭代使用自身生成数据进行训练）普遍存在"自演化退化"现象：性能先提升后下降。现有方法仅从Questioner或Solver单一组件层面进行干预，忽略了自演化是一个紧密耦合的整体系统，缺乏系统层面的诊断与缓解机制。

Method: 1. 定义"可学习信息增益"：理论上一轮数据相对于上一轮提供的新可参数化信息量，等于KL散度+熵变化；实践中用小型语言模型(Pythia-160M)拟合上一轮数据，用NLL对当前轮数据进行评分，增益定义为当前轮平均NLL减去上一轮平均NLL。2. 提出ATRI框架：(a) 轮内按样本信息增益对GRPO advantage进行重加权；(b) 轮间当C_t连续两轮低于阈值(τ=0.1C₁)时停止训练。3. 信息论上证明闭合环路存在"生成包含"(Generative Containment)约束，解释退化的根本原因。4. 扩展方向性信息增益C_t^d用于外部数据选择。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B/8B-Base上，使用R-Diverse评估套件（7个数学推理+3个通用推理基准），ATRI在两个模型上均取得最佳综合性能（Qwen3-4B: Math AVG 53.55 vs 最佳基线52.56；Qwen3-8B: 58.94 vs 56.49）。六个基线方法均呈现三阶段生命周期，C_t警报比准确率峰值早1-4轮触发，验证了系统性诊断的有效性。在Phase III，pass@8下降19.8点，路径熵下降36.5%，证实解空间收缩。C_t控制层计算开销小（相对开销2.2%-4.1%），且随基础模型增大比例下降。

Conclusion: ATRI提供了一种系统层面的诊断工具和干预机制，通过可学习信息增益有效缓解了LLM自演化中的性能退化问题。其核心贡献在于：(1) 将闭环自演化的退化现象归因于"生成包含"信息论约束；(2) 提供了一个独立于具体方法的通用诊断信号；(3) 通过轮内重加权和轮间早停两个机制实现计算高效（仅增加约2%开销）的退化缓解。C_t还可作为方法无关的监控器应用于任何自演化算法。

Abstract: Self-evolution lets large language models (LLMs) improve iteratively using their own generated data, but often suffers from self-evolution degeneration: performance improves, plateaus, then declines. Existing methods address this issue at the component level, targeting either the Questioner or the Solver, and overlook that self-evolution is a tightly coupled system. We propose a holistic framework based on learnable information gain, which measures how much novel, parameterizable information a round provides relative to the previous round. Theoretically, this gain equals the Kullback-Leibler divergence between the two rounds' data distributions plus their entropy change. Practically, it is estimated by fitting a small language model to the previous round and scoring new data via negative log-likelihood. Based on this diagnostic, we propose ATRI (Adaptive Training Regulation via Information-gain), which reweights samples within a round and halts training across rounds when information gain remains low. Experiments on popular datasets demonstrate the superiority of our proposal.

</details>


### [97] [Grounded Revision vs. Prior Injection: Probing Retrieval-Augmented Patent Claim Amendment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36550)
*Josepha Michiko Leo,Hyun-seok Min,Yehoon Jang,Irvan Zidny,Jin-Woo Chung,Sungchul Choi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文通过构建专利权利要求修订数据集（7,385个USPTO案例）和探针评估协议，对四个前沿大语言模型（Claude Sonnet 4、Claude Haiku 4.5、GPT-5.4、GPT-4o-mini）进行受控实验，测试检索增强生成（RAG）是真正"基础性修订"还是仅"先验注入"。结果显示无模型表现出显著先验注入行为，检索效应小且方向不一致，先验注入分类单元为空。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商业系统（如PatentGPT、IPRally Drafter）声称检索增强修订能提高输出质量，但缺乏同行评审的独立验证。RAG在专业写作中的实际机制（结构性相似性驱动 vs. 通用模板注入）尚无明确实证。专利权利要求修订提供了具有法律定义"正确性"的独特测试场景：审查员明确指出被攻击的权利要求限制并引用现有技术。

Method: 三大核心组件：(1) USPTO起诉案件语料库（7,385个XML对齐的四元组：修订前权利要求、驳回、引证现有技术、修订后权利要求）；(2) 七项探针协议（五个观察性探针A-E + 两个检索干预探针F随机/G结构匹配），固定提示模板下对比随机与结构匹配检索策略；(3) 确定性五通道指标（C1基础对齐、C2修订局部性、C3范围保留、C4稳健性、C5模板依赖性），无需LLM评判。预注册三个假设：H1（检索作为先验注入锚点）、H2（相似性为二阶效应）、H3（模板回收膨胀）。在四种前沿模型上执行9,600次预注册调用。

Result: 关键结果：(1) 没有任何测试模型显示可检测的经典先验注入行为，ΔC5均未超过预注册阈值+0.2（最大+0.20，GPT-4o-mini恰好在边界）；(2) 检索效应小且在随机vs结构检索间方向不一致；(3) 零假设在密集（语义）检索器、检索深度k∈{1,3,5,10}、释义敏感基础性指标下均成立；(4) 修订局部性（C2）揭示模板通道遗漏的模型特异性差异（GPT-5.4为唯一例外）；(5) 四单元分类法中先验注入单元未占据：Sonnet 4为"锚定基础修订者"，GPT-5.4和GPT-4o-mini为"结构匹配者"，Haiku 4.5为"惰性/轻度先验注入者"。H1被全部四个模型拒绝，H2仅Sonnet 4支持，H3仅Haiku 4.5支持。

Conclusion: 在四模型、单语料库设置下，预注册测试未发现任何模型超过H1先验注入阈值。零假设在随机、结构、密集三种检索机制及k∈{1,3,5,10}深度范围内均稳健。修订局部性（C2）显示模板通道遗漏的模型特异性信号。研究发布完整框架、语料库和评分代码，协议可应用于商业技术栈和其他检索配置，单元占据情况可能不同。该框架价值不依赖于零结果本身：即使在没有先验注入的情况下，也能通过多通道诊断识别模型特定行为模式，为RAG系统评估提供超越单通道评分的诊断工具。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation is widely used in professional writing, yet whether retrieval grounds revision or merely injects templates is rarely tested where "correct" has a definable meaning. Patent claim amendment supplies that signal: the examiner names the attacked limitation and cites prior art, providing per-case ground truth. We release three artifacts: (i) a corpus of 7,385 USPTO prosecution cases with XML-aligned pre/post claims, rejection, and cited prior art; (ii) a seven-probe battery comparing random and structural-match retrieval as two policies under a fixed prompt scaffold; (iii) a deterministic five-channel metric (C1-C3 and C5 in main, C4 supplementary) requiring no LLM evaluation. Across 9,600 pre-registered calls on four frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4, Claude Haiku 4.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-4o-mini), no tested model exhibits detectable classical prior-injection behavior; retrieval effects are small and direction-inconsistent between random and structural retrieval, and the null is unchanged under a dense (semantic) retriever, across retrieval depths k in {1,3,5,10}, and under a paraphrase-sensitive grounding metric. Revision locality reveals a model-specific difference that the template channel misses. The four-cell taxonomy, which we treat as exploratory, leaves the prior-injector cell unoccupied.

</details>


### [98] [Generating Edit-Inducing Questions for AI Research Manuscripts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36617)
*Sebastian Joseph,Zichao Wang,Jennifer Healey,Alexa Siu,Junyi Jessy Li,Ani Nenkova*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM生成"能引发编辑的问题"以改进AI研究论文草稿的能力,通过对比GPT模型与人类审稿人在ICLR/NeurIPS投稿与最终版数据集上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学术论文写作常因"知识的诅咒"而难以有效传达,而同行评审反馈获取困难且有限,亟需自动化、高质量的反馈生成方法。

Method: 基于PeerQA数据集中116篇ICLR/NeurIPS论文的投稿与终稿对,使用GPT-4o和o3在三种上下文设置(全文/线性/段落)下生成问题,定义四项评估指标(valid、edit-inducing、edit rate、edit coverage),并通过自动化答案检测流程评估问题质量。

Result: GPT模型生成的edit-inducing问题数量是人类审稿人的10倍以上(11-19个 vs 1个),且每个问题对应的编辑范围更大,覆盖了作者约一半的修改内容。但GPT问题中edit-inducing的比例较低(7-10%)。推理模型(o3)在有效问题比例和生成质量上优于非推理模型(GPT-4o),且GPT-4o问题更具抽取性(词汇重叠率更高)。

Conclusion: LLM作为"不知疲倦的读者"可有效辅助论文作者,生成比人类审稿人数量更多、覆盖更广的edit-inducing问题;但需进一步研究如何高效剪枝低质量问题,且应注意长上下文可能损害推理模型的输出质量。

Abstract: We study the ability of LLMs to generate edit-inducing questions whose answer will improve a paper draft. On a dataset of paired submission and camera-ready papers from ICLR and NeurIPS, we compare the helpfulness of questions from GPT models with or without full paper context to that of human reviewers. GPT produces more edit-inducing questions and its questions are associated with more extensive edits and cover a broader range of edited content compared to questions from reviewers. However, a much smaller percentage of the GPT questions are edit-inducing. Our analyses confirm that automated questions can be beneficial to authors and highlight an example task where proper attending to long context deteriorates reasoning model ability to produce helpful output.

</details>


### [99] [Gödel Forest: Balancing Search Depth and Breadth for Data-Centric Recursive Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36675)
*Ziqi Zhao,Fanqing Meng,Haocheng Lu,Lingxiao Du,Qiguang Chen,Mengkang Hu,Xiao-Ming Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 Gödel Forest，一种面向数据中心递归自我改进（RSI）的多智能体框架，通过协同进化的搜索树森林与共享演化记忆，解决搜索深度与广度的核心矛盾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RSI 系统要么冻结基础模型仅优化外部提示/智能体框架，要么在数据中心范式中陷入单智能体视野狭窄或并行搜索协调低效的困境；验证每个数据策略需要昂贵的模型训练，造成探索深度与广度难以兼得的根本张力。

Method: 1. 问题形式化：将数据策略搜索建模为持久搜索树，每个智能体沿私有树进行深耕。2. 局部深度搜索：四阶段认知循环（诊断→提议→验证与评估→回顾），含预算感知的诊断门控机制。3. 全局协同：通过"读-演化-发布"异步协议与共享演化记忆（全局排行榜 Λ + 结构化经验课程 ℒ）协调多棵树。4. 课程蒸馏：将成败经验压缩为约100 token 的紧凑结构化课程（意图、效用变化、归因、操作规则），避免原始执行轨迹造成的上下文膨胀。

Result: 在 RSIBench-Data 的六个领域基准（SWE-bench Verified/Multilingual/Pro、Terminal-Bench 2.0、GPQA Diamond、AIME 2026）上，相对单智能体基线平均提升 10.70%，五个任务降低墙钟时间；消融实验证实共享记忆带来 +7.00% 增益；K=3 为帕累托最优的并行度；框架在 Claude Sonnet-5 与 Codex（gpt-5.6-sol）两种骨干上均验证有效。

Conclusion: Gödel Forest 通过持久搜索树与异步共享记忆的协同进化，将数据中心递归自我改进从孤立的单树搜索扩展为可扩展的集体智能范式，证明了轻量级经验共享机制是突破训练-在-循环瓶颈的关键。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) aims to achieve compounding gains by having models improve themselves. While most existing RSI systems optimize external agent harnesses or prompts around a frozen base model, data-centric RSI directly updates the model's own parameters by training on agent-generated data. However, because validating data strategies requires expensive model training, existing methods face a fundamental dilemma: a single agent gets trapped in narrow directions and lacks exploration breadth, while naive parallel search or heavy trace sharing sacrifices long-horizon search depth. To address this challenge, we introduce G"odel Forest, a multi-agent framework that organizes recursive self-improvement as an ensemble of co-evolving search trees. In G"odel Forest, each agent autonomously grows a persistent tree, deepening, branching, or pruning data strategies based on model feedback to secure depth, while parallel trees explore distinct regions of the data space to expand breadth. Crucially, rather than leaving trees isolated or flooding them with heavy execution logs, a dynamically co-evolving memory connects the forest: agents continuously distill their successes and failures into compact procedural lessons anchored to a global leaderboard. Through this forest ecosystem, a dead-end in one tree instantly warns the whole forest against unpromising paths, while an empirical breakthrough quickly seeds new exploration branches in neighboring trees. Evaluated on RSIBench-Data across six diverse domains, G"odel Forest outperforms the single-agent baseline by an average of 10.70% while reducing wall-clock time on five tasks. Ablations confirm that co-evolving shared memory yields a +7.00% gain over independent parallel search, demonstrating that collective distillation is key to scalable self-improvement. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [100] [ProgressCompass: Embodied Progress Reward Models Are Lost Without the Right Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36684)
*Jianshu Zhang,Keliang Wu,Chengxuan Qian,Xiyuan Yang,Ce Zhang,Ariel Tian,Anbang Liu,Haoran Lu,Han Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"上下文依赖进度估计"问题，指出当前具身进度奖励模型(PRM)在长任务中因缺乏上下文而失效，构建了ContextProgress-Bench基准，并提出ProgressCompass代理循环框架，通过冻结PRM配合通用VLM提供上下文，使进度误差降低63%、秩一致性提升76%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能体执行长任务时，仅靠当前帧无法判断进度，因为进度依赖历史信息（先前状态、序列顺序、重复事件区分）。现有PRM即使读取完整历史仍会在进度估计上失效，而现有基准主要针对短任务，上下文依赖的进度估计被严重低估。

Method: 1) 构建ContextProgress-Bench基准（24任务、120回合、552标注子任务区间），覆盖三种上下文依赖形式：状态回忆、序列追踪、重复消歧；2) 对5个PRM进行配对诊断（有无上下文的对比实验）；3) 提出ProgressCompass代理循环，由Orienter（VLM）提供上下文、冻结的PRM评分、Verifier（VLM）校验、Navigator（文本控制器）调度；4) 理论分析：证明ProgressCompass误差上界与无上下文估计器的误差下界（上下文地板）。

Result: 1) 提供正确上下文时，5个PRM的MAE降低77-82%；2) ProgressCompass使冻结的RoboMeter-4B进度误差从25.4降至9.3（降63%），Spearman ρ从0.53升至0.93（升76%），恢复78%的oracle差距；3) 在Early stop、Extra steps、Mismatch三种负面场景下均优于基线；4) 期望转移τ_t的消融表明其在验证步骤中至关重要；5) 并行化使每回合墙钟时间降低65.6%。

Conclusion: 具身PRM并非无法进行进度估计，而是在缺乏正确上下文时会"迷失方向"。ProgressCompass通过冻结PRM与通用VLM的协作循环，无需训练或标注即可有效提供上下文，在更长、更复杂的任务上显著提升进度估计精度和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Embodied agents now take on ever longer tasks. For long tasks, knowing only whether a task finally succeeds or fails says little; the steps along the way matter. Progress Reward Models (PRMs) score how far a task has come at every step, and serve as dense rewards, verifiers and monitors. Yet in long tasks the current frame alone often cannot tell how far the task has come, because progress depends on what happened before. We call this problem context-dependent progress estimation. Existing benchmarks on progress estimation mostly focus on short tasks whose progress can be read from the current observation, and whether PRMs can estimate progress when context is needed remains underexplored. We therefore build ContextProgress-Bench, with 24 manipulation tasks for 120 episodes. The benchmark covers three settings: (i) State Recall, where information needed for progress appeared earlier but is not in the current frame; (ii) Sequence Tracking, where steps follow a fixed order, so progress requires knowing which steps are done and which comes next; and (iii) Recurrence Disambiguation, where look-alike frames sit at very different progress. We then run a paired diagnosis: each PRM keeps the same input format in both runs, and in one run its instruction integrates the right context. Even PRMs that read the entire history get lost in estimating progress, yet with the right context the same five models cut their progress error by 77-82%. Embodied PRMs are thus not incapable of progress estimation, but lost without the right context. We therefore propose ProgressCompass, an autonomous agentic loop that reorients an existing PRM and uses current general-purpose VLMs to supply the context the PRM needs. Wrapped in the loop, the same frozen PRM cuts its progress error by 63% and raises its rank agreement by 76%. With such a compass, PRMs estimate progress far better on longer, more complex tasks.

</details>


### [101] [Video2Skill: From Streaming Experience to Reusable Embodied Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36691)
*Jianshu Zhang,Ce Zhang,Xiyuan Yang,Chenwei Xu,Haoran Lu,Yijiang Li,Yaqi Xie,Katia P. Sycara,Han Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文提出"流式具身技能发现"(SESD)问题，并构建Video2Skill基准，评估视觉-语言模型(VLM)能否从连续视频流中增量构建并维护可复用技能库。研究发现现有19个开源VLM在技能分组上接近随机水平，规模扩大并不带来一致提升；统一模型倾向于过度合并不同变换，而分解模型则倾向于碎片化。监督微调（包括提出的反事实库状态再平衡方法CLaRe）可改善分组，但模型仍难以识别训练中未见的新变换，"识别现有技能何时不足"成为核心挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能体在执行长时域任务时需要基于可复用技能进行规划，但前提是知道哪些技能存在以及如何实例化。现有方法依赖预定义技能库或环境反馈信号，而能否从被动视频流中在线构建和维护符号化技能库是一个尚未解决的根本问题。VLM虽能描述单个操作事件，但能否将事件流组织为可复用技能尚未被系统评估。

Method: 1. 形式化流式具身技能发现(SESD)问题：模型按顺序处理视频块，预测操作事件的时序范围并表示为符号技能调用，技能库跨视频持续存在并影响后续预测。2. 构建Video2Skill基准：基于HD-EPIC（人类厨房活动）和RoboInter（机器人桌面操作）两个数据集，48个规范变换类别，三维度评估（事件覆盖、命名不变的技能分组、创建-复用决策）。3. 评估19个开源VLM在两种范式下的表现：统一处理（联合识别事件并更新库）与分解处理（先生成文本描述再用同一模型更新库）。4. 提出三种监督微调策略：oracle历史SFT、反事实库状态再平衡(CLaRe)、基于学生生成历史的on-policy纠错。

Result: 1. 零样本评估：许多SOTA模型的技能分组接近随机水平，ARI最高仅27.0；统一模型Pair Precision低（倾向合并），分解模型Pair Recall低（倾向碎片化）；模型规模增大并不带来一致改进。2. 监督微调有效：oracle历史SFT在统一范式所有设置中ARI最高；CLaRe在某些设置中改善覆盖率或创建召回率；on-policy纠错在分解范式中获得最高复用召回率。3. 核心瓶颈：训练后模型库大小停滞不足参考一半，训练中未见的新变换虽能被定位时序，但几乎从未被赋予新技能；复用召回率97-98.7%而创建召回率仅19-40%，模型无法判断何时现有技能不足。

Conclusion: 当前VLM在从流式视觉经验构建可复用技能库方面存在根本性局限。识别新变换与复用已有技能之间存在持续张力——监督学习虽改善分组质量，但模型会巩固熟悉技能而鲜少扩展库。Video2Skill基准揭示了具身技能发现的核心挑战：不仅需要识别复现变换，还需判断现有技能库何时不充分并创建适当新抽象。这为未来从流式视觉经验中学习的研究指明了关键瓶颈。

Abstract: Manipulation behaviors vary widely across objects and scenes, but they share a small set of reusable skills, and planning with these skills helps embodied agents generalize to new tasks. Yet an agent can only plan with skills it knows. Recovering skills from observed experience, the inverse of planning, builds this knowledge over time and yields skill data for training future agents. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) describe individual manipulation events well, but can they organize a stream of events into reusable skills? We formulate this problem as Streaming Embodied Skill Discovery (SESD): a model watches videos in sequence and maintains a persistent skill library that shapes its later decisions. To systematically measure this ability, we introduce Video2Skill, a benchmark that covers robot tabletop manipulation and human kitchen activity and tests three core capabilities: (i) locating manipulation events in time, (ii) grouping events of the same transformation, and (iii) deciding when to reuse an existing skill or create a new one. Across 19 open-source VLMs, many models group events at near-chance level, and scale does not consistently help. Their errors depend on how perception and library updates are coupled: joint models merge distinct transformations into one skill, while models that update the library from text descriptions duplicate recurring ones. Supervised fine-tuning, including our counterfactual library-state rebalancing (CLaRe), improves grouping but exposes a deeper bottleneck: trained models consolidate familiar skills yet rarely expand the library. Their libraries stall below half the reference size, and transformations unseen in training are located in time but almost never given a new skill. Recognizing when existing skills are insufficient thus emerges as the central challenge.

</details>


### [102] [LAURA: Knowledge Distillation for Interpretable Ambiguous Clause Identification in Legal Contracts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36707)
*Amrita Singh,Aditya Joshi,Jiaojiao Jiang,Hye-young Paik*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LAURA是一个面向法律合同模糊条款识别的后训练框架，通过知识蒸馏将GPT-4o教师模型的知识转移到≤1B参数的开源学生模型中，联合优化分类与可解释理由生成。其核心创新是IRAC-Unlearning提示技术，借鉴法律推理框架（Issue-Rule-Application-Conclusion）并融入"反学习"信号，生成忠实且结构化的理由。实验表明，Flan-T5(250M)在保持最佳不透明基线识别性能的同时，实现了所有可解释基线中最高的理由质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律合同中的歧义会给企业带来财务与法律风险，但并非所有歧义都会引发纠纷——部分歧义允许灵活解释而不触发争议，而另一些则会导致严重的法律冲突。因此，仅识别歧义并不充分，需要可解释的理由分析来帮助法律和非法律利益相关者判断哪些歧义值得进一步关注。现有工作（Singhal et al., 2024）虽提出了首个公开的合同歧义数据集，但缺乏可解释性，且依赖商业LLM存在成本、可扩展性和隐私问题。使用≤1B参数开源模型进行可解释模糊条款识别尚未被研究。

Method: LAURA采用知识蒸馏框架：(1) 教师模型GPT-4o使用新颖的IRAC-Unlearning提示技术（结合IRAC法律推理框架的四个阶段与"反学习"信号）生成忠实、领域适配的理由；(2) 学生模型（Flan-T5/Qwen-2.5/Llama-3.2等≤1B开源模型）通过联合目标函数进行微调，该函数结合二元交叉熵分类损失与序列级交叉熵理由生成损失（λ=1）；(3) 在单一前向传播中同时输出标签和理由。IRAC-Unlearning提示的四个阶段包括：Issue（识别核心解释问题）、Rule（适用相关法律标准，如contra proferentem、plain meaning rule、reasonable person standard）、Application（应用规则并通过"反学习"信号重新检验以匹配给定标签）、Conclusion（输出最终理由）。实验中比较了5种提示变体（CoT、Few-Shot、Contrastive、SC-Unlearning、IRAC-Unlearning）。

Result: 在Singhal et al. (2024)的1000条合同条款数据集（524条歧义/476条非歧义，80:20划分）上：(1) **识别性能**：LAURA + Flan-T5 (250M) + IRAC-Unlearning达到Binary F1=0.70、Accuracy=0.69，与最佳不透明基线RoBERTa SFT (F1=0.70, Acc=0.69) 持平；(2) **可解释性**：在正确性、完整性和简洁性三个维度上的人工评估（450条理由、1400条标注、Cohen's κ=0.93近乎完全一致）中，LAURA在正确性和简洁性上得分最高，仅在完整性上偶尔遗漏次要细节；(3) **基线对比**：提示型基线（Direct、CoT、Few-Shot）表现差（最高F1=0.69），SFT基线（F1=0.65-0.71）无模型能同时在F1和Accuracy上表现强劲，IFT/PPI因小模型推理时幻觉而表现最差；(4) **错误分析**：50个分类错误中，19个为vagueness、4个referential、2个incompleteness、25个非歧义误判，主要困难来自上下文依赖的模糊词（如"reasonable"、"applicable"、"good faith"）和复杂句法结构。

Conclusion: LAURA是首个使用≤1B开源模型进行可解释模糊条款识别的系统性工作。结论表明：(1) 单纯提示方法不足以完成该任务，需要任务特定的训练；(2) 训练学生模型对生成高质量理由至关重要（PPI因仅依赖推理时提示而表现最差）；(3) Flan-T5的编码器-解码器架构比Qwen-2.5和Llama-3.2等纯解码器架构更适合联合分类与理由生成任务。局限性包括：仅一个公开英文数据集、仅在条款级别评估（缺乏文档级上下文）、Flan-T5偶尔遗漏细节。未来方向：构建多语言合同歧义数据集、纳入文档级上下文、探索RLHF或人机协作以提升理由完整性与识别性能。

Abstract: Legal contracts contain ambiguities that expose enterprises to financial and legal risks. Some ambiguities allow flexible interpretation without triggering disputes, while others lead to significant legal conflicts. This makes identification alone insufficient, and interpretable rationale analysis essential. We propose LAURA, a post-training framework for interpretable ambiguous clause identification. LAURA leverages knowledge distillation with an IRAC-Unlearning prompting technique to transfer knowledge from a teacher LLM to an open-weight student model (<=1B parameters), which is then trained using a joint objective combining classification and rationale generation losses. The framework supports both legal and non-legal stakeholders in making informed decisions about which ambiguities require further attention. Extensive experiments across 7 baselines and 7 open-weight models demonstrate that LAURA with Flan-T5 (250M) delivers state-of-the-art interpretability over all interpretable baselines while matching the identification performance of the best-performing opaque baseline.

</details>


### [103] [ATTUNER: Recomputation-Free KV Cache Reuse via Query-Side Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36722)
*Xinghao Chen,Junnan Dong,Cai Ke,Chak Tou Leong,Haocheng Sun,Keyu Chen,Siyu An,Ruizhi Qiao,Xing Sun,Wenjie Li,Xiaoyu Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Attuner，一种面向LLM智能体场景的位置无关缓存（PIC）查询侧自适应方法。它通过在查询投影中插入低秩适配器（训练参数量<0.05%），从全上下文预填充教师模型蒸馏输出分布，从而学会"读取"冻结的工件KV缓存，而无需重构缓存或运行时重计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在LLM智能体中，技能、文档、记忆等可重用内容（artifacts）会被反复加载到上下文中，每次请求都重新编码这些内容浪费大量计算。位置无关缓存（PIC）允许独立编码工件并在不同位置复用其KV状态，但相比全上下文预填充存在质量损失。现有方法通过恢复位置ID或重计算部分token来弥补损失，但作者发现：(1)工件KV缓存本身是忠实的（单工件场景损失小）；(2)位置错位影响小；(3)真正的失败在于多工件场景下的注意力路由——用全预填充的注意力分数替换PIC的注意力分数即可恢复性能，无需修改KV。这促使作者从"修改缓存"转向"学会读取缓存"的思路。

Method: Attuner在Transformer每一层的查询投影中插入低秩适配器：q̃ = W^Q·h + (α/r)·B·A·h，其中A∈R^{r×d}，B∈R^{d×r}为可训练矩阵。适配器仅作用于在线（未缓存）的prompt token和生成token，缓存的工件KV完全冻结。训练时，采用响应分布蒸馏：冻结的全预填充教师模型在相同输入和响应前缀下监督使用PIC缓存的学生模型，最小化输出分布的KL散度。推理时，适配器可合并到投影权重中，无需教师或缓存重构。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上的七个基准测试（覆盖技能：TheoremQA/LogicBench/MedCalc-Bench/CHAMP/BigCodeBench；文档：MuSiQue；记忆：PersonaMem-v2）中：①域内任务平均分较PIC提升5.13（4B）和7.77（8B）点，与全上下文预填充差距缩小到1.61和0.51点；②域外任务（TheoremQA、CHAMP）也提升3.02和3.51点，显示良好的泛化能力；③保持近PIC延迟，域内几何平均TTFT加速1.79×（4B）和2.45×（8B），最高3.73×加速；④大幅优于APE、EPIC、CacheBlend、AgentKVShift、KVLink、COMB等基线方法；⑤仅需1024个训练样本即可恢复大部分质量，8192样本接近全预填充水平；⑥在PIC下改进幅度显著大于Full下的改进（平均5.13 vs 0.17点），证明改进源于适配缓存读取而非通用性能提升。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示了PIC质量损失的真正根源——不是工件KV表示本身，而是多工件场景下的注意力路由失败。基于此，提出Attuner作为查询侧自适应范式，开辟了"学会读取缓存而非重写缓存"的新方向。相比KV重计算方法，Attuner训练极少参数（<0.05%），推理时无需缓存重构或教师模型，既保留了PIC的延迟优势，又恢复了接近全预填充的质量，并展现良好的域外泛化能力。查询侧自适应是实现高质量、高效缓存复用的有效路径。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents repeatedly load reusable content, such as skills, documents, and memory entries, into the current context. Re-encoding this content for every request wastes computation. Position-independent caching (PIC) alleviates this by encoding each artifact independently and reusing its key-value (KV) states at arbitrary positions, but it incurs a quality loss relative to full-context prefill. Existing methods repair this loss by restoring global position IDs or recomputing selected tokens. In this work, we isolate the source of the loss, finding that the positional mismatch has minor effect, and independently cached artifacts retain faithful representations: reading a provided artifact stays largely accurate, and performance degrades only when the model must select among multiple artifacts. Moreover, replacing PIC's attention scores with full-prefill scores recovers performance with the cached KV unchanged, localizing the failure to the attention rather than KV recomputation. Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{Attuner}, a query-side adaptation method that learns to read a frozen artifact cache. \textsc{Attuner} inserts low-rank adapters into the query projections and is trained by distilling full-prefill distribution into the student. It trains fewer than 0.05\% of the model parameters and, at inference, requires neither cache recomputation nor a full-context reference. On Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across seven benchmarks covering skills, documents, memory, and code, \textsc{Attuner} substantially outperforms prior PIC baselines in both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, matches full-context prefill quality while providing up to $3.73\times$ speedup.

</details>


### [104] [Distilling What Matters: Confidence-Aware Selective Distillation for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36734)
*Ayan Sengupta,Vaibhav Seth,Tanmoy Chakraborty*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 CaRE-KD，一个面向大语言模型知识蒸馏的置信度感知选择性蒸馏框架。它通过 token 级的 CaRE-Divergence（前向 KL 与反向 KL 基于师生置信度自适应切换）和 batch 级的 Revival 机制（基于 BALD 拒绝教师认知不确定性更高的样本），解决了教师预测高熵与幻觉导致学生校准退化的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准知识蒸馏隐含假设教师是可靠预言者，但 LLM 常出现高熵预测与幻觉，前向 KL 的均值寻优特性会迫使学生将概率质量分配到不可靠的长尾，损害已校准的先验（即"保真度陷阱"）。现有静态插值方法（Skewed-KL、α-β divergence）施加固定几何偏好，无法适应自回归生成中逐 token 的可靠性差异。

Method: CaRE-KD 包含两个互补组件：(1) CaRE-Divergence（token 级）：通过置信度门控 g 在前向 KL（教师置信时，均值寻优）和反向 KL（教师不确定时，模式寻优）之间自适应切换，门控由归一化熵置信度差驱动，可采用硬门控（指示函数）或软门控（sigmoid 带 margin）；(2) Revival（batch 级）：基于 Monte Carlo dropout 估计的 BALD 分数，当教师的认知不确定性高于学生时抑制更新，使用相对分位数阈值保证尺度不变性。理论上提供了梯度分解分析、严格分离静态散度的命题，以及在 Sharpness Hypothesis 下熵置信度近似 BALD 的条件等价定理。

Result: 在 8 对师生配置、11 个基准测试（指令跟随、聊天对齐、代码生成、数学推理）上，CaRE-KD 持续优于 Skewed-KL 和 α-β divergence 等强基线：指令跟随 ROUGE-L 提升最高 +3.2，MBPP pass@1 提升 +2.1，GSM8K 准确率提升 +1.7，CollegeMath 提升 +1.8，LLM 评判事实性最高提升 +2.5。Revival 作为损失无关插件也能系统性增强现有蒸馏目标。

Conclusion: CaRE-KD 证明了在现代 LLM 蒸馏中，既需要自适应优化几何（token 级），也需要选择性拒绝监督（序列级）。该框架在容量差距大、对精度敏感的场景（代码、数学）收益最大；对小压缩比、已良好校准的师生配置增益有限。计算开销方面，N=3 MC dropout 在指令跟随任务上增加约 42% 时钟，但通过跳跃反向传播可部分回收。

Abstract: Knowledge Distillation (KD) trains a smaller-capacity student model to imitate a larger-capacity teacher model by matching output distributions, implicitly assuming the teacher to be a reliable oracle. In large language models (LLMs), this assumption often fails: teacher predictions can exhibit high entropy and hallucinations, causing standard KD to degrade well-calibrated student priors. We propose CaRE-KD, a confidence-gated distillation framework that replaces static objectives with uncertainty-adaptive optimization. CaRE-KD has two components: a token-level loss (CaRE-Divergence) that adaptively switches between Forward and Reverse KL divergence based on teacher--student confidence, and a batch-level epistemic rejection mechanism (Revival) that suppresses updates when the teacher is more uncertain than the student. We provide a gradient-level analysis showing how this dual-granularity design induces a conditional calibration mechanism that prior static divergences cannot reproduce. Empirically, across eight teacher--student pairs and eleven benchmarks spanning instruction following, chat alignment, code generation, and mathematical reasoning, CaRE-KD delivers consistent gains over strong baselines (Skewed-KL, $\alpha$--$\beta$ divergence). Highlights include up to $+3.2$ average ROUGE-L on instruction-following tasks, $+2.1$ pass@1 on MBPP, $+1.7$ accuracy on GSM8k, and $+1.8$ accuracy on CollegeMath over the strongest baseline, with consistent gains in LLM-as-a-judge factuality (up to $+2.5$ per task over Skewed-RKL). Revival further acts as a principled, loss-agnostic plug-in that systematically strengthens existing distillation objectives by filtering epistemically unreliable teacher supervision.

</details>


### [105] [Rethinking Multimodal Fake News Detection in the Generative AI Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36850)
*Wenbin Shen,Guoxuan Qin,Guangxu Yao,Baodong Wang,Yuanbo Rui,Zhichao Lian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对生成式AI时代多模态假新闻检测面临的新挑战，构建了Weibo26数据集，并提出了生成性感知层次推理框架GAHR。该框架联合建模全局判断与局部校正，并引入生成性检测辅助任务，实现在判别新闻真实性的同时识别生成内容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI的广泛应用使得假新闻不再局限于人工捏造或简单篡改，而是呈现出原生内容与生成内容共存的复杂形态。现有多模态假新闻检测研究主要聚焦于真实性评估，很少刻画生成性差异对证据可靠性的影响；而AIGC检测虽然能识别生成内容，但无法判断新闻事件本身的真实性。两者在数据和评估上存在割裂。

Method: 1. 构建Weibo26数据集：基于微博社交媒体新闻事件，使用2种文本生成模型（DeepSeek-V4-Flash、Qwen3-VL）和6种图像生成模型（Flux、Hunyuan、Kandinsky、Kolors、Pixart、SDXL），形成NRN、NFN、ICRN、ICFN、TCRN、TCFN六类共15154个样本，每条样本同时提供真实性标签和生成性标签。2. 提出GAHR框架：(a) 统一编码表示——使用RoBERTa、DINOv2、CLIP分别提取文本、视觉和跨模态特征，映射到统一512维空间；(b) 全局判断——通过双向跨模态注意力生成全局真实性判断，包含均值表示与元素级乘性交互的融合门控；(c) 局部校正——从文本侧、图像侧及图文一致性三个维度提取局部证据，通过校正门控以残差方式修正全局判断；(d) 生成性检测辅助分支——预测文本和图像是否由生成模型产生。总损失为真实性分类损失与生成性检测损失的加权和。

Result: 在PHEME、GossipCop、AMG、Weibo17、Weibo21和Weibo26六个数据集上，GAHR在多数数据集上取得最优或次优的准确率和AUC，在假新闻召回率和F1值上表现出明显优势。在Weibo26的AIGC检测任务中，GAHR-T（文本侧）取得0.821准确率，GAHR-I（图像侧）取得0.994准确率，均优于对应基线方法。消融实验验证了文本模态、全局判断和局部校正各组件的必要性。t-SNE可视化表明GAHR能有效按生成性参与和真实性信息组织表示空间。

Conclusion: 本文通过构建Weibo26数据集和提出GAHR框架，桥接了多模态假新闻检测与AIGC检测之间的割裂，使生成性信息能够参与真实性推理。实验验证了该方法在传统假新闻检测基准和新构建的生成内容场景下的有效性和竞争力，为生成式AI时代的多模态假新闻检测提供了新的数据和方法基础。

Abstract: Generative content is increasingly entering the production and dissemination of news, transforming fake news from manually fabricated or simply manipulated material into complex forms in which native and generated content jointly participate. Existing multimodal fake news detection research primarily focuses on veracity assessment and rarely characterizes how generativity differences affect the reliability of evidence. In contrast, AIGC detection primarily determines whether content is generated or modified by generative models, but it does not by itself establish whether the underlying news event is true. To bridge the separation between these tasks in data and evaluation, we construct Weibo26, a multimodal fake news detection dataset for generative-content scenarios. On this basis, we propose the Generativity-Aware Hierarchical Reasoning (GAHR) framework, which combines global judgment with local correction so that generativity information participates in news-veracity reasoning. Experiments on multiple existing fake news detection benchmarks and Weibo26 show that GAHR achieves competitive veracity-detection performance while effectively identifying generative content.

</details>


### [106] [Momentum-Coupled Rubric Adaptation for Detailed Image Captioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36893)
*Zhenwen Ji,Lei Jin,Shanyong Wang,Jiaming Lu,Chengqiang Lu,Yi Wu,Yao Hu,Lizhen Cui,Yanyu Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出MoCo Rubric框架，通过共享参数多任务SFT初始化Caption Policy、Rubric Generator和Rubric Judge三个角色，并利用指数移动平均（EMA）将Policy参数变化动量传递给Generator和Judge，实现rubric-based强化学习中三个角色的语义一致性和时间协调。在五个图像描述基准上达到72.83%的平均胜率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有rubric-based强化学习方法通常使用不同模型分别承担描述生成、rubric构建和评判三个角色，存在跨模型语义不一致问题；动态rubric方法虽然交替更新Policy和Generator，但固定Judge会导致rubric构建与评判与Policy优化不同步。

Method: 两阶段框架：(1) Shared Multi-Role SFT - 在单个视觉语言模型上通过角色条件多任务监督微调，使同一模型具备Caption Policy、Rubric Generator和Rubric Judge三种能力；(2) Policy RL with Momentum Transfer - 仅对Policy使用GRPO进行强化学习更新，Generator根据当前Policy采样、参考描述和图像证据在线构建rubric，Judge基于rubric提供奖励信号；通过指数移动平均（EMA）以动量系数m和同步间隔H将Policy参数变化传递给共享的Generator-Judge动量模型，并提供了tracking-stability trade-off的理论分析（Proposition 1）。

Result: 在PixMo-Cap、DenseFusion、CapArena、CompreCap、DOCCI五个基准上，MoCo Rubric以Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct为骨干达到72.83%平均胜率，超越RubiCap 2.90个百分点；在盲评中获得最佳平均排名（2.450）和最高首选项占比（35.9%）；在基于描述的QA任务中获得最高平均分67.17。消融实验验证了共享初始化、在线rubric和EMA联合动量传递的互补贡献，m=0.99、H=1时表现最佳。

Conclusion: MoCo Rubric通过共享参数多任务SFT建立统一角色基础，结合在线rubric和EMA参数传递实现rubric内容响应性和评估器状态协调，证明了协调式rubric适应作为详细图像描述强化学习有效路径的可行性，无需对rubric角色进行独立强化学习优化。

Abstract: Detailed image captioning requires accurate and comprehensive descriptions of fine-grained visual content, yet caption quality spans factual accuracy, information coverage, and clarity. Compared with conventional methods that rely mainly on high-quality supervision or holistic rewards, rubric-based reinforcement learning decomposes these requirements into explicit criteria and provides targeted, structured feedback. However, existing methods often use separate models for caption generation, rubric construction, and judging, which may lead to inconsistent interpretations across roles. Some dynamic rubric methods alternate updates between the caption policy and rubric generator while keeping the judge fixed, but staged optimization may still leave rubric construction and judging out of step with policy optimization. We propose MoCo Rubric, a two-stage framework that coordinates these roles. First, role-conditioned, shared-parameter multi-task supervised fine-tuning equips a single vision--language model to serve as the Caption Policy, Rubric Generator, and Rubric Judge. Then, the Generator constructs rubrics online from captions sampled by the current Policy, reference captions, and image evidence. The Judge provides rubric-based rewards, and only the Policy receives GRPO updates. As Policy updates change the candidates being evaluated, we use an exponential moving average of the Policy parameters to update one momentum model shared by the Generator and Judge. This gradual transfer lets both rubric roles track Policy updates without separate RL optimization while smoothing parameter changes that could disrupt their rubric capabilities under direct synchronization. Across five captioning benchmarks, MoCo Rubric achieves an average pairwise win rate of 72.83\%, the best mean rank in blind ranking, and the highest average score in caption-based question answering.

</details>


### [107] [RAEGNet: Relation-Aware Evidence Graph Network for Harm-Aware Multimodal Fake News Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36902)
*Wenbin Shen,Guoxuan Qin,Guangxu Yao,Baodong Wang,Yuanbo Rui,Zhongjie Ba,Zhichao Lian*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: RAEGNet 是一种用于多模态假新闻检测的关系感知证据图网络，通过事件级证据检索和条件危害建模，在多个数据集上优于现有基线方法，并特别提升了对高危害假新闻的识别能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖实体级检索易引入事件无关噪声，且仅关注整体性能而忽视不同假新闻实例的危害程度差异。

Method: 设计 ELERF 事件级证据检索框架（基于完整新闻文本作为查询），构建 RAEGNet 关系感知证据图（包含新闻-证据立场关系和证据-证据交互关系的9类有向边），引入条件危害分支联合建模真实性与潜在危害，并通过分类损失、MSE 危害损失及序数排序损失联合优化。

Result: 在 Weibo-21、Fakeddit 和自建 SSS 数据集上，RAEGNet-A 在所有评估指标上均优于多种基线方法（包括无外部知识、外部知识增强及基于 LLM 的方法），事件级检索优于实体级检索，高危害假新闻识别能力显著提升（HHF F1 和 HHF Recall 在三个数据集上均达到最优）。

Conclusion: RAEGNet 将关系感知证据图与条件危害学习统一于假新闻检测框架中，通过事件级证据检索和危害感知联合优化，在三个数据集上整体性能优于基线，并对高危害假新闻展现出强大的识别能力。

Abstract: Existing multimodal fake news detection methods often introduce external information to assist detection. However, most of them rely on entity-level retrieval and are therefore prone to introducing event-irrelevant noise. Meanwhile, existing methods mainly focus on improving overall performance and do not account for differences in the degree of harm posed by different instances of fake news. To address these limitations, we design an Event-Level Evidence Retrieval Framework (ELERF) and propose a Relation-Aware Evidence Graph Network (RAEGNet). ELERF retrieves external evidence based on the complete event semantics of a news item. RAEGNet constructs a directed graph that incorporates news-evidence stance relations and evidence-evidence interaction relations, and introduces a conditional-harm branch to jointly model authenticity and potential harm. Experimental results demonstrate that RAEGNet outperforms multiple baseline methods across all evaluated metrics on Weibo-21, Fakeddit, and our self-constructed SSS dataset.

</details>


### [108] [Can Language Models Learn to Forecast Stock Prices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36914)
*Jiacheng Guo,Suozhi Huang,Shuzhen Li,Yunlong Gao,Zerui Cheng,Jason Ge,Shushu Liang,Zihao Li,Hao Lu,Ming Yin,Shilong Liu,Jiashuo Liu,Xu Kuang,Mengdi Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究通过后训练（监督微调+PPO强化学习）能否提升语言模型预测股票价格的能力。基于Qwen3-4B构建的AURA-4B在自定义的Beta基准测试上，预测得分提升106.8%（20.94→43.31），达到与前沿大模型相当的水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后训练方法在数学推理、代码等可验证任务上取得显著成功，但金融预测面临结果噪声大、相关信息集事先未知等独特挑战，研究者希望探索后训练是否能帮助语言模型更好地使用工具进行股票价格预测。

Method: 1) 构建Beta沙盒与基准：包含499只美股、8个预测区间（1-126交易日）、9种市场检索工具（K线、技术指标、排名、市场/行业数据等），按时间严格划分训练（2011-2023）和测试（2024-2026）；2) 评分公式S=D×M/100（方向准确度×条件幅度一致性）；3) SFT阶段：用GPT-5.4基于历史已实现收益生成工具调用演示，全参数微调Qwen3-4B；4) PPO阶段：以预测得分为终端奖励，进行50轮优化，将策略锚定到SFT检查点。

Result: AURA-4B预测得分从20.94提升至43.31（+106.8%），排名15个系统中第3，超过9个前沿模型中的7个；条件幅度一致性从33.3升至66.2（接近翻倍），但方向准确度仅从62.9微升至65.4；SFT主要扩大了工具使用广度（工具数中位数4→7），PPO进一步增加了排名和市场上下文查询占比（16.2%→38.0%）。

Conclusion: 研究表明，即使在结果噪声大、相关证据事先未知的金融预测场景下，基于已实现收益的后训练仍能显著提升语言模型的预测能力；改进主要来自预测幅度的校准而非方向判断，且训练改变了模型调查市场的方式。

Abstract: Post-training has been shown to significantly improve language models' performance on tasks with verifiable outcomes, including mathematical reasoning, software engineering, and computer use. However, whether the same approach can improve forecasting in financial markets is much less clear. Compared with tasks with verifiable outcomes, not only are realized returns noisy, but even what constitutes a relevant information set for making effective predictions is not obvious a priori: the model must decide which observations to gather and then commit to a numerical judgment before the outcome is known. We study this question in a chronological stock-price sandbox, where a language model gathers price, volume, relative-performance, and market-context evidence and predicts a future return. We post-train Qwen3-4B with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on tool-use demonstrations, then proximal policy optimization (PPO) with a terminal reward given by the forecast score against the realized return. The resulting AURA-4B more than doubles the starting direction--magnitude score, from 20.94 to 43.31, and is comparable to frontier language models on this benchmark. Conditional magnitude agreement rises from 33.3 to 66.2, while directional accuracy changes from 62.9 to 65.4. SFT expands tool use, and PPO further increases the share of ranking and market-context queries. These results show that post-training can substantially improve financial forecasting performance, together with changes in how the model investigates the market, on this outcome-selected benchmark.

</details>


### [109] [Benchmarking Automatic Speech Recognition Tools for Iberian Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36920)
*Fernando López,Pablo Gómez,David Solans,Paulo Villegas,Jordi Luque*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对11个ASR系统（10个开源权重模型+1个商业API）在5种伊比利亚语言及德语、土耳其语控制组上进行基准测试，使用85小时数据集评估词错误率（WER）与实时因子（RTF/RTFx），并分析公平性问题。结论是各语言、各维度间存在明显权衡，无单一最优模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ASR大规模评估偏向英语，伊比利亚半岛语言（巴斯克语、加泰罗尼亚语、加利西亚语、葡萄牙语、西班牙语）覆盖不足，且低资源语言、偏差与效率权衡研究匮乏。本文旨在系统对比多个ASR系统在这些语言上的识别精度、推理效率及人口学公平性。

Method: （1）数据集：组装85.37小时多语言数据集，涵盖OpenSLR 69/76/77/108/94及Common Voice德语子集，涵盖朗读语音、广播媒体与有声书三种领域。（2）模型：选取10个开源权重模型（Whisper-large-v3、Voxtral系列、omniASR系列、seamless-m4t-v2-large、canary-1b-v2、parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3、Phi-4-multimodal、Qwen3-ASR-1.7B，均小于7B参数）及1个商业API（Scribe v2）。（3）评估指标：宏平均WER（各语言等权）、替换/删除/插入率、中位RTF与RTFx；统一在单块RTX 3090上顺序推理。（4）分析维度：跨语言精度、精度-效率权衡、按说话者性别的公平性分析。

Result: （1）整体精度：Scribe v2最低WER（6.45%），seamless-m4t-v2-large最佳（8.12%，仅限非商业）；可商用开源模型中omniASR-LLM-1B-v2（16.64%）与Whisper-large-v3（19.34%）领先。（2）效率：parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3吞吐最高（RTFx 151.7），omniASR-CTC-1B-v2次之（103.7）且WER较优（21.46%），为最佳精度-效率折中。（3）低资源语言：巴斯克语表现最差，无明确巴斯克覆盖的模型（如parakeet、canary）输出近随机。（4）公平性：多数模型呈现持续的男性优势（canary-1b-v2差距达+17.1%），仅Scribe v2与seamless-m4t-v2-large表现较为公平。

Conclusion: 无单一开源权重模型在精度、速度、语言覆盖与许可上同时占优。语言覆盖是首要选型准则：高资源语言（德语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语）表现稳定，低资源语言（尤其是巴斯克语）暴露显著差异。可商用场景下，精度优先选omniASR-LLM-1B-v2或Whisper-large-v3；精度-效率平衡选omniASR-CTC-1B-v2；最高吞吐选parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3但精度受限。跨架构持续存在的性别差异揭示多语言ASR中的公平性挑战。

Abstract: Comprehensive evaluations of automatic speech recognition (ASR) for Iberian languages remain limited, and low-resource languages, biases, and efficiency trade-offs are underexplored. We benchmark eleven systems, ten open-weight models and one commercial API, across five Iberian languages (Basque, Catalan, Galician, Portuguese, Spanish), with German and Turkish as controls. Evaluation uses an 85-hour dataset covering read speech, broadcast media, and audiobooks, assessing accuracy and efficiency via word error rate (WER) and real-time factors (RTF/RTFx). Results show no single model dominates: accuracy, efficiency, and language coverage present clear trade-offs. Low-resource languages, especially Basque, degrade significantly, highlighting the role of training coverage. We observe consistent sex disparities across most systems, highlighting fairness challenges in multilingual ASR. Overall, the benchmark provides practical guidance for real-world model selection.

</details>


### [110] [Dating the Model: Hidden Dates in System Prompts Affect LLM Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36931)
*Mario Sanz-Guerrero,Minh Duc Bui,Manuel Mager,Katharina von der Wense*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究揭示了一个被忽视的LLM评估非确定性来源：系统提示中隐藏注入的当前日期。仅改变日期这一变量，就导致9个主流LLM在6个标准基准上的性能发生显著波动（MCQA最高6%、数学推理14%、代码生成7%、机器翻译2.84 BLEU），且会导致排行榜排名变化。该效应超过了批大小、精度等已知非确定性因素，且思维链提示会放大此问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM评估的可复现性是科学研究的基础，但现有研究主要关注硬件、批大小等非确定性因素，而忽略了一个用户无法控制的时变因素——API提供商或聊天模板中隐藏注入的系统级当前日期。该研究旨在量化这一隐藏元数据对评估结果的影响。

Method: 实验设计采用控制变量法，仅改变系统提示中的日期（2024年全年365天），其他配置（提示词、随机种子、解码参数等）完全固定且确定性。评估9个LLM（涵盖Llama 3.1、Gemma 3、Qwen3、Phi-4、GPT-OSS等系列）在4类任务6个数据集上的表现：MCQA（MMLU、GPQA、ARC-C）、数学推理（GSM8K）、代码生成（HumanEval）、机器翻译（WMT）。此外还测试了GPT-5.1（验证专有模型）、CoT提示、少样本提示，以及与其他非确定性源（批大小、精度、GPU、选项顺序、系统指令措辞）的对比。

Result: 核心结果：日期变化导致MCQA准确率波动最高6%（平均2.52%），GSM8K波动最高14.42%（平均7.75%），HumanEval pass@1波动最高7.32%（平均4.81%），机器翻译BLEU波动最高2.84。模型排名会因日期变化而重排。该效应超过了批大小、数值精度、GPU型号的影响，与选项顺序和系统指令措辞变化的影响相当。CoT提示反而放大日期敏感性（自回归生成中早期token扰动级联），少样本提示无法缓解。在不注入日期时，结果落在365天日期实验的数值范围内，说明日期并非决定性能，而是引入噪声。用户位置等其他隐藏元数据也会产生类似影响。不一致预测的置信度显著低于一致预测，说明日期主要影响模型本就不确定的问题。

Conclusion: LLM评估中存在被忽视的非确定性来源：隐藏注入的当前日期。该效应规模大、跨任务普遍存在、无法通过标准提示技术缓解，对排行榜公平性和研究可复现性构成严重威胁。论文建议：可能时从聊天模板中移除日期（保留模板其余部分不变）；或固定日期并随结果报告。强调评估协议需考虑隐藏提示元数据，并将置信度/校准作为核心评估指标以标记脆弱预测。

Abstract: Reproducibility is essential for scientific research, yet prior work shows that LLM outputs vary with hardware and batching. We identify an overlooked factor: the hidden injection of the current date into system prompts, which users cannot control and which changes every day. Across 9 recent LLMs and 6 datasets spanning multiple-choice QA (MCQA), math reasoning, code generation, and machine translation, performance varies solely with the current date, with deltas of up to 6% on MCQA, 14% on math reasoning, 7% on code generation, and 2.84 BLEU on machine translation. Model rankings also shift, affecting leaderboards. This date effect exceeds other sources of non-determinism, such as batch size and numerical precision. Standard prompting techniques -- chain-of-thought and few-shot prompting -- do not reduce the sensitivity; chain-of-thought even amplifies it. Our findings underscore the need for careful evaluation protocols to ensure reproducibility and fair comparisons in LLM research.

</details>


### [111] [Chinese-Jev: Bringing System One Model to Chinese-Language Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36965)
*Zexiao Wang,Zihao Zhang,Xudong Wang,Pan Wang,Ziyi Ye,Haoyu Zhao,Zuxuan Wu,Shuicheng Yan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 Chinese-Jev，一种面向中文决策任务的紧凑模型，采用编码器主干（mmBERT-base，约 3.22 亿参数），将异构中文标注统一转换为候选概率分布，并通过通用语料预训练加领域微调的两阶段训练策略，在通用任务及医学、法律、金融领域实现高精度低延迟决策，支持 INT8 量化移动端部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Jev 类系统一模型在中文决策任务上准确率有限，限制了其在通用和专业场景中的实用性；此外，生成式大语言模型在仅需标签或分数的决策任务上成本过高，需要一种高效、低延迟的中文决策模型。

Method: 方法包括：(1) 统一数据构建流水线，将单选、命题判断、评分、多选等异构标注统一转换为候选上的概率目标，支持软监督；(2) 两阶段训练，先在 1000 万通用中文决策上预训练，再分别在医学（300 万）、法律和金融（各 2.4 万）语料上微调；(3) 采用 mmBERT-base 编码器 + 类型条件决策 Transformer 架构，训练目标结合交叉熵与 RLCD 策略梯度（含对有序评分使用 RPS）。同时构建 CJ-Bench 评测基准（307,900 条决策）。

Result: 在通用任务上 Chinese-Jev 准确率 69.20%，超越闭源 Jev 1.24%，ECE 从 11.45% 降至 3.78%，速度提升 20.3 倍；领域微调后医学准确率超越 Jev 4.0%，跨专业领域达 Jev 平均准确率的 92%，平均延迟 15 ms，速度提升 17 倍；INT8 量化后在 iPhone 15 Pro 上实现约 1 秒/决策的本地推理。

Conclusion: Chinese-Jev 通过统一数据流水线与轻量编码器架构，有效将系统一决策模型适配到中文通用和专业领域，在准确率、校准与延迟方面均表现优异，并通过 INT8 量化展示了端侧部署可行性；法律与金融领域仍存在准确率差距，专业化后校准改进不均衡，提示未来需在领域适配与置信度校准方面进一步研究。

Abstract: System One models such as Jev offer an efficient alternative to generative language models for tasks that require decisions rather than open-ended responses. However, existing Jev models exhibit limited Chinese-language decision accuracy, restricting their utility in both general and specialized settings. In this paper, we introduce Chinese-Jev, a System One model that addresses this gap through a unified data processing and training pipeline. Our data processing protocol converts heterogeneous Chinese-language annotations into probability targets over candidate options, enabling a shared training formulation across domains and question formats. To enable efficient inference, Chinese-Jev adopts a lightweight encoder-only backbone for text encoding and learns to score candidate answers through decision-oriented training. To address the misalignment between the pre-training distribution and downstream Chinese-language scenarios, we first train the model on a general-purpose corpus of 10 million examples, then fine-tune it separately for the medical, legal, and financial domains. To evaluate decision accuracy and calibration in both general and domain-specific Chinese-language settings, we introduce Chinese-Jev Bench (CJ-Bench). After first-stage pre-training, Chinese-Jev exceeds the accuracy of the closed-source Jev model by 1.24% on general-domain tasks while achieving a 20.3x speedup. Subsequent domain-specific fine-tuning yields a 4.0% accuracy improvement over Jev in medicine and achieves 92% of Jev's average accuracy across specialized domains, with a 17x speedup and an average latency of only 15 ms per example. We further demonstrate on-device deployment of an INT8-quantized model on mobile devices, achieving an inference latency of approximately 1.0 second per decision. The project is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [112] [Repetition, Not Length: Isolating the Counting Failure in Neural Text-to-Speech](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36974)
*Kirill Borodin,Vasilii Kudryavtsev,Maxim Maslov,Grach Mkrtchian*

Main category: cs.CL
