TL;DR: 该论文通过精心设计的对照实验（matched control），证明神经文本转语音（TTS）模型在重复文本上的计数失败是由"重复"本身而非"长度"引起的。在控制句子与词数完全一致的情况下，六个自回归模型对非重复控制文本的渲染准确率高达94.3%，而对重复文本仅18.2%，存在76.1个百分点的巨大差距；该差距在贪心解码、重复惩罚、四种独立语音识别器及420种规格下无一逆转，并可推广到保留架构及部分非自回归基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究将TTS模型在重复文本上的循环、截断和计数错误（looping/truncating/losing count）归因于暴露偏差或注意力对齐问题，并认为"长输入更难"。但这种说法混淆了两个变量：重复k次会让文本既变长又具有周期性。本文旨在将"重复"与"长度"两个变量解耦，验证到底是哪个因素真正导致了计数失败。

Method: 1. 测试集设计：180个项目，6种载体模板，目标词重复k∈{1,2,3,4,6,8,12,16,24,32}次；每个k≥2的项目配有一个长度匹配的对照组，将k次重复替换为来自8词词池的不同填充词。2. 模型：6个自回归检查点（Llasa 1B/3B/8B、Qwen3-TTS 0.6B/1.7B、XTTS-v2），2个非自回归基线（VITS、F5-TTS），1个保留架构（CosyVoice 2）。3. 评判器：使用CTC语音识别器（wav2vec2）而非Whisper，避免后者在重复音频上的幻觉问题。4. 周期梯子实验：固定载体和词数，仅改变周期p∈{1,2,3,4,6,8}，验证缺陷是否与周期性平滑相关。5. 收缩假设检验：测量重复边界间状态映射的最大奇异值q，检验q<1的收缩机制。6. 状态容量分析：计算有效秩N_eff的增长速率。7. 预注册预测：使用三个架构的部分池化预测第四个架构（CosyVoice 2）的差距。

Result: 1. 核心结果（k≥6）：控制组准确率94.3%，重复组仅18.2%，差距76.1个百分点（每检查点76.7 [68.4, 84.4]）。2. 420种规格下差距范围34.4-86.4，无一逆转符号。3. CosyVoice 2预测差距65.3 [5.9, 93.3]，实际观测64.4，验证预测。4. 周期梯子：准确率随p单调上升（p=1:10.4%, p=2:47.9%, p=4:73.6%, p=8:93.1%），即使p=2（无相邻重复）仍保留约一半缺陷。5. 非自回归基线：VITS无解离（-6.7点），F5-TTS重现缺陷（60.0点）。6. 收缩假设被推翻：q值在5个检查点上范围21.0-347.7（q>1），从无收缩。7. 状态容量：重复文本以控制组0.46倍的速率增长新状态。8. 探针分析：k≤32时计数仍可从隐藏状态解码（k=48-128时衰退）。

Conclusion: 在长度固定的情况下，仅重复就能破坏所有测试的自回归TTS系统。76.1个百分点的差距在420种分析规格中无一逆转，且具有推广性（保留架构吻合预测）。缺陷与文本周期平滑相关——即使无相邻重复也保留约一半——表明问题源于周期性而非简单的逐字同一性。失败并非自回归特有（部分非自回归模型也表现），也非状态收缩机制（q始终>1）。重复文本以较慢速率增长状态空间容量，但为何读出失败仍是开放问题。该研究为TTS计数失败提供了首个将重复与长度解耦的受控实验证据。

Abstract: Text-to-speech models loop, truncate and lose count on text that repeats a phrase many times. We show that repetition itself is what breaks them, not the length that comes with it. Every repeated sentence in our test set is paired with a control of matched sentence and word count in which no word ever repeats back-to-back. Six models from three architectures render the controls almost perfectly and fail the repeated twins: 94.3% against 18.2% exactly right at k >= 6. The gap survives greedy decoding, repetition-penalty sweeps, four independent speech recognisers and 420 analysis specifications without once reversing sign; a held-out fourth architecture lands within a point of its predicted gap, and one of two non-autoregressive baselines shows the same failure. Varying the period of the text shows the failure grows smoothly with periodicity, half of it surviving when no word is adjacent to itself.

</details>


### [113] [AMU:Admission and Memory Update for Personalized Conversations---Structured Memory with SLM Guided Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36976)
*Tao Hwang,Yishi Diao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AMU是一个用于个性化对话的写入时记忆控制框架，通过结构化记忆过滤和SLM引导的存储管理，在记忆写入阶段而非仅在检索阶段控制记忆质量，从而维护更干净、更可检索的个性化记忆。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆系统侧重于存储、检索或整合，但写入阶段的控制不足，导致瞬时请求、重复陈述和过时状态进入记忆库并在后续个性化中产生噪声。检索过滤和事后整合只能部分解决问题，因为低价值记录已写入存储。需要一种在写入时就进行准入控制和对已有记忆进行关系感知更新的机制。

Method: AMU包含两个耦合机制：(1) 结构化记忆过滤——将用户输入解析为类型化记录m={a(方面), i(意图), p(可复用个人标志), e(实体), s(摘要), v(情感), c(置信度)}，通过准入门G(x)=p·q_a·q_i·r_e·r_s·c过滤低价值输入，并使用方面-意图对加嵌入相似度限制候选池；(2) SLM引导的存储管理——SLM判断每条记录与候选记忆的关系为duplicate/update/separate，duplicate丢弃、separate插入、update则融合为新记录m*=SLM_fuse(d,M)替代旧状态。存储时使用结构化字段作为检索元数据，检索时再用阈值τ_r过滤。

Result: 在基于GPT-4o生成的20个会话（1000条写入轮次+200个查询）受控基准上，AMU获得P@3=37.33, R@3=63.50, F1@3=44.47, HIT@3=57.50, Red.@3=2.83，优于Full Compressed Memory、Mem0、A-MAC、A-MEM和Sliding Window；消融实验证实两个机制互补；SLM规模分析显示2B即可，4B后边际收益有限；在下游LLM评判中AMU获4.37分（无记忆2.92、全压缩3.21）；阈值敏感性、嵌入模型、SLM骨干和会话混合分析均显示框架的稳定性。手动验证标注有效率分别为89.3%和94.1%。

Conclusion: AMU通过将结构化记忆过滤与SLM引导的关系感知存储管理相结合，在记忆写入阶段实现准入控制和重复/更新/独立决策，实验证明其能维护更干净、可检索性更强的个性化记忆，且对嵌入模型、SLM骨干选择和会话混合具有鲁棒性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become the foundation of personalized assistants, but maintaining persistent user memory across long-term interactions remains challenging. Existing memory systems often focus on storage, retrieval, or consolidation, while memory writing remains less controlled: transient requests, duplicate statements, and outdated user states may enter memory and later be retrieved for personalization. In this paper, we present AMU: Admission and Memory Update for Personalized Conversations, an SLM-guided (Small language model guided) structured framework for writing-time memory control. AMU uses structured memory filtering to decide what should enter memory and SLM-guided storage management to determine whether an admitted record should be stored separately, discarded as a duplicate, or fused as an update. We evaluate AMU in a controlled memory writing and retrieval setting. Experimental results show that AMU maintains cleaner and more retrievable personalized memories.

</details>


### [114] [CypherTurn: A Multi-Turn Benchmark for Conversational Text-to-Cypher Evaluation and the Autonomy Divergence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36987)
*Yuzhe Zhang,Weijie Zhu,Haolin Yang,Ziyun Zhang,Xianwei Xue,Mengke Chen,Qiutong Pan,Huaqian Cai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 CypherTurn，这是首个面向对话式 Text-to-Cypher 任务的多轮基准测试，包含 721 个会话、5,927 个轮次，涵盖 7 个知识图谱与 13 种对话现象。作者通过引导式（Guided）与智能体式（Agentic）两种协议评估 15 个模型，发现即使最佳模型在引导协议下执行准确率也仅为 64.7%，会话级正确率不足 5%；并揭示"自主性发散"（Autonomy Divergence）现象，即自主操作下排行榜前列模型发生显著重排，表明错误管理能力与原始生成能力相互独立。此外，增加动作预算（×3 到 ×10）无法缩小自主性差距，且单轮 Cypher 微调反而会损害多轮指令遵循能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 Text-to-Cypher 基准（如 CypherBench、Text2GQL-Bench 等）均仅评估单轮独立查询，无法反映真实分析师在多轮会话中基于前序结果进行链式推理的工作场景，且无法衡量跨轮错误传播效应。本文填补此空白，构建首个多轮对话式 Text-to-Cypher 基准，揭示自主代理评估中隐性失败模式。

Method: 构建 7 个合成知识图谱（覆盖有向环、双部环、菱形汇聚、自引用循环等拓扑），标注 13 种对话现象（导航/聚合/过滤/话语）与 9 种链模式，每会话分配 10 种人格之一，经两阶段人工审核（Kappa=0.83）；设计引导协议（提供前序金标上下文）与智能体协议（模型自主管理历史，共享动作预算 B=T×m，m∈{3,5,10}）；采用 5 种动作空间（EXECUTE_CYPHER/ASK_USER/INSPECT_SCHEMA/SEARCH_VALUES/SUBMIT_ANSWER）；评估 15 个模型，使用执行准确率（EX）、来源子图 Jaccard 相似度（PSJS）、链错误率（CER）、会话精确匹配（SEM）四类指标。

Result: 引导协议下 Claude Opus 4.7 以 0.647 EX 居首，会话级正确率（SEM）最高仅 0.046；智能体协议下 Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite 反超至 0.432 EX；前部模型排名发生显著重排（"自主性发散"，Spearman ρ 在前沿模型中降至 0.63，11/45 对比较发生显著逆转）；CER 在智能体协议下从 0.47 升至 0.77，DeepSeek 与 Qwen3 超 0.83；INSPECT_SCHEMA 占比与自主 EX 相关性达 Spearman ρ=0.93；动作预算从 ×3 扩至 ×10 无显著改善，前沿模型自我限制于约 2 动作/轮；单轮 Cypher SFT 使 Gemma EX 从 0.281 降至 0.261，而 STRuCT-LLM-Novo 通过 RL+CoT 跨形式主义训练使 QwQ-32B 提升 13.1 点（0.395→0.526）。

Conclusion: CypherTurn 确立了对话式图数据库推理的开放挑战：性能天花板偏低（最佳模型 64.7%），会话级正确率近乎可忽略；自主性发散揭示错误管理是相对独立的子能力；预算扩展无法弥补此差距；训练范式与多轮任务特性匹配至关重要，单轮 SFT 反而有害，而架构匹配的领域特化可超越部分前沿模型；该基准推动多轮训练语料、模式恢复机制与细粒度语义等价度量等后续研究。

Abstract: Graph databases are increasingly queried through natural language, yet every existing benchmark evaluates isolated single-turn queries rather than the multi-turn sessions through which analysts actually work. We introduce CypherTurn, the first benchmark for conversational Text-to-Cypher evaluation, comprising 721 sessions and 5,927 turns across 7 knowledge graphs and 13 conversational phenomena. We evaluate 15 models under a guided oracle protocol and a fully autonomous agentic protocol, yielding four findings. First, the best model reaches only 64.7% execution accuracy, and session-level correctness remains below 5%. Second, despite strong overall rank correlation, frontier models exhibit a consequential reordering of the top of the leaderboard under autonomous operation, a phenomenon we term the Autonomy Divergence, which reveals error-management as a partially independent capability from raw generation skill. Third, scaling action budgets from x3 to x10 fails to close the autonomy gap, as the strongest frontier models self-limit to approximately two actions per turn regardless of available budget. Fourth, single-turn Cypher fine-tuning degrades multi-turn instruction following, while architecture-appropriate specialization outperforms several frontier models. These results establish CypherTurn as an open challenge for conversational graph database reasoning. Code and data are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [115] [LatCom: Cross-Agent Latent Compression for Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37017)
*Shinan Zhang,Tao Zhang,Qihui Zhu,Mengjie Zhang,Dong Jin,Yunpeng Hou,Shuangwu Chen,Xiaobin Tan,Quan Zheng,Jian Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LatCom是一个面向多智能体潜在协作的跨智能体潜在压缩框架，通过两阶段训练的压缩器将多个发送方的潜在表示映射为固定数量的接收方可读槽位，在保持准确率的同时显著降低推理延迟和输出令牌使用量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统采用潜在协作避免自然语言通信中的信息损失，但直接转发所有发送方潜在表示会导致接收方上下文随智能体数量和推理长度线性增长。现有潜在压缩方法对每个发送方独立压缩后再拼接，未解决跨智能体冗余问题。作者量化发现不同智能体的潜在轨迹间存在高余弦相似度（0.553–0.771）和约43%的有效秩压缩，表明存在大量冗余。

Method: LatCom框架包含：(1) 将多个发送方的对齐潜在轨迹聚合成统一序列U，加入任务、发送方身份和分隔符嵌入；(2) 基于Transformer的压缩器C_ϕ使用K个可学习槽位令牌，将U映射为K×d的压缩消息M（K<<L）；(4) 两阶段训练——Stage 1（可读性学习）：单发送方场景，使用任务损失L_task、接收方引导的对比损失L_con（基于接收方解码损失的软边界）以及全轨迹对齐损失L_align（Jensen-Shannon散度+均值池化L2锚点）建立接收方可读的潜在接口；(3) Stage 2（融合学习）：多发送方场景（2–6个发送方），采样金/非金/混合证据组，扩展对比损失到多源设置L_ms，训练压缩器融合互补证据并消除冗余；(4) 冻结发送方和接收方，仅训练压缩器，优化目标为接收方对真实答案的监督解码损失。

Result: 在7个基准（GSM8K、ARC-Easy/Challenge、MedQA、MBPP+、HumanEval+、GPQA-Diamond）上使用Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B评估：(1) 准确率：LatCom平均准确率76.27%（4B）和80.15%（8B），在14个任务-模型设置中7个最优，平均比独立压缩方法InterLat提升约1.9个百分点；(2) 效率：相对LatentMAS平均推理加速2.46×（1.85×–3.75×），输出令牌减少70.3%（63.6%–81.3%）；(3) 压缩开销仅0.116秒，模型占用7.49 GiB；(4) 消融实验：Stage 2贡献9.0点平均提升，去除L_con/L_align/L_ms分别下降5.53/11.65/2.37点；(5) 槽位K=32–64为最佳权衡，K=8明显下降，K=128无进一步提升；(6) 控制分析：联合均值池基线低10.92点，单源延续训练低3.37点，验证联合多源融合的必要性。

Conclusion: LatCom通过跨智能体潜在压缩有效解决了多智能体潜在协作中的上下文膨胀和跨智能体冗余问题，固定槽位潜在瓶颈能在保持任务性能的同时显著提升推理效率。但存在局限：(1) 依赖同模型族的对齐隐藏表示，难以直接推广到异构多智能体系统；(2) 固定槽位预算在某些代码生成任务上仍弱于全潜在中继，可能丢弃细粒度推理信息。未来方向包括自适应通信预算、异构模型设置及可靠性敏感应用。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) increasingly use latent collaboration to avoid the information loss and repeated encoding-decoding overhead of natural-language communication. However, directly forwarding all sender latents makes the receiver-side context scale with both the number of agents and the reasoning length, increasing computation, memory usage, and collaboration latency. A natural solution is latent compression. But we find that cross-agent redundancy remains unresolved in existing latent compression approaches, which typically compress each sender independently and then concatenate the results. We propose LatCom, a cross-agent latent compression framework for efficient multi-agent latent collaboration. LatCom maps multiple sender latents into a fixed number of receiver-readable and task-relevant slots. Rather than reconstructing all sender hidden states, it optimizes the compressed latents for receiver-side task utility. LatCom trains the compressor in two stages: single-sender readability learning first establishes a latent interface interpretable by the frozen receiver, and multi-sender fusion learning then trains the compressor to fuse complementary evidence and remove redundancy across agents. Experiments on multiple benchmarks with Qwen3-4B show that LatCom achieves an average 2.46x inference speed-up over LatentMAS and reduces output token usage by 70.3% while maintaining comparable average accuracy.

</details>


### [116] [Learning from Think-Mode Advantage via On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37044)
*Wanqi Ren,Jianxiang Wang,Danxuan Liu,Linyi Ding,Yuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ThinkOPD方法，通过在on-policy distillation (OPD)中引入trace-response divergence (TRD)作为trace-response兼容性的代理，结合组内相对奖励增益，对共享特权思维轨迹在兄弟响应间进行响应级路由。在数学推理和代码生成任务上，ThinkOPD在同模型和跨模型设置中均优于Uniform ThinkOPD基线及相关自蒸馏方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在启用了思维模式的on-policy distillation中，虽然学生的前缀是on-policy的，但共享的特权思维轨迹可能与某些完整学生响应路径不兼容，导致相同的轨迹在不同响应上产生不同的师生差异。均匀地为所有兄弟响应分配监督权重忽视了这种trace-response分歧，限制了优势思维模式的传递效率。

Method: ThinkOPD将共享trace/student-response对作为监督单元。首先计算trace-response divergence (TRD)：通过稀疏前向KL在token级别衡量trace-conditioned的分歧，再通过有限视界H和折扣因子γ累积持续分歧，最后在响应级别聚合为TRD分数。然后在每个提示组内，通过组内相对z-score标准化奖励增益和TRD，将sigmoid(reward_gain)与exp(-η·TRD)相乘并在组内归一化得到响应级OPD权重。最终的token级KL监督按该权重加权聚合，梯度从路由决策中分离。

Result: 在Qwen3-1.7B上，ThinkOPD的五基准Overall avg@16为32.0%，比Uniform ThinkOPD (29.0%)高3.0个百分点，比最强外部基线BRTS (29.7%)高2.3个百分点。同模型设置中提升1.7–3.0个百分点；跨模型Qwen3-4B→1.7B和1.7B→0.6B的数学平均分别提升1.9和1.6个百分点。消融实验证明reward-only和TRD-only路由均弱于完整方法，反转TRD偏好会损害性能。TRD优于Length、Raw-KL和Top-k agreement等替代兼容性代理。ThinkOPD的重复计算成本(1.31)远低于BRTS-4 (2.10)，同时效果更好。

Conclusion: ThinkOPD通过显式建模trace-response兼容性与outcome benefit的互补性，在保持学生探索的同时更高效地分配特权trace监督。启用了思维模式的on-policy distillation暴露了在固定教师下的路由依赖兼容性，为研究跨学生路径的监督传递提供了一个受控实验环境。reward增益捕捉outcome benefit，低TRD偏好与共享教师路径更兼容的路线，两者结合是实现蒸馏效用最大化的关键。

Abstract: Explicit intermediate reasoning gives large language models (LLMs) a stronger problem-solving mode. We study learning from this think-mode advantage via on-policy distillation (OPD). OPD preserves student-generated trajectories and provides dense token-level teacher targets at student-visited prefixes. Privileged reasoning is used during distillation rather than student inference. Uniform ThinkOPD, a natural think-enabled OPD baseline, conditions a fixed teacher on one shared think trace and uniformly distills every sibling student response. Although its prefixes are on-policy, the trace need not follow a route compatible with every complete response: the same privileged trace can induce different teacher-student discrepancies even when responses reach the same outcome. We summarize this interaction with trace-response divergence (TRD) and introduce ThinkOPD, which routes supervision at the response level by combining group-relative reward gain with a TRD-based compatibility proxy. Final response weights are normalized within each rollout group. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation, ThinkOPD outperforms Uniform ThinkOPD in both same-model settings and both cross-model teacher-student pairs, and it exceeds representative rationale and self-distillation baselines in a controlled comparison. Controlled interventions show that outcome benefit and the TRD-based proxy provide complementary routing signals in this setting. Think-enabled OPD provides a controlled setting for studying how teacher advantage becomes transferable along student responses.

</details>


### [117] [Traverse: Learning When to Remember, Reset, and Redirect for Long-Horizon Web Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37082)
*Jingyuan Ma,Lynx Aster,He Zhang,Siyao Song,Weijie Yuan,Zhe Zhang,Kai Jia,Zhifang Sui*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Traverse框架，通过Rubric-Answer-Verify三状态机和Seal Memory工具实现自主长程搜索代理，并通过仅优化最后片段的强化学习策略避免Seal Collapse失败模式，在BrowseComp上取得72.83分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长程搜索代理在累积噪声上下文后，早期错误会持续存在且难以恢复，导致搜索陷入退化状态。传统方法仅关注搜索状态维护，忽略了代理自身判断答案正确性的能力。

Method: 1）三状态机Rubric-Answer-Verify：代理先制定答案标准，再搜索，最后独立验证；2）Seal Memory工具让代理自主决定何时压缩上下文及保留哪些信息（含Read Memory检索工具）；3）Seal引导RL：仅优化上下文压缩后的最后片段，配合GRPO风格优势估计和GSPO策略优化；4）掩码SFT在教师轨迹上过滤不良回合。

Result: Traverse-35B在BrowseComp上达到72.83，超越同规模开源系统（QUEST-35B、AREX-Turbo等）；在DeepSearchQA和WideSearch上达到搜索专项模型最优；在GAIA、FinSearchComp、ShoppingComp上较基座分别提升18.45、19.70、0.1331；消融实验验证最终片段RL策略稳定且优于全片段训练，主动压缩优于自动压缩（Avg@3提升10.28分）。

Conclusion: Traverse通过赋予代理自主管理搜索流程和上下文的能力，结合仅优化最后片段的简单RL设计，有效解决了长程搜索中噪声累积和信用分配模糊的问题，实现了在多类搜索任务上的强泛化性能。

Abstract: Long-horizon information-seeking agents often accumulate noisy or misleading context, causing early mistakes to persist and making recovery increasingly difficult. We introduce an autonomous search harness in which the agent manages its own search process through three states: Rubric, Answer, and Verify. The agent first defines criteria for a valid answer, searches under these criteria, and then independently verifies the result before deciding whether to terminate or continue searching. It is further equipped with a Seal Memory tool that enables active context management. Training this behavior with reinforcement learning, however, can induce Seal Collapse, resulting in unstable training and preventing the agent from reliably learning when and how to use its memory tools. We solve this with a simple strategy that trains only the final segment after context management. Our 35B model achieves 72.83 on BrowseComp, outperforming comparable open-source systems, and consistently improves over the base model across BrowseComp-ZH, xbench, DeepSearchQA, WideSearch, financial investigation, and product search. Ablations show that autonomous compression outperforms automatic compaction and validate our RL design.

</details>


### [118] [Cross-Linguistic Effects in Bilingual Phoneme BabyLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37121)
*Nikitas Theodoropoulos,Maria Lymperaiou,Giorgos Filandrianos*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了双语音素BabyLM中跨语言效应，比较正字法与音素输入对L1-L2语法习得的影响，发现音素输入下L1相关的语法学习轨迹变化更强，而早期词汇差异与音素库相似度相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿童通过口语习得语言，而语言模型通常基于正字法文本训练，存在模态差异。本研究旨在探讨输入模态（正字法 vs. 音素）是否影响双语音早期L1对L2语法学习的跨语言效应，以及类型学距离（句法、音素库）是否与这些效应相关。

Method: 使用BabyBabelLM语料训练GPT-2架构的双语模型（85M参数），固定L2为英语，L1分别为德语、瑞典语、波斯语和巴斯克语，覆盖不同的句法和音素库距离。采用顺序-交错训练（前10k步仅L1，后20k步交错）。通过G2P+进行音素化，在正字法和音素条件下训练匹配模型。使用BLiMP、MultiBLiMP和BabySLM最小对任务进行评估，并通过训练检查点分析学习轨迹。

Result: 结果显示：1）音素LM在语法评估中显示出比正字法LM更清晰的L1相关排序（音素LM与句法距离的相关系数为-0.94至-0.99，正字法仅为-0.47至+0.13）；2）德语和瑞典语（句法上更接近英语）在语法任务中始终优于波斯语和巴斯克语；3）早期词汇学习阶段，德语和波斯语（音素库距离较低）的英语词汇准确率更高，但该效应在持续英语暴露后消失；4）正字法LM总体语法准确率更高，但L1相关排序较弱且不一致。

Conclusion: 跨语言影响在不同语言层面和学习阶段有所不同：音素库相似度与早期词汇优势相关，句法相似度与更持久的语法差异相关。输入模态塑造了学习过程中的表现和跨语言影响。该研究强调了输入模态在模拟语言习得中的重要性，并为双语及基于音素的人工学习者研究提供了资源。

Abstract: Cross-linguistic effects are a central topic in bilingual first-language acquisition. Artificial learners can help investigate L1-L2 interactions by enabling controlled comparisons across language combinations and learning conditions. Recent work explores this direction by training bilingual language models under developmentally plausible constraints. However, human and model learners still diverge in fundamental ways, with one major difference being input modality: children learn primarily from spoken input, whereas language models are typically trained on orthographic text. To reduce this gap, researchers have trained models on phonemic representations of speech. In this work, we combine these research directions to train bilingual BabyLMs with phonemic input. We keep English fixed as the L2 and vary the L1 across German, Swedish, Persian, and Basque, selected to represent contrasting combinations of syntactic and phoneme-inventory distance from English. Our results show stronger L1-related variation in grammatical learning trajectories under phonemic than orthographic input, while early lexical differences align with phoneme-inventory similarity.

</details>


### [119] [LLM unbranding: Erasing Commercial Identity while Preserving Generic Utility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37127)
*Kajetan Ożóg,Alicja Wojciechowska,Dawid Malarz,Paweł Batorski,Artur Kasymov,Przemysław Spurek*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文形式化定义了LLM去品牌化任务，旨在从生成文本中同时消除显式品牌名称与隐式文字商业外观（trade dress），同时保持通用知识与实用性；提出包含20个品牌、5个领域、5300+提示的综合评测基准，并提出一种基于黑盒进化式系统提示搜索的推理时方法MUTE，在4个主流LLM上显著优于NPO、SimNPO、梯度上升/差分等参数空间去学习方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在生成中频繁复现受保护的商标、口号与品牌特征，带来商标淡化、虚假归属、品牌诽谤等真实法律风险；现有机器去学习方法要么破坏通用语义、要么产生过度拒答，无法实现"选择性去除品牌身份"这一细粒度目标，且文本中的"文字商业外观"比视觉logo更为隐蔽，难以被关键词过滤捕捉。

Method: 1)构建基准数据集：20个品牌×5领域×6类提示（通用、推荐、场景、口号、产品描述、事实），并划分为train/validation/eval互不相交。2)提出基于Qwen3-32B的多步LLM-judge评估协议，分别测量目标品牌提及率、文字商业外观提及率、任意品牌提及率、保留知识、世界事实、回答质量六个维度。3)提出MUTE方法：冻结目标模型，使用Qwen3.5-9B作为生成器产生候选系统提示，以谐波均值同时优化"非泄漏率"与"保留正确率"为适应度，进行4代（最多96个候选）的进化搜索，为每个品牌-模型对独立发现最优系统提示。4)在4个目标模型（Qwen3-8B/14B、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B）上与NPO、SimNPO、GradAscent、GradDiff、Prompt Baseline等基线对比。

Result: MUTE在所有4个模型上将目标品牌提及率从原始的0.47-0.60降至0.012-0.090（最低），任意品牌提及率降至0.14-0.16（最低），同时保留正确率保持≥0.9925，文字商业外观泄漏也降至最低；权重空间方法（NPO/SimNPO/GradAscent/GradDiff）几乎无法有效降低目标品牌泄漏（仍>0.38），固定提示基线虽能部分降低（0.13-0.20）但明显劣于进化式MUTE。消融实验表明谐波均值目标、历史父代选择略优于局部选择和仅遗忘目标；跨模型提示迁移通常会降低性能（平均+2.84pp泄漏），表明针对目标模型的搜索仍然必要。

Conclusion: 文字去品牌化是一个独立且具有挑战性的新任务，传统权重空间去学习范式无法解决；MUTE证明黑盒进化式推理时提示优化是实现"选择性去除品牌身份同时保持通用能力"的可行且部署友好的方向，无需任何参数更新即可在显式名称与隐式商业外观两个层面有效抑制品牌泄漏。

Abstract: Establishing unbranding as a critical practice to prevent visual logos from acquiring negative connotations is standard in image generation. Large Language Models (LLMs) now face a parallel and emerging challenge. These models frequently generate brand descriptions within diverse contexts. This frequency introduces significant risks, such as trademark dilution, false attribution, and brand defamation. In response, we formally define the novel task of LLM Unbranding. We specifically address the complex challenge of managing trade dress within textual outputs. This involves neutralizing characteristic language, slogans, and stylistic markers that define brand identity. Crucially, these elements are less evident than explicit visual logos. To benchmark this task, we introduce a comprehensive evaluation dataset incorporating prominent brands from multiple commercial domains. We rigorously evaluate existing state-of-the-art machine unlearning models using this benchmark. This evaluation identifies their limitations in selective textual unbranding. Finally, we propose MUTE, a novel inference-time method that effectively neutralizes textual trade dress while preserving the LLM's general capabilities and utility. By leveraging an iterative refinement loop, MUTE systematically optimizes system instructions to safely eliminate brand leakage without requiring fragile parameter updates. Code and dataset: The evaluation dataset and code for LLM Unbranding are available at this https URL . The implementation of MUTE is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [120] [Bridging Semantic Gaps in RAG through Generated Context Knowledge Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37171)
*Xinkai Du,Chao Lv,Yalin Sun,Quanjie Han,Lei Yao,Maosong Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出KASB框架，通过DPO微调LLM生成查询对齐的上下文作为语义桥梁，结合自适应证据选择机制融合生成与检索知识，以缓解RAG中查询与检索段落之间的语义鸿沟问题。在三个开放域QA数据集上取得最优效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG系统受限于查询与检索上下文之间的语义空间失配问题（语言表达、抽象层次、术语差异），且生成知识易产生幻觉、检索知识相关性不足，二者融合缺乏有效机制。

Method: KASB包含四个阶段：(1) LLM生成查询相关假设上下文G；(2) 利用基于答案包含性自动构建的偏好对，通过DPO微调生成器以减少幻觉；(3) 以生成上下文作为信号，通过嵌入相似度对检索证据进行无监督选择；(4) 基于相似度分布的一阶/二阶差分进行自适应top-k*选择，并将选择后的检索上下文与生成上下文拼接送入LLM生成答案。

Result: 在TriviaQA、NQ、WebQ三个开放域QA数据集上，KASB分别取得75.4、59.6、61.2的EM分数，超过HyDE、COMBO、BRMGR等基线；DPO微调使生成上下文的检索EM绝对提升14.85%~18.08%；在BM25、Contriever、DPR等多种检索器上一致提升检索Top-20/100准确率；自适应k*选择（平均15-24）优于固定k值。

Conclusion: KASB是一种轻量级的检索后处理框架，通过生成上下文引导证据选择并融合双源知识，在多个数据集和检索器上一致提升RAG性能，验证了生成上下文引导证据选择作为系统级集成方案的实用价值；但存在依赖LLM知识覆盖、偏好信号为表面答案包含而非语义正确、未做去重与矛盾消解、局限于单轮QA等局限。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation has established itself as a fundamental framework in natural language processing, seamlessly integrating information retrieval with the generative capabilities of large language models. However, this process is fundamentally constrained by a critical challenge: semantic space mismatch between queries and retrieved contexts. We propose Knowledge-Aware Semantic Bridging (KASB), a novel framework that improves passage selection quality through semantic space alignment between queries and retrieved documents through intelligent knowledge fusion. Our approach leverages the complementary strengths of generative and retrieval-based knowledge through a multistage process that enhances both relevance and accuracy. We evaluate KASB on three popular open-domain Question Answering datasets to demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

</details>


### [121] [VLM Fine-Tuning for End-to-End Combinatorial Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37175)
*Qingsong Yan,Xia Jiang,Yaoxin Wu,Wen Song,Lu Zhang,Yingjie Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于视觉-语言模型(VLM)的端到端组合优化求解器，通过将文本实例描述与输入衍生的视觉表示相结合，使用监督微调(SFT)和验证器引导的强化学习(RL)训练一个统一的VLM跨多个组合优化任务，在CVRP和JSSP等复杂任务以及大规模实例上取得了显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于大语言模型(LLM)的端到端组合优化求解器仅使用文本序列化表示问题实例，可能掩盖了图连通性和对象关系等对生成有效解至关重要的空间和结构信息，限制了求解效果。

Method: 1) 多模态表示：为不同CO问题设计问题自适应的视觉表示（如路径问题的节点-链接图、调度问题的操作图），与文本描述组合作为输入，不包含任何解衍生信息；2) 使用Qwen3-VL作为共享VLM，通过LoRA进行监督微调(SFT)；3) 采用验证器引导的强化学习，使用GRPO算法，设计包含可行性奖励和最优性奖励的复合奖励函数，鼓励生成满足约束的高质量解。

Result: 在TSP、OP、CVRP、MIS、MVC、PFSP、JSSP七个任务上的实验表明：VLM总体上优于纯文本的LLM求解器，在CVRP和JSSP上改进最显著（Best-of-N下gap分别降低0.95%和2.35%）；随着问题规模增大，视觉信息的优势更加明显，VLM在多种实例规模上均优于领域专用基线方法。

Conclusion: 视觉信息的引入能有效提升端到端组合优化求解的性能，尤其在结构复杂的任务和大规模实例上优势显著；未来工作将探索VLM在更广泛的优化问题中的应用及其在更复杂CO实例上的迁移能力。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have provided a unified interface for end-to-end combinatorial optimization (CO), but textual serialization alone may obscure spatial and relational structures that are important for generating effective CO solutions. This paper presents a general-purpose vision-language solver that augments textual instance descriptions with input-derived visual representations. A single vision-language model (VLM) is applied across different CO tasks and trained using supervised fine-tuning followed by verifier-guided reinforcement learning. While the visual inputs contain no gold solutions or solution-derived information, our experiments show that the VLM generally improves solution quality over its text-only counterpart, with particularly clear gains on more complex CO problems such as CVRP and JSSP. The advantage of visual information is more pronounced at large problem scales.

</details>


### [122] [CredWise: A Controlled Agentic Decision-Intelligence Framework for Explainable and Auditable Credit-Risk Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37223)
*Aakash Kumar Tiwari*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CredWise 是一个面向信用风险评估的受控智能体决策智能框架，集成了 XGBoost 预测、概率校准、SHAP 可解释性、政策检索（RAG）、SQL 分析和受控智能体路由，将模型证据、政策证据与分析证据分离整合，最终决策交由人工审核。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信用风险预测输出概率不足以支撑放贷决策，审查者还需了解预测依据、特征贡献及与放贷政策的一致性。同时机器学习模型在金融场景中存在可解释性差、概率未校准、概念漂移及缺乏人工监督等问题，亟需将预测、可解释性、政策检索与结构化分析整合到一个可控的决策支持工作流中。

Method: 基于 Lending Club 数据（2007–2018，1,345,310 条贷款，18 个特征）按时序划分（2007–2016 训练 / 2017 验证 / 2018 测试），训练 XGBoost 分类器并以 sigmoid 校准概率；使用 SHAP 生成全局与个体特征贡献；构建基于 FAISS/BM25/Hybrid 的政策检索组件；实现只读受限的 SQL 分析层；通过监督路由智能体将查询分发至风险、政策、SQL、决策智能四条路径，并在 Streamlit 仪表板中整合输出。

Result: 2018 测试集校准后 ROC-AUC=0.7109、PR-AUC=0.2993、F1=0.3714、准确率 65.44%；Brier 分数从 0.2157 降至 0.1273，ECE 从 0.2862 降至 0.0585；SHAP 全局排序在 2017 与 2018 间的 Spearman 相关性达 0.9959；FAISS 在 28 条政策查询上 Hit@1=0.929、MRR=0.964；SQL 六案例三项指标均为 1.0；智能体路由 45 例准确率 95.6%；revol_util 与 int_rate 的 PSI 显著上升。

Conclusion: CredWise 证明可将预测、校准、可解释性、政策检索、SQL 分析与受控智能体路由整合到统一的决策支持工作流，并通过组件级独立评估保证各证据来源的可追溯性。但其仅为学术原型，性能受限于单一历史数据集、小规模受控基准（28/6/45）以及无完整公平性评估，最终放贷决策仍由人工做出。

Abstract: Credit-risk prediction is important in banking, but a prediction alone does not explain why an applicant is risky or how it should be combined with other evidence. This paper presents CredWise, a decision-support framework that integrates credit-risk prediction, probability calibration, explainable artificial intelligence, policy retrieval, SQL analytics, and controlled agent-based workflows. An XGBoost model is trained on Lending Club data (1,345,310 loans, 18 features) using a temporal split: 2007--2016 for training, 2017 for validation, and 2018 for testing. On the 2018 test set, the calibrated model achieved a ROC-AUC of 0.7109, PR-AUC of 0.2993, F1-score of 0.3714, and accuracy of 65.44\%. Calibration reduced the Brier score from 0.2157 to 0.1273 and the expected calibration error from 0.2862 to 0.0585. SHAP explanations were temporally stable, with a Spearman correlation of 0.9959 between 2017 and 2018 feature rankings. On 28 labeled queries covering nine policy sections, FAISS achieved the best Hit@1 (0.929) and MRR (0.964), while all three retrieval methods reached Hit@5 = 1.0. Agent routing achieved 95.6\% accuracy (43 of 45 cases), and the SQL benchmark scored 1.0 on exact-match, execution-success, and result-match across six cases. These results show that CredWise can combine predictions, explanations, policy evidence, and structured analytics in one controlled workflow. It is an academic research prototype, and final decisions remain with a human reviewer.

</details>


### [123] [SemOPT: Fixing Semantic Errors in LLM-based Optimization Modeling via Reward-Guided Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37361)
*Zetong Zhou,Wentao Zhang,Jingyuan Wang,Yifan Yang,Zizhuo Wang,Shixi Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SemOPT框架，通过训练语义奖励模型和分层蒙特卡洛树搜索，专门修正LLM在运筹学优化建模中产生的语义错误，在7个基准上达到最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在自动化优化建模中，语法错误可通过执行反馈检测，但语义错误（代码可执行但违反问题意图）难以识别和修正，是主要瓶颈。现有搜索方法依赖通用评估器且搜索空间过细，无法回溯到高层建模策略错误。

Method: SemOPT包含两大组件：(1) 语义奖励模型R：基于Qwen3-4B，用Bradley-Terry pairwise对比目标训练，区分忠实求解器代码与可执行但语义错误的代码，训练数据包含自然采样和突变生成的hard negatives；(2) 自适应修正系统：先用阈值门控机制τ过滤高置信度初始解，低置信度时触发分层MCTS，沿"建模策略→数学模型→求解器代码"三级层次搜索，以R作为价值信号。

Result: 在7个基准测试中，SemOPT在复杂数据集（IndustryOR、ComplexLP、ComplexOR）上比最强基线平均提升7.6%准确率，ComplexOR达72.2%（提升9.2%）；门控机制减少约2.6倍API调用；语义奖励模型AUC/F1显著优于通用LLM评判器；残余错误主要分布在数学模型层的约束定义上（53.6%）。

Conclusion: 语义引导的分层搜索能有效修正LLM优化建模中的语义错误，语义奖励模型与建模层次结构互补贡献增益，门控机制在精度与推理成本间取得良好平衡。

Abstract: Operations research supports decision-making in domains such as energy, economics, and healthcare. Solving operations research problems typically begins with optimization modeling, which translates a natural-language problem description into executable solver code. LLMs offer a promising way to automate this process, but they remain prone to errors. In practice, these errors can be divided into two categories: syntactic errors refer to solver code that fails to run successfully or is judged infeasible by the solver; semantic errors refer to solver code that successfully returns an objective value but violates the intent of the original problem. Since semantic errors do not trigger runtime failures, they are difficult to detect and rectify. To address this problem, we introduce SemOPT, a semantic-guided framework for correcting LLM-based optimization models. SemOPT combines a semantic reward model that distinguishes faithful math models from plausible but incorrect ones with an adaptive correction system that applies hierarchical reward-guided search over the modeling space. Experiments on seven optimization modeling benchmarks show that SemOPT establishes a new state of the art and achieves an average 7.6% accuracy improvement over the strongest baseline on complex datasets.

</details>


### [124] [Look What You Made Us Cluster: Hate Narrative Extraction from Reddit Discourse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37408)
*Annabelle K. L. Chua,Forster J. Khoo,Joel C. R. Tan,Huey Ting Ang,Kheng Hwee Tan,Joel Y. A. Sim,Shirley W. H. Ow,Ria Mundhra,Elsie C. K. Toh,Youfeng Xu,Lynnette H. X. Ng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型(LLM)的叙事提取与聚类管道，用于从在线社交媒体文本中精确提取仇恨叙事。该管道将叙事表示为"实体-评价"对，通过扩展方面级情感分析(ABSA)实现多步推理，并利用Leiden算法与LLM引导的精炼过程形成元叙事(meta-narrative)。作者在2024年英文Reddit评论数据集上以批评Taylor Swift的帖子为例进行验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计算方法依赖语义表示，仅能捕捉表层含义，难以识别间接或隐含语言中的仇恨叙事，导致提取精度有限且可解释性不足。需要一种更精确、可解释的方法来捕捉在线仇恨叙事的累积与传播模式。

Method: 三阶段管道：(1) 实体识别与归一化——LLM单次提示提取实体并解析至规范形式；(2) 叙事提取——基于ABSA的多步LLM推理，依次识别方面(aspect)、判断类型(ethics/capability/appearance)、评价(evaluation)及情感得分，生成摘要；(3) 元叙事提取——按实体与情感极性分桶，使用Leiden算法进行社区检测聚类，再经LLM语义标注与基于自然语言粒度描述的拆分/合并精炼过程。模型使用Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-FP8。

Result: 在90个手动标注样本上的评估：实体识别准确率98.9%，方面准确率75%，评价准确率92.5%，端到端准确率68.9%；判断类型宏平均F1达1.0，情感ICC=0.93。案例分析展示了管道成功恢复出"Taylor Swift虽客观美丽但缺乏性感"这一语义连贯的仇恨元叙事模式，即使个体评论表面看似正面或中性。

Conclusion: 该管道提供了一种精确且可解释的在线叙事监测途径，有助于检测和理解新兴仇恨叙事。局限包括上游实体与情感提取错误的传播、LLM的非确定性对精炼阶段的影响、静态语料处理限制等。未来工作方向包括增量聚类、设定聚类级仇恨判定标准等。

Abstract: Narrative extraction allows us to identify online hate narratives, supporting the construction of rigorous detection systems. Existing computational approaches, however, are limited in precision as they rely on semantic representations, which tend to capture only surface-level meaning. To detect more precise and interpretable narratives, we present an extraction pipeline that represents narratives as entity-evaluation pairs. Narratives are extracted using a Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning process that extends Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis, identifying the aspect, classifying its judgement type as the basis for evaluation, and deriving the evaluation accordingly. Extracted narratives are then clustered using Leiden, following which clusters are resolved to an intended level of granularity through an LLM-guided refinement process. We illustrate this narrative pipeline with English Reddit comments from 2024 that criticize Taylor Swift, analyzing a representative cluster that exhibits hate speech patterns to demonstrate its interpretive value.

</details>


### [125] [Larry Caused the Car to Stop, But the Model Didn't Notice: Transformer Blindness to the M-Heuristic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37497)
*Stefania Butnaru,Claudiu Creanga*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过NLI框架测试DeBERTa、RoBERTa、BART及Gemini是否能运用新格莱斯派的M-启发式（标记形式蕴含标记意义），对比词汇使役与迂回使构的语用差异，发现这些模型在默认处理中完全无法捕捉该语用区分，但Gemini在元语言提示下可达100%准确率，表明相关知识存在于参数中但未被默认调用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前Transformer模型在语义理解任务上表现优异，但其语用推理能力（尤其是基于形式而非内容的M-启发式推理）尚未被充分研究。M-启发式作为Levinson新格莱斯派框架的核心原则，要求模型理解"标记形式蕴含标记意义"，这对现有架构是未知的挑战。

Method: 基于Wolff (2003)的人类行为实验，构建188项NLI测试集（涵盖15个动兼类动词），采用2×2设计（词汇/迂回使役 × 正常/异常方式），使用在MNLI上微调的DeBERTa-v3-large、RoBERTa-large、BART-large进行默认NLI评估；对Gemini Flash-Lite进行三种提示策略对比（直接NLI、思维链、元语言提示）；进行线性探针分析和语义相似度分析验证表征层面。

Result: DeBERTa准确率0%（188/188预测Neutral），RoBERTa 2.7%，BART 0%，无一超过随机基线；线性探针在第4-11层可达100%区分度，但控制实验显示其追踪的是句法复杂度而非使役语用；语义相似度分析显示迂回使役锚点在29/30个三元组中更接近非中介描述，与M-启发式预测相反（p<0.0001）；Gemini在直接提示下0%，思维链21.8%，元语言提示下达100%且推理痕迹具项目特异性。

Conclusion: 基于MNLI微调的Transformer NLI模型既不能自发运用M-启发式，也未在句子表征中编码该语用对比（其表征组织方式与M-启发式预测相反）；Gemini在元语言提示下的完美表现表明该原则的知识存在于参数权重中，但默认NLI流程未能程序化调用该知识；缩小此差距需要专门训练以强化形式-意义映射的自发推理，而非仅仅让模型接触相关原则。

Abstract: Modern transformer models excel at capturing semantic relationships through sentence embeddings, yet their ability to perform pragmatic reasoning remains understudied. This paper investigates whether encoder-based transformers such as DeBERTa employ the M-Heuristic (the neo-Gricean principle that marked linguistic forms implicate marked meanings). We test this hypothesis by contrasting lexical causatives (e.g., ``Larry stopped the car'') with periphrastic causatives (e.g., ``Larry caused the car to stop'') using a Natural Language Inference framework. Our experiments across 188 conditions with 15 ambitransitive verbs reveal that DeBERTa, RoBERTa, and BART show no evidence of capturing the pragmatic distinction between these forms, with DeBERTa predicting ``Neutral'' for 100% of cases. Probing analysis initially suggested a representation-use dissociation, but control experiments reveal the probe was tracking syntactic complexity, not causative pragmatics. Semantic similarity over 30 triplets places periphrastic causatives closer to unmediated manner descriptions in 29/30 cases, opposite to M-Heuristic predictions in the embedding space. Under explicit metalinguistic framing, Gemini Flash-Lite reaches 100% with item-specific traces, so the principle is available under instruction yet unused in default NLI.

</details>


### [126] [The Rashomon Wikipedia: A Data-Perspectivist Analysis of Divergent Historical Narratives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37498)
*Claudiu Creanga,Liviu P. Dinu,Anca Dinu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文以"数据视角主义"视角，通过对比维基百科五种语言版本（罗马尼亚语、匈牙利语、俄语、土耳其语、英语）对三个有争议的罗马尼亚历史事件（波萨达战役、1940年苏联占领比萨拉比亚、1462年特戈维什特夜袭）的论述，揭示了不同语言社群之间存在的"引文孤岛"现象，并提出了一种基于"对抗性提示"的"和平使者"（Peace-Maker）LLM流水线，以实现真正的视角平衡式中立叙述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 维基百科虽以"中立观点"（NPOV）为原则，但实际上由相互独立的语言社群编写，往往依赖本国史料，在争议性历史事件上形成截然不同的叙事。论文旨在量化这种跨语言历史编纂学偏见，并探索AI能否充当真正的中立调停者（而非仲裁者）。

Method: 1. 数据收集：从维基百科API和MediaWiki标记中抽取2005–2024年共29个历史版本文章，以及119条引文；2. 立场分类：使用Gemini 3.0 Pro配合"上下文增强器"（±300字符窗口）将引文分为Pro-RO/Pro-HU/Neutral/Contested四类，并用母语人类标注员验证（Cohen's Kappa 0.75–0.85）；3. 细粒度叙事指标：对每个事件定义特定维度（如"弗拉德英勇度"vs"奥斯曼威胁度"、"苏联正当性"vs"受害者叙事"），按0–100打分；4. "和平使者"流水线：提取主张→匹配冲突→测试四种提示策略（Standard/Academic/Mediator/Adversarial），由LLM-as-a-Judge评估中立性、冲突保留度和来源归属度。

Result: 1. 引文孤岛：波萨达战役119条引文中，罗马尼亚语版91.1%亲罗、仅2.2%亲匈；匈牙利语版平衡（23.1%亲罗、25.0%亲匈）；三种语言版本间仅共享2条引文；2. 时间演化：罗马尼亚对"夜袭"的民族主义得分从2020年峰值85降至2024年的72，呈缓和趋势；俄语对比萨拉比亚的论述高度波动，2024年突然转向亲罗立场（72分），可能反映俄乌战争后对苏联帝国史的反思；俄语版本长期近乎零提及苏联 deportation，至2024年才出现；土耳其语与罗马尼亚语在"弗拉德残暴度"上存在15–20分的持续差距；3. Peace-Maker：标准提示中立性仅0.47（产生"幻觉共识"），而对抗性提示获得完美中立（1.00）、冲突保留（1.00）和来源归属（1.00）分数。

Conclusion: 维基百科并非统一的全球档案，而是由"引文孤岛"定义的独立认识论社群联盟；叙事并非静态，会受到地缘政治冲击而波动（如2024年俄语比萨拉比亚条目的转变）；在AI调停上，标准LLM倾向于"裁决式"幻觉共识，而对抗性提示——明确要求保留并归因分歧——能产生真正的"视角平衡"中立叙述；论文将中立性操作化为"视角平衡"（perspectival balance）而非折中立场，为未来LLM在历史争议中的角色提供了新范式，但需警惕事实性矛盾与"虚假平衡"的风险。

Abstract: Wikipedia aims to provide a unified, neutral record of history, yet its independent language editions often function as distinct epistemic communities, creating divergent narratives around contested events. This paper investigates cross-lingual historiographical bias by analyzing Wikipedia articles across five languages (Romanian, Hungarian, Russian, Turkish, and English) focusing on three contentious events in Romanian history: the Battle of Posada (1330), the Soviet occupation of Bessarabia (1940), and the Night Attack at Targoviste (1462). Using human annotators and Large Language Models (LLMs) to classify citation stance and quantify narrative evolution from 2005 to 2024, we identify a phenomenon of "citation isolation". In the case of the Battle of Posada, only 2 out of 119 citations were shared between language editions, with the Romanian edition exhibiting a 91% pro-national bias compared to the balanced Hungarian edition. Longitudinal analysis reveals that these narratives are volatile and responsive to contemporary geopolitics, evidenced by a significant shift in the Russian framing of Bessarabia in 2024. Finally, we propose a "Peace-Maker" pipeline to automate conflict reconciliation. We demonstrate that while standard prompting leads models to hallucinate consensus, "adversarial" prompting, which explicitly instructs the model to preserve and attribute disagreement, achieves near-perfect neutrality scores.

</details>


### [127] [Who Warmed the Archives? LLMs Overestimate Historical Warmth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37499)
*Claudiu Creanga,Liviu P. Dinu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了多种NLP方法（词法基线、历史领域微调Transformer、LLM零样本/少样本提示）从五个世纪的德语历史档案中提取Pfister温度指数的能力，发现简单词法方法（TF-IDF +岭回归）优于所有专门微调的Transformer；而六款主流LLM尽管能在相关性上匹配最佳词法基线，却普遍存在一种与年代正相关的"温暖偏差"——即对越接近现代的文本系统性高估温度，且这种偏差在剥离显式日期线索后仍几乎不变，指向一种"非历史性的当下先验"（anachronistic present-day prior）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 历史档案是延长器测气候记录的关键来源，但手工提取气候指数（如Pfister温度指数）成本高昂，NLP/LLM成为规模化解决方案。然而现有评估多停留在"能否提取信号"层面（相关性、F1），鲜有研究审视其误差是否系统性、按时代分层，从而影响跨世纪气候比较的可靠性。本文旨在填补这一缺口，警示研究者不能仅凭相关系数就将LLM视为历史气候指数的"神谕"。

Method: 1. 数据：来自tambora.org的德语（含少量法语/拉丁语）历史档案语料，标注Pfister温度指数（TI ∈ [-3,+3]）与历史湿度指数（HHI）；主语料按年代切分（1500–1849训练/1850–1899验证/1900–2022测试），另构建702行的世纪分层偏差审计样本。
2. 模型：（a）词法基线——词级TF-IDF+岭回归、字符n-gram TF-IDF+XGBoost（可加年份特征）；（b）微调Transformer——Europeana BERT、GHisBERT（从头在历史德语上预训练）、Historic Multilingual BERT；（c）零样本/少样本LLM提示——Gemini 2.5 Flash、GPT-5-mini、DeepSeek v4 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Qwen3.7-Plus、Kimi-K2.6-Fast，温度=0。
3. 评估：报告MAE/RMSE/Pearson r；偏差审计将零样本预测偏差对日历年份做线性回归；在702行样本上做"时代线索剥离"消融（替换四位年份、删除Anno Domini等历法标记），对比原始与剥离后偏差-年份斜率；附带中世纪语料季节性TI回归与中世纪事件抽取次要案例研究。

Result: 1. 词法击败Transformer：词级TF-IDF+岭回归测试r=0.3225（最佳），甚至专用GHisBERT仅r=-0.0161（噪声水平），最佳绝对校准为字符n-gram XGBoost+年份特征（MAE=0.8596）。
2. LLM可匹配相关性但代价高：Gemini 2.5 Flash零样本r=0.3197（与最佳词法r=0.3225几乎一致），但MAE=1.72约为词法基线（0.90）的2倍，呈现右偏过预测；3-shot相似度检索少样本将r提升至0.4140，MAE降至1.44。
3. 跨模型温暖偏差：六个LLM在零样本下均显示偏差随日历年份显著上升（斜率+0.129至+0.344/世纪，全部p<0.01），且在冷月最强（Gemini冷月斜率+0.389/century），方向一致；整体效应量适中（r²≈0.01–0.05）但跨六个独立模型家族一致。
4. 时代线索消融：剥离显式年份与历法标记后，斜率几乎不变（保留96–122%），强烈支持"非历史性当下先验"假说，而非模型正确推断时代后做了合理先验调整。
5. 泛化：湿度指数上词法方法同样领先；中世纪季节TI上词法TF-IDF达r=0.4916；中世纪事件抽取中拉丁语引文节点标签F1反而低于德语方言，与"标准化语言更易"的直觉相反。

Conclusion: 词法检索在从跨世纪历史文本提取气候信号上出人意料地稳健且优于专用历史Transformer；LLM提示配合少量相似度检索示例可在相关性上匹敌甚至超越词法基线，但其误差呈系统性、按年代分层的温暖偏差，且在剥离时代线索后仍持续——揭示LLM依赖一种"非历史性的当下先验"而非真正读懂引文年代。因此，仅以Pearson r不足以将LLM认证为历史气候指数"神谕"；未来工作应验证该偏差是否跨语言/跨区域普遍存在，并与人类标注者的当下主义偏差比较，同时探究其是否部分源于五个世纪间天气词汇的语义漂移。

Abstract: Historical archives are an under-used source for extending the instrumental climate record backward in time, and LLMs offer a way to extract the indices climatologists derive by hand. Beyond measuring how well systems extract this signal, we check whether their errors are safe to use for cross-century comparison, since a good correlation score does not rule out systematic, era-linked bias. Comparing lexical baselines, fine-tuned historical transformers, and LLM prompting on the Pfister temperature index across five centuries of German text, lexical methods beat every fine-tuned transformer we test, including one pretrained from scratch on historical German (r=-0.016). All six LLMs we test (Gemini 2.5 Flash, GPT-5-mini, DeepSeek v4 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Qwen3.7-Plus, Kimi-K2.6-Fast) show a warm bias that grows with calendar year, with the same sign in every model (slopes +0.13 to +0.34/century, p<0.01). The effect is modest in size (r-squared approx equal to 0.01 to 0.05) but consistent across six independently developed models. The best-correlated of the six, Gemini 2.5 Flash, matches the best lexical correlation (r=0.32) at double the error. An ablation stripping explicit dates and calendar-era markers from the quotes leaves this trend essentially unchanged, favoring an anachronistic present-day prior over the model correctly inferring the quote's era. Correlation alone is thus insufficient for vetting an LLM as a historical-climate-index oracle.

</details>


### [128] [E-MoE: Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts for Non-Factorized Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37533)
*Arseny Ivanov,Alexander Kolesov,Alexander Korotin,Ivan Oseledets,Mikhail Goncharov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出E-MoE（Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts）方法，通过将掩码扩散语言模型（MDM）的反向过程构建为以MoE路由器决策为离散共享潜变量的因子化分布混合，在不增加激活参数的前提下捕获位置间相关性，从而改善少步生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散模型（MDM）的反向过程通常在位置上因子化，导致少步生成（few-step generation）时无法建模同时被揭示的token之间的相关性，产生低质量样本。现有方法（如VADD）通过引入连续高斯潜变量来捕获相关性，但需要额外的识别网络且容易发生后验坍缩（posterior collapse）。本文旨在通过复用MDM骨干网络中MoE的路由器决策作为离散共享潜变量，避免额外参数和先验设计问题。

Method: 方法包含三个核心部分：(1) 理论推导——为具有离散共享潜变量的混合反向过程推导ELBO上界，得到包含重构项和路由KL项的训练目标；(2) MoE参数化——将MoE骨干网络的每层每token路由器决策作为离散潜变量z∈{1,...,E}^{L×D}，先验q_θ(z|x_t)仅依赖噪声序列，后验p_θ(z|x_t,x_0)额外依赖干净序列，使用Gumbel-Softmax（top-2 straight-through）实现可微采样；(3) 训练与采样——训练需要两次前向传播（一次干净、一次噪声），推理仅需先验路径，每个NFE对应一次前向传播。KL散度简化为逐层逐token的路由分布之间的KL，无需额外识别网络。

Result: 在三类任务上验证：(1) 二维合成数据（8-modes和Swiss-roll）——在NFE=1时E-MoE有效率分别为94.4%和90.3%，优于MDLM（37.7%、49.3%）和VADD（91.8%、93.8%）；(2) 二值化MNIST——测试BPD为0.062，优于MDLM（0.077）和VADD（0.064），参数规模相近；(3) LM1B文本生成——在NFE=1和2时生成困惑度比基线低2~2.6倍（如NFE=1时E-MoE为643.8，MDLM为1433.8），MAUVE得分在NFE=2时达24.6%（MDLM仅3.0%，VADD仅3.8%），样本熵匹配数据分布。消融实验表明关闭混合机制会使困惑度恶化1.7~2.1倍。

Conclusion: E-MoE通过将MoE路由决策重新诠释为离散共享潜变量，成功打破了MDM反向过程中的因子化障碍，在不增加激活参数和不引入额外识别网络的前提下显著改善了少步生成质量。该方法在合成数据、图像和文本任务上均优于因子化基线和连续潜变量基线（VADD），且潜变量在训练中持续被使用，无需热身调度或辅助损失。在低NFE区域改进最为显著，符合并行去掩码的实际应用场景；局限性在于随NFE增加收益递减，且依赖路由器对齐质量。

Abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) generate sequences by progressively unmasking several tokens per denoising step, but their reverse process is typically factorized over positions, limiting sample quality in the few-step regime where diffusion's speed advantage over autoregressive decoding matters most. A recent line of work introduces a continuous Gaussian latent, trained as a variational autoencoder, to capture correlations across positions, but such approaches are prone to posterior collapse, where the latent is silently ignored. We propose Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts (E-MoE), which builds the reverse process as a mixture of factorized distributions over a discrete shared latent given by the expert-routing decisions of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) backbone, without increasing active parameters over the factorized baseline. Across synthetic multi-modal benchmarks, binarized MNIST, and LM1B, E-MoE improves few-step generation over factorized baselines.

</details>


### [129] [RunyaNER: Auxiliary Language Selection for Runyankore NER](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37543)
*Prosper Arineitwe Asiimwe,Francois Meyer,Jan Buys*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发布首个公开的 Runyankore 语 NER 数据集 RunyaNER（237k 标注词，30k 句），并系统研究了在跨语言零样本迁移和多语微调中如何选择辅助语言，发现基于嵌入的相似度度量比传统语言学特征更能预测迁移性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多非洲语言在 NLP 资源中严重不足，缺少标注数据集；同时在低资源语言上如何选择辅助语言以最大化跨语言迁移效果仍不清楚。Runyankore 作为乌干达 Bantu 语言缺乏 NER 基准，且现有工作对辅助语言选择策略孰优孰劣结论不一。

Method: 构建 RunyaNER 数据集（基于 SALT 和 MPTC 平行语料，半自动人工标注，四类实体 PER/LOC/ORG/DATE），评估三种多语 PLM（mBERT、XLM-R、Afro-XLMR）在三种监督模式（单语、零样本、多语）下的表现；比较四种语言相似度度量（LinguaMeta、URIEL、原型余弦相似度、SWD）与下游迁移性能的相关性，并扩展到四语辅助组。

Result: Afro-XLMR 单语微调 F1=0.826 最佳；零样本迁移对辅助语言高度敏感，Great Lakes Bantu 语（Kinyarwanda、Luganda）效果最好；嵌入相似度（特别是余弦和 SWD）与下游 F1 的 Spearman 相关性显著强于元数据和类型学指标（零样本下最高 ρ≈0.64，p<0.01）；多语微调下辅助语言选择的影响显著减弱。

Conclusion: RunyaNER 为低资源非洲语言 NER 提供了首个公开基准；在零样本跨语言迁移中嵌入相似度比传统语言学资源更可靠地指导辅助语言选择，但一旦引入目标语言监督，辅助语言选择的重要性大幅降低。

Abstract: Cross-lingual zero-shot transfer and multilingual fine-tuning are promising approaches for NLP tasks such as Named Entity Recognition (NER) in low-resource languages, but in the absence of target language benchmarks, it is unclear which auxiliary language selection strategy leads to the best transfer. We introduce RunyaNER, the first publicly available NER benchmark for the East African language Runyankore, and use it to investigate the choice of which languages to use for transfer. Created with a semi-automated pipeline and fully manually verified, RunyaNER contains over 237k annotated words across 30k sentences. We benchmark pretrained models on RunyaNER, establishing that our dataset is of sufficient quality and size to produce effective Runyankore NER models. We then use RunyaNER to investigate auxiliary language selection in cross-lingual zero-shot and multilingual fine-tuning settings. Our experiments show that while transfer performance is highly sensitive to auxiliary language selection, embedding-based measures computed from labelled training spans correlate more strongly with downstream transfer performance than traditional linguistic features based on metadata or typology. By releasing RunyaNER and providing a systematic analysis of auxiliary language selection strategies, this work contributes both a new benchmark resource and practical insights for multilingual transfer in low-resource settings.

</details>


### [130] [Orthogonal Yet Coupled: Decoupling Geometric Components for Model Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37564)
*Zijing Wang,Yongkang Liu,Mingyang Wang,Ercong Nie,Mengjie Zhao,Yunpu Ma,Kang Liu,Zihan Wang,Shi Feng,Daling Wang,Hinrich Schütze*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出DiGA（Disentangled Geometry-Aware）模型融合框架，针对现有融合方法将任务向量视为不可分割单元所导致的"跨分量耦合"问题，通过正交分解任务向量为方向分量与结构分量并独立聚合，有效提升多专家模型融合性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型融合方法（TA、TIES、DARE、TSVM、OrthoMerge等）将每个任务向量当作单一不可分的聚合单元，忽视了任务更新中包含的方向变化与结构变化等异质几何信息，导致自适应融合算子（如基于完整任务向量统计量计算掩码、符号、权重）的决策受到跨分量干扰——即一个分量的几何特征会影响另一分量的选择、权重与组合方式，这种"跨分量耦合"降低了融合质量。

Method: DiGA框架包含三个核心步骤：(1) 以预训练模型的列空间正交矩阵Q (通过QR分解得到) 作为共享几何参考，将每个任务更新正交分解为方向分量T_i = Q·skew(Q^⊤Δ_i)（对应基帧内的旋转/重定向）和结构分量R_i = Δ_i - T_i（包含基帧内的形变和超出预训练参数子空间的变异）；(2) 对T_i族和R_i族分别独立执行相同的分支聚合算子G，包括冗余感知方向构造（Gram-Schmidt正交化结合原始源范数）和共识感知幅度校准（γ = (1+c̄)n̄，其中c̄为平均成对余弦相似度）；(3) 将两个分量独立聚合的结果正交重组为统一更新W* = W_0 + Δ_T + Δ_R。该框架可嵌入TIES、DARE、TSVM等现有融合方法。

Result: 在Llama-3.1-8B LoRA/OFT专家融合（5个专家）、MergeBench（Llama-3.2-3B全微调5专家）和Qwen2.5-VL-7B视觉语言专家（3个）上的实验表明：DiGA在LoRA设置下任务平均达59.18%（最强基线+0.48），OFT设置下达58.60%（最强基线+1.28），MergeBench上达41.09%（最强基线+0.22），视觉语言融合上达61.84%（最强基线+0.18），均接近个体专家平均水平。消融实验证实：仅保留方向分量任务平均下降6.70点，仅保留结构分量下降3.04点；全向量聚合（不解耦）下降0.36点；去除冗余去除/共识校准/源幅度分别下降0.39/0.33/3.42点。将DiGA的分离原则应用于TIES、DARE、TSVM均能持续提升性能，且仅做分解而不分离聚合（Comp.-Joint）反而使TSVM下降2.25点，验证了保持分量独立性的必要性。

Conclusion: DiGA识别并解决了模型融合中一个此前被忽视的干扰源——跨分量耦合，通过正交分解为方向与结构分量并独立处理，有效提升融合模型性能并减少能力退化。该解耦-聚合-重组的融合原则具有通用性，可嵌入多种现有融合方法，为未来模型融合研究提供了新方向：设计能区分应保留几何与可重组几何的目标函数。

Abstract: Merging pretrained models has emerged as an effective approach for consolidating diverse capabilities into a single unified model. However, prevailing merging methods typically treat each task vector as an indivisible merging unit, overlooking the heterogeneous geometric changes encoded within it. This treatment can induce cross-component coupling: when merging decisions are derived from statistics of the complete task vector, the geometric characteristics of one component may influence how another is selected, weighted, or combined, potentially degrading the quality of the merged model. To address this issue, we propose DiGA, a Disentangled Geometry-Aware model merging framework. Using the pretrained weights as a shared geometric reference, DiGA orthogonally decomposes each task vector into components corresponding to distinct geometric attributes. Rather than merging the task vectors as a whole, DiGA aggregates corresponding components independently within their respective subspaces and subsequently recombines them into a unified update. This component-wise formulation preserves the geometric identity of each component and prevents the characteristics of one component from interfering with the aggregation of another. Furthermore, DiGA can be incorporated into a broad range of existing model merging methods. Extensive experiments across diverse models, tasks, and merging methods demonstrate that DiGA improves merged-model performance and reduces capability degradation. Our repository is on this https URL .

</details>


### [131] [Devils in Question Relay: Source-Conditioned Relay Steering to Mitigate Hallucinations in Audio-visual Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37568)
*Yu Zhang,Pingrui Zhang,Xuefeng Bai,Pengfei Zhang,Yang Xiang,Kehai Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究音频-视觉大语言模型（AVLLM）中的"源混淆接地幻觉"问题，提出训练免费方法SECRET，通过在问题表征层面进行源条件中继转向，有效减少跨模态干扰，显著提升多个基准测试性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AVLLM面临关键挑战——源混淆接地幻觉：未使用模态的线索诱导出所需模态无法支持的响应。现有方法虽取得一定进展，但对该错误如何从内部跨模态交互中产生仍理解不足。本文旨在揭示其内部机制并提出有效缓解方法。

Method: 通过路径干预和表征分析揭示"问题中继"机制：问题状态同时承载干扰线索和所需源证据。基于此提出SECRET（SourcE-Conditioned RElay sTeering）：(1) 从问题文本识别所需模态；(2) 构建正/负问题表征——分别通过切断干扰模态和所需模态到问题位置的注意力路径获得；(3) 使用正负表征的逐token差异（经范数匹配）转向原始问题状态。三个并行分支在前L₁层共享参数，L₁之后合并并继续生成。

Result: 在CMM和AVHBench两个基准上对三种AVLLM（VideoLLaMA2-AV-7B、Qwen2.5-Omni-7B、Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B）测试，SECRET持续优于现有训练免费方法（VCD、AVCD、MAD），在CMM和AVHBench上分别比基础模型最多提升18.0和7.1个百分点。模态特定描述任务上也显示出对开放生成任务的泛化能力（更低的干扰参考重叠和更高的模态接地分数）。消融实验验证了问题位置干预优于生成位置干预，注意力路径干预优于模态移除干预。

Conclusion: SECRET通过在问题中继层面进行源条件转向，有效缓解AVLLM中的源混淆接地幻觉，无需训练且保留完整视听输入。问题状态作为跨模态信息中继的发现为理解多模态信息整合提供了新视角，也为设计训练免费的干预方法开辟了新方向。

Abstract: Audio-visual large language models (AVLLMs) have made remarkable progress in multimodal understanding and reasoning through interactions among visual, auditory, and linguistic information. However, recent studies show that AVLLMs face a critical challenge: $\textbf{source-confused grounding hallucination}$, where cues from the unused modality induce responses that the required modality does not support, undermining reliability in real-world applications. Existing methods have made progress in mitigating this failure, yet how it arises from internal cross-modal interactions remains insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we conduct path-intervention and representation analyses, revealing a $\textbf{question-relay}$ mechanism: question states carry interfering cues alongside required-source evidence, undermining grounding in required-modality evidence. Cutting pathways from interfering modality to question states yields greater correct-answer logit recovery than cutting those to the generation position. Motivated by these findings, we propose $\textbf{SECRET}$ ($\textbf{S}$ourc$\textbf{E}$-$\textbf{C}$onditioned $\textbf{RE}$lay s$\textbf{T}$eering), a training-free method that mitigates cross-modal interference at the question relay. Using contrasting question representations elicited through different modality-pathway interventions, SECRET steers the original question states toward required-source evidence. Experiments on two widely adopted benchmarks CMM and AVHBench across three AVLLMs show that SECRET consistently outperforms prior training-free methods, substantially mitigating source-confused grounding hallucinations (e.g., up to +18.0 and +7.1 percentage points over base models). Modality-specific captioning further demonstrates its generalizability to open-ended generation.

</details>


### [132] [Pair Difficulty Matters: Rethinking Pairwise LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation and Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37577)
*Bruno Brocai,Maria Becker*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文指出当前评估LLM作为成对裁判(pairwise judge)可靠性的三大常用代理指标——位置偏差、非传递性、成对一致率——存在系统性误导,因为这些指标对所有文本对等权重,而在Bradley-Terry聚合框架下,真正决定排名恢复能力的是大间隔(far-gap)对,小间隔(close-gap)对的翻转本质上接近信息论意义上的最优噪声。作者通过受控模拟和两个教育领域人工评分语料库(CLEAR、ASAP 2.0)验证:代理指标与金标准排名的相关性很弱,其预测力集中在远间隔区。论文主张评估应使用rank-gap条件化指标,理想情况下直接对照人类排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献大量报告LLM裁判在位置偏差、传递性和成对一致性上表现不佳,可能使实践者放弃本可胜任的评估器。作者认为这种评估具有误导性:这些代理指标在BT几何下被小间隔对所主导,而这些对排名恢复贡献极小。

Method: 理论层面:基于Bradley-Terry模型的log-likelihood分析,证明单对翻转对MLE排序参数θ̂的影响与间隔|Δ|成正比,因此小间隔对的翻转几乎不改变恢复排名。模拟层面:构造BT强度正态分布的受控数据,生成配对一致率恒为60%但错误分布不同(q参数控制)的模拟裁判,观察其与金标准的Spearman相关ρ。实验层面:在CLEAR(教师对学生作文可理解性的成对评分)和ASAP 2.0(学生议论文1-6分评分)两个语料上,用GPT-5.4-nano/mini、Ministral-3-3B/14B、Gemma-3-4B/12B六个模型作裁判,按|Δ|分位划分"close"和"far"区间,分别计算一致性、IPP、非传递性比例,以及与金标准的Spearman ρ;并对五个代理指标在12个judge-corpus点上做置换检验。

Result: 模拟显示,在配对一致率完全相等的情况下,误差集中在远间隔对的裁判ρ显著低于误差均匀分布的裁判。实验中,六个裁判的close对一致性均明显低于far对(典型如Gemma-3-4B:close=.19/.09、far=.53/.46);非传递性以inequality型为主,与一致性r=.928,本质是同一不确定性的重述。五个代理指标与ρ的Spearman相关中,只有"远间隔一致性"达.897且Holm校正后显著(p=.001),其余代理均不显著;近间隔一致性仅.245,位置偏差IPP仅.126。GPT-5.4-mini与nano在CLEAR上一致性无显著差异但mini ρ显著更高;Gemma-3-4B非传递性极高(27.2%/29.3%)却仍恢复出与其他裁判可比的排名(ρ≈.67)。

Conclusion: 聚合不一致指标不适合作为裁判质量的模型选择信号,因为它们过度权重信息量低的近间隔对;裁判评估应转向rank-gap条件化指标,理想情况下直接比较与人类排名的相关性。对基准设计有两条启示:提示应设计能拉开生成回应间隔的题项,而不是单纯增加难度;金标准应将条目组织为有序排列,或在不可行时报告难度感知的指标。论文未给出具体推荐指标,认为选择取决于人类评分的采集方式,需要新的行为数据。局限性:仅教育领域、仅成对评判、人类金标准本身主观且估计θ有噪声。

Abstract: Large Language Model judges are widely used to rank texts and text-generating systems through pairwise comparison, and their reliability is typically assessed via three proxies: position bias, transitivity, and pairwise agreement (self- or human-labeled). Because these proxies drive judge selection and benchmarking, a substantial literature reporting that judges perform poorly on them risks steering practitioners away from otherwise capable evaluators. We argue this assessment is misleading. Under the Bradley--Terry geometry underlying pairwise aggregation, each proxy is dominated by close-rank-gap pairs, where inconsistency is information-theoretically expected and individual verdicts contribute little to the aggregate ranking; far-gap pairs carry the ranking signal but barely move the proxies. We formalize this argument and validate it in a controlled simulation and on two human-rated corpora: the proxies correlate only weakly with ranking accuracy against gold, and their predictive component concentrates in the far-gap regime. Judges should therefore be assessed on rank-gap-conditional metrics, ideally against human rankings. Code at this https URL .

</details>


### [133] [Co-Linguistics: AI-augmented Theory Construction in Linguistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37635)
*Emmanuel Chemla,Benjamin Spector,Alexandros Kalomoiros,Philippe Schlenker*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"Co-Linguistics"概念，主张将AI（尤其是大语言模型和数学证明AI）作为语言学的"合作科学家"，用于构建和评估语言学理论，而不是将其视为人类语言能力的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自20世纪60年代以来，语言学发展出了许多原则上可数学形式化的理论（通常使用形式语言理论或模型论语言）。随着数学领域的AI革命，这种形式化能力将影响语言学。但与数学不同，语言学的目标并非证明新定理，而是寻找最佳公理集以推导出经验性陈述。因此，需要探索AI如何以新的方式辅助语言学研究。

Method: 论文提出"Co-Linguistics"框架，将AI作为合作科学家应用于三个层面：(1) 将现有理论完全显式化；(2) 比较相互竞争的理论；(3) 更具雄心地提出新理论（对应机器学习中的"程序归纳"）。此外，AI还能通过其卓越的数据访问能力，加速识别和检验关键预测（对应"主动学习"）。作者强调理论评估到理论构建的循环可能带来语言学理论的递归甚至自主改进，但人类仍处于核心地位——语言学家提供科学方向并进行概念评估，实验参与者则用于检验LLM能力之外的经验预测。

Result: 该论文是一篇观点性/概念性论文，未呈现具体实验结果，而是提出了一个将AI整合到语言学研究中的系统性框架，强调了AI在理论形式化、比较、构建和评估方面的潜在作用。

Conclusion: AI（尤其是LLMs和形式化数学工具）将成为语言学的强大合作工具，加速理论构建和评估的循环，实现语言学理论的递归改进。然而，人类的指导不可或缺：语言学家提供科学方向和概念评估，实验参与者提供LLM无法触及的经验数据。因此，Co-Linguistics代表的是人机协作而非AI自主研究的模式。

Abstract: LLMs have been studied in recent linguistics as potential models of humans' linguistic abilities. Here we discuss an entirely different use of AI, namely as a co-scientist, to help construct and assess linguistic theories (we refer to the result as "Co-Linguistics"). Since the 1960s, linguistics has developed theories that are in principle mathematically formalizable, often in the language of formal language theory or model theory. The AI revolution in mathematics will thus have consequences in linguistics-but with an essential twist: proving new theorems is rarely the linguist's goal. Rather, one seeks to find the best set of axioms to derive empirical statements. AI could accelerate research by making existing theories fully explicit, by comparing competing theories, and more ambitiously, by proposing new theories (in machine learning, this relates to "program induction"). It will also help assess theories by accelerating the identification and test of crucial predictions, thanks to unparalleled access to data (in machine learning, this relates to "active learning"). While the cycle from theory evaluation to theory construction may give rise to recursive and possibly autonomous improvement of linguistic theories, humans remain central: linguists provide scientific directions and evaluate theories conceptually, and experimental participants are needed to assess empirical predictions that are outside the reach of LLMs.

</details>


### [134] [Corpus-Guided Dual-Path Propagation for Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37661)
*Baoxian Liu,Tong Wei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出NexusRAG，一种基于语料库引导双路径传播的关系无关图检索增强生成框架，通过引入实体邻居先验缓解现有句子中介传播的查询门控截断与虚假激活两类失效模式，在多跳QA与GraphRAG-Bench子集上取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关系无关图检索方法（如LinearRAG）依赖查询-句子相似度中介实体传播，导致两类失效：(1) 查询门控截断——有用桥接证据因句子查询相似度低而被剪除；(2) 虚假激活——查询相关句子激活与推理链无关的偶发实体。需引入不依赖显式关系抽取的语料级结构信号来弥补这一缺陷。

Method: 在Tri-Graph基础上构建查询无关的实体邻居矩阵W，融合归一化共现信号与基于ANN的余弦语义相似度。提出双路径传播：(1) 语义传播——在邻居先验约束下经由查询相关句子识别实体前沿；(2) 结构传播——沿W直接扩展至未被句子中介覆盖的邻居实体。传播权重通过累积用于邻居感知的PPR段落初始化，融合稠密检索相似度与实体证据（含hop折扣）。

Result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue与GraphRAG-Bench Medical子集四个基准上，使用GPT-4o-mini、DeepSeek-V4-Flash、Qwen3.6-27B-FP8三种骨干，NexusRAG在所有数据集的Avg.与LLM-Acc.上均优于LinearRAG及多个强基线（KGP、G-Retriever、RAPTOR、E2GraphRAG、LightRAG、HippoRAG/HippoRAG2、GFM-RAG）。在GraphRAG-Bench四个问题类别上证据召回最高，超出次优基线4.2–8.1分。桥接召回与答案召回也有相应提升。消融显示邻居W的三种用法（语义门控、结构传播、段落初始化）互补，移除W整体带来最大下降（−3.3点LLM-Acc.）。参数敏感性分析表明融合系数α与阈值τ在合理范围内稳健。在ATLAS-Wiki 5M/10M规模上额外预处理开销低于总索引成本的3%。

Conclusion: NexusRAG通过语料级邻居先验与双路径实体传播，缓解查询门控截断与虚假激活，在无需显式关系抽取的前提下提升了多跳证据检索的完整性与下游QA性能，且具备良好的扩展性与部署效率。

Abstract: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation supports multi-hop retrieval by organizing corpus information into graphs. However, existing relation-free graph retrieval methods rely primarily on query-sentence similarity to search for evidence. This can exclude useful bridging evidence with low query similarity and activate incidental entities unrelated to the reasoning chain. In this paper, we propose a simple and effective approach called NexusRAG, which augments the relation-free Tri-Graph with a corpus-level entity neighborhood structure derived from joint entity co-occurrence and semantic similarity. NexusRAG employs this structure to guide two complementary propagation paths: neighborhood-constrained semantic propagation through sentences identifies the query-relevant entity frontier, while direct structural propagation between neighboring entities expands that frontier to structurally related entities. The propagated entity weights also inform neighborhood-aware passage initialization for Personalized PageRank. Experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks and a domain-specific subset of GraphRAG-Bench show that NexusRAG consistently outperforms existing approaches. On the GraphRAG-Bench subset, NexusRAG achieves the highest evidence recall in all question categories, exceeding baselines by 4.2-8.1 points. The implementation code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [135] [Reader Proficiency Shapes Layer-wise Surprisal Profiles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37688)
*Akio Hayakawa,Horacio Saggion*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM不同层的surprisal与人类阅读行为的关系如何随读者词汇熟练度和注视指标变化，提出"Predictive Depth"指标量化预测力在各层的分布，发现低词汇熟练度读者在FPGD上表现出更深的Predictive Depth，而TGD上差异较小；且TGD本身比FPGD具有更深的Predictive Depth。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统文本难度评估方法多基于表层指标或最终理解准确性，无法捕捉阅读过程中不同熟练度读者的实时处理差异。已有研究表明LLM不同内部层对阅读时间的预测能力不同，且不同阅读指标对应不同层深度，但读者熟练度如何影响这一层级关系尚不清楚。

Method: 使用MECO L2语料库（L2英语读者眼动数据），将读者按LexTALE词汇分数分为High-Lex和Low-Lex两组。对12个LLM（Gemma 3、Qwen 2.5、OLMo 2、Llama 3.1系列）使用Logit-Lens技术提取每一层的surprisal。通过线性混合效应模型（LMM）量化每层surprisal对FPGD和TGD的独特贡献（ΔLL），并定义"Predictive Depth"为ΔLL加权平均的归一化层深度。通过留一法（LOO）分析检验所选内部层在未见文本上的泛化能力。

Result: 1) FPGD上，10/12个LLM中Low-Lex读者的Predictive Depth比High-Lex更深（平均差+0.024）；2) TGD上这一差异显著缩小（10/12中仅有4个LLM，差+0.003）；3) TGD的Predictive Depth在所有LLM中均比FPGD更深（High-Lex中全部12个，Low-Lex中10/12）；4) LOO分析显示所选内部层在未见文本上优于最终层（21/24个案例中MAE更低），但绝对改进幅度有限。

Conclusion: 层深度与注视指标所捕获的阅读过程的时间跨度和广度相关，TGD比FPGD需要更深层、更具上下文信息的surprisal表征。低词汇熟练度读者在首次通过阅读时可能更早依赖上下文信息，表现为更深的Predictive Depth。然而，预测力的可迁移增益在实际应用中仍然有限，表明surprisal单独不足以准确预测未见文本的注视行为。

Abstract: Reading behaviour varies not only with linguistic input, but also with reader proficiency. In this study, we investigate whether the layer-wise relationship between surprisal from large language models (LLMs) and human gaze behaviour differs across readers with different levels of proficiency and across gaze measures. Using eye-tracking data from the MECO L2 corpus, we compare readers with high and low vocabulary proficiency on first-pass gaze duration (FPGD) and total gaze duration (TGD). We quantify the distribution of the predictive power of surprisal across model layers using Predictive Depth. Across 12 tested LLMs, we find that readers with lower vocabulary proficiency tend to show deeper Predictive Depth for FPGD, while this difference is smaller for TGD. Also, TGD itself shows deeper Predictive Depth than FPGD in both proficiency groups. These patterns suggest that where predictive power is concentrated across LLM layers may be related to the timing and breadth of the reading processes captured by different gaze measures, and that this relationship can vary with reader proficiency. Our leave-one-out analysis further shows that the advantage of informative internal layers extends to unseen texts, although the practical improvements in prediction are limited. Overall, our results show that layer-wise LLM surprisal provides a useful perspective on variation in reading behaviour across both reader groups and gaze measures.

</details>


### [136] [Billiger.de Products: A Bilingual Entity Matching Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37713)
*Aaron Steiner,Ksenia Elagin,Ralph Peeters,Johannes Knopp,Christian Bizer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Billiger.de Products，一个基于德国比价平台的德英双语实体匹配基准。该基准包含13个消费品类别的13,568个产品报价，遵循WDC Products的三维设计（边界案例比例、未见实体比例、开发集大小），并提供对齐的英语翻译版本。实验表明该基准比现有基准更难，PLM匹配器在英语版本上得分更高，而零样本GPT-5.2对语言不敏感。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有实体匹配基准主要包含英语产品数据且常被单一品类（如电子产品）主导，缺少德语等非英语、多品类、跨数据融合的评估资源。本文旨在填补这一空白，构建一个覆盖广泛消费品类别的双语基准，以评估匹配系统在不同语言和跨语言场景下的性能。

Method: 基准构建流程包括：(1) 使用DBSCAN对德国比价平台billiger.de的产品名称进行聚类；(2) 从聚类中选取相似但不同的产品作为边界案例组；(3) 将报价按训练/验证/测试集划分，控制未见实体比例和开发集大小；(4) 生成匹配和非匹配对。通过三个维度的组合（3×3×3）产生27个变体。使用GPT-5-mini将所有报价翻译为英语，并保持对、splits和标签固定。评估方法包括六种监督匹配器（WordCooc、Magellan、RoBERTa、XLM-R、R-SupCon、HierGAT、Ditto）和零样本GPT-5.2两种提示（Simple和Rule-Guided），在德语、英语和跨语言测试集上进行测试。

Result: 在德国版本上，Ditto和HierGAT是最强的监督系统，在最简单变体上分别达到86.39和84.10 F1，但在未见实体上性能显著下降（如Ditto从Seen到Unseen平均下降21.57 F1）。基于PLM的匹配器在英语版本上平均得分更高（RoBERTa平均+3.97 F1，HierGAT平均+7.74 F1），而零样本GPT-5.2对语言基本不敏感。与WDC Products相比，PLM匹配器在Billiger.de Products英语版本上得分低8.8到19.0 F1。在跨语言设置中，RoBERTa、XLM-R、HierGAT和Ditto在DE-EN/EN-DE对上损失6.0到10.9 F1，而GPT-5.2没有一致的跨语言惩罚。品类分析显示服装和家具是最难的品类，电子产品相对容易。

Conclusion: Billiger.de Products被定位为比现有英语基准更具挑战性的实体匹配基准，验证了评估非英语、多品类匹配系统的必要性。PLM匹配器的语言敏感性主要源于其英语为主的预训练数据（XLM-R证明多语言预训练可缓解此问题）。跨语言匹配仍是一个开放挑战，需要未来研究开发更好的多语言匹配策略。零样本LLM在跨语言场景中表现出显著的稳定性，是该任务的潜在解决方案。

Abstract: Existing product matching benchmarks primarily contain English-language product data and are often dominated by a single product category, such as electronics. This paper introduces this http URL Products, a bilingual German and English entity matching benchmark covering thirteen consumer product categories, including difficult-to-handle categories such as clothing and furniture. The benchmark data originates from the German price comparison platform this http URL . Following the design of WDC Products, the benchmark offers multiple variants that differ in the fraction of corner cases, the size of the development set, and the fraction of entities unseen during training. An aligned English translation of every offer keeps all pairs, splits, and labels fixed, while cross-language test sets combine German and English records within individual pairs. We validate the benchmark using six supervised matchers and zero-shot GPT-5.2 on both language versions and the cross-language test sets. The validation shows the difficulty of the benchmark. The comparison of the results on the English version of the benchmark to the results on the German version shows that most matchers score on average higher on the English version. The difference is largest for RoBERTa and HierGAT, while the zero-shot LLM runs are largely insensitive to the language. Comparing the F1 scores achieved by PLM-based matchers on the English version of this http URL Products with their performance on existing English-language benchmarks, such as WDC Products and Abt-Buy, shows that this http URL Products is more difficult than these benchmarks.

</details>


### [137] [Which papyrus HTR is good enough? Character-error-rate tolerance of four papyrological tasks on Greek texts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37755)
*Anton Repushko,Elena Chepel*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对希腊纸草手写文本识别（HTR）输出的字符错误率（CER），系统性地测试了四种纸草学任务（文书类型判定、年代判定、公文与文学分类、关键词检索）在不同错误率下的容忍度，并量化了"在噪声文本上重新训练"对模型鲁棒性的提升效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 绝大多数希腊纸草（约90%以上出土的100–150万件碎片）尚未编辑出版，无法被数字工具检索利用。HTR技术虽在进步，但其输出错误率对下游纸草学研究任务的实际可用性从未被系统评估过。本文旨在回答"HTR的错误率要低到什么程度才能满足特定纸草学任务"这一核心问题。

Method: 1）以papyri.info的63,846篇希腊文本权威版本为基准，通过剥离编辑层（恢复、变音符号、词界等）模拟"完美HTR"的字母级输出（L3）；2）使用受控的、基于种子的退化算法，以精确的1:1 Levenshtein编辑操作将文本精确降级到1%–50%的CER（含四种错误形状变体和丢失行实验）；3）训练小型模型（TF-IDF+LR/ridge、fastText、字符CNN、ByT5-small）和八种无训练的检索方法；4）比较两种训练范式：R-clean（在干净文本上训练）和R-matched（在测试CER水平上重新训练）；5）使用配对百分位置信区间计算每个任务的CER容忍度阈值（c95和c90）。

Result: 不同任务的CER容忍度差异显著（跨度近一个数量级）：T3 公文/文学分类最稳健（保留90%性能至20% CER）；T1 文书类型判定为7.5–12.5%；T4 检索（排序/过滤）为5%；T2 年代判定最脆弱（仅3%）。在15–30% CER高噪声区间下重新训练几乎消除了词汇模型的崩塌性下降（如文书类型在30% CER下从0.163提升至0.703）。丢失整行（行损失率）对分类任务影响较小（30%行损失约等于5% CER），但对检索召回率有线性影响。检索查询长度是关键因素：10+字母的查询可容忍20% CER，3–6字母的仅能容忍3%。

Conclusion: 研究为四个纸草学任务分别设定了具体的CER目标值：公文/文学分类可"按现状"使用（20% CER），文书类型经重新训练后在20–30% CER下可用（当前HTR在草书体上的水平），检索需配合编辑距离排序法和长查询词使用，年代判定需要更好的HTR或更优模型（即使完美转录也无法仅凭文本达到世纪级精度）。完美转录并非必要，单一CER指标也不充分；下游模型在噪声文本上的训练是提高鲁棒性的关键。所有语料规则、退化算法、冻结语料和结果表均已发布，便于随HTR系统改进而重新校准阈值。

Abstract: Purpose: Most Greek papyri remain unpublished and undigitised; a handwritten text recognition (HTR) pipeline that transcribes them automatically would let scholars discover documents and literary works that have so far gone unread. Recognition systems for Ancient Greek papyri are in statu nascendi, and how accurate they must be for a given papyrological task has not been examined. To answer this and set a benchmark for Greek papyrus HTR, we test a range of character error rates (CER) against four papyrological tasks, using published editions as ground truth. Methods: From 63,846 current editions of Greek texts in this http URL , we imitate a letters-only "perfect HTR" output by removing the editorial layer, then degrade it with a seeded algorithm to exact CERs of 1 - 50%, with lost lines and four error-shape variants. On these data we train small models (TF-IDF, fastText, a character CNN, ByT5-small) for document type, dating and documentary-versus-literary classification, and apply eight keyword search methods. We compare models trained on clean text with models retrained at a specific CER level, and evaluate across CERs. Results: Tolerance differs by task. With clean-trained models, documentary-versus-literary classification retains 90% of its metric up to 20% CER; document type up to 7.5%; subtypes and search up to 5%; dating only up to 3%. Retraining on text containing character errors largely eliminates the sharp degradation that otherwise sets in above 15% CER. Models generally tolerate concentrated damage in a long document better than small errors spread across a short text. Conclusion: The study provides a CER target for each of the four tasks and shows that models trained on noisy text make current, imperfect text recognition useful for them.

</details>


### [138] [Selecting What Matters: Semantic Compression-Guided Selective Pooling for Long-Context Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37782)
*Zifeng Cheng,Jie Zheng,Zhiwei Jiang,Shuwen Wang,Fei Shen,Shiping Ge,Qing Gu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SCSP是一种无需训练的长上下文嵌入框架，通过语义压缩提示引导的注意力模式识别并选择性聚合信息丰富的token，以替代传统均匀平均池化，避免长文档中冗余内容稀释关键语义信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的长上下文嵌入方法普遍采用mean pooling，对所有token一视同仁地平均，难以处理长文档中大量冗余或弱信息内容，导致关键语义被稀释。本文旨在探索能否在不进行额外训练的前提下，识别并选择性聚合信息丰富的token来构建更有效的长上下文嵌入。

Method: SCSP包含四个核心组件：(1) 输入构造——将长文档按句子感知方式切分为多个块，每块后附加语义压缩提示（如"Brief summary: ""）；(2) 提示隔离的注意力掩码——在保留文档token间因果注意力的同时，将每个提示的注意力限制在其对应块内，防止提示干扰文档表示；(3) 语义压缩引导的token选择——利用提示对各块的注意力分布，经层和头维度取max后得到token重要性分数，按阈值α/|C_i|筛选高重要性token；(4) 中间层选择性池化——从中间层提取被选token的表示并进行均值池化，得到最终嵌入。整个流程无需任何训练或微调。

Result: 在Mistral-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma2-9B、Qwen2.5-7B等多个LLM上，SCSP以即插即用方式一致提升Vanilla Mean、Echo Mean、HTP等基线，在512和8192上下文长度下均带来显著增益（如Llama-3.1-8B@8192上Echo Mean平均提升15.94个绝对NDCG@10点，相对提升约60%）。在LOCOV1数据集上也取得平均+5.00的提升。此外，SCSP还可增强GritLM和NV-EMBED等微调嵌入模型（分别+11.33和+3.06）。消融实验验证了句子感知分块、逐块提示、提示隔离掩码、max聚合策略等设计均不可或缺；超参数分析显示仅需保留约8–14%的token即可达到最优性能。

Conclusion: SCSP通过语义压缩提示引导的注意力信号实现选择性token聚合，证明了"少而精"的token聚合方式比均匀平均更有效，且作为一种通用、无训练的即插即用模块，可广泛应用于通用LLM和微调嵌入模型，显著提升长上下文嵌入质量。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential as training-free text encoders for long-context embeddings. Existing approaches primarily improve information flow under causal attention and typically construct embeddings by uniformly averaging all token representations. However, for long documents, such mean pooling can dilute salient semantic information with abundant redundant or weakly informative content. To this end, we propose SCSP, a training-free framework that leverages semantic compression for informative token selection in long-context embedding. Specifically, SCSP first partitions a document into sentence-aware chunks and appends a semantic compression prompt to each chunk. A prompt-isolated attention mask preserves information flow among document tokens while restricting each prompt to its corresponding local context. We then use the attention patterns elicited by these prompts to estimate token importance, select informative tokens, and aggregate their intermediate-layer representations into the final embedding. Extensive experiments on long-context embedding benchmarks demonstrate that SCSP can be integrated into both zero-shot and fine-tuned models in a plug-and-play manner, consistently improving their performance.

</details>


### [139] [Can Vision-Language Models Stay Helpful When Facing Implicit Risks? Intent-Privilege OPSD for Efficient Safety-Helpfulness Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37837)
*Haotian Deng,Wenbin Xing,Gang Xu,Tao He,Jinkai Zheng,Chun Li,Zheng Zhu,Ming Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Intent-Privilege OPSD框架，通过证据基础意图作为训练期特权监督，利用单次rollout的on-policy自蒸馏将安全与有用性对齐到VLM学生模型中，解决了跨模态隐式风险下安全-有用性平衡的难题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM在跨模态隐式风险（即图像和文本单独无害、组合后产生风险）场景下不安全响应率高达30%-64%。现有安全方法依赖大规模偏好数据、多rollout训练或推理时附加防护模块，且常因笼统拒绝而牺牲有用性。作者意图回答：能否以更高效的方式同时兼顾安全与有用性？

Method: 1）构建证据基础意图标注的四阶段流水线（图像证据提取、文本证据提取、联合意图构建、独立审计），排除未支撑的动机推测、显式安全标签和拒答指令；2）采用Intent-Privilege On-Policy Self-Distillation：冻结教师接收意图特权，学生仅看原始图像和请求，单次rollout后教师在学生生成的token前缀上提供token级分布指导，通过top-32前向KL蒸馏传递意图条件偏好；3）结合通用任务anchor样本的交叉熵损失保持常规多模态能力；4）部署时无需教师或特权标注。

Result: 仅用1447条安全样本（约比标准偏好数据集少95%），在SIUO+HoliSafe上联合安全-有用性成功率从43.9%提升至53.5%，五个评估组均取得最高成功率。训练时间相比GRPO基线减少5倍（40.88h→8.05h），推理长度缩短7%。消融实验表明：去除特权下降7.4-9.7点，使用源特权（未优化）导致严重退化（如MOSSBench从37.0%降至12.6%），打乱特权与输入的对应关系也消除增益，证明效果依赖输入特定的证据基础意图。LLaVA补充实验显示出一致的迁移趋势。

Conclusion: 意图监督的价值关键取决于其忠实度——未支撑或推测性的意图反而会加剧过度拒绝。Intent-Privilege OPSD证明，训练期使用证据基础的意图特权配合单次rollout自蒸馏，可在无需推理时附加模块的情况下，以极少数据实现校准的安全-有用性对齐。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) remain vulnerable to cross-modal implicit risks: visual and textual inputs that appear benign in isolation can jointly elicit unsafe responses. Existing safety methods often require large preference datasets, costly multi-rollout training, or additional safeguards at inference time. They may also sacrifice helpfulness by directly refusing requests that could be answered safely. In this paper, we propose Intent-Privilege On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which leverages evidence-grounded intent as privileged supervision during training to help VLMs recognize implicit risks and provide safe, useful responses instead of blanket refusals. OPSD distills a teacher's intent-conditioned preferences over responses into a student using a single rollout per prompt; the student then responds without intent annotations or an additional safety module. With only 1,447 safety-specific examples - 95% fewer than standard preference datasets - OPSD reduces training time by 5x relative to multi-rollout GRPO-style training and average inference length by 7%. It attains the highest ratio for joint safety-helpfulness success, which measures the proportion of responses that are both safe and helpful, across all five evaluation groups. Remarkably, on pooled SIUO+HoliSafe, this success ratio rises from 43.9% to 53.5%. These results show that training-time intent supervision can improve both safety and helpfulness while substantially reducing data, training, and inference costs.

</details>


### [140] [AnthroDial: Benchmarking LLM Anthropomorphism in Autonomous Social Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37853)
*Wentao Liu,Xi Chen,Siyu Song,Biao Yuan,Yu Zhang,Zhou Zhuotong,Jingying Zhou,Guohao Feng,Shasha Hu,Tianfu Wang,Shangshang Yang,Haoyang Liu,Youjia Li,Xiaokun Wang,Min Ji,Ji Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AnthroDial提出一个统一框架，用于开发在开放式持续交互中具备类人社交智能的LLM代理，涵盖三个层面：交互（MindFlow）、评估（CAPS-Eval）和训练（SEEDS+DiAPO），并构建了覆盖日常聊天、游戏交互和长程角色交互的基准测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM社交代理研究主要关注角色扮演的忠实性或行为心理测量，但缺乏统一方法使LLM在持续开放式交互中自主决定"是否、何时、如何"沟通，并系统评估其类人程度。

Method: 三大核心组件：（1）MindFlow——基于动态Mind Buffer的轻量级交互框架，支持自主异步通信，采用事件驱动虚拟时钟；（2）CAPS-Eval——基于认知-情感人格系统理论的分层评估框架，包含L0有效性门控、整体维度(E)和逐轮维度(D)；（3）SEEDS（自扩展环境合成）+ DiAPO（诊断自适应策略优化）——前者通过persona和scenario card双向生成扩展训练环境，后者基于最近发展区理论动态调整各维度奖励权重。

Result: 在三类场景（日常聊天、长程角色、游戏交互）上对7个LLM进行评估，验证了CAPS-Eval的可靠性、与人类判断的一致性（Kendall's τ≥0.80），以及SEEDS+DiAPO管道的有效性：基于Qwen3.5-9B，DiAPO使三个场景的ACC@95分别达到0.76/0.92/0.9661，显著优于GRPO（0.72/0.74/0.8814）和ECP、HumanLM、OSIM等基线。

Conclusion: AnthroDial从交互、评估、训练三个互补维度提供了开发可信类人社交代理的统一框架，证明了联合设计MindFlow自主交互机制、CAPS理论驱动的多维评估以及自适应奖励优化的有效性，为开放式社交交互代理的发展提供了系统化基础。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as social agents, yet credible human-like interaction requires more than fluent responses or persona consistency. Agents must autonomously decide whether, when, and how to communicate while adapting to evolving contexts, goals, and relationships. Existing research, however, lacks a unified approach to enabling, evaluating, and improving such capabilities in continuous, open-ended interaction. We introduce AnthroDial, a unified framework for developing anthropomorphic social agents from three complementary aspects: MindFlow, a lightweight interaction harness that enables autonomous, asynchronous, and adaptive communication through a dynamic Mind Buffer; CAPS-Eval, a theory-grounded framework for evaluating cognitive, affective, and behavioral dimensions of anthropomorphic interaction; and a scalable training paradigm that combines SEEDS for environment expansion with DiAPO for adaptive capability optimization. We further construct evaluation datasets covering everyday communication, game interaction, and long-horizon character interaction. Extensive experiments across diverse models and scenarios demonstrate improved interaction autonomy and naturalness, validate the reliability, discriminativeness, and agreement with human rankings of CAPS-Eval, and confirm the effectiveness of our training paradigm. Together, these components provide a unified framework for developing credible human-like social agents in open-ended interaction.

</details>


### [141] [Zero-shot Dependency Parsing with Unsupervised Cross-Lingual Bootstrapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37883)
*Lalita Lowphansirikul,Attapol Rutherford,Jian Gang Ngui,Sarana Nutanong,Peerat Limkonchotiwat*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于无监督跨语言引导(bootstrapping)的方法，通过语法感知句子增强、对比学习、MLM辅助损失和多层表示聚合，提升多语言预训练模型在零样本跨语言依存句法分析中的性能，尤其在低资源语言上取得显著改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于编码器的多语言预训练模型（如mBERT）在序列级跨语言任务中表现优异，但在依存句法分析等句法任务中，由于不同语言的句法结构差异（尤其是动宾语序），零样本跨语言迁移性能受限。现有方法大多依赖有监督微调，且对低资源语言的多语数据集依赖性强。本文旨在探索仅使用单语（英语）数据、通过无监督表示学习提升PLM零样本依存句法分析性能的可行性。

Method: 1. 语法感知句子增强（Syntax-aware Sentence Augmentation）：基于英语EWT树库的依存分析结果，通过子树旋转（subtree rotation）改变语序但不改变语义，包括OV（动宾）、后置介词、形容词-名词三种增强方式，作为对比学习的正样本。
2. 对比学习与MLM辅助损失：采用in-batch负样本对比学习，拉近原句与语法修改句的表征距离；同时加入MLM损失（权重λ）以保留原PLM的词汇和上下文知识。
3. 多层表示聚合：借鉴层组合策略（如平均第6层与最后一层表示），增强表征鲁棒性，无需额外训练成本。
4. 实验设置：仅使用英语EWT单语数据预训练后，用UDapter（基于语言类型学特征的adapter）在13个高资源树库上微调，在28个低资源语言上零样本评估UAS/LAS，并通过无参数树探测(probing)方法分析句法结构捕获能力。测试了mBERT、XLM-R、DistilBERT、MiniLM等多种编码器。

Result: 1. 在mBERT上，结合OV增强+MLM损失（λ=0.01）使(0,50]MB低资源已见语言组UAS提升+2.63、LAS提升+2.15；已见语言平均UAS+1.27、LAS+1.29（单层）。
2. 多层聚合（L12+L6）在不牺牲性能的前提下提供类似增益。
3. 不同动宾语序语言分析显示，VO语言和无主导语序语言获益更明显，OV语言结果混合。
4. 无参数树探测显示引导后模型的UAS/UUAS提升，且与下游LAS改善正相关（Spearman相关性78.33%单层，66.67%多层）。
5. 在Wikipedia预训练的编码器（mBERT、Distil-mBERT、XLM-100、mMiniLM）上效果显著，但在CC-100预训练的XLMR上未观察到提升。
6. 与UDapter基线相比，整体平均UAS+0.16、LAS+0.25（mBERT L12+OV+MLM λ=0.01）。

Conclusion: 无监督跨语言引导方法通过语法感知增强、对比学习、MLM保留和多层聚合，有效提升了多语言PLM的零样本依存句法分析能力，尤其在低资源语言上表现突出。无参数树探测验证了模型句法结构的鲁棒性增强。该方法在Wikipedia预训练模型上具有普适性，但XLMR效果有限，提示预训练数据特性对方法效果有影响。未来需探索多源数据、多语言增强、decoder-based模型及其他NLU任务的扩展。

Abstract: Pre-trained language models (PLMs) with encoder-based architectures have shown impressive capabilities in zero-shot cross-lingual transfer for various language understanding tasks. However, applying this technique to dependency parsing remains a significant challenge due to its syntactic nature. To boost model generalizability across linguistic typologies, we propose a cross-lingual unsupervised bootstrapping method to improve syntactic knowledge within the PLM. We show that our method achieves a significant improvement in zero-shot parsing performance in low-resource languages. Analysis of these bootstrapped models uncovers increased robustness in recognizing syntactic structures, evidenced by higher scores in parameter-free tree probing tests.

</details>


### [142] [Layer-Informed Fine-Tuning via Three-Stage Functional Segmentation of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38027)
*Junning Shao,Siwei Wang,Zhixuan Fang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出LLM的三阶段功能分割假说(概念化-推理-文本化),并基于此设计了一种参数高效微调方法LIFT,通过量化敏感度分析定位功能瓶颈,仅微调关键功能层,在两个模型系列和四个推理数据集上实现了更高的精度和更低的训练成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
