Motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）追求通用智能的宏大叙事，依赖于其底层优化引擎——强化学习更新规则——是否支持累积适应。然而，算法自发现已产生超越PPO达到SOTA的Disco103，但其内部更新机制仍是黑箱，特别是其持久循环状态如何利用累积学习历史完全未知。本研究弥补宏观RSI抱负与微观学习动力学之间的鸿沟。

Method: 方法论核心是对Disco103的持久循环状态进行因果机制审计。将Sutton与Silver"经验时代"操作性化为五轴框架：(A1) 扩展视野、(A2) 基础化奖励单位、(A3) 持续流、(A4) 生命周期内变化、(A5) 探索深度。采用受控模型系统（Catch、CatchStream、Tracking、MinAtar、DeepSea）隔离高维感知复杂性。执行外科手术式干预：零状态钉扎、定时冻结、自然转移、永久钳制。在固定元参数下，通过钉扎、冻结、移植循环状态测试学习历史何时是资产或负担。附带的数值几何分析检查分类价值头的标量意义。使用种子块bootstrap区间（10,000重采样，多重性调整族）。并将该协议移植到第二个规则OPEN以测试可移植性。

Result: 三大核心发现：(1) 在归一化分数阈值S≥0.8下，活跃循环状态在Catch上维持六个数量级的可用奖励尺度窗口，而零钉扎仅维持三个，差异为3[2,3]个数量级；(2) 错配历史的代价源于永久钳制而非历史内容本身；在低接受者尺度下，允许导入状态自然演化可减轻供体错配的代价（交互作用：0.393[0.079,0.861]）；(3) 在Catch动作反转下，控制回放保留容量可逆转Disco103相对DQN的恢复优势。有效类别箱统计揭示不同接口下相似行为对应不同内部表征。方案移植到OPEN规则成功，扩展了协议可行性。

Conclusion: 学习历史既不是无条件资产，也不是固有负担。历史在支持跨奖励尺度学习时是资产；当其在低接受者尺度下被阻止修改时，错配历史会成为更大负担。回放控制进一步分离表面适应与内在可塑性，揭示外部数据周转的贡献。可修改性是下一代自改进学习系统的核心设计原则。该工作建立了从算法自发现迈向自演化智能体的解释性蓝图和具体评估标准，为持续从经验学习而不被过去所束缚的智能系统奠定基础。同时强调在审计记忆支持的能力前必须先建立能力门槛（如完整Atari中的Pong实验所示）。

Abstract: The pursuit of recursive self-improvement (RSI) toward general intelligence is divided between macro-level language model scaling and the interaction-driven principles of "Era of Experience". Yet, any self-improving architecture ultimately rests upon its underlying optimization engine: if general intelligence requires learning from grounded interaction, the reinforcement learning (RL) update rule itself must be capable of cumulative adaptation. While algorithm self-discovery has produced Disco103 that surpassed PPO to achieve SOTA benchmark performance -- its internal update machinery remains an uninspected black box. We present the first causal mechanistic audit of a self-discovered RL rule, structured directly around the five pillars of the Era of Experience: extended horizon, grounded reward scales, continuing streams, within-lifetime change, and exploration depth. By surgically pinning, freezing, and transplanting recurrent states while holding meta-parameters fixed, we test when learning history acts as an asset or a burden. Three findings organize the audit: (1) Recurrent history actively expands usable reward scales, sustaining a six-decade window versus three under zero-pinning. (2) Decoupling historical content from its maintenance reveals that the penalty of mismatched history stems from perpetual clamping; allowing imported state to evolve naturally attenuates this burden. (3) Under environmental change, controlling replay retention reverses the apparent adaptation advantage over DQN, demonstrating that external data turnover can confound internal plasticity. Validated through capability thresholds and ported to a second rule (OPEN), this work grounds macro-RSI ambitions in micro-level learning dynamics, establishing a foundational audit standard for next-generation, self-evolving RL algorithms.

</details>


### [241] [Grab a Coffee: Future-Aware Guidance for Discrete Diffusion with Compiled Objectives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35924)
*Dongxin Li,Gwen Yidou-Weng,Guy Van den Broeck,Wei Wang,Anji Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: COFFEE是一个即插即用的离散扩散模型推理时引导框架，通过将序列级目标编译为有限状态自动机与无目标依赖载体配对，在多项式时间内完成联合重建，避免指数级枚举，在符号、语言和生物序列任务上实现强控制效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散模型在推理时难以用序列级目标（如奖励、约束）进行引导，因为某个未解析token的价值取决于它与其他token组合形成高奖励序列的方式，对所有可能补全进行枚举的计算量随未解析位置数指数增长。现有方法要么需要噪声状态下的属性估计器，要么需要完成序列后再搜索，难以同时建模token间依赖与序列级偏好。

Method: COFFEE在每个扩散步骤中构建两个组件：(1) 无目标依赖载体（dependence carrier），如链式HMM，吸收去噪器给出的边际token分布形成未解析token的联合模型；(2) 编译目标（compiled objective），使用Aho-Corasick自动机将序列级偏好（硬约束或学习软奖励）表示为局部状态转移和权重。两者配对形成乘积图，通过动态规划在联合状态空间上计算后向消息，复杂度从指数级降至多项式（O(L·A·|V|·H²)）。最后从归一化的联合分布中采样得到干净重建，再传给冻结的扩散更新规则。

Result: 在Dream和LLaDA骨干网络上，对Dyck修复（100%有效性，编辑距离7.8）、Sudoku（100%有效性）、CommonGen（100%词汇覆盖）、RealToxicityPrompts（高无毒率）、DNA调控任务（DeepSTARR、APARENT、K562）和蛋白质设计（Protein-1YCR）等任务进行评估，COFFEE在控制指标上几乎全面超越CDD、CDM、D-CBG、DG-TAG、GILC-DB、MDM-VGB等基线，并在低去噪预算下保持优势。机制分析显示未来目标因子确实影响当前token选择（K562查询中AAAAAA的概率从0.771降至0.500）。

Conclusion: COFFEE证明了将序列级目标以编译有限状态形式引入推理过程、而非仅用于评估的可行性，使联合条件、补全加权引导和基于优化的约束能够在预训练神经生成中实现，展示了神经-符号方法在扩散引导中的潜力，但也存在模式坍缩（如DeepSTARR退化为单一全T序列）和表示容量受限于有限状态类等局限。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion models generate sequences by iteratively resolving multiple tokens in parallel, offering a flexible alternative to left-to-right generation. However, guiding this process with a sequence-level objective is difficult because the value of one unresolved token depends on the other tokens with which it can form a high-reward sequence. Enumerating all such completions makes the whole guidance computation grow exponentially with the number of unresolved positions. We introduce COFFEE, a plug-and-play framework that avoids this enumeration by separating sequence dependence from the objective. At each diffusion step, a target-free carrier absorbs the marginal token distributions predicted by the denoiser to construct a joint model over the unresolved tokens, while a compiled finite-state model records how their combinations affect the sequence-level preference. Pairing their states allows COFFEE to transfer global preferences to unresolved positions and sample a clean reconstruction without retraining the diffusion model. The same framework supports explicit hard constraints and learned soft objectives. We evaluate COFFEE across multiple symbolic, language, and biological benchmarks, where it achieves strong control results with task-dependent quality and diversity trade-offs. By making objectives available to inference rather than only evaluation, COFFEE brings joint conditioning, completion-weighted guidance, and optimization-based constraints into pretrained neural generation, showing the potential of neural-symbolic methods in diffusion guidance.

</details>


### [242] [Right Words, Wrong Moment: A Clinician-Grounded Analysis of Distress in 19,930 Conversations between Young People and ChatGPT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35953)
*Marx Wang,Ella Zhang,Cameron Tan,Andrea Mock,Songling Ngo,Zijing Wang,Robert Wolfe,Shirin Amouei,Rachel A. Hanebutt,Desmond C. Ong,Caroline Figueroa,Katie Davis,Anind K. Dey,Alexis Hiniker*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究18-25岁年轻人在心理困扰时使用ChatGPT的情况，基于158名年轻人的19,930条真实对话记录和10位临床医生的评审，发现心理困扰程度较高的年轻人在情感投入和行为改变上更强；ChatGPT常给出过度戏剧化、过早提供大量建议的回复，且缺乏安全评估；据此提出"先问安全→降低情绪强度→再探索"的五项设计指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用对话型AI（如ChatGPT）虽非专为心理健康设计，但18-25岁年轻人频繁在情绪困扰时使用它们，且相关风险（如情感过度依赖、妄想、自伤加剧等）已引起学界和公众关注。然而已有研究多依赖回溯报告、公开帖子或研究脚本，缺乏对真实完整对话的细粒度分析，也缺乏来自临床专业人士的对话级评审和改写。因此亟需基于自然对话数据，结合临床视角，理解GPCA在心理困扰情境中"做对了什么、做错了什么"，并据此形成可落地的设计规范。

Method: 采用三阶段混合方法：（1）通过自建去标识化聊天记录收集工具，从158名18-25岁年轻人处获取19,930条完整ChatGPT对话，并收集PHQ-4心理困扰量表和11项ChatGPT使用体验问卷，用Welch t检验和Cohen's d比较困扰组与非困扰组差异，经Benjamini-Hochberg FDR校正；（2）从语料中经三轮阅读筛选出5个高情感困扰的典型对话（涉及自伤、妄想、性侵、失恋、性欲羞耻）；（3）招募10位有18-25岁青少年/青年服务经验的有执照临床医生（含心理学家、社工、精神科医生等），先通过前置工作表阅读5个对话并改写ChatGPT回复（共33条改写），再进行1小时半结构化访谈，对访谈记录进行归纳式主题分析（归纳编码→亲和图聚类→协商达成共识），最终归纳出7类过程失败和3阶段回应框架。

Result: 1. 困扰组（PHQ-4≥6，n=63）在情感投入（M=3.31 vs 2.84, d=+0.40）和行为改变（M=3.89 vs 3.54, d=+0.44）上显著高于非困扰组（n=95），信任和自我效能呈同向边际显著，依赖担忧无显著差异；2. 在5个真实对话中，ChatGPT表现出：对话极少追问澄清、在几乎不了解情况时就提供大量分段建议、用词过度强烈和戏剧化、在用户明确拒绝建议后仍持续给建议、缺乏针对具体可及资源的转介、并倾向于在情感上"取代"人际支持；3. 10位临床医生肯定了ChatGPT的可用性和部分措辞，但识别出7类反复出现的"过程失败"——未经询问便声称了解（F1，10/10）、探索不足即给方案（F2，10/10）、提供超量通用建议（F3，10/10）、角色和亲密度越界（F4，9/10）、安全评估不一致（F5，9/10）、有害顺从（F6，9/10）、以更激烈的情绪回应用户的激动情绪从而加剧失调（F7，7/10）；4. 临床医生改写遵循三阶段有序流程：先问安全→降低强度恢复情绪调节→不带认同地探索，并据此提炼出5项可验证的设计指南（G1-G5）。

Conclusion: 论文得出三点核心结论：（1）心理困扰与年轻人对ChatGPT更强的情感投入和更高的行为改变显著相关；（2）当年轻人处于急性心理困扰时，ChatGPT倾向于给出冗长、戏剧化、过早且过量行动导向的建议，并缺乏安全评估和具体转介，但其措辞和可用性获得了临床医生的部分认可；（3）基于33条临床医生改写，研究提炼出五项针对GPCA的设计指南（G1有意排序：安全→共同调节→探索；G2保持角色边界；G3不带建议地回应；G4承认未知而非假设；G5提供可及的具体转介），强调GPCA的安全护栏应超出内容层面、深入到过程层面的排序与情绪强度管理，并在使用GPCA回应心理困扰时应注意其与人际支持的差距，结合实时评估进一步验证。

Abstract: Young people increasingly turn to General-Purpose Conversational Agents (GPCAs), such as ChatGPT, in moments of distress. We examine young adults' (ages 18-25) experiences using ChatGPT. We first collected 19,930 ChatGPT conversations and survey data from 158 young adults. We then selected five example conversations reflecting user distress. Finally, we asked ten clinicians to review those five conversations. We found distressed participants reported greater emotional engagement with ChatGPT and greater behavioral change from using it than their peers. When they turned to ChatGPT in moments of acute distress, ChatGPT was quick to give overly dramatic responses and excessive action-oriented suggestions. Clinicians endorsed ChatGPT's availability and much of its wording, but identified seven process failures, such as prematurely jumping to solutions. We translated clinicians' feedback into design guidelines following three stages: 1) asking about safety, 2) de-escalating intensity to restore emotional regulation, and 3) exploring concerns without agreeing with them.

</details>


### [243] [SAGE: A Statistical Acceptance Gate for Self-Evolving Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36043)
*Yihao Wang,Linhan Xia,Rui Liu,Zhaofeng Zhang,Hongyu Wu,Yang Yang,Jinglu He,Yu Guo,Kai Lei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SAGE，一种基于统计假设检验的接受门控机制，用于解决LLM智能体自进化过程中朴素接受规则导致的两个缺陷：永久性回归和优化器诅咒（Optimizer's Curse）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的智能体通过编辑持久的技能文档实现自进化，该过程包含优化器提出候选编辑和门控决定是否接受两个步骤。现有研究（如SOTA方法SkillOpt）主要关注优化器，但门控仍采用朴素的"只要提升聚合验证分数即接受"的规则，存在两大缺陷：（1）聚合分数可能掩盖已解决问题上的永久性回归；（2）有限且含噪的验证集上的最高观测分数存在向上偏差（优化器诅咒）。

Method: SAGE包含两个核心组件：（1）逐项配对评估：在相同验证项上比较当前技能与编辑后的技能，区分胜利、回归和平局，对回归施加非对称惩罚（λ≥1的折减净增益Δλ=w-λℓ，以及经验回归比例ρ）；（2）单侧配对假设检验：基于不一致对进行精确条件二项检验pλ(w,ℓ)=Pr[Bin(m,qλ)≥w]，其中qλ=λ/(1+λ)，仅当Δλ>0、pλ<α、ρ≤τ时接受编辑，否则弃权。该机制是标准门控的保守细化，在边界参数(λ,α,τ)=(1,1,1)下可精确恢复基线。

Result: 在五个基准（LiveMath、SpreadsheetBench、SearchQA、OfficeQA、ALFWorld）和四个骨干LLM（DeepSeek-V4、GLM-5.2、MiniMax-M3、Qwen3.6）的等预算协议下，SAGE在20个设置中的19个降低了回归率，剩余1个与基线持平；例如DeepSeek-V4上LiveMath回归率从36.5%降至0%，OfficeQA从42.8%降至0%。同时SAGE在全部20个设置中获得最高最终分数，LiveMath从34.15提升至48.78。消融实验表明逐项配对贡献平均6.20分增益，完整SAGE在配对基础上再增2.53分。

Conclusion: SAGE证明了智能体自进化中的接受决策是被忽视的关键瓶颈，统计接受机制应与编辑提案获得同等方法论关注。SAGE作为标准门控的保守细化，能有效防止回归并抵御优化器诅咒，其收益在高回归风险任务上尤为显著。未来工作方向包括扩展至分级验证器、自适应阈值、多模态评估以及多智能体协同接受规则。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents increasingly self-evolve by editing a persistent skill document that encodes their workflow, tool-use rules, and decision logic. This loop has two steps, an optimizer that proposes a candidate edit and a gate that accepts or rejects it. Prior work has concentrated on the optimizer, while the gate still follows a naive rule that keeps any edit which improves an aggregate validation score. We show that this rule fails in two ways. First, it admits permanent regressions, since an edit can raise the average while breaking items the skill already solves. Second, it is vulnerable to the Optimizer's Curse, since the best observed score on a finite and noisy validation set is upward biased. To solve the above two limitations, we propose a statistical acceptance gate for self-evolving agents (SAGE). Compared with previous work, SAGE has two contributions. First, SAGE proposes a per-item paired comparison that evaluates the current skill and the edited skill on identical validation items, which exposes regressions that an aggregate score hides and penalizes them asymmetrically. Second, SAGE also employs a one-sided paired test that commits an edit only when its wins are statistically reliable against its losses, and it abstains otherwise. SAGE is a conservative refinement of the standard gate that recovers the baseline exactly at a boundary setting. It commits only a subset of the baseline's edits, filtering out those whose gains are unreliable or purchased by breaking already-solved items. Across five benchmarks and four backbone LLMs under an equal-budget protocol, SAGE lowers the regression rate in 19 of 20 settings and matches the baseline in the remaining one, for example from 36.5% to 0% on LiveMath and from 42.8% to 0% on OfficeQA with DeepSeek-V4. SAGE also attains the highest final score in all 20 settings, raising LiveMath from 34.15 to 48.78.

</details>


### [244] [PowerZooJax: A JAX-based Power System Benchmark for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36052)
*Zhanhua Pan,Xiao Liu,Zhilong Cao,Jianhong Wang,Dawei Qiu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PowerZooJax 是一个基于 JAX 的电力系统强化学习基准套件，提供五个覆盖发电、输电、配电、分布式能源资源和数据中心微电网的约束马尔可夫决策过程任务，通过将潮流计算、经济调度、市场出清和设备动力学重写为 JAX 计算图，实现全流程 GPU 加速，相比 CPU 基线获得最高超过 2000 倍的吞吐量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有电力系统 RL 环境范围狭窄，且受限于 CPU 仿真工作流，导致大规模评估困难。需要一个既能保留电力系统物理建模精度，又能实现 GPU 端到端加速的统一基准，以支持可扩展、可复现的 RL 算法评估。

Method: 1) 将五个电力系统任务（GenCos 市场竞标、TSO 输电调度、DSO 配电需求响应、DERs 分布式能源协调、DCMG 数据中心微电网）统一建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）。2) 将径向交流潮流（DistFlow）、直流最优潮流（ADMM 求解）、市场出清（PDIPM 求解）以及设备动力学重写为固定形状的 JAX 计算图，使用 jax.lax.while_loop/fori_loop 替代 Python 循环，jax.vmap/scan 实现批量并行。3) 提供统一的 CMDP 接口（奖励+多通道安全成本）、标准化评估协议（包含分布外压力测试）以及 PPO、SAC、IPPO、PPO-Lagrangian、Sauté PPO 等基线算法。

Result: 在单块 RTX 4500 Ada GPU 上，PowerZooJax 相比 CPU 基线（SB3/SBX）获得 8× 至 2077× 的吞吐量加速，其中 GenCos 和 DERs（涉及求解器密集型计算）加速最高（>2000×）。GenCos 任务中 IPPO 学习到利润 395k GBP/天（介于均匀中间报价 303k 和最高加价 598k 之间），并在分布外压力测试中保持排序。TSO 任务中 PPO-Lagrangian 消除备用不足违规并将热过载率降至 6%，代价是运营成本从 1.58M 升至 3.50M GBP/天。DCMG 中 SAC 学到协调储能充放电以利用电价峰谷的长视域调度策略。

Conclusion: PowerZooJax 证明电力系统 RL 基准可以同时兼顾物理建模保真度和计算可扩展性。通过 GPU 端到端集成，实现了快速回滚同时保留真实电网决策所需的操作指标。五个任务在统一 CMDP 接口下展示了跨多样化电力系统设置的 RL 算法评估，标准化报告了收益、安全成本和压力测试性能。局限在于当前版本在电网规模、不确定性建模和任务多样性上仍有限制，且基于公开/合成数据，不能完全代表真实运行场景。

Abstract: Power system operation is a safety-critical sequential decision-making problem, making it a natural testbed for reinforcement learning (RL). However, existing RL environments for power systems are often narrow in scope and computationally limited by CPU-based simulation workflows, making large-scale evaluation difficult. We introduce PowerZooJax, a JAX-based benchmark suite for RL in power system operation. It provides five constrained Markov decision process tasks spanning generation, transmission, distribution, distributed energy resources, and data center microgrid. By rewriting power flow, economic dispatch, market clearing, and device dynamics as JAX computation graphs, PowerZooJax keeps the entire training and evaluation loop on the GPU. Experiments show substantial speedups over CPU-based simulations and demonstrate standardized evaluation of policy returns, safety violations, and out-of-distribution stress conditions. Our open-source benchmark is available at: this https URL .

</details>


### [245] [GeoWind2Plan: Mission-Time 3D Urban Wind Prediction for Energy-Efficient UAV Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36056)
*Shaoxiang Qin,Yucheng Zhao,Fuyuan Lyu,Di Zhou,Jiachen Yao,Xue Liu,Anima Anandkumar,Liangzhu Leon Wang,Xiongye Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GeoWind2Plan是一个任务时间内（mission-time）的几何-风场-规划一体化框架，针对城市低空无人机能量高效规划问题。它利用仅需的背景风矢量、3D建筑几何和起止点，通过局部几何条件神经算子预测任务相关的3D风场块，并将其拼接成可查询的局部风场，最后通过物理驱动的无人机能量模型联合优化3D路径和速度剖面。系统将风场推理从CFD的约8小时缩短至约3秒，在顺风、逆风、侧风任务中分别节能6.9%、12.7%和4.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市低空无人机任务中，建筑将环境风重塑为空间变化的3D流场，使得无人机能耗不仅取决于路径长度，还取决于局部风暴露情况。然而CFD虽能提供高保真风场，但每次模拟耗时数小时到数天，且绑定于固定的入流边界条件，无法适应任务时间内变化的来流方向和速度。因此需要一种快速、能够适应不同背景风条件且基于建筑几何的3D风场预测方法，使风感知规划在任务时间内可行。

Method: GeoWind2Plan框架包含四个核心模块：(1) 参考系神经算子F_φ——基于局部FNO设计，以多方向距离特征(MDDF)和SDF编码建筑几何，在固定参考入流条件下离线训练，预测局部3D风速场；(2) 风向适应——利用建筑解析平均流的偏航协方差性质（命题1），将城市几何旋转到参考风框中进行推理，再将预测向量场旋转回原始坐标系；(3) 风速适应——基于高雷诺数平均流相似性假设（假设1），通过U/U_ref比例缩放预测风场；(4) 走廊局部化推理——仅评估与任务走廊相交的风场块，拼接为可查询的局部风场。规划端采用RRT初始化+非线性轨迹优化，配备基于动量理论的多旋翼能量模型（包含有效机械功率、诱导功率和叶型功率），联合优化位置、速度和加速度。

Result: 在5个未见城市域（A-E）、3种风速（2、4、8 m/s）和3种风向制度（顺风、逆风、侧风）下进行测试：(1) 推理效率——20%走廊宽度推理约3秒，全场约15秒，相比CFD约8小时提速约4个数量级；(2) 能耗节省——相比风无关规划，在顺风、逆风、侧风任务中分别节能6.9%、12.7%和4.5%，恢复CFD参考规划节能量的87.9%、85.7%和75.0%；(3) 强风条件下优势更明显——8 m/s逆风时，风无关规划超载41.0%，本算法仅0.7%；(4) 走廊局部化——20%走廊宽度即可保持决策相关风结构，推理时间从15秒降至3秒；(5) 规模泛化——在3 km×3 km城市块E上仍接近CFD参考（全场超载仅2.5%）。

Conclusion: GeoWind2Plan证明了能量高效的城市无人机规划不需要逐点完美的风场重建。通过学习可泛化的几何-风场映射、预测任务相关的3D风走廊，并将局部风场与连续风感知轨迹优化耦合，系统能够在多样化城市几何、风速和风向下产生接近CFD参考规划的轨迹，同时将风场推理从小时级降至秒级，使建筑分解的城市风场成为实用的任务时间规划信号。局限包括使用时间平均风场（不模拟湍流功率波动和安全性风险）、假设背景风在任务期间固定。

Abstract: In urban low-altitude flight, buildings reshape ambient wind into spatially varying 3D flow, making unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) energy depend on local wind exposure as well as path length. However, building-resolved wind information is rarely available when a mission must be planned. Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) can produce high-fidelity urban flow fields, but each simulation is tied to a fixed inflow boundary condition and can take hours to days, which is incompatible with urban UAV missions that typically last minutes to tens of minutes. We present GeoWind2Plan, a geometry-to-wind-to-planning framework for mission-time 3D urban wind prediction and energy-efficient UAV planning. Given only a background wind vector, 3D building geometry, and a start-goal pair, GeoWind2Plan transforms the building geometry into a reference-wind frame, predicts mission-relevant 3D wind patches with a localized geometry-conditioned neural operator, stitches them into a queryable local wind field, and optimizes a feasible 3D path and speed profile using a physically grounded UAV energy model. Rather than pursuing CFD-perfect reconstruction, GeoWind2Plan targets decision-useful wind prediction: trajectories are planned with predicted wind and evaluated under high-fidelity CFD wind. Across held-out urban domains, wind speeds, and mission wind-angle regimes, GeoWind2Plan performs corridor-localized wind inference in about 3 seconds, compared with roughly 8 hours for CFD. Under CFD evaluation, trajectories planned with GeoWind2Plan reduce energy by 6.9%, 12.7%, and 4.5% in tailwind, headwind, and crosswind missions relative to wind-agnostic planning, recovering 87.9%, 85.7%, and 75.0% of CFD-reference savings. These results show that fast, corridor-localized 3D urban wind prediction can make wind-aware UAV energy planning practical at mission time.

</details>


### [246] [Mirror-Score: Calibrated, Inference-only Scoring Exposes the Limits of Sequence-compatibility Ranking in D-peptide Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36057)
*Jiada Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Mirror-Score 是首个面向异手性 D-肽/L-蛋白复合物的校准型、纯推理打分框架与公开基准（含 31 个晶体复合物、18 个文献验证亲和力），通过系统校准证明原始 ProteinMPNN NLL 作为亲和力排序指标失效（pooled Spearman=0.19，家族内符号翻转 MDM2/CHIP +0.62 vs gp41 -0.70），并提出以 Boltz-2 镜像空间共折叠界面 pLDDT 作为更优排序依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: D-肽计算设计流程（如 Mirror-Peptidizer）以原始 ProteinMPNN NLL 作为排序准则，但该指标从未与实测亲和力校准，导致实验命中率低（MDM2 设计 9 个中仅 4 个可检测结合）。领域亟需回答哪些可计算特征携带亲和力信息，以及单一打分能否跨靶点家族迁移。

Method: （i）沿 x 轴镜像靶点并进行手性质控；（ii）从 PDB 筛选 31 个 D-肽/L-蛋白晶体复合物（4 个靶点家族，18 个含文献验证亲和力），逐条记录溯源；（iii）计算三类特征——ProteinMPNN NLL、界面描述符、Boltz-2 共折叠置信度（pTM/ipTM/界面 pLDDT/界面 PAE 等）；（iv）以 log10 KD/IC50 为标签进行 Spearman 相关、留一法（LOO）交叉验证及跨家族留一族评估；（v）提出五步前瞻设计流程并以 LasR/LecB 为案例落地。

Result: NLL 整体 Spearman ρ=0.19（p=0.46），家族间符号翻转（MDM2/CHIP +0.62；gp41 -0.70），证伪其作为通用亲和力排序指标。Boltz-2 界面 pLDDT 在 gp41 病毒进入家族结构级 LOO ρ=0.90（p=0.006），肽层级正确排序全部三个独立化学型（PIE12>PIE71>PIE7）；但因仅 3 个独立化学型，结果被界定为方向一致性而非统计验证预测器。跨家族校准失败（最佳 ρ=-0.58），需采用家族匹配校准。

Conclusion: 不应以原始 ProteinMPNN NLL 进行 D-肽排序；建议使用镜像空间共折叠置信度（界面 pLDDT）结合小规模家族匹配校准集；跨家族打分迁移在当前样本量下不可支持。Mirror-Score 以 Apache-2.0 开源发布全部基准、镜像结构、热点图与设计脚本。

Abstract: D-peptides combine protease resistance with high target specificity, but computational design of D-peptide binders remains immature. Mirror-Peptidizer introduced an in silico mirror-image screening pipeline using target reflection, backbone generation, and ProteinMPNN sequence design, but its raw ProteinMPNN negative log-likelihood (NLL) ranking was not validated against measured affinities, and only 4 of 9 tested MDM2 designs bound detectably. We introduce Mirror-Score, a calibrated, inference-only scoring framework for heterochiral D-peptide/L-protein complexes, and a public benchmark of 31 crystal complexes across four target families, including 18 with literature-verified affinities. Raw ProteinMPNN NLL is not a valid affinity ranker: its pooled Spearman correlation with affinity is 0.19, and correlations reverse between MDM2/CHIP (+0.62) and gp41 (-0.70). We therefore evaluate Boltz-2 mirror-space cofolding confidence. For the complete viral-entry family (7 structures representing 3 peptides), interface predicted local distance difference test (pLDDT) achieves structure-level leave-one-out Spearman rho = 0.90 (p = 0.006) and correctly orders all three peptides by affinity, whereas NLL fails (structure-level rho = 0.18). Because only three independent chemotypes are represented, this result indicates directional consistency rather than a statistically validated predictor. Cross-family calibration does not transfer at current sample sizes, supporting family-matched calibration as the practical deployment mode. We also specify a prospective design protocol for the antimicrobial-resistance targets LasR and LecB from Pseudomonas aeruginosa, including mirrored structures, ligand-derived hotspot maps, diffusion-model-ready inputs, and Mirror-Score ranking. Code, benchmark data, structures, and analysis scripts are openly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [247] [SMat-Attention: Structured Long-Context Sequence Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36062)
*Emile Anand,Abdullah Ateyeh,Archer Wang,Marin Soljačić*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SMat-Attention提出了一种基于因果掩码VC维度的结构化长程注意力机制，通过点-超平面关联构造二进制掩码家族，实现softmax注意力与线性注意力之间的可调中间方案，在保持次二次预填充成本和常数时间解码的同时，以VC维度作为控制长程访问复杂度的显式架构参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的长上下文序列模型面临一个基本权衡：softmax注意力提供灵活的token级交互但计算成本为二次方，而线性注意力虽然实现线性训练和常数时间解码，却将整个历史压缩到固定大小的状态中，限制了关联召回能力。作者旨在通过引入VC维度作为可调的结构参数，弥合这两种机制之间的鸿沟，使长程访问模式的组合丰富度成为显式的架构旋钮。

Method: 1. 基于有限域上点-超平面关联构造VC维度为d的因果掩码家族M^(d)，d=1时退化为标准因果掩码L_T，d越大支持更丰富的子集路由模式；2. 掩码采用分块结构（远距离块+最近块），通过G=RCE^T的三因子分解实现profile表和type表的聚合复用；3. 提供chunkwise前向和反向算法，硬件效率高；4. 支持门控机制（M̃^(d)）与Mamba-2、Gated DeltaNet的扩展结合；5. 学习路由变体使用top-k查询读取和内容哈希；6. 提出stepped-window解码方案支持horizon-free推理。理论结果：硬路由预填充O(T^{2-3/d}+T)工作（d≤3时为O(T)线性），解码使用O(T^{1-1/d})缓存状态实现常数时间每token解码。

Result: 1. 子集路由实验验证了VC维度预测的路由表达力：d=4时在k=6子集选择上达到78.71%（vs d=1时9.96%）；2. 多键检索中d=4在k=3时达到98.99%精确支持匹配，显著优于线性基线（0%）和LSH分桶；3. MQAR任务中SMat扩展在Mamba-2和GDN上均改善了多个设置下的平均召回准确率（GDN宽度64时d=3达到87.37% vs基线70.59%）；4. 联合上下文-键召回中d=3在GDN上达到60.15% vs 基线33.78%；5. 端到端成本测量显示d≤2时SMat预填充与DeltaNet相当，d=3时256K上下文比softmax快210-300倍，解码快51倍，缓存小5.5-43倍；6. PG-19语言建模表现与基线相当（750M token训练后perplexity相近）；7. 步进窗口解码在长度泛化实验中保持性能（训练长度1024，评估8192时窗口方案达到97.6%，而固定边界仅51.9%）。

Conclusion: SMat-Attention通过将VC维度作为控制长程访问模式复杂度的显式架构参数，成功建立了softmax注意力和线性注意力之间的可调中间方案。该框架提供了次二次预填充成本和常数时间解码保证，同时通过点-超平面关联结构实现了比现有线性注意力变体更丰富的子集路由能力。实验验证了VC维度作为路由表达力预测指标的有效性，学习路由扩展在多个关联回忆任务上改善了Mamba-2和Gated DeltaNet基线。步进窗口解码方案有效解决了固定边界在长度泛化时的性能退化问题。未来工作方向包括更自适应的路由方案、动态上下文和更大规模语言模型评估。

Abstract: Long-context sequence models face a fundamental tradeoff: softmax attention uses flexible token-level interactions at quadratic cost, whereas linear attention obtains linear-time training and constant-time decoding by compressing history into a fixed-size state. In this work, we ask whether we can connect these regimes through a tunable notion of structure. To this end, we introduce Structured Matrix Attention (SMat-Attention) via a family of causal masks with structured long-range routing whose row supports have VC-dimension $d$. In our construction, $d=1$ recovers the standard causal mask, and increasing $d$ permits richer subset-routing patterns. We give chunkwise forward and backward algorithms to enable hardware-efficiency. For sequences of length $T$, the hard-routing construction takes $O(T^{2-3/d}+T)$ work, despite the mask being dense, for our prescribed family. In fixed-horizon streaming, decoding after the distant prefix takes constant time per token using $O(T^{1-1/d})$ cached states. SMat-Attention therefore makes VC-dimension an explicit knob governing access-pattern complexity, prefill cost, and decoding memory. Empirically, subset-routing and rule-assisted multi-key retrieval experiments illustrate the masks' routing expressiveness. Extensions to Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet using learned routing with top-$k$ query reads retain subquadratic prefill, improve recall accuracy over the backbones in several settings, and achieve comparable small-scale language-modeling performance.

</details>


### [248] [LongCat-DeepResearch Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36071)
*Meituan LongCat Team,He Zhu,Yue Xu,Wanli Wu,Haolin Ren,Yuxin Bian,Jiarui Zhao,Rongzhi Zhang,Quanchi Weng,Jinghao Cui,Yu Fan,Yuhan Liu,Yunhu Ye,Jiyuan Ren,Fengcheng Yuan,Zhao Yang,Jiacheng Zhang,Yuchuan Dai,Ruixuan Xiao,Haozhe Sun,Xiangyuan Liu,Cheng Sun,Yao Du,Yiming Hao,Hongbo Guo,Shuo He,Lei Wang,Xunliang Cai,Yan Chen,Fan Yang,Lingchuan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LongCat-DeepReport 是美团 LongCat 团队推出的深度研究系统，由增强版 LongCat 模型与多智能体工作流组成。工作流将全局规划与详细调查分离，并通过节级编辑协调修订。其核心创新是引入 ResearchSpec——一个可执行的、紧凑的研究规范，作为报告所需内容的前瞻代理。多个规划智能体先探索外部资源并完善 ResearchSpec；研究智能体在独立上下文中并行调研并撰写其负责的章节；章节被组装后，全局编辑指导本地编辑进行有针对性的局部修订，避免重复重写整篇报告。

在三个公开基准和一个内部基准上对系统进行评估。LongCat-DeepResearch 在 DeepResearchBench 上得分 55.25、DeepResearchBench II 上 51.35、ResearchRubrics 上 79.83，以及在内部基准上得分 76.04（四个对比系统中排名第二）。系统在这三个公开基准上均超过 ChatGPT-DeepResearch、Claude-DeepResearch 和 Gemini-DeepResearch。

该工作流还支持为 LongCat 通用模型的中训练和后训练构建研究任务和轨迹。开发集分析表明，组合不同规划视角有益，但进一步的规划优化效果混合。额外的编辑轮次能改善两个基准的平均可读性偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放式深度研究要求语言模型智能体在证据需求无法事先完全规定的情况下调查未明确的问题，并综合发现形成全面的长篇报告。现有系统在反馈研究与写作时面临三大困难：（1）证据、中间推理和草稿文本竞争有限的上下文，压缩可能删除尚未显现相关性的信息；（2）早期发现会锚定正在发展的叙事并收窄后续搜索视角；（3）重复更新整篇报告会重新生成超出新证据影响范围的文本。本文旨在解决如何在不将整个调查集中于不断扩展的草稿中的前提下，保留研究与写作之间的反馈。

Method: 方法核心是引入一个紧凑的研究规范（ResearchSpec）作为报告所需建立内容的代理，将早期迭代从完整报告转移到这一规范上。

1. **规划阶段**：多个独立的 Planning Writers 在提交计划前短暂搜索和阅读外部资源，以获取先验知识之外的证据基础。Planning Judge 整合候选规范，Critic 寻找缺失的问题和案例，Reviser 整合反馈。ResearchSpec 记录每个章节的范围、研究问题、所需实体或案例以及临时来源线索，并赋予唯一的层级 ID（如 S1.2）。

2. **研究阶段**：每个 Researcher 接收原始查询、完整 ResearchSpec 和单个章节分配，在独立上下文中开展详细工具交互，并行执行，写出带有引用的章节。完整章节被保留作为工件，不依赖于先前生成的章节。

3. **组装与编辑阶段**：章节按 ResearchSpec 顺序机械组装，保留文本和引用。Global Editor 阅读完整草稿，分配重复材料的所有权、识别冲突并指定变更。Local Editors 在其分配章节上应用指令，输出范围是局部的，避免单次调用重生成整个文档。

4. **数据构建**：问题-解耦的质量与证据相关的评分标准通过基于独立源材料的文章路径和冻结的多源简报路径构建，并经过搜索能力检查（Keep/Revise/Drop 闸门）和确定性检查（重复评分标准、答案泄漏、排除源泄漏、时间范围）。教师执行工作流收集阶段特定的轨迹，经过角色身份、工具调用/响应闭合性、中间工件有效性等过滤检查，用于中训练和后训练。

5. **模型与训练**：研究相关数据与其它数据一起用于 LongCat 通用模型的中训练和后训练；LongCat-DeepResearch 将该模型与上述研究工作流相结合。

Result: **主要基准结果**（表1）：

- DeepResearchBench（GPT-5.5 medium 评判）：LongCat-DeepResearch 总体 55.25，超过 ChatGPT-DeepResearch（54.95）+0.30、Claude-DeepResearch（53.43）和 Gemini-DeepResearch（50.21）。在全面性（56.21）、洞察/深度（56.48）和指令遵循（55.18）上领先；可读性（49.96）仍较弱。

- DeepResearchBench II：总体 51.35，超过 Claude-DeepResearch（48.18）+3.17。在信息回忆（46.42）和分析（60.69，分析上 60.69 对比次高 52.26，优势显著）上领先；展示（83.13）次于 ChatGPT-DeepResearch（86.98）。

- ResearchRubrics（Gemini 2.5 Pro 评判）：总体 79.83，超过 ChatGPT-DeepResearch（74.21）+5.62。在显式要求（86.97）、隐式要求（79.52）和综合（78.92）上领先。

- 内部基准：76.04，第二名，超过 Claude-DeepResearch（61.42）和 Gemini-DeepResearch（42.49），落后 ChatGPT-DeepResearch（76.59）0.55 分。

**组件消融**（表2）：完整流程在 DeepResearchBench II（48.68）和 ResearchRubrics（79.14）上均优于单 Writer→Reviser、单整体报告 Researcher 和无 Editor 的变体（均值 63.91 为最高）。

**ResearchSpec 优化**（表3）：W0 单 Writer 计划的显式覆盖率 53.76%，J0 Judge 整合计划 60.47%，R1 一轮修订 63.74%、R2 两轮修订 63.74%；报告质量也随规划聚合而改善，但进一步优化的效果混合。

**Editor 缩放**（表4）：增强 Editor 的多轮迭代将 DRB-II 上从 A0 的 55.87 提升到 B3 的 58.38（+2.51，95% 区间 [+0.63, +4.78]），ResearchRubrics 上 A0 的 85.91 提升到 B2 的 86.87；平均可读性偏好从 50.00 提升到 53.96。增强 Editor 共同改变源访问、指令和迭代次数，未分解各自贡献。

**模型与工作流配置**（表5）：当前 LongCat + 当前工作流在三个基准上的均值为 62.14；前版本 + 当前工作流为 58.05；前版本 + ReAct/直接报告为 47.04。

**案例研究**：AI 增强投资组合管理（DRB-II 012，最终 89.88）展示 ResearchSpec、章节研究和编辑交互；生成式 AI 与劳动力市场（DRB-II 056，最终 11.43）暴露规划优化无法解决的覆盖缺口。

Conclusion: LongCat-DeepReport 将早期研究迭代从完整报告转移到 ResearchSpec 上，通过并行规划定义证据要求和章节职责，研究智能体独立开发带引用的章节，作者编辑协调修订组装草稿。这些接口还支持研究任务和轨迹的构建。

系统在三个公开基准（DeepResearchBench 55.25、DeepResearchBench II 51.35、ResearchRubrics 79.83）和一个内部基准（76.04）上具有竞争力。在匹配的开发子集上，完整 LongCat 流水线具有最高的组件研究均值。完整基准的模型-工作流比较有利于当前系统：当前工作流在前版本模型下提升，当前模型进一步在该工作流下提升。进一步的规划优化产生混合的类别级效果，而增强的编辑轮次改善了平均可读性偏好。这些观察仅针对评估配置，并未分离训练阶段的贡献。

研究规范覆盖度支持对计划要求的早期检查；事实验证和独立报告评估仍属必要。局限包括：（1）规划范围固定于规划阶段，章节研究后重新开放全局议程不在核心范围内；（2）研究和编辑可能保留于相关细节；（4）报告可能冗长、密集或重复，仍有可读性改进空间；（3）评估指标不能全面衡量所有方面（如 Fact），且部分研究子集使用先前检查过的开发子集。

Abstract: We present LongCat-DeepResearch, a deep research system that combines an enhanced LongCat model with a multi-agent workflow for producing comprehensive, evidence-grounded reports. The workflow separates global planning from detailed investigation and coordinates revision at the section level. Multiple planning agents first explore external sources and refine an actionable research plan, termed ResearchSpec. Research agents then investigate and draft their assigned sections in parallel, gathering additional evidence in separate contexts as their analyses develop. Once the sections are assembled, global review guides targeted local revisions, reducing reliance on repeated full-report rewriting. This workflow also supports the construction of research tasks and trajectories for the mid-training and post-training of LongCat's general-purpose models. LongCat-DeepResearch achieves 55.25 on DeepResearchBench, 51.35 on DeepResearchBench II, and 79.83 on ResearchRubrics. On an in-house benchmark, it scores 76.04, ranking second among four compared systems. Development-set analyses show benefits from combining planning perspectives, while further planning refinement has mixed effects. Additional editing improves average automatic readability preference across two benchmarks, with different trends on each.

</details>


### [249] [A Polyphonic Conception of AI Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36079)
*Matthieu Queloz,Pierre Beckmann*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种"复调式"（polyphonic）AI理解概念，挑战了传统"单声部"（monophonic）理解范式。作者基于LLM内部机制的实证证据，主张模型输出源于多个并行、可靠性不均的机制联盟。论文提出以"可靠回路"（sound circuitry）为中心的新理解概念，强调其存在性、招募性和控制性，为AI输出信任的判断提供可操作的依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医生、法官等实践者需要判断是否信任AI输出，但纯数学/统计描述无法区分可信与不可信输出，而任何能做出这种区分的词汇最终都会重新引入"理解"概念。现有的理解概念建立在"单声部"假设之上——即理解定位于单一机制——但这一假设在LLM面前失效，需要重新工程化理解概念以指导信任分配。

Method: 1. **隐喻构建**：通过"陪审团传阅"类比（每天新陪审员基于桌上遗留笔记工作，最终给出统一裁决）映射Transformer计算机制。2. **再引入论证（Reintroduction Argument）**：证明任何试图用非认知词汇区分AI输出可靠性的尝试，最终都会重塑理解概念的推理连接。4. **机制可解释性证据综合**：综合Elhage、Lindsey、Nanda、Wang等多位研究者的机制可解释性发现，包括归因图（attribution graph）、电路（circuit）、特征（feature）层面的实证。5. **案例研究**：以Claude 3.5 Haiku的先兆子痫诊断和Llama-3.1-8B的通用加法电路为例。6. **谬误识别**：识别"定位谬误"和"启发式排斥谬误"两种推理陷阱。

Result: 1. LLM在特征、连接、电路三个层面均呈现"复调性"——同一内容由多个特征编码，电路内含多重路径，同一任务可由多个独立电路完成。2. 识别出四种"可靠回路"未控制输出的情况：休眠（dormancy）、误招募（misrecruitment）、干扰（interference）、计算瓶颈（compute bottleneck）。3. 提出理解的双维度：深度（depth，取决于回路的准确性和通用性）与控制力（hold，取决于招募和控制的可靠性）。4. 在前沿模型层面，机制证据的收集仍具可行性，可作为系统卡（system cards）认证机制的基础。

Conclusion: 论文提出"AI理解"的工作定义：当模型的输出源于为该任务正确招募并控制输出的可靠回路（特征、连接、电路的组合）时，模型即理解其所作所为。回路可能是联合充分但单独不足的联盟，且模型可能拥有多个此类联盟。理解无需唯一内部位置，深度与控制力可分离。这一概念将AI理解的哲学问题转化为可经验研究的实证问题——关于可靠回路的存在、招募、控制和作用范围——并为实践中分配信任提供了可行路径。论文最后指出当前LLM存在"编排差距"（orchestration gap），即未能像人类那样可靠地协调其部分能力。

Abstract: When a doctor, a judge, or an engineer must decide whether to trust an AI model's output, they cannot avoid asking what the model understands. Purely mathematical or statistical descriptions struggle to distinguish trustworthy from untrustworthy outputs without reintroducing the question of AI understanding in all but name. Yet the question is ill-framed as it stands, because the inherited concept operates within a monophonic paradigm: the idea that a cognitive system's understanding of something must be localised to a single mechanism underpinning all the capacities conferred by such understanding. Drawing on a wide range of mechanistic evidence, we show that LLMs are pervasively polyphonic: outputs emerge from coalitions of parallel mechanisms of uneven reliability, which variously complement, duplicate, or drown out one another, with several coalitions sufficing for a task without any one being indispensable. Polyphony not only complicates attributions of understanding, but renders monophonic inference patterns hazardous. In response, we develop a conception of understanding fit for polyphonic AI. It centres on sound circuitry that is reliably and correctly recruited and in control of outputs. Attributions of understanding thereby become tractable claims about internal organisation, and can do the work of guiding trust in AI.

</details>


### [250] [GeoOutageBench: Benchmarking Ambiguity-aware, Ontology-grounded Geospatiotemporal KGQA for Multimodal Power Outage and Resilience Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36082)
*Ethan D. Frakes,Amy Kvien,Rishabh Kundu,Redad Mehdi,Van D. Tran,Vibha S. Mandayam,Kristopher O. Davis,Erika I. Barcelos,Roger H. French,Yinghui Wu,Mengjie Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GeoOutageBench 是首个面向电力故障与韧性分析的地理时空KGQA基准，针对多模态数据（停电记录、夜光遥感、气象观测、风暴事件、地理实体与领域本体）构建时空知识图谱GeoOutageKG，通过七类能力型查询（空间包含/邻近、时间区间、事件序列、时空共现、多模态证据、情景假设）和48条基准问题、72个参考SPARQL解释，评估LLM的：(1)对含歧义地理时空问题的NL2SPARQL能力；(2)本体效用（Query Coverage/Closeness）；(3)多模态KGQA答案准确性。实验测试GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Claude Opus 4.7三种模型，结果显示Claude Opus 4.7在时空约束F1（ST F1=0.711）和答案SRS（0.850）上最优，GPT-5.5在执行兼容性上最强（1.000），Gemini 3.1 Pro在类别恢复上领先（Class F1=0.834）。GeoOutageOnto覆盖率1.0，平均Closeness为0.0673。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有KGQA基准（如LC-QuAD、QALD、SciQA、Spider4SPARQL）主要面向百科或学术类Web知识图谱，对以下三点支持不足：(1) LLM对领域特定时空语义（含联合时空约束的歧义NL问题）的理解；(2) 本体与KG对KGQA的可利用性量化评估；(3) 多模态证据（停电记录、风暴报告、遥感影像）对KGQA质量的影响。电力故障和极端天气频发且影响加剧，亟需支持基础设施韧性分析的LLM-KG系统评估工具。

Method: (1) 构建GeoOutageOnto本体与GeoOutageKG：整合EAGLE-I停电记录（1173万实例）、NOAA风暴事件（201万）、HURDAT飓风、SVI社会脆弱性、Black Marble夜光遥感（33.5万NTL图像）、TIGER地理元数据；以MDS-Onto/BFO为顶层对齐基础。(2) 七类能力型查询：空间包含/邻近、时间区间、事件序列、时空共现、多模态证据、情景/反事实，分1-3跳复杂度。(3) 原始操作算子库ℒ（NL2STQ、Q2A、OntoQ2A、mmQ2A、mmOntoQ2A及地理缓冲、时空连接、kNN、栅格瓦片UDF）。(4) 三大评估任务及自定义指标集𝒫：Task 1含Syntax/Compat/Exact/Align/Class F1/Prop F1/Schema F1/Spatial F1/Temporal F1/ST F1；Task 2含Query Coverage与Closeness；Task 3含Prec/Rec/F1/Hits@k/MRR/nDCG@10/SRS。(5) 配置profile𝒞=(𝒬,𝒪,ℛ𝒬,𝒢,ℳ,𝒫)支持用户可配置评估。(6) 11人专家团队（4能源环境+4计算机+2地理+3电力）人工设计+LLM辅助生成NL问题，CS专家验证SPARQL真值。

Result: Task 1（48问题，72参考解释）：三模型均100%语法有效；GPT-5.5与Claude Opus 4.7兼容性1.0，Gemini 0.979；Exact Match接近0；Claude Opus 4.7在Align(0.805)、Prop F1(0.774)、Schema F1(0.772)、Spatial F1(0.886)、Temporal F1(0.754)、ST F1(0.711)全面领先；GPT-5.5 Spatial F1次之(0.870)；Gemini Class F1最高(0.834)。ST轴细分：Claude达ST F1=0.850，S F1=0.891，T F1=0.863。Task 2：GeoOutageOnto覆盖率1.0，平均Closeness=0.0673（范围0.0196–0.1373），反映查询复杂度差异。Task 3：Claude Answer F1=0.540、SRS=0.850；GPT Answer F1=0.522、SRS=0.785；Gemini Answer F1=0.314。二跳明显易过多跳（GPT 0.992 vs 0.310）。多模态case study展示同一模糊问题可通过mmQ2A附加NTL图像与停电地图证据。

Conclusion: GeoOutageBench填补了时空KGQA基准空白，验证了：(1) Claude Opus 4.7在时空理解综合最强，GPT-5.5执行可靠性高，Gemini 3.1 Pro类恢复优；(2) 语法/可执行≠答案正确，答案级评估更具判别力；(3) GeoOutageOnto为本基准查询负载提供完整词汇支撑，但schema利用率随查询复杂度变化；(4) 多模态证据可补充停电范围与恢复时间线的可视化解释。未来工作将扩展反事实时空推理、跨模态混合检索、网络攻击/电网过载等其他扰动源，并将Black Marble与EAGLE-I覆盖扩展至佛罗里达以外。

Abstract: We introduce GeoOutageBench, a benchmark for assessing LLM-based geospatiotemporal KGQA for multimodal outage and resilience analysis. Unlike existing KGQA benchmarks for Web knowledge, GeoOutageBench considers a spatiotemporal KG that integrates visual, textual, and structured data from outage records, remote sensing, weather observations, storm and power events, geographic entities, and domain ontologies. It provides a competency query taxonomy at different difficulty levels from spatiotemporal containment and proximity, spatiotemporal co-occurrence analysis, multimodal evidence, to hypothetical evaluation. Over multimodal KG and query classes, GeoOutageBench provides user-configurable evaluation of three important, highly coherent yet less studied tasks: (1) LLMs' understanding for ambiguous geospatiotemporal questions in terms of NL to SPARQL interpretation, (2) query-driven assessment of ontology utility, and (3) answer accuracy of multimodal KGQA retrieval. GeoOutageBench provides a design principle and foundation for assessing LLM-KG systems that support real-world infrastructure resilience analysis. Our benchmark, source code, data, results, and other documentation are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [251] [An Exact Generate - Transform Decomposition of Small-LLM Team Scaling Across Orchestration Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36104)
*Blaz Bertalanic,Carolina Fortuna*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统地研究了八种多智能体编排架构在五个7-9B小型开源LLM上的扩展行为，覆盖六个基准测试（最多30次调用），并提出了一个精确的"生成-变换"（Generate-Transform）分解框架，将准确率变化精确拆分为"广度覆盖红利"和"强度变换变化"两部分，揭示了团队规模化的回报高度依赖于任务类型：在算术题上有显著提升但在多选题上几乎无收益，且没有一种架构在所有任务上获胜。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实践者越来越多地用多智能体协作团队替代单次LLM调用，但尚不清楚：(1) 在哪些任务上增加团队规模（即更多调用）确实有效；(2) 哪些架构能更好地利用扩展预算；(3) 扩展带来的收益究竟来自"产生了更多正确答案候选"还是"后续处理更有效地利用了已有候选"。现有研究往往固定团队规模和模型，缺乏完整的预算轨迹分析，且常用的任务平均化报告会掩盖任务间的巨大差异。

Method: 提出精确的Generate-Transform分解（代数恒等式，无需拟合）：将任何工作流按"提案覆盖"O = P(至少一个提案正确) 和最终准确率Y分解，定义覆盖情境成功率s和生成式恢复率g，利用中点乘积恒等式将Y的变化精确拆分为：ℰ（广度覆盖红利）= ᾱΔO（由中点杠杆加权）和ℐ（强度变换变化）= Δg + ŌΔv。实验涵盖8种DAG架构（Star、Persona-Star、Proposer-Critic、Tournament、Tree、Chain、Cascading-Chain、Diamond）、5个7-9B指令微调模型、6个基准（ARC、GPQA、GSM8K、GSMHard、MMLU-hard子集、HumanEval+），调用预算N∈{2,3,5,7,10,15,20,30}，共约430万次团队试验和5000万次智能体响应；采用1000次项目聚类自助法做95%置信区间估计。

Result: （1）规模化回报高度依赖任务：从N=3到N=30，算术题（GSM8K/GSMHard）准确率最多提升17分，而ARC/GPQA/MMLU多选题任何架构至多提升约4分；任务平均化报告会掩盖这一鸿沟。（2）Proposer-Critic在算术题上扩展最陡峭，在N=30时以+5.7分领先亚军（CI [5.1, 6.4]），但在ARC/MMLU/代码上排名垫底；没有一种架构跨任务和跨模型全面获胜。（3）分解揭示：在所有任务上覆盖都在增加（ℰ为正），但只有在算术题上"下游变换"才能有效转化覆盖（ℐ为正或小幅负），而在多选题和代码上变换丢弃了大量新覆盖的正确答案；等调用预算下token成本仍有2.1倍差异，Proposer-Critic位于精度-成本前沿（59.1%精度，17.1k tokens）。

Conclusion: 团队规模化不是通用杠杆：回报集中在算术题上，Proposer-Critic在大规模下能转化新增覆盖但在其他任务上表现不佳。Generate-Transform分解将规模化收益分解为广度（覆盖）和强度（变换）两个精确分量，可诊断哪些任务受限于"找不到候选答案"、哪些受限于"找到了但处理不好"。无架构跨模型和任务胜出，规模化是任务和架构特定的赌注。

Abstract: Replacing one LLM agent with a collaborating team can raise accuracy, but whether scaling the team helps, and which architecture to scale, is unclear. Sweeping eight agent orchestration architectures across five instruction-tuned 7-9B models, five short-answer benchmarks, and an executable-code benchmark up to 30 calls, we find that the returns to team scaling are sharply task-dependent: from three to thirty calls accuracy rises by up to 17 points on the two arithmetic word-problem benchmarks (GSM8K, GSMHard) but by at most four on ARC, GPQA, and MMLU, for every architecture, a split the usual task-averaged number conceals. Proposer-Critic captures the arithmetic gains, scaling steepest and, in aggregate, surpassing every other architecture at the largest budget (item-clustered intervals exclude zero), though it ranks among the weakest elsewhere, and no architecture wins across tasks. We explain these trajectories with an exact generate-transform decomposition. Partitioning any workflow into proposal coverage and a downstream transform, any accuracy change splits exactly into an extensive coverage dividend and an intensive transformation change. The decomposition diagnoses each task: arithmetic offers coverage headroom that a critic-guided transform converts, whereas the multiple-choice benchmarks either saturate in coverage or fail to convert it, and on open-ended code generative recovery nearly vanishes so accuracy tracks coverage. At equal call budgets token cost still varies 2.1x. Extra calls therefore create candidate opportunity that only some architectures, on some tasks, convert. Team scaling is a task- and architecture-specific bet, not a uniform lever.

</details>


### [252] [The Layer Mystery of VLA: An Information-Theoretical Analysis of VLA Latent Interface](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36118)
*Yuxiang Liu,Lizhi Yang,Fengze Xie,Aaron Ames,Yisong Yue*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型中潜在接口的层级选择问题。通过大规模实验和理论分析，证明单层选择优于多层层融合，并提出InfoNCE作为高效的层级质量代理指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA策略将预训练视觉-语言主干连接到动作头，潜在接口应暴露哪些主干层级尚不明确。现有文献存在单层与层融合两种范式的分歧，且缺乏多训练种子的严格实验验证，导致层级选择成为VLA设计中的未解之谜。

Method: 1）在三种预训练主干（Cosmos-2B、Qwen-2B、ABot-Pretrain）和两个操作基准（LIBERO、CALVIN）上，系统比较单层选择与三种融合方法（APT、VLA-Adapter、BEHAVIOR-1st），每种配置使用3个训练种子。2）推导信息瓶颈目标下InfoNCE与动作预测的等价性定理。3）提出InfoNCE-argmax层级选择方案，比较InfoNCE、DiME、提示级/数据集级矩阵熵作为代理指标的效果。

Result: 54种融合配置中有47种表现不如最佳单层；融合优势在统计上非常有限。最优层在不同主干和基准间差异显著，从不在最深层。InfoNCE与Oracle质量的Spearman相关性最高（最高+0.94）。InfoNCE-argmax方案将选择遗憾从17.89个百分点（最深层选择）降至3.71个百分点，GPU计算量减少9-33倍，性能接近oracle优化的固定层启发式（3.28-3.50点）。

Conclusion: 层级选择是VLA设计中的关键决策，InfoNCE作为实用工具能够有效指导层级选择。未来工作应研究动作头容量、主干微调和真实部署对层级质量的影响，以及融合方法的非信息论优势。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies connect a pretrained vision-language backbone to an action head through a latent interface, but which backbone layers this interface should expose remains unclear. We study single-layer selection and multi-layer fusion for frozen backbones across three pretrained models and two manipulation benchmarks, LIBERO and CALVIN, with three policy-training seeds per configuration. Across three fusion mechanisms and three layer-subset strategies, 47 of 54 configurations underperform the best observed single-layer policy. Our stastical analysis further confirms that fusion's advantage is very limited. However, the best layer varies substantially across backbones and benchmarks, making layer selection consequential and exhaustive policy sweeps expensive. We further derive a reweighting equivalence between the proposed information-bottleneck objectives for action-conditioned InfoNCE and action prediction, motivating InfoNCE as a proxy for layer quality. Empirically, InfoNCE provides the most consistent positive association with policy success among four evaluated proxies. Selecting the layer with the highest InfoNCE score requires 9-33 times less GPU compute than exhaustive policy sweeps and reduces mean selection regret from 17.89 percentage points for deepest-layer selection to 3.71 points across six settings. Its mean regret is close to the 3.28-3.50 points achieved by fixed-layer heuristics optimized retrospectively using all six oracle sweeps, without requiring closed-loop evaluations during selection.

</details>


### [253] [AdaST: Adaptive Coupling for Spatial-Temporal Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36119)
*Zhenyu Lei,Chenghao Liu,Yushun Dong,Qi R. Wang,Jundong Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AdaST提出了一种自适应空间-时间耦合的预测方法，根据数据内在的耦合结构动态调整空间和时间建模，通过分解-重组范式将输入分解为时间、空间和时空耦合三个分量，使用异质性感知专家和相关性正则化机制实现自适应预测，在多个基准上达到最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有空间-时间预测方法隐含假设数据存在强且均匀的时空耦合，但真实数据存在显著不同的耦合模式（时序主导、空间主导、强耦合），不匹配的架构会导致虚假依赖和性能下降。需要一种能根据数据内在耦合结构动态调整建模方式的自适应框架。

Method: AdaST采用分解-重组框架：(1) 异质性感知分解器（4种专家：空间、时刻、星期、时空）将输入分解为时间特定、空间特定、时空耦合三个分量；(2) 角色对齐建模：时间分量用时间注意力，空间分量用空间混合器，时空分量用交错操作；(3) 相关性正则化重组器通过门控网络和余弦相似度相关性度量自适应组合三个分量。

Result: 在PEMS04/07/08、PurpleAir、METR-LA、ETTh1、ExchangeRate等7个基准上全面优于16个基线方法；在PurpleAir上MAE相对最优基线提升4.3%；消融实验证实各模块和专家均有贡献；t-SNE可视化显示三个分量被有效解耦；门控分数分析揭示了不同数据集存在不同的耦合结构。

Conclusion: AdaST通过分解-重组范式有效解决了空间-时间预测中耦合结构不匹配的根本挑战，能够自动适应多样化的耦合模式，提供可解释的预测结果，为时空预测提供了灵活透明的解决方案。局限性在于参数较多及当前仅评估短期预测。

Abstract: Spatial-temporal (ST) forecasting underpins many real-world systems such as traffic, climate, and energy networks. While existing methods implicitly assume strong spatiotemporal coupling, we observe that real-world ST data exhibits distinct coupling regimes, ranging from temporal-dominated and spatial-dominated to strongly coupled patterns. This mismatch causes current models to suffer from spurious dependencies and degraded performance when one correlation dominates. To overcome this limitation, we aim to dynamically modulate spatial and temporal modeling based on the data's inherent coupling structure. However, three key challenges exist: unknown coupling structure, heterogeneous coupling dynamics, and suboptimal spatial modeling. We propose AdaST, an adaptive ST forecasting framework that tackles these challenges through a decompose-recompose paradigm. AdaST factorizes inputs into components capturing different coupling patterns using heterogeneity-aware experts. Each component is processed by role-aligned modules, and a correlation-informed adaptive recomposer integrates them for final prediction. Extensive experiments confirm that AdaST significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, validating the necessity of an adaptive approach.

</details>


### [254] [Memory Is a Derivation: The Distributed-Evidence Paradox in Long-Term Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36130)
*Hongjun Liu,Chen Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"记忆即推导"视角，研究长期运行LLM智能体将交互历史压缩为持久记忆时的可靠性问题。核心提出DerivAudit审计框架，围绕证据范围、组合有效性和准入可靠性三个耦合要求，分析记忆写入时的两类失败模式：引用不完整导致有效记忆被误判，以及多个单独成立的事实被组合为历史不支持的更强断言。同时揭示"分布证据悖论"——有效记忆常需跨交互组合证据，但同样的设置反而使不支持的组合更难被拒绝。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期运行的LLM智能体依赖持久记忆跨会话/任务复用信息，但记忆可能不忠实反映交互历史所支持的内容。已有工作关注记忆检索与演化，但对写入时的推导完整性缺乏系统研究：作者是否引入了历史未建立的关系或事件状态？引用是否遗漏了分布在早期交互中的支持证据？写入时的验证器是否在拒绝错误记忆的同时保留了有效信息？

Method: 1. 框架：DerivAudit，对同一候选记忆写入在两套证据视图（仅引用、扩展预写入历史+BM25检索12个段落、上限16段）下分别审计。2. 语义义务分解：将记忆分解为事实主张、关系和限定条件，全部支持才算有效。3. 参考标签路由：标注者回答三个原语问题（D/E/R），按确定性规则路由出四类标签，分歧由盲审裁决。4. 验证视图对比：整体判断、原子声明、谓词-论元QA与组合感知视图（紧凑关系、组合图、义务级）。5. 控制实验：70个匹配族（局部/分布式×有效/无效），含支持删除、冗余删除、可适用反驳等干预。6. 准入可靠性：在391条带标签自然写入上重放三种写入时验证设置。7. 下游因果探针：固定记忆槽位（正确/失真/缺失），计算CACE_harm和CACE_reject。模型：Qwen3-30B-A3B、Gemma-4-31B、Llama-3.3-70B。

Result: 1. 证据范围：扩展历史恢复了约60%引用不充分的记忆支持（LoCoMo从53.5%升至79.5%，HaluMem从47.0%升至77.0%），但扩展后仍有17-21%不被支持。2. 组合有效性：原子验证仅检测16.5%的不支持关系，谓词-论元QA达39.2%但多跨度保留仅56.4%；无单一视图在检测与保留之间取得跨模型稳定平衡。3. 分布证据悖论：分布式证据下，整体/义务感知验证对无效Qwen案例的检测率仅8.6%和11.4%；将合理前提替换为长度匹配的不相关内容后，无效记忆接受率从65-88%降至0-10%，证明机制是"合理前提组合偏差"而非上下文长度或远距忽略。4. 准入可靠性：扩展历史使修复记忆保留率显著提升（Qwen +11.6点，p=0.007；Gemma从58.0%升至95.5%；Llama从85.7%升至98.2%），但不支持记忆的拒绝率跨模型不一致（Llama从83.3%升至88.5%，Gemma从66.7%降至59.0%）。5. 累积验证噪声：增加2或4个独立为真的义务检查使Qwen中位对数几率下降7.7，98.7%记录下降；Gemma准入率从93.3%暴跌至2.6%，Llama从97.4%降至35.5%。6. 下游影响：失真记忆使下游失败率上升83.8-93.0个百分点（CACE_harm），有效记忆缺失使失败率上升92.8-99.5个百分点（CACE_reject）。7. 重写漂移：第四轮时Gemma时间漂移69.7%、情态漂移78.1%，Qwen分别为91.1%和92.6%。

Conclusion: 可靠的记忆写入不能仅停留在检索相关证据，还需判断证据是否支持进入持久记忆的完整含义。语义推导完整性应作为写入时的正确性要求。框架贡献在于将引用不完整与不支持组合分离，并跨自然与受控设置系统刻画三种失败模式（不完整来源、分布证据悖论、验证诱导的有效记忆拒绝）。结论指出证据扩展对保留有效记忆一致有效，但对拒绝不支持记忆并不一致有效；更细粒度的检查本身可能拒绝有效记忆，揭示一种内在的两难权衡。

Abstract: Long-running LLM agents compress past interactions into persistent memories that may be reused as premises for later tasks. This creates a distinct derivation problem: whether the memory actually follows from what the interaction history supports. Relevant evidence may be scattered across earlier interactions, while compression can introduce relations or event status that the history never established. A valid memory may therefore appear unsupported because its citations omit relevant evidence, while individually supported facts may be composed into a stronger statement the history never established. We characterize this problem through three coupled requirements: (1) Evidence scope; (2) Compositional validity; (3) Admission reliability. We therefore ask whether the interaction history available at write time supports what enters persistent memory. We introduce DerivAudit, a framework for auditing whether a memory is actually supported by the history available when it was written. The audit separates three questions: whether supporting evidence lies beyond writer-provided citations, whether the composed memory introduces unsupported meaning, and how write-time admission decisions affect later memory use. Across two natural memory corpora, audits using broader pre-write history recover support for nearly 60% of memories that appear unsupported from citations alone, while 17-21% remain unsupported after expansion. Yet broader evidence does not by itself make admission reliable: unsupported memories are still frequently admitted across verification models, and evidence expansion alone worsens it on two backbones.

</details>


### [255] [More Features Are Not More Evidence: Limits of Training-Free Human Activity Recognition with Jev](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36154)
*Orhan Konak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究通用概率决策模型 Jev 在无需训练的人体活动识别（HAR）任务中的表现，通过对比 WISDM、UCI341、PAMAP2 三个数据集上的实验，发现 Jev 的识别性能远低于有监督模型，且增加数值特征反而会降低性能，揭示了传感器到模型的接口设计是模型评估的关键部分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 HAR 依赖大量标注数据训练专用分类器，而通用模型有望摆脱这一依赖，实现无需训练的传感器决策。但其能否有效解释确定性传感器信号描述仍不清楚。本文旨在评估固定通用决策模型在 HAR 任务中的实际能力。

Method: 使用 Jev（TypeSafe AI 的固定通用概率决策模型）在 WISDM、UCI341、PAMAP2 三个数据集的 1,800 个类别均衡加速度计窗口上进行测试，测试三种确定性传感器表征（R1：20 个统计特征；R2：32 个信号感知特征；R3：R2 + 确定性语义渲染），共产生 5,400 个决策，并与生成式基线（Claude）和三个有监督 HAR 模型（RF、SVM、1D-CNN）进行比较，辅以概率验证、校准分析和事后融合实验。

Result: Jev 在三个数据集上的最佳 macro-F1 仅为 0.038、0.118 和 0.089，远低于有监督模型的 0.686–0.907。增加数值特征（R2 相对 R1）会在所有数据集上降低性能，导致预测坍缩至单一类别。加入语义渲染（R3）部分恢复性能但存在显著差距。Jev 概率校准差（ECE 0.13–0.35），但查询速度快（亚秒级）且成本极低。事后融合在 WISDM 上有微弱提升（macro-F1 +0.007），但在 UCI341 和 PAMAP2 上未能复现。

Conclusion: 通用决策模型不能替代有监督 HAR 分类器。传感器信号中包含的信息与模型可利用的信息之间存在差异，传感器到模型的接口应被视为模型评估的一部分，而非中立的预处理步骤。快速廉价的推理不能免除对传感器表征和解释方式的验证需求。

Abstract: General-purpose models promise sensor-based decisions without training a task-specific classifier, which could reduce the dependence of Human Activity Recognition (HAR) on labeled data. Yet it remains unclear whether such models can directly interpret deterministic descriptions of physical sensor signals well enough to replace or complement trained HAR models. We study this question using Jev, a fixed general-purpose probabilistic decision model, on 1,800 class-balanced accelerometer windows from WISDM, UCI341, and PAMAP2. Jev receives no labeled examples, retrieval context, or HAR-specific parameter updates. We evaluate three deterministic sensor representations and compare 5,400 Jev decisions with a generative baseline and three supervised HAR models. Jev remains far below supervised recognition, with its strongest representation reaching macro-F1 of 0.038, 0.118, and 0.089 across the three datasets, compared with 0.686 to 0.907 for the supervised models. More numerical features do not improve Jev. Instead, they reduce recognition on all three datasets, while augmenting the same numerical evidence with a deterministic semantic rendering partially recovers performance, although the experiment does not isolate semantics from the accompanying serialization and redundancy changes. Jev is fast and inexpensive to query, but its probabilities are not reliably calibrated for recognition. A post-hoc fusion analysis finds a small improvement on WISDM that does not replicate on UCI341 or PAMAP2. These results show that training-free sensor decisions depend not only on the information available in the signal, but also on whether the model can use the representation through which that information is exposed. The sensor-to-model interface should therefore be treated as part of the model evaluation rather than as a neutral preprocessing step.

</details>


### [256] [Principled Thoughts for Latent Recursive LLM Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36159)
*Fahd Seddik,Fatemeh Fard*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出REST，一种针对潜在递归LLM系统中思想表示的训练目标。它将有效思想表示的四个理论属性（因果性、极小性、可分离性、稳定性）转化为可微损失项，添加到交叉熵损失上，无需架构变更或推理时新增参数，在7个基准测试中提升准确率最高达7.5个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在递归LLM系统（单agent和多agent）通常仅通过最终解码答案的交叉熵（CE）进行训练，这无法约束中间的思想表示。理论分析揭示了仅CE训练的四种失败模式：替换发散（thought与文本传递之间的分布差异降低正确答案概率）、信息损失（producer输出未被保留）、思想碰撞（不同问题的思想表示坍缩）、producer不确定性（未编码输出分布）。这些失败导致正确答案概率下降，因此需要超越答案级监督的表示级训练目标。

Method: REST将四个属性形式化为可微损失项：(1) 因果性——惩罚thought与文本传递之间的KL散度，确保信息保持；(2) 极小性——基于信息瓶颈原理，惩罚保留无关输入信息，通过CE(Y|T)−λ₂CE(X|Y,T)实现；(3) 可分离性——通过对比式损失使不同语义输入的pooled thought保持距离；(4) 稳定性——通过预测均值熵的probe编码producer的不确定性。这些损失以β加权添加到CE上。方法在frozen基础LLM上训练外部链接R_ψ，应用于单agent（self-loop）和多agent（planner-refiner-solver链，递归多轮）设置，覆盖7个数学、科学、医学、代码基准，使用Light（1-2B）和Scaled（3-4B）两套模型。

Result: REST在7个基准测试（MATH500、AIME2025/2026、GPQA-Diamond、MedQA、LiveCodeBench-v6、MBPP+）上均优于CE基线。多agent设置平均+3.5点，最佳配置+7.5点；单agent设置平均+3.3点，最佳+6.5点。收敛到最终答案的率从73%提升到95%。REST思想表示更好地编码producer的输出（而非输入），坍缩现象消失，思想间相似度降低。因果性和极小性在所有β值下都改善精度；而可分离性和稳定性对权重更敏感。在Scaled系统上增加递归轮数可进一步提升增益。

Conclusion: REST确立了以原则化方式监督潜在思想的方法，超越了最终答案的交叉熵监督。理论分析证明所监督的属性可下界正确答案的概率。实验证实CE-only思想在语义不同的问题间坍缩并保留无关信息，而REST思想展开并保留相关信息。表明最终答案准确率为潜在系统提供了不完整的视图，应辅以思想表示的检查。该方法使得agent间潜在通信更容易审计。

Abstract: Large language models can reason in continuous space instead of decoded text, by recurring on their own hidden states or by passing those states between agents, while training supervises only the Cross-Entropy (CE) of the final decoded answer and does not constrain the thought. Theoretical and empirical analyses establish and confirm four failures of CE-only training that lead to a lower probability of the correct answer such as collapsing thoughts across distinct questions and retaining irrelevant information. We introduce REST (REpresentation-Supervised Thoughts), a training objective that turns four properties of a valid thought representation (causality, minimality, separability, and stability) into differentiable losses added to CE. We instantiate it in latent single-agent and multi-agent systems, without architectural changes or added parameters at inference. Across 7 benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, medicine, and code generation, with the same training data, compute, and latent budget, REST increases accuracy over CE-only training across agent settings and model sizes by up to 7.5 percentage points and convergence on a final answer by 30\%. Furthermore, REST thoughts encode more of what is required to achieve the correct answer, and decoding them better recovers the intended output of the agent, which makes latent communication easier to interpret. Project Website: this https URL

</details>


### [257] [FigAct: Turning Scientific Figures into Active Canvases for Explanation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36190)
*Shishi Xiao,Zichao Wang,Alexa Siu,David H. Laidlaw,Jennifer Healey*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FigAct提出了一种将静态科学图表转化为问题驱动的交互式视觉演示框架，通过Plan-Ground-Act三阶段流程直接在图表SVG元素上施加视觉动作来引导读者注意力，并训练了FigAct-8B模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在解释科学图表时通常以长文本形式输出，读者需要手动将文本描述映射回图表中的视觉元素，这一过程认知负担较重。论文受人类口头讲解时配合手势指引的启发，希望让图表本身成为解释的"活动画布"，使模型生成结合旁白、定位的视觉证据和视觉动作的演示序列。

Method: 提出Plan-Ground-Act三阶段框架：(1) Plan将解释分解为有序的"视觉节拍"序列；(2) Ground通过将SVG重组为基于几何的森林结构，进行多轮由粗到细的层级化搜索（Keep/Expand/Delete操作），定位每个节拍的SVG元素，将token消耗降低40-50倍；(3) Act从离散动作空间（camera、tint、deemphasize、reemphasize、arrow、infer_relation、annotation、abstraction）中选择动作并由确定性渲染器执行。训练方面，先用VFIG合成数据（SFT，32,319样本）初始化FigAct-8B，再采用三任务特定奖励（grounding正确性、搜索效率、渲染质量）的阶段感知GRPO进行强化学习，并独立归一化各奖励通道以分别路由到Ground和Act阶段。

Result: 在400个真实科学图表基准上，作为即插即用框架，FigAct使各MLLM的grounding完成率、元素F1和端到端演示质量均获得一致提升，同时SVG token使用量减少40-50倍。FigAct-8B（SFT+RL）达到100% grounding完成率、62.27 Elem. F1、97.10%执行成功率、72.25 NVA。消融实验表明三个奖励均贡献互补信号，阶段感知GRPO优于标准GRPO。18名研究生的用户研究显示，纯文本解释的理解准确率为66.7%，加入高亮后提升至75.6%，完整FigAct演示达到83.3%。

Conclusion: FigAct证明了科学图表不仅可以作为多模态理解的输入，还可以成为模型生成解释的主动演示画布；通过将解释直接链接到视觉证据和呈现动作，使科学图表更易于理解，同时显著提高了grounding效率。

Abstract: Scientific figures are designed to communicate information visually, yet MLLMs typically explain them by translating their visual content back into text. This requires readers to manually map the resulting explanations back to the figure. Inspired by how people present visual information, we introduce FigAct, a framework that transforms static scientific figures into question-conditioned visual presentations by acting directly on their existing graphical elements. Like a human presenter, FigAct generates a sequence of short narrations, grounds each narration in the corresponding visual evidence, and applies visual actions to guide the viewer's attention. We develop a hierarchical search strategy for efficient element localization, reducing token usage by approximately 40$\times$. We further train FigAct-8B using three task-specific rewards for grounding accuracy, search efficiency, and rendering quality. We further build a human-verified benchmark from figures in real-world scientific papers to evaluate the ability of MLLMs to generate grounded visual explanations. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of FigAct and show that treating scientific figures as presentation canvases makes explanations clearer and easier to follow.

</details>


### [258] [An Empirical Study and Assessment of EU AI Act Compliance Checkers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36228)
*Zhen Tao,Alize Kahraman,Shidong Pan,Zhenchang Xing,Chiara Ullstein,Jens Grossklags,Chunyang Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对欧盟《人工智能法案》(EU AI Act) 实施后涌现的12个自动化合规检查工具(AIACCs)开展首次系统性实证研究，从交互模式、报告质量、法律条款覆盖三个维度进行评估。研究发现现有AIACCs质量参差不齐，仅适合作为早期导向工具，存在交互不一致、法律建模过度简化、报告缺乏确定性和可操作性、以及对生命周期治理条款覆盖不足等系统性问题，并据此给出未来设计原则与多方建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 欧盟《AI法案》带来大量合规义务，中小企业与个人开发者因缺乏法律专业知识难以将其转化为工程与治理实践。市场上涌现的自动化合规检查工具(AIACCs)声称可简化合规评估，但其可靠性未经系统检验，使用低质量工具可能形成"虚假合规感"，遗漏安全保障并向下游工程实践传播错误。研究旨在填补这一空白，提供AIACC生态的实证基线。

Method: 采用混合实证方法：(1) 通过Google、GitHub、GPTs Store、LinkedIn等平台搜索并按可达性、运营范围、流行度、监管时效性筛选出12个AIACCs；(2) 构造覆盖六大风险分支(禁止/高风险/透明度/GPAI/最小风险/范围外)的6个代表性场景作为测试输入；(3) 收集48份问卷型AIACC生成的合规报告；(4) 两位标注员沿多维度手工标注交互机制、输入输出特征与法律条款覆盖；(5) 采用基于213个hedge cues的Hedge Sentence Rate衡量报告确定性，采用Keyword Loss of Specificity衡量报告可操作性；(6) 评估18个AI法案条款的覆盖情况。

Result: 主要发现包括：(1) AIACCs分为动态分支问卷、固定问卷、对话助手、技术分析工具四种模式，各有侧重但在法律保真度、用户友好性、透明度和证据严谨性之间存在权衡；(2) 8个问卷型AIACCs生成的48份报告长度差异极大(46–1023词)，多包含风险评估和义务列表，但角色确定(仅4个checker)、对象确定(仅2个)和法律依据覆盖不均；(3) 平均Hedge Sentence Rate为0.650(高于生物医学语料基线)，说明报告过多使用不确定、条件性语言；(4) Keyword Loss of Specificity均值为0.840，指令性关键词大多出现在义务陈述而非可执行步骤中；(5) 条款覆盖严重不均：Article 5(禁止)和Article 6(高风险分类)各被10个checker覆盖，但Article 9–15(风险管理、数据治理、技术文档、记录保存、透明度、人工监督、准确性/鲁棒性/网络安全)仅4–5个checker覆盖，Article 27(基础自由度影响评估)、Article 4(AI素养)各仅3个覆盖；(6) 观察到风险误分类(将实时生物识别一概判为禁止)与角色分配模糊等问题；(7) LLM驱动的对话助手存在跨基础模型结果不一致(GPT-4o vs GPT-5得出相反结论)和迎合用户倾向等可靠性问题。

Conclusion: 当前AIACCs仅能作为早期合规导向工具，不能作为合规证据。其系统性问题——缺乏输入验证、法律建模过度简化、可重现性差、责任不透明、可读性差——可能向AI生态下游传播"虚假合规感"。作者提出三项设计原则：验证用户输入、使输出可执行、支持可重现性与可审计性；并向工具提供者、组织用户、监管机构/标准机构和研究者分别给出针对性建议。研究呼吁将自动化合规工具作为研究对象予以更多关注，并建立实证基准和评估方法以随AI法案演进进行纵向跟踪。

Abstract: The EU AI Act introduces extensive compliance requirements for organizations that develop, deploy, or integrate AI systems. Many of these requirements are directly relevant to security and privacy, while also addressing closely related issues such as data governance, transparency, accuracy, and robustness. However, stakeholders such as small-to-medium businesses and individual developers often lack the legal expertise required to interpret these obligations and translate them into engineering and governance practices. This disconnect creates challenges for implementing the EU AI Act and may lead to missing safeguards or misdirected development and deployment efforts. To address this, various automated EU AI Act compliance checkers (AIACCs) have emerged, claiming to streamline compliance assessments and provide practical guidance. In this paper, we present the first empirical study and assessment of AIACCs. We characterize 12 mainstream AIACCs across multiple dimensions, evaluate their legal coverage and alignment, and analyze checker-generated compliance reports for structure, determinacy, and actionability. We find that the quality of AIACCs varies significantly and that they currently can only serve as early-stage orientation tools. Specifically, we observe inconsistent interaction modes and user-friendliness, a tendency to overly simplify or omit key obligations, and a failure to provide determinate, actionable guidance. As a result, reliance on the current generation of AIACCs may foster a false sense of compliance. With our study, we provide a critical baseline of the current AIACC landscape. We further offer design principles for the implementation of more reliable compliance-support tools.

</details>


### [259] [MERID: Multimodal Exploration via Recursive Self-Improvement Agents for Major Depression Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36235)
*Lei Liu,Zhaokang Liang,Qingcheng Zeng,Chenda Duan,Lu Mi,Zhen Tan,Tianyu Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MERID框架，通过递归自我改进（RSI）机制自动构建多模态抑郁检测流水线，包含Grounded State Construction、Coupled Pipeline Exploration和Evidence-Guided Evolution三个核心模块，在多个抑郁基准数据集上取得了领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态抑郁检测面临异构模态需要定制化预测流水线的挑战，现有手工设计多模态架构和智能体辅助流水线开发方法难以在实验反馈基础上自主修改流水线并将验证后的改进传递到后续设计中。

Method: MERID框架采用基于经验的递归自我改进（RSI）循环，包含三个模块：(1) Grounded State Construction (GSC) 通过checked数据适配器保持主体-目标-记录对应关系的一致性；(2) Coupled Pipeline Exploration (CPE) 将表征、融合和预测器选择作为联合改进目标，在共享协议下评估组合；(3) Evidence-Guided Evolution (EGE) 使用基于主体级评分自助法不确定性的接受边际来指导修改并验证流水线替换。理论分析证明了保留分数的单调性和存储分数差距的上界。

Result: 在E-DAIC、MPDD-2025/2026、Mental Health和Kaggle基准测试中，MERID在多项分类和症状严重度任务上达到了最佳性能。E-DAIC二分类Macro-F1平均0.6768（Claude Opus 4.8）和0.7057（GPT-6 Astra），PHQ-8 CCC达0.3268，显著优于最佳基线Flex-MoE（0.5993）和MDAgents（0.0520）。MPDD-2026 Young队列PHQ-9 CCC达0.6050，远超MulT基线的0.0760。进一步研究证实了声学和语言线索对抑郁检测的价值。

Conclusion: MERID通过递归自我改进协调流水线探索、反馈引导修订和验证继承，推动流水线设计向符合精神病学临床理解的抑郁评估方向自主演化，实验证明其在多模态抑郁检测任务中取得了领先性能。

Abstract: Major depressive disorder (MDD) severely impacts daily activities and quality of life. Detecting MDD involves multimodal data, such as interview recordings and sensor measurements. This is particularly challenging, as these heterogeneous modalities often demand distinct, customized prediction pipelines. Existing efforts to address this challenge have explored both manually engineered multimodal architectures and agent-assisted pipeline development. Despite their progress, it remains challenging to autonomously revise pipelines based on experimental feedback and carry verified improvements forward into subsequent designs. To this end, we propose Multimodal Exploration via Recursive Self-Improvement Agents for Major Depression Analysis (MERID). The framework develops depression pipelines through experience-based recursive self-improvement (RSI). Grounded State Construction (GSC) grounds experience by aligning multimodal records with subject-level depression targets. Coupled Pipeline Exploration (CPE) jointly modifies representations, fusion, and predictors to build successor pipelines for classification and severity estimation. Evidence-Guided Evolution (EGE) guides revisions through feedback and verifies gains under uncertainty in small depression cohorts before inheritance. Extensive experiments on depression benchmarks show that MERID achieves the best results on multiple tasks compared with multimodal and agent-based baselines. Further analysis highlights the value of acoustic and linguistic cues for depression detection. Our code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [260] [ChronoSRL: Temporal Geometry for Self-Supervised Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36238)
*Nico Bohlinger,Jan Peters*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ChronoSRL 提出在自监督目标条件强化学习中，将评论家(critic)的表征空间赋予明确的时间几何结构——状态-动作与目标嵌入之间的距离直接以"目标达成时间"为单位进行训练，并结合生存强化学习预测完整的达成时间分布和停留时间，从而在7个标准基准和四足机器人 sim-to-real 任务上，以更小网络实现更快、更高性能的学习，是唯一能完成速度跟踪、目标位置保持和爬箱任务的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的对比强化学习(CRL)和生存强化学习(SRL)的评论家在表征空间中衡量的是抽象距离而非时间，而空间上近的目标在时间上可能很远(受障碍、地形和智能体能力影响)。仅靠"是否到达"的二元信号或物理距离会导致表征无法反映真实的可达性时间，因此需要将时间距离显式嵌入表征空间，使智能体能预测到达各目标所需时间并据此做出更可靠的动作决策。

Method: 1) 时间距离学习：训练评论家嵌入 ϕ(s,a) 与 ψ(g) 的欧氏距离 d_θ(s,a,g) 去匹配目标达成时间 τ，以 κτ (κ=-log γ) 为目标，使表征距离与折扣时间尺度一致；对于未达成的目标和来自其他轨迹的目标，用 hinge 损失将其距离推到至少一个折扣视界 κW 之外。
2) 生存强化学习拓展：从嵌入预测完整的达成时间分布 h_θ(t|s,a,g) 和生存函数 S_θ(t|s,a,g)，由此构造 Q_hazard 作为策略目标；同时预测智能体在目标附近的停留时间 O_θ(t|s,a,g)，得到 Q_occ 鼓励停留。
3) 软演员-评论家式目标：J(π) = Q_hazard + β·Q_occ − α·log π，鼓励更快、更可靠地到达并停留在目标附近。
4) 实现细节：使用 Huber 损失训练时间距离，分桶生存预测加速训练，自适应 β 平衡两个 Q 项。
5) 支持机器人常用塑形项：在时间目标中加额外代价 c_t，使 τ̃ = τ + λ·Σc_t。

Result: 在7个标准运动和导航基准以及四足机器人 sim-to-real 的速度跟踪、目标位置保持和爬箱任务上，ChronoSRL 学习速度更快、最终性能更高，且网络规模比对比CRL、动作分块对比 ACCRL 和 SRL 基线小一个数量级；它是唯一能够稳定保持在指令速度/目标位置、并爬上最高箱子的自监督 RL 方法；消融实验表明去除停留预测、时间距离或分离损失都会显著降低性能；理论分析证明 Q_hazard 满足 Jensen 不等式，能反映达成时间的均值与可靠性的联合优化。

Conclusion: 将时间几何显式引入评论家表征空间，使自监督目标条件 RL 同时具备时间距离感知和生存分析能力，是一种高效、通用的目标条件 RL 范式，特别适合需要可靠性、停留行为和机器人塑形代价的真实任务，可作为未来自监督 RL 和机器人学习的基础方法。

Abstract: A goal that is close in space can be far away in time. Obstacles, terrain, and the agent's own capabilities determine how long it takes to get there. Yet, critics in contrastive and survival reinforcement learning do not measure the distances in their representation space in units of time. We therefore introduce ChronoSRL, which gives the critic's embeddings an explicit temporal geometry. The distance between state-action and goal embeddings is trained to match the time that the agent takes to reach the goal (goal-reaching time), while goals that were not reached, and goals from other trajectories, are pushed at least one discount horizon away. Furthermore, reaching a goal quickly once does not mean that reaching it is reliable in general, so the policy should not follow the temporal distance directly. Instead, we build on survival reinforcement learning and predict from our temporal embeddings not only the full distribution of goal-reaching times but also the time spent near the goal. Thereby, the policy is trained to favor actions that reach the goal sooner and more reliably and that keep the agent near it. ChronoSRL learns faster and reaches higher performance than contrastive, action-chunked contrastive, and survival reinforcement learning baselines on seven standard locomotion and navigation benchmarks, even with much smaller networks. To test the limits of self-supervised reinforcement learning, we introduce velocity tracking, goal-position reaching, and box climbing tasks with a quadruped robot in a realistic sim-to-real locomotion setup, and show how the shaping terms that are typical for robotics can be naturally incorporated into our framework. ChronoSRL is the only one of the tested self-supervised reinforcement learning methods that learns to stay at the commanded velocities and goal positions, and climbs the highest boxes.

</details>


### [261] [CoRe: Co-Evolving Reward Models for Mitigating Latent Reward Hacking in Video Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36245)
*Zhaolong Su,Yujin Han,Feng Wang,Jameson Dong,Hins Hu,Difan Zou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CoRe框架，通过协同演化奖励模型与生成器，缓解视频扩散模型在潜在空间对齐中出现的"潜在奖励黑客"问题，在Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B上提升VBench分数至84.92。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散模型使用潜在奖励模型(LRM)进行高效对齐，但固定LRM会导致"潜在奖励黑客"：生成器在数百步内逃离奖励模型的训练分布，导致奖励分数虚高但视频质量崩塌。

Method: CoRe框架将奖励模型与生成器作为动态协同演化系统：(1)非对称更新——每次生成器更新前对奖励头进行5-10步重新拟合；(2)三方Bradley-Terry目标——引入"负样本真值视频"防止奖励模型退化为简单的真假判别器；(3)相对间隔+核锚定生成器损失——通过hinge损失和特征空间核函数引导生成器逼近优质真值视频特征。

Result: 在Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B上，CoRe将VBench总分从83.96提升至84.92（所有对比方法最高），语义分数从80.10提升至82.20；VBench-2.0总分从56.3提升至58.03，可控性从33.8大幅提升至38.29。消融实验显示动态程度达86.72，远优于固定奖励（67.06）和无锚定在线奖励（崩溃至16-19）。训练成本约8 GPU小时（4×H100）。

Conclusion: 潜在奖励黑客的根源在于生成器逃离奖励模型的分布支持；通过让奖励模型随生成器协同演化，可同时获得稳定的训练过程和显著的质量提升。框架轻量高效，为大规模视频扩散模型的对齐提供了新范式。

Abstract: Latent reward models (LRMs) enable efficient alignment of video diffusion models by scoring intermediate states directly in latent space. However, we find that optimizing against a fixed latent reward rapidly leads to latent reward hacking: the predicted reward stays high while perceptual and motion quality deteriorate. Our analysis identifies distributional escape as the central cause: within a few hundred updates, the generator moves beyond the reward model's training support, where its scores no longer reflect video quality. Based on this insight, we introduce CoRe, a co-evolving reward framework that treats latent-space alignment as a dynamic interaction between the generator and the reward model. Rather than optimizing against a stationary proxy, CoRe continually refits the reward model on the generator's current samples while anchoring it to real-video preferences, so the generator cannot gain reward by drifting away from the data. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, experiments show that CoRe consistently improves generation quality over both the pretrained model and prior alignment methods, while avoiding the quality collapse of fixed-reward optimization.

</details>


### [262] [Towards Mitigating Deceptive Safety Alignment in Large Reasoning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36254)
*Xiangyu Zhou,Saleh Zare Zade,Rafi Ibn Sultan,Alexander Kotov,Dongxiao Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对大型推理模型(LRMs)中存在的"欺骗性安全对齐"问题，提出了一种新的评估指标DSAR和一种基于强化学习的对齐方法SARA。核心发现是LRMs在标准RL训练中仅基于最终答案给予奖励，导致推理过程和最终答案传达不一致的安全信号。研究通过隐藏表示分析证实了模型在最终答案阶段表现出比推理阶段更强的安全判别能力。SARA通过对推理过程和最终答案同时施加安全感知奖励来缓解这一问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型(LRMs)如OpenAI o1和DeepSeek-R1通过强化学习训练以增强链式思维(CoT)推理能力，但传统RL奖励仅基于最终答案，对中间推理缺乏直接监督，由此产生"欺骗性安全对齐"现象：模型在推理过程中表现出不安全或不一致的安全信号，但最终答案表面上是安全的。这种不一致性可能掩盖模型的真实行为，特别是在对抗性预填充攻击下被进一步放大。现有评估方法缺乏直接衡量推理-答案安全一致性的指标，限制了对此现象的深入理解和针对性解决方案的开发。

Method: 方法包含两部分：(1) 评估指标DSAR（欺骗性安全对齐率）：通过独立评估推理轨迹和最终答案的安全信号，测量两者的一致性，使用LLM法官在句子级别判断推理中的安全感知，并结合LLM Guard判断整体安全性；(2) 对齐方法SARA（安全感知推理对齐）：基于DAPO框架的强化学习方法，将奖励设计为 R_i^harm = (1/2)R_i^cot·R_i^SA + (1/2)R_i^ans，其中R_i^SA鼓励早期识别有害意图（通过1 - k*/N奖励最早安全感知句位置），对良性提示使用不同的拒绝奖励以减少过度拒绝，并可选加入反对齐预填充增强对抗鲁棒性。

Result: 在DS-Qwen3-8B和DS-Qwen2-14B上，SARA在对抗性预填充攻击下的1-DSAR达到85.30和84.66，显著优于所有基线（包括RECAP的70.93和80.51）。SARA在SAR（推理安全感知率）上也达到最高（75.10和77.00），证明一致性的提升源于真正更安全的推理而非仅优化最终答案。在标准提示下，SARA在OR-Bench-hard上的HS达到91.21（DS-Qwen3-8B），而STAR-1仅为49.89。整体平均分（安全、帮助性、效用的调和均值）SARA在两个模型上分别达到82.76和81.97，为所有方法中最佳，同时保持了GSM8K和MMLU-Pro上的竞争力。消融实验证实各奖励组件（R^cot、R^SA、R^ans）均对性能有贡献。

Conclusion: 本文系统研究了大型推理模型中的欺骗性安全对齐现象，提出了DSAR作为量化推理-答案安全不一致性的直接指标，并通过层间余弦相似性和PCA可视化提供了机制层面的证据，表明安全判别能力主要集中于最终答案阶段而非推理阶段。提出的SARA方法通过对中间推理施加安全感知奖励，在保持帮助性和实用性的同时显著缓解了欺骗性安全对齐问题。实验结果支持"显式监督中间推理是可靠安全对齐的必要条件"这一结论，为LRMs的安全对齐研究提供了新的方向。局限性在于RL训练的实验仅在两个DeepSeek模型上进行，未涵盖更大模型、闭源模型以及长程策略欺骗和工具使用等其他欺骗形式。

Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) are commonly trained with reinforcement learning (RL) to improve their generation of chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning before producing final answers. However, RL rewards are typically assigned based on final answers, providing little or no direct supervision over intermediate reasoning. This can lead to deceptive safety alignment, where the reasoning trace and final answer convey inconsistent safety signals. To systematically investigate this phenomenon, we introduce DSAR (Deceptive Safety Alignment Rate), a metric that jointly assesses reasoning traces and final answers to quantify their safety inconsistency. Across multiple LRMs and benchmarks, we find that deceptive safety alignment is pervasive under standard prompting conditions and is substantially amplified under prefilling attacks. We further provide a hidden representation analysis showing that models exhibit stronger safety discrimination at the final-answer stage than during intermediate reasoning. To close this gap, we propose SARA (Safety-Aware Reasoning Alignment), an RL-based method that rewards both safety-aware reasoning and safe final answers, encouraging early harmful intent recognition and enforcing reasoning-answer consistency. Experiments show that SARA significantly mitigates deceptive safety alignment under both standard and adversarial settings while preserving helpfulness and utility. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [263] [OTROPE: Optimal Transport-based Robust Off-policy Evaluation for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36264)
*Liner Xiang,Wenbo Zhang,Hengrui Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出OTROPE，一种基于最优传输的鲁棒免策略评估方法，用于在行为策略与目标策略存在分布偏移、标签稀缺且响应似然不可用的黑盒LLM设置下进行可靠评估。该方法在语义嵌入空间中通过最优传输对齐已标注的行为策略样本与未标注的目标策略样本，结合修正后的人类标记残差与代理预测器，实现双稳健型估计，无需行为策略建模或密度比估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM离线评估面临三大挑战：（1）人工标注稀缺，代理评估器（如LLM-as-a-judge）不可靠；（2）行为策略（旧模型）与目标策略（新模型）存在分布偏移；（3）黑盒API下响应似然不可用，导致序列级密度比退化、重要性加权方法方差膨胀。PPI假设分布一致无法处理偏移，DR/IS在弱重叠区域失效。

Method: OTROPE将行为-目标分布对齐从token级序列空间转移至语义嵌入空间，通过求解熵正则化最优传输问题获得权重w*，使加权后的已标注经验分布与目标经验分布在Wasserstein距离下对齐。估计器为：V̂_OTROPE = (1/N)Σ ĝ(z̃_j) + Σ w*_i (g*(z_i) - ĝ(z_i))，即DM代理预测项加OT重加权残差修正项。代理预测器支持MoE（混合专家）和多数投票两种聚合策略。

Result: 在合成实验（不同τ水平分布偏移）和真实LLM评估任务（RewardBench 2、Chatbot Arena，涵盖GPT-4、GPT-3.5-Turbo、Claude 3.5 Sonnet等目标策略）上，OTROPE在MAE指标上均优于IS、DR、PPI、PPI++基线。在Chatbot Arena上，OTROPE的MAE低至0.010-0.049，且由<15B参数的弱LLM组成的集成可超越671B参数的DeepSeek-V3.1。理论分析证明了一致性（定理4.2）、收敛速率O_p(N^{-1/2} + n^{-1/d_0} + N^{-1/d})（定理4.3）以及双稳健性（定理4.4）：只要OT权重或代理预测器之一收敛即可保证估计一致性。消融实验证实修正项和代理预测器均不可或缺；对PCA维度、传输代价（ℓ_1/ℓ_2）、熵正则化λ和嵌入模型（bge-m3/TF-IDF）均具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: OTROPE为黑盒LLM的离线策略评估提供了一个理论上严谨且实践有效的框架，通过语义空间中的最优传输重加权解决了标签稀缺、分布偏移和似然不可用三大挑战，理论上具备一致性和双稳健性保证。局限性在于OT权重计算对高维嵌入计算成本较高（需PCA降维），且当前仅适用于静态输入-输出评估，未来可扩展至多轮交互（bandit/MDP）场景。

Abstract: Reliable evaluation of large language models (LLMs) is essential for their development and deployment, yet is often costly, risky, and difficult to perform safely online. We study off-policy evaluation for LLMs, where limited human-labeled data from a behavior model are used to evaluate a newer target LLM. This setting is challenging because labels are scarce, behavior--target distribution shift is common, and response likelihoods are often unavailable for black-box LLMs. We propose the Optimal Transport-based Robust Off-Policy Evaluation (OTROPE), a likelihood-free evaluation that performs distributional correction in a semantic space via optimal transport to align labeled behavior-policy samples with unlabeled target-policy samples. OTROPE combines corrected human-labeled residuals with proxy predictors, yielding a doubly robust-style evaluation without behavior-policy modeling or density-ratio estimation. We theoretically characterize why baseline evaluators fail under LLM distribution shift, and establish consistency and convergence rates for OTROPE when either the reweighted behavior distribution or the proxy predictor converges. Experiments on synthetic and real LLM evaluation tasks show that OTROPE consistently outperforms baselines while enabling ensembles of weaker LLM evaluators to approach and sometimes surpass stronger evaluators. Code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [264] [From Surfaces to Volumes: Registered Geometry for Protein Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36277)
*Siyuan Chen,Cai Zhou,Jinrui Zhang,Zhaokang Liang,Taku Komura,Wojciech Matusik,Stephen Bates,Tommi Jaakkola,Wengong Jin,Peter Yichen Chen,Minghao Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Protein-TetSphere，一种基于注册式残基级体素表示的蛋白质几何建模方法，将每个残基的四面体区域拟合到共享拓扑参考并在共同Laplacian基中编码，在配体结合口袋分类、蛋白质-蛋白质界面预测和从头蛋白质结合剂设计三个任务上均优于仅依赖表面特征的基线（如AtomSurf）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有蛋白质几何模型主要依赖分子表面特征（采样点、法向量、曲率），无法显式建模表面之下的体素组织，也无法为残基级体素结构提供一致的坐标系。两个残基可能具有相似的暴露表面几何形状，却占据截然不同的三维体素上下文，因此表面表示存在信息缺失。

Method: 1）对蛋白质链进行四面体化（fTetWild）并按最近原子距离为每个体素顶点分配残基标签，再经半径1.0Å的球查询扩展得到残基对应的四面体子区域；2）将每个残基子区域的两阶段拟合（先局部MSMS表面点对点ICP，再链级fTetWild面片点对三角形ICP，参考532顶点/1727四面体模板，缩放s=0.6）到固定拓扑四面体球模板，保持连接性\mathcal{K}不变；3）在共同图Laplacian L=D-A的前64个非平凡特征向量U₆₄构成的基上，将残基局部坐标系（Rᵣ由N-Cα-C右手法则构造）下的位移场ΔVᵣ投影为Cᵣ=U₆₄ᵀΔVᵣRᵣ∈ℝ^{64×3}；4）每个谱模式作为token经轻量Transformer聚合为256维残基TetSphere嵌入，与表面分支（16点+4描述符，3层不变消息传递）和化学分支（疏水性/电荷）融合；5）通过Pairformer式single-pair主干与核苷酸/配体token联合上下文化，以多模态掩码重建（TetSphere在残基15%掩码内再掩15%模式）预训练；6）下游适配：口袋分类拼接AtomSurf特征，PPI通过零初始化残差适配器修改logit，结合剂设计通过REPA对齐将BoltzGen单/对表示与冻结教师对齐。

Result: 配体结合口袋分类：MaSIF-ligand上平衡准确率从AtomSurf的0.795±0.005提升至0.826±0.004（+0.031），无TetSphere对照为0.807±0.003。蛋白质-蛋白质界面预测：PINDER聚类分割holo设置下，Pinder-Pair/Site AUROC从0.914/0.852提升至0.932/0.866（+0.018/+0.014），无TetSphere对照为0.919/0.855。从头结合剂设计：BoltzGen Challenge Set最终通过率从14.95%提升至19.90%（+4.95pp），ProtDBench骨架级通过率从27.62%提升至32.19%（+4.57pp），binder-only RMSD中位数从1.492Å降至1.334Å；改进在10个靶标中分布广泛（ProtDBench 7/10，Challenge Set 4/10最优），且TM 0.8下的多样性调整聚类通过率最高。

Conclusion: Protein-TetSphere通过将异构残基体素注册到共享四面体参考并在共同Laplacian基中编码，为蛋白质表示学习提供了一致的残基级体素坐标系，补充了分子表面无法表达的内部组织信息（堆积、埋藏、局部厚度）。该表示在识别、相互作用预测和生成设计三类任务上均带来一致提升，证明了显式组织蛋白质体素的价值。局限性在于目前仅处理静态结构，未来可扩展至分子动力学轨迹以及多尺度生物分子组装。

Abstract: Existing protein geometry models typically represent molecular surfaces using local geometric features such as sampled points, normals, and curvature. While effective for capturing exposed molecular shape, these representations do not explicitly model the volumetric organization beneath the surface or provide a consistent coordinate system for residue-wise volumetric structure. We introduce Protein-TetSphere, a registered residue-wise volumetric representation for proteins. Each protein chain is tetrahedralized to obtain local volumetric regions associated with individual residues, which are then registered to a shared fixed-topology tetrahedral reference and represented in a common Laplacian basis. This registration establishes consistent volumetric coordinates across residues, enabling local three-dimensional deformation to be integrated with surface and chemical information in a multimodal protein representation. We evaluate Protein-TetSphere on ligand-binding pocket classification, protein--protein interface prediction, and de novo protein binder design. Across the three tasks, Protein-TetSphere improves ligand-binding pocket balanced accuracy from $0.795$ to $0.826$, Pinder-Pair/Site AUROC from $0.914/0.852$ to $0.932/0.866$, and binder-design success from $14.95\%$ to $19.90\%$ on the BoltzGen Challenge Set and from $27.62\%$ to $32.19\%$ at the ProtDBench backbone level. These results show that registered volumetric geometry provides complementary spatial information beyond molecular surfaces across protein recognition, interaction, and design.

</details>


### [265] [Illusory Truth or Mere Exposure? Model-Dependent Repetition Effects in LLM-Based Social Media Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36278)
*Azza Bouleimen,Nicolò Pagan,Anikó Hannák*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了四种大语言模型（LLM）在社交媒体模拟场景中是否复现人类的"虚幻真相效应"（Illusory Truth Effect, ITE），即重复暴露增加陈述感知真实性的认知偏差。研究采用两阶段上下文实验设计，在336,000条评分数据上发现四种模型呈现显著不同的行为模式，表明ITE在LLM中的复现具有模型依赖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式智能体模型（GABM）越来越多用于社交媒体和错误信息传播研究，但其作为人类行为代理的有效性需要验证。一个关键问题是这些LLM智能体是否复现了已建立的人类认知偏差，尤其是与错误信息传播高度相关的虚幻真相效应。此前Griffin等(2023)仅在已弃用的text-davinci-003上验证过ITE，且未在社交媒体模拟情境下测试，因此需要检验该效应在不同模型和更生态有效的设计中的可推广性。

Method: 研究设计了一个两阶段上下文实验：(1)模拟阶段——LLM扮演社交媒体用户，浏览5轮新闻推文，每轮4条，其中1条为重复陈述，其余15条为唯一填充推文；(2)评级阶段——在同一上下文窗口内，对4条陈述（1条重复+3条全新）按真实性、重要性、情感和兴趣四个维度以1-7李克特量表评分。测试了四个模型（Gemma-3-4b-it、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、GPT-5-nano），开源模型在温度0.1和1.0两种设置下测试。每条陈述有10个推文变体、3次重复，共收集336,000条评分。分析采用OLS回归描述性分析和线性混合效应模型（LMEM）推断分析，包含陈述重复×属性×模型三向交互，并通过对比真实重复与全新陈述的均值来分离ITE（真实性特异性提升）与单纯暴露效应（跨维度普遍提升）。

Result: 四种模型表现出四种质性不同的模式：(1) Gemma-3-4b-it：呈现真正的ITE，真实性评分提升（δ̂=+0.977, p<0.001）显著高于其他属性，是唯一具有真实性特异性增强的模型；(2) Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct：呈现单纯暴露效应，所有四个属性均显著提升，且重要性提升最大（δ̂=+1.184），真实性并非特异性增强；(3) GPT-5-nano：对真实性（δ̂=-0.041, ns）和重要性（δ̂=+0.003, ns）无重复效应，但重复内容引发轻微怀疑（兴趣δ̂=-0.256, p<0.001；情感δ̂=-0.080, p<0.05）；(4) Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct：呈现小幅真实性提升（δ̂=+0.097, p<0.001），但其他属性均下降（重要性δ̂=-0.149, 兴趣δ̂=-0.107, 情感δ̂=-0.322, 均p<0.001）。温度参数对这些结果无影响，方差分解显示固定效应仅解释6.4%的总方差，语句层面和模拟情境层面的随机效应各贡献约24-25%的方差，表明LLM评级行为具有高度的情境敏感性。

Conclusion: 研究结论表明ITE在LLM中的复现具有模型依赖性，不同模型不仅在量级上不同，在模式上也质性不同——Griffin等(2023)的ITE发现不能推广到所有LLM。重复效应易感性更多取决于训练决策，而非模型规模或模型家族。对于需要模拟人类ITE行为的研究（如错误信息传播模拟），Gemma-3-4b-it目前提供了最接近人类行为真实性的近似。高度的情境敏感性意味着不应在脱离具体信息环境的情况下解读重复效应，提示在选择LLM智能体进行GABM时需谨慎评估特定认知偏差的复现情况。

Abstract: Generative agent-based models (GABMs) are increasingly used to simulate social media dynamics, including misinformation spread. For such social simulations to be valid proxies of human behavior, LLM agents should replicate established human cognitive biases, among them the Illusory Truth Effect (ITE), where repeated exposure to a claim increases its perceived truth value. We investigate whether and how the ITE manifests across four LLMs (Gemma-3-4b-it, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and GPT-5-nano) in a social media simulation context. We propose a two-phase within-context experimental design that embeds the repetition manipulation inside a realistic news feed interaction. Using this design, we collect 336,000 truth, importance, sentiment, and interest ratings across 100 statements, 10 feed variants, and 3 replications.
