Removing unreliable messages recovers part of the lost accuracy, suggesting that communication should be selective based on upstream reliability and the evidence already available to the downstream agent.

</details>


### [323] [IronLLM: Forging Compact Edge-Native Language Models for Real-Time Embodied Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36860)
*Changdi Yang,Fengquan Jiao,Haochih Lin,Haoran Yang,Jing Xiao,Liangyu Huo,Suxin Lu,Tiance Chen,Wei Liu,Yinggan Xu,Yunxiang Lu,Zai Zheng,Zhirui Xie,Zhongyang Che,Ziyan Tang,Zuoxiang Zhao,Jian Yao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: IronLLM-0.6B is a 654M-parameter compact language model designed for efficient on-device inference targeting embodied intelligence applications. It features a hybrid attention architecture (Gated DeltaNet + GQA), X-MTP speculative decoding with shared KV-cache achieving 1.48x speedup, and a quality-driven training pipeline on 6.2T tokens. The Instruct-Only design produces concise responses suitable for low-latency edge deployment.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: The paper addresses the critical need for compact, high-performance language models for embodied intelligence scenarios (robots, in-vehicle systems, smart cockpits) where inference latency, memory footprint, and energy consumption outweigh raw model capacity. Small models face unique challenges in data sensitivity, architectural efficiency, and post-training capability preservation that require specialized design.

Method: The approach combines four key innovations: (1) Hybrid attention architecture with Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and GQA layers at 3:1 ratio with Zero-RMSNorm; (2) X-MTP shared-KV multi-token prediction eliminating per-depth KV replay, plus lightweight verification head for rollback-free drafting; (3) Quality-oriented data pipeline on 6.2T tokens with WSD learning rate schedule and three-stage curriculum; (4) Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) that decouples capability production (specialist models) from capability integration via token-level reverse KL distillation plus verifiable rewards. The Light variant replaces RMSNorm with Dynamic Tanh, uses ReLUx activations, and employs data-independent gating for extreme efficiency.

Result: IronLLM-0.6B achieves performance competitive with Qwen3.5-0.8B and MiniCPM5-1B despite being smaller, winning 8/19 base benchmarks and leading in instruction following, math reasoning, and subjective quality. Decoding speed reaches 460 tokens/s at 1K context, maintaining 377 tokens/s at 32K (vs Qwen3-0.6B at 166 tokens/s). X-MTP achieves 1.37-1.48x speedup on math/code tasks with 3.3-3.6 tokens committed per step. The Light variant retains most capabilities (5.5 point average deficit) with improved inference/quantization efficiency. MOPD outperforms TIES merging on all 13 tested benchmarks for capability integration.

Conclusion: The IronLLM models establish an effective capability-efficiency frontier for resource-constrained edge deployment. The work demonstrates that compact models can achieve competitive performance through careful co-design of architecture (hybrid attention), data efficiency (6.2T vs 36T tokens for Qwen3), training methodology (MOPD), and inference optimization (X-MTP, Instruct-Only design). Future directions include more capable edge architectures, robot-side deployment, multimodality, and broader hardware evaluation for embodied tasks.

Abstract: We present IronLLM-0.6B, a 654M-parameter language model designed for efficient on-device inference. IronLLM-0.6B combines a hybrid attention architecture with X-MTP, a lightweight shared-KV multi-token prediction design that eliminates per-depth KV-cache replay and employs a lightweight verification head for rollback-free drafting, achieving a 1.48x decoding speedup. The model is pretrained on approximately 6.2 trillion tokens using a quality-oriented data pipeline and is further post-trained with Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation to integrate capabilities from domain-specialized teachers. To better meet the low-latency requirements of on-device scenarios, IronLLM-0.6B adopts an Instruct-Only design. Evaluations show that IronLLM-0.6B achieves competitive performance relative to larger models such as Qwen3.5-0.8B and MiniCPM5-1B, while producing more concise responses on many tasks. We further present IronLLM-0.6B-Light, which replaces RMSNorm with Dynamic Tanh and simplifies several computationally expensive components to improve inference and quantization efficiency. Together, the IronLLM models provide an effective performance-efficiency trade-off for resource-constrained deployment.

</details>


### [324] [State Trace Rationale As Auxiliary Task in Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36867)
*Muhammad U. Nasir,Alex Vogt,Steven D. James,Julian Togelius*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: STRAT (State-Trace Rationale as Auxiliary Task) 在深度强化学习中增加一个辅助预测头，要求智能体基于人类空间导航框架（landmark/route/survey）预测自身状态的简短文本trace。文本标签由环境规则在线自动生成，无需人工标注。在60个稀疏奖励的XLand-MiniGrid任务上，STRAT在标准PPO完全失败的中等难度任务上取得了显著性能提升，同时压缩了状态表征、防止了表征秩坍塌，并提供每步可读的智能体信念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在稀疏奖励的深度强化学习中，学习到的表征往往只捕捉与回报相关的信息，可能不足以支撑复杂任务。已有辅助任务多关注像素、下一帧或潜状态等任务无关目标，而基于语言的辅助任务虽已出现，但未明确描述内容应包含什么、各部分重要性如何。人类空间导航通过 landmark（地标）、route（路径）和 survey（全局布局）三类知识协同完成导航，本文以此为动机设计语言辅助任务的监督内容。

Method: STRAT 在基于PPO 的actor-critic 策略上添加一个辅助状态trace 预测头。trace 由5 行模板化自然语言组成（共90 个token，其中24 个内容槽可变）：agent position（pos_y, pos_x, direction）→ route knowledge；goal 和 subgoal（由规则集的goal predicate 和反向链式planning 生成）→ landmark knowledge；上一动作及基于值函数差 ΔV 的"closer/farther/same"进度信号 → route knowledge；inventory 持有物 → survey knowledge。标签在rollout 阶段从模拟器状态和任务规则在线生成，不作为策略输入。损失为内容槽上的token 级交叉熵 L_ST，加权 λ_st 加入到 L_PPO + c_v L_V − c_e H 中。基础策略使用Transformer-XL 记忆骨干，主实验在XLand-MiniGrid-R1-9x9 符号观测、243 步稀疏奖励下进行，60 个任务分属small/medium/high 三个benchmark，按 Placed/Go-hold/Beside/Align 四类难度分层，10 个随机种子。消融包括：(1) trace 各组成部分组合（landmark-only、route-only、无action、无position、无goal-subgoal）；(2) 进度标签替换为BFS/欧氏距离；(3) 用GRU 替换Transformer-XL；(4) λ_st 与τ 扫描。表征分析采用40 个时间点上冻结检查点的Minimum Description Length（prequential code length）评估目标可见性、子目标相位、动作、方向、坐标、库存等可解释变量的可压缩性，并使用effective rank、srank、participation ratio、dormant units 四个统计量跟踪表征容量以检测秩坍缩。

Result: 在60 个任务中：Placed（easy）类任务PPO 与STRAT 均能解决；Go-hold（medium）类任务上STRAT 在100% 任务上严格优于PPO 且差距显著；Beside（hard）类任务上两者均整体表现不佳，但STRAT 在约40% 环境中明显优于PPO；Align（hardest）类任务两者均无法解决。消融表明：单独landmark（goal/subgoal）或单独route（position/action）信号不足，PPO 在多个Go-hold 任务上完全失败；同时去除action 或position 描述也会显著降低性能。BFS/欧氏距离进度信号与值引导进度信号在样本效率上接近，少数任务上前者更优。λ_st 与τ 对最终回报有影响，应作为超参调节；GRU 骨干在easy 与Beside 任务上同样能获得增益，证明STRAT 不依赖具体记忆架构。表征分析显示：STRAT、STRAT-wa、STRAT-wp 在目标可见性上稳定压缩信息，而STRAT-gs 与PPO 未能压缩；STRAT 在子目标相位、动作、方向、坐标、库存等变量上也表现出比PPO 更优的可压缩性，呈现更透明的表示。容量分析表明STRAT 的effective rank、srank、participation ratio 不发生坍缩，dormant units 几乎为0，与PPO 差异明显。

Conclusion: STRAT 通过引入基于人类空间导航框架的状态trace 辅助任务，在不改变推理流程、不增加人工标注的前提下，显著提升PPO 在稀疏奖励长视野任务中的表现，并产出更紧凑、可解释的表征以及每步可读的智能体信念报告；其收益主要来自landmark、route、survey 三类知识的联合监督，未来工作可向更难任务（如Align）的课程式或开放式学习方向发展。

Abstract: We propose STRAT, an auxiliary task that trains deep reinforcement learning (RL) agents to predict a short textual trace of their own state. Inspired by human spatial navigation, the description combines landmark, route, and survey knowledge, tracking the agent's position, inventory, goals, and immediate progress. Environment rules generate this text online without human labelling. Our method adds a single auxiliary head to a standard policy. Across 60 sparse-reward XLand-MiniGrid tasks, STRAT solves complex environments where standard RL fails outright, while compacting state representations and preventing rank collapse. Beyond performance gains, the predicted trace provides a readable account of agent beliefs at every step for no extra cost.

</details>


### [325] [WEFT: Scaling Tool-Use Post-Training for General-Purpose Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36887)
*Bo Mao,Hang He,Linting Wang,Lizhi Lin,Maosen Zhou,Guanming Liu,Jinxiu Liu,Tianyu Huai,Chaoyun Zhang,Bingxuan Li,Kepeng Lei,Guanting Dong,Zhou Shao,Rui Zheng,Hang Yan,Jie Zhou,Chengcheng Wan,Tao Gui,Liang He,Xipeng Qiu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: WEFT提出了一种面向工具使用后训练的全系统进化框架，通过协同构建智能体交互系统、执行驱动的自进化以及稳定的大规模后训练，解决了仅扩展可执行环境带来的性能瓶颈问题，并在多个基准测试上显著优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前工具使用后训练的规模化主要集中于合成可执行环境，但环境只是智能体交互系统（环境、任务、智能体框架、评估器）的一部分。孤立扩展环境并不能保证模型性能的同步提升，因为可靠的学习信号需要所有组件的协同交互。

Method: WEFT框架包含三个核心机制：(1) 可扩展的智能体交互系统构建，跨环境广度、任务复杂度和交互多样性进行扩展；(2) 执行驱动的自进化，利用执行轨迹和状态证据迭代归因失败并修订负责的组件，新一轮rollout评估变更并为后续进化提供证据；(3) 稳定的大规模后训练，包括前缀保留采样以保留已验证的进度、原子回合信用分配以定位学习信号，以及MegaMCP以在共享工具服务的并发rollout中保持隔离和可恢复状态。

Result: 在多个模型和基准上的大量实验证明了WEFT在工具使用后训练中的有效性。WEFT-8B和WEFT-14B在BFCL V4、τ²-Bench和Claw-Eval上均优于所有评估的同规模环境扩展基线。具体而言，WEFT-14B相比Agent-World-14B分别提升了6.41、2.23和12.27个百分点。WEFT-35B-A3B进一步将这些增益扩展到更具挑战性的长程工作流基准，包括Toolathlon-Verified和AutomationBench。

Conclusion: WEFT通过将训练重点从孤立扩展可执行环境转向整个智能体交互系统的协同进化，有效提升了工具使用后训练的效果和稳定性，为大规模智能体训练提供了更可靠的方法论。

Abstract: Recent efforts to scale tool-use post-training have largely centered on the synthesis of executable environments, which constitute only one component of a broader agentic interaction system comprising the environment, task, agent harness, and evaluator. Scaling environments in isolation, however, does not guarantee commensurate gains in model performance, because reliable learning signals depend on coherent interactions among all components of the agentic interaction system. To address this problem, we introduce WEFT (Whole-system Evolution For Tool-use Post-training), which couples scalable agentic interaction system construction, execution-driven self-evolution, and stable post-training. WEFT scales agentic interaction system construction across environment breadth, task complexity, and interaction diversity. Execution-driven self-evolution iteratively uses execution traces and state evidence to attribute failures and revise the responsible components, with fresh rollouts evaluating the changes and providing evidence for subsequent evolution rounds. For stable post-training at scale, WEFT addresses both optimization and execution reliability: prefix-preserving sampling retains verified progress and atomic-turn credit assignment localizes learning signals, while MegaMCP maintains isolated, recoverable state across concurrent rollouts over shared tool services. Extensive experiments across various models and benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of WEFT for tool-use post-training. WEFT-8B and WEFT-14B outperform all evaluated matched-size environment-scaling baselines on BFCL V4, $\tau^2$-Bench, and Claw-Eval. In particular, WEFT-14B improves over Agent-World-14B by 6.41, 2.23, and 12.27 percentage points. WEFT-35B-A3B further extends these gains to more challenging long-horizon workflow benchmarks, including Toolathlon-Verified and AutomationBench.

</details>


### [326] [Beyond Sub-Gaussian Detector Scores: Robust Weighted Profile-Loss Change Point Detection for Human-LLM Text Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36888)
*Wan Tian,Zhongyi Li,Yawen Li,Rui Zhang,Yijie Peng,Fuzhen Zhuang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 RWCP（Robust Weighted Profile-Loss Change Point Detection）方法，用于在人类与 LLM 混合文本中定位作者切换点。针对现有加权均值对比方法对极端分数脆弱以及直接将均值替换为稳健中心会模糊目标函数的问题，RWCP 结合封顶可靠性权重、Huber 轮廓增益和可靠性坐标下的窄区间阈值搜索。理论核心是将真实分割与偏移分割之间的总体差距表示为合并成本，绕过了混合段非线性中心的封闭解；在显式曲率、间距和依赖条件下实现了变化数量的精确恢复和边界定位；其二次损失极限恢复了加权 CUSUM。还提出 RWCP-R 变体用于在非相邻段落间共享源中心。在五个回顾性基准上，核心 RWCP 将族宏平均 WindowDiff 相对 WCP 降低 17.6%，RWCP-R 进一步降低；但在协作与密集变化文本中两者均漏检变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合人机文档需要定位作者切换点而非整体分类。现有加权变化点检测（WCP）使用检测器分数的可靠性加权，但存在三个问题：(1) 极端分数（如罕见 token、代码、短单元）会扭曲加权均值对比；(2) 将均值替换为稳健中心会破坏 CUSUM 的人群分解（错误分割混合两个源位置，其最优中心并非加权算术平均）；(3) 需要依赖感知而非仅亚高斯假设。需要一种既能控制极端值影响、又能给出可分析的人群差距的稳健加权变化点检测方法。

Method: 1. 稳健加权轮廓增益：用 Huber 损失代替二次损失，权重由封顶逆方差定义  $w_i^\circ = \Pi_{[w_{\min},w_{\max}]}(\sigma_i^{-2})$；增益 $\hat{\Gamma}_{s,e}(b)$ 为单位置模型与分割模型的优化 Huber 损失之差。2. 可靠性坐标搜索：在累积权重 $W(t)=\sum_{i\le t}w_i$ 上均匀采样区间，应用窄区间阈值原则（NOT），选择总可靠性质量最小的过阈值区间，递归执行；使用置信质量 $g_N$ 保护防止重复发现。3. 合并成本分析：定理 3.8 证明真实边界与偏移边界的人群增益差等于两段合并的过剩风险 $2D^*$，迁移至消除对非线性混合中心的需求。5. RWCP-R 变体：用 Viterbi 解码共享 $S$ 个源状态中心，拟合尺度 $\sigma$，目标函数含 Huber 发射损失与转换惩罚 $\lambda$。6. 理论框架：基于曲率假设、可靠性假设、依赖假设（Bernstein 条件 + $\beta$-混合）、中心质量与间距/信号假设，证明有限样本下变化数精确恢复与加权定位。

Result: 在 25 个设置、2,690 个实例的五个基准族（单变化 WikiQA/News/Story、CoAuthor 真实协作、多变化 Story、文本攻击、LLM 比例）上：(1) 核心 RWCP 将族宏平均 WindowDiff 从 WCP 的 0.4070 降至 0.3355（相对 17.6%），在四个族上改善 WD；(2) RWCP-R 进一步降至 0.3110（相对 WCP 23.6%），在 23/25 设置上优于 WCP；19 个逐设置配对 95% 区间低于零；(3) 边界恢复改善最明显的是单变化文本（单变化族 F1 从 0.435 升至 0.544，count MAE 从 1.637 降至 0.340）；(4) 但两者在协作与密集变化文本上均漏检变化：核心 RWCP 在 CoAuthor、多变化、攻击、比例族上分别有 82.4%、93.1%、94.7%、92.8% 的文档未报告边界；(5) RWCP-R 在 84.1% 的 CoAuthor 文档上输出零边界。组件消融显示尺度自适应和有限 Huber 截止改善窗口误差，而统一权重改善 count MAE 和边界 F1。

Conclusion: RWCP 通过合并成本识别将稳健变化点检测转化为优化段风险比较，无需求解混合段 Huber 中心的封闭解；二次极限恢复加权 CUSUM。在有界分数集中、可靠性坐标隔离和保护递归下，核心 RWCP 在陈述条件下获得精确计数恢复和加权定位。回顾性评估显示核心 RWCP 平均 WindowDiff 降低且仅在单变化族同时改善计数与 F1；其高零边界率暴露了固定分析阈值在 CoAuthor 与密集/扰动文本上的局限。RWCP-R 通过在非相邻段落间共享信息进一步降低族宏平均 WindowDiff，在单变化上获得最明显的边界恢复增益，但其他族仍存在计数/F1 权衡。窗口级一致性与个体变化恢复回答不同问题；结果支持窗口误差降低而非该基准套上的通用精确计数恢复。遗留问题包括渐进编辑、句内混合、分数语义反转、长记忆依赖与目标相关权重估计。

Abstract: Mixed human-LLM documents require locating authorship transitions from detector scores whose reliability varies across text units. Existing weighted mean contrasts are vulnerable to extreme scores, while directly replacing means with robust centers obscures how a misplaced boundary changes the population objective. We propose Robust Weighted Profile-Loss Change Point Detection (RWCP), which combines capped reliability weights, Huber profile gains, and narrowest-over-threshold search in reliability coordinates. Our key analysis expresses the population gap between a true and a displaced split as a merge cost, avoiding a closed-form solution for the nonlinear center of a mixed segment. Under explicit curvature, spacing, and dependence conditions, core RWCP recovers the number of changes and localizes their boundaries; its quadratic-loss limit recovers squared weighted CUSUM. We also study RWCP-R, a separately evaluated decoder that shares source centers across nonadjacent passages. Across five retrospective cached-score benchmark families, core RWCP reduces family-macro WindowDiff by 17.6\% relative to weighted change-point detection, and RWCP-R lowers it further. Boundary recovery improves most clearly for isolated changes, while both fixed configurations miss changes in collaborative and densely alternating text.

</details>


### [327] [Harness Evolution as Learning: Approximation, Generalization, and Optimization Limits of Self-Improving Personal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36892)
*Zeyu Gan,Zixuan Gong,Yong Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将"个人代理的harness演化"建模为机器学习问题，从经验与理论两方面系统分析了围绕固定基础模型的自适应个性化所面临的三大局限性：harness架构的近似误差、harness规模的泛化误差、自演化算法的优化误差，并给出了相应的实验观测与定理解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型能力提升后，如何将其转化为个人代理在日常场景中持续适配用户偏好的实用行为成为关键问题。现有工作多集中于修改模型参数，但实际部署中基础模型通常被冻结，适应性必须通过外部harness工程实现。harness设计的多样性与演化算法的差异留下了三个未解张力：harness架构、harness规模与自演化算法对个性化效果的影响缺乏统一量化基准与理论解释。

Method: 1) 提出AppWorld-P偏好基准，在AppWorld上增加可执行的用户偏好规则层，使偏好合规性可程序化度量。2) 采用固定基础模型claude-haiku-4-5-20251001，控制harness机制、内存长度或更新策略进行对照实验。3) 将harness演化形式化为学习问题，将风险差距分解为近似误差、泛化误差、优化误差三个分量。4) 通过潜概念模型、可达策略集合、信息论上界与Hoeffding不等式、Wasserstein不动点分析等手段给出条件性定理解释（Theorem 4.1–4.4及Corollary 4.3）。

Result: 经验结果：在所评估构造下，harness机制选择上，context类harness足以处理本地指令型偏好（如短信署名、付款备注格式），但对需要历史推断或精确计算的偏好（如字符校验和、习惯性支付卡、累计消费）效果有限，加入验证重试或外部计算后合规率显著提升（运行总额违规率从0.44降至0.00）；内存规模上，违规率从L=0时约0.77下降至L=10时约0.20，但继续扩大至L=20–150反而回升至0.25–0.27，呈非单调U型；自演化算法上，ACE、TEPA与TRACE在24次交互后违规率约0.48–0.57，与oracle上下文0.071之间存在持续约0.40的差距，Reflexion几乎无提升。理论上证明了context可达集被预训练策略凸包限制困住而control可达集可超出该凸包；当用户最优策略只能由control达到时，control类近似误差为零而context类严格为正；Theorem 4.2与Corollary 4.3表明泛化界随L严格增大，与覆盖界结合后给出上确界风险的U型覆盖-估计权衡；Theorem 4.4证明在持续更新偏差下，优化误差存在正下界μβ₀²/(2(1+ρ)²)，解释了观察到的持续oracle差距。

Conclusion: 研究得出三个核心结论：(1) 个性化合规性依赖harness机制是否与偏好需求匹配，context适合激活既有行为，复杂偏好需要control类干预；(2) 内存扩张并非单调有益，存在覆盖增益与估计误差的权衡，应根据反馈证据量与可靠性决定保留、合并或扩展；(3) 重复自演化未必能闭合oracle差距，算法层面的偏差可能形成正优化下界，需要更丰富反馈、接地修正信号与独立验证记忆编辑。这些发现通过将harness演化形式化为学习问题，统一解释了多样化harness工程实践所对应的误差成分，为未来harness设计与失败诊断提供了统一框架。

Abstract: As the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) continue to advance, increasing attention is turning to how to translate their abilities into useful behavior. Personal agents bring this question into everyday settings, where models are expected to serve individual users and continually adapt to their preferences. With the underlying model held fixed, such adaptation relies on harness engineering: designing and evolving the surrounding layer that manages context, memory, tools, and execution. Despite rapid progress, the factors governing effective harness evolution remain insufficiently understood. To narrow this gap, we investigate three central questions concerning harness architecture, harness scale, and self-evolution algorithms through complementary empirical and theoretical analyses. Empirically, we introduce a preference-oriented benchmark and systematically characterize the capabilities and limitations of personal agents associated with these three dimensions. Theoretically, we formulate harness evolution as a learning problem and explain these phenomena through approximation, generalization, and optimization errors. Analyses of reachable policies, capacity under finite interaction evidence, and biased update dynamics provide theoretical accounts of the observed phenomena. Together, these results offer a unified perspective on the limits of personalization through harness evolution and inform future harness design.

</details>


### [328] [HorizonFlow: Variable-Length Planning for Offline Goal-Conditioned RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36896)
*JunHyeok Oh,Zian Jang,Byung-Jun Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 HorizonFlow，一种用于离线目标条件强化学习的分层规划器，将规划长度视为生成的输出而非预设输入，通过结合插入式生成与流匹配，联合生成连续计划内容与长度，在 Maze2D、Multi2D 及 OGBench 导航与视觉操控基准上取得了最高的平均性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的生成式轨迹规划方法（轨迹修复）通常在生成内容之前预设规划时长（horizon），但该时长因路径而异。过短的时长会导致不可行的转移，过长的时长则引入冗余运动，且 VH-Diffuser 等方法使用学习得到的长度预测器仍需在生成前选定时长，时机不匹配会限制计划质量。

Method: HorizonFlow 采用分层架构，包含子目标路线规划器（RP，生成变长潜在子目标序列）和动作前缀控制器（PC，生成变长动作前缀）。两者均结合基于插入的生成（insertion-based generation）与流匹配（flow matching），使用部分生成计划指导 token 插入，由共享 Transformer 同时预测速度、缺失 token 数（零截断泊松参数）与间隙完成概率。训练使用对数均匀采样长度、InfoNCE 损失稳定编码器、局部前缀目标及两阶段生成时钟 σ∈[0,2]。推理阶段采用最小计数选择（不依赖学习值函数）与 Feynman–Kac 重采样（基于计数引导分数偏向更短计划），并以滚动时域方式执行。

Result: 在 Maze2D/Multi2D（D4RL 归一化得分）、OGBench 导航与视觉操控（成功率）的基准对比中，HorizonFlow 在三组基准上均达到所有对比方法中最高的平均性能，且在长视野环境中优势最大。在 Maze2D-Large 的 XY 路线生成诊断中，联合内容–长度生成在所有标称步数分箱上保持高到达率，而预设时长在近/远目标间存在权衡；生成计数与标称步数的 Spearman 相关性（ρ=0.954）优于 HIQL 值派生长度（0.924）与 VHD 长度预测（0.653）。架构消融显示，用 BC 策略替换前缀控制器将平均成功率从 94.2% 降至 67.8%，去除分层则降至 42.9%。

Conclusion: HorizonFlow 证明了将规划长度作为生成输出而非预设输入的可行性，联合插入与流匹配能同时生成连续计划内容与长度，分层架构（RP+PC）对导航任务至关重要。生成计数可在无需单独值模型的情况下用于候选选择与生成引导。基于计数的方法在确定性环境中有效，但其在随机动力学下的适用性有待验证。

Abstract: Recent advances in generative planning have made trajectory inpainting a promising approach to offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning. However, these methods typically specify the planning horizon before generating plan content, even though the appropriate horizon depends on the route itself. A horizon that is too short can force infeasible transitions, whereas one that is too long can introduce redundant motion. We introduce HorizonFlow, a hierarchical planner that treats plan length as an output of generation rather than a prescribed input. Its subgoal route planner guides its action-prefix controller through a sequence of latent subgoals. Both components combine insertion-based generation with flow matching to jointly generate continuous plan content and length, using the partially generated plan to guide token insertion. HorizonFlow reuses the resulting length information to select candidates and steer generation toward shorter plans without a separate learned value model. Across Maze2D, Multi2D, and OGBench navigation and visual manipulation benchmarks, HorizonFlow achieves the highest average performance among the compared methods.

</details>


### [329] [STAR-GRPO: Canonical Anchoring and Reliability-First Advantages against Representation-Dependent Reward Hacking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36900)
*Wan Tian,Zhongyi Li,Xiang Xu,Minhao Zou,Yijie Peng,Fuzhen Zhuang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: STAR-GRPO（Self-Tuned Anchored Reliability Group-Relative Policy Optimization）是一种针对群组相对策略优化（GRPO）中奖励黑客问题的可靠性优先优势估计器。它通过同一rollout的成对评分差异来评估rollout可靠性，将相对可靠性纳入鲁棒位置-尺度拟合中，并在最终优势中加入绝对组可靠性衰减因子，从而在保持任务奖励作为优化对象的同时，限制不可靠奖励对组基线和策略更新的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在群组相对策略优化（GRPO）中，奖励黑客问题尤为突出：单个不可靠的高奖励会偏移组基线，改变其他rollout的优势分配；而后置加权或纯相对权重无法表达整组的不确定性。论文需要：设计一种优势构造方法，使可靠性在归一化前进入组统计，并在更新中保留绝对可靠性量级。

Method: 方法核心包括：(1) 成对评分视图——同一rollout使用部署视图和规范化视图（或代理评分与语义锚点）进行双重评估，计算差异 D=R_obs-R_canon；(2) 基于上下文自适应伪Huber鲁棒位置-尺度拟合，生成rollout级可靠性权重；(4) 自调式稳健拟合在归一化前进入组统计，共享跨批次尺度参数；(3) 最终优势为 A_STAR = w̄_b · w_{b,i}/(ν_b+ε_w) · φ_{b,i}，其中 w̄_b 为绝对组可靠性因子。理论分析包括识别边界（定理3.1/B.2/B.4）、量级控制与居中（定理5.1/D.3）、单离群点衰减（命题5.2）以及共形可靠性控制（定理5.3/C.9）。

Result: 在两个奖励黑客场景中验证：RQ1（令牌接口利用）：以Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct为策略、Skywork-Reward-V2-Qwen3-8B为奖励模型，STAR将规范化验证奖励从3.121提升至4.902（绝对增益1.781），同时抑制观察接口奖励至-0.570（对比TOMPA-GRPO的9.641）。RQ2（医学推理的rubric-proxy过度优化）：以Qwen3-4B在RubricHub-Medical训练，独立评委得分从0.2706提升至0.3174（+17.3%），代理-评委差距从0.2935降至0.2318（-21.0%），过度声明率从0.2464降至0.2204（-10.6%）。

Conclusion: STAR-GRPO提供了一种原则性方法，通过成对评估在归一化前将可靠性纳入组统计，并以绝对组可靠性因子限制有界优势。理论分析建立了坐标界和二阶矩界、精确居中条件以及可靠性依赖的衰减保证；实验证明该方法在两种不同奖励黑客场景下有效，在保持任务奖励作为优化目标的同时，将更多优化信号转化为独立评估可复现的质量。

Abstract: Reward hacking occurs when policy optimization exploits a brittle reward interface or an overly permissive proxy objective, improving the training score without improving the underlying response quality. This phenomenon is amplified in group-relative policy optimization: an unsupported reward can shift the group baseline and alter the updates of other rollouts, while post-hoc or purely relative weighting cannot represent group-wide uncertainty. We propose \emph{Self-Tuned Anchored Reliability Group-Relative Policy Optimization} (STAR-GRPO), a reliability-first advantage estimator based on paired assessments of the same rollout. STAR separates the quality signal from its learning influence: score disagreement determines rollout reliability, relative reliability enters a self-tuned robust location--scale fit before group normalization, and absolute group reliability attenuates the resulting bounded advantage. The analysis establishes coordinate and second-moment bounds, characterizes exact centering through the weighted location equation, and gives reliability-dependent attenuation guarantees for outlying rewards. We evaluate STAR-GRPO in two complementary reward-hacking regimes. In token-interface exploitation, STAR prevents runaway optimization of the deployed-interface score while improving the canonical quality signal. In rubric-proxy overoptimization for medical reasoning, STAR improves independent semantic evaluation, narrows the proxy--judge discrepancy, and reduces overclaim while optimizing the same task proxy. Together, these results show that reliability-first normalization offers a principled way to limit unsupported reward influence on both group baselines and policy updates, while retaining the task reward as the optimization target.

</details>


### [330] [PrecogUI: Proactive GUI Agents via Pre-cognitive Simulation and Experience Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36923)
*Bin Kang,Jiarui Ouyang,Li Jiang,Bin Chen,Zhuotao Tian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PrecogUI提出一种前认知(pre-cognitive)GUI智能体架构，将范式从被动反应式执行转变为主动预测式决策。其核心由三个组件构成：PEP(Proactive Experience Pool)以"状态-动作-结果"元组缓存异常与成功模式；PSE(Proactive Simulation Executor)基于条件扩散模型预测候选动作的下一符号化UI布局以提前规避异常；PEC(Pre-cognitive Execution Controller)融合先验与预测，通过闭环纠错机制实现异常优先处理与执行鲁棒性。同时提出AutoTraj数据生成引擎与InterfereBench基准（34个应用、1160个任务组、约27k标注截图），用于评估长时域、强扰动场景下的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有反应式GUI智能体在长时域、动态场景中容易受弹窗、黑屏等突发扰动影响，导致注意力分散并产生级联失败。实验表明反应式策略在扰动增加或扰动出现较晚时成功率急剧下降，揭示了纯反应式策略的脆弱性，亟需赋予智能体前认知规划与显式异常处理能力。

Method: 方法由四个模块组成：(1) AutoTraj数据构建流水线，包含Autonomous Explorer(基于探索价值V平衡布局发现与罕见状态访问)、Trajectory Parser(两阶段过滤与MLLM排序标注)、Perturbation Injector(注入叠加层与环境级扰动生成clean-perturbed配对)以及PolyTouch多手势宏执行层；(2) PEP采用双记忆(Anomaly Memory与Success Memory)，以布局签名(type,bbox)与IoU贪婪匹配实现最近邻检索，并采用版本感知更新策略与指数陈旧衰减；(3) PSE采用条件潜扩散模型预测下一步符号化UI布局，结合规则化的异常识别(遮挡/黑屏/冻结)与布局差异度D_layout生成候选动作可靠性评分；(4) PEC先进行预认知异常检查(检索PEP或规则)，再生成候选动作-格式对(index/relative/absolute)、用PSE过滤高风险候选并执行最高分候选，最后通过布局变化与语义验证进行状态监控与停滞/意外转移恢复(回滚、重试、临时禁忌列表)。

Result: 在InterfereBench强扰动子集上，PrecogUI相对最强基线在扰动设置下SR高出22.4和22.1个百分点，扰动导致的SR下降控制在10.8和11.1点(基线下降27-30点)；在AndroidControl-High与GUI-Odyssey上SR分别达76.4%和89.1%；在ScreenSpot跨设备grounding上达91.2%加权平均准确率；在OSWorld 15步/50步协议下分别达20.7%与27.5% SR。消融实验显示PEP/PSE/PEC在强扰动子集上累计带来+10.6/+9.7/+6.6的SR增益。PSE预测质量达89.4%类型准确率、80.2% bbox IoU、83.2%元素级F1；恢复机制在12.4-18.6%的episode中触发，其中69.7-73.1%恢复成功。

Conclusion: PrecogUI通过"经验-预见-反馈"闭环显著提升了GUI智能体在长时域、强扰动动态环境中的鲁棒性与可靠性，且在标准grounding与导航基准上保持竞争力。局限性在于：look-ahead仿真与验证引入额外延迟与计算开销；经验先验可能因应用更新而过时。未来工作应采用轻量化、可任意时刻终止的预测与漂移感知的记忆维护策略。

Abstract: Existing reactive Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents often fail in long-horizon, dynamic scenarios, where unexpected disturbances trigger attention-diverting and cascading failures. To address this, we propose PrecogUI, a pre-cognitive architecture that shifts the paradigm from reactive execution to proactive decision-making. Specifically, we design a Proactive Experience Pool (PEP), which caches recurring anomaly and success patterns as "state-action-result" tuples in a dual-memory repository. Furthermore, we introduce a Proactive Simulation Executor (PSE) that learns to forecast the next symbolic UI layout given a candidate action, enabling early anomaly avoidance and ranking candidate actions by predicted reliability. Finally, a Pre-cognitive Execution Controller (PEC) fuses these priors and predictions, prioritizes handling of foreseen anomalies, and ensures execution robustness through a closed-loop error correction mechanism. For robust evaluation, we develop AutoTraj, an automatic data-generation engine, to construct InterfereBench, a benchmark for long-horizon tasks with strong disturbances. Experiments demonstrate that PrecogUI surpasses state-of-the-art methods on InterfereBench while maintaining competitive performance on public benchmarks. The code will be publicly available.

</details>


### [331] [Neuro-Symbolic Computer Use: Learning Reusable Policies for Reliable and Efficient Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36927)
*Hyewon Suh,Thanh Minh Nguyen,Chih-Lun Lee,Darrow Hartman,Lizhao Liu,Xin Eric Wang,Ang Li,Jiachen Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"神经符号化计算使用"范式，通过将重复性工作流编码为可复用的神经符号策略（代码处理稳定决策，神经网络处理依赖观测的决策），并采用神经符号策略迭代（NSPI）从智能体轨迹中学习这些策略。在OSWorld和ScienceBoard基准测试中，该方法显著提升了重复运行可靠性（Pass^3提升3.6-15.8分），同时将单次运行成本降低15-217倍、延迟降低3.4-5.1倍，并在工作流变体迁移任务上超越AutoRPA 8.6-17.5分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有计算机使用智能体在每次执行时都从头规划每一步，对于重复性工作流既昂贵又不可靠；现有RPA方法则在环境变化时容易失效。本文旨在解决这一矛盾，使智能体能够将执行经验转化为可复用的程序，同时保持对状态变化的适应性。

Method: 1. 神经符号策略：代码处理稳定的工作流结构（顺序、变量、循环、分支），神经原语处理依赖观测的决策（如GUI定位、状态检查）；2. 神经符号策略迭代（NSPI）：从单条智能体轨迹初始化策略，通过执行-诊断-探索-修订循环迭代优化，使用任务完成判断器和模块级判断器定位失败，由编码模型根据智能体从失败点的延续进行代码修复；3. 通过在生成的参数/初始状态变体上训练实现策略泛化；4. 部署时使用前置动作验证器守护每个状态变更步骤。

Result: 在OSWorld（361任务）和ScienceBoard（169任务）上使用GPT-5.6 Terra和Claude Opus 5作为骨干模型：NSPI在全部四种设置中Pass^3均为最高，比基础智能体高3.6-15.8分；单次运行成本降低15-217倍，延迟降低3.4-5.1倍；在仅基于变体训练的策略迁移到保留原任务上，Pass^3超越AutoRPA 8.6-17.5分；构造成本可在3-27次执行后回收。

Conclusion: 神经符号计算使用范式成功将执行经验转化为可复用策略，在重复执行可靠性和效率方面显著优于纯神经智能体和传统RPA；策略泛化能力和前置验证器进一步增强了实用性；长工作流和判断器分析揭示了轨迹到策略转换及策略评估的剩余瓶颈，更好的获取与验证方法可进一步扩展该方法的适用范围。

Abstract: Many computer tasks recur: the same workflow runs many times, with new inputs and from different starting states. Current computer-use agents re-plan every step of every run, which makes them costly and unreliable on such tasks. We introduce neuro-symbolic computer use, in which a recurring workflow is executed by a learned policy rather than re-derived by an agent on each run. The policy fixes the decisions that are stable across runs (ordering, variables, loops, and branches) in executable code, and delegates observation-dependent decisions, such as grounding and state checks, to neural models. We learn these policies with neuro-symbolic policy iteration: starting from one agent trajectory, it executes the policy, diagnoses failures with task-completion and step-level judges, and revises the code with a coding model informed by an agent's continuation from the point of failure, without access to the benchmark evaluator. Iterating on generated parameter and initial-state variants makes the policy reusable, and a pre-action verifier guards each state-mutating step at deployment. On OSWorld-Verified and ScienceBoard, the learned policies achieve the highest Pass^3 of all methods in all four settings, 3.6-15.8 points above the base agent, while cutting per-run cost by 15-217$\times$ and latency by 3.4-5.1$\times$. On OSWorld-Verified, policies built only on variants transfer to the held-out original tasks, exceeding AutoRPA by 8.6-17.5 points in Pass^3.

</details>


### [332] [Learn from the Gap: Differential-Aware Advantage Pruning with Adaptive Rollout Sampling for GRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36932)
*Jiahua Yang,Zhiwei Yang,Xianpeng Zhang,Dongyu Chen,Xing Chen,Tianhuang Su,Haonan Lu,Quanlong Guan,Kai Tang,Chuangchuang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出FastRL，一个即插即用的强化学习框架，通过"最大化差异性优势剪枝"（MDAP）和"自适应Rollout采样"（ARS）两个核心模块，在GRPO系列算法（GRPO/DAPO/GSPO）上同时实现训练加速与性能提升，实验获得平均2.07倍训练加速和约1.64%准确率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO及其变体（如DAPO、GSPO）在策略优化中表现优异，但存在两大瓶颈：(1) 每个问题需多轮rollout采样并对每个token重复进行概率评估，计算开销巨大；(2) 低信息量或高度同质的轨迹会降低下游学习信号的效率，引入模式崩溃风险。现有加速方法（如CPPO、GRESO）存在效率-性能的权衡困境：加速明显时性能下降，性能保持时加速有限。

Method: FastRL包含两个互补模块：
- **最大化差异性优势剪枝（MDAP）**：将同一问题内G条轨迹按优势值分组（Eq.6），在每个优势组内用n-gram Jaccard相似度（Eq.7）作为梯度相似度的代理，通过贪心最大独立集选择（阈值τ=0.8，Eq.8）去除低信息和高同质轨迹，保留结构多样的代表性轨迹。
- **自适应Rollout采样（ARS）**：基于历史剪枝统计量（均值G^mean和最大值G^max，Eq.10-11）动态调整下一轮的rollout数量（G_{t+1}=max(round(G_1-Δ_t), 2)，Eq.14），通过复合权重α（Eq.11）随训练进度从偏向探索转向偏向效率。

两个模块协同工作：MDAP消除梯度计算阶段的冗余，ARS消除rollout采样阶段的冗余，且MDAP的剪枝统计驱动ARS的采样调整。

Result: 在Geometry3K和GeoQA8K-R1V两个数据集上，使用Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct和Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct两个基模型：
- **训练效率**：FastRL集成到GRPO/DAPO/GSPO后，平均获得2.07倍训练加速（最高2.22倍），同时训练时间减半以上。
- **准确率**：在域内和4个域外基准（MathVerse/MathVision/MathVista/WeMath）上，平均准确率提升约1.64%。
- **消融实验**：移除MDAP导致加速从2.14×降至1.15×，准确率下降0.72-1.43%；移除ARS导致加速下降0.08-0.28×，准确率下降0.15-1.89%，证明两模块互补。
- **泛化性**：在纯文本MATH数据集上使用Llama3.1-8B-Instruct，FastRL获得2.30倍加速且准确率最高（73.04%）；Pass@16指标也优于所有基线，证明未压缩探索空间。
- **训练动态**：FastRL保持最低token消耗和最稳定的策略熵（避免熵崩溃），且收敛更快。
- **细粒度分析**：MDAP主要加速优化阶段（update_actor压缩约2.64×），ARS主要加速rollout生成阶段（timing_gen压缩1.09-1.31×）。
- **超参数τ的敏感性**：τ=0.8为最佳平衡点（最大加速下保持最高准确率）。
- **剪枝策略分析**：随机剪枝导致性能显著下降；仅按优势分组（每组保留1条）已达2.35×加速；叠加Jaccard剪枝后才达到52.63%的准确率，证明Jaccard剪枝防止误剪高价值但同优势的结构多样化轨迹。

Conclusion: FastRL通过"学习差异"的核心洞察，有效解决了GRPO变体中效率-性能的权衡问题。其结构化剪枝策略保留最具信息量的轨迹，自适应采样机制平衡探索与效率。实验证明该框架在多模型、多数据集、多模态（视觉和文本）设置下均具有广泛的适用性和鲁棒性。未来工作需将MDAP扩展至连续奖励函数场景（需通过分段离散化等任务特定设计实现）。

Abstract: Recently, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and its variants have been developed for policy optimization and demonstrated notable performance gains. However, these methods usually incur substantial computational overhead due to per-question multi-rollout sampling and repeated per-token probability evaluation across rollouts. Furthermore, low-information or highly homogeneous trajectories can degrade downstream learning signal efficiency, hindering model optimization and limiting final performance. To address these issues, we propose FastRL, a novel plug-and-play reinforcement learning framework that simultaneously improves training efficiency and the effectiveness of policy learning. Specifically, 1) We introduce an advantage-aware pruning strategy to selectively preserve high-advantage trajectories while maximizing inter-trajectory gradient diversity. 2) Then, we design an adaptive rollout sampling mechanism to dynamically adjust the sampling scale across different training stages based on historical pruning distributions, balancing exploration adequacy and computational efficiency. Experiments demonstrate that FastRL can be seamlessly integrated into GRPO, DAPO, and GSPO variants, achieving an average 2.07$\times$ training speedup on Geometry3K and GeoQA8K-R1V, along with an approximately 1.64\% improvement in average accuracy on visual reasoning benchmarks. Source codes will be available at this https URL .

</details>


### [333] [VLALight: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Traffic Signal Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36934)
*Pan Zhang,Siqi Lai,Kemu Dong,Hao Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VLALight是首个面向交通信号控制的端到端视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，直接从多视角路侧视频推理时空交通状态并生成协同信号相位决策。其采用两阶段监督冷启动训练（视觉感知+决策）+协同智能体强化学习，并引入自适应快/慢推理模式以平衡决策质量与推理开销，在七个真实交通流数据集上全面优于交通工程、RL及LLM/VLM基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有交通信号控制方法依赖手工构造的交通状态（如排队长度、车辆计数）或分离的感知模块，导致物理观测与控制决策之间存在鸿沟；同时现成的视觉语言模型缺乏交通时空推理能力，限制了从原始路侧视频进行端到端控制的可行性。

Method: VLALight基于Qwen3.5-4B构建，包含：(1)多目标时空交通感知模块，从四方向视频提取车道级车辆数、排队长度及变化量；(2)拓扑感知的协同感知，沿路网有向图路由邻接交叉口的感知结果（直接协调帧+邻居方向压力）；(3)两阶段监督冷启动——第一阶段学习视觉感知，第二阶段利用DeepSeek教师生成推理轨迹并按队列差异标注Fast/Slow模式；(4)协同智能体RL，采用GDPO式维度独立归一化融合局部奖励、网络奖励、格式奖励与推理成本惩罚，并通过人为平衡的Fast/Slow rollout实现自适应模式选择。

Result: 在济南（12路口）、杭州（16路口）、纽约（196路口）三个城市网络的7个真实交通流数据集上，VLALight在21项数据集-指标对比中取得16项最优，纽约网络AQL和AWT相对SOTA基线分别降低5.5–13.0%和6.7–12.1%；消融实验验证协同信息、网络级奖励、平衡Fast/Slow rollout的必要性；自适应推理使平均延迟降至3.936s（比Pure Slow低12.7%），且慢模式比例随队列负载从38.86%单调升至63.14%。

Conclusion: VLALight证明了VLA模型在物理交通信号控制中的可行性，通过端到端视觉输入+协同时空推理+自适应推理效率，在大规模城市路网中实现了优于现有交通工程、RL及LLM控制器的网络级交通效率，为真实部署中的视觉驱动交通控制奠定了基础。

Abstract: Traffic signal control (TSC) is essential for improving urban mobility and reducing congestion. Although roadside cameras are widely deployed at signalized intersections and provide rich visual observations of evolving traffic, existing TSC methods typically rely on manually engineered traffic states or separate perception modules, creating a gap between physical observations and control decisions. We present VLALight, the first vision-language-action (VLA) model for end-to-end traffic signal control from multi-view roadside videos. VLALight directly maps visual observations to coordinated signal actions through multi-target spatiotemporal traffic reasoning and topology-aware cooperative perception across intersections. To establish this capability, we develop a two-stage supervised cold-start training strategy for visual traffic understanding and signal decision-making, followed by cooperative agentic reinforcement learning that jointly optimizes local control and network-wide traffic efficiency. Furthermore, VLALight introduces adaptive fast and slow reasoning modes, enabling the policy to allocate deeper reasoning only when additional deliberation provides sufficient control benefits. Through balanced mode-aware rollouts and relative advantage optimization, VLALight learns to trade off decision quality and inference cost. Extensive experiments on seven real-world traffic-flow datasets across three urban networks demonstrate that VLALight consistently outperforms transportation-based, RL-based, and LLM/VLM-based baselines. Ablation studies validate the effectiveness of cooperative perception, network-level optimization, and adaptive reasoning. These results demonstrate the potential of VLA models for real-world physical traffic control. Our project is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [334] [CoEM: Empowering Long-Context Reasoning with Commit-on-Evidence Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36935)
*Jingguang Li,Yebo Wu,Zuyi Guo,Kailang Ma,Xianjie Dai,Han Zheng,Benwang Chen,Li Li,Can Rong,Heye Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CoEM提出了一种新的递归记忆机制，通过"承诺-基于证据"的策略，将固定上下文记忆预算划分为已提交记忆和待定证据集，允许在后续上下文明确相关性后再进行不可逆压缩，从而解决长上下文推理中过早压缩导致关键信息丢失的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有递归记忆方法在处理长上下文时面临"过早信息压缩"的关键缺陷：当证据在初次观察时看似无关，但后续上下文出现后才变得关键时，立即压缩会不可逆地丢弃这些重要信息。论文通过诊断分析发现32.03%-44.53%的多跳问答问题存在延迟证据相关性现象。

Method: CoEM将固定上下文记忆预算分为两部分：(1)已提交记忆M_t存储压缩事实；(2)待定集P_t保留原文片段。策略对新证据执行Promote、Keep、Drop三种操作，Keep允许证据保留直至后续上下文澄清其相关性。冻结的NLI验证器（DeBERTaV3-small）在承诺前检查事实是否有源支持。采用强化学习训练策略，结合步级证据奖励和最终答案奖励，并使用return-to-go机制将后续验证反馈传递给早期记忆决策。

Result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA和MuSiQue三个多跳问答基准上，使用Qwen3.5-4B和Qwen3.5-9B骨干网络，CoEM在所有上下文长度（50-6400文档）上均优于预算匹配的基线方法。在6400文档长输入下，CoEM（Qwen3.5-9B）相比最强基线ReMemR1提升10.4-11.4 F1点，且在128块证据间隔下比最强基线高25.3 F1点。验证器仅需4.3 ms/对的延迟（比Qwen3.5-9B验证器快约69倍），忠实度达97.2%。

Conclusion: CoEM通过将证据支持与相关性判断解耦，有效解决了长上下文推理中延迟证据相关性问题。核心贡献在于：自适应保留未解决证据直到后续上下文澄清、源验证确保记忆质量、步级证据奖励提供中间监督。实验证明长上下文记忆应同时决定"记住什么"和"何时压缩"，未来可扩展至代码和科学文档场景。

Abstract: Long-context reasoning is essential for complex and long-horizon tasks, yet the performance of large language models (LLMs) degrades as context length increases. Recent approaches address this by processing input chunk by chunk while maintaining a bounded textual memory in model context. However, premature information compression can discard critical details essential for subsequent reasoning. In this paper, we introduce Commit-on-Evidence Memory (CoEM), which learns when to convert source evidence into compact memory facts. Specifically, under a fixed context-memory budget, CoEM preserves potentially useful source excerpts verbatim in a pending set, allowing subsequent context to clarify their relevance before irreversible compression. As new context arrives, a learned policy revisits each pending excerpt and decides whether to promote it to the committed memory, retain it for further consideration, or discard it. A frozen verifier ensures proposed facts are accepted only if supported by retained excerpts and current context. To further guide effective memory management, we train this policy using reinforcement learning by combining fine-grained, step-level evidence rewards with final answer rewards. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CoEM consistently improves long-context reasoning. When evaluated on 6,400 documents long-context input, CoEM outperforms the strongest memory baseline by 10.4-11.4 F1 points on Qwen3.5-9B. Code repository: this https URL .

</details>


### [335] [SCA: Spatial Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning of GUI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36939)
*Shengtian Yang,Ziyu Xiong,Kaibing Yang,Guangfeng Cai,Yewen Li,Peng Jiang,Gai Kun,Qingpeng Cai,Lei Feng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出空间信用分配（SCA），一种针对GUI智能体分组强化学习的新型信用分配方法。SCA利用采样点击的屏幕坐标来细化组相对信用，解决了二元评估将空间上不同的失败点击视为相同以及全失败组无相对信号的问题。SCA包含两个分支：Residual（通过留一法预测混合命中组的奖励残差）和Prox（全失败组按距目标距离排序）。在ScreenSpot-Pro和多个动作预测基准上取得最佳RFT结果，并通过精确梯度分析验证了其机制有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的分组相对强化学习（如GRPO、RLOO）通过比较同一GUI状态下多个采样响应的奖励来改进GUI动作预测。然而，二元评估存在两个问题：(1)将空间上不同的失败点击视为相同，未利用点击位置的空间信息；(2)当所有采样点击都失败时，组优势为零，丢弃了有用的空间证据。这限制了强化微调在GUI任务中的效果。

Method: 方法核心：SCA基于采样点击的屏幕坐标，在三种奖励机制下路由信用分配：(1)混合命中组：SCA-Residual将坐标投影到四个轴（水平、垂直、两个对角线），用Theil-Sen估计器在每个轴上拟合留一坐标-奖励趋势，预测胜出响应并形成残差信用，与原始组优势混合；(2)全失败组：SCA-Prox使用到标注目标的指数衰减距离度量来排序点击，按接近度分配信用；(3)全命中组：保留原始组优势。空间参考仅用于构造训练更新，不改变部署策略。方法在控制合成设置下通过精确梯度分析（MSE、余弦相似度、范数比）验证更新方向的正确性。

Result: 主要结果：(1) GUI grounding：SCA-3B在ScreenSpot-Pro全部16个接地子列上超过GUI-R1，差异0.3-1.7个百分点；ScreenSpot-Pro十二子列算术平均26.1 vs GUI-R1 25.2；ScreenSpot Web Text 90.5±0.30，Desktop Text 94.8±0.28。(2) 动作预测：GUI-Act-Web GR 89.0±0.42，OmniAct-Web GR 77.0±0.45，OmniAct-Desktop GR 80.5±0.41；低级整体82.0±0.36；在十个低级动作预测指标上获得最佳RFT结果；GUI-Odyssey 66.0±0.52。(3) 精确梯度分析：SCA-Residual梯度MSE 0.14825（vs GRPO 0.16201），余弦相似度0.99985；Full SCA梯度MSE 0.14754，余弦相似度0.99997。(4) ScreenSpot-Pro六个领域均提升0.70-1.10个百分点，文本目标提升1.23点，图标目标提升0.48点。

Conclusion: SCA利用邻近rollout几何为GUI点击分配信用：Residual用交叉拟合残差处理混合命中组，Prox为全失败组提供接近度信号。在报告的离线评估中，三种子均值在接地和动作预测套件上均高于GUI-R1点估计。合成研究衡量了更新方向和误差。分支控制、在线交互和更大骨干模型留待未来评估。

Abstract: GUI agents automate tasks on digital devices by grounding language instructions in visual interfaces. Existing group-relative reinforcement learning improves GUI action prediction by comparing the rewards of multiple responses sampled from the same GUI state. However, binary evaluation treats spatially different failed clicks as identical and provides no relative signal when all sampled clicks fail. To address these limitations, we propose Spatial Credit Assignment (SCA), which uses the screen coordinates of sampled clicks to refine group-relative credit. Specifically, SCA predicts each held-out response's reward from the other responses in groups containing both successes and failures, then uses the prediction residual to adjust credit. When all sampled clicks fail, SCA instead orders them by distance to the annotated target. These spatial references are used only to construct the training update; the deployed policy remains unchanged. We evaluate whether this correction improves the policy update itself by comparing its error and directional alignment with the exact return gradient in a controlled synthetic study. Across GUI grounding and offline action-prediction benchmarks, SCA improves grounding across professional domains and achieves the strongest results among reinforcement-fine-tuned models on most action-prediction metrics, with consistent gains across the reported GUI suites.

</details>


### [336] [Dual-Channel Robust Group-Relative Policy Optimization via Advantage and Sequence-Weight Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36944)
*Zhongyi Li,Wan Tian,Xiang Xu,Yutian Xiao,Yikun Ban,Yijie Peng,Fuzhen Zhuang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RoVR-GSPO 提出了一种双通道鲁棒的 GSPO 优化器，分别在奖励通道（用 RoVR 鲁棒参考估计 + 有界残差信用）和比率通道（用可微的 SoftRoVR 聚合生成鲁棒序列权重）解决 GRPO 类方法中两类失效模式（极端奖励擦除干净响应间的优势对比、token 级对数比扰动改变序列权重与裁剪分支）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 GRPO/GSPO 类组相对策略优化方法在小样本统计下存在两类敏感性问题：(1) 奖励侧——一个极端奖励经过组内归一化后会使得所有干净响应的两两优势差趋于零；(2) 比率侧——局部 token 对数比扰动会改变序列级似然权重和裁剪分支。论文指出二者具有不同的设计自由度，但现有方法未将其区分开。

Method: RoVR-GSPO 包含两个独立通道。奖励通道：先用块状凸 M-估计（Barron α=1，pseudo-Huber）构造有界分数局部中心，再用复合分位数（tie-neutral，J0 中位约定）做外层一步校正，形成鲁棒参考 θ̂_RoVR；再用有界奇映射 χ_κ(u)=u/√(1+(u/κ)²) 限制单点杠杆并保留干净响应间的优势对比，得到 Â_i^credit。比率通道：把 token 对数比 ℓ_i,t 通过 SoftRoVR（有限温度 logistic 指标 H_γ + 平滑中位 smed_η 初始化 + 解算器迭代）可微地聚合成一个鲁棒序列权重 q_i^SoftRoVR = exp(SoftRoVR(ℓ))。理论部分给出了有限组鲁棒参考+信用稳定界（Theorem 4.1）、干净外层效率（Theorem 4.2，√(Bn) 渐近正态，外层因子 V_K→π/3 优于中位数 π/2）、SoftRoVR 的标定与裁剪分支稳定命题（Proposition 4.3），并讨论了块预算 B≥2q+1、n_min≥2s+1 的双层保护分辨率。

Result: 在三个下游任务上一致优于匹配条件下的 GSPO 基线：数学推理（Qwen3-4B-Base 与 OLMo-3-7B-Instruct，rule 与 InternLM2 两种奖励共 20 个设置下 RoVR-GSPO 的均值都更高，五项基准平均提升 2.08%/3.97% 与 1.27%/1.96%）；长文摘要 GovReport（ROUGE-1/2/L 双 backbone 都提升）；离线工具调用注释（最高验证 Total reward 1.924→2.009）。通道消融显示完整 RoVR-GSPO 优于仅 RoVR-Adv（奖励通道）和仅 SoftRoVR（比率通道）。受控扰动实验：在 α=16σ 的奖励污染下，鲁棒参考位移从 1.000σ 降到 0.060σ，有界信用将尺度膨胀从 28.194× 降到 1.911×、干净对比保留从 0.035 升到 0.520；在 20% 的连续 token 突发扰动下 SoftRoVR 把对数权重位移降低约 87%，强单点尖峰下降低约 26% 并降低剪裁翻转。标量参考估计器比较中 RoVR 在 Gaussian、t₃、点污染、整块污染下综合表现良好，外层因子 V_K=1.0691（K=9，理论）与经验 1.0747 吻合。

Conclusion: RoVR-GSPO 把组相对策略优化中的奖励优势与序列似然权重视为两个可独立分析、可独立替换的统计接口。块状 M-估计加 tie-neutral 复合分位数聚合给出鲁棒参考，有界信用映射在保留干净响应对比的同时控制单点杠杆，可微 SoftRoVR 聚合减少局部 token 扰动对序列权重与裁剪分支的影响。理论、通道消融与受控扰动共同支持鲁棒优势估计与序列权重估计是面向 LLM 后训练的一个实用统计接口。论文明确说明有界信用是代理选择而非无偏梯度，SoftRoVR 也非精确重要性比，部署仍需独立的奖励审计与分布外评估。

Abstract: Group-relative policy optimization relies on reward-derived advantages and sequence-level likelihood weights, both of which can be sensitive to localized outliers. Extreme rewards can collapse the contrast among clean responses after group normalization, while token-level log-ratio perturbations can alter sequence weights and clipping decisions. We introduce RoVR-GSPO, a dual-channel robust optimizer that addresses these failure modes separately. Its reward channel combines robust reference estimation with bounded residual credit, while its ratio channel uses differentiable SoftRoVR aggregation to construct robust sequence weights. We provide stability and efficiency analyses for both channels. Experiments on mathematical reasoning, long-context summarization, and tool-call annotation show consistent improvements over GSPO, while controlled perturbation studies demonstrate stronger robustness to reward contamination and token-ratio anomalies.

</details>


### [337] [REALHOP: Rethinking Multi-Hop Reasoning Evaluation via Behavioral Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36984)
*Jiawen Tao,Xiaokun Yuan,Yaoming Li,Chenxu Liu,Mengzhou Wu,Tong Yang,Maxm Pan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: REALHOP 指出当前多跳问答基准中"标注的推理链≠模型实际依赖的证据",通过行为审计指标 BNR 揭示这一鸿沟,并提出 diagnose-construct-verify 框架重建基准,使每个推理步骤成为回答所必需。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多跳QA基准假设正确答案意味着模型执行了标注的推理链,但模型可能通过记忆答案、更短路径或表层线索绕过关键证据,导致答案正确性无法证明真正的多跳推理能力。需要一种直接测量证据必要性的方法,并构建使每步推理都不可或缺的基准。

Method: 提出 BNR 指标:在 Full 正确样本上定向删除某个标注证据,观察答案是否无法恢复;采用 matched-background Control 区分证据特异性失败与一般删除敏感性。REALHOP 框架包含诊断(BNR审计)、构造(实体重绑、关系分解、添加竞争路径、事实路由至可追踪位置)和验证(结构/语义/行为检查)。在 MuSiQue、FRAMES、LongBench v2 三个场景适配。

Result: 五个现有基准 panel-mean BNR 仅 16.6–48.9%。REALHOP-MuSiQue(790对配对问题)将 panel-mean BNR 从 27.4% 提升至 94.4%,Full 准确率保持 68.5–83.5%。REALHOP-FRAMES BNR 达 88.9–89.9%。REALHOP-LongBench(216题)在 16 个模型上的多选准确率离散度从 13.9 扩展至 59.2 点,开放回答中 BNR 达 96.5–98.1%。消融表明竞争路径插入贡献了大部分难度提升和行为必要性提升。

Conclusion: 概念上连贯的推理链与正确的最终答案本身不足以证明多跳推理能力。验证每个目标 hop 的行为必要性应与测量答案准确性同等重要,作为多跳评估的基本设计准则。

Abstract: Complex questions often require multi-hop reasoning that connects facts distributed across sources or distant regions of a long context through intermediate steps. Benchmarks commonly evaluate this ability with questions built around predefined reasoning chains, treating a correct answer as evidence that the intended composition was used. Yet answer correctness alone leaves open whether success depends on the evidence associated with each intended step: models may instead rely on memorized associations, shorter paths, or partial evidence. We examine this dependence using the Behavioral Necessity Rate (BNR), which measures how often targeted evidence removal prevents answer recovery on initially correct instances. Across five existing benchmarks, panel-mean BNR ranges from 16.6% to 48.9%, exposing a substantial gap between annotated structure and observed dependence. Guided by this diagnosis, we introduce REALHOP, a diagnose-construct-verify framework that rebinds entities, factorizes selected relations, adds complete competing paths, and places evidence at traceable locations. Structural and semantic checks precede freezing; behavioral interventions follow. On 790 paired MuSiQue questions, REALHOP raises panel-mean BNR from 27.4% to 94.4% while retaining high Full accuracy. It also yields high BNR on REALHOP-FRAMES and REALHOP-LONGBENCH. On 216 long-context questions, the matched multiple-choice spread across 16 models grows from 13.9 to 59.2 points and persists under repeated open-ended evaluation. Together, these results show that a conceptually coherent chain and a correct final answer do not by themselves establish multi-hop reasoning. Verifying that success depends on every intended hop is therefore as fundamental to multi-hop evaluation as measuring answer accuracy itself.

</details>


### [338] [CF-LoRA: Decoupled Factor Aggregation and Adaptation-Aware Client Clustering for Federated LoRA Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36986)
*Mengjun Yi,Langxing Yang,Suhan Guo,Furao Shen,Jian Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CF-LoRA是一个用于联邦LoRA微调的聚类框架，通过解耦因子聚合（仅在每个阶段聚合A或B其中一个矩阵）和基于B矩阵相似度的自适应客户端聚类，联合解决了结构聚合失配和统计协作问题，在语言和视觉任务上以单因子通信开销实现了最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦LoRA微调在非IID数据下面临两类根本性不匹配：(1)结构聚合失配——独立平均客户端的LoRA因子A和B后相乘会产生虚假的跨客户端乘积B_i·A_j（i≠j），与理想的聚合更新不一致；(2)统计协作失配——在异构数据下强制使用单一全局适配器会导致负迁移。现有方法如FFA-LoRA、FedEx-LoRA只解决聚合一致性问题，FedSA-LoRA、PACFL只解决异构性问题，缺乏联合解决方案。

Method: CF-LoRA是一个三阶段框架：(I)全局A聚合与本地B个性化（仅上传聚合A，B保持本地，进行T₁轮）；(II)基于学习到的B矩阵余弦相似度，采用层次聚类将客户端划分为K个簇；(III)簇内联邦微调——冻结共享的A，仅在簇内聚合B矩阵，再进行T₂轮。每个阶段仅聚合一个低秩因子，避免了两个因子独立平均后相乘带来的失配。

Result: 在RoBERTa-base（5个GLUE数据集）和ViT-B/16（4个视觉数据集）上的实验表明，CF-LoRA在所有数据集上均达到最高平均准确率（语言90.51%，视觉84.77%），相比FL-LoRA提升1.6-3.3个百分点，且每轮仅传输一个LoRA因子（通信开销降低50%）；在强异构（α=0.1）和大规模联邦（50客户端）下保持鲁棒；层次聚类优于K-means、谱聚类和随机分组。

Conclusion: CF-LoRA通过解耦因子聚合和基于B的自适应聚类有效解决了联邦LoRA微调中的双重不匹配问题，在跨模态任务上以单因子通信开销取得了最优精度-通信权衡；但当前使用预定义簇数K和单次聚类，未来可探索自适应聚类方法。

Abstract: Federated LoRA fine-tuning enables parameter-efficient adaptation of pre-trained models without sharing private data, but suffers from two fundamental mismatches under heterogeneous client data: a structural aggregation mismatch caused by independently averaging LoRA factors, and a statistical collaboration mismatch caused by enforcing a single global adapter across divergent clients. To address these issues, we propose CF-LoRA, a clustered federated LoRA fine-tuning framework that combines decoupled factor aggregation with adaptation-aware client clustering. CF-LoRA first learns a globally shared $A$ factor while retaining personalized $B_i$ factors, then identifies clients with similar adaptation patterns based on the cosine similarity of their learned $B_i$ factors, and finally performs intra-cluster $B$-factor aggregation with a frozen $A$ factor. By decoupling LoRA factor aggregation, CF-LoRA preserves the low-rank structure and mitigates the structural aggregation mismatch, while adaptation-aware clustering promotes collaboration among clients with similar adaptation patterns and reduces negative transfer caused by statistical heterogeneity. Experiments on four language tasks and four vision datasets with RoBERTa and ViT show that CF-LoRA achieves the highest average accuracy in both modalities while communicating only one LoRA factor per optimization round.

</details>


### [339] [ImbalancE: Inference-Time Latent Search Against Degree Imbalance in Link Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36996)
*Alberto Bernardi,Luca Costabello,Christophe Gueret*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为ImbalancE的推理时潜在搜索方法，用于缓解知识图谱嵌入（KGE）模型在链接预测中因实体间度（degree）不均衡导致的低度实体预测质量低下问题。该方法在推理阶段通过结合训练上下文和外部预言机（如LLM）信息，对锚定实体及相关实体嵌入进行细粒度微调，在多个基准数据集上显著提升了高度不平衡三元组的预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有KGE模型在链接预测任务中，聚合指标虽高，但对低度实体的预测质量极差。已有研究将此问题归因于关系类型或度偏差，但缺乏系统性定义和有效解决方案。该研究旨在系统性地揭示"度不均衡"（degree imbalance）问题——即测试三元组中头尾实体度差异对预测质量的影响——并提出一种推理时（无需重新训练）的轻量级优化方法来解决此问题。

Method: 1. **问题定义**：提出归一化度差异度量Δ̂，定量刻画三元组中头尾实体的度不均衡程度，并揭示低度实体存在两种学习失效模式：过拟合和无法收敛。
2. **ImbalancE方法**：在预训练KGE模型之上，对每个查询q=(s,p,?)进行推理时潜在搜索，优化一个双项损失函数：
   - **训练上下文项（Training Context Term）**：利用训练集中与查询共享锚点实体和关系的已知三元组𝒞_q，仅优化锚点实体嵌入，使其更好地适配该查询。
   - **预言机增强项（Oracle-Enhanced Term）**：利用外部预言机（如基于LLM编码实体描述的相似度）生成额外的候选三元组Ω_q，同时优化锚点和目标实体嵌入，将低度目标实体的表征偏向查询。
3. **技术细节**：冻结关系嵌入和训练上下文目标实体嵌入，无需负采样，作为正则化器防止嵌入坍塌。算法在T次迭代内通过梯度更新完成。

Result: 在FB15k-237、WN18RR、YAGO3-10三个基准数据集上的实验表明：
- **FB15k-237**：ImbalancE使ComplEx-N3和RotatE在High-Low split上MRR提升超过4倍（H@10从0.06→0.28），Low-High split上提升约2-3倍。
- **WN18RR**：各指标均有一致提升，但因度极化程度较低，改善幅度有限。
- **YAGO3-10**：因预言机仅用实体标签（缺少描述）导致质量受限，仅H@10有提升。
- **基线对比**：显著优于KG-Mixup，并在高度不平衡三元组上匹配甚至超越计算量远大的CSProm-KG。
- **消融实验**：两项损失互补，预言机项贡献更大。
- **效率**：单查询约0.9-1.4秒，全测试集440秒（FB15k-237），远低于重新训练（935秒）。
- **普适性**：适用于TransE、DistMult、ComplEx、RotatE等多种KGE模型；NBFNet因实体嵌入纠缠无法受益。
- **稳定性**：100轮内无坍塌，不同种子结果一致。

Conclusion: 该研究系统揭示了KGE模型中度不均衡导致的双重学习失效问题（低度实体过拟合与无法收敛），并提出ImbalancE作为首个应用于KGE模型的推理时潜在搜索方法。该方法作为预训练模型的插件，无需重新训练，计算开销极低，能在关键的高度不平衡三元组上显著提升预测质量，使轻量级KGE模型达到与计算密集型LLM增强方法相当的水平，为推荐系统等关注长尾实体的实际应用提供了可靠解决方案。

Abstract: Knowledge Graph Embedding models have been extensively used to learn representations of entities and relations in Knowledge Graphs for predicting missing links. However, the quality of the learned representations varies a lot across different areas of the graph. If previous research has loosely linked the problem to relation types or degree bias, we show that it is more widespread and it correlates with the degree imbalance of the entities in test triples. In particular, the prediction of a target entity that has a degree much smaller than the degree of the anchor entity is extremely problematic. This is critical in recommender systems and other use cases, where these triples represent important corner cases. To address this issue, we propose an inference-time latent search optimization method capable of significantly improving model predictions on the most imbalanced triples. Built on top of a pre-trained model, it explores the embedding space at evaluation time, blending known and out-of-band information to mitigate the degree imbalance bias. We show the value of our approach on imbalanced triples from common benchmark datasets, where we outperform conventional methods, opening the door to the successful adoption of Knowledge Graph Embedding models on these critical corner cases.

</details>


### [340] [CADOC: Cache-Aware Dynamic Object Context for Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37012)
*Junjie Yao,Zhangchen Zhou,Zhi-Qin John Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 CADOC（Cache-Aware Dynamic Object Context），一种面向长程智能体的在线可恢复上下文管理算法。该算法通过将结构化对象替换为紧凑的检索 Card 来缩短提示词长度，并在批量提交时权衡累积等待成本与共享缓存重建成本，从而在不破坏前缀缓存复用的前提下实现高效压缩。实验表明，CADOC 在多个基准上比其他策略平均降低约 40% 的输入成本，同时保持接近完整上下文的任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程智能体面临上下文瓶颈问题：每次请求需重新发送历史记录、上下文窗口限制任务长度、长历史降低推理质量。现有的可恢复压缩方法依赖对未来重用量的预测或预设时间间隔，无法仅依据当前可观测信息做出最优决策。此外，立即替换虽能减少 token，但可能因破坏前缀缓存而实际增加成本。

Method: CADOC 的核心是将结构化对象替换为可按需检索原始内容的 Card，并引入一种基于经济订货量（EOQ）权衡的批量调度规则。具体而言：算法维护一个"待处理序列"，通过"经济穿越"条件 W_t + w_r·G_t ≥ Q_t 决定何时批量提交替换，其中 W_t 为累积等待成本、G_t 为潜在缩短量、Q_t 为共享缓存重建成本。该规则在平稳假设下可恢复最优整数批量大小，在线运行无需未来信息或额外 LLM 调用。文章还证明了该规则在等待-建立目标下具有 2-竞争的有限时界界。

Result: 在固定历史回放实验中，CADOC 在所有热尾设置（h∈{2,4,8,16}）下均取得最低聚合输入成本，相对完整上下文节省 11.56%–30.65%，并优于固定批量、立即替换和 token 阈值等基线。在三条基准链（Terminal-Bench 2.1、LongMemEval-V2、SWE-bench）的端到端评估中，CADOC 降低输入成本 34.12%–47.13%、输入 token 44.72%–80.60%，任务完成率仅下降最多 4 个百分点。在不同缓存读权重（w_r∈{0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1}）的敏感性测试中，CADOC 在 15 种基准-权重组合中均达到最低成本。

Conclusion: CADOC 提供了一种基于成本推导的可压缩上下文管理方法，证明高效压缩不仅取决于缩短提示词，还取决于调度编辑以保留缓存复用。该算法无需未来信息、LLM 调度调用或逐场景批量大小调优，在保持接近完整上下文性能的同时显著降低长程智能体的输入成本，为长程上下文管理开辟了新的思路。

Abstract: For a long-horizon agent, context is the bottleneck: the history is resent with every request, the window caps task length, and reasoning degrades as the history grows. Replacing structured objects with compact retrieval Cards shortens the prompt and keeps the exact originals retrievable, but editing the history can break prefix-cache reuse, and prior recoverable methods time their edits by forecasts of future reuse or by preset intervals. We propose CADOC (Cache-Aware Dynamic Object Context), an online algorithm that replaces structured objects with compact Cards while preserving exact, on-demand retrieval of their original contents. CADOC schedules replacements in batches by balancing accumulated waiting cost against shared cache-reconstruction cost. Its scheduling rule follows from an economic order quantity trade-off, recovers the optimal integer batch under stationary assumptions. Across evaluation, CADOC consistently achieves the lowest aggregate input cost among the compared configurations, which reduces input cost by approximately 40\% on average while maintaining task performance close to full context. CADOC thus provides a cost-derived approach to compressible context management, demonstrating that efficient compression depends not only on shortening prompts but also on scheduling edits to preserve cache reuse.

</details>


### [341] [Physics-Informed Multi-Agent Coordination for Hospital Patient Flow Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37022)
*Guoqing Zhang,Rafik Hadfi,Takayuki Ito*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"物理信息驱动的多智能体协调"（Physics-Informed Multi-Agent Coordination）的框架，将基于MIMIC-IV真实数据校准的BCMP排队网络拓扑作为物理先验，嵌入到去中心化多智能体强化学习（Dec-POMDP）架构中，用于医院患者流转优化。框架通过拓扑感知的动作指纹通信协议和空间分层奖励分解机制实现科室间的协作路由与动态服务扩容，在显著降低系统累积延迟的同时保持了临床安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医院各科室本质上是去中心化的自治单元，拥有局部观测、异构资源和相互冲突的运营目标（急诊科追求快速分流，ICU需保留呼吸机，普通病房需稳定床位）。传统的集中式启发式调度或集中式强化学习方法难以适应医院治理的去中心化结构。同时，经典BCMP排队网络的解析模型基于稳态假设和固定路由矩阵，在状态依赖的真实动态（有限床位导致的物理阻塞）下其乘积形式解不再成立。因此需要一种既能保留排队理论结构知识、又能适应去中心化动态决策的协调方法。

Method: 1) **物理先验层**：基于MIMIC-IV约6万例住院数据校准开放BCMP排队网络拓扑，确定M个科室节点、K个患者类别、转移概率矩阵P、基础服务率μ和床位容量c_i*（通过Erlang-C与Halfin-Whitt联合计算），同时定义Foster-Lyapunov稳定约束ρ_i<1。2) **Dec-POMDP建模**：每个科室作为自主智能体，观测为5维局部特征（占用率、队列深度、可用容量、SLA警告、当前加速因子）。动作空间为离散双通道——α策略（4级出院加速0~15%）和λ策略（5级准入调控0~100%）。3) **拓扑感知通信**：智能体沿BCMP有向边向邻居广播动作指纹（EMA平滑的策略分布FP_i），不进行全局通信，避免O(M²)开销。4) **空间分层奖励**：R_i = ω_local·R_local + ω_neighbor·R_neighbor + ω_global·R_global，分别对齐科室效率、抑制跨科室转嫁、锚定全局延迟减少。5) **安全约束**：基于MIMIC-IV历史转科路径构建专家动作掩码，将不符合临床规程的转科动作屏蔽。算法采用CTDE架构下的MA2C（Mean-field Advantage Actor-Critic）。

Result: 在1.25倍需求冲击下的4000小时仿真中：协作MA2C（随机执行）将累积延迟降至2081.2±571.7小时，相比静态Markov基线（117478.1小时）降低约56倍，独立A2C贪婪执行甚至崩溃至463038.7±243695.6小时。结构消融实验证实：禁用协作路由(λ策略)导致延迟发散至226231小时；禁用动作指纹通信使延迟增至3024.5小时；禁用动态加速使延迟增至3990.8小时。安全性方面，MA2C将乒乓转科率从历史7.375%降至1.727~1.736%，ICU过早出院率从2.585%降至约0.21%。

Conclusion: 该框架成功将经典排队理论的结构知识（拓扑、容量边界）与去中心化多智能体学习的动态适应性相结合，证明了物理信息驱动先验在安全关键医疗调度中的价值——它既约束了探索空间保证临床安全，又通过拓扑通信和分层奖励使智能体涌现出协作路由协商行为，将饱和科室推回排队论中ρ_i远小于1的线性稳定区。未来工作将引入基于LLM的认知智能体来模拟临床医师实时行为与工作负荷动态，以弥合仿真到现实的差距。

Abstract: Efficient patient flow coordination across autonomous hospital departments is critical for mitigating overcrowding and balancing resource utilization. While classical queueing theory, specifically open Baskett--Chandy--Muntz--Palacios (BCMP) networks, provides an interpretable mathematical topology for healthcare operations, analytical models rely on stationary assumptions and fixed routing matrices that degrade under state-dependent real-world dynamics. Conversely, centralized reinforcement learning approaches struggle to accommodate the decentralized structure of hospital governance, where individual clinical departments function with localized observations, heterogeneous resources, and divergent operational objectives. In this paper, we present a Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) framework titled \emph{Physics-Informed Multi-Agent Coordination}, which embeds empirically calibrated BCMP queueing topologies as physical priors within a decentralized multi-agent reinforcement learning architecture. Formulated as a Decentralized Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (Dec-POMDP) under coupled resource constraints, our method enables autonomous departmental agents to cooperatively negotiate patient routing and dynamic service scaling. To mitigate environmental non-stationarity without inducing excessive communication overhead, agents exchange localized action fingerprints along network edges and optimize a spatially decomposed reward structure. Empirical evaluations driven by real-world MIMIC-IV patient trajectories indicate that this cooperative multi-agent approach substantially reduces cumulative system delay compared to static Markovian approximations, heuristic dispatching, and independent multi-agent baselines, while maintaining clinical safety constraints.

</details>


### [342] [Language as the Interface: Foundation-Model Contrastive Learning Links Transcriptomes and Electrophysiology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37024)
*Junbo Shen,Jinying Gao,Bo Lei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出LangPatch框架，以冻结的通用文本编码器作为接口，通过对比学习将预训练的基因语言表征（GenePT）与电生理特征对齐，实现跨模态神经数据的整合与跨脑区、跨物种迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经科学领域需要构建多模态基础模型来整合转录组与电生理数据，但现有方法要么依赖从头训练耦合编码器（如JAMIE），无法迁移知识；要么对单细胞基础模型进行大规模权重微调，而Patch-seq队列数据规模太小（10³–4×10³细胞），微调困难。本文旨在利用冻结的预训练基因语言表征作为先验，以语言作为跨模态接口解决低资源场景下的对齐问题。

Method: LangPatch将基因描述（GenePT嵌入）与电生理特征的文本化表述（语言化profile）通过同一个冻结的通用文本编码器（OpenAI text-embedding-3-large，3072维）编码到同一空间。基因侧通过一个0.4M参数的上下文适配器（基于训练集的全局、家族、层级统计条件化的门控残差）调整基因先验；细胞表征为适应后基因向量的表达加权平均。电生理侧通过确定性文本化（特征名+单位+分位数标签+profile token）后由同一编码器嵌入。两侧通过仿射投影层与对称InfoNCE对比损失对齐，加上辅助回归正则项。不更新编码器权重。

Result: 在三个Patch-seq队列（小鼠视觉皮层3,654细胞、小鼠运动皮层1,208细胞、人类皮层612细胞）上，LangPatch在转录组→电生理预测中取得最高平均Pearson r（视觉0.522、运动0.520、人类0.414），优于JAMIE、Geneformer、UCE、Nicheformer等基线。跨模态对齐FOSCTTM降至0.107/0.135（视觉/运动，vs JAMIE 0.208/0.222）。反向从电生理预测转录组身份（家族macro-F1 0.779/0.710）也优于基线。跨脑区零样本迁移保留70–71%相关性，鼠→人迁移保留47%（急性切片58%），11/11跨区概念和18–20/25跨物种概念超过排列零。基因归因分析显示优先基因富集细胞类型标志和离子通道基因。

Conclusion: 冻结的通用语言模型可以作为转录组与电生理之间的共享几何接口。LangPatch为多模态神经科学基础模型提供了构建模块：一次训练得到的表示可同时服务于未被patch的图谱细胞和未被测序的记录细胞，原则上还可扩展到其他可语言化的模态。但证据局限于两个小鼠皮层区和一个主要人类队列，且依赖外部文本嵌入API。

Abstract: Integrating transcriptomic and electrophysiological data is essential for building multimodal foundation models for neuroscience. Patch-seq provides paired measurements of gene expression and intrinsic electrophysiology from the same neuron, establishing a basis for training cross-modal models. Here we introduce LangPatch, a foundation-model-based contrastive learning framework that uses paired Patch-seq data to align pretrained GenePT representations with electrophysiological phenotypes through a language-based interface. Gene descriptions and verbalized electrophysiological profiles are embedded by the same frozen text encoder. A context adapter and projection modules connect the modalities through paired contrastive learning. Across mouse visual, mouse motor, and human cortical cohorts, LangPatch achieves the highest mean transcriptome-to-electrophysiology prediction correlation among the evaluated foundation-model and representation-learning methods. It also improves held-out cross-modal alignment in the two mouse cohorts (FOSCTTM 0.107/0.135 vs. 0.208/0.222 for JAMIE, an existing cross-modal Patch-seq imputation method). It predicts transcriptomic family, type, cortical layer, and marker-gene expression from electrophysiology, exceeding other baselines on most endpoints. More importantly, the method transfers across brain areas and species: a model trained on mouse visual cortex predicts electrophysiology in motor cortex with approximately 70% correlation retention and in human cortex with 47% (58% on acute-slice recordings). Together, these results demonstrate alignment between molecular and functional representations of neurons, providing a building block for multimodal foundation models in neuroscience.

</details>


### [343] [AnyAct: Universal Action for Self-Evolving Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37025)
*Lingrui Xu,Yangqin Jiang,Jiachang Zhang,Xubin Ren,Chao Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AnyAct 提出了一种面向开放世界智能体的通用动作层，通过层次化渐进检索、测试时可靠性演化与异构观测接地等机制，统一管理大规模、动态、异构的工具生态，平衡任务成功率与执行成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对开放世界 AI 代理面临的三大核心挑战：工具生态规模庞大超出 LLM 上下文窗口（scale dilemma）、工具质量因更新或故障而波动（non-stationarity）、反馈格式异构（pixels、文本、结构化数据）形成信息壁垒（heterogeneity）。现有方法依赖固定动作集或缺乏动态可靠性感知，无法从经验中演化动作空间，难以在成功率与效率之间取得最优权衡。

Method: AnyAct 的核心设计聚焦两大目标：（1）构建自演化的动作空间——通过层次化渐进检索（服务器级 LLM 推理 + 工具级 BM25 + 语义重排序）实现粗到细的过滤，并在测试时根据执行反馈（近期成功率 + 连续失败计数）更新每个动作的可靠性分数，对不可靠动作进行剪枝；（2）实现可靠性感知的动作编排——通过异构观测接地模块，使用 VLM 将 GUI 截图解析为机器可读的知识，与文本/结构化反馈一起整合到统一的上下文表示中。动作空间混合原子动作（GUI/shell）与语义动作（MCP API），并以最大化成功率同时惩罚执行步数为优化目标。

Result: 在 LiveMCPBench 上，AnyAct 在 Claude-Sonnet-4、DeepSeek-V3、DeepSeek-R1、Qwen3-235B 四种基座模型上均取得 SOTA，整体准确率分别达 93.55%、84.95%、78.49%、77.42%，相比 Naive 基线提升显著，对原生能力较弱的模型提升幅度最大。在新建的 OSMCP 基准上，AnyAct 以仅 50 步达到 77.27% 的总体成功率，优于使用 100-150 步的多数竞争对手；在 LibreOffice Calc、GIMP、Impress、Writer 等多个应用上均取得最佳表现。消融实验验证了检索模块与演化模块的必要性，鲁棒性分析显示在描述噪声扰动下检索 Top-10 工具的稳定性良好。

Conclusion: AnyAct 作为首个统一的通用动作层，有效解决了大规模、动态、异构工具生态系统下代理的三个核心挑战，能够自适应构建并演化动作空间，鲁棒地编排异构动作，在任务成功率与执行效率之间实现良好平衡。该方法对基座 LLM 能力要求较低，并贡献了用于多粒度动作协作评估的 OSMCP 基准，填补了该领域的评估空白。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) advance, AI agents are increasingly deployed in open-world environments to tackle complex sequential tasks (e.g., document processing, cross-application collaboration), relying heavily on actions ranging from GUI operations to semantic APIs. However, three core challenges persist: the "scale dilemma" of massive tool ecosystems exceeding LLM context windows, the "non-stationarity" of tool quality due to updates or outages, and the "heterogeneity" of feedback formats (pixels, text, structured data) creating information silos. To address these, we propose AnyAct, a universal action layer that unifies available capabilities into a self-evolving action space, enabling agents to operate efficiently and reliably in large-scale, dynamic tool ecosystems. AnyAct's core design focuses on two objectives: constructing this action space via hierarchical progressive retrieval (filtering task-relevant actions) and test-time reliability evolution (pruning unreliable actions), and enabling reliability-aware action orchestration through a heterogeneous observation grounding module that unifies multi-modal feedback. Additionally, it defines a hybrid action space (primitive + semantic actions) and optimizes for a balance between task success rate and execution cost. Evaluations on LiveMCPBench and OSMCP (a new benchmark we developed for multi-granularity action collaboration) demonstrate state-of-the-art performance. AnyAct delivers substantial performance gains over baseline methods across various LLM base models on LiveMCPBench and improvements are particularly notable for models with constrained native capabilities. On OSMCP, it achieves 77.27% overall success with only 50 steps, which is half the steps required by most competitors.

</details>


### [344] [Beyond Low-Rank Parameterization: Narrowing the Gap Between LoRA and Full Fine-Tuning via Gradient Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37027)
*Yihao Ouyang,Shiwei Li,Haozhao Wang,Xiandi Luo,Zhuoqi Hu,Jinglun Yu,Yichen Li,Ruixuan Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 GDLoRA（梯度分解低秩适配）方法，通过刻画 LoRA 参数化诱导的切空间，将完整权重梯度正交分解为切向分量和法向分量，并将法向梯度直接用于更新基权重，同时保留 LoRA 因子的标准 AdamW 优化。该方法在不增加优化器状态内存的前提下，在 NLU、数学推理、常识推理和图像分类任务上缩小了 LoRA 与全量微调之间的性能差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA 等参数高效方法与全量微调之间存在性能差距。现有 LoRA 变体主要改进初始化或低秩因子优化，但其一阶权重空间更新方向受限于当前参数化所能表达的空间。本文旨在显式恢复并利用当前 LoRA 参数化无法表达的正交梯度分量。

Method: 1. 刻画 LoRA 可访问梯度空间，证明其等价于当前 LoRA 参数化诱导的切空间 T_LoRA。2. 将完整权重梯度 G 正交分解为切向分量 G_∥（在切空间内）和法向分量 G_⊥（垂直于切空间）。3. GDLoRA 从前向激活和反向信号重建完整梯度，提取法向分量 G_⊥（经 1/N 归一化）用于直接更新基权重，同时 LoRA 因子 A、B 保留标准 AdamW 优化。投影基 U、V 由当前因子的 QR 分解构造，无需对完整梯度做 SVD。该方法不引入基权重的动量或方差缓冲，保持 LoRA 的优化器状态内存预算。

Result: 在 RoBERTa（GLUE）、Llama-3-8B（数学推理 6 任务）、Gemma-7B（常识推理 8 任务）和 ViT（图像分类 8 数据集）上，GDLoRA 一致优于标准 LoRA 和其他变体（PiSSA、DoRA、rsLoRA、Fira、LoRA-GA、LoRA-Pro）。相比 LoRA 平均提升 2–4 个百分点；将 Llama-3-8B 数学推理上 LoRA-FFT 差距从 3.12 缩小到 0.62 个百分点。内存方面，GDLoRA 仅比 LoRA 多用 5.9% 显存（21.6 GB vs LoRA），相比 FFT 减少 65%。

Conclusion: GDLoRA 通过将法向梯度直接应用于基权重，提供了标准 LoRA 一阶优化方向之外的互补梯度信息，在保持 LoRA 优化器状态内存优势的同时显著缩小了与全量微调的性能差距。该方法可解释性强，对基权重学习率不敏感，并在多种模型架构和任务上一致有效。

Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a widely used approach to parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), yet a performance gap can remain relative to full fine-tuning (FFT). Many LoRA variants improve the initialization or optimization of low-rank factors. At each training step, however, their first-order weight-space directions are constrained by the current parameterization. We characterize the corresponding LoRA-accessible gradient space and show that it coincides with the tangent space induced by the current LoRA parameterization. This characterization yields an orthogonal decomposition of the full weight gradient at the current model parameters. We term the component orthogonal to this space the normal gradient. Based on this decomposition, we propose GDLoRA (Gradient-Decomposed Low-Rank Adaptation). GDLoRA reconstructs the full weight gradient from forward activations and backward signals, extracts its normal component, and directly updates the base weights with this component, while retaining standard AdamW optimization for the LoRA factors. GDLoRA incorporates complementary normal gradients without increasing standard LoRA's optimizer-state memory budget under matched adapter and optimizer configurations. Experiments on natural language understanding, mathematical reasoning, commonsense reasoning, and image classification show that GDLoRA consistently improves over LoRA and narrows the performance gap to FFT. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [345] [FedLAFP: Low-Rank Aggregation Meets Full-Rank Personalization in Federated Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37033)
*Mengjun Yi,Huaian Gu,Yinghao Ai,Furao Shen,Jian Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FedLAFP提出了一种角色感知的联邦参数高效微调框架，将紧凑的共享LoRA分支用于跨客户端聚合，将客户端私有的全秩RandLoRA分支用于本地个性化适配，通过客户端和层级特定的融合权重平衡两者，仅通信共享部分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦个性化方法通常对共享和私有适配采用相同的低秩结构，忽视了共享分支需要紧凑且聚合友好、私有分支需要充足表达能力以捕获客户端特异性这一根本差异，导致在统计异构场景下个性化能力受限。

Method: FedLAFP采用非对称双分支设计：(1) 共享LoRA分支（低秩A·B分解）通过服务器FedAvg聚合；(2) 私有RandLoRA分支基于固定随机低秩基与可学习对角缩放矩阵组合，实现全秩能力更新且无需通信；(3) 客户端和层级特定的logits经softmax生成融合权重自适应组合两分支输出；(4) 受控线性回归实验验证LoRA聚合对齐性更好、RandLoRA恢复客户端残差更准的角色分配合理性。

Result: 在四个视觉识别基准（DTD、Oxford Pets、SUN397、UCF101）上FedLAFP均取得最佳准确率，平均个性化准确率达86.93%，超过最强基线1.30个百分点；在GLUE语言任务（MRPC、SST-2）上同样优于基线；消融研究确认LoRA共享+RandLoRA私有的角色分配最优，客户端-层级融合优于其他融合策略；在不同异构程度下均稳定优于FedLoRA。

Conclusion: FedLAFP通过角色感知设计有效解决了联邦异构场景下共享与私有适配的结构冲突，证明了非对称适配器分配的有效性；未来工作将扩展至更大模型、考虑资源异构、引入隐私保护聚合以及自动分配共享/私有容量。

Abstract: Federated parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables clients to adapt pre-trained models without sharing raw data or communicating the full model, but statistical heterogeneity makes a single global adapter insufficient for personalized prediction. Existing personalized methods typically use the same low-rank structure for both shared and private adaptation, overlooking their distinct requirements for aggregation and personalization. We propose FedLAFP, a role-aware framework that couples a compact, globally aggregated LoRA branch with a client-private, full-rank-capable RandLoRA branch. The shared branch provides an efficient interface for transferring common knowledge, whereas the private branch combines fixed random low-rank bases with learned scaling coefficients to provide expressive client-specific adaptation without additional communication. Client- and layer-specific mixing coefficients jointly fuse the two branches, and only the shared LoRA parameters are exchanged. A controlled linear study supports this role assignment: LoRA yields more aligned client updates and lower aggregation error, while RandLoRA more accurately recovers client-specific residuals. Experiments across four visual recognition benchmarks show that FedLAFP consistently outperforms local-only and federated LoRA baselines, achieving an average personalized accuracy of $86.93\%$ and exceeding the best baseline average by $1.30$ percentage points.

</details>


### [346] [Watch-Think-Interact: Bootstrapping Long-Horizon Multi-Turn Streaming Video Reasoning with Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37035)
*Ziheng Huang,Yicheng Bao,Xueheng Li,Zhenkun Gao,Bangwei Liu,Kunquan Li,Yuxiang Shen,Bangyan Li,Xuejiao Wang,Changbo Wang,Gaoqi He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Watch-Think-Interact (WTI) 提出了一种用于长视野多轮流式视频推理的闭环框架，通过"主动窗口感知 + 时间索引紧凑记忆 + 选择性源视频回溯"机制解决现有方法因前向压缩丢失证据而无法恢复的问题，并配套构建了 WTI-82K 数据集与 Stream-GDPO 轨迹级强化学习方法，在流式视频基准上刷新开源 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流式视频模型在固定上下文预算下，依赖前向压缩构建在线状态。当后续问题揭示出先前被压缩丢弃的视觉细节的相关性时，这些细节已不可恢复，状态本身无法重建被忽略的证据。

Method: 三方面：1）WTI 闭环推理框架——维护紧凑自然语言记忆（带源视频时间区间标签），结合 8 块活动视觉窗口与选择性回溯（每次至多回溯 4 个已观察块，不推进流），策略可在"沉默/回答/回溯"之间决策，回溯后在同一时间步重新决策；2）WTI-82K 数据——82,335 个带时间戳的问题组织为 4,812 条因果对齐的多轮轨迹，覆盖 Real-Time、Backward Tracing、Proactive 三类交互；3）Stream-GDPO 强化学习——扩展 GDPO，对完整多轮 rollout 做轨迹级优化，对 outcome/format/recall/memory 四类奖励分别归一化后再聚合。训练分两阶段：掩码 SFT 冷启动交互协议，Stream-GDPO 优化完整滚动决策。

Result: 在 OVO-Bench 上达到 73.6% 加权总体准确率（开源流式模型 SOTA，其中 Real-Time 76.9%、Backward 70.0%、Forward 73.4%，均领先）；在 StreamingBench 上达到 83.3%（超越 VST-7B 79.5%）；离线长视频基准上 Video-MME 66.9%、MLVU 69.9%、LongVideoBench 62.9%，整体保持强劲。组件消融显示记忆与回溯互补（去掉回溯后 OVO-BT 从 73.4% 降至 55.5%，去掉记忆降至 62.8%，仅记忆仅 48.2%）。

Conclusion: WTI 通过因果对齐的紧凑记忆与源视频选择性回溯，实现了在固定上下文预算下对长视野流式视频的可恢复推理；Stream-GDPO 的轨迹级优化能有效对齐"早期动作影响后续状态"的流式决策特性，在流式和离线长视频任务上均表现优异，确立了新的开源最优水平。

Abstract: Streaming video assistance requires models to answer asynchronous questions from an observed prefix under a fixed context budget. Existing approaches model response timing or compress history, but an online state formed before future questions are known can omit visual details before later questions reveal their relevance; the retained state alone cannot recover them. We introduce Watch-Think-Interact (WTI), a closed-loop framework for multi-question streaming video reasoning. WTI maintains compact natural-language memory entries tagged with source-video time ranges; these entries support direct reasoning when sufficient and otherwise anchor selective recall of finer visual evidence. For each question, WTI answers when current context and memory suffice, continues watching when required evidence has not appeared, or recalls a relevant past interval and decides again after incorporating the returned chunks, without replaying the full observed history. To train this behavior, we construct WTI-82K, comprising 82,335 timed questions across 4,812 causally aligned trajectories, and develop Stream-GDPO to optimize complete multi-question streaming rollouts using trajectory-level feedback for response timing, source-video recall, and memory updates. WTI achieves state-of-the-art aggregate performance among the compared open-source streaming baselines, reaching 83.3% on StreamingBench and 73.6% weighted overall accuracy on OVO-Bench.

</details>


### [347] [MatToolBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents in Real-World Materials Science Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37053)
*Mei Wu,Rui Xie,Runyu Zhang,Yuqiang Li,Tianfan Fu,Bo Chen,Kai Yu,Xin Chen,Lu Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MatToolBench是首个在Windows 11虚拟机内评估多模态代理操作专业材料科学软件（10种工具，204个任务）的真实环境基准，覆盖GUI操作、OriginPro脚本和代码数据库查询三种模态。结果显示通用基准上的强表现无法迁移到专业科学工作流，最佳模型在GUI任务上仅25%成功率、代码任务45%成功率，揭示了领域知识稀缺、跨工具工件传递和隐式视觉反馈等核心瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用多模态GUI代理在日常软件基准上表现优异，但其操作专业科学软件（尤其是材料科学工具）的能力尚未被系统评估。专业科学软件存在网络数据稀疏、界面特殊化、隐式工作流惯例等特点，导致通用预训练难以覆盖，形成评估盲区。

Method: 在Windows 11虚拟机（Docker容器内QEMU）中构建统一评估框架，包含三个专门代理（GUI Agent、Code Agent、Origin Agent）。每个任务由领域专家分解为多个细粒度评分子标准，支持部分得分；GUI评估器通过OCR与像素分析（平均F1=0.98），OriginPro任务使用确定性导出检查加多模态LLM美学评判（人类-LLM一致性研究验证），代码任务使用参考输出匹配。评估7个前沿多模态模型，并进行提示消融实验。

Result: 评估Doubao-seed-1-8、Kimi-k2.5、Claude-sonnet-4.6、GPT-5.4、Qwen3-VL系列共7个模型。最佳模型：GUI平均SR=25.0%（Claude），代码平均SR=45.0%（GPT-5.4），Origin最高SR=68.8%（GPT-5.4）。DigitalMicrograph无模型超过20% SR，OPTIMADE最高达85%。消融实验：移除领域特定提示后JADE SR从25%降至5%，MP从15%降至0%，Origin综合得分从17/32降至5.2/32，提示工程对科学软件至关重要。识别四种失败模式：GUI定位错误、过早终止、死锁循环、领域知识缺失。

Conclusion: MatToolBench证明了通用基准表现与专业科学工作流表现之间存在显著的领域迁移鸿沟，失败根源在于领域特定操作知识、预训练对科学软件覆盖不足、跨工具工件传递薄弱以及仅视觉暴露的关键状态。该基准为数据稀缺、知识密集的科学工作流提供了具有挑战性的诊断测试平台，推动面向科研代理的研究发展。

Abstract: Multimodal GUI agents have achieved impressive results on general software benchmarks, yet their ability to operate professional scientific software remains largely unexplored. In materials science, sparse domain-specific web data, specialized interfaces, and tacit workflow conventions create blind spots that general-purpose pretraining cannot readily bridge. We present MatToolBench, the first real-environment benchmark for evaluating multimodal GUI agents on professional materials science software, comprising 204 tasks across 10 tools in three modalities: GUI operation, OriginPro scripting, and code-based database queries, all executed inside a Windows 11 VM. Each task is decomposed into fine-grained sub-criteria by domain experts, enabling interpretable partial-credit scoring; the GUI component of our multi-level evaluation pipeline achieves an average F1 of 0.98. For OriginPro figure-generation tasks, we further conduct a human-LLM agreement study to validate the use of a multimodal judge for secondary aesthetic assessment. Our experiments show that strong performance on general benchmarks does not transfer to professional scientific workflows, and that this gap is not a visual-grounding problem alone: failures arise from domain-specific operational knowledge, sparse pretraining coverage of scientific software, weak cross-tool artifact handoff, and critical states exposed only visually. Even the best model reaches only 25% success rate on GUI tasks and 45% on code tasks. MatToolBench therefore serves as a challenging diagnostic benchmark and real-environment testbed for data-scarce, knowledge-intensive scientific workflows.

</details>


### [348] [actr: aligning thoughts and responses for multilingual safety in reasoning llms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37054)
*Xianhui Zhang,Jian Yu,Chengyu Xie,Chenhang Cui,Shuyi Miao,Pengyang Shao,Yu Zheng,Fei Shen,Tat-Seng Chua*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ACTR是一个针对推理大语言模型多语言安全的框架。它揭示并解决了一个核心问题：模型在推理过程中识别出了安全风险，但最终仍以非高资源语言生成不安全回复。通过提出思维差距分数（TGS）量化该跨语言脱节，并定位"安全思维神经元"，ACTR采用神经元选择性一致性优化（NSCO），仅更新这些神经元的参数即可显著降低攻击成功率，同时保持通用能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理型LLM在多语言场景下存在关键的安全漏洞：面对非高资源语言的越狱攻击时，模型的推理痕迹能正确识别风险，但其最终回复却仍不安全。这种"思维-响应脱节"表明现有对齐方法未能有效将推理阶段的安全判断传递至多语言回复生成中。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) **思维差距分数（TGS）**——基于注意力输出投影能量比，量化推理痕迹对回复生成的归一化贡献在跨语言间的差异；(2) **安全思维神经元识别**——通过对比推理开启/关闭模式下神经元掩蔽引起的表征变化差集，定位支持安全推理利用的关键神经元（top 3%）；(3) **神经元选择性一致性优化（NSCO）**——采用冻结评判模型对思维-响应安全类别一致性提供二元奖励，仅通过二元掩码更新所选神经元的参数，无需人工标注。

Result: 在Qwen3-8B和Gemma4-12B-it两个模型上，ACTR在AdvBench-X和MultiJail基准上均达到最低平均攻击成功率（ASR）：Qwen3-8B上为0.29%/1.90%，Gemma4-12B-it上为0.72%/1.03%，相对最强基线提升40%-45.8%；安全能力可泛化至未见语言（斯瓦希里语ASR从62.86%降至1.27%）；MMMLU和MGSM通用能力保持或略有提升；XSTest上良性请求误拒率仅从4.40%升至6.40%（随机神经元基线为52.00%）。

Conclusion: ACTR通过机制可解释性分析揭示了推理LLM中跨语言思维-响应安全脱节的因果机制，并提出了一种参数高效的无标注对齐方法。该工作证实了针对性神经元干预在多语言安全对齐中的有效性，同时维持了模型的通用推理能力并避免了过度拒绝，为多语言安全研究提供了新的分析视角和技术路径。

Abstract: Ensuring the safety of reasoning large language models (LLMs) across languages is essential for their reliable deployment. However, when exposed to jailbreak attacks in non-high-resource languages, these models may generate unsafe responses even when their reasoning traces identify safety risks. To address this issue, we propose aligning cross-lingual thoughts and responses (ACTR), a framework that improves multilingual safety alignment by strengthening the use of existing safety reasoning. Specifically, we first present the think gap score (TGS) to compare the normalized contributions of reasoning traces to attention outputs during response generation across languages, and use reasoning- trace substitution to measure the cross-lingual safety gap. Next, using a corpus of jailbreak queries, we assess neuron importance through changes in response representations caused by neuron masking and compare the high-importance neuron sets obtained with reasoning enabled and disabled to identify safety think neurons that support the use of safety reasoning. Finally, we devise neuron-selective consistency optimization (NSCO), which uses a frozen judge model to reward agreement between the safety categories of reasoning traces and responses while updating only the parameters associated with the selected neurons, requiring no human-annotated responses or preference data. Across two reasoning models, ACTR achieves lower average attack success rates than the evaluated state-of-the-art methods on AdvBench-X and MultiJail, with safety gains extending to unseen languages, while preserving or improving average performance on multilingual knowledge and mathematical reasoning tasks and limiting false refusals of benign requests. Warning: this paper contains examples with unsafe content.

</details>


### [349] [Breaking the Illusion of Review Reliability under Static Evaluation: SCOPE Fuzzing for LLM-based Scientific Reviewers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37097)
*Zhuo Chen,Hao Zeng,Jiawei Liu,Guoxiu He,Le Cai,Liu Haotan,Li Wenbo,Yong Huang,Wei Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM辅助同行评审中的可靠性评估问题，揭示了静态评估方法的两大根本缺陷（分层脆弱性与扰动欠覆盖），并提出SCOPE-Fuzzer——一种基于策略感知的内容自适应模糊测试框架，通过反馈驱动的策略选择与上下文敏感的突变机制，在有限查询预算下更有效地暴露LLM评审者的可靠性漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
