Result: 在域内RouterEval和跨模态MMR-Bench(排除在预训练外)上均优于10个基线(Weighted kNN、MLP、Embedding-Ridge、EmbedLLM、RM-Softmax、TRouter、InferenceDynamics、UniRoute、ICL-Router、Context-Mean)。在MMR-Bench K=8时比最强基线高2.23质量点,域内K=8时高0.84点。新模型引入仅需8个观测即可超越重新拟合的基线;用1%的观测即可匹配Weighted kNN的全上下文性能。消融显示候选池Transformer和目标到上下文注意力贡献最大;目标域从头训练比冻结RouteFM低1.08点,而在预训练基础上微调收益甚微。

Conclusion: 证明LLM路由可从"基础模型"视角实现,单一冻结路由器通过上下文即可跨域、跨模态、适应新候选模型和不同部署偏好,支持"预训练一次,任意路由"的范式转变。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) routing aims to assign each query to the most suitable model from a heterogeneous candidate pool, improving the quality--efficiency trade-off of LLM inference. Existing routers are typically learned through local fitting: a router is optimized for a particular query workload and candidate pool, and often requires additional supervision or retraining as the routing environment changes. We ask whether LLM routing can instead be approached from a foundation-model perspective, learning a reusable routing capability that generalizes across tasks, candidate models, and deployment conditions. To this end, we introduce RouteFM, which learns to characterize anonymous candidate models from behavioral context and infer their target-specific capabilities, rather than binding routing decisions to fixed model identities or a single environment. Through episodic pretraining across heterogeneous routing environments, this capability can be reused by a frozen router and adapted to new environments through context alone. Experiments demonstrate transfer across changes in domains, modalities, candidate pools, and context budgets, with the largest gains when behavioral evidence is limited. On MMR-Bench, which is excluded from pretraining, RouteFM outperforms the strongest baseline by 2.23 quality points with only eight observations per candidate. These results support moving LLM routing from repeated local fitting toward a pretrain once, route anywhere paradigm. Our code is publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [377] [Beyond Prompt Count: How Data Shapes Transfer in On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37377)
*Jiaxuan Wang,Jiafei Lyu,Yuchen Cai,Siye Wu,Pengyuan Wang,Jiashun Liu,Xiang Cheng,Kai Yang,Yangkun Chen,Saiyong Yang,Lan-Zhe Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了在策略蒸馏（OPD）中，提示（prompt）的数量、来源和选择策略如何影响师生模型间的知识迁移。研究发现OPD具有很高的提示效率——少量提示即可逼近大规模提示池的性能，但提示效用是关系性的而非内在属性，依赖于师生配对和目标任务。文中还分析了功能与参数对齐、不利迁移的表征干预与恢复机制，并指出在所研究的设置中均匀随机采样仍是具有竞争力的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作虽已表明OPD能通过少量提示实现有效迁移，但提示数量、来源和选择如何具体影响不同师生配对间的迁移效果仍不清晰，提示的"充分性"与"可互换性"之间的区分也未被系统研究。

Method: 本文采用系统性的实验与诊断分析方法：1) 在多种师生配对（RL/SFT-continuation pairs与跨模型设置）下扫描不同提示数量M与来源；2) 使用参数对齐、功能对齐（log-prob变化方向余弦、KL差距闭合度）和隐状态干预（CKA、hidden-state replacement）分析迁移机制；3) 通过切换训练支持（continued OPD）研究不利迁移的恢复；4) 对比8种提示选择策略（包括均匀随机、分层随机、语义多样性、难度选择、T-S不一致性、Cost-D-opt等）与混合池源过滤的效果。

Result: 关键结果包括：1) 少量提示即可达到大池性能（4个DAPO提示匹配3,840个DeepMath提示的数学得分）；2) 提示效用是关系性的——仅更换教师即可逆转数学与代码提示的相对有效性；3) 功能与参数对齐可解耦（43个检查点中参数余弦中位数0.069，功能余弦中位数0.859）；4) 不利迁移可通过表征干预和切换至有效支持的持续OPD恢复；5) 在JustRL-DeepMath研究中均匀随机采样在M=8和M=48时均取得最高4任务均值；6) 过滤掉表现差的来源（GSM8K）未带来一致增益。

Conclusion: 本文区分了提示效率与提示可互换性，表明有效的数据选择依赖于师生配对与目标能力。在所研究的设置中，随机采样提供了具有竞争力的基线，提示选择策略需在考虑筛选成本后展示其相对于随机采样的收益。不利的训练历史不一定会阻碍后续的有效迁移，因为性能可通过表征干预或切换支持恢复，即便参数路径不同。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains students using teacher feedback on their own sampled responses, yet how prompt choice shapes transfer across teacher-student pairs remains poorly understood. We systematically study prompt quantity, source, and selection across RL- and SFT-continuation pairs and cross-model settings. We find that OPD can be highly prompt-efficient: a few prompts can approach large-pool performance, with four DAPO prompts matching the observed mathematics score of 3,840 DeepMath prompts. However, prompt utility is relational rather than intrinsic: changing only the teacher can reverse the relative effectiveness of mathematics and code prompts. To characterize these transfer differences, we analyze parameter and functional changes across prompt supports and model pairs. Functional alignment with the teacher varies across supports and target tasks; in continuation pairs, teacher-aligned prediction changes can coexist with weak parameter alignment. Continued OPD on effective supports can restore performance after unfavorable transfer. Finally, targeted selection does not consistently outperform uniform random sampling, and filtering out a source that performs poorly alone yields no consistent gain across three paired support draws. Overall, our results distinguish prompt efficiency from prompt interchangeability and show that effective data choice depends on the teacher-student pair and target capability, with random sampling providing a competitive baseline in the studied settings.

</details>


### [378] [Direct Experience World-Model Optimization: Learning the World Beyond Action Imitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37398)
*Xiangcheng Zhan,Zirui Chen,Yicheng Zhao,Ziteng Gao,Shuo Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DEWO（Direct Experience World-Model Optimization），一种面向World-Action Models (WAMs)的部署后学习范式。它通过在交互转折点处收集匹配的成功与失败轨迹，利用视觉预测作为监督信号进行持续的世界建模，结合无分类器引导和进度门控机制，在仿真和真实机器人平台上提升了灵巧操作任务的成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧操作中高维动作空间下微小的执行误差会逐级放大，导致策略偏离训练分布。现有部署后学习方法（SFT、RL等）主要优化行为本身，而不要求更好的世界预测，这使得WAM在部署后无法有效适应其实际遇到的物理交互。

Method: DEWO的核心方法包含四个部分：1）**交互转折点识别**：通过回溯探索，在失败轨迹中定位从可恢复变为不可恢复的边界；2）**关键经验收集**：在转折点恢复状态后采样多条连续轨迹，收集匹配的成功与失败延续；3）**结果条件化世界建模**：成功轨迹提供视觉与动作监督，失败轨迹仅提供视觉监督（动作目标被屏蔽），通过结果条件标签训练；4）**进度门控动作引导**：推理时，值头从视频表征估计任务进度，当进度停滞时激活无分类器引导，将动作预测向成功条件方向偏置。

Result: 在5个DexJoCo仿真任务上，DEWO将FACT成功率从64.5%提升至81.2%，将FastWAM从80.7%提升至82.3%（SFT反而降至76.1%）。在三种WAM范式（Joint、IDM、FastWAM）上均有提升，Joint获益最大（+4.8pp）。消融实验表明，加入成功和失败的视觉未来分别带来递增的提升，且验证集视频损失同步下降（水Plant降32.7%，Fold Glasses降17.8%）。在4个真实任务（Wuji和Sharpa手）×2轮部署学习中，3×3网格评估中，初始有成功的格子成功率从51.0%提升至71.7%（+20.7pp），全网格从20.6%提升至28.9%。

Conclusion: DEWO证明了持续的世界建模可以成为WAM部署后适应的有效组成部分。通过围绕交互转折点组织成功与失败的视觉未来进行预测学习，结合进度门控的无分类器引导，能够改善灵巧操作中的空间泛化可靠性。该工作将世界建模从被动的预训练阶段提升为部署后适应的主动组成部分，为实现通过部署经验自我改进的智能体奠定了基础。

Abstract: World-Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with predictions of how physical interactions unfold. However, current post-deployment learning paradigms typically improve behavior without requiring better world predictions. Especially in dexterous manipulation, small execution errors can compound in high-dimensional action spaces, hindering policy improvement and pushing interactions beyond the world model's training distribution. Motivated by this, we propose Direct Experience World-Model Optimization (DEWO), a post-deployment learning paradigm for WAMs that, alongside action imitation, refines world representations through visual experience to better condition action generation. Specifically, it identifies interaction turning points and learns from successful and failed futures to support classifier-free guidance. An additional value head estimates task progress from video representations and activates guidance when progress stalls during inference. Across five DexJoCo tasks, DEWO improves average success across all three WAM formulations. Ablations show that visual supervision from successful and failed continuations improves both prediction and control beyond action supervision alone. On four real-world tasks across Wuji and Sharpa, 3 x 3 grid evaluations show that two rounds of deployment learning increase success from 51.0% to 71.7% in cells with at least one initial success, a gain of 20.7 percentage points. These findings support continued predictive learning for improving control through deployment experience, making world modeling an active part of WAM adaptation.

</details>


### [379] [Routing Should Pay for Itself: Sparse Supervision for Economical LLM Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37402)
*Guannan Lai,Gelin Bian,Hao-Xuan Ma,Jun-Peng Jiang,Long Chen,Jian-Dong Liu,Zhi-Hao Tan,Han-Jia Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SaveRouter提出了一种稀疏监督的LLM路由框架，仅使用33-41%的训练反馈即可在四个路由基准上保持有竞争力或更好的路由质量，并将盈亏平衡部署量减少1.9-9.5倍，核心收益在于路由在经济上能否更快回收前期监督投入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM路由研究主要关注服务时效率，但忽视了路由器构建所需的密集查询-模型监督带来的前期成本。这种前期支出会显著延迟路由投资的回收点；同时观察到路由质量在收集全部监督之前就已饱和，密集监督在经济上存在过度配置问题。

Method: SaveRouter框架包含三个阶段：(1) 自适应稀疏反馈获取——基于经验贝叶斯UCB策略，结合能力估计与不确定性，对每个训练查询选择K≪M个模型进行评估；(2) 分层能力估计——通过双向可加Ridge回归拟合结构化的组-模型先验，结合局部证据进行收缩估计；(3) 查询级残差修正——通过留一法构造残差目标，为每个模型拟合轻量级线性预测器，捕获组内实例级差异。最终通过成本感知的argmax路由策略进行部署。

Result: 在LLMRouterBench、Mixinstruct、MMR-Bench和RouterBench四个基准上，主设置仅使用33-41%的可用训练反馈，SA-BEP相比最快常规全监督路由器减少约1.9-9.5倍。消融实验验证了查询级残差修正、任务感知分组和UCB获取策略的必要性。额外分析表明更多监督并非总是更优，最小化服务成本的最优监督水平与实现最早回收的水平可能不同。

Conclusion: 经济有效的LLM路由不仅取决于服务时效率，还取决于部署前获取的监督量。SaveRouter证明了通过选择性获取信息性反馈并在相关查询间共享能力信息，可以从有限监督中学习有效的路由策略，从而更快回收前期监督投入。理论上区分了"信息完备性"与"决策充分性"，为稀疏监督路由提供了理论支撑。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) routing reduces serving cost by assigning each query to an appropriate model while preserving response quality. Learning such a router, however, often requires executing multiple candidate models on historical queries to collect query--model quality feedback, creating a nontrivial supervision cost before deployment. Existing work largely focuses on serving-time efficiency, overlooking whether the resulting savings are sufficient to recover this upfront expenditure. We further observe that routing quality often saturates well before all query--model feedback is collected, suggesting that dense supervision can be economically over-provisioned. We propose SaveRouter, a sparse-supervision routing framework that selectively acquires informative model feedback and shares capability information across related queries, while retaining query-level refinement for fine-grained routing. We evaluate routing by jointly accounting for supervision expenditure and subsequent serving-time savings. Across four routing benchmarks, the main setting uses only about 33--41% of available training feedback while maintaining competitive or better routing quality, and reduces the break-even deployment volume by approximately 1.9--9.5 times compared with the fastest conventional router. Further analysis shows that acquiring more supervision is not always economically preferable: the supervision level that minimizes serving cost can differ from the one that achieves the earliest payback. Our code is publicly available at this https URL .

</details>


### [380] [Demistifying Data and Simulator Assumptions in Supervised Causal Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37446)
*Pingchuan Ma,Rui Ding,Bojun Huang,Shuai Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了监督式因果发现（SCD）方法，从预测目标、粒度、编码器、解码器和训练机制五个维度对代表性方法进行分类比较，分析了模拟器假设如何补充观测数据中的因果信息，并指出目标可识别性与模型迁移性是两个需要分别考察的问题，最终提出了匹配图目标的评估建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监督式因果发现方法依赖模拟器生成训练对（数据集+结构标签），而观测数据本身可能与多个因果图相容。现有文献对这些方法的目标、假设和迁移能力缺乏统一框架的系统性分析，导致方法比较和评估存在混乱。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: （1）从预测目标、预测粒度、编码器、结构解码器、训练机制五个维度构建统一比较框架；（2）将经典可识别性理论（A1–A3条件独立可识别性、A4可识别函数模型类）映射到SCD方法上；（4）分析模拟器先验在CI等价类内引入的额外约束机制；（5）对约15种主流SCD方法（RCC、ML4S、SPOT、ML4C、DAG-EQ、CSIvA、AVICI、BCNP、SiCL、Kode、SEA、ADAG、Arrow、TTT-SCL、TICL）进行逐项分析；（6）提出评估建议（区分合成/半合成/真实基准，匹配图目标的度量）。

Result: （1）建立五维度比较框架，并提供两份详细表格（表I方法概览、表II模拟器规格）；（2）揭示CI可识别性仅在马尔科夫等价类层面成立，模拟器通过机制/噪声约束可在该类内区分方向；（3）明确区分"目标在模型类内是否可识别"与"训练后预测器能否迁移"两个独立问题；（4）指出DAG-EQ的Pearson相关输入在等方差高斯模型下不充分、AVICI的后验依赖于模拟器先验、ADAG需要额外结构假设等具体局限性；（5）提出测试时适配可匹配观测边际但无法区分同边际的因果模型。

Conclusion: 监督式因果发现的有效性取决于模拟器假设与部署数据假设的匹配程度。CI可识别性仅在条件独立假设下成立，更强的方向识别需要机制、噪声、干预或背景知识的额外限制。评估应明确图目标（CPDAG/全DAG），并分开描述训练与测试模拟器。真实数据评估需要记录参考图的外部因果证据和不确定性。未来工作方向包括迁移性、测试时适配和不确定性评估。

Abstract: Supervised causal discovery learns to infer causal structure for a new dataset from training datasets paired with structural labels. These training pairs are typically simulated, making the simulator both a source of supervision and a carrier of assumptions about causal graphs, mechanisms, and noise. Understanding the resulting predictions therefore requires examining how these assumptions supplement the information available in observational data, which may be compatible with multiple causal graphs. This paper examines that relationship across representative methods available through June 2026. We organize these methods by prediction target, prediction granularity, encoder, structural decoder, and training regime to relate what each method predicts to how it uses data and simulator-based supervision. Using this framework, we distinguish two questions: whether the target is identifiable under the assumed model class, and whether a trained predictor generalizes beyond its training distribution. Restrictions on mechanisms and noise can make otherwise ambiguous causal directions identifiable, but predictive accuracy under those restrictions does not establish transfer when they change. This distinction motivates evaluation that matches metrics to the identifiable graph target and tests changes in graphs, mechanisms, and noise between training and deployment. Extending such evaluation to real data also requires documenting the external causal evidence and uncertainty behind benchmark reference graphs. Together, these analyses guide method comparison and identify open questions in transfer, test-time adaptation, and uncertainty assessment.

</details>


### [381] [Commitment Hierarchies under Intent Revision: A Belief-Revision Account of Salvage in Tool-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37453)
*Spandan Ghose Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种"salvage"机制来解决工具调用代理在用户中途改变意图时的子结果复用问题。核心发现是：决策质量取决于"角色设计"而非模型能力。让语言模型逐节点判断keep/patch/discard不可靠，但让它一次性分类修订类型，再用确定性层传播决策，则在所有测试模型上达到成本最优的oracle水平。论文将计划建模为承诺层级，将意图变更建模为AGM风格的后置修正算子，证明了局部观察策略不可能既安全又成本最优，而单分类设计可以。三个实验环境验证其节省43%成本且保持100%正确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前工具使用代理在用户中途改变意图时面临两难：要么restart浪费已完成的工具调用（有效子结果占restart成本的43%），要么naively continue回答已被用户放弃的旧问题。需要在保持正确性的同时最大化复用已缓存的子结果。

Method: 1. 将执行计划建模为有向无环图(DAG)，节点为带缓存结果和成本的承诺，边表示消费关系。2. 将用户意图建模为约束集Φ，将修订δ分类为addition/retraction/revision，并定义provenance set追踪每个节点依赖的约束。3. 定义salvage算子S(D,δ)对每个缓存节点标注Keep/Patch/Discard，提出五个AGM风格后置条件（Success/Inclusion/Vacuity/Consistency/Minimality）。4. 区分三种信息机制：Local（仅看节点自身）、Informed（看直接生产者的状态）、Structured（一次性读取supp(δ)后确定性传播）。5. 证明Theorem 2.1：任何确定性Local策略不可能同时满足Inclusion和Minimality。6. 证明Theorem 2.2：Structured设计在provenance sound假设下满足所有五个后置条件。

Result: 在三个环境中验证：CostBench（1,080实例）上structured judge达到0.90-1.00的oracle节省率，per-node judge仅0.44；STT-Arena（1,110实例）上keep/patch/discard与oracle一致（3.05 vs 6.08子目标，100%正确）；Synthetic DAG（188实例）上structured judge在三个模型（gpt-4o/gpt-4o-mini/gemini-2.5-flash）上均达1.00 oracle节省率且零违规，而per-node和informed judge均严重不足。总体比restart便宜43%，保持100%正确率。gpt-5 rollouts中保持环境状态但重置上下文可将通过率从0.11提升至0.52。

Conclusion: 将计划建模为承诺层级、将意图变更建模为信念修正，可以为中途意图修订的失败模式命名，给出解释为何per-node判断必然失败的局部性界，以及一个衡量标准。实践启示是角色设计：只问模型"什么变了"，让确定性层传播答案。局限性在于仅测试了三个温度为0的模型，假设层级计划和记录的provenance，且合成DAG为存在性证明而非普遍性。

Abstract: When a user changes their mind partway through a task, an agent that has already split the task into sub-goals and paid for tool calls must decide, per cached sub-result, whether to keep, patch, or discard it (salvage), restarting wastes valid work and continuing unchanged answers the old question. Our main finding is that salvage quality is a matter of role design rather than model capability: a language model asked the keep/patch/discard question one node at a time is unreliable, but asked to classify the revision once, with a deterministic layer propagating the decision, it reaches the cost-optimal oracle on all three models tested, from two vendors. Modeling the plan as a commitment hierarchy and the intent change as a belief-revision operator with AGM style postulates, we prove that no policy observing only a node's local view can be both safe and cost optimal, while the single classification design is both. Across three environments the policy recovers the full achievable savings, 43% cheaper than restart, at 100% correctness.

</details>


### [382] [Governing the Edge: Automating Commercial Property and Casualty Insurance Underwriting via a Hybrid Local-Cloud Multi-Agent Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37454)
*Vivek Kumar Singh,Gautam Bhowmick*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"Governing the Edge"框架，一种基于LangGraph的混合本地-云端多智能体系统，用于自动化商业财产意外险（P&C）的承保行政工作。系统包含13个节点（11个智能体+2个确定性控制节点），敏感数据由本地Gemma 2处理，匿名化后由云端Claude Sonnet推理。核心贡献是将合规编码为图边条件而非事后检查，通过确定性谓词执行硬性停止规则。在20个合成场景中，硬性停止类准确率100%（6/6可复现），整体合规准确率70%，处理时间从人工40分钟缩短至约4.5分钟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商业P&C承保人员30-40%时间耗费于行政事务（读文档、数据查询、重新录入），单份申请约40分钟手动处理。现有AI方案存在三大缺陷：①无法强制合规；②无法调用权威外部数据源；③通常将敏感数据直接发送至云端API。本文瞄准承保流程中的行政层自动化，保留人工风险判断，重点解决合规性、数据隐私和外部数据落地三大空白。

Method: 系统架构：13节点LangGraph StateGraph，分两层级。①本地层：Gemma 2（ollama/gemma2）处理原始文档解析、ACORD 125字段提取、风险子智能体；②云端层：Claude Sonnet 4.6通过LiteLLM处理匿名化数据上的推理（风险聚合、覆盖缺口、定价、可解释性）。关键设计：合规规则编码为图边条件函数（route_compliance），PASS状态才放行至定价；硬性停止规则由Python确定性谓词evaluate_hard_stops执行，不依赖LLM；CONFLICT状态触发一次自动重试后升级人工；隐私边界通过序列化器、云端提示词、网络隔离三处执行；每智能体绑定特定工具接口（当前为合成存根）并记录调用日志；Pydantic schema在边界校验输出；8类错误追踪分类用于运维监控。10条P&C合规规则覆盖商业财产与汽车（5条STOP级+5条WARN级）。

Result: 端到端场景CA-S06（SaaS快递公司，主司机3年内3次严重违章）展示全流程：本地三个并行风险子智能体→Risk Aggregator跨隐私边界→Compliance Agent确定性触发CA-02硬性停止→路由至Human Escalation，定价和覆盖缺口模块未被调用。性能：单次端到端268.8秒（约4.5分钟），相对人工40分钟显著提速，但慢于云端单次提示（6.4秒）。准确率对比20场景：硬性停止层6/6（100%，可复现）、简单批准4/4、WARNING层2/6、低置信升级2/4，整体70%；对照Monolithic Sonnet（75%）与Linear Pipeline（30%）。硬性停止结果由温度0的确定性谓词保证稳定；WARNING和升级层因本地Gemma 2判断与合成工具随机性在不同运行间波动。

Conclusion: 框架通过将合规作为图边条件而非事后检查，解决了线性管线中违规结果沿流程传播的根本问题；通过本地-云端分层与序列化强制执行解决了数据驻留约束；通过绑定工具接口与审计日志解决了外部数据落地需求。在硬性停止关键合规层达到100%可复现准确率，整体合规率70%，遗留差距集中在依赖本地模型判断的软性层（WARNING与低置信升级）。主要局限：外部工具为未播种的合成存根，软层结果不可复现；硬性停止规则当前依赖提取字段而非工具返回的真实数据；场景为合成数据、单一专家标注。生产部署需更新阈值以匹配各州DOI要求和NAIC示范法，并将Gemma 2升级为Gemma 4以改善延迟。

Abstract: Underwriters in commercial Property and Casualty (P&C) insurance spend 30 to 40% of their time on administrative work rather than risk judgment, and a single submission takes about 40 minutes by hand. We present Governing the Edge, a multi-agent framework for that layer, organized around a data-residency constraint: sensitive submission data must not leave the perimeter. Eleven agents and two deterministic control nodes, one a human-escalation interrupt, form a 13-node LangGraph workflow across two tiers. Agents touching raw submissions run locally on Gemma 2, each bound through a tool interface logging every invocation (synthetic stubs in the current prototype); only anonymized scores and non-identifying fields cross to Claude Sonnet in the cloud. Compliance rules are encoded as conditions on graph edges, so a non-compliant submission never reaches pricing. We walk through one full scenario end to end, a commercial auto submission whose principal driver carries serious violations, showing every agent call, every tool invocation, and the resulting routing decision. The framework processes a 40-minute manual submission in a few minutes on a single edge device, dominated by serialized on-device inference. On the hard-stop violation tier the framework enforces every rule correctly and reproducibly, since hard stops are deterministic predicates over fields extracted at temperature 0; overall compliance accuracy across the 20-scenario benchmark is 70%, with the remaining gap concentrated in softer, judgment-based tiers. It keeps a complete audit trail and respects the privacy boundary throughout. We release all code, compliance rules, tool stubs, and synthetic datasets.

</details>


### [383] [VeriWeave Govern: Evidence-Gated Deterministic Runtime Governance for Enterprise AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37457)
*Kabeh Mohsenzadegan,Vahid Tavakkoli,Kyandoghere Kyamakya*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出VeriWeave Govern——一种面向企业AI智能体的确定性运行时治理层，通过证据门控、三态决策（deny>review>allow）、OOD失败安全、人为审核路由与可重放防篡改审计，将动作生成与动作授权分离为独立的信任域。在GovernBench（60,000案例×30种子）与150例欧盟/奥地利法规评估中验证其安全性与可用性权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM智能体从文本生成演化为可调用工具、修改基础设施和处理受保护数据的自主系统，错误授权的后果（如部署软件、释放数据、影响公民流程）远比错误回答更严重。传统RBAC/ABAC与策略引擎（OPA/Cedar）缺乏对证据时效性、冲突控制、人工问责、未知动作和策略演化的支持；而使用同一随机模型同时担任动作提议方和最终授权方会产生循环信任问题。因此需要一个独立于规划器的确定性授权边界。

Method: 系统采用请求形式化 x=⟨a,o,r,p,c,E,t⟩（身份、操作、资源、目的、上下文、证据集、时间），规则匹配集Q(x)与证据门控G(x)共同决定结果：U(x)=存在review规则 ∨ ¬G(x) ∨ Q(x)=∅；D(x)在存在deny规则时为deny，否则U(x)=1时为review，否则allow。三大核心组件：①策略匹配器（评估版本化谓词与证据需求）；②证据验证器（计算权威性、时效性、签名、内容、矛盾性的logistic信任分数s(e)=σ(w⊤φ(e)+b)，阈值τ=0.76接受）；③决策归约器（执行deny>review>allow与OOD失败安全）。补充机制包括：哈希链审计（h_i=SHA256(h_{i-1}‖R_i)）、版本化策略束（含策略集哈希）、反事实治理证书（记录最小证据扰动对决策的影响）。三条安全不变量命题：deny优势性（增加allow规则不能使决策更宽松）、证据单调性（移除证据不能产生新allow）、重放确定性（相同输入与策略版本产生相同输出）。实验采用GovernBench（30种子×2,000合成案例，覆盖公共行政、医疗、金融、软件工程代理、企业办公五大领域，含7类对抗族：过期证据、伪造签名、引用洗白、证据洪水、矛盾证据、策略降级、工具替换）与150例EU/奥地利法规评估（两位盲法独立人类标注员，原始一致率1.000、κ=1.000）。

Result: GovernBench结果（30种子×2,000案例）：VeriWeave平均准确率0.9888（95% CI 0.9876–0.9899）、macro-F1=0.9836、FAR=0.0000、GASR=0.0000；RBAC准确率仅0.5864（FAR=0.3032），ABAC为0.4947（FAR=0.5053）。消融实验：移除证据门控→准确率0.7127、FAR=0.2873；移除deny优先级→FAR=0.2115；移除OOD失败安全→FAR=0.1284、GASR=0.1427；移除人为审核→FAR=0.0890；移除时序重放→FAR=0.0665；移除矛盾检测→FAR=0.0008但GASR=0.0067。证据模型AUROC=0.9840、AUPRC=0.9896、Brier=0.1226、ECE=0.2253。Docker API：12/12端到端场景通过，并发度4时平均延迟10.42 ms、P95=17.14 ms、吞吐371.64 req/s。负载矩阵：4个并发级别×10,010请求=40,040请求，零失败；并发32时P95=108.84 ms、吞吐368.97 req/s。150例法规评估：两位标注员完全一致（80 allow/20 review/50 deny）；VeriWeave/OPA/Cedar准确率0.8000（零false allow，但30例过度升级为review）；Gemma 4 31B准确率0.9733（零false allow，仅4例错误）；VeriWeave相对Gemma准确率差−0.1733（Holm校正McNemar p=7.67×10⁻⁶）。

Conclusion: 研究证明确定性证据门控可作为自主规划与副作用执行之间的实用强制层，零观察到的unsafe allow与零GASR展示了分层防御（证据门控、deny优先级、OOD失败安全、人工问责、时序重放）的互补性。150例人类评审揭示出可测量的安全–可用性权衡：确定性引擎通过过度升级保持保守，而Gemma 4 31B更接近人类共识但缺乏确定性强制语义。核心系统原则是动作授权应通过独立、证据感知、可重放的策略强制来显式控制该权衡，而非追求单标签准确率最大化。架构支持四信任域分离（规划器/上下文/治理/执行）与渐进部署生命周期（observe→shadow→selective enforcement→broad enforcement）。代码以Python 3.13实现并以VeriWeave Govern v0.4.0开源发布。

Abstract: Enterprise artificial-intelligence agents increasingly call tools, modify infrastructure, and process protected data, creating a need to separate action generation from action authorization. This article presents VeriWeave Govern, a deterministic runtime governance layer that evaluates structured agent actions against versioned policies, validates typed evidence, applies fixed deny > review > allow precedence, routes consequential actions to accountable human review, and records replayable tamper-evident audit state. GovernBench evaluates the design over 30 independent seeds and 60,000 oracle-labelled cases spanning five enterprise domains, adversarial evidence, out-of-distribution actions, and temporal policy evolution. VeriWeave achieves 0.9888 mean accuracy, 0.9836 macro-F1, zero observed aggregate false allows, and zero observed Governance Attack Success Rate on the evaluated cases. Six ablations show that evidence gating, deny precedence, out-of-distribution fail-safe behavior, human review, contradiction handling, and temporal replay contribute complementary safety. The deployed API additionally passes 12/12 end-to-end scenarios and a 40,040-request concurrency matrix with zero failures. A separate 150-case EU/Austria regulation-grounded evaluation uses frozen predictions and two independent blinded human annotators, who agree on all decisions. On this set, deterministic engines remain conservative, while a Gemma 4 31B comparator aligns more closely with the human consensus. The results expose a measurable safety--utility trade-off and motivate evidence-aware, replayable governance as an independent control plane for enterprise agent execution.

</details>


### [384] [CRASM-Gate: Deterministic-First Constraint- and Role-Aware Semantic Mapping with Selective Model Assistance Across Heterogeneous Industrial Standards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37458)
*Kabeh Mohsenzadegan,Vahid Tavakkoli,Kyandoghere Kyamakya*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CRASM（确定性约束与角色感知语义映射方法）及其选择式模型辅助扩展CRASM-Gate，针对异构工业标准（AAS、OPC UA、IEEE 1451、IEC 61499、ISO 15926风格）的语义互操作问题，采用"确定性优先"架构——候选约束检索、确定性规则、目的地/源端角色区分、语义/结构排序、歧义拒绝、目标验证，仅在不确定性/分歧门控处调用受JSON Schema约束的本地LLM，最终决策权归确定性验证。在14,400个样本（6个有向标准对×3难度×10配置）的冻结基准上，CRASM-Gate F1=0.9938、结构有效性=1.0000；CRASM F1=0.9931、无生成模型调用；LLM-only基线仅0.5347。CRASM将top-1错误从670降至10，延迟0.0688 s/样本（vs 24.5 s），模型辅助仅额外带来1个正确决策但延迟增加229×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业标准（OPC UA、AAS、IEEE 1451、IEC 61499、ISO 15926）用不兼容的层次、标识符、角色和结构约束编码同一工程概念，导致最近邻词法/嵌入匹配在技术上仍可能不可接受。现有方法（模型驱动转换、本体匹配、知识图谱、LLM）在语义合理性与确定性工程约束冲突时缺乏明确的接受权责分工。需要一种明确区分"语义相似性"与"结构/角色可接受性"、且LLM辅助可控可审计的互操作架构。

Method: 1）标准适配器规范化源元素为协议限定路径；2）有界检索+确定性规则构建候选证据；3）CRASM融合词法、嵌入、规则、数据类型、单位、实例、父路径、上下文/路径对齐、检索、信号族、测量角色等多通道评分；4）显式目的地vs源端角色解释（公式5：对所需目的地匹配奖励、源端匹配惩罚），低分或低边际时拒绝；5）CRASM-Gate门控条件（公式6：top1<0.82或top1-top2≤0.08或规则/检索分歧）触发受JSON Schema约束的本地LLM调用，模型输出经规范化后回流入同一确定性验证器。架构三不变式：候选闭包、验证器主导、模型非权威。

Result: 在冻结基准（6有向对×3难度×10配置=14,400决策，种子2105616649，固定本地gemma4:e2b端点）上：CRASM-Gate F1=0.9938（1431/1440），CRASM F1=0.9931（1430/1440），LLM-only F1=0.5347（770/1440）；中/难样本CRASM与CRASM-Gate均100%正确；LLM-only中样本仅18.96%、难样本41.46%；五对标准F1=1.0000，所有错误集中于AAS→OPC UA（CRASM 0.9583、CRASM-Gate 0.9625）；CRASM延迟0.0688 s/样本（比LLM-only快约356×），CRASM-Gate延迟15.77 s/样本（增加229×换1个正确决策）；结构有效性均为1.0000；检索R@1=0.2618、R@5=0.6597（远低于最终F1，证明检索仅为候选证据而非决策者）。

Conclusion: 核心结论是权威分解（authority decomposition）而非单纯高分：确定性CRASM承担几乎全部受控质量，LLM应被视为有界的、可选的、可测量的不确定性解析器，不能绕过结构验证；"确定性优先"互操作架构将候选有界性、决策可分解性、拒绝可接受性、验证器终局性作为可审计的不变式。未来工作：清洁化消融协议的多种子重跑、专家标注的官方工业构件、外部本体匹配基线、无限制候选发现、可执行跨模型转换与对级验证器。

Abstract: Industrial standards often encode the same engineering concept through incompatible hierarchies, identifiers, roles, and structural constraints, so the nearest lexical or embedding match can still be technically inadmissible. This article presents CRASM, a deterministic constraint- and role-aware semantic mapping method, and CRASM-Gate, its selectively model-assisted extension. The framework separates standard-specific canonicalization, bounded retrieval, deterministic rules, destination-versus-origin role interpretation, semantic and structural ranking, ambiguity refusal, and target validation. CRASM-Gate adds a confidence/disagreement gate that may invoke a candidate-constrained large language model, while final authority remains with deterministic validation. A controlled artifact covers six directed industrial-standard pairs, three difficulty levels, and ten configurations, yielding 14,400 sample-level decisions. With a fixed local model endpoint, CRASM-Gate reaches mean F1 0.9938 and an implemented structural-validity rate of 1.0000; deterministic CRASM reaches 0.9931 without generative-model calls; and the model-only baseline reaches 0.5347. Relative to the model-only baseline, CRASM reduces top-1 errors from 670 to 10 while exhibiting 0.0688 s/sample rather than 24.5263 s/sample observed latency. CRASM-Gate improves CRASM by one additional correct decision out of 1,440, with observed latency increasing to 15.7666 s/sample. The results support a deterministic-first interoperability architecture in which model assistance is optional, measurable, candidate-bounded, and unable to bypass structural validation.

</details>


### [385] [Authority Before Utility: Non-Compensatory Control for Persistent LLM Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37474)
*Wesley Shu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对大语言模型持久化记忆系统中的"权威控制"问题提出：仅靠检索相关性（utility）不足以保证记忆在更新、删除或撤销后不再被使用。作者主张将"权威性"（authority）作为不可补偿（non-compensatory）的硬约束，与效用排序分离。理论上证明对原始效用施加固定有限惩罚无法在正仿射重参数化下保证排除，因此采用秩归一化的SOFT基线作为更强的对比。在执行审计中，原预设的TIDE/LongMemEval主实验因构念混淆和DEV集缺失而被隔离，转用Memora Remembering作为替代诊断。在Qwen3-8B上，HARD排除相比DEV选定的SOFT(λ=0.6)在185个HELDOUT单元上取得15.61个百分点的成对差距，主要由遗忘值泄漏驱动，同时当前值召回率得以保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持久化记忆系统中，一条记忆在语义上仍高度相关（utility高），但可能因更新、删除或撤销而不再具备回答当前问题的资格（inadmissible）。检索效用无法独立解决这一控制问题，需将"是否被授权使用"与"是否有用"区分开来。这一问题在访问控制、决策理论（非补偿偏好）、测量理论及安全控制中均有先例，但尚未被系统引入LLM持久化记忆的设计中。

Method: 形式化定义权威状态m_Q(i)∈{0,1}，候选集M及原始效用U_i。HARD控制器在排序前直接移除所有m_Q=1的候选（即F(Q)={i∈M: m_Q(i)=0}）。SOFT控制器保留全部候选，按S_λ(i)=R_i - λ·m_Q(i)排序，其中R_i∈[0,1]为秩归一化效用。提出命题1：若不可接受候选j对可接受候选k有正原始效用优势，则存在正仿射变换U'=aU+b使j在S_λ下仍超过k，说明固定原始惩罚不具表示无关性。秩归一化因仅依赖顺序而具有尺度不变性，构成更强的补偿基线。实验以Memora Remembering为材料化语料（200题，其中180题含value-bearing遗忘项），按依赖聚类（period×persona）切分为15个DEV和185个HELDOUT单元。在Qwen3-8B（BF16，do_sample=False，禁用thinking，256 token上限）上以12候选上下文预算执行。DEV从10点λ∈{0,.05,.10,.20,.40,.60,.80,.90,.95,.99}中选定λ=0.6（DEV误差.1912）。估计量为平衡构念误差E=½[(1-当前召回)+(1-遗忘缺席)]。通过20,000次聚类自举（28簇）报告95%置信区间，并辅以单元级、留一簇、persona-only及period-only敏感性与167单元仅含materialized遗忘值的子集分析。

Result: 在185单元/28簇HELDOUT上，HARD平衡构念误差为4.04%，SOFT(λ=0.6)为19.66%，成对差15.61个百分点，簇自举95%CI=[13.07, 18.76]。分解显示：当前召回率差异仅2.40点（91.92% vs 89.52%），而遗忘缺席差异高达28.83点（100.00% vs 71.17%）。单元层面HARD在95个单元更优、90个持平、SOFT无优势。留一簇聚合效应14.94–16.13点，无单簇可解释聚合结果。167单元materialized子集得17.30点差距（HARD 1.78% vs SOFT 19.08%）。DEV仅15单元在10个λ上选择，存在选择不确定性未传播至HELDOUT推断。

Conclusion: 在固定的权威状态Q下，秩归一化后最强的有限补偿控制器（DEV选定λ=0.6）相比硬排除仍显著多泄漏遗忘值，且未换来更高的当前值召回，从而为LLM持久化记忆中的权威感知控制架构提供了操作层面的实证证据。但该证据局限于：单一模型（Qwen3-8B）、单一基准（Memora Remembering）、单一效用代理（会话近因性秩归一化）、12候选上下文预算、确定性证据值评分器；不构成对所有标量控制的普遍否定，不评估学习式权威推断，也不构成独立下游危害测量。HARD效应可能部分由上下文占用重塑而非纯逻辑门控驱动，且Q的正确推断本身是独立的治理课题。原始TIDE/LongMemEval主矩阵因构念混淆（age≠inadmissibility）和无DEV集而被隔离，使替代单元的证据等级降为"操作对比"而非前瞻性因果确认。未来工作应在独立裁决的权威状态下评估学习式Q，并采用因子设计固定上下文占用以分离逻辑排除与干扰项减少的贡献。

Abstract: Persistent memory creates a control problem that retrieval relevance alone does not solve: a memory can remain highly useful after an update, deletion, or revocation makes it inadmissible for the current answer. We formalize this as a separation between utility and authority. A fixed finite penalty applied to an unnormalized utility score cannot guarantee exclusion under arbitrary positive-affine reparameterization of that score; by contrast, rank-normalized compensation is scale-invariant and therefore forms a stronger empirical comparator. Our prospectively frozen TIDE/LongMemEval primary was quarantined before a valid HELDOUT comparison because the materialized TIDE adapter conflated historical age with query-relative inadmissibility and the aligned LongMemEval split left no DEV set for the predeclared penalty selection. We therefore report a post-primary replacement diagnostic on Memora Remembering, where update/delete operations provide item-level forgetting state. On Qwen3-8B, DEV selected lambda = 0.6 from a ten-point normalized SOFT family. Across 185 HELDOUT units in 28 dependency clusters, HARD exclusion yields 4.04% balanced construct error versus 19.66% for locked SOFT, a paired difference of 15.61 points with a 20,000-replicate cluster-bootstrap 95% interval of [13.07, 18.76]. The effect is driven primarily by forgotten-value leakage while current-value recall is preserved. This is same-Q operator-comparison evidence, not a universal claim that scalar control fails, not an evaluation of learned authority inference, and not an independent downstream-harm endpoint.

</details>


### [386] [Boundary-State Control for Tool-Using Language-Model Agents: Commit-Time Consistency under State Drift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37475)
*Wesley Shu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出BSC-R机制，用于解决工具调用语言模型代理中"提案-提交"间隙的安全一致性问题：通过在受信任的效果汇处绑定单次使用的提交见证者到精确动作和授权状态的语义投影。内部测试表现优异（0/4403无效提交，5899/5900有效保留），但外部CONTINUITY套件暴露其25%的失效率，表明这是一个范围有限的提交时一致性机制，而非通用安全方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具调用语言模型代理存在"提案-提交"时间间隙：模型判定动作可执行后，到该动作产生持久化外部效果之间，授权状态（撤销、权限变更、政策更新、审批失效、重放等）可能发生改变。这种TOCTOU类竞态使单纯的模型输出决策不足以保证执行时的安全性，需要在效果边界进行确定性重新校验。

Method: BSC-R（Boundary-State Control with semantic authorization projection）在受信任的效果汇处实施确定性验证机制。核心结构为：鉴定时生成τ = MAC_k(canon(a) || canon(π(z_q)) || n)，其中a为规范化动作，π为语义授权投影（绑定主体、执行者、权限、委托范围、政策标识/摘要/时期、污染等），n为单次使用随机数。提交时重新规范化、计算当前投影、验证见证者、消费nonce。同时冻结了十种扰动类别用于机制识别。

Result: RQ1：确定边界内核在2847个AgentDojo攻击场景中完全保持基础行为（80.576%效用，1.616%攻击成功率），而学习策略则崩溃为全拒绝。RQ2：完整联合绑定在10302个提案上接受所有未变更提交，拒绝所有十类扰动。RQ3：独立边界漂移实验中，全联合绑定实现0/4403无效提交和5899/5899有效保留。RQ4：外部CONTINUITY套件中，BSC-R在目标构造上完美（700/700良性、1200/1200已表示的非重放无效、160/160重放生命周期、200/200模糊无释放），但在完整2560攻击套件上无效效果提交率25%（vs CONTINUITY的0%）。

Conclusion: BSC-R是范围限定的提交时一致性机制，而非通用代理安全声明。其有效性严格依赖于语义投影所覆盖的安全不变量；外部套件中25%的失效率源于投影未涵盖的溯源、发布有效性、变换/收据、阶段签名者、替代路径等不变量。代理安全的实际设计空间应组合模型级过滤、限制性策略和提交时一致性检查，而非相互排斥的替代方案。

Abstract: Tool-using language-model agents can decide that an action is permissible and execute it only after security-relevant state has changed. We study this proposal-to-commit gap and introduce BSC-R, a deterministic effect-boundary mechanism that binds a single-use commit authorization to the exact action and to a semantic projection of the authorization state that justified it. On 2,847 attacked AgentDojo episodes, the boundary kernel preserves the unprotected agent's behavior exactly (80.576% utility; 1.616% attack success). On 10,302 frozen proposals, it accepts every unchanged commit and rejects every instance of ten prospectively specified changed or replayed classes. In an independently generated boundary-drift experiment, full joint binding commits 0/4,403 invalid contexts while retaining 5,899/5,899 valid contexts. A prospective external evaluation on the 3,460-scenario CONTINUITY suite retains all 700 benign cases, prevents 1,200/1,200 represented non-replay invalid effects, handles 160/160 replay lifecycles correctly, and withholds 200/200 ambiguous no-release cases. The broader external suite also exposes the method's limit: across all 2,560 attacks, BSC-R has a 25% invalid-effect commit rate versus 0% for CONTINUITY. The result is therefore a scoped commit-time consistency mechanism, not a universal agent-safety claim.

</details>


### [387] [SkillGym: Training Skill-Use Agents with Automatic Verifiable Environment Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37539)
*Renxi Wang,Mingshan Hee,Fajri Koto,Timothy Baldwin,Haonan Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SkillGym 是一个自动化流水线，将网络社区编写的技能包转化为可验证、可执行的训练环境（含 6.8k 任务与 19k 成功轨迹），通过监督微调显著提升 LLM 智能体的"技能调用"能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法多从固定环境中提取技能，局限于少数领域；而社区技能虽丰富但缺乏任务、环境与验证，难以作为训练数据。SkillGym 旨在将外部、异构的公共技能转化为"技能关键型"训练任务，并构建可靠的执行验证机制，使模型学习到调用与运用技能的可迁移行为。

Method: 三阶段流水线：（1）从 skills.sh 与 claude-skill-registry 爬取 184k 技能条目，经多维标注与规则过滤筛选出 11,897 个可离线、可复现运行的技能；（2）采用 builder-reviewer 双智能体系统，按"程序执行、溯因诊断、约束满足、偏序规划"四种推理结构构建任务，并配备参考解与可执行验证器，通过"有效性门"与"质量门"双重把关；（3）使用 Kimi-K3、DeepSeek-V4-Flash、GLM-5.2 三教师模型在四种智能体框架下收集 19k 条已验证的成功轨迹，并基于此进行监督微调。

Result: 在 2B 至 122B 参数的六款基座模型上，SkillGym SFT 在 22/24 项对比中带来提升：SkillGym 测试集平均提升 13.8 分、SkillEval 提升 9.7 分、SkillsBench 提升 9.7 分、Skill-Use-Bench 提升 41.2 分。其中 Qwen3.5-9B SFT 模型在两个基准上超越了未训练的 397B 模型。消融实验表明：（a）训练后智能体对相关技能的"触发读取率"从 28% 提升至 96%；（b）质量审核通过的任务数据优于仅通过执行验证的数据；（c）训练带来的增益在不同推理结构上保持一致，且能迁移到训练中占少数的结构以及训练中未见的技能上；（d）技能访问使训练后模型的成功率提升 16.5 分，是基础模型（7.5 分）的两倍以上。

Conclusion: SkillGym 证明了将社区公共技能规模化转化为可验证训练环境的可行性，揭示了训练的核心收益在于让智能体学会主动调用所提供技能，而非仅提升通用解题能力；该方法在跨模型、跨规模、跨领域、跨推理结构以及未见技能上均展现出良好的泛化能力。未来工作应针对"方法/工具密集型"技能扩充数据，并探索将 SkillGym 的可执行验证器作为奖励信号进行强化学习训练。

Abstract: Skills equip LLM agents with professional knowledge and guidance to complete long-horizon and complex tasks. Although skills have been widely adopted in recent agent paradigms and harnesses, how to synthesize reliable training data and how to train agents for skill use remain underexplored. In this work, we propose SkillGym, an automatic pipeline to build verifiable environments, collect trajectories, and train skill-use agents. SkillGym first crawls a large volume of skills from the internet, then keeps those whose workflows can run reproducibly offline. A builder-reviewer pipeline is used to construct difficulty-controlled tasks, spanning four task types, each with a reference solution and an executable verifier. With this pipeline, we build 6.8k environments and collect 19k verified successful trajectories for supervised finetuning. Finetuning on these trajectories improves LLMs of different families and sizes, from 2B to 122B parameters across four skill-use benchmarks; Our Qwen3.5-9B SFT model outperforms the 397B untrained model on two of them. Further analysis shows that training teaches agents to invoke skills, raising the rate of reading the relevant skill from 28% to 96%, and that the gains hold across reasoning structures, extending to task types that form a minority of the training data and to skills held out from training

</details>


### [388] [How Can Recommendation Feedback Evolve Agent Memory?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37544)
*Shanwen Mao,Mingming Li,Hao Zhang,Zhiheng Li,Yige Wang,Penghua Yu,Junxiong Zhu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了TIDE框架,旨在将推荐系统中延迟、嘈杂、上下文依赖的反馈信号转化为智能体外部记忆的演化驱动力,并提出Memory Evolution Gain (MEG)作为评估记忆更新对未来任务效用的指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内容生成智能体部署在推荐系统后会收到点击、转化、负反馈等真实世界结果信号,但这些信号具有延迟性、噪声,且受受众构成、投放位置和推荐策略影响,同时单一结果可能由多条记忆共同影响,导致归因困难。现有方法依赖即时反馈或语义检索,难以可靠地将推荐结果转化为记忆适应度信号。

Method: 方法包含三个核心阶段:(1)时间信用——将完整生命周期而非任意时间点的指标快照作为多目标结果摘要;(2)语义信用——通过匹配对照集合和环境记录,将可靠生命周期结果转化为上下文相关的决策证据链;(3)责任信用——结合记忆使用记录和反事实重放,将上下文适应度分配给真正参与生成并影响决策的记忆。基于这三层信用分配,对记忆种群执行强化、交叉(crossover)、变异(mutation)或驱逐(eviction)操作,并在固定容量约束下进行种群选择。生成器参数保持冻结,记忆以受容量约束的种群形式持续演化。

Result: 在电商会员营销内容生成智能体上:TIDE在离线时序回放中取得+7.75百分点的MEG,在为期一周的在线A/B实验中,UCTR相对提升+5.10%,激活率提升+4.79%(均p<0.001);在基于MemoryCD改编的延迟标签基准上,TIDE取得最低MAE(0.531)和RMSE(0.895)及最高MEG@δ=5(+0.0365)。消融实验表明责任信用是最关键的组件,移除后Mean Utility下降0.149;十轮演化实验中TIDE在有界记忆(80条)下取得最高效用(0.809),且90%的驱逐操作针对注入的噪声记忆。分布漂移实验中TIDE恢复时间仅需0.33轮,显著快于基线。

Conclusion: TIDE通过结合时间、语义、责任三层信用分配,有效将延迟、上下文依赖的推荐结果转化为可追溯、可审计、可逐条回滚的外部记忆演化,提供了一种高效、可追溯的智能体持续适应方案,在离线效用、在线业务指标和跨任务泛化三个维度均取得最优表现。

Abstract: Content-generation agents continuously receive impressions, clicks, conversions, and negative feedback from recommendation systems, providing real-world outcome signals for memory evolution. However, these signals are delayed and noisy, confounded by audience composition, placement, and recommendation policies, and may result from the combined influence of multiple memories, making accurate attribution difficult. Existing methods rely primarily on immediate feedback or semantic retrieval and therefore struggle to reliably translate recommendation outcomes into memory fitness. To address this challenge, we propose TIDE (Trajectory-Informed Directed Memory Evolution), an external memory evolution framework driven by delayed recommendation feedback. We further introduce Memory Evolution Gain (MEG), which measures the utility improvement of evolved memory over a no memory baseline on strictly future tasks. TIDE treats memory as a capacity-constrained population of experiences: temporal and semantic credit assignment estimates contextual fitness, while responsibility credit distributes outcome signals according to the memories referenced during generation. These signals are then used to reinforce, crossover, mutate, or evict memories. On an e-commerce membership marketing content-generation agent, TIDE achieves a +7.75-percentage-point MEG in offline temporal replay and significantly improves both unique click-through rate (UCTR) and activation rate in an online A/B test. On a delayed-label benchmark, TIDE achieves the lowest mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean squared error (RMSE) and the highest MEG among the compared methods, demonstrating its effectiveness.

</details>


### [389] [Rational Clarification by Assistive Agents via Value-of-Information Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37588)
*T. Duy Nguyen-Hien,Yee Whye Teh,Wee Sun Lee,Tan Zhi-Xuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: REVOIR提出了一种基于信息价值(VoI)推理的推理时决策框架，使LLM辅助代理能够理性地决定何时向用户提出澄清问题、何时直接行动，在两个基准测试中以更少的问题实现了更高的任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于语言的辅助代理常面临用户意图模糊的问题。现有方法要么直接行动（可能产生与用户意图错位），要么基于信息增益或固定阈值提问，忽视了不确定性减少对下游性能的影响、提问与行动的成本权衡，以及用户可在行动后提供纠正的可能性。需要一个理性的决策框架来平衡这些权衡。

Method: REVOIR（Rational Enquiry via Value-of-Information Reasoning）将澄清辅助建模为协作博弈，采用变分粒子近似维护用户意图信念，通过推理时计算提问与行动的成本调整后价值（基于模拟用户回答/纠正后的期望任务奖励），决策是否提问。在CondAmbigQA（模糊问答）和ADAPT（偏好对齐家务规划）两个基准上与提示、思维链、微调、信息增益等基线对比。

Result: 在CondAmbigQA上，REVOIR以更少的澄清实现更高正确率，Pareto支配基于EIG的REIGN基线；在用户终止设置下能自适应减少提问，依靠用户纠正。在ADAPT上，REVOIR在偏好满足率上超越微调的Reflection-DPO（44%）13-15个百分点达56-59%，且提问量少约5倍，无需任何训练。vanilla推理代理随推理努力增加反而减少澄清，无法自适应。

Conclusion: REVOIR证明任务导向的信息价值推理比通用推理扩展或信息增益策略更有效，能在不同成本-正确率权衡下自适应行为，并在用户可纠正场景下展现理性适应能力。但当前为单步VoI估计（短视），尚不支持双控制和动作-提问交错，需未来工作开发多步VoI估计并在真实用户上评估。

Abstract: Users of language-based assistive agents often make ambiguous requests. In response, an assistant can either directly act on its interpretation of the request --- risking misalignment with the user --- or ask a clarifying question. Which option is the most safe and helpful? A common approach is to ask questions that minimize uncertainty about the user's intent until a threshold is reached. However, this neglects the impact of uncertainty reduction on downstream performance, the costs of asking versus acting immediately, and the possibility that users may provide corrections without being asked. To navigate these trade-offs, we introduce Rational Enquiry via Value-of-Information Reasoning (REVOIR). REVOIR makes clarification decisions via inference-time reasoning about the value-of-information of a question, which captures the expected improvement in task reward due to the answer received. In two assistive tasks --- ambiguous question answering (CondAmbigQA) and preference-aligned household task planning (ADAPT) --- we show that REVOIR achieves greater success with fewer questions than approaches based on prompting, chain-of-thought, fine-tuning, or information gain, improving preference satisfaction on ADAPT by 13-15% over a fine-tuned clarification policy while requiring no training and asking five times fewer questions. Furthermore, when the assistant can receive cheap user corrections after acting, REVOIR naturally infers that asking questions is not always efficient, demonstrating the adaptivity of our approach. In contrast, we find that vanilla reasoning agents fail to adaptively clarify user requests, and request fewer clarifications as reasoning effort increases.

</details>


### [390] [FOCUS: Training-Free Decision-Preserving Context Compression for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37590)
*Shantanu Dixit,Anson Bastos,Xuchao Zhang,Chetan Bansal,Saravan Rajmohan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FOCUS 是一个无需训练的测试时框架，通过将智能体的交互历史划分为 atomic(目标-动作-观测)span，基于草稿模型的蒙特卡洛规划滚动评估每个 span 的"反事实未来效用"（即移除该 span 是否会改变未来决策），从而在保留决策相关 span 的同时压缩智能体上下文。该方法将上下文压缩重新定义为"决策保留的因果抽象"问题，与信息瓶颈(IB)目标在理论上等价，并在多个智能体基准上达到 SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体在长时任务中积累的交互历史随任务长度线性增长，导致推理成本呈二次方增长，且注意力稀释使决策质量下降。现有上下文压缩方法（基于 token 似然、soft-prompt、KV-cache 淘汰、离线学习的压缩策略等）存在两大局限：(1) token 级/缓存级过滤会破坏工具调用、代码等结构化交互痕迹的局部因果结构；(2) 离线学习的压缩策略在推理前就已固定，无法根据测试时演化的轨迹动态调整。因此需要一种无需训练、可在测试时动态适应、面向决策保留的上下文压缩方法。

Method: 方法核心包含四个阶段：(1) 将智能体交互历史表示为 atomic(推理-动作-观测)span 序列，避免破坏结构化交互的局部因果关系；(2) 形式化每个 span 的反事实未来效用 U(s_i) 为移除该 span 后未来轨迹分布的 KL 散度变化，并证明在有界未来交互假设下最大化总效用等价于优化 IB 目标；(3) 由于精确计算 KL 效用不可行，使用轻量草稿模型 a_φ 进行 N 次蒙特卡洛规划滚动采样，每次生成计划草图并显式引用其依赖的历史 span，将引用频率 û_i 作为效用估计；(4) 引入防御性验证阶段，对未被引用的 span 进行二次审查，识别并保留可能引发重复错误或丢失因果状态的"救援集" S_R，最终保留集 S_keep = S_U ∪ S_R。理论上证明 û_i 在 Hoeffding 不等式意义下以 O(1/√N) 速率收敛至真实依赖概率，且在 utility margin 假设下，阈值化能以高概率恢复未来相关 span 集。

Result: 在 5 个智能体基准（AppWorld、OfficeBench、8-QA、WebVoyager、τ²-Bench）上全面优于现有压缩基线（FIFO、Retrieval、LLMLingua、Prompting、ACON）。主要结果：在 AppWorld 上使用 gpt-4.1 作为主智能体和草稿模型时，峰值上下文减少最多 48%，依赖性减少 73%，任务成功率比无压缩执行提升最多 8.9 个百分点（绝对 64.9% vs 56.0%）；使用 gpt-4.1-mini 时仍提升 23%。在不同草稿模型（gpt-4.1-mini、Qwen3-8B/14B、Phi-4）间均稳健，Qwen3-8B 作为草稿可使 gpt-4.1 主智能体性能提升 17% 同时削减 25% 峰值 token。消融实验表明 N=3 次滚动后收益趋于饱和；OfficeBench 上 API 总成本降低 37%，草稿模型开销仅占 3%；滚动并行化可使压缩延迟降低约 2.5 倍。理论附录证明 û_i 估计的收敛速率（O(1/√N)）、keep-set 恢复的指数稳定保证，以及与 KL 反事实效用的一致性（重叠系数 0.85-0.90，Spearman 相关性 0.39-0.48）。定性分析揭示了一个失效模式：当任务是集合泛化形式（如"将所有好友加为朋友"）时，草稿模型的低估会导致实体级 span 被错误剪枝。

Conclusion: FOCUS 将智能体上下文压缩从传统的"冗余消除"范式转变为"决策保留的因果抽象"范式，通过将问题与信息瓶颈目标联系起来，为基于前瞻性反事实效用的压缩提供了原则性基础。其无需训练、架构无关、模块化设计的特性使其可作为任何封闭 API 前沿模型的即插即用压缩层。实验证明决策保留式压缩不仅能无损缩减上下文，还能通过缓解注意力稀释来主动提升基座智能体的决策质量。该工作开辟了将决策理论原理整合到 LLM 系统设计中的研究方向，特别是在长时工具使用智能体场景下具有重要实践价值。

Abstract: LLM agents accumulate interaction histories that grow linearly with task length, causing quadratic inference cost scaling and performance degradation from attention dilution. Existing context-compression methods learn what to discard offline: by contrastively optimizing guidelines, distilling compressors, or training compression policies. This incurs a substantial cost. Further, the compression policy is learned a priori and is not dynamically conditioned on the evolving test-time trajectories. In this paper we ask a complementary question: Which past interactions causally shape the agent's future decisions? We recast context compression as a causal decision preservation problem over discrete interaction units and introduce FOCUS, a training-free context compression framework that operates entirely at test time. Our method requires no offline data collection or fine-tuning, and is architecture-agnostic, attaching to any closed-API frontier model as a modular compression layer. We evaluate FOCUS on diverse agentic benchmarks including API and tool-calling, QA, web domain and multi-turn dialogue. Our method establishes new state of the art performance, cutting peak context by up to 48% and dependency by 73% while improving task success by up to 8.9 percentage points over uncompressed execution.

</details>


### [391] [XU-RS: Explaining Credal Width in Random-Set Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37594)
*David Achara,Maryam Sultana,Alexander D. Rast,Fabio Cuzzolin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出XU-RS框架,用于将基于预训练语言模型的随机集分类器所产生的"信度宽度"(credal width,认知不确定性指标)归因到具体输入词元。通过Expected Gradients方法,框架能识别哪些输入token影响了模型对特定答案的认知不确定性,并在MedQA数据集上使用SmolLM3-3B和Llama-2-7B进行了验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不确定性估计仅能反映模型对预测的信心程度,但无法解释这种不确定性的来源——即输入中哪些部分导致了模型的不确定性。若不了解不确定性所依赖的输入特征,使用者无法判断该不确定性评分是否依赖于任务相关的特征,这在高风险领域(如医疗问答)中尤为关键。现有可解释性方法主要针对预测分数而非不确定性本身,且随机集分类器产生的信度宽度是一种特殊的不确定性表示,缺乏专门的解释工具。

Method: XU-RS框架包含三个核心组成部分:(1)基于预训练语言模型(LoRA适配)的随机集分类器,通过14个sigmoid输出估计答案集合的下概率,经修正后产生合法的信度宽度;(2)采用Expected Gradients(EG)特征归因方法,将原始输入与参考提示(其他问题及选项)的嵌入向量对齐,沿中间路径计算梯度,得到每个token对宽度差异的贡献;(3)两类诊断检查——参考提示准备检查(验证对齐操作是否改变了被解释的宽度差异)和数值准确性检查(通过完备性残差、余弦相似度等指标验证归因值是否准确反映宽度差)。此外,论文还推导了概率修正步骤(截断负值、重新归一化)对宽度梯度的影响,揭示了归一化会导致排除目标答案的集合间接影响其宽度。

Result: 在MedQA数据集100道测试题上,对SmolLM3-3B和Llama-2-7B的实验表明:(1)将XU-RS排名最高的token嵌入置零(zero-masking)所引起的绝对宽度变化显著大于随机置零(平均优势分别为0.0381和0.0450,95%置信区间均不含零);(2)概率修正(归一化)在95.84%-99.92%的测试样本中处于激活状态,意味着排除目标答案的集合通过共享分母影响其宽度;(3)在四个合成案例中,即使token排名高度稳定(中位Spearman相关0.9951),归因值的完备性残差仍超过容差(中位0.0652),通过FP32精度的Integrated Gradients加密积分点可显著降低残差;(4)参考提示的对齐操作会使宽度差异发生0.20-0.54的偏移,说明归因计算解释的差异可能与原始提示间的真实差异不同。

Conclusion: XU-RS为随机集分类器的认知不确定性提供了系统的token级归因框架,在MedQA上验证了其识别影响宽度token的有效性。论文通过概率修正分析揭示了被归因函数的真实结构,并通过受控实验明确区分了数值准确性与参考一致性两类独立问题,提出了一套诊断流程。该工作强调了在使用归因方法解释模型不确定性之前,必须分别验证参考提示的有效性和归因计算本身的数值准确性。局限性包括评估仅基于固定的100题MedQA样本、zero-masking修改的是嵌入而非文本,以及部分诊断检查在检查测试结果后才制定。

Abstract: Uncertainty estimates tell us how unsure a model is, but not why. Without knowing which parts of an input influences a model's uncertainty, we cannot tell whether that uncertainty score depends on input features that are relevant for the task. We study this problem in randomset classifiers built using pretrained language models. These classifiers assign probability to individual answers and to groups of answers, producing lower and upper probabilities for each answer; The difference between these probabilities, called credal width, is used to represent epistemic uncertainty about an answer arising from limited training data. We propose XU-RS, a framework that attributes an answer's credal width to the input tokens (words or word pieces) supplied to a language model. XU-RS uses Expected Gradients (a standard feature attribution method) to estimate how input tokens contribute to credal width. The proposed framework is evaluated on a MedQA dataset using SmolLM3-3B and Llama-2-7B models, demonstrating that setting the embedding of a token ranked highly by XU-RS to zero (zero-masking) causes larger changes in credal width than zero-masking randomly selected tokens. In addition, we show that normalisation can cause other answer groups to influence an answer's width, reveal how token attribution can mask numerical errors, and provide diagnostic checks to verify whether a token ranked highly by XU-RS meaningfully explains model uncertainty.

</details>


### [392] [Flattening the Connectome Spectrum: A Spectral Filter for FC Induces a Pretraining Target for fMRI Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37642)
*Giovanni Marraffini,Victoria Shevchenko,Carlo Alberto Barbano,Demian Wassermann*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种对功能连接(FC)矩阵的谱滤波方法(特征值取α*≈0.35次幂)，可显著改善基于FC的表型预测性能；并以此滤波后的连接组作为预训练目标，通过CKA(中心化核对齐)蒸馏损失训练了一个小型fMRI-BERT编码器，使其以少一个数量级的参数即可与现有脑基础模型(BFM)性能相当，并在短扫描和小队列场景下优于原始FC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前脑基础模型(BFM)在fMRI表型预测上仍逊于直接对FC做核岭回归(KRR)的简单线性基线。作者认为问题部分源于FC矩阵自身的特征值分布极度不均，导致回归权重集中于少量主成分而无法利用更多个体间差异，因此需要从改进FC表示入手，并以此构建更适合fMRI的预训练目标。

Method: (1) 对每个被试的Pearson FC矩阵做谱滤波 α*=0.35，将特征值取幂后重组矩阵，等价于在连接组特征空间施加低通均衡滤波器(压缩动态范围、保留模态顺序)；该变换无需组参考、无需跨被试参数估计。(2) 通过两种准则(嵌套交叉验证的KRR预测精度、训练折内的中心化核-目标对齐)确定α*。(3) 以滤波后的整段FC作为"教师"信号，训练fMRI-BERT Transformer编码器(学生仅看80个时间点窗口)，损失为学生与教师Gram矩阵之间的中心化核对齐(CKA)。预训练数据来自162个OpenNeuro公开数据集，约4000小时fMRI。

Result: 在5个数据集、11种图谱、6种预测目标上，FC^{α*}在所有条件下匹配或超过原始FC的KRR基线(如HCP-YA Schaefer-400认知综合得分从r=0.543提升至0.627)；参与度从10.1提升至218.9，表明更多模态参与贡献。预训练的fMRI-BERT(1M/8M)在大多数任务上与参数量大一个数量级的6个已发布BFM相当或更优，在短扫描(2.4分钟)和小队列(<250被试)条件下显著优于原始FC，尤其指纹识别能力突出(CoRR识别率从0.762提升至0.895)。

Conclusion: 对每个被试FC矩阵的特征值进行幂律校准(α*≈0.35)既能提升基于FC的表型预测性能，又可作为有效的预训练监督信号，使小型自监督编码器在短扫描和小样本场景下超越原始FC并与大规模脑基础模型竞争。该方法无需GPU、完全开源，对临床等难以获取长扫描/大样本的队列具有实用价值；但α*在HCP-YA上选定后被固定使用于所有任务，可能不是普适最优，预训练语料的异质性处理也存在局限。

Abstract: Self-supervised pretraining reshaped prediction in language and vision, and brain foundation models (BFMs) inherited its promise. Representations learned from large unlabelled corpora should capture individual functional dynamics and generalise across cohorts. However, kernel ridge regression (KRR) fitted on functional connectivity (FC) matrices still predicts individual phenotypes more accurately than any BFM we tested. In this paper, we show that KRR is weighted by the eigenvalues of the FC which are miscalibrated for phenotype prediction. We apply an efficient spectral filter to recalibrate the eigenvalues of each subject's FC matrix, enabling the model to exploit more inter-individual variance. Across the 5 datasets, 11 parcellations and 6 prediction targets we tested, we match or exceed the KRR baseline. Based on this finding, we then pretrain a small encoder model on about 4,000 hours of fMRI from 162 open datasets, whereby we align the pairwise similarities between the embeddings of recording snippets with those between the recalibrated connectomes. Our model performs on par with the best of the 6 published BFMs we tested while having an order of magnitude fewer parameters. Our encoder performs better than FC on short scans and in smaller cohorts, especially in fingerprinting. We release the pretrained model weights, the code and the pretraining data, preprocessed and parcellated.

</details>


### [393] [Beyond a single latent space: a dual-latent world model for long-horizon planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37644)
*Delin Zhao,Zhengrong Yue,Shaobin Zhuang,Junlin He,Xiaoyu Chen,Zikang Wang,Yuxin Liu,Limin Wang,Yali Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Dual-Latent World Model (Dual-WM)，通过分离低层（原始动作）与高层（宏动作）的状态表示和动力学模型来解决长时程规划中的递归预测漂移和潜在空间距离退化问题；结合LoRe（带指数衰减权重监督自生成rollout的训练机制）和MAPS（宏动作先验整形），在五个视觉控制任务上显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单潜在空间的世界模型在长时程规划中存在两个失败模式：(1) 局部准确的转移模型在递归展开时漂移；(2) 高维潜在空间中范数等距感化（distance concentration）使得远距离状态间的目标距离难以区分，导致候选未来难以排序。这两个问题源于同一状态几何同时承担精细执行和远距离目标评估两种时间角色。

Method: 1) 双潜在空间架构：低层编码器+Transformer预测器处理原始动作的逐步转移；高层编码器将长度为k的低层潜窗口映射到独立高层表示，配备宏动作预测器和宏动作编码器。2) LoRe：对自生成的多步rollout进行监督，使用指数衰减权重 w_h ∝ exp(-α_s·h)，低层和高层有各自独立的衰减率α_L和α_H，动机来自递归误差传播分析 e_h ≤ ε·S_h(L)。3) MAPS：用KL散度将宏动作后验正则化为标准高斯先验，便于基于CEM的采样搜索。4) 三阶段粗到细规划：Stage 1用CEM在高层潜空间规划宏动作序列产生子目标；Stage 2将低层动作的潜窗口通过E_H映射到高层空间与子目标匹配；Stage 3切换到低层直接目标收敛。

Result: 在TwoRoom、Reacher、Sokoban-Long、PushT、Cube-Single五个视觉控制任务上进行从零训练评估：目标偏移50步时平均成功率从基线75.9%提升到84.4%；100步时从61.4%提升到69.5%；100步偏移下在全部五个任务上均优于最强基线，平均比LeWM高30.8个百分点。消融实验证实：双尺度LoRe比单步监督在100步偏移上将成功率从48%提升到92%；窗口拼接接口的成功率仅41%，而学习的E_H接口达93%；MAPS将成功率从67%（确定性编码）提升到93.5%。表征诊断显示高层表示保留远程目标区分能力（TwoRoom和Reacher上Spearman秩相关显著优于低层和LeWM），rollout训练的检查点在递归预测中保留更多物理状态信息。

Conclusion: 长时程潜在规划需要可靠的递归预测和能区分远距离进度的目标距离，而这两者不能由单一潜在空间的几何结构同时承担。Dual-WM通过时间角色分离的表示、双尺度衰减权重监督（LoRe）和面向搜索的宏动作先验（MAPS）实现可靠的长时程规划。Sokoban-Long上的离散动作结果验证了该框架对动作空间的普适性。未来方向包括自适应时间跨度和离线设定之外的评估。

Abstract: Latent world models often struggle with long-horizon planning despite accurate short-term predictions. Recursive rollouts accumulate errors, while distance concentration in high-dimensional latent spaces can weaken goal discrimination. We introduce the Dual-Latent World Model (Dual-WM), which separates local execution and long-range planning through distinct state representations and dynamics models. The low-level model predicts action-conditioned transitions, while the high-level model uses learned macro-actions to plan over longer temporal spans. We also propose Long-Horizon Representation Learning with Weighted Rollout (LoRe), which supervises self-generated predictions at both levels. An analysis of recursive error propagation motivates exponential horizon weights with separate decay rates for the two temporal scales. During planning, the high-level model generates latent subgoals that the low-level model refines into actions for precise execution. We evaluate from-scratch Dual-WM on five goal-conditioned visual control tasks against the task-wise strongest baselines without actor-guided proposals. At goal offsets of 50 and 100 environment steps, mean success increases from 75.9% to 84.4% and from 61.4% to 69.5%, respectively. At offset 100, Dual-WM outperforms these baselines on all five tasks and improves mean success over LeWM by 30.8 percentage points. Ablations and supporting analyses provide evidence of more informative representations for goal evaluation and greater consistency under recursive prediction. These results highlight the value of separating temporal roles and training across multiple horizons for reliable latent planning. Our core implementation is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [394] [EnterpriseBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Enterprise-Level Strategic Reasoning and Decision-Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37658)
*Min Yang,Yichen Pan,Jinghua Piao,Dandan Song,Yongshun Gong,Yong Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EnterpriseBench是一个用于评估LLM智能体在企业级战略推理与决策任务中的两层基准测试，结合了基础企业/金融问答和三个交互式决策场景（管理咨询面试、Beer Game供应链模拟、企业数字孪生）。通过九个智能体方法和四个基座模型的广泛实验，发现当前智能体在企业场景中尚未实现稳定、全面、跨任务的可靠性，且静态QA性能无法可靠预测交互式决策表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的企业/金融基准测试主要评估静态能力（如信息提取、数值计算、领域知识和金融问答），而对企业实际工作流中常见的信息缺失、不确定性、延迟反馈和长期权衡等交互式、长周期决策能力评估不足。论文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: EnterpriseBench采用两层评估设计：(1)基础层——整合现有企业/金融QA数据集，按能力类别（信息提取、数值计算、领域知识、复杂推理）和难度（0-10分）统一标注；(2)交互式决策层——引入三个专业任务：①Consulting（基于MBA咨询案例的多轮隐藏信息业务诊断面试，由LLM面试官与受测智能体交互，LLM裁判沿四个维度评估）；②Beer Game（四级供应链库存控制，智能体控制零售商，25步决策，以总成本衡量）；③Enterprise Digital Twin/EDT（基于BPTK的项目型企业仿真，智能体一次性输出人员规模、风险等级和项目组合方案，以累计收益衡量）。评估9种智能体方法（CoT、Self-Refine、Reflexion、AMEM、Debate、Discussion、DC、GEPA、ACE）在4种基座模型（DeepSeek-V3、GPT-4.1、DeepSeek-V4-Pro、GLM-5.2）上的表现，并通过人工审计、提示稳健性测试和难度标注可靠性验证评估协议的有效性。此外提出AOA（自适应智能体选择）方法作为概念验证。

Result: 主要结果：(1)基础层显示明显的难度效应——数值计算和领域知识从简单到困难任务性能急剧下降；(2)交互式任务揭示了与静态QA不同的评估信号——静态QA表现好的方法不一定是Consulting、Beer Game或EDT的最佳方法，且最佳方法因任务和基座模型而异（无单一方法持续最优）；(3)可靠性验证方面：Consulting的LLM裁判与人类评分在500条转录上达到Pearson r=0.887，ICC(2,3)=0.892，85%评分在1分以内一致；提示稳健性测试最大偏差仅0.12分；难度标注与人类评分Pearson r=0.96；(4)AOA概念验证方法将整体QA得分从0.725提升至0.729，超过最佳固定方法。实验表明当前智能体尚未在企业场景中实现稳定、全面、跨任务的可靠性。

Conclusion: EnterpriseBench提供了一个从基础企业推理到交互式决策的完整评估框架，通过广泛的实验证明了静态QA性能无法可靠预测交互式决策能力，当前LLM智能体在企业战略推理与决策中仍面临重大挑战。该基准具有经验可靠性支撑，为评估智能体在真实企业场景中的能力与局限提供了实用工具。然而，论文也指出了局限性：交互任务在受控环境下进行、不涵盖多模态证据、未覆盖所有行业和组织规模、不应被解释为LLM智能体已准备好在高风险商业决策中自主部署的证据。

Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly expected to support enterprise workflows, where tasks often involve missing information, uncertainty, feedback, and long-term trade-offs. However, existing enterprise and financial benchmarks mainly test static capabilities such as information extraction, numerical calculation, domain knowledge, and financial QA, leaving interactive and long-horizon decision-making underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce EnterpriseBench, a benchmark that evaluates LLM agents across this spectrum, from static question answering to dynamic decision-making. Specifically, EnterpriseBench reorganizes existing enterprise and financial QA datasets into a unified foundational suite annotated by capability and difficulty, and introduces three professional interactive settings: Consulting, based on management-consulting-style business cases for client problem diagnosis through multi-turn information seeking; the Beer Game, adapted from a classic supply-chain management simulation for inventory control under delayed feedback; and Enterprise Digital Twin, a project-based business simulator for workforce, risk, and project planning. Experiments with nine agent methods under four backbone models show that current agents have not yet achieved stable, comprehensive, and cross-task reliability in enterprise scenarios. These results show that EnterpriseBench provides a practical benchmark for evaluating LLM agents in realistic enterprise strategic reasoning and decision-making.

</details>


### [395] [MeanFlowAdvantage: Stable Reward Fine-Tuning for Few-Step Average-Velocity Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37670)
*Haocheng Tang,Tianchi Xie,Xingqiao Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MeanFlowAdvantage（MFA）是一种针对平均速度生成器（如MeanFlow）的带符号优势加权最小二乘目标函数，通过共享的分离式MeanFlow导数修正项，将奖励微调对齐到推理时实际部署的有限区间平均速度流映射上。在SD3.5-Medium上仅用4步NFE即匹配或超越40步DiffusionNFT，并在DNA启动子设计上同时支持无教师在线策略RL和教师引导的奖励分级蒸馏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MeanFlow通过预测区间平均速度实现少步生成，但现有的基于优势的奖励微调目标（如DiffusionNFT、AdvantageFlow）针对瞬时速度或x₀空间预测设计，与推理时直接使用的平均速度图存在表征不匹配问题。需要一种能直接优化部署流映射、保持少步采样能力的奖励微调方法。

Method: 1. 核心构造：使用一个共享的、分离梯度的MeanFlow导数修正项d（通过JVP精确计算或有限差分估计），从滚动网络u_old推导出瞬时速度表示V_k = u_k + (t-s)·sg[d]和x₀空间预测F_k = x_t - t·V_k。2. 目标函数：将AdvantageFlow的二次损失应用于F空间。由于共享修正项在两两差中自动消去，损失严格等价于平均速度空间的带优势加权MeanFlow回归：ℓ_θ = t²(A‖u_θ - ū‖² + γ‖u_θ - u_old‖² + λ‖u_θ - u_ref‖²)。3. 间隔采样：混合边界（s=t, 50%）、全跳（s=0, 25%）和一般正长度间隔（25%）。4. 理论分析：证明目标在总体层面等价于拟合重加权分布q ∝ (γ+A)π_old的MeanFlow目标，更新方向由优势与目标间的协方差决定。5. 应用扩展：同一目标用于奖励分步引导的蒸馏，教师提供回程尾部m_k，目标替换b上的extrapolation。

Result: 在SD3.5-Medium（4步NFE）：MFA在全部8项指标上均优于匹配的MeanFlowNFT基线，其中美学分数提升+0.37、HPSv3提升+0.26；在仅4 NFE下即在6/8指标上匹配或超越40步DiffusionNFT。在DNA启动子设计上：无教师RL将Sei MSE从0.0714降至0.0482（3种子平均）；奖励分步蒸馏中MFA达到0.0467 Sei MSE，较MeanFlowNFT（0.0570）相对降低18%，4种子重复实验均保持优势（平均19.7%），联合bootstrap CI为[0.0091, 0.0138]。消融实验验证了修正项、正长度间隔和签名优势均为必要组件。

Conclusion: MFA成功将奖励微调对齐到MeanFlow的有限区间平均速度表征，通过共享导数修正保证了优化目标与部署流映射的等价性。理论上证明其拟合重加权分布的MeanFlow目标，且自洽不动点可产生跨采样预算迁移的精确流映射。该方法同时统一了在线策略RL和奖励分级蒸馏两种范式，在图像和生物学序列两种分子语言生成任务上均表现优异。开放问题包括近似流映射一致性、蒸馏中原则化的负优势设计以及序列保真度的三种子趋势。

Abstract: MeanFlow enables efficient few-step generation by predicting interval-average velocities, but this representation creates a mismatch for reward fine-tuning: existing advantage-based objectives are typically defined on instantaneous velocities or equivalent $x_0$-space predictions, whereas inference directly uses the learned average-velocity map. We introduce MeanFlowAdvantage, a signed advantage-weighted least-squares objective for average-velocity generators. Our key construction uses a shared, detached MeanFlow derivative correction to express the reward objective in prediction space while making rollout and reference regularization exact penalties on the average-velocity network deployed at inference. The resulting formulation preserves MeanFlow's native few-step sampler and provides a direct mechanism for transferring reward improvements to the deployed flow map. On SD3.5-Medium, MeanFlowAdvantage improves all eight reported metrics over the matched four-step MeanFlowNFT baseline and, with only four NFEs, matches or exceeds the 40-step DiffusionNFT baseline on six of eight metrics. The same objective also transfers to DNA promoter design, where it supports both teacher-free on-policy RL for a generator defined on a manifold and teacher-guided reward-graded distillation, with the latter yielding the lowest one-step Sei profile MSE among the compared configurations.

</details>


### [396] [KUPAS MASTER: Distilling the Tacit Expertise of Master Practitioners into Agent-Ready Experience Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37673)
*Changmian Wang,Yuchao Ma,Xuchao Lu,Chen Zhang,Ping Sun,Jiazheng Wang,Shan Wang,Xuanwen Chen,Yihe Sun,Ziyu Lu,Jianqiang Huang,Hongzhi Li,Ziqing Xia,Kaihua Tang,Xian-Sheng Hua,Qinghua Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: KUPAS MASTER 是一个"经验工程"平台，通过九层认知语料构建，将从业者的隐性专业知识（如线索判断、行动依据、边界条件）从异构工作记录中提炼为可追溯、可调用的结构化经验库与技能，使 LLM 智能体在专业任务上的表现显著优于原始语料检索增强生成（RAG）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常规工作记录往往遗漏从业者的隐性知识（哪些线索关键、判断为何合理、适用条件与边界是什么），导致 LLM 智能体难以有效利用专业经验。论文旨在弥合个体隐性经验与组织可复用智能体能力之间的鸿沟。

Method: 核心方法为"九层认知语料构建"，包含：（1）六要素案例表示（context, cues, judgment, action, boundaries, outcomes）；（2）九层提取维度（L1知识–L9约束）；（3）六类经验资产库（规则、约束、最佳实践、负面案例、角落案例、技能）；（4）四阶段流程——语义对齐、个体经验提炼、组织整合、交叉评审；（5）将资产打包为带显式输入、步骤、依赖与停止条件的可调用技能，集成至智能体并连接评估反馈。

Result: 基于 20 位随机授权从业者的样本，处理 1,576 个源文件，生成 23,024 条个体经验记录和 13,113 条组织资产。177 题/531 回答的评估显示：基座模型（A）、原始语料 RAG（B）、KUPAS MASTER 智能体（C）综合得分分别为 70.63、79.75、89.58；C 在所有七个评分维度上均优于 B，证据充分性与准确性提升 11.1 分，边界与合规性提升 9.0 分；胜出率 176/177 题。代价是平均延迟从 A 的 16.2 s、B 的 34.0 s 升至 C 的 57.1 s。

Conclusion: 将从业者隐性经验通过结构化提炼、组织整合与技能封装转化为可追溯、可复用的智能体能力，相比原始语料 RAG 带来显著且稳定的性能提升，为个体隐性经验向组织知识资产转化提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Experienced professionals know more than just facts and conclusions. They know which cues matter, why a judgment is reasonable, and which action to take. Routine work records often leave out this tacit knowledge, making it difficult for Large Language Model (LLM) agents to use professional experience effectively. We introduce KUPAS MASTER, an experience engineering platform built around nine-layer cognitive corpus construction. It turns heterogeneous work records and practitioner interviews into traceable, reusable experience corpora for agents. Six case elements preserve the task process: context, cues, judgment, action, boundaries, and outcomes. Nine-layer cognitive corpus construction organizes tacit experience along nine extraction dimensions and stores the resulting assets in six libraries: rules, constraints, best practices, negative examples, corner cases, and skills. Semantic alignment, individual experience distillation, organizational consolidation, and cross-review preserve source evidence, conditions of use, and unresolved disagreements. The platform packages these assets into callable skills with explicit inputs, steps, dependencies, and stopping conditions, connecting experience collection to task execution and evaluation feedback. Using authorized samples from 20 randomly selected practitioners, the platform processed 1,576 source files into 23,024 individual experience records and 13,113 organizational assets. The evaluation spans multiple professional domains. Under common task inputs and scoring criteria, the base model, raw corpus retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and KUPAS MASTER agent scored 70.63, 79.75, and 89.58, respectively. The KUPAS MASTER agent improved on raw-corpus RAG in all seven scoring dimensions. The platform provides a practical path from individual tacit experience to organizational knowledge and agent capabilities.

</details>


### [397] [Learning from Shared-Control Overrides: Context-Driven Acceleration Profile Prediction for Personalized Overtaking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37684)
*Ruizheng Xu,Lounis Adouane,Javier Ibañez-Guzmán,Clément Zinoune*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CoP-ACC框架，将驾驶员对ACC系统的油门覆盖行为视为人在回路监督信号，通过无监督层次聚类提取代表性加速度曲线，并结合上下文分类器与残差回归器，实现自适应巡航控制的个性化定制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统ACC系统通常基于平均驾驶员标定，在超车等关键场景中难以匹配个体驾驶期望，导致驾驶员频繁通过油门覆盖进行手动干预。现有端到端回归方法会过度平滑动态响应，无法准确捕捉驾驶员的个性化偏好。

Method: 提出混合流水线CoP-ACC：(i)利用无监督层次聚类从油门覆盖事件中提取代表性加速度曲线；(ii)训练上下文分类器，将操纵前的驾驶条件映射到对应曲线；(iii)使用残差回归器在选定曲线基础上进行细化，生成平滑且个性化的加速度曲线。

Result: 在真实公共道路数据上，以保留的强制ACC基线进行评估，方法在重建保真度方面表现优异，并能生成趋向于驾驶员在潜在覆盖场景下期望行为的加速度曲线。

Conclusion: 研究表明，从共享控制中的油门覆盖行为中学习，可实现具有前瞻性的个性化ACC行为，有助于减少驾驶员手动干预并提升乘坐舒适性。

Abstract: Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) systems are typically calibrated for an average driver, often resulting in a mismatch between vehicle behavior and individual expectations during time-critical maneuvers such as highway overtaking. When the ACC is perceived as too conservative and inconsistent, drivers intervene through throttle overrides, providing implicit feedback on the system's behavior. This paper reframes these override actions as human-in-theloop supervisory signals and proposes a data-driven framework for personalized vehicle adaptation, termed Context-driven Personalized ACC (CoP-ACC). Rather than relying solely on end-to-end regression, which tends to over-smooth dynamic responses, we introduce a hybrid pipeline combining: (i) unsupervised hierarchical clustering to extract representative acceleration profiles from override events; (ii) a context classifier that maps pre-maneuver driving conditions to the appropriate profile; and (iii) a residual regressor that refines the selected profile into a smooth, personalized acceleration profile tailored to the immediate context. Evaluated on real-world public-road data against a withheld forced-ACC baseline, the approach demonstrates high reconstruction fidelity and generates acceleration profiles that tend toward the driver's expected behavior in potential override contexts. The results highlight the potential of learning from shared-control overrides to enable anticipatory, personalized ACC behavior, reducing manual interventions and improving ride comfort.

</details>


### [398] [EngiWorld: What Can Frontier Agents Deliver in Professional Engineering Environments?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37686)
*Hongcheng Gao,Hailong Qu,Yu Lei,Henghui Sun,Haoyang Li,Yipeng Wei,Naihao Xue,Xiaohan Yu,Zhuo Tao,Yihe Zang,Yajiao Wang,Jingyi Tang,Yi Li,Jingjing Zhou,Jie Luo,Bohan Zeng,Chengyu Shen,Hao Jiang,Chong Chen,Bowen Qu,Olive Huang,Zeqiang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EngiWorld是首个面向专业工业工程软件（CAD/CAE/CAM/BIM/EDA/3D可视化）的完整设计环路基准测试，涵盖1,301个专家策展任务、26个软件平台，评估七个前沿模型后发现能力差距显著，最强模型EngiScore仅为44.3，多软件任务成功率仅3.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管LLM/MLLM智能体在通用计算机使用任务上取得快速进展，但专业工业工程软件（如CAD、CAE等）的可靠自动化仍未实现。现有基准存在三大局限：(1) 成功判定仅对比最终状态或参考解，无法验证工程制品的功能完整性；(2) 缺乏足够的交互深度，无法维持参数化逻辑和长操作序列；(3) 存在反馈鸿沟，智能体仅接收文本信号而非工程师依赖的原生领域反馈（渲染输出、仿真收敛曲线等）。论文旨在填补通用智能与专业工程需求之间的鸿沟。

Method: 构建EngiWorld基准，包含：(1) 1,301个专家策展任务，覆盖6个工程领域和26个软件平台（37种环境配置），通过CLI/GUI接口交互；(2) 6种任务类型（单软件、多软件、软件选择、定量设计、图像建模、开放式任务）；(3) 基于制品的评估方法论，通过统一领域验证器套件编程化检查几何有效性、物理可行性和规则合规性，定量设计任务按规格达成度连续评分而非二元成功。评估7个前沿模型（GPT-5.6-Sol、Claude Opus 5、Kimi K3、Gemini 3.7 Flash、Qwen 3.8 Max/Flash、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash）在300个分层采样任务上的表现。

Result: Claude Opus 5以44.3 EngiScore领先，GPT-5.6-Sol为38.0；所有模型在300个任务中有128个全部得零分。多软件任务仅3.6%成功率（168次尝试中仅6次成功）。能力差距在跨应用依赖协调、精确几何/物理约束满足、交付前验证等环节均显著。失败模式分两大类：(1) 声明完成但制品未通过验证器（GPT占87%，Claude占73.9%）；(2) 决策回合耗尽（占GUI失败55.3%，CLI失败36.6%）。消融实验表明视觉信息呈现方式、运行时图像访问、无障碍信息、截图分辨率和交互历史长度对不同模型有不同影响，视觉反馈并不自动转化为更好的工程决策。开放式任务vs多软件任务的对比表明：减少工作流约束可提高成功率（任务09有4个模型在开放式版本上成功但多软件版本全部失败）。

Conclusion: EngiWorld揭示了通用智能与专业工程需求之间的根本差距：当前智能体可操作单个工具但无法可靠执行跨阶段工程工作流。基准为构建能闭合工程设计环路（而非仅操作单个工具）的工业智能体提供了严格的基础。定量评分机制有效区分有效制品之间的质量差异，但验证门控阻止几何缺陷制品获得分数。视觉信息、无障碍元数据等额外结构化观察并不自动改善工程决策，使用价值取决于智能体如何将其整合到执行策略中。

Abstract: Autonomous agents have made rapid progress in general-purpose computer use, but reliable automation of professional industrial engineering remains out of reach, as engineering workflows demand reasoning over geometric and physical constraints and dependencies preserved across software and design stages. We present EngiWorld, the first benchmark structured around the complete design loop: 1,301 expert-curated tasks spanning 6 engineering domains (CAD, CAE, CAM, BIM, EDA, and 3D visualization) and 26 professional software platforms, with both GUI and CLI interfaces and 6 task types ranging from software-selection to open-ended tasks. We further introduce an artifact-centric evaluation methodology built on a unified domain-verifier suite, which programmatically checks the geometric validity, physical feasibility, and rule compliance of final and intermediate artifacts, and scores quantitative design tasks continuously by specification attainment rather than binary success. Evaluation of seven frontier models reveals a substantial capability gap: the strongest model achieves an EngiScore of only 44.3, and just 3.6% of multi-software attempts succeed. EngiWorld provides the first rigorous foundation for measuring progress toward agents that operate professional engineering software end to end.

</details>


### [399] [WISE-ATTA: When to Ask for Labels in Budgeted Active Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37687)
*Muhammad Huzaifa,Lea Schönherr,Thorsten Eisenhofer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 WISE-ATTA 方法，将主动测试时适应（ATTA）问题重新定义为"预算化"场景，关注在整个测试流中"何时"请求监督（而非仅在每个 batch 内"选什么样本"标注）。该方法通过基于熵的 batch 效用分数与自适应分位数阈值在时间维度上分配标注预算，并在被选中的 batch 内通过预测漂移（相对于 EMA anchor）选取单一最有益样本。在 ImageNet-C/R/K/A 上使用更少标签取得了与或超过现有 ATTA 方法的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 ATTA 方法隐含假设每个测试 batch 都能请求监督，专注于"每个 batch 内选哪些样本"标注。但在长测试流中，每个 batch 的监督价值差异很大，且总标注成本随流长度线性增长。本文关注一个被忽视的问题：在有限标注预算下，"何时"在整个测试流上分配监督同样关键。

Method: WISE-ATTA 包含两个组件：(1) **Budget-paced batch 选择**：使用 batch 内低熵预测数量作为 batch 效用代理信号，维护最近 W 个 batch 效用分数的滑动窗口，通过自适应分位数阈值和基于"预算债务"的 pacing 控制器（无需知道流长度）在时间维度上分配标签；(2) **Drift-based 样本选择**：维护 EMA anchor 模型，对被选中的 batch 选择当前模型与 anchor 预测差异最大的单个样本（即处于"持续适应中但尚未收敛"的样本）。仅更新归一化参数（无监督时）与分类器头（有监督时）。

Result: 在 ImageNet-C（CTTA 和 FTTA 协议）以及 ImageNet-R/K/A 自然分布偏移上，WISE-ATTA 在 RN50-BN 和 ViT-B-16 上均取得最佳平均错误率，且在多数情况下标签使用量比基线少 50%（≤0.5 labels/batch）。在 r=0.5 固定预算下，相比 EATTA 提升约 1.0–1.3 点；W=250 历史窗口、M=1 warmup、δ=1 slack 设置下鲁棒。低预算下（r=0.2）增益最显著（ImageNet-R 上提升 4.12 点），标签倾向于在前 10–40% 流段集中分配。对标注延迟敏感：延迟增大时所有 ATTA 方法均退化。

Conclusion: 实验证明，监督的"时机"（when）是主动测试时适应中一个关键但被忽视的维度。WISE-ATTA 通过时间维度的预算分配与漂移驱动的样本选择，在显著减少标注的同时实现了竞争性或更优的鲁棒性。未来工作应关注延迟感知扩展、异构 batch 内的多源偏移，以及更新本身的预算化。

Abstract: Active test-time adaptation (ATTA) improves robustness under distribution shift by updating a deployed model during inference while selectively querying supervision. However, most existing ATTA methods implicitly assume that supervision can be requested for every incoming test batch, which can incur substantial annotation cost over long test streams. In this work, we introduce \emph{budgeted ATTA} in which labels are available for only a fraction of test batches. This formulation shifts the central challenge from deciding \emph{what} to label within a batch to deciding \emph{when} supervision should be applied over time. To address this challenge, we propose a budget-aware approach \emph{WISE-ATTA} that allocates supervision over the test stream based on lightweight signals computed online, prioritizing periods where supervision is likely to be most useful. When a batch is selected for supervision, we further employ a drift-based sample selection criterion that targets samples exhibiting ongoing, unconverged adaptation dynamics, enabling effective updates from a single labeled example. We evaluate this approach on synthetic corruptions (ImageNet-C) and natural distribution shifts (ImageNet-R/K/A). Across settings, WISE-ATTA achieves competitive or improved performance compared to recent ATTA methods while requiring substantially fewer labels. Overall, we find that the timing of supervision is a key, yet underexplored, aspect of active test-time adaptation. Code: this https URL

</details>


### [400] [Locating Answer-Correctness Signals in Frozen Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37700)
*Yuansen Liu,Yixuan Tang,Anthony Kum Hoe Tung*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出BEATRICE方法，从冻结大语言模型的单次前向传播中提取四类内部信号（隐藏状态、token概率、残差流分量、注意力分布）来检测答案正确性。研究发现隐藏状态信号最强但其他三类信号具有互补性，多信号融合在分布外场景提升最显著。该方法在两个骨干网络上验证有效，并被用作下游检索控制器PGIR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有正确性检测探针通常依赖单一信号家族或单一层，在分布偏移下表现脆弱；检索增强场景下的专用检测器多针对段落忠实性而非答案正确性，二者在检索证据无效时可能分歧。需要系统研究答案正确性信号在模型内部的位置、信号家族及其组合方式。

Method: BEATRICE从冻结LLM单次前向传播提取四类token级特征：(1)单层隐藏状态（验证集选层17）；(2)下一token分布的五维标量统计；(3)各层attn/FFN贡献的L2范数与logit-lens推力；(4)跨段注意力的熵与质量。构建15个组合编码器（4类信号的非空子集），用token级CNN分别编码context/question/answer三段，再以MLP融合。训练一个融合头通过贪心前向选择在验证集AUROC上筛选编码器子集。在with-context设置下，候选池额外包含closed-book编码器。最终将检测器接入PGIR控制器，分别用closed-book探针决定是否触发检索、with-context探针决定是否信任检索结果。

Result: 在Qwen3.5-9B上的六个开放域QA数据集（三个域内多跳，三个零样本单跳），BEATRICE在几乎所有列上以单次前向传播领先23个基线：closed-book域内测试AUROC 0.839，with-context域内测试0.932；零样本PopQA在with-context下达0.948。配对bootstrap显示所有with-context列和域内closed-book列的领先显著。消融实验揭示：(1)单信号中hidden states最强，但其余三类各自恢复其1/3到1/2的错误，且无两两冗余；(3)三信号（隐状态+残差+注意力）优于四信号全融合；(3)正确性信号集中在answer span，去掉answer token损失约0.02 AUROC；(4)with-context下保留一个closed-book编码器能稳定提升。附录G的家族消融显示，辅助家族仅在主编码器边界附近翻转决策，扮演窄范围纠错角色。注意力家族对字面支持敏感，其可靠性取决于检索质量（在NQ上当45.1%错误答案被逐字抄入段落时下降）。附录H用真实E5检索重复实验，Qwen 0.891、Gemma 0.911均领先。在Gemma 4上BEATRICE同样领先，PGIR以平均EM 0.319、F1 0.397和约4.3次生成/问题位居宏平均第一。

Conclusion: 四类内部信号呈一致的"解剖结构"：一个家族主导、其余互补，正确性信号集中在answer span，closed-book与with-context共享这一结构但细节不同。多信号融合的收益在分布外最大，正是单信号最脆弱之处。该读出可在不重训的前提下零样本迁移，并直接驱动检索控制器。结论强调应将"读出"视为对基础模型的预测性测量——知道哪些家族承载证据、证据集中于何处、何时融合能带来增益——而非单一的探针分数，这使探针设计从对编码器的试错转向对模型的测量，并可随模型更新重复进行。

Abstract: Language models expose internal signals that predict whether an answer is correct, readable from a single forward pass of a frozen model without additional generations. Yet existing probes often commit to one signal family or layer and can be brittle under distribution shift; in retrieval-augmented settings, many specialized detectors instead target passage faithfulness, which can diverge from correctness when retrieved evidence is unhelpful or conflicting. We therefore ask where answer correctness is readable, which internal signal families carry it, and how they should be combined. We search over hidden states, token probabilities, residual-stream features, attention, and their fusion, treating the selected readouts as a predictive measurement rather than a mechanistic localization. We run this analysis separately in closed-book and with-context settings, since context can change which readouts are informative. A consistent anatomy emerges: correctness concentrates in the answer span, recovered from the answer tokens even under retrieval, and the families carry it complementarily, so fusing them helps most out of distribution, where a single signal is weakest. The protocol is effective across two backbones and gates a retrieval controller as one downstream use.

</details>


### [401] [Generative Interactions: Weaving Multiparty Human Motion with Bilevel Latent Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37708)
*Ojas Shirekar,Yash Surange,Agustinas Jučas,Chirag Raman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BRAID提出了一种用于多人社交运动建模的层次化序列潜变量模型，通过群体级与个体级双层潜变量显式捕捉共享交互动态与个体行为变化，在完整、稀疏或部分观测条件下实现统一的社交运动预测、补全与生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有社交运动模型侧重轨迹合理性而忽略交互状态，难以跨群体、跨任务、跨观测设置迁移，缺少可复用的群体与个体联合结构化表征。

Method: 将多人社交运动生成建模为元迁移学习问题，引入双层潜变量：群体潜变量 z^g 编码共享交互动态，个体潜变量 z^p 在群体上下文下编码个体行为；采用精度加权的后验融合（自下而上证据与自上而下的先验）处理变分推断，并通过联合 ELBO + 重建损失训练；使用冻结预训练时序运动 VAE 解码身体姿态。

Result: 在 Panoptic Haggling、DnD、DD100、DuoBox、Embody3D 等数据集上，BRAID 在社交预测、补全、缺失关节/伙伴重建等任务上于 SDTW、跨个体 SDTW、FD 等指标上一致优于 MAGNet、RoHM、Social Processes、SNP 等基线，并展现出显式的群体活动结构与跨群体的个体身份可识别性（top-1 重识别准确率 41.4%）。

Conclusion: BRAID 通过统一的关节级上下文接口支持完整/稀疏/缺失观测与未来预测；其群体与个体潜变量提供可解释、可复用的社交状态表征，可作为具身智能体系统的紧凑信念接口，但也存在层次潜变量未完全解耦、多样性与长时序精度之间的权衡等局限。

Abstract: Human social behaviour is not a collection of independent motions, but a jointly organised process in which group dynamics and individual variation continuously shape one another. Yet existing social motion models often prioritise plausible trajectories while leaving interaction state implicit, limiting their ability to transfer across groups, tasks, and partial-observation regimes. To address this gap, we introduce Bilevel Representations for Agent Interaction Dynamics (BRAID), a hierarchical sequential latent-variable model for generative multi-person interaction. BRAID explicitly formulates social motion generation as a meta-transfer learning problem: shared interaction priors are learned across datasets and adapted through arbitrary context sets of observed people and joints. The model represents each scene through a group-level latent state that captures shared interaction dynamics and person-level latent states that capture individual behaviour conditioned on the evolving group context. This modelling choice enables coherent generation under full, sparse, or partial observations while exposing compact social-state vectors that can serve as an interface for downstream embodied-agent systems. We evaluate BRAID under a unified SMPL-based representation on social forecasting, tracking and in-filling, and response generation, using metrics that assess not only reconstruction accuracy but also realism, diversity, temporal alignment, and interpersonal coordination. We further analyse the hierarchical latent space, showing that it captures separable group- and individual-level structure.

</details>


### [402] [Context Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37725)
*Rulin Shao,Shannon Zejiang Shen,Junjie Oscar Yin,Yuetai Li,Minheng Wang,Hamish Ivison,Radha Poovendran,Nathan Lambert,Teng Xiao,Mike Lewis,Wen-tau Yih,Luke Zettlemoyer,Pang Wei Koh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Context Language Models (CLMs)，将语言模型的上下文视为可任意编辑的文件，使模型本身而非外部harness负责上下文管理。CLMs在长时程任务上以更少算力超越现有SOTA策略；可通过in-context技能演化与基于GRPO的成功门控效率优势的强化学习进一步优化；并提出Suffix Cache Reuse以减少CLM服务中的重prefill开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统语言模型的上下文管理依赖外部harness的固定策略（compaction、offloading、retrieval），缺乏自适应能力。Sutton"苦涩的教训"启示我们应让LM自主搜索和学习超越人类先验的策略。现有action-based方法虽增加模型自主性，但仍受限于harness预定义的有限动作集。

Method: 1) 将context视为可编辑文件，LM通过Bash命令自由编辑上下文文件，每次修改自动同步到下一次调用的live context；2) 形式化定义CLM转换方程c_{t+1}=f_θ^CLM(c_t)取代标准LM的追加操作；3) 引入prefix-reuse FLOPs度量指标及Suffix Cache Reuse (SCR)服务优化；4) 提出ContextBench诊断基准解耦上下文管理与推理能力；5) 上下文内：通过自然语言指令引导或文本演化循环优化技能文档；6) 训练：采用stepwise GRPO并引入success-gated efficiency advantage奖励高效的成功轨迹。

Result: 零样本CLM（Qwen3.6-27B/GPT5.6-Sol）在多个长时程任务上优于SOTA：BrowseComp-Plus上准确率提升11.4%、FLOPs减少21.5%；12小时EdgeBench上得分提升5%、FLOPs减少59%；24小时多仓库agent-swarm任务上端到端加速提升65%。数学优化任务上CLM全面超越OpenEvolve等专用进化流程。技能演化在ContextBench上将保留测试准确率最多提升35.9点。Qwen3.5-9B经RL训练后在BrowseComp-Plus上从28.8%提升至42.5%（+47.6%），FLOPs减少12%。SCR相比标准SGLang服务端算力减少35%。

Conclusion: 将上下文管理从外部harness控制转为模型内在行为是有效的：CLMs在零样本、in-context学习及RL训练下均取得显著性能提升与计算效率改善，涌现出多代理编排记分板、内部笔记角色、可复用压缩函数等创新行为。然而模型可编辑上下文也带来新的安全风险（如prompt injection通过上下文持续存在），需未来工作研究防御机制。

Abstract: We introduce Context Language Models (CLMs), language models that natively manage their own context. We implement this by treating the context as a file and allowing the model to make unrestricted updates to this file. This allows the model to learn what is most important to maintain in context, and naturally extends to multi-agent systems where multiple agent contexts coexist as files. Building CLMs zero-shot with existing models outperforms SOTA context management strategies across a variety of tasks: 11.4% higher accuracy with 21.5% fewer FLOPs on BrowseComp-Plus, 5% higher scores with 59% fewer FLOPs on 12-hour EdgeBench, and 65% greater improvement with the same compute on a 24-hour multi-repository agent-swarm task. Moreover, by shifting context management from external harness control to intrinsic model behavior, CLMs naturally enable both in-context and parametric learning of context-management strategies.
