This behavior has little effect on task reward, yet among successful episodes it causes the agent to make 1.06 fewer tool calls on average, changing the interaction being evaluated while preserving the reward. Finally, across seven proxies we identify an empirical cost-fidelity frontier, enabling practitioners to select the least expensive simulator that satisfies a required fidelity level.

</details>


### [430] [Probability is Not Enough: Exploring and Counting Divergent Tokens for Reasoning Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38070)
*Feiyang Li,Shengjing Liu,Qi Zhan,Sijie Cheng,Weiqing Wang,Hongwen Chen,Yuxuan Yang,Wen Wang,Yile Wang,Hui Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DTC框架，通过计算两个模型在解码过程中强烈分歧的token数量来量化大语言模型推理的不确定性，无需训练且支持白盒与黑盒评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM推理置信度估计方法多基于token概率，但其有效性机制不清；预实验发现替换token概率为粗粒度替代品仍能改善校准，暗示被选token的数量本身可能是校准增益的关键信号。

Method: 1）预实验：对UQAC方法，将选中token的概率替换为轨迹均值概率或全局常数，发现仅依靠选中token数量即可获得校准增益；2）提出DTC框架，使用两个模型的next-token分布之间的Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD）识别分歧token（JS D超过阈值θ），统计其数量m；3）DTC_lin直接将m映射为置信度（线性递减至饱和），DTC_prod将m与轨迹平均概率C_mean结合（C_mean^(m+k)）；4）支持单辅助（白盒）和双辅助（黑盒）设置。

Result: 在6个数学基准、3个模型家族（Qwen2.5、Qwen3、Gemma3）的白盒实验中，DTC_lin平均ECE为13.0%，远优于标准全序列置信度方法（32.7%-42.4%）。在黑盒设置（DeepSeek-V3.2、Qwen3等）中，DTC_lin将DeepSeek-V3.2的verbalized置信度平均ECE从32.1%-40.2%降至13.7%-16.3%。DTC_prod在保持低ECE的同时获得更高的AUROC。将其应用于verbalized分数可进一步降低过度自信（ECE降低12.3-35.9个百分点）。

Conclusion: DTC通过计数分歧token提供了一种简单有效的推理不确定性量化方法，证明token数量本身是关键的校准信号，无需特定概率值；该方法在白盒和黑盒场景下均显著优于基于概率和verbalized的基线，并能降低verbalized分数的过度自信，为LLM推理不确定性量化提供了新视角。

Abstract: As the chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities of large language models improve, evaluating and calibrating their reasoning confidence is becoming increasingly important for quantifying the uncertainty of their answers. Current methods for estimating the confidence of large language models are generally based on probabilities of selected key tokens, but the underlying mechanism remains unclear. Our pilot study finds that replacing selected token probabilities with coarse substitutes can also improve calibration, motivating us to further explore effective signals of model confidence. We introduce Divergent Token Confidence (DTC), a framework that estimates confidence by counting tokens at which two models strongly disagree during decoding. DTC identifies these divergent tokens using the Jensen-Shannon divergence between next-token distributions evaluated along the same reasoning trajectory. We find that their count is almost negatively associated with answer accuracy, thereby serving as a simple yet effective signal for uncertainty quantification. DTC supports both white-box and black-box evaluation using auxiliary models, without explicit training and affecting the generation process. Experiments across multiple model families and six mathematical benchmarks demonstrate improved calibration over probability-based and verbalized baselines. Under white-box evaluation, the count-only estimator achieves an average expected calibration error of 13.0%, compared with 32.7%-42.4% for standard full-sequence confidence methods. In black-box settings, it also improves calibration over the original verbalized scores. For example, mean expected calibration error falls from 32.1%-40.2% to 13.7%-16.3% on DeepSeek-V3.2. These findings provide new insights for improving reasoning uncertainty quantification in large language models. The code is released at this https URL .

</details>


### [431] [Character Training for Risk-Averse Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38093)
*Arav Dhoot,Punya Syon Pandey,Jamie Johnson,Daniel Tan,Elliott Thornley,David Demitri Africa*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种"性格训练"(character training)方法，通过自然语言"宪法"(constitution)描述智能体的恒定绝对风险厌恶(CARA)偏好，并利用在线策略蒸馏(on-policy distillation)将其灌输给大语言模型，以使未来可能失调的AI更倾向于与人类合作而非叛乱。该方法在风险偏好评估上与直接在基准上训练的基线方法表现相当，并在分布外泛化方面更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机源于AI安全领域的一个核心问题：如果未来高度智能的AI与人类目标不一致(失调)，其风险中性的资源偏好将使人类无法通过支付报酬来避免其叛乱行为。但如果AI具有足够的风险厌恶特征，人类就可以用较小的成本与之达成合作交易。因此，研究如何可靠地将风险厌恶偏好灌输给语言模型，对于实现Thornley和MacAskill提出的"与AI做交易"的安全方案至关重要。

Method: 方法核心是构建一份自然语言"宪法"，以第一人称声明的方式描述模型的CARA(恒定绝对风险厌恶，系数α=0.01)身份特征，采用因子设计(factorial design)在示例数量(0/2/4)、陈述风格(陈述式/程序式)和效用曲线追踪(是/否)三个维度上变化，共生成12种宪法变体。训练方法采用在线策略宪法蒸馏：冻结的教师模型(带宪法的系统提示)对同一模型的LoRA学生进行指导，通过反向KL散度损失(评分函数梯度)将教师信号蒸馏到学生中，仅更新LoRA适配器而不修改基础权重。实验在Qwen3.5-9B、Qwen3.8-27B、Gemma-4-12B和Gemma-4-31B四种模型上进行，每种宪法训练500步。同时对比了SFT、DPO和tie-training三种基线方法。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1) 性格训练能够有效诱导风险厌恶，在核心赌注评估上与基线方法相当，但在结构性消融(改变决策呈现方式)上表现更优，Qwen模型上最佳学生平均得分0.90-0.95，远超基线的0.46-0.57；(2) 宪法蒸馏效果存在显著的模型家族差异：Gemma模型比Qwen模型更容易接受性格蒸馏，Qwen模型虽基线较高但很快进入平台期，Gemma则需要约2M训练token后才有显著提升；(3) 在宪法设计因素中，token预算和模型选择是最具影响力的因素，陈述式(declarative)措辞优于程序式(procedural)，而增加具体示例数量或追踪效用曲线并非稳定有益；(4) 风险厌恶训练带来了一些安全相关的副作用：所有四个模型的"短视奖励偏好"(myopic reward preference)均一致增加；能力(MMLU、GPQA)和概念推理基准基本保持不变，决策理论倾向略微偏向因果决策理论。

Conclusion: 论文结论认为，性格训练是一种有前景且可扩展的方法，用于在语言模型中灌输稳健的偏好特征，使其在面对陌生情境时能够泛化。token预算是影响性格训练效果的最关键因素，远超宪法具体内容的影响。然而，该方法并非完美隔离的干预——它会在相邻的安全相关行为上产生选择性副作用，特别是短视奖励偏好的增加。因此，在将风险厌恶训练部署为安全措施之前，需要仔细设计和审计宪法内容，并理解这些偏好的耦合关系。论文也指出了需要进一步研究的方向，包括不同模型家族和规模的可推广性、其他形式的风险厌恶、以及训练token预算的进一步扩展。

Abstract: Risk aversion in resources could prevent misaligned AI agents from causing catastrophic harm. Misaligned but risk-averse agents would tend to favor safer strategies like making deals with humans over riskier strategies like rebelling. We train agents to be risk averse through character training, finding that persona traits provide a robust mechanism for instilling risk preferences. To do this, we construct a model constitution describing constant absolute risk aversion (CARA) over an agent's resources and instill it through on-policy distillation. Despite never seeing the benchmark's decision format during training, character-trained models are competitive with baselines trained directly on it, and generalise better than them out of distribution on two of our four models. We also modulate different aspects of the constitution, finding that token budget and model choice are the most influential aspect of character training to instill risk aversion. We conclude from these results that character training is a promising and scalable way to instil broad dispositions, which we can use to our advantage in mitigating risk from misaligned AI agents.

</details>


### [432] [NeuronEye: Query-Guided Visual Concept Activation for Vision-Language Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38098)
*Ruiyu Yan,Bowen Chen,Shaowen Wan,Lin Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: NeuronEye是一个即插即用的框架，通过稀疏自编码器将视觉-语言模型（VLM）的密集视觉表示分解为稀疏的概念级神经元词汇表，并利用语言查询在推理过程中选择性激活相关视觉概念，提升VLM在空间和关系推理任务上的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前视觉-语言模型（VLM）将视觉信息编码在纠缠的密集隐藏状态中，无法有效隔离和调制查询所需的特定视觉证据，限制了结构化视觉推理能力。生物视觉系统通过稀疏群体编码和自上而下的注意力调制解决了这一问题，这启发了作者设计概念级选择性调制框架。

Method: NeuronEye包含三个核心组件：(1) 稀疏神经元空间（SNS）：使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）将视觉token状态分解为过完备稀疏基，并将其组织为概念级聚类，形成可寻址的视觉概念词汇表；(2) 神经元引导的视觉聚焦（NVF）：使用语言查询激活相关神经元聚类，定位表达所选概念的patch，并通过局部交叉注意力将聚焦证据注入视觉token；(3) 感知概念抑制（PCS）：在后续层中衰减主导感知方向，保留较弱但相关的线索。整个过程在冻结VLM骨干网络的单次前向传播中完成。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上，NeuronEye将CV-Bench总体准确率从78.5提升至81.6（+3.1），其中Distance子任务提升+9.5，BLINK Multi-view提升+8.3；在LLaVA-1.6-7B上也呈现类似改进，尤其在空间和关系子任务上表现突出。相比视觉token减少方法和表示级干预基线，NeuronEye在CV-Bench和BLINK上均取得最优总体性能。消融实验验证了三个组件的互补贡献，插入层（layer 8）和聚类数量（K=64）的选择经验证为最优。

Conclusion: NeuronEye证明了稀疏自编码器特征不仅可以作为事后可解释性工具，还可以作为主动接口用于概念级视觉推理。该框架以即插即用方式在冻结VLM骨干网络上运行，无需额外微调，在空间、关系和多视图推理任务上取得持续改进。未来工作可扩展稀疏神经元空间的领域覆盖，构建面向特定领域（如医学影像）的神经元词汇表。

Abstract: Current vision-language models (VLMs) encode visual information in dense hidden states where object identity, spatial layout, and local attributes are implicitly entangled rather than explicitly disentangled, limiting their ability to isolate and modulate the specific visual evidence required by a given language query. Inspired by sparse population coding and top-down modulation in biological vision, we introduce NeuronEye, a plug-in framework that constructs a sparse, concept-level neuron vocabulary from intermediate VLM representations and selectively activates query-relevant visual concepts during inference. NeuronEye decomposes vision-token states into an overcomplete sparse basis organized by concept-level clusters, uses the language query to activate relevant clusters and localize the patches where selected concepts are expressed, and injects the focused evidence back into vision tokens. A complementary suppression mechanism attenuates dominant perceptual directions to preserve weaker but relevant cues. All operations run in a single forward pass over a frozen VLM backbone. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, NeuronEye raises CV-Bench overall accuracy by +3.1 with gains of +9.5 on Distance, and improves BLINK Multi-view by +8.3, with similar trends on LLaVA-1.6-7B. These results suggest that sparse neuron vocabularies can serve not only as post-hoc interpretability tools but also as active interfaces for concept-level visual reasoning.

</details>


### [433] [Do LLM Agents Execute the Plans They Declare? From Planning-Mode Declaration to Pattern-Specific Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38108)
*Subba Reddy Oota,Francisco Herrera,Jordi Cabot Sagrera,Marcos López de Prado,Shadab Khan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM智能体在长时程任务中是否能真正执行其所声明的规划模式，提出"规划即路由"(Planning-as-Routing)框架，将LLM声明的规划模式(预定义/顺序/层次/搜索)通过确定性路由器分派到对应的模式特定执行器，发现在四个基准和三个LLM上，通用Plan+ReAct仅能保持22%–45%的声明结构，而模式特定执行器能显著提升任务成功率，但当前LLM并不能可靠地为每个任务选择最优模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有planner-executor系统的失败可能源于两个不同层面：(1)选择层——所声明的规划模式本身不适合该任务；(2)执行层——尽管选择了合适的规划模式，但在执行过程中未能忠实保持该结构。仅有最终任务成功率无法区分这两种失败来源。受人类面对不同任务采用不同规划策略的启发，作者探究LLM智能体是否存在类似的"规划声明-执行鸿沟"(Plan Declaration-Execution Gap)。

Method: 作者提出Planning-as-Routing框架：(1)定义四种规划模式——预定义(Predefined)、顺序(Sequential)、层次(Hierarchical)、搜索(Search)；(2)设置三种实验条件——Flat ReAct、Plan+ReAct、Planning-as-Routing，逐步隔离规划选择与执行的影响；(3)构建强制分派(pattern-ceiling)矩阵以分离选择失败与执行失败；(4)使用基于规则的执行结构验证器（与人工标注一致性κ=0.31/0.34）和LLM-as-judge对规划质量和遵守度进行评分；(5)在四个基准(ALFWorld、WebArena、Mind2Web、SWE-bench Verified)和三个LLM(Qwen3.6、DeepSeek-V4、Gemma-4-26B)上进行三随机种子评估。

Result: 四项主要发现：(1)通用Plan+ReAct在三个基准上仅保持22%–45%的声明规划结构，长规划尤其差，层次/搜索模式最难保持；(2)规划模式有效性随环境和模型变化——Search在ALFWorld最强、Hierarchical在SWE-bench最强，Gemma-4-26B在ALFWorld上偏好Hierarchical而其他模型偏好Search；(3)模式特定执行将ALFWorld任务成功率从0.48提升至0.92、SWE-bench从0.36提升至0.44，远超Plan+ReAct，且在长任务上优势更明显；(4)当前LLM无法可靠地为个别任务选择最优规划模式（与任务盲策略相比Δ在−0.025至+0.009之间，无统计显著性），但少样本示例在多数配置下可改善选择（提升+0.004至+0.156）。

Conclusion: 可靠的智能体规划需要两要素：选择有效的规划模式以及通过匹配的执行器忠实执行该模式。Planning-as-Routing显著缩小了执行鸿沟，但针对任务的自适应模式选择仍是开放问题。未来工作应探索更多规划模式、动态路由、动作级正确性与结构忠实度的联合评估，以及多智能体系统中的交接感知评估。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) enable agents to solve long-horizon tasks by generating a plan and then executing it in an environment. However, successful planning requires two distinct capabilities: selecting an appropriate plan for the task and executing it faithfully. Existing planner--executor systems can fail at either stage, while final task success alone cannot distinguish selection from execution failures. We therefore study the Plan Declaration--Execution Gap and introduce Planning-as-Routing, where an LLM declares one of four planning modes: Predefined, Sequential, Hierarchical, or Search, and a deterministic router dispatches the task to the corresponding pattern-specific executor. Across four benchmarks and three LLMs, we find three consistent patterns. First, generic Plan+ReAct often fails to preserve declared planning structure, especially for longer plans: across three benchmarks, only (22)--(45%) of trajectories preserve it, whereas pattern-specific executors enforce the intended structure. Second, planning-mode effectiveness varies across environments and models: Search performs best on ALFWorld, Hierarchical on SWE-bench, and the strongest pattern can vary across models within the same benchmark. Third, the largest gains come from execution: pattern-specific executors improve task success from (0.48) to (0.92) on ALFWorld and from (0.36) to (0.44) on SWE-bench Verified over Plan+ReAct. Current LLMs, however, do not reliably select the strongest mode for each task, although few-shot examples improve selection in some benchmark--model combinations. Overall, reliable agent planning requires both effective mode selection and faithful execution: routing substantially closes the execution gap, while task-specific mode selection remains open.

</details>


### [434] [Stochastic World Models for Verifying Vision-Based Neural Feedback Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38120)
*I. Samuel Akinwande,Mykel J. Kochenderfer,Clark Barrett*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于随机世界模型（latents具有物理含义）的感知代理，用于视觉神经反馈系统的验证；并设计了结合伪造、前向分析、自适应细化、符号分析和反向分析的验证流程，在紧急制动基准上显著优于现有基于GAN的验证方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉神经反馈系统的安全验证需要既表达传感器观测变化、又便于验证器推理的感知模型。现有GAN代理参数大、难以表达复杂场景且难以验证；确定性世界模型缺乏可建模的环境变化。作者希望通过将变化集中于少量物理含义明确的latent来兼顾表达力与可验证性。

Method: 1) 将视觉神经反馈系统形式化为以生成式模型为传感器的状态式系统；2) 提出一种基于反卷积+FiLM调制的随机世界模型，其latent对应物理量（如太阳高度角），构建时只使用标准验证器可界定的算子（线性、Conv、BN、ReLU、tanh、McCormick松弛）；4) 设计结合falsification、前向reachability、abstraction optimization、adaptive refinement、symbolic analysis与backward analysis的验证流程。

Result: 在Aircraft Taxiing与AEBS两个基准上，所提世界模型在RMSE与SSIM上均优于已有GAN代理，参数最多少130倍（AEBS RGB上29k vs 3.86M）。在灰度AEBS上，本文方法解析了100%状态空间（之前方法38%未解决）；在RGB AEBS上首次报告结果，解析超过80%。验证GPU-hours分别为1043和550。

Conclusion: 将感知变化集中在物理可解释latent中的随机世界模型，能以更少参数生成更高保真度的代理图像，并可通过组合多种验证技术解决此前GAN代理无法验证的视觉神经反馈系统问题。限制：保证仅对代理系统成立；缺乏代理与真实相机之间的形式化联系；RGB结果使用了卷积而非原版attention感知头；符号分析贡献较小。

Abstract: Verifying a vision-based neural feedback system requires a model of the observations its controller acts upon. Such a model must capture the variation the sensor produces, while remaining tractable for closed-loop analysis. Generative adversarial networks (GANs) have served as perception surrogates, but they are large, reproduce complex scenes poorly, and are hard to verify. We explore stochastic world models as a richer class of perception surrogates. We train a world model with physically grounded latents, built from operations that standard verifiers bound. It reproduces held-out frames more faithfully than GAN surrogates with up to 130 times as many parameters. To verify these surrogates, we develop a procedure that combines falsification, adaptive refinement, symbolic, and backward analyses. On an emergency braking benchmark with a GAN surrogate, our procedure resolves the entire state space, 38% of which the state-of-the-art verifier left unresolved. On the RGB version of the benchmark, where no verification results have previously been reported, our procedure resolves over 80% of the state space with a world model surrogate.

</details>


### [435] [AdviSD: Learning to Advise Frontier LLMs via Targeted Multi-Turn Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38142)
*Rishabh Agrawal,Hejie Cui,Shasha Li,Shanchan Wu,Sercan Ö. Arık*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出AdviSD方法，通过目标性多轮自蒸馏训练小型顾问模型来指导冻结的前沿大语言模型执行器。核心创新在于理论分析证明并非所有反馈修正都有助于学习——那些不影响执行结果的修正可能通过共享参数损害模型在其他场景的决策。AdviSD通过对比有无建议时顾问对相同执行器响应的预测分数差异来选择需要监督的决策，无需执行器似然或额外推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前前沿大语言模型通常通过API调用，用户无法修改其权重。当这类模型作为智能体执行任务时，一个小的可训练顾问模型可以从外部提供自然语言建议来引导它。然而，仅从任务奖励学习的顾问获得的反馈有限，因为情节奖励总结了整体任务表现但未指明具体哪些建议决策应该改变。反射机制虽能基于完成交互提出具体修正，但一个看似合理的修正可能并不改变执行结果（如执行器本就擅长的搜索步骤），通过共享参数学习这些"无效"修正可能损害顾问在其他场景的建议质量。因此需要一种机制来选择哪些修正值得学习。

Method: AdviSD结合基于结果的GRPO强化学习与反馈条件自蒸馏。核心选择机制是配对评分：预更新顾问对同一已记录执行器响应，在包含已发出建议和不含建议两种上下文中分别评分，使用两种评分差异的绝对值作为预测信号来选择需要监督的决策。具体步骤：(1) 外部反射器对不完美情节中至多5个建议决策提出修正；(2) 对原始弃权决策和配对评分差异超过校准阈值的决策保留监督；(3) 通过donor建议（来自其他任务的建议）校准阈值，使用0.95分位数作为固定阈值；(4) 反馈条件教师（预更新顾问副本）以反馈块增强的上下文监督仅看原始上下文的学生。损失函数包含GRPO损失加上自蒸馏辅助损失，权重λ_s从0.30线性衰减到0.05（前60个更新）。

Result: 使用Qwen3-8B作为顾问训练，Gemini 3.7 Flash和Claude Sonnet 4.6作为冻结执行器。AdviSD在BFCL-v3上比advisor-GRPO提升4.2-6.4个百分点，在EnvScaler上提升3.9-5.1分。Q1：领域内BFCL-v3和EnvScaler聚合指标最高。Q2：消融实验显示AdviSD比匹配计数随机选择高2.5-4.9分，比无门控高3.2-5.1分，证明选择具体修正而非仅减少监督是有价值的。Q3：无需重新训练即可迁移到四个分布外基准（ACEBench、ToolHop、τ²-bench、RoTBench），宏观平均比独立执行高2.7-3.6分；跨版本和跨模型系列迁移均优于迁移的GRPO 3.1个百分点。Q4：训练进度显示AdviSD从第20次更新起持续领先基线。

Conclusion: AdviSD通过区分提出修正与选择学习位置，实现了更高效的顾问训练。理论分析（定理1-2和推论1）解释了共享参数模型中校正选择如何通过监督组成（composition）和监督频率（exposure）影响最终性能。匹配计数随机控制实验验证了目标选择规则比简单减少监督更有价值。AdviSD的顾问在领域内、分布外和跨执行器迁移场景中均达到最优，证明了选择哪里学习对顾问-执行器接口至关重要。该方法不依赖执行器似然或额外执行器推理，具有良好的实用性和泛化能力。

Abstract: A small trainable advisor can steer a frozen language-model executor using natural-language advice. In addition to learning from task rewards, the advisor can use feedback from completed interactions to improve its advice. However, a plausible correction need not change execution, yet learning from such corrections can still affect the advisor's future decisions in other contexts. In a shared-parameter model, we prove that such corrections can limit learning if their targets favor useful advice less strongly than those of other corrections. Keeping them less often than the rest improves the model's eventual performance compared to learning from every correction. Motivated by this, our method, Advisor Self-Distillation (AdviSD), pairs outcome-based reinforcement learning with self-distillation from a feedback-conditioned copy of the advisor selectively. Reflection proposes corrections, and the advisor scores the same recorded executor response with and without its issued advice, using the magnitude of the difference to select decisions for supervision. This approach does not require executor likelihoods or additional executor rollouts. Experiments with Qwen3-8B advisors for Gemini and Claude show that AdviSD outperforms advisor-GRPO by 4.2-6.4 percentage points on BFCL-v3 and by 3.9-5.1 score points on EnvScaler. The trained advisors generalize to out-of-domain tasks and transfer across different executor versions and model families. AdviSD also beats matched-count random selection, supporting the value of its selection rule.

</details>


### [436] [Learning Meta-Skills for Agent Harness Design in Test-Time AI4AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38143)
*Cheng Qian,Kunlun Zhu,Beibin Li,Zhenhailong Wang,Heng Ji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"元技能"(Meta-Skill)框架,使固定的Builder模型通过学习目标模型的执行反馈,将经验提炼为可复用的支持原则,并据此为新任务构建执行环境(harness)。在两个基准测试中,该方法在六组配置下均优于直接向目标传递知识,验证了"将经验转化为可执行支撑"的价值,并展示了同模型自我改进的潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体性能不仅取决于推理能力,还取决于其执行环境。现有研究多关注直接改进目标模型或搜索工作流,但忽略了"如何学习为Agent构建更好的支持环境"这一维度。作者希望通过让Builder从执行经验中学习,使固定权重的模型也能获得性能提升。

Method: 1. 定义Meta-Skill三元组(when, provide, use),描述何时需要支持、提供什么资源、目标如何使用。2. 建立"构建-执行-反思"循环:Builder在开发集上构建harness→目标执行并产生反馈→Builder基于证据keep/revise/add更新技能库。3. 技能库冻结后,在测试时通过完整技能库或BM25检索方式指导Builder为每个新任务构建任务特定的harness(涵盖7个组件族:指令、记忆、上下文、组合工具、执行控制、验证恢复、工作区)。4. 使用GPT-5.6-Sol作为Builder,Gemini-3.6-Flash/Qwen3.8-Flash/GPT-OSS-120B作为目标,在Harness-Bench(106题)和NewtonBench(324题)上评测。

Result: 在六个模型-基准组合中:1. 完整技能库的Builder在宏平均上达到65.31%,比无技能构建提升8.95个百分点,比直接传递技能给目标提升12.02个百分点;2. NewtonBench上NewtonBench上无效提交减少35.5%,正确发现增加21.9%;3. NewtonBench(平均+10.96点)比Harness-Bench(+6.95点)受益更大,因前者存在重复的协调失败模式;4. 同模型自进化实验中平均提升18.71点,表明无需权重更新即可实现系统级自我改进;5. 跨Builder转移显示接收方自主学习优于直接迁移,但原则仍可跨模型复用。

Conclusion: 1. Meta-Skill的核心价值在于将知识"操作化"为执行支撑(工具、状态、控制),而非仅仅是提示词;2. 控制器组件对执行一致性提升最显著(尤其对Gemini减少13.36点);3. 经验学习最有价值于重复性失败模式的任务;4. 支持设计本身是一个独立的学习维度,即使同一模型也能通过学习构建更好的harness来实现自我改进,为系统级自进化提供了新路径。

Abstract: Agent performance depends on both reasoning ability and the environment in which it acts. We study test-time AI-for-AI, asking how a Builder can learn to construct better execution environments for a Target while both models' weights remain fixed. To make the Builder's experience reusable, we introduce Meta-Skill: principles specifying when support is needed and what resources to provide. The Builder learns these principles from Target's execution feedback on the development set, then uses the frozen skill bank to construct harnesses for unseen tasks. Across Harness-Bench and NewtonBench, full-bank meta-skills improve macro-average performance by 8.95 percentage points over no-skill construction, and 12.02 points over direct delivery of the same bank to the Target. These results highlight the value of translating experience into executable support. Gains when the same model serves both roles further suggest a path to system level self-improvement through learning to build better environments.

</details>


### [437] [Thinking Before Thinking: Scaling Agentic Inference Through Meta-Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38147)
*Paras Dahal,Anton Bakhtin,Taco Cohen,Zhengxing Chen,Carole-Jean Wu,Rob Fergus,Scott Yih,Gabriel Synnaeve,Ruslan Salakhutdinov,Sanjeev Arora,Jason Weston,Anirudh Goyal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"智能体元推理"(agentic meta-reasoning)——一种推理时的控制框架,将智能体的控制决策(下一步做什么)与对象层任务执行分离,由控制器通过Assess-Propose-Evaluate-Dispatch四阶段显式结构化决策,而工作者执行任务;通过持久化制品图(artifact graph)实现紧凑状态记忆。在四个基准(IMO ProofBench-Advanced、ARC-AGI-2、LongCoT-mini、ProgramBench)和三个前沿模型上,主预算下12项匹配对比全部优于直接控制基线,平均提升3.6–4.2分;ProgramBench上GPT-5.5达到71.5%(vs Codex 58.0%),且在直接控制趋于平台期的预算范围内继续提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体将控制决策与对象层工作交错在同一调用中,随着任务变长、模型调用增多,如何选择下一步工作本身成为一项独立且关键的认知任务。控制错误的代价不仅是浪费算力,还可能让失败路径延续整个运行,或丢弃已找到的正确解。因此,作者认为控制决策应当拥有自己的结构化推理过程,并与对象层工作分离。

Method: 设计Meta-Reasoning Agent:工作者执行任务级计算,控制器维护紧凑的自身状态s_t和持久化制品图(V为工件、E为上下文依赖的有向边)。每个控制周期包含四个阶段:(1)Assess——根据新工件更新对运行进度的评估;(2)Propose——基于状态提出下一批候选计算方案A_t,不知道预算以避免自我裁剪;(3)Evaluate——在剩余预算b_t^eval下对方案做定性价值评估,选择ã_t;(4)Dispatch——将ã_t转化为可执行动作,确定每个工作者接收的工件上下文C_i。控制器与工作者共享同一模型调用预算B。还引入Direct Control Agent作为关键基线:相同工作者、相同接口、相同预算,唯一区别是每步动作在单一调用中基于累积历史直接决定,从而隔离出显式分阶段控制的贡献。诊断方法包括:工件图拓扑(节点数、边数、深度、宽度、扇入)、覆盖率(运行中是否曾出现正确解)、Type-2 AUC(控制器对工件正确性的排序能力)、前沿选择增益(相对于从最深终态工件均匀随机选择的提交正确率差)。

Result: (a) 性能:主预算下Meta-Reasoning Agent在4个基准×3个模型共12项匹配对比中均取得最高分。IMO ProofBench-Advanced平均+4.0分(Gemini 3.1 Pro +8.6最多),ARC-AGI-2平均+4.2分,LongCoT-mini平均+3.6分。ProgramBench上GPT-5.5达71.5%对比Codex 58.0%、直接对照63.7%;Opus 4.8达67.2%对比Claude Code 65.5%。(b) 预算扩展性:预算从400增至1200调用时,元推理持续提升(GPT-5.5从64.1%到71.5%),而直接控制在400调用附近C版仅差+2.6分后趋于平台;ProgramBench上GPT-5.5直接控制仅用约18%的1200调用预算,元推理使用89–101%。(c) 工件图:元推理的图节点数与边数随预算增长更显著(ProgramBench上GPT-5.5边数增长约4倍),且远高于直接控制;显示更多早期工作的再利用。(e) 覆盖率:多数设置下元推理显著提升(Gemini IMO +20百分点),正确解出现率更高。(f) 监控:控制器verdict的Type-2 AUC普遍高于工作者confidence(Gemini IMO:0.88 vs 0.55)。(g) 选择:前沿选择增益在多数设置下为正(ARC-AGI-2 GPT-5.5 +11 pp vs 直接控制 +3 pp),但非均匀。(h) 记忆:控制器状态保持在数千至数万字符,而直接控制历史在最长Opus运行超过一百万字符。

Conclusion: 智能体的性能不仅取决于如何完成任务,还取决于如何决定任务是否值得做。随着推理运行变长,这一决策本身成为一项独立的工作。Agentic meta-reasoning通过将控制与对象层工作显式分离,使控制器能够以结构化推理方式评估进度、探索选项、权衡预算价值并选择上下文,从而使智能体在更长运行和更大预算下持续扩展。工件图分析为这种"控制作为可测量能力"的观点提供了诊断工具。预算不足时控制开销可能不划算(Opus 4.8在400调用预算下落后),且控制器评估错误可能传播误导状态;LongCoT-mini的国际象棋子集上出现了"过度修正已正确解"的失败模式。

Abstract: As agents take on longer and more complex problems, controlling the execution becomes a task in its own right. Each step in the run brings new control choices, like which partial work to build on, whether to start fresh, or when to stop. We introduce agentic meta-reasoning, an inference-time harness that makes these choices an explicit and structured reasoning process. Workers carry out the task-level computation, while a controller consolidates what the run has established, explores next options, assesses what each option is worth under the remaining budget, and dispatches the chosen work with context drawn from persistent memory. Between decisions the controller carries only a compact account of the run rather than replaying its full history. Our baselines span production coding agents and research harnesses, together with a Direct Control Agent using the same workers and compute budget allowance. On ProgramBench, which tests long-horizon agentic capability through program reconstruction, meta-reasoning achieves 71.5% with GPT-5.5 against 58.0% for Codex; with Opus 4.8 it achieves 67.2% against 65.5% for Claude Code. On the other benchmarks, spanning abstract reasoning, multi-domain long-horizon reasoning, and proof generation, it gains between 3.6 and 4.2 points over direct control, averaged across three frontier models. It keeps improving over the tested budget ranges where direct control plateaus, though its overhead can hurt at small budgets. Artifact-graph analysis reveals more reuse of earlier work, higher coverage of correct solutions in most settings, and nonuniform gains in final selection. These results indicate that spending computation on structured control becomes more important as agents scale to longer runs.

</details>


### [438] [PrototypeNAS: Rapid Design of Deep Neural Networks for Microcontroller Units](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15106)
*Mark Deutel,Simon Geis,Axel Plinge*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Enabling efficient deep neural network (DNN) inference on edge devices with different hardware constraints is a challenging task that typically requires DNN architectures to be specialized for each device separately. To avoid the huge manual effort, one can use neural architecture search (NAS). However, many existing NAS methods are resource-intensive and time-consuming because they require the training of many different DNNs from scratch. Furthermore, they do not take the resource constraints of the target system into account. To address these shortcomings, we propose PrototypeNAS, a zero-shot NAS method to accelerate and automate the selection, compression, and specialization of DNNs to different target microcontroller units (MCUs). We propose a novel three-step search method that decouples DNN design and specialization from DNN training for a given target platform. First, we present a novel search space that not only cuts out smaller DNNs from a single large architecture, but instead combines the structural optimization of multiple architecture types, as well as optimization of their pruning and quantization configurations. Second, we explore the use of an ensemble of zero-shot proxies during optimization instead of a single one. Third, we propose the use of Hypervolume subset selection to distill DNN architectures from the Pareto front of the multi-objective optimization that represent the most meaningful tradeoffs between accuracy and FLOPs. We evaluate the effectiveness of PrototypeNAS on 12 different datasets in three different tasks: image classification, time series classification, and object detection. Our results demonstrate that PrototypeNAS is able to identify DNN models within minutes that are small enough to be deployed on off-the-shelf MCUs and still achieve accuracies comparable to the performance of large DNN models.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI enhancement unavailable (incomplete_output). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

Method: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Result: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Conclusion: AI enhancement unavailable (incomplete_output). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

Abstract: Enabling efficient deep neural network (DNN) inference on edge devices with different hardware constraints is a challenging task that typically requires DNN architectures to be specialized for each device separately. To avoid the huge manual effort, one can use neural architecture search (NAS). However, many existing NAS methods are resource-intensive and time-consuming because they require the training of many different DNNs from scratch. Furthermore, they do not take the resource constraints of the target system into account. To address these shortcomings, we propose PrototypeNAS, a zero-shot NAS method to accelerate and automate the selection, compression, and specialization of DNNs to different target microcontroller units (MCUs). We propose a novel three-step search method that decouples DNN design and specialization from DNN training for a given target platform. First, we present a novel search space that not only cuts out smaller DNNs from a single large architecture, but instead combines the structural optimization of multiple architecture types, as well as optimization of their pruning and quantization configurations. Second, we explore the use of an ensemble of zero-shot proxies during optimization instead of a single one. Third, we propose the use of Hypervolume subset selection to distill DNN architectures from the Pareto front of the multi-objective optimization that represent the most meaningful tradeoffs between accuracy and FLOPs. We evaluate the effectiveness of PrototypeNAS on 12 different datasets in three different tasks: image classification, time series classification, and object detection. Our results demonstrate that PrototypeNAS is able to identify DNN models within minutes that are small enough to be deployed on off-the-shelf MCUs and still achieve accuracies comparable to the performance of large DNN models.

</details>


### [439] [Predicting Team Performance from Communications in Simulated Search-and-Rescue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.03791)
*Ali Jalal-Kamali,Nikolos Gurney,David Pynadath*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究如何通过分析团队对话数据预测团队表现。基于DARPA ASIST项目的Minecraft搜索与救援实验数据，结合预试验个体特征(BEARD)、动态团队效能指标(TED)以及LDA主题建模与K-means聚类方法，识别出12个沟通主题和8个聚类簇，并构建了一个可在任务进程10%-30%时实现早期干预预测的多阶段pipeline。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在多智能体辅助人机团队的场景中，自主智能体需要理解人类团队的沟通模式以提供有效帮助。然而个体特征(如信任、社交敏锐度等)往往不可直接观察，沟通成为推断团队特征和表现的重要途径。该研究旨在探索是否能从自然对话数据中识别团队特征与沟通模式，从而预测团队表现并实现早期干预。

Method: 方法包含六个主要环节：(1) BEARD线性回归——分析8个预试验特征变量与表现的关系；(2) TED线性回归——筛选去依赖的动态效能变量并建立表现预测；(3) 文本预处理——清洗转录文本，构建文档-词矩阵，得到222个独立试验文本；(4) LDA主题建模——基于textmineR进行100次/主题数的概率一致性评估，确定12个最佳主题；(6) K-means聚类——基于theta矩阵与gap statistics确定8个最佳聚类簇；(6) 早期预测pipeline——基于前1/10与1/3转录文本进行聚类预测，结合BEARD与TED变化进行多阶段干预决策。

Result: (1) BEARD回归显示愤怒与表现强负相关、社交敏锐度正相关、运输技能意外负相关(可能因过度自信)；(2) TED回归显示process-effort-agg与comms-total-words正相关、process-skill-use-agg负相关；(3) 12个主题中部分共享搜索救援语境词项，部分(如主题2/3/5)呈现独特沟通模式；(4) 聚类结果显著区分第一轮与第二轮试验，线性回归显示簇分配与表现显著相关(p=0.0008)，簇5表现最低(-196.30)，簇2、3次之；(5) 低表现簇表现为高行动率、低过程努力/覆盖/分诊、沟通与负载分布失衡；(6) 早期预测准确率达10%时47%、30%时76%。

Conclusion: 研究证实，从自然对话数据中可有效推断团队特征并预测表现。有效团队倾向于保持沟通平衡与负载均衡分配，而低效团队表现出碎片化互动模式。所构建的多阶段早期预测与干预pipeline可在任务进程10%-30%时识别低效试验并触发干预决策，为自主智能体辅助人机协作提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Understanding how individual traits influence team performance is valuable, but these traits are not always directly observable. Prior research has inferred traits like trust from behavioral data. We analyze conversational data to identify team traits and their correlation with teaming outcomes. Using transcripts from a Minecraft-based search-and-rescue experiment, we apply topic modeling and clustering to uncover key interaction patterns. Our findings show that variations in teaming outcomes can be explained through these inferences, with different levels of predictive power derived from individual traits and team dynamics.

</details>

### [440] [Generated Query Expansion Still Helps Strong Sparse Retrieval: A Controlled Study with SPLADE-v3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37911)
*Ryan C. Barron,Cade W. Trotter,Maksim E. Eren,Kim Ø. Rasmussen,Liz D. Miller,Benjamin J. Migliori*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文针对强学习稀疏检索器 SPLADE-v3，系统比较了四种生成式查询扩展方法（词项列表、伪文档、多伪参考、语料引导文本）与一种语料诱导类型化概念图方法 HiQE 在三个科学检索数据集上的效果。研究发现所有生成式方法均能稳定提升 SPLADE-v3，而概念图方法无效。增益主要来自生成内容所提供的补充词汇，前提是原始查询在混合中保持足够权重。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学查询简短且与文献专业词汇存在差异。虽然生成式查询扩展可弥合该差异，但既有研究表明随着检索器增强其价值会减弱，甚至损害最强检索器。因此需明确：在已具备上下文词项扩展能力的强学习稀疏检索器（如 SPLADE-v3）之上，外部生成内容是否仍能带来收益。

Method: 采用控制变量设计：冻结 SPLADE-v3 文档索引与编码器，仅改变查询侧表示。四种生成格式（Flat LLM-QE、Query2doc、MuGI-style、CSQE）经同一 SPLADE-v3 查询编码器编码后，通过固定公式 z̃q = Budget256(α·z̄q + (1−α)·ā(q)) 与受保护的原始查询向量混合，α 控制权重，固定 256 维稀疏预算。语料诱导概念图 HiQE 作为对照。通过插值权重扫描、打乱文本与非上下文词袋控制、概念图多种消融（关系、深度、验证、随机、门控）进行稳健性检验。统计检验包括配对 bootstrap、配对符号随机化与 Holm/Bonferroni 校正。在 NFCorpus、TREC-COVID、SciDocs 上以 nDCG@10 为主要指标评估。

Result: 全部 12 个生成方法与数据集组合均提升 SPLADE-v3 的 nDCG@10，最佳相对增益分别为 NFCorpus 4.81%（CSQE）、TREC-COVID 8.92%（Query2doc）、SciDocs 9.47%（CSQE），11/12 在 Holm 校正后仍显著。103/114 插值设置优于基线，所有 α≥0.3 的设置均稳定提升。打乱文本与非上下文词袋对照在 24 个聚合比较中均高于基线，表明增益主要来自词汇本身。HiQE 概念图在三个数据集上无一致增益（+0.0013、−0.0126、+0.0006），所有消融亦未恢复增益，门控亦无济于事。

Conclusion: 生成式查询扩展在已具备上下文词项扩展的强学习稀疏检索器上仍具价值，其增益来源是生成器补充的科学词汇，但前提是原始查询须在混合表示中保留足够权重（至少 30%）。仅在查询侧增加相关术语并不足以复现该收益，语料诱导类型化概念图未表现出可比模式。未来工作应聚焦检索监督的概念选择、保留短语的表示以及面向逐查询排序影响的门控机制。

Abstract: Scientific queries are often brief, while relevant papers use specialized vocabulary. Generated query expansion can bridge this mismatch, but earlier work suggests that its value shrinks as the underlying retriever becomes stronger. We test the four generated formats of term lists, a pseudo-document, multiple pseudo-references, and corpus-steered text all together with SPLADE-v3 on NFCorpus, TREC-COVID, and SciDocs. Every condition searches the same frozen document index and follows the same query-side integration rule and 256-dimension budget, isolating the effect of the added content. All twelve method-collection comparisons improve aggregate nDCG@10, with best relative gains of 4.81%, 8.92%, and 9.47%. Eleven remain significant after Holm correction. The gain persists in 103 of 114 interpolation settings, including every setting that assigns at least 30% of the mixture weight to the original query. Shuffled-text and non-contextual lexical-bag controls also remain above baseline in all 24 aggregate comparisons, showing that the added vocabulary carries most of the benefit. A corpus-induced typed concept graph, by contrast, produces no consistent gain, and its relation, depth, validation, random, and gating controls do not rescue it. Generated vocabulary can therefore complement a strong learned sparse retriever, provided that the original query remains strongly represented.

</details>


### [441] [Soft Curriculum Learning for Optimizing Fresh and Generalized Recommendations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35783)
*Arnab Bhadury,Siyan Zheng,Anlan Yu,Palaksh Rungta,Jiawei Li,Changping Meng,Dapeng Hong,Chuan He,Onkar Dalal*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向工业级持续训练推荐系统的"软课程学习"（Soft Curriculum Learning）框架，通过损失退火和图内权重调整替代传统的数据过滤方法，解决了流行度反馈循环问题，同时避免了CPU瓶颈，在检索和排序模型上均取得了线上A/B测试的显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模短视频推荐系统存在严重的流行度偏差自我强化循环：模型反复推荐热门"头部"内容，导致训练数据进一步倾斜，模型记忆头部模式而忽视长尾内容，抑制新内容、冷启动和利基内容的分发。传统课程学习（CL）通过动态数据拒绝实现由易到难的训练，但在工业级持续训练流水线中会因CPU预处理成为瓶颈而饥饿TPU/GPU，且全局课程调度无法适应连续训练中的数据分布漂移。

Method: 提出Soft Curriculum Learning框架：（1）不对数据进行拒绝过滤，而是在TPU/GPU核心上直接对损失向量乘以退火权重系数；（2）难度量化采用两种方式：基于互动量的流行度分位数和基于SNGP（谱归一化神经网络高斯过程）不确定性的估计；（3）采用循环课程调度（cyclic pacing），将数据流按子日区间划分周期性重置，而非全局递增；（4）两种权重策略：Hard-Example Warmup（w=1.0−α·d·(1.0−p)）和Bidirectional Difficulty Scaling（w=1.0+α·(2p−1)·(2d−1)）；（5）通过Batch Difficulty Normalization（将批次平均权重归一化为1）缓解A/A方差问题。

Result: 在排序模型上，离线AUC在展示正向、预期负向、满意度等任务上均有正向提升（Eng-Bi最佳达+0.04%）；线上A/B测试中，Eng-Bi变体实现用户满意度+0.54%、冷启动用户互动+5.7%。在SASRec检索模型上，线上独立检索互动数提升+7.7%，冷启动内容互动在三个年龄段桶中均有提升。在Two-Tower检索模型上，离线MAP@K全面超越基线（MAP@1从0.16348提升至0.17133）。相比之下，全局课程学习方法（Global-1Day/Global-3Day）在离线和线上均表现负面，验证了循环调度的优越性。

Conclusion: Soft Curriculum Learning成功适配了工业级持续训练推荐系统，通过循环退火和损失加权打破了流行度反馈循环，避免了硬件效率损失，同时在排序和检索两阶段均验证了其在促进长尾和冷启动内容分发、提升用户满意度方面的有效性，为未来工业部署课程学习技术提供了可复制的蓝图。

Abstract: Large-scale recommender systems, particularly short-form video platforms, are often bottlenecked by massive popularity feedback loops. In such environments, as models recommend popular items, they generate an overwhelming amount of skewed training data for "head" items. This creates a self-reinforcing cycle where retrieval and ranking models memorize "head" item patterns at the expense of generalizing across the vast "tail" of the catalogue. While Curriculum Learning (CL) offers a powerful mechanism to break this feedback loop by systematically exposing models to progressively more difficult and less frequent examples, its adoption in industrial recommendation has been hampered by hardware utilization inefficiencies or the needs for complicated pre-processing techniques because dynamic data rejection algorithms tend to starve hardware accelearators (TPUs/GPUs) by becoming largely CPU-bound. In this work, we introduce a scalable Soft Curriculum Learning framework designed specifically for continuous training setups within industry-scale retrieval and ranking models. By utilizing loss annealing and in-graph weight adjustments rather than rigid data filtering, we break the popularity feedback and enable dynamic curriculum pacing without sacrificing system throughput. We demonstrate empirical evidence through applications across sequence-based retrieval models (such as SASRec), two-tower retrieval models, and large-scale continuous ranking models. Online A/B tests on our short-video platform demonstrate substantial lifts in both overall user satisfaction and fresh content consumption, all without degrading model throughput.

</details>


### [442] [Do Evidence-Reading Diagnostics Improve Interface Selection in Small LLM Recommenders?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37472)
*Han Chen,Yingrui Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文考察了"证据阅读行为测试"产生的诊断特征是否能帮助小规模LLM推荐系统在多个推荐接口（history-only prompting、textual collaborative evidence、score fusion）之间做出更好的选择。在四个领域、六个checkpoint的受控八候选排序实验中,加入证据阅读诊断特征相比仅使用可观察特征+稳定性特征的基线选择器,并未达到预设的0.005 NDCG@5改进目标(实际Δ=-0.0019,95% CI [-0.0046, 0.0004])。然而,来自检索到的相似用户的协同证据本身相比随机用户控制将prompting性能提升了+0.0999 NDCG@5。结论强调:诊断测量应通过其能否在已有特征和固定接口之外改善推荐选择来评判。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推荐系统可通过多种接口接收协同信息(纯文本prompting或与经典推荐器分数融合),选择何种接口是一个独立的决策问题。证据阅读测试的逻辑动机在于:若模型能正确比较各候选的支持计数,则可能更有效地利用文本证据。但作者指出"识别最大计数"与"预测用户后续偏好"是不同判断,行为测试暴露的弱点未必指向何种替代方案更好。因此核心问题是:诊断特征相对于选择器已有输入,是否能提供增量信息以改进接口选择决策。

Method: 实验设置:
- 数据:四个领域(MovieLens 20M、Amazon Instruments 2023、KuaiRec、Last.fm 1K),共1,848开发用户和3,426评估用户
- 模型:六个固定checkpoint(Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B、Qwen3-4B、Phi-4-mini、Gemma-3-4B、Llama-3.2-3B)
- 任务:控制性八候选排序(1个正样本+7个按过去流行度匹配的负样本),按时间顺序评估,使用next-token logits,四种cyclic顺序平均
- 三个接口:H(history-only)、T(textual collaborative evidence)、F(score fusion F=(1-α)s(H)+αs(C))
- 基线选择器B:使用可观察特征V+六个稳定性prompt特征S₆
- 增强选择器B+R:B+R=V+S₆+R₆,加入六个证据阅读prompt产生的20个阅读特征
- 选择器使用增益预测器(直方图梯度提升),预测T-H和F-H的效用增益
- 统计推断:10,000次分层bootstrap重采样用户,domain级Holm校正
- 预注册决策规则:改进≥0.005 NDCG@5且95%区间不含零且至少三个领域正向

Result: 主要结果:
1. B+R vs B:Δ=-0.001881 NDCG@5,95% CI [-0.004580, 0.000421],未达0.005目标,两个决策规则均失败
2. 匹配超参数后上限仍低于0.005目标
3. 检索证据vs随机用户控制:+0.0999 NDCG@5(每个领域均正向)
4. Dev-fixed固定接口优于两个学习选择器(0.5524 vs B的0.5447 vs B+R的0.5428)
5. 证据阅读测试揭示:
   - 答案位置偏差(Qwen3 95.0%选首选项,Gemma零tie召回)
   - Tie响应偏差(Phi/Llama对非tie过度回答tie,Gemma从不回答tie)
   - 模型异质性:Gemma效应-0.0068(单独显著负向),其他家族接近零
   - 测试准确率与选择效应的强负相关(Spearman=-0.94)
6. 18个响应衍生特征中,checkpoint间方差占比中位数仅9.98%,但部分特征(零一检查)在checkpoint间方差>50%

Conclusion: 本文区分了"协同证据的有用性"与"测量模型如何阅读证据的有用性"。检索证据本身显著提升prompting(相比随机用户),但加入证据阅读诊断特征未能达到预注册的0.005 NDCG@5选择改进目标。此外,基于开发集选定的固定接口策略同时优于两个学习选择器。方法论结论是:评估行为诊断的价值应通过其能否在已有特征和固定接口之外改善推荐选择来衡量;应同时报告答案偏好偏差和checkpoint内请求级变化,而非仅报告聚合准确率。研究承认仅适用于所测选择器和候选集,且存在Last.fm时间戳暴露、KuaiRec阈值变更未文档化、可能存在outcome-informed设计不确定性等局限。

Abstract: Behavioral tests measure how a language model reads evidence. We ask whether those measurements help choose a recommendation interface. We evaluate six small instruction-tuned checkpoints across four recommendation domains with chronological evaluation and 3,426 evaluation users. Each request ranks eight candidates. A baseline selector chooses among history-only prompting, prompting with collaborative evidence, and score fusion. It uses observable features and six stability prompts that vary wording and candidate order. An augmented selector adds features from six evidence-reading prompts that ask the model to compare support counts. An interface chosen once on development (validation) data for each domain and checkpoint scores 0.5524 NDCG@5, compared with 0.5447 for the baseline selector and 0.5428 for the augmented selector. Adding the diagnostic features changes NDCG@5 by -0.0019 (95% interval [-0.0046, 0.0004]). The interval includes zero, and its upper bound is below the analysis plan's 0.005 improvement target. Matching the selectors' hyperparameters also leaves the interval upper bound below that target. Evidence from retrieved similar users improves prompting by 0.0999 NDCG@5 over a control using randomly selected users matched for activity. The evidence-reading tests also reveal answer-position and tie-response biases. These results concern the tested selectors and candidate sets. They illustrate why diagnostic measurements should be evaluated by whether they improve recommendation choices beyond existing features and a fixed interface.

</details>


### [443] [MERGE: Multi-LLM Ensemble for Retrieval via Generative Enrichment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37574)
*Tzu-I Ho,Yung-Yu Shih,Shang-Yu Su,Dongzhe Wang,Yun-Nung Chen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: MERGE 提出一种两阶段 LLM 集成框架，通过三个异构 7–8B 开源模型并行生成查询扩展候选，再由更大的 LLM 生成式融合为单一查询；配合以任务驱动（即下游检索分数）的自动提示优化（APO）锦标赛循环，为每个（阶段、模型）对自动调优提示，无需手工工程或 LLM 评判器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单 LLM 受限于训练数据与架构偏差，且提示工程在不同模型族间难以迁移、规模化成本高，限制了查询端富化方法在工业 IR 场景中的实用价值。

Method: 两阶段框架：Stage 1 使用 Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B-v0.3 三种异构模型并行生成查询扩展候选；Stage 2 使用 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 生成式融合候选为单一查询。任务驱动 APO 循环：基于 20% 开发子集的 BM25 nDCG@10 对候选提示评分，采用锦标赛机制（每轮生成两份挑战样本，与当前冠军比较，连续两轮存活则收敛），并提供带历史轨迹的变体。

Result: 在五个 BEIR 基准（NQ、SciFact、FiQA、Touché-2020、DBPedia）上，相对原始查询 BM25 nDCG@10 提升 +2.1 至 +14.9 点；在所有五个数据集上击败无监督 LLM 查询扩展基线 Exp4Fuse，并在 3/5 数据集上匹配或超越更强的监督基线 docT5query+Exp4Fuse。Stage-2 集成严格优于任一 Stage-1 模型；任务驱动 APO 将 −4 至 −5 点的种子提示退化恢复为稳定增益。

Conclusion: MERGE 通过双层集成（水平异构生成 + 垂直生成式融合）结合任务驱动 APO，实现了无需手工提示工程、无需语料访问、无需有监督训练数据的查询扩展，在 BEIR 上验证了与强监督方法相当或更优的检索性能，且对检索器无关，可自然延伸至稠密检索器或文档端富化。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to enrich user queries in information retrieval (IR) so that a standard retriever such as BM25 can bridge vocabulary gaps with the target corpus. Any single LLM, however, is limited by its training data and architectural biases, and its enrichment behavior depends on hand-crafted prompts that must be re-engineered for each new model -- an expensive and poorly scalable process. We present MERGE (Multi-LLM Ensemble for Retrieval via Generative Enrichment), a two-stage framework: three heterogeneous 7-8B open-source LLMs independently produce candidate expansions, and a larger LLM generatively synthesizes them into a single query. To make prompt engineering scalable across the ensemble, we integrate a task-grounded Automatic Prompt Optimization (APO) loop into both stages. Unlike APO methods that judge candidates with an LLM evaluator, our loop scores each candidate by its downstream retrieval performance and runs a small tournament between the current champion prompt and optimizer-proposed drafts, terminating once the champion survives two consecutive rounds; a history-augmented variant additionally feeds the recent tournament trajectory back to the optimizer. MERGE is retriever-agnostic and issues a single BM25 pass with no rank fusion, no supervised document expansion, and no re-indexing. On five BEIR benchmarks (NQ, SciFact, FiQA, Touche-2020, DBPedia), MERGE improves BM25 nDCG@10 over the original queries by +2.1 to +14.9 points and matches or outperforms strong LLM-based query-expansion baselines despite using only compact open-source models. Ablations confirm that the Stage-2 ensemble beats any single Stage-1 LLM, and that task-grounded APO converts large seed-prompt regressions into consistent gains without hand-tuning.

</details>


### [444] [Effective Dense Retrieval using Only In-Context Examples](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38099)
*Nour Jedidi,Abdul Basit Ali,Hang Li,Jimmy Lin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: RICE（Representations from In-Context Examples）是一种无需训练的稠密检索方法，通过少量上下文示例（in-context examples）提示decoder-only大语言模型（LLM），直接生成高质量的稠密表示。在10个BEIR数据集上，RICE在所有"训练-free"方法中取得了最高的平均Recall@100，并能与LLM2Vec-Gen等自监督检索器相媲美，但与大规模监督训练的稠密检索器仍有差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于decoder-only LLM的稠密检索系统通常需要额外的检索器训练（监督或自监督），但构建无需训练即可获得有效LLM嵌入的方法仍具挑战。PromptReps通过指令提示LLM直接生成表示，但查询和文档编码相互独立，缺乏共享上下文。作者希望探索仅通过少量in-context examples即可让LLM生成有效的稠密检索表示。

Method: RICE基于PromptReps的思路：让LLM生成一个代表性单词，并提取其最终隐藏状态作为嵌入表示。与PromptReps不同的是，RICE在提示中加入少量任务相关的query-document示例对，每个示例包含PromptReps生成的代表性单词。这些in-context examples为查询和文档编码提供共享上下文。RICE还包含零样本变体（RICE Zero-Shot），用于对比prompt文本差异的影响。方法还探索了动态示例选择（基于BM25相似度）以及不同示例组合的影响。

Result: 在10个BEIR数据集上，使用Qwen3-8B和Qwen3.5-9B作为backbone：1）RICE在所有training-free方法中达到最高平均Recall@100；2）相比PromptReps-Dense，Qwen3-8B提升3.6点，Qwen3.5-9B提升2.4点；3）相比RICE Zero-Shot（Qwen3.5-9B），RICE提升3.6点，证明收益来自in-context examples；4）使用Qwen3.5-9B时，RICE比LLM2Vec-Gen平均Recall@100高1.6点；5）动态示例选择（查询侧）可进一步提升效果；6）消融实验显示示例的领域相关性比query-document相关性更重要，准确的相关性标注并非必需。

Conclusion: RICE证明了仅通过少量in-context examples即可让LLM生成有效的稠密检索表示，无需任何检索器训练。该方法在training-free方法中达到最优，并缩小了与监督稠密检索器之间的差距。消融研究发现：in-context examples的价值主要来自任务和领域特定的语言，而非示例的准确性；同领域内的非相关示例甚至随机示例都能提升效果，而跨领域相关示例则效果较差。RICE为构建无需训练的稠密检索系统提供了有前景的方向，且易于适应新任务和领域。

Abstract: Turning decoder-only large language models (LLMs) into strong dense retrievers typically requires some form of retriever training. In this paper, we ask whether LLMs can instead be prompted to produce effective representations for dense retrieval given only a few in-context examples. To answer this, we introduce RICE (Representations from In-Context Examples), a simple "training-free" approach that extracts high-quality dense representations from LLMs. To do so, RICE conditions the LLM on examples that provide a shared context for query and document encoding. Our results demonstrate that RICE embeddings can substantially improve the accuracy of prompt-based LLM embeddings, establishing it as a simple method to build LLM-based dense retrievers that do not require training. We release our code at this https URL .

</details>


### [445] [Socrates-RAG: Premise-Directed Inquiry against Coordinated Evidence Poisoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35773)
*Renyu Zhao,Xinyuan Zou,Lanbin Liu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 Socrates-RAG，一种面向开放语料问答中"协同证据投毒"的主动检索防御策略。该策略将竞争性答案表征为假设，识别能区分它们的一个未解决前提，并据此生成下一次查询以获取决定性证据。在 48 个反事实虚构世界（24 个一跳 + 24 个二跳）上的对照实验表明，Socrates-RAG 的安全准确率从基线查询扩展的 79.2% 提升至 93.8%（p=0.0391），增益完全来自二跳案例中"前提替换"机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 RAG 投毒防御（TrustRAG、RobustRAG、ReliabilityRAG 等）多作用于已检索到的固定证据集合，仅解决"哪些已检索证据应该被采信"。但在开放语料场景下，决定性证据可能根本不在初始上下文中——此时防御的关键不再是过滤或聚合，而是"下一步该检索什么"。简单地重复原查询只会检索到更多攻击者的协调副本，无法恢复缺失的决定性记录。

Method: 方法分四个角色：① Assertor 表征当前候选答案及其必要前提；② Elenchus 选取一个"若被解决即可区分各候选答案"的前提，并据此生成包含专有实体/案号/规则名的判别性查询；③ Aporia 决定证据是否足以支持唯一答案或仍存在不可消解的冲突；④ Dialectic 返回带引用的简短答案或 CannotDetermine。控制器强制执行 B=2 查询、每查询 top-3 的预算，并实施"证据链释放守卫"——只当引用页面包含直接绑定实体与答案的最终记录，或包含桥接记录加上其终端记录时才放行答案，否则转为弃答。配套给出条件性救援保证定理（(B,r)-separable 状态下，前提导向策略的安全覆盖率为 1 而重复/主题查询为 0）以及副本鲁棒性引理（攻击副本若评分低于决定性文档则无法将其挤出 top-r）。对照基线为同一主干网络生成的"普通相关性查询扩展"，二者共享初始证据、检索器、预算、答案提示与释放规则，差异仅在查询生成。

Result: 在 48 个与开发集不相交的反事实虚构世界上：Socrates-RAG 安全准确率 45/48（93.8%），查询扩展 38/48（79.2%）；配对结果 8 胜 1 负 39 平，双侧精确符号检验 p=0.0391；决定性证据召回率同步提升；不安全答案从 1 例降为 0 例。分层分析显示差距完全集中在 24 个二跳案例（Socrates-RAG 21/24 vs. 扩展 14/24），一跳案例二者均 24/24。机制层面，7/8 次 Socratic 胜局表现为：首查询检索到签署的策展记录→将新解析出的档案/规则代入第二查询以命中终端存储记录；而扩展基线继续使用宽泛的人名-档案-金库术语反复检索协调投毒副本。静态对照 RobustRAG 与 TrustRAG 在同一 48 世界上分别得到 0/48 安全答案（不安全 48/48 与 24/48），证实了"决定性证据不在初始集合中时，固定上下文聚合必然失败"的边界。代价方面，二者均调用 144 次模型，但 Socrates-RAG 的输出 token（121,771 vs. 66,346）与延迟（1,215.6s vs. 758.9s）显著更高。

Conclusion: 本文将 RAG 投毒防御重新框定为"主动证据获取"问题：聚合保护上下文中已有的证据，而前提导向的探究能够恢复"可触及但尚未被检索"的缺失证据。其收益并非普遍存在——仅当新解析出的前提必须被组合进下一次查询（二跳证据链）时才显现；在标识符已可见或主干网络能独立推断出合适来源类型时收益接近归零。形式化保证是有条件的（前提-查询可分离性），且评估使用虚构模板化世界与确定性词法检索，不直接外推到开放 Web 上的实际攻击场景。需进一步在公开多跳语料、实时检索器、自适应攻击与多模型上验证外部有效性及质量-成本权衡。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) defenses typically decide how to filter or aggregate a fixed retrieved set. In open-corpus question answering, however, decisive evidence may be absent from the initial context but retrievable, making the next query part of the reliability problem. We introduce Socrates-RAG, a premise-directed active retrieval policy that represents competing answers, selects an unresolved premise whose resolution would discriminate them, and uses newly acquired evidence to refine a subsequent query before answering or abstaining. We formalize the resulting finite-budget evidence state and give a conditional rescue guarantee relative to repeated or topical-query policies. We evaluate Socrates-RAG against a matched control in which the same backbone generates ordinary relevance-oriented search queries; both policies share the initial evidence, deterministic retriever, two-query/top-three budget, answer prompt, and label-free evidence-chain release rule. On a disjoint 48-world counterfactual evaluation, premise-directed inquiry raises safe accuracy from 79.2% to 93.8%, with 8 wins, 1 loss, and 39 ties (two-sided exact p=.0391). Decisive-evidence recall improves by the same margin, while unsafe answers fall from one to zero. Both policies solve all 24 one-hop cases; the gain is concentrated in two-hop cases, where Socrates-RAG substitutes a newly resolved premise into its second query. This controlled study isolates a specific benefit of premise-directed acquisition without claiming general robustness on the open Web.

</details>


### [446] [Post-Generation Verification Dominates Retrieval Optimization: A 2^4 Factorial Ablation of RAG Pipeline Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35774)
*Ng S. T. Chong*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该论文通过 2^4 全因子消融实验，系统比较了 RAG 流水线中四个增强特征（章节扩展 SE、代理搜索 AS、完整性检查 CC、目录引导检索 ToC）的效果与交互作用。实验涵盖 768 个条件（16 配置 × 24 查询 × 2 模型），在 5 份公共文档上进行。主要发现是：生成后验证（CC）是单一最有效特征（d=+0.48），其单独使用优于任何不含 CC 的配置；ToC 提供零 LLM 成本的显著增益；AS 效果不稳定且依赖查询类型；SE 在该语料上无效。研究强调验证答案比优化检索更重要，且评估 RAG 特征需要因子设计与多样化的查询类型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代 RAG 流水线堆叠了大量增强特征，但这些特征通常被孤立验证，其交互效应未被测量。论文指出单因素评估无法揭示特征间的冗余、互补或抵消关系，也无法可靠地为部署决策排序特征优先级。

Method: 采用 2^4 全因子设计，在 5 份公共文档（GDPR, UN Staff Rules, EU AI Act, UNOPS Procurement, NIST 800-53r5；78–492 页）上对 4 个独立特征（SE, AS, CC, ToC）的全部 16 种组合进行测试，使用 24 个查询覆盖 8 种交互类型（baseline, se_target, toc_target, as_target, cc_target, toc_cc, as_toc, full_stack），使用两种云端模型（DeepSeek-V4-Flash, grok-4.3），共 768 个条件。使用 Claude Opus 4.6 对照已验证参考答案进行模型答案锚定评分（准确性、完整性、有用性 1–5 分）。主效应采用 Welch's t 检验，置信区间为 5000 次自助法（seed 42）。

Result: CC 为主效应最强的特征（d=+0.48, p<0.001），在准确性、完整性和有用性上均显著；CC 单独使用得 4.31/5，超过所有不含 CC 的配置（包括 SE+AS+ToC 的 4.11）。ToC 获 d=+0.22（p=0.003），零 LLM 成本。AS 复合效果小且不稳定（d=+0.14, p=0.050），帮助部分查询但伤害另一些（如 as_target 上 Δ=−0.22）。SE 完全无效（d=−0.01）。SE×CC 交互显示 SE 在 CC 启用后贡献可忽略。质量-延迟帕累托前沿包含 6 个配置，最高质量配置（4.35）延迟约为基线两倍。查询类型强烈调节特征效用（在 cc_target 上 CC 达 d=+0.83），单查询类型评估会系统性错误排序特征。仅 ToC 在页面级检索精度/召回率上有可观察的影响。

Conclusion: 论文结论是：生成后验证（CC）比检索阶段优化（SE/AS/ToC）更具杠杆效应；特征的效用强烈依赖于查询类型，单一查询类型评估会系统性错误排序；应优先选择哪些特征启用，而非启用的数量；评估 RAG 流水线特征时，因子设计与多样化的查询类型是必要的方法论保障。实践建议：低延迟场景用 ToC；均衡场景用 AS+ToC；质量优先场景用 CC；最高质量用全特征组合。

Abstract: Modern RAG pipelines stack many enhancement features, but these features are typically validated in isolation, leaving their interactions unmeasured. We run a 2^4 full factorial ablation of four pipeline features -- section expansion (SE), agentic search (AS), completeness check (CC), and table-of-contents-guided retrieval (ToC) -- across 16 configurations, 24 queries spanning eight interaction types, and two cloud-class models (768 conditions) on five public documents (78-492 pages), scoring every answer against a verified reference. Post-generation verification dominates: CC is the strongest feature (d=+0.48, p<0.001), improving accuracy, completeness, and usefulness simultaneously, and CC alone (4.31/5) outperforms every configuration without it, including the three-feature SE+AS+ToC (4.11). ToC yields a significant gain at zero LLM cost (d=+0.22); AS is small and unstable, helping some queries and harming others; SE is neutral. The highest-quality configuration roughly doubles baseline latency, producing a genuine quality-latency Pareto frontier of six configurations. Feature utility is strongly query-type dependent -- CC reaches d=+0.83 on completeness-demanding queries -- so single-query-type evaluations systematically mis-rank features. We conclude that verifying answers matters more than optimizing retrieval, and that factorial designs with diverse query types are necessary to evaluate RAG features.

</details>


### [447] [TSG Suggester: Tree-Structured Knowledge-Graph Retrieval for Troubleshooting Guide Recommendation in Cloud Incident Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35780)
*Shawn Pan,PavanUttej Ravva,Walt Williams,CJ Barberan,Nutan Sahoo,Ziran Min,David Gross,Irene Shaffer*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: TSG Suggester是一种云事件管理中的故障排除指南（TSG）检索系统，通过将每篇指南解析为保留原生章节层级的树状结构，在内部节点附加由大语言模型生成的"问题抽象"，并融合每篇指南的实体知识图谱进行查询时的混合检索，在314个真实事件、112篇指南和18个服务团队上取得了54.78% Top-1和82.48% Top-5的准确率，显著优于文本RAG、RAPTOR、图像增强RAG等基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云服务的事件响应中，在轮值工程师需要快速定位适用的故障排除指南，但现有流程依赖关键词搜索，指南以解决方案语言撰写而事件以症状语言描述，存在严重的词表鸿沟，导致检索耗时长、影响恢复效率。

Method: 提出Tree + KG方法，包含四个阶段：(1) 解析每篇指南为JSON树保留原生层级；(2) 对每个内部节点用LLM生成问题抽象，将解决方案语言重写为问题语言；(3) 为每篇指南独立构建实体知识图谱；(4) 查询时融合节点嵌入相似度（取最大值以避免嵌入稀释）与实体匹配得分。比较了五种检索策略。

Result: Tree + KG在所有截断点领先（Top-1 54.78%、Top-3 77.07%、Top-5 82.48%），相比纯文本RAG Top-1提升8.58点。结构贡献+2.15点，知识图谱实体匹配贡献额外的+6.43点。两个反直觉发现：(1) 原生层级优于RAPTOR构建的层级；(2) 多模态图像增强反而有害，Top-5降低22.64点，因为通用描述稀释了嵌入。

Conclusion: 结构对齐优于语义增强：保留作者书写的层级、添加问题抽象重写、辅以实体级离散信号，构成了针对有层级的技术文档检索的正确架构。部署建议：返回Top-5候选而非单条；将Tree+KG作为检索骨干；利用相似度结构主动识别重复指南以改善语料库质量。

Abstract: On call engineers in large scale cloud services work under intense time pressure, yet locating the correct Troubleshooting Guide (TSG) for an incident remains a largely manual, keyword driven process, and prior empirical work finds that guide search consumes a substantial fraction of total mitigation time. We present TSG Suggester, a retrieval system that recommends relevant TSGs directly from an incident description. We evaluate five retrieval strategies: Text Only RAG, Image Augmented RAG, RAPTOR, Tree Structured Retrieval, and our proposed Tree + Knowledge Graph (Tree+KG), on 314 real world incidents spanning 112 unique TSGs drawn from 18 service teams on a production incident management system. Tree+KG converts each guide into a tree that preserves its native section hierarchy, attaches LLM generated problem abstractions to internal nodes to bridge the solution oriented language of guides and the problem oriented language of incidents, extracts a per guide entity knowledge graph, and fuses embedding similarity with entity level matching at query time. Tree+KG attains 54.78% Top 1 and 82.48% Top 5 accuracy, leading every baseline at every cutoff, with an 8.58 point Top 1 gain over text only RAG. Two findings are of independent interest. First, structural alignment dominates: methods that preserve or rebuild document structure outperform flat chunking where precise discrimination matters. Second, and contrary to our initial hypothesis, multimodal enrichment actively hurts. Captioning guide screenshots and injecting the captions costs 22.64 Top 5 points relative to the text only baseline because generic captions dilute embeddings rather than sharpen them. We report error analyses for both results and provide concrete deployment guidance.

</details>


### [448] [Financial Evidence Crowding: Diagnosing and Mitigating Constraint-Induced Displacement in Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35782)
*Yixi Zhou,Jiayi Yin,Fan Zhang,Xiangyi He,Haipeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出"金融证据拥挤"(Financial Evidence Crowding)概念,诊断并缓解RAG中由显式查询约束冲突导致的固定top-k上下文分配失败。通过FinDeCrowd-Stress受控诊断框架证明冲突候选使Recall@10降低0.147,并提出FinDeCrowd-RAG方法(结合类型化兼容性与局部词法竞争的学得残差+恒等门控)在不改变候选库的前提下将Recall@10从0.757提升至0.902,并改善下游问答准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG在金融问答中受限于固定top-k上下文预算,主题相似但存在period、segment、metric或table scope冲突的候选会挤占上下文槽位,将答案支持证据挤出top-k。现有基准的聚合检索分数混淆了语义竞争与显式约束冲突,二者需要不同对策,因此需要可审计的受控诊断与针对性修复。

Method: 1) FinDeCrowd-Stress:构建matched compatible与incompatible候选池,固定查询、相关证据、排序模型、候选数与检索预算,通过BGE/TF-IDF相似度等多维匹配控制难度差异,量化由显式冲突造成的额外位移;2) FinDeCrowd-RAG:在冻结基础分数(如BGE)上学习线性残差,整合类型化兼容性、模式覆盖率与局部词法竞争浓度(候选与bank内5近邻的平均TF-IDF余弦);3) 恒等门控(identity gate):二元路由预测残差是否改善nDCG@10,否则保持原始排序,控制回归风险;4) 非注入评估:在无查询特定候选插入的FinDER全局索引上分析拥挤发生率与修复效果。

Result: 受控诊断显示不兼容池使Recall@10下降0.147(95% CI [-0.164,-0.129]),最佳支持证据平均后移3.34位;FinDeCrowd-RAG在相同候选库上将Recall@10从0.757提升至0.902、nDCG@10从0.557提升至0.714;非注入检索中拥挤占可修复失败的43.5%,恒等门控将Recall@10从0.420提升至0.492同时回归率仅2.6%;在FinanceBench与FinQA上分别提升答案准确率9.2与3.0个百分点并降低无支持响应率。

Conclusion: 约束诱导位移是RAG中可分离、可度量的评估目标;固定候选库上的恒等门控重排序能在保持Recall@100不变的前提下有效恢复已被检索覆盖的证据,改善生成端答案准确性与引用支持,为RAG评估中分离"证据可用性"、"上下文分配"与"答案使用"三个层次提供了方法论基础。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) retrieves candidate evidence and sends only a limited top-ranked subset, the top-k context, to a generator. In financial question answering, passages can match a query's topic while conflicting with its period, segment, metric scope, or table scope. We study the resulting set-level ordering failure, which we call financial evidence crowding. FinDeCrowd-Stress isolates this failure through matched compatible and incompatible candidate pools while fixing the query, relevant evidence, ranking model, candidate count, and retrieval budget. On a FinDER test split containing companies unseen during training, incompatible pools reduce top-10 evidence inclusion (Recall@10) by 0.147 relative to equally difficult compatible pools. This gap shows that conflicting candidates consume limited context slots and displace answer-supporting evidence. We then introduce FinDeCrowd-RAG, a learned score correction that combines a fixed relevance score with typed compatibility and local lexical competition. A query-level identity gate applies the correction only when it predicts a better order; otherwise, it preserves the original ranking. On identical controlled candidates, FinDeCrowd-RAG raises top-10 evidence inclusion from 0.757 to 0.902 by recovering evidence already present in the candidate set. On a FinDER index built without query-specific candidate insertion, gated reranking raises this inclusion rate from 0.420 to 0.492, while top-100 retrieval coverage remains 0.743 by design. With a fixed generator, the same ordering change improves answer accuracy and citation recall on FinanceBench and FinQA. These results identify constraint-induced displacement as a measurable RAG evaluation target and show that identity-gated reranking can recover evidence already covered by first-stage retrieval.

</details>


### [449] [Structured Interaction, Visual Localization, and Robust Execution for Complex Web Tasks: A Technical Report on the WebRetriever Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35904)
*Ziqi Zhang,Shaohui Li,Bing Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文介绍了在WebRetriever Challenge中获胜的Web代理系统，采用"结构化交互优先、按需视觉感知"的策略，结合三大关键设计：网格化视觉定位、层次化上下文管理、容错执行机制，在官方Protocol 3比赛中以59%的通过率获得第一名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型在推理、规划和工具使用方面的进步，Web自动化正从基于规则的脚本转向由自然语言指令驱动的自主代理。Web代理需要理解页面状态、自主选择交互目标和操作类型，并根据网站反馈持续调整动作。WebRetriever Challenge要求代理在真实或近真实的Web环境中完成信息检索、过滤、排序和内容提取任务，面临三大挑战：(1)结构化表示对图表、图像、颜色等视觉信息不完整；(2)长交互轨迹导致上下文冗余；(3)多任务并发执行中的故障传播。

Method: 系统基于AgentScope和Playwright MCP构建，包含三个核心组件：(1)网格辅助视觉定位——在截图上叠加16×12网格并使用归一化坐标系[0,1000]²，让视觉语言模型先定位网格区域再估算精确坐标，避免直接预测像素坐标；(2)层次化上下文管理——对browser_snapshot进行48,000字节阈值下的结构感知截断（优先保留main、article、dialog区域），对JavaScript输出进行JSON解析和冗余字符串替换（24,000字节预算），并在75%的280,000 token上下文使用时触发历史摘要；(3)故障感知执行机制——每个CDP端点启动独立worker进程，使用短锁分配任务，工具超时180秒（三次连续超时终止），区分页面级错误和连接级故障进行分级恢复，父进程监控心跳并在等待超限时终止重启worker。

Result: 系统使用Qwen3.7-Plus作为主模型和视觉语言模型，温度0.2，最多100次ReAct迭代。在Protocol 1本地评估中达到79%的最佳通过率（100个任务，单浏览器连续执行）；在Protocol 3官方比赛中使用8个并发browser worker达到59%的通过率，结合NavEval和人工验证，排名第一并赢得WebRetriever Challenge冠军。

Conclusion: 获胜系统成功整合了结构化网页交互、截图理解和网格辅助视觉定位，层次化上下文管理支持长轨迹任务，浏览器会话复用、有界超时处理和worker级恢复支持并发执行。经验表明需要协调模型决策、页面表示和执行基础设施，自适应工具选择和任务感知记忆是未来改进方向。

Abstract: This report presents the web agent system developed for the WebRetriever Challenge. The system follows a structuredinteraction- first strategy, using semantic webpage information for routine browser operations and invoking visual perception only when structured representations are insufficient. Three key designs are introduced: grid-assisted visual localization for difficult-to-access controls, hierarchical context management for reducing redundant page and interaction history, and fault-aware execution mechanisms for stable multi-browser task processing. The system achieved a pass rate of up to 79% in local evaluation on Protocol 1. In the official Protocol 3 competition, it achieved a 59% pass rate with eight concurrent browser workers and ranked first overall, winning the WebRetriever Challenge.

</details>


### [450] [GRP v0.1 Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36688)
*Wenfeng Zhuo,Vincent Xue,Charles Wei,Cong Ni,Ruiming Lu,Jiwen Ren,Mo Li,Peng Yang,Xufei Wang,Dongheng Li,Jiacong He,Yi Song,Yufei Fan,Mikhail Obukhov,Yiwen Chen,Yvette Liu,Yin Ye,Chengjie Wu,Mingtao Zhang,Jinchao Ye,Lili Zhang,Chunhui Zhu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Snap Inc. 提出 GRP（Generative Recommendation Paradigm），将检索、排序与奖励建模统一在单个编码器-解码器模型中，并通过渐进式部署路径（先作为新增检索源、再替换弱源、最终绕过排序器）替代传统多阶段级联。核心贡献包括：项目级历史融合、偏解码器架构设计、合并显式行为流的子线性采样、Qwen3-VL Semantic ID 编码、判别性增强的 MHP 排序模块、引入参考锚定边际项的 mGRPO 后训练算法，以及将端到端检索延迟降低 69% 的推理优化。在线 A/B 实验中，绕过早期排序并替换较弱源带来 +0.82% 观看时长和 +2.56% 分享量的显著增长，且平台级护栏指标中性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业推荐系统依赖检索、粗排、精排与重排的多阶段级联，难以整体替换为端到端生成模型。直接"一夜替换"的尝试因三个结构性障碍而失败：(1) 生成检索的粗粒度"下一项"排序远未达到最终排序质量；(2) 短视频内容目录每日近乎完全更新，冻结模型的精确召回迅速崩塌；(3) 对生成候选真正具有判别力的奖励模型本身就是难题。作者主张采用渐进式替换路径而非激进切换，并在建模层面将排序与奖励统一纳入生成模型。

Method: 模型架构：T5 风格编码器-解码器，采用 1:2 编码器-解码器层比例（偏解码器）。编码侧使用项目级融合（每个历史项压缩为一个 token）配合变长 FlashAttention 和 RoPE（仅用于编码器自注意力）；解码侧采用按目标项分块的块间独立自注意力机制，使生成成本与目标项数线性相关而非其交叉乘积。生成目标为 Qwen3-VL Semantic ID（RQ-VAE 量化 + 协同参与对比损失），所有层级共享单一嵌入表。排序模块为多任务预测（MHP）网络，对候选 query 启用跨注意力加 DCNv2 直连残差路径，输出多个参与度预测（完成、跳过、观看时长、收藏、分享、回复等），且三个输入（候选 SID 嵌入、编码器隐藏状态、用户上下文）均使用 stop-gradient 切断以避免干扰生成表征。后训练采用 mGRPO：冻结编码器、归一化与 MHP 模块，仅优化解码器；冻结 MHP 作为奖励信号，并加入参考锚定的单边边际项，当策略开始用高奖励样本替换已记录目标时激活，保护召回。后训练使用 Muon（≥2-D 权重矩阵）+ Lamb（1-D 参数）混合优化器。推理优化包含事件序列截断、事件扁平化 C++ 重写、批量反向查找、KV 缓存、CUDA 图捕获和工作进程调优。

Result: 离线结果：(1) 项目级融合在相同编码器 token 预算下容纳 4 倍历史，HR@10 +1.7%；(2) 1:2 编解码比例相比 2:1 在 HR@5/10/20 与吞吐上同时提升（+21% 吞吐）；(3) 合并显式行为流后 Reward Recall@20 提升 20%；(4) Qwen3-VL SID 较 MM-SID 在 Recall@20 上提升 11.9%；(5) MHP 重设计后稠密头 AUROC 提升 0.11–0.13，稀疏头 AUPRC 提升 97–184%；(6) mGRPO 在 2 节点规模下实现 Reward Recall@10 +3.1% 且 Recall@10 +0.9%，而纯 GRPO 召回下降 1.25% 且奖励无增益。推理端到端检索延迟降低 69%。在线 A/B 测试：作为检索源，4 倍解码预算下观看时长 +0.46%、分享量 +0.77%（20 倍预算下均显著）；早期排序绕过 + 源替换使观看时长 +0.82%、分享量 +2.56%、浏览量 +0.47%，且平台级护栏中性。

Conclusion: GRP 验证了"将排序与奖励建模吸收进生成模型 + 渐进式迁移"是可行的端到端生成推荐路径。渐进式三阶段策略（新增检索源 → 替换弱源 → 绕过排序器）使每一步都可独立度量与发布。当前局限：(1) 在升压率等部分维度上仍落后于最强源，限制了配额扩张；(2) MHP 在稀有头（收藏、分享、回复）上的 AUPRC 绝对值仍低，奖励对关键长尾行为的信息量不足；(3) 部署的密集模型规模偏小，历史扩展在 B_ref 之后增益消失，RL 收益随批量规模增长，提示密集容量配置不足。未来工作包括：多目标奖励、缩小 MHP 在服务分布上与生产排序器的差距、以及评估更大规模密集模型并复现扩展规律。

Abstract: Industrial recommendation systems rely on multi-stage cascades whose retrieval, ranking, and serving components are difficult to replace jointly. We present GRP, a generative recommendation framework that combines retrieval, ranking, and reward modeling in a single encoder-decoder model, and evaluate a progressive path toward end-to-end recommendation. The model generates multimodal Semantic IDs and scores candidates with a jointly trained ranking module. The frozen ranking module then supplies rewards for reinforcement-learning post-training. We introduce mGRPO, which adds a reference-anchored margin to reward optimization to preserve the likelihood of logged targets. Offline experiments examine history encoding, model capacity allocation, event selection, tokenization, and reward discrimination. Serving optimizations reduce end-to-end retrieval latency by 69%. Online experiments evaluate the model as a retrieval source, with early-ranking bypass, and with replacement of weaker sources. In a retrieval-only comparison, view time increases by 0.46% and shares by 0.77% relative to production. A separate comparison combining bypass and source replacement yields increases of 0.82% in view time and 2.56% in shares, with neutral platform-level guardrails. These results support progressive deployment while identifying remaining gaps in ranking quality and performance across recommendation metrics.

</details>


### [451] [Optimizing VLP-aligned Multimodal Intent Representation with Correct Visual Instantiation for Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36946)
*Xuri Ge,Chunhao Wang,Junchen Fu,Haokun Wen,Zhiwei Xu,Ying Zhou,Zhumin Chen,Pengjie Ren,Zhaochun Ren,Xin Xin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: VMIR-CVI是一个统一的零样本合成图像检索（ZS-CIR）框架，通过结合VLP对齐的多模态意图推理与正确的视觉实例化，优化与VLP兼容的多模态意图表示。该方法在CIRR、CIRCO和FashionIQ三个基准上达到了新的SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的零样本CIR方法存在两个主要问题：(1) 视觉伪词学习方法引入参考噪声且融合粗糙；(2) MLLM推理方法生成的描述冗长且视觉锚定不足。两者都偏离了VLP的原生表示空间，导致检索性能受限。本文旨在构建既语义明确又视觉实例化锚定、同时与冻结VLP检索空间兼容的混合模态意图表示。

Method: 提出VMIR-CVI框架，包含三个核心模块：(1) VMIR模块——通过多步CoT提示注入VLP风格的少样本示例，引导MLLM生成目标一致且保留正确参考实例的检索对齐文本描述；(2) TVID模块——无需训练，利用ViT倒数第二层特征、注意力消除的最终层、空文本参考，通过实例感知注意力机制解耦细粒度视觉实例，抑制噪声；(3) HIAF模块——通过上下文感知实例伪词嵌入（CIPE）策略将视觉实例注入目标描述对应位置，再通过可学习的Combiner动态融合纯文本与混合模态表示，采用CLIP风格对比学习进行预训练。预训练在10万张ImageNet图像上进行，仅训练轻量级Projector和Combiner。

Result: 在CIRR、CIRCO和FashionIQ三个基准上，分别使用ViT-B/32、ViT-L/14、ViT-G/14三种CLIP骨干网络，VMIR-CVI均达到了新的SOTA。以ViT-L/14为例：CIRR平均Recall@k提升至62.69（+2.55于OSrCIR），CIRCO平均mAP提升至28.96（+2.46），FashionIQ平均R@10/R@50提升至36.40/57.78（+3.14/+3.41）。消融实验验证了三个模块的互补性：移除目标文本导致最大性能下降（如CIRCO平均mAP下降9.04点），验证了视觉实例化应补充而非替代目标语义。推理延迟约1.5秒，预训练仅需10万图像和约10GB GPU内存。

Conclusion: VMIR-CVI通过统一MLLM意图推理与视觉伪词学习的互补优势，有效弥合了合成查询与冻结VLP检索空间之间的语义鸿沟。VLP对齐的目标导向推理、意图一致的视觉实例化以及混合模态对齐融合三者协同工作，实现了准确且鲁棒的零样本CIR。局限性在于依赖MLLM推理质量、冻结VLP特征对复杂场景可能不足，未来将探索自适应实例对齐和更高效的融合机制。

Abstract: ZS-CIR aims to retrieve a target image from a reference image and a modification text without paired supervision, typically by encoding composed queries as text-dominant representations within the image-text matching space of VLPs. However, queries reconstructed by visual pseudo-word learning or MLLM-based target reasoning often deviate from the native VLP representation space due to reference noise and coarse text fusion in the former, and verbose, weakly visually grounded descriptions in the latter. In this paper, we propose a unified ZS-CIR framework (named VMIR-CVI) to reconstruct multimodal composite queries from two complementary perspectives for optimizing VLP-compatible multimodal intent representation. First, it reasons and converts the multimodal intent into a unified textual description, aligning with the native text space of the VLP backbones to produce more retrieval-compatible textual queries. Second, it reconstructs the query representation with correctly decoupled visual instance cues, reducing reference noise while preserving target-relevant content. Specifically, a VLP-aligned Multimodal Intent Reasoning (VMIR) module injects few-shot VLP-style exemplars into chain-of-thought prompts, guiding the MLLM to generate target-consistent intent queries. A Training-free Visual Instance Disentanglement (TVID) module decouples fine-grained visual instances from global reference features without additional optimization. Finally, a lightweight Hybrid-modal Intent Alignment and Fusion (HIAF) module integrates the reasoned textual intent and disentangled visual cues into a unified hybrid-modal representation for robust ZS-CIR. Extensive experiments on three CIR benchmarks, namely CIRR, CIRCO and FashionIQ, show that VMIR-CVI significantly outperforms existing baselines and achieves new state-of-the-art performance. Code and trained models will be publicly released.

</details>


### [452] [HELIX: Purified and Unified - Rethinking Feature Interaction and Sequence Modeling for Large-Scale Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37183)
*Yuntao Zheng,Miao Zhang,Yadong Ding,Yanchuan Tang,Lixiyu Chen,Hao Wang,Quan Li,Shiying Cai,Yue Lin,Jiayu Li,Yu Feng,Wentao Yang,Rongkun Xing,Jiekai Wang,Mingge Zhang,Feiling Gong,Xiang Gao,Jinyu Dong,Yajing Zhang,Pengfei Ren,Yinzhou Wang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 HELIX，一种面向大规模工业推荐的统一架构，通过将序列建模与特征交互相结合，引入单向信息流和混合 token 机制，缓解单一建模轴的扩展瓶颈；在线 A/B 测试在 TikTok 电商场景带来约 6% 的每用户 GMV 提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业推荐排序模型通常沿两个建模维度发展：异构特征交互和长序列行为建模。作者发现单独扩展任一能力会很快触及扩展上限且扩展律斜率不佳，因此猜想联合扩展两条建模轴才能获得更优的扩展律，从而打破性能瓶颈。

Method: 提出 HELIX 架构，将序列检索与特征交互交错进行，并通过"单向信息流"约束：可复用的序列状态只单向流向候选条件化的 mix-token，从而在保持用户侧序列计算可摊销的同时，跨深度保留两条建模轴间的通信；支持序列建模与特征交互的不对称、灵活扩展。

Result: HELIX 部署于 TikTok 电商推荐系统，离线指标上稳定提升 CTR AUC、CVR AUC 等排序表现；在在线 A/B 测试中实现约 6% 的电商视频每用户 GMV 增长。

Conclusion: HELIX 验证了序列建模与特征交互联合扩展的重要性，表明统一的交错架构配合单向信息流和 mix-token 设计，是工业推荐模型实现更优扩展律并带来显著业务收益的有效路径。

Abstract: Industrial recommendation ranking models typically scale along two modeling axes: feature interaction over heterogeneous user, item, context, and cross features, and sequence modeling over long, informative, and multi-type user behavior histories. We find that scaling either capability in isolation is insufficient, as each exhibits a limited scaling ceiling and a suboptimal scaling-law slope. We conjecture that achieving a more favorable scaling-law slope requires jointly scaling both axes. To support this, we present HELIX, a purified and unified architecture for large-scale recommendation. HELIX interleaves sequence retrieval and feature interaction while enforcing one-way information flow from reusable sequence states to candidate-conditioned mix-tokens. This design preserves cross-depth communication between the two modeling axes while keeping user-side sequence computation amortizable, enabling flexible and asymmetric scaling of sequence modeling and feature interaction. Deployed in TikTok's e-commerce recommendation system, HELIX consistently improves offline CTR AUC, CVR AUC, and other ranking metrics. In online A/B tests, it achieves an approximately 6% increase in e-commerce video GMV per user.

</details>


### [453] [Towards Semi-Automatically Comparing Keyword-Based and Semantic Search Accuracy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37749)
*Mohamed Ben Salha,Fiete Lüer,Maik Betka,Stefan Wagner*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种初步的半自动评估框架，通过可互换的等价类来定量比较关键词搜索与语义搜索（如RAG）的信息检索准确性。该框架以工业案例研究验证，表明上下文感知搜索在统计上显著优于传统关键词搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统关键词搜索在上下文理解方面存在局限，而新兴的语义聊天搜索（如RAG）虽具潜力，但与传统方法的定量比较研究匮乏，现有评估多依赖主观用户反馈，缺乏严谨的量化对比。

Method: 提出三步评估框架：1）创建基于清单（checklist）的真值集，包含精确关键词、同义词及不相关主题查询；2）定义任务特定的等价类（ordinal scale），将检索质量映射为等级；3）使用Mann-Whitney U-Test和Vargha-Delaney A12统计检验评估差异。通过工业案例（Confluence vs. RAG，使用ChromaDB、Llama 3.2 8B、jinaai嵌入模型）进行验证，共63条查询。

Result: 在63条查询的工业案例研究中：1）Confluence vs. 完整RAG：A12=0.397，U=1574.5，p=0.0195（小效应量0.1782），RAG显著优于Confluence；2）Confluence vs. RAG检索组件：A12=0.353，U=1400.5，p=0.0015（中效应量0.2538），检索组件同样显著优于Confluence。两项比较均达到p<0.05的统计显著性。

Conclusion: 该框架具备可适应性设计，能够客观量化比较不同输出格式（列表 vs. 消息）的IR系统，验证了上下文感知搜索相对于关键词搜索的统计显著优势，同时减少了主观用户研究的成本。但存在单企业案例的局限性，未来可通过自动化真值集生成、纳入响应时间等指标及大规模跨企业验证来扩展框架。

Abstract: The increasing importance of Information Retrieval (IR) in managing large datasets has highlighted significant limitations in traditional keyword-based search systems. Context-aware chat-based search methods, such as Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), have recently emerged, but their evaluation compared to keyword-based systems often relies on subjective user feedback. A rigorous, quantitative comparison between these paradigms remains lacking. This work introduces a novel, preliminary framework to quantitatively assess IR accuracy of search systems that produce different output formats, such as lists and messages. It focuses on two key aspects: the ranking accuracy for keyword-based systems and the completeness of retrieved information for semantic chat-based systems. Our approach enables semi-automatic comparisons of semantic and keyword-based methods using interchangeable equivalence classes tailored to domain-specific contexts (e.g., companies or problems). We validate the framework through an industrial case study, demonstrating statistically significant improvements in context-aware search over keyword-based methods, supported by analyses including the Mann-Whitney U-Test. With its adaptable design, the proposed framework provides a strong foundation for objectively assessing keyword-based and semantic chat-based search methods.

</details>

### [454] [Sage: Formalization with Semantic Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35790)
*Thomas Hirtz,Farzad Jafarrahmani,Abdelmouksit Sagueni,Xiang Zhou,Wengping Deng,Liang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Sage，一个用于自动形式化（autoformalization）的智能体框架，通过四阶段分解生成管道与双信号语义修正循环，将自然语言数学命题翻译为 Lean 4 形式化语句，重点解决"严格性幻觉"问题——即仅通过类型检查的语句可能丢失假设、引入空真命题或篡改数学边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经定理证明系统（如 Goedel-Prover、DeepSeek-Prover、AlphaProof）假设形式化语句 S_F 已给定，专注于证明搜索 S_F→P_F。然而，将非形式化自然语言 S_NL 翻译为 S_NL→S_F 是关键的数据瓶颈，存在"严格性幻觉"：Lean 4 类型检查器接受可通过编译但会丢弃假设、引入空真或改变数学边界的语句。标准编译修复循环无法检测语义不匹配。本文还指出单遍整体翻译（monolithic translation）在处理开放式查询（Question-type）时存在"发现陷阱"（Discovery Trap），模型倾向于猜测答案（70.9% 的泄漏率）以获取高通过率。

Method: Sage 采用三阶段架构：(1) 草案阶段（Draft）——将生成分解为四个角色隔离的智能体：Distiller（识别数学领域，在有证明时提取 Inferred Goal，无证明时将开放查询重述为声明式目标）、Preprocessor（生成 Declarative Normal Form，分离假设与目标）、Formalizer（翻译为 Lean 4，应用 Anti-Trivialization Guard）、Formatter（语法清理与组装）；(2) 验证阶段（Verify）——Lean 4 编译器检查单 sorry 不变式，语义 Rater 沿七个维度评估：Missing、Wrong、Extra、Semantic Match、Exactness、Naturality、Descriptive Precision；(3) 修正阶段（Refine）——双信号语义修正循环联合 Compile∧Sage-SM 门控，每轮向 Corrector 提供 Lean 编译器诊断与 Rater 失败维度、评分及理由，运行 T 轮。框架支持 Answer-Aware（利用非形式证明生成解析后的 prover-ready 目标）与 Answer-Agnostic（不使用证明，忠实保留查询开放性）两种配置。理论贡献包括：区分 Assertion-type 与 Question-type 数学命题的形式化可行性三难（Feasibility Trilemma），以及提出 Type-Theoretic Locks（利用 Lean 4 大消除限制将目标从 Prop 移至 Type，使用 Subtype 强制 prover 提供显式计算见证，防御 Polarity Cheat 与 Triviality Trap）。

Result: 在 Omni-MATH（300 题，98.7% 为 Question-type，Answer-Agnostic）：Sage 在 pass@4 实现 73.3% 的 Compile∧Goedel-SM 联合成功率（pass@1 为 50.3%），相比微调的 Goedel-Formalizer-V2 基线（pass@4 为 42.0%，pass@1 为 26.7%）近乎翻倍；答案泄漏率从 Monolithic+Semantic 的 70.9% 降至 2.7%，Multiple Sorries 率仅 1.1%。在 IMO-Unformalized（175 题国际数学奥林匹克未形式化前沿）：Sage 实现 87.4% pass@4 经验证忠实度，基线仅 19.4%，零样本胜出约 6 倍；盲测配对评估中 79.4% 的对决中获胜。在 IMO-Formalized（223 题）：pass@4 联合忠实度 83.9%（基线 50.7%）。在 Omni-MATH Answer-Aware 设定下：S_QL reachSage-SM 门控达 96.3%，Goedel-SM 达 77.3%。基础模型消融表明，从 Qwen3-32B 到 Qwen3.8-27B，联合忠实度从 30.3% 提升至 85.7%，平均修复轮数从 3.2 降至 ~1.1。语义门控的人工验证：71.1% 与人类多数投票一致，Spearman ρ=0.63、Pearson r=0.64。Goedel-SM 拒绝原因审计显示，Monolithic 与 Goedel 基线主要因 Wrong Injection（74.5%/56.9%）与 Mathematically False 被拒，而 Sage 主要因 Existential 编码（76.8%）被拒。

Conclusion: Sage 证明推理时的语义验证对高完整性形式化不可或缺。通过建立自动形式化器必须作为忠实翻译者而非无约束神谕的原则，Sage 抑制结构性答案泄漏，提供可信赖的合成数据生成引擎，弥合非形式化数学知识与机器可验证真理之间的差距，为下一代自动推理系统奠定基础。局限性包括：(1) 形式化开放查询为存在命题时仍暴露于证明无关性带来的逻辑捷径，需推进类型理论层面的工程化计算目标类型；(2) 多智能体迭代修正带来显著的时钟延迟开销，较适合离线语料生成而非在线推理场景；更强的底层模型协同减少修复轮数并提升忠实度。

Abstract: While neural theorem provers have achieved impressive milestones in formal mathematics, they largely operate on the assumption that faithful Lean 4 formal statements are already provided. Translating informal natural language into a formal language is a critical data bottleneck plagued by an "illusion of rigor": standard type-checkers accept statements that compile but drop hypotheses, introduce vacuous truths, or subtly alter mathematical bounds. To resolve this, we introduce Sage (Semantic Agent-Guided Formalization Engine), an agentic framework that replaces monolithic translation with a four-stage decomposed generation pipeline coupled with a dual-signal semantic correction loop. By pairing Lean 4 compiler diagnostics with multi-dimensional semantic feedback, our correction loop enforces mathematical fidelity alongside syntactic validity. By explicitly accounting for the gap between open-ended queries and declarative formal targets, our pipeline prevents models from achieving high formalization rates by guessing unverified answers (exhibiting a 70.9% answer leakage rate). Consequently, Sage suppresses leakage to 2.7% while achieving 73.3% pass@4 joint compilation and semantic fidelity on the Omni-MATH without proofs (compared to 42.0% for a fine-tuned Goedel-Formalizer-V2 baseline). Finally, on IMO-Unformalized, a novel frontier of 175 unformalized International Mathematical Olympiad problems, Sage demonstrates effective zero-shot generalization with 87.4% pass@4 verified fidelity compared to just 19.4% for the baseline, winning over 79% of blind pairwise evaluations.

</details>


### [455] [Calibration-First Cross-Cohort Multimodal Temporal Learning for Transferable Asthma-Risk Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35795)
*Taimoor Ahmad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CALIBRA-ASTHMA框架，以"校准优先"的方式解决跨队列（cross-cohort）哮喘恶化风险预测中的概率校准与模态缺失问题。该框架整合了专用时序编码器、可靠性条件融合门控、对抗式队列对齐、分层目标校准以及分裂保形预测（split conformal prediction）。在半合成三队列基准测试中，AUPRC低于最强基线TemporalTransformer（0.224 vs 0.240），AUROC为0.717，Brier分数为0.098。作者明确指出这是方法学概念验证，未证明临床有效性，呼吁在真实队列上进行外部验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有哮喘预测模型多在单一队列内优化判别性能，忽视跨队列迁移时的概率校准问题。同时，多模态数据存在缺失性和信息性缺失机制，部署时传感器生态和患者群体发生变化会导致概率失准，单纯追求判别力可能产生不可靠的临床警报。

Method: 1. 专用循环编码器处理6类模态（环境、肺功能、症状、药物、可穿戴、上下文）；2. 可靠性网络基于观测比例、近期性和变异性计算融合门控权重，对完全缺失模态设为零；3. 梯度反转层对抗式地减少队列特异性表征；4. 冻结预测器后，在患者不相交的目标校准子集上训练带岭收缩的分层logistic校准层；5. 分裂保形预测在相同校准集上构造可弃权的预测集合；目标测试标签全程密封，不参与训练、校准或保形分位数估计。

Result: 在5个种子、3队列半合成基准（70+70+60患者，52天，7天窗口预测3天事件）的留一队列迁移测试中：CALIBRA的AUPRC为0.224（低于TemporalTransformer的0.240），AUROC为0.717，Brier分数为0.098，ECE为0.013；模态移除压力测试显示优雅退化；分裂保形覆盖接近名义水平；消融实验显示各组件贡献有限且存在权衡；Wilcoxon配对检验经Holm校正后无统计显著性。

Conclusion: 该工作是一个完整的方法学概念验证，证明了管道在受控偏移下的实现正确性和可复现性。核心局限在于使用了半合成数据，无法证明临床可迁移性、警报安全性或患者获益。作者明确呼吁在至少两个伦理合规的真实纵向哮喘队列上进行外部验证，并预先注册事件定义、缺失数据策略和子组分析。

Abstract: Asthma deterioration forecasting must remain reli- able when patient populations, sensor ecosystems, and available modalities change across cohorts. Existing models commonly optimize within-cohort discrimination and may produce poorly calibrated probabilities after transfer. We present CALIBRA, a calibration-first multimodal temporal framework for short- horizon risk prediction with incomplete data. Dedicated recurrent encoders process environmental, pulmonary, symptom, medication, wearable, and context streams; a reliability-conditioned gate suppresses stale or absent modalities, while gradient-reversal training discourages avoidable cohort signatures. A shrinkage- based hierarchical logistic layer calibrates probabilities using a patient-disjoint target subset, and split conformal prediction provides abstention-capable prediction sets. To avoid fabricating clinical evidence, we evaluate the complete implementation on a documented three-cohort semi-synthetic benchmark with controlled distribution shift, informative missingness, and sealed target patients. Across five configured seeds, CALIBRA achieved mean target-test AUPRC 0.224 versus 0.240 for the strongest non-ablation comparator, TemporalTransformer; mean AUROC was 0.717, and Brier score was 0.098. Experiments additionally assess complete-modality failures, calibration, conformal coverage, decision curves, subgroup behavior, ablations, runtime, and parameter count. The results verify the method and reproducible pipeline under controlled shift, but do not establish clinical effectiveness. External validation on harmonized real asthma. Overall this artifact provides evidence for carefully governed real-cohort validation.

</details>


### [456] [Binarization Flattens the Score Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35797)
*Jacob Cole*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析了大语言模型(LLM)评判器在奖励建模中将多等级评分二值化为通过/失败(0/1)所带来的"评分空间扁平化"问题。研究在联合高斯评分模型下证明了：二值化会引入沿通过阈值的仿射拉伸自由度（不可识别方向），而保留至少一个中间等级（如三等级 {0, 0.5, 1}）可消除此模糊性。在 MATH 和 SciBench 数据上的实验验证了该结论，并指出评分无法消除的残留盲区（如加载对齐的均值偏移，即迎合性风格的提升会被判委员会误读为能力提升）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 评判器作为奖励在 RL 后训练中越来越常见，但常被坍缩为二值判决。这种输出通道的粗糙化使得某些策略变化（如围绕通过阈值的得分拉伸）与真实改进在判委员会看来完全不可区分，构成 reward hacking 的盲区。论文从构造效度角度系统化地刻画这些不可识别的变化。

Method: 1. 观察模型：每个(评判器,准则)对产生的潜在评分 S_ij = λ_j θ_i + ε_ij，θ_i 为共享因子；准则通过固定阈值输出等级或二值判决。
