Motivation: RLHF、最佳N测试时缩放和价值引导推理等应用中，尽管可获得数值奖励，但许多方法仍选择构造成对目标训练奖励模型。经验结果不一致：有些研究报告成对方法优于逐点方法，另一些则发现相反结论。本文旨在回答一个核心问题：给定逐点奖励数据，何时使用成对损失进行奖励学习能在理论上保证更好的下游决策？

Method: 在分组离线上下文赌博机设定下，每个上下文可观测多个动作奖励。考虑半参数模型：均值为可学习的动作相关分量加上任意上下文相关但与动作无关的干扰。通过统一的局部化分析（localized analysis），为有限函数类和线性函数类推导有限样本回归保证，并转化为离线遗憾界。对比逐点回归（VR，直接回归观测奖励）和差分回归（VDR，回归同上下文下配对动作的奖励差）。还推导了VR的下界实例以及线性类的VR替代误差界。

Result: 对于有限类，VDR消除了VR界中2ε_aprx的误指定项，并将F·R_max项从1/N_x尺度改进为1/N尺度，并给出了VR失败但VDR成功的分离实例。对于线性类，VDR消除误指定项ε_aprx、ε_x、ε_a、ε_z，但其N^{-2}项依赖不同的几何量α_C（中心化特征差异的条件数），而非VR的α_0（原始特征的条件数）。通过构造简单例子表明α_C/α_0和α_0/α_C均可趋向无穷。LLM响应选择实验中，N_a≥64时VDR在三种奖励模型下均显著优于VR。

Conclusion: 有限类情形下VDR一致优于VR：消除误指定误差并通过上下文内平均改进奖励尺度项。线性类情形下不存在一致优势：VDR去除干扰引起的偏差（bias），但其方差依赖特征差异的几何性质，在正确设定且几何条件有利时，使用绝对奖励的VR可能具有更低的估计方差。结果呈现特征几何依赖的偏差-方差权衡，实践中应根据misspecification程度和特征几何结构选择目标函数。

Abstract: Pairwise losses are increasingly used for reward learning even when pointwise rewards are observed, with mixed empirical results. When and why do pairwise losses outperform pointwise losses? We study this question in a grouped offline contextual-bandit setting allowing multiple actions per context, capturing many reward learning scenarios. We compare Value Regression (VR), which regresses observed rewards pointwise, with Value Difference Regression (VDR), which regresses reward differences between a pair of actions sampled under the same context. We consider a semiparametric model where the mean reward is the sum of a learnable action-dependent component and an arbitrary context-dependent yet action-independent nuisance, capturing context-specific disturbances. Using a unified localized analysis, we prove finite-sample regression guarantees for finite and linear function classes and translate them into offline-regret bounds. For finite classes, VDR eliminates the misspecification term in the VR bound and improves a reward-scale-dependent error term by averaging over actions within each context, a benefit absent from the corresponding VR term. For linear classes, neither method uniformly dominates: within-context differencing removes nuisance-induced bias but may increase estimation variance relative to using absolute rewards when the misspecification is sufficiently low. This yields a feature geometry-dependent bias-variance tradeoff, which we corroborate with numerical experiments.

</details>


### [679] [Explainable Machine Learning for Multilayer Planar Winding Inductance Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37211)
*Spyros Rigas,Theofilos Papadopoulos,Georgios Alexandridis,Antonios Antonopoulos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Rapid and accurate self-inductance estimation for multilayer rectangle-shaped planar windings is essential for modern high-frequency power converters, yet traditional workflows rely on complex mathematical equations, rigid monomial formulas or unexplainable black-box machine learning (ML) models that degrade severely outside their training domain. This paper introduces an explainable ML framework unifying post-hoc feature attribution (SHAP and permutation importance) with Kolmogorov-Arnold Network-guided symbolic regression via the SR-KAN framework to discover closed-form analytical equations without prior structural assumptions. Evaluated on a new open-source dataset of over 10,000 Finite Element Analysis (FEA) simulations across seven out-of-distribution (OOD) classes, standard tree-based ensembles exhibit severe extrapolation errors (> 36%), whereas the unconstrained SR-KAN expression achieves a robust OOD relative error of 8.22%. Experimental verification across 55 physical printed circuit board prototypes (up to 8 layers, with inductances from 4.11 {\mu}H to 559.27 {\mu}H) confirms that the KAN-discovered expression translates effectively to real-world hardware, predicting inductance with a mean absolute relative error of 6.26%. To support reproducible research, the complete FEA simulation dataset and prototype measurements are released open-source.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI enhancement unavailable (incomplete_output). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

Method: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Result: AI enhancement unavailable; see the original abstract.

Conclusion: AI enhancement unavailable (incomplete_output). Original arXiv metadata is preserved.

Abstract: Rapid and accurate self-inductance estimation for multilayer rectangle-shaped planar windings is essential for modern high-frequency power converters, yet traditional workflows rely on complex mathematical equations, rigid monomial formulas or unexplainable black-box machine learning (ML) models that degrade severely outside their training domain. This paper introduces an explainable ML framework unifying post-hoc feature attribution (SHAP and permutation importance) with Kolmogorov-Arnold Network-guided symbolic regression via the SR-KAN framework to discover closed-form analytical equations without prior structural assumptions. Evaluated on a new open-source dataset of over 10,000 Finite Element Analysis (FEA) simulations across seven out-of-distribution (OOD) classes, standard tree-based ensembles exhibit severe extrapolation errors (> 36%), whereas the unconstrained SR-KAN expression achieves a robust OOD relative error of 8.22%. Experimental verification across 55 physical printed circuit board prototypes (up to 8 layers, with inductances from 4.11 {\mu}H to 559.27 {\mu}H) confirms that the KAN-discovered expression translates effectively to real-world hardware, predicting inductance with a mean absolute relative error of 6.26%. To support reproducible research, the complete FEA simulation dataset and prototype measurements are released open-source.

</details>


### [680] [Interacting particle guidance for sampling reward-tilted generative priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37227)
*Adhithyan Kalaivanan,Zheng Zhao,Jens Sjölund,Fredrik Lindsten*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"交互粒子引导"(IPG)的方法，用于从奖励倾斜(reward-tilted)生成先验中采样。该方法通过在Feynman-Kac PDE中加入一个交互式漂移项来抵消重加权项，从而避免了序列蒙特卡洛(SMC)方法中的权重退化和粒子崩溃问题。漂移项在再生核希尔伯特空间(RKHS)中求解，具有闭式解且计算开销可忽略。实验证明IPG在高斯混合模型、图像修复和蛋白质结构推断任务上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理时引导(inference-time steering)允许在不重新训练的情况下，将预训练的扩散模型和流模型适配到新任务，如条件生成。然而，现有的引导方法依赖近似产生有偏样本，而SMC方法虽然渐近精确但在实际中由于GPU内存限制导致粒子数量受限，遭受严重的权重退化和粒子崩溃问题。需要一种既能保持SMC方法的理论保证又能避免实际退化问题的方法。

Method: 方法核心思想是将SMC中的重加权(resampling)替换为传输(transport)。具体地：(1)分析Feynman-Kac PDE的中间目标密度动态；(2)引入额外的传输项以抵消重加权项；(3)在再生核希尔伯特空间(RKHS)中参数化漂移项u_t，通过最小化平方残差的局部目标函数；(4)利用Tikhonov正则化获得闭式解；(5)提出两种变体：标准IPG和使用Stein控制变量的IPG-CV；(6)采用Langevin扩散项使粒子动力学保持p_t不变性。算法只需在每步求解N×N线性系统，开销极小。

Result: 实验结果：(1)256维GMM实验：IPG和IPG-CV在无重采样情况下，在ESS、均值误差、MMD和SWD指标上均优于FKC和DriftLite基线方法；(2)图像修复实验(N=16粒子)：在256×256 AFHQ Cat图像上，IPG/CPG-CV避免了FKC和DriftLite的严重粒子崩溃，产生了感知上多样化的样本；(3)蛋白质结构推断实验(N=16粒子)：IPG-CV在15个测试蛋白中全部至少产生一个可设计结构，而FKC仅7/15、DriftLite仅8/15；(4)计算开销方面，IPG/IPG-CV与FKC基本相当(约122秒/图像)，远快于DriftLite(约444秒/图像)。

Conclusion: IPG是一种无需训练的方法，通过推导Feynman-Kac PDE中的交互式修正漂移来抵消重加权项，实现了使用无加权交互粒子系统从奖励倾斜生成先验中采样。该方法在RKHS中获得闭式解，计算开销可忽略。实证表明IPG在高斯混合、图像修复和蛋白质结构推断等任务上显著优于现有方法，避免了粒子崩溃问题。研究也指出了局限性：当中间奖励梯度远弱于先验分数时，粒子可能难以跨越多模态分布中的高能垒，可通过调节插值路径或增大正则化参数来缓解。未来工作可探索学习型核或预训练潜空间的应用。

Abstract: Inference-time steering adapts pretrained diffusion and flow-based models to new tasks, e.g., to generate samples from a conditional distribution or samples with desired properties, without retraining. This can be formalized as sampling from a reward-tilted generative prior. As exact sampling from this distribution is intractable, guidance-based methods rely on approximations producing biased samples, and sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) methods correct for this bias using importance weights. However, while exact in the large particle limit, SMC suffers from weight degeneracy and particle collapse in practice. We propose interacting particle guidance (IPG), which replaces reweighting with transport. The particles interact through an additional drift, derived from the Feynman--Kac PDE to cancel the reweighting term, and remain unweighted. Choosing the drift in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space yields a closed-form solution that is cheap to compute, with negligible overhead compared to SMC. We demonstrate the method on Gaussian mixtures with known posteriors, and on high-dimensional image inpainting and protein structure inference tasks.

</details>


### [681] [Differentiating Bisimulation Metrics: A Framework for Parametric Markov Chain Fitting via Bicausal Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37239)
*Sergio Calo,Amy Zhang,Javier Segovia-Aguas,Anders Jonsson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 D-BOT（可微双因果最优传输），通过包络定理推导出双模拟度量关于模型参数的精确闭式梯度，统一解决参数化马尔可夫链拟合、状态空间压缩和观测模仿学习三类任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 序贯决策中的多个核心问题（ILfO、状态空间压缩、world-model 学习、sim-to-real）都可归结为"最小化模型与目标过程之间的距离"，但现有方法多基于状态边际分布匹配，无法区分因果-时序行为相同的不同策略；需要一种同时满足因果耦合、可从样本估计、对模型可微的距离度量。

Method: 1) 利用 Calo et al. (2024) 证明的双模拟度量 ≡ Bicausal OT 等价性，将其写为关于转移占用测度 ν_θ 的线性规划；2) 通过 LP 鞍点的包络定理（Danskin/参数化 LP 形式）推导精确闭式梯度 ∇_θ d_γ = −∑ λ*_Y(x|y) α*_Y(x,y,y') ∇_θ ν_θ(y,y')；3) 外层交替调用 SOMCOT（获得对偶证书 λ̄_Y, ᾱ_Y）与梯度下降，∇_θ ν_θ 按参数化方式计算——显式核用自动微分求闭式 ν_θ = (1−γ)(I−γP_θ^⊤)^{-1}ν_0 的梯度，ILfO 情形通过策略梯度定理转化为隐式奖励下的策略梯度；4) 实例化到状态空间压缩、参数化模型学习、ILfO 三个场景。

Result: 1) 模型学习：离散带漂移随机游走（N=16，γ=0.95，f_true=1.5，f_0=−2）下，梯度迭代单调收敛到真实漂移参数；2) 状态空间压缩：将 25 状态块链压缩至 5 个抽象态，双模拟距离收敛至接近零，恢复的软编码器 λ_X 准确将 5 个等价块映射到各抽象态；过参数化（n_Y>5）不损害性能；3) ILfO：在 5 状态 4 动作随机链 MDP 上，与 IOSTOM、PW-DICE 对比，随机专家策略下 D-BOT-ILfO 在 SPI 距离与策略 KL 上均优于基线，确定性专家下表现相当。

Conclusion: 双模拟度量对模型动力学的梯度可通过包络定理获得简洁闭式表达，使 D-BOT 成为参数化马尔可夫链拟合的通用框架，统一了压缩、模型学习和 ILfO；局限性在于需 O(|𝒳|²|𝒴|²) 内存（限制于数百状态）、外层问题一般非凸（梯度方法仅保证局部收敛）、SOMCOT 有限步终止会引入外层梯度偏差，未来工作包括单循环联合更新与大规模/连续状态空间函数近似。

Abstract: Many problems in sequential decision-making, such as imitation learning from observations, state-space compression, world-model learning, and sim-to-real transfer, can be reduced to learning a model such that a notion of distance with respect to the target process is minimized. We consider this general framework and consider the bisimulation metric, equivalently Bicausal Optimal Transport (BOT), as the notion of distance to minimize. We show that BOT, since it can be formulated as a linear program (LP), is differentiable with respect to the model dynamics. We then derive an exact closed-form gradient via the envelope theorem applied to the LP saddle point. The result is a general algorithm, Differentiable Bicausal Optimal Transport (D-BOT), that can be applied to each of the problems above. The proposed algorithm learns the best model by alternating between distance computation and gradient steps. We apply D-BOT for three different settings: state-space compression, parametric model learning, and imitation learning from observations (ILfO). We show empirical results that confirm the viability of all three instantiations.

</details>


### [682] [Trident: Unifying Guarded Dispatch and Host Execution for PyTorch Triton Workloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37241)
*Jinjie Liu,Xiaoyan Liu,Shuhan Zhang,Wenjia Sun,Ruilin Yang,Chunlei Men,Yonghua Lin,Shaohua Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Trident 是一个基于 Torch-MLIR 的 PyTorch 编译器后端，通过将守卫（guard）专业化选择、参数与环境准备以及主机执行统一编译到单一可执行模块（SCM），消除 torch.compile 在缓存命中路径上的运行时调度与粘合代码开销，显著降低短 Triton 内核的端到端延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PyTorch 调用用户编写的 Triton 内核时，即使 torch.compile 生成原生 C++ wrapper，每次调用仍需经过 Dynamo 运行时的专业化缓存查找、守卫评估和参数准备等粘合代码。对于设备执行极短的常见内核，这类主机侧开销已成为端到端延迟的主导因素，torch.compile 在某些情况下甚至比 eager 模式更慢。

Method: 核心创新是 Specialization Cache Module (SCM)：1) 使用 Torch-MLIR 将 TorchDynamo 捕获的 FX 图及其守卫打包为高层 MLIR 子模块；2) 合并所有版本并通过 TVM FFI IR 降至 LLVM dialect，加入有序派发器；3) JIT 编译为单一可执行模块，仅暴露一个 TVM FFI 入口；4) 嵌入 Triton CUBIN 以绕过 Triton Python 运行时的专业化路径；5) 通过模式生成的 Trident FFI 包装复用 ATen 已注册实现。

Result: 在 H800 上的评估显示：内核层面，Trident 在 21 个 FlagGems 算子中的大多数上优于 eager 与 torch.compile，热路径加速比最高达 1.73×（silu）、3.07× 优于 torch.compile；模型层面，在 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 与 Qwen3-8B 上分别于 MMLU/GSM8K/HumanEval 数据集上实现 1.30–1.47× 端到端加速、1.13–1.24× ITL 加速，最高 1.68× 优于 torch.compile。冷启动略慢，但稳态性能显著提升。

Conclusion: Trident 证明将专业化管理与主机执行编译到同一模块中是释放定制 Triton 内核性能的有效途径；仅编译被选中图的主机 wrapper 不足以在模型规模上稳定优于 eager 路径，统一编译守卫选择与执行可显著消除残留主机开销。

Abstract: User-written Triton kernels enable high-performance GPU computation within PyTorch, but their end-to-end latency can remain dominated by host-side orchestration, especially when device execution is short. Although this http URL can generate native host wrappers for captured graphs, each invocation still passes through runtime-managed specialization lookup, guard evaluation, and preparation before reaching the wrapper. We present Trident, a compiler backend that removes this recurring overhead from the specialization cache-hit path. Trident introduces the Specialization Cache Module (SCM), which compiles guarded specialization selection, argument and execution-environment preparation, and host execution for multiple specializations into a single executable module. An invocation enters the SCM once, remains in compiled code when a specialization matches, and returns to Python only when a new specialization must be compiled. Built on Torch-MLIR, Trident lowers guards and host-side orchestration to native code while retaining calls to optimized runtime implementations of supported ATen operators. Our evalu- ation on two LLMs shows that Trident achieves up to a 1.47x speedup in model-level end-to-end latency over eager execution and up to 1.68x over this http URL .

</details>


### [683] [Efficiently Approximating Attention Is Hard](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37261)
*Lukas Haverbeck,Carmen Amo Alonso,Andres Felipe Posada-Moreno,Sebastian Trimpe,Marco Pavone*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了在标准复杂度假设（SETH）下，不存在真正次二次（truly subquadratic）算法能对softmax注意力机制在所有输入上提供任何非平凡的加性或相对近似保证。该结论在参数设定 d=Θ(log n)、B=Θ(√log n)（即已知算法能达到近线性时间与极小误差的最温和参数边界）下成立，并扩展到带KV缓存预处理的解码场景以及稀疏注意力检索场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer中softmax注意力的二次方复杂度是长序列推理的主要瓶颈。现有快速近似方法虽然在实践中有效，但要么依赖输入结构，要么仅在低维小范数参数范围内具有均匀保证。已有下界仅排除高精度近似，遗留了一个关键开放问题：在更温和的参数范围内，能否以任意粗糙的均匀误差换取高效计算？本文旨在回答这一问题。

Method: 论文通过将注意力近似问题归约到近似最近对（Approximate Closest Pair, CP）问题来建立下界。核心技巧是：给定CP问题的两组二进制向量集合，将其中一组编码为键和值矩阵、另一组编码为查询矩阵，并引入"虚拟键"（dummy keys）使得归一化后的注意力输出成为是否存在距离低于阈值的近似最近对的几乎二元指示器。在稀疏注意力场景中，使用截断的指数随机变量对键进行扰动，使得一个近似最近对以高概率主导所有注意力质量。基于Rubinstein (2018) 关于CP问题在SETH假设下的下界，推导出注意力近似问题的下界。

Result: 主要定理：在SETH假设下，当d=Θ(log n)、B=Θ(√log n)时，不存在O(n^{2-q})时间的算法能以任何η<1/2的加性误差或η<1的相对误差近似注意力。该结果还扩展到：(1) 即使允许任意多项式时间KV缓存预处理，亚线性解码时间也无法获得非平凡均匀保证；(2) 即使在显著的稀疏性承诺下，识别获得恒定注意力比例的小键集在预处理后仍不可行。这些结果在已知算法可达近线性时间与极小误差的最温和参数边界处建立了尖锐的相变：均匀注意力近似从高精度可能变为任何精度都不可能。

Conclusion: 本文确定了均匀注意力近似的计算极限：在现有近线性时间高精度算法可处理的参数范围之外，均匀近似必须利用输入相关结构。这意味着虽然经验有效的快速注意力方法仍然可能，但对其提供严格最坏情况保证的前景本质上受到限制。预处理和稀疏性等实践中的常见放宽策略也无法绕过这一基本障碍。

Abstract: Softmax attention is ubiquitous in modern machine learning, but its quadratic scaling with sequence length makes it costly. To reduce this cost, attention is often approximated with fast algorithms, which incur error but can still perform well in practice and on some inputs. At the same time, the growing diversity of attention applications makes approximation guarantees that do not depend on particular input structure a compelling target. For such uniform guarantees over all inputs, known runtime lower bounds rule out fast algorithms for near-exact attention, but leave open the practically important regime: is there an efficient algorithm with even a modest uniform approximation guarantee? We answer this question negatively. Under standard complexity-theoretic assumptions, no truly subquadratic algorithm can approximate attention with any nontrivial additive or relative guarantee uniformly over all inputs. This impossibility holds in the mildest parameter regime for which known algorithms do not already achieve strong approximation guarantees in near-linear time, and extends to practically relevant relaxations: even after polynomial preprocessing of the KV cache, no efficient algorithm can obtain a nontrivial uniform approximation guarantee, or identify a small set of keys receiving substantial attention under sparsity. Overall, our results settle the computational limits of uniform attention approximation.

</details>


### [684] [Scaling Full Conformal Image Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37298)
*Julio Silva-Rodríguez,Ender Konukoglu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出T-FCP框架和SO-LDA求解器，通过结合零样本VLM的归纳共形预测器对标签进行剪枝，再对剩余候选标签执行全共形预测（FCP），并利用基于秩一逆协方差更新的在线LDA求解器避免重复模型重训，从而在ImageNet等大规模标签空间上实现高效的全共形图像分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高风险图像分类场景中，Split Conformal Prediction（SCP）数据效率低，导致有限样本下经验覆盖率不稳定；而Full Conformal Prediction（FCP）虽统计效率更高，但因需对每个测试样本的每个候选标签重新训练模型，在大规模标签空间（如ImageNet的1000类）上计算不可行。

Method: 1. T-FCP：将FCP与一个轻量级ICP（使用零样本VLM原型作为非一致性分数）相结合，通过联合界定理获得形式化覆盖率保证 1−(α_ICP + α_FCP)，其中α_ICP较小（默认0.5%）的ICP用于剪枝不太可能的标签，仅对剩余候选运行昂贵的FCP。
2. SO-LDA：基于LDA的在线线性求解器，利用Sherman-Morrison公式执行秩一逆协方差更新，将逐标签更新成本降至O(F²)；并通过零样本原型对残差进行中心化（避免校准/测试间的非对称性）以及文本引导先验（λ_TEXT）来稳定低数据场景下的性能。

Result: 在11个基准数据集（含ImageNet）上，CLIP ViT-B/16校准样本N=C×16条件下：T-FCP将ImageNet推理延迟从原始FCP-GD的~500s/图像降至~30ms/图像，峰值GPU约16GB；在α=0.10下达到81.8%的有效覆盖率（%Valid），相对SCP的77.1%更稳定；中位数集合大小比SCP小约10%，单例预测更多；并在不同CLIP/MetaCLIP骨干、APS非一致性分数、ResNet-50单模态迁移到ImageNet-V2等设置下验证了方法的通用性。

Conclusion: T-FCP + SO-LDA通过零样本VLM引导，将全共形预测从理论上的"金标准"方法变为大规模图像分类中实用可行的工具，相对于SCP提供了更稳定的经验覆盖率与相当的集合效率；当前主要局限是线性求解器性能略低于迭代梯度法（约1.5%差距），且联合界分配使得覆盖率保证略显保守，未来可结合更自适应的非一致性分数与精确正则化策略进一步改进。

Abstract: Conformal prediction provides set-valued predictions with distribution-free coverage guarantees, making it attractive for high-stakes image classification. However, split conformal prediction is data-inefficient, while full conformal prediction (FCP), despite its stronger statistical efficiency, is computationally prohibitive at scale because it requires candidate-specific model refits at test time. We address this limitation by leveraging zero-shot vision-language models (VLMs) to guide scalable FCP in large label spaces. We introduce Targeted Full Conformal Prediction (T-FCP), which uses a lightweight inductive conformal predictor to prune unlikely labels and applies FCP only to the remaining candidates, reducing computation while retaining the formal guarantee of the combined conformal procedure. We further propose Stabilized Online LDA (SO-LDA), an efficient VLM adaptation solver based on rank-one inverse-covariance updates. Across multiple benchmarks, including ImageNet, T-FCP enables practical full-conformal image classification with modest test-time overhead, yielding efficient prediction sets and more stable empirical coverage than split conformal alternatives.

</details>


### [685] [Parallel Tempering for Diffusion-Based Combinatorial Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37323)
*Arman Mielke,Uwe Bauknecht,Thilo Strauss,Mathias Niepert*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PT-Denoise是一种推理时的即插即用方法，通过并行回火（parallel tempering）协调多个并发的离散扩散去噪轨迹，无需重新训练即可提升图组合优化问题的解质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的离散扩散模型在组合优化中通常独立生成多个候选解并取最优，但这些独立轨迹之间缺乏信息交流，且在固定去噪评估预算下无法利用各轨迹的相对进度自适应调整采样行为。

Method: 为每个副本分配温度参数调节去噪随机性，并周期性根据中间能量评估通过Metropolis-Hastings准则交换相邻温度间的状态；将种群规模与温度阶梯解耦，每个温度梯档分配多个副本以避免过长的温度阶梯限制移动；整个过程无需修改或重新训练预训练去噪器。

Result: 在MIS、MDS、最大割和最大团四个图组合优化问题上，基于DiffUCO和SDDS两个扩散骨干网络的实验表明，PT-Denoise一致地提升了最优解的质量（如MIS上相对差距从1.79%降至0.47%），且每个实例推理时间仅增加最多1毫秒。

Conclusion: PT-Denoise作为一种推理时协调策略，通过并行回火机制有效平衡探索与精炼，以极低的计算开销提升了扩散组合优化方法的性能；该框架可推广至其他扩散应用领域，但依赖松弛能量函数作为中间状态质量的代理指标。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for solving combinatorial optimization (CO) problems on graphs by learning to sample high-quality solutions. A common inference-time approach is to generate multiple candidate solutions independently and return the best-performing sample, improving solution quality at the expense of an increase in computational cost. In this work, we introduce PT-Denoise, an inference-time procedure that allows these concurrent denoising trajectories to interact through parallel tempering, without requiring retraining or fine-tuning of the underlying denoiser. Our method assigns a temperature to each diffusion process and allows processes to swap temperatures based on their relative performance. This dynamically reallocates promising, low-energy trajectories to colder, more concentrated sampling regimes while allowing higher-energy states to escape local minima through randomized exploration. Experiments on canonical graph-structured CO problems show that our approach consistently improves the quality of the best solution found, while only adding minimal computational overhead.

</details>


### [686] [Looped Transformers as Optimizers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37379)
*Yulong Huang,Chen Jiang,Zhanpeng Zhou,Hongtao Zhang,Tianyu Li,Tianyu He,Xiangyu Zhang,Bojun Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的优化框架，将Looped Transformer的循环状态视为"快速权重"（fast weight），并从投影（projection）、局部目标（objective）和优化器更新规则三个角度推导循环转换。基于该框架识别了现有循环转换中的输入映射不匹配问题，进而设计了OperLoop方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Looped Transformer通过重复使用共享Transformer块实现参数高效的深度扩展，但现有循环转换机制的设计原则尚不清晰，不同架构（Vanilla Loop、Parcae、HyperLoop等）的转换机制难以统一比较和优化。缺乏系统的设计指导原则。

Method: 核心方法包含三部分：(1) 将循环状态视为快速权重，将循环转换建模为基于梯度的优化更新，通过投影、局部目标和优化器更新规则三要素在闭式形式下推导转换；(2) 基于该框架识别Parcae、HyperLoop等模型中的输入映射不匹配问题，并通过对齐输入映射构建改进变体；(3) 设计OperLoop，结合delta目标函数（残差校正）、显式权重衰减和自适应步长（因果调度步长单调递减），采用HyperLoop的扩展状态结构。

Result: (1) 输入映射对齐使Parcae和HyperLoop在训练损失和平均常识准确率上均有所提升（HyperLoop平均准确率从58.93%提升至59.47%）；(2) OperLoop在匹配训练FLOPs下，平均生成性能优于参评的循环和非循环基线。OperLoop（Loop3）EM均值比5B基线高1.69个百分点，参数约为基线一半；(3) OperLoop（Loop6）EM均值达到31.90%，比基线高8.01个百分点；(4) 消融实验验证了delta目标函数和因果步长调度的有效性。

Conclusion: 统一优化框架有效指导了循环转换的修改和设计。输入映射对齐是该框架的核心设计约束。OperLoop证明了该框架能够从优化角度指导新型循环架构的构造。未来可通过改变快速权重的结构、投影方式以及借鉴Muon等高级优化器思想进一步推进循环转换设计。

Abstract: Looped Transformers provide a parameter-efficient approach to depth scaling by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks. Recent reasoning models have likewise highlighted the value of scaling test-time computation through longer computation trajectories. However, the principles for designing effective loop transitions remain poorly understood. We view the looped hidden state as a fast weight that is updated throughout the depth. We formulate loop transitions as local gradient-based updates, with recurrent blocks predicting implicit targets at each depth. Our framework derives loop transitions in closed form from a projection, a local objective and an optimizer update rule. Mapping representative loop transitions into this framework reveals mismatches between their transitions and projections. We first align the input maps of existing transitions. We then derive OperLoop, which combines explicit weight decay, adaptive step size and a delta objective. The aligned variants reduce training loss and improve average commonsense accuracy. OperLoop improves average generative performance over the compared looped and non-looped baselines under matched training FLOPs. These results support the framework's usefulness for loop design. We extend the analysis to additional loop models and outline a roadmap for future loop transition design.

</details>


### [687] [High-Dimensional Simulation-Based Inference in Latent Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37381)
*Lars Kühmichel,Stefan T. Radev,Bhanu Prasanna Koppolu,Masoumeh Davoudi,Jerry M. Huang,Paul-Christian Bürkner*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了"潜空间模拟推断"（Latent SBI），将高维参数空间通过自编码器压缩到低维潜空间中进行后验推断，再解码回原始参数空间。在控制训练计算量一致的情况下，该方法在精度和边际校准上与标准目标空间推断相当，同时采样速度提升超过一个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经模拟推断（SBI）主要关注从高维观测中推断低维可解释参数，表示学习几乎都集中在压缩观测端。然而，当SBI开始面向高维参数空间（如图像去噪、超声成像等）时，推理目标本身的压缩成为尚未解决的关键问题。本文旨在回答是否应该以及如何压缩高维推理目标。

Method: 两阶段框架：（1）第一阶段使用InfoVAE在仅参数样本上训练自编码器，学习参数到低维潜码的压缩表示并冻结；（2）第二阶段在冻结的潜码空间中训练条件生成网络近似后验，采样时通过解码器映射回原始参数空间。理论方面，通过命题1将联合后验误差分解为后验项、编码项和解码项三项之和；命题2证明第一阶段目标的最优化解码器项可消失。在实现上兼容流匹配、扩散模型和标准化流三种生成架构。

Result: 在四个案例研究（相关高斯协方差矩阵2080维、Fashion-MNIST去模糊、高斯随机场、地图到卫星图像196608维）和三种生成族中验证：在匹配训练计算量的条件下，潜空间推断在精度（NRMSE、CRPS）和边际校准（覆盖率、校准误差）上与标准推断相当或更优；在高维图像任务上采样加速达19×至62×。例如地图到卫星任务中，潜空间扩散模型采样速度提升19倍且视觉质量更优；去模糊任务中流匹配采样加速62倍。压缩比消融实验表明存在最优压缩比（高斯案例中d=8），超过后信息损失主导导致质量快速下降。联合微调自编码器实验表明冻结策略优于联合训练。

Conclusion: 潜空间SBI为高维参数推断提供了一种实用框架，在保持或提升后验质量的同时大幅提高采样速度。其成功依赖于自编码器与参数先验的有效维度匹配。自编码器仅基于参数先验训练，不观测条件信息，可能丢弃观察约束的信息方向；潜空间采样受限于自编码器流形，像素级解码器会丢失高频细节。未来方向包括条件编码、感知/对抗损失以保留细节，以及将框架扩展到序列和图结构参数。

Abstract: Neural simulation-based inference (SBI) has been widely successful in inferring a relatively small number of interpretable parameters from potentially high-dimensional observations, such as images or time series. Accordingly, representation learning in SBI has focused almost exclusively on compressing the observations used to condition the posterior. More recently, however, SBI has begun to target increasingly high-dimensional parameter spaces, raising the complementary question of whether the inference target itself should be compressed. Our answer is a practical merger of SBI and latent generative modeling, which learns a low-dimensional representation of the simulator parameters, performs posterior inference directly in this latent space, and maps posterior samples back to the original parameter space. We characterize the conditions under which latent-space inference recovers the desired target posterior and systematically study its empirical trade-offs. Across four case studies and three generative families, we compare latent and standard estimators while controlling for network capacity, regularization, optimization, and training compute. At matched training compute, latent-space inference achieves accuracy and marginal calibration comparable to direct target-space inference while sampling up to more than an order of magnitude faster.

</details>


### [688] [MoTIF-X: A Multimodal Tokenized Framework for Interpretable and Extensible Molecular Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37384)
*Linqing Mo,Jiayu Zhou,Bin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MoTIF-X是一个以化学基序(motif)为中心的分子表示学习框架，通过两阶段预训练将分子图、SMILES和3D构象信息统一到共享的Transformer token空间中，并在分子性质预测和药物-靶点相互作用任务上取得了优异性能，同时支持子结构级别的可解释性分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多模态分子表示学习方法通常独立编码不同模态（分子图、SMILES、3D构象）并在后期进行对齐，这限制了细粒度的跨模态交互和子结构级别的可解释性。此外，将分子表示扩展到跨领域任务（如药物-靶点相互作用预测）同时保持可解释性仍然具有挑战性。

Method: MoTIF-X采用两阶段预训练策略：(1)第一阶段通过分层对比学习在原子级、基序级和分子级尺度上建立基序表示，使用GIN编码器处理分子图和片段图；(2)第二阶段将基序token、SMILES token和离散化的扭转角token通过多模态掩码token建模在统一Transformer中联合训练。基序作为图锚点整合拓扑、符号和构象信息。下游应用包括分子性质预测和DTI预测（结合ProtBERT蛋白质表示）。

Result: 在OpenADMET ExpansionRx基准测试的9个ADME终点上，MoTIF-X实现了最低的平均绝对误差(MAE)，宏平均相对绝对误差(MA-RAE)为0.626，优于最强基线CheMeleon的0.687。显著性分析显示在多重检验校正后绝大多数端点-基线对比中显著优于基线。在DTI预测中，BindingDB测试集PCC达0.8858，在外部药物冷启动ChEMBL数据集上PCC达0.6147，无需额外微调。在DTI分类基准（BIOSNAP、BindingDB、DAVIS及泛化设置）上取得最高平均AUPR。消融实验证实了基序token上下文化、多模态集成和两阶段预训练的互补贡献。注意力分析显示3D预训练将注意力从SMILES token重新分配到基序token，表征几何分析显示更结构化的聚类。可解释性分析显示基序归因分数与实验活性变化相关（Spearman ρ=0.44），并在肝细胞癌相关化合物案例研究中一致突出水杨酰胺(salicylamide)基序，分子对接验证了该基序的结构合理性。

Conclusion: MoTIF-X验证了以结构为锚点的基序中心token化策略能够提升预测性能、支持跨任务迁移，并实现化学可解释的分析。性能增益源于对分子信息的适当粒度组织（基序级token作为原子细节和全局嵌入之间的中间尺度），而非简单地增加模态数量。两阶段预训练（分层对比学习+多模态掩码token建模）共同促进了这一过程。该框架为分子建模提供了一个可迁移、可解释且可扩展的统一基础，未来可扩展到生成任务、文本注释等其他模态。但仍存在局限：推理时不显式使用3D表示，依赖几何信息的任务需进一步评估；归因分析为计算一致性证据而非实验验证的结合机制。

Abstract: Molecular representation learning is central to computer-aided drug discovery. Molecular graphs, SMILES strings, and 3D conformations provide complementary structural information, yet many multimodal approaches encode these views independently and align them only at a later stage, limiting fine-grained cross-modal interaction and substructure-level interpretability. To address these limitations, we introduce MoTIF-X, a motif-centered framework that uses graph-grounded chemical motifs as shared anchors for multimodal integration and interpretation. Its first pretraining stage learns motif representations through hierarchical contrastive learning across atomic, motif, and molecular scales. The second stage contextualizes these representations with SMILES and torsion-angle tokens through multimodal masked token modeling. After pretraining on drug-like molecules with multiple conformers, MoTIF-X achieved the lowest mean absolute error on all nine OpenADMET ExpansionRx endpoints and the best overall performance among the evaluated methods. Significance analyses supported its advantage in the vast majority of endpoint-baseline comparisons after multiple-testing correction. Ablation studies supported the complementary contributions of motif-token contextualization, multimodal integration, and two-stage pretraining. Beyond molecular properties, the framework extended to drug-target interaction prediction, achieving the best average classification performance across the evaluated benchmarks and generalizing to an external drug-cold-start dataset without additional fine-tuning. Its motif-centered design also enabled substructure-level interpretation: higher motif attribution scores were associated with larger experimentally measured activity shifts. Together, these findings support MoTIF-X as a transferable and interpretable framework for molecular modeling.

</details>


### [689] [Rethinking Soft Tokens for Parallel Decoding in Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37391)
*Kodai Kawamura,Kenji Kawaguchi,Anji Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视扩散语言模型(DLM)中的软令牌(soft token)机制,提出一种无需训练、几何感知的软令牌构造方法(基于球面线性插值SLERP),并通过实证分析提出软令牌反馈改善并行解码的"一致性寻求"(agreement-seeking)解释,即软令牌通过乘法混合抑制跨位置不一致的预测组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型(DLM)在并行解码中,因使用分解近似联合分布,会生成各自合理但相互不一致的令牌。现有软令牌方法虽有效,但其作用机理通常被归因于"保持预测不确定性",这一解释未经系统检验,且现有方法需额外训练,无法区分反馈效果与训练适应效果。

Method: 1) 提出几何感知软令牌构造:保留top-k候选嵌入的欧氏聚合,但对[MASK]嵌入与候选聚合体之间采用球面线性插值(SLERP),并保持[MASK]嵌入的范数;2) 在冻结预训练DLM上无需额外训练即可使用;3) 通过形式化"不确定性保持"解释为加性混合,并与构造产生的预测比较;4) 提出"一致性寻求"解释:乘法混合行为抑制不一致的跨组合,使各位置的边际预测趋向相互兼容。

Result: 在4个预训练DLM(LLaDA-8B、LLaDA-1.5、LLaDA-2.0-mini、Dream-7B)和4个数学/代码基准(GSM8K、MATH500、HumanEval、MBPP)上,该方法在2、4、8令牌/步的并行解码设置中均优于标准并行解码和欧氏软令牌基线。JS散度分析表明构造的预测更接近乘法参考而非加性参考;反向KL分析表明其因子化联合预测与依赖保持的序贯参考一致性更高;且与自适应采样方法(Fast-dLLM、EB-Sampler)结合时仍能带来提升。

Conclusion: 软令牌反馈改善并行解码的机制不仅仅是保持预测不确定性,而是通过乘法混合行为促进跨位置预测的一致性(即"一致性寻求")。几何感知的SLERP构造能够在冻结预训练DLM上无需训练地提升并行解码效果,这一概率视角有助于设计更有效的并行解码表示。

Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) enable parallel generation by predicting and committing multiple tokens at each denoising step, yet they can generate individually plausible but mutually inconsistent tokens. Recent work shows that \emph{soft tokens} can mitigate this issue by representing uncertain positions with continuous embeddings built from the model's predictive distribution at the previous decoding step. However, although soft tokens are commonly understood as preserving predictive uncertainty, how soft-token feedback improves parallel decoding has not been systematically examined. In this paper, we investigate this question in frozen pretrained DLMs to examine soft-token feedback without the effects of additional training. To construct soft-token inputs in a training-free setting, we identify a geometric mismatch between conventional soft-token construction and the pretrained embedding space. Based on this observation, we propose a training-free, geometry-aware construction of soft tokens. Our analysis of soft-token feedback suggests that uncertainty preservation alone does not fully explain how it reshapes subsequent predictions. To better explain how soft-token feedback improves parallel decoding, we provide empirical evidence that it favors coherent token sequences. Across four pretrained DLMs and four math and code benchmarks, our method outperforms standard parallel decoding and a training-free Euclidean soft-token baseline. Code: this https URL

</details>


### [690] [Learning Macroscopic Dynamics without Reconstructing Microscopic States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37392)
*Zhichao Han,Yue Zhao,Qianxiao Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TAMPL（Target-Anchored Macro-Predictive Latents），一种无需微状态重建的框架，用于学习针对特定宏观观测量的隐状态及其动力学。核心思想是交替训练隐表示与潜空间转移模型，并使用冻结的目标编码器锚定下一状态目标以避免"潜尺度坍缩"。理论分析在线性系统中解释了重建目标与宏观预测的错位以及尺度坍缩机制，并给出了局部收敛的充分条件。实验在格点SIRS传染病、双组分粒子混合和高分子拉伸三个随机动力系统中均显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂系统的宏观属性时间演化预测具有重要科学意义。现有方法通常将高维微状态编码为低维隐状态以学习其演化，并通过重建微状态来学习表示。然而在有限潜容量下，重建会偏向保留高方差的微观细节而牺牲宏观预测所需信息；而直接联合优化隐表示与转移（不重建）又往往失败，原因在于"潜尺度坍缩"——潜状态尺度缩小可降低训练损失但宏观演化误差依然很大。因此需解决"重建与宏观预测错位"和"潜尺度坍缩"两难问题。

Method: 提出TAMPL框架：(1) 损失函数包含当前宏观读出损失和下一隐状态转移损失（监督潜一致性而非直接监督下一宏观量，以保证长时域递归预测准确）；(2) 训练交替两个阶段——表示阶段用冻结的目标编码器计算下一隐状态目标以更新编码器和读出器，转移阶段固定表示拟合转移模型；(3) 支持随机转移（使用条件流匹配）和确定性转移；(4) 推理时仅对初始微状态编码一次，随后在潜空间递归推进并读出宏观量。理论部分在线性系统中严格刻画了重建错位（Theorem 1）、尺度非强制性导致联合训练失败（Proposition 4.2）、不正确吸引流形（Theorem 3），并给出TAMPL局部收敛的充分条件（Theorem 2/4）。

Result: 在三个随机动力系统实验中均取得最佳结果：(1) 晶格SIRS传染病（CNN编码器，dz=16）：RMSE 0.1056（次优JLD-VIC为0.1324）；(2) 双组分粒子混合（DeepSet编码器，dz=8）：RMSE 0.2613（次优TwoStage-Recon为0.3039）；(3) 高分子拉伸（ResNet-34编码器，dz=4）：RMSE 0.1131，是唯一能准确捕捉Slow测试机制延迟拉伸的方法。控制数值实验证实了潜尺度坍缩和错误吸引解的存在，以及TAMPL的有效性。

Conclusion: TAMPL是一种有效的无重建潜动力学学习框架，通过交替更新和冻结目标锚定机制克服了尺度坍缩问题。理论分析阐明了重建错位和联合训练失败的根源，并给出了局部收敛条件。实验表明该方法在多种物理系统的宏观预测上显著优于现有基线。未来工作包括扩展理论至非线性系统、研究历史依赖的潜转移以及应用于实验数据。

Abstract: Modeling the temporal evolution of macroscopic properties of complex systems is an important scientific task. To predict this evolution without full microscopic simulation, a common approach encodes microstates into compact latent states, learns their evolution, and reads out macroscopic predictions from the latent trajectory. These latent states are often learned through microstate reconstruction. However, with limited latent capacity, reconstruction can favor high-variance microscopic details over information needed for macroscopic prediction. Yet jointly learning latent states and their transition without reconstruction often fails to obtain latent dynamics that support accurate macroscopic prediction. We show that this failure can arise from latent scale collapse: shrinking the latent state scale reduces training loss while macroscopic evolution error remains large. Here, we propose a reconstruction-free framework to learn latent states with their dynamics for prescribed macroscopic prediction. Training alternates between updating the latent representation with the transition and next-state latent targets fixed, and updating the transition with the latent representation fixed. At inference, the trained model predicts macroscopic states recursively from an initial microstate. Our theoretical analysis characterizes reconstruction misalignment and scale collapse under joint training, and gives a sufficient condition for local convergence to correct latent dynamics for our method. Experiments on epidemic spreading on a lattice, mixing of two particle species, and polymer stretching demonstrate that the proposed method achieves substantially better macroscopic prediction over baselines.

</details>


### [691] [Scale Sensitivity in Low-Bit Post-Training Quantization: Curvature of the Quantization Error Landscape](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37416)
*Jonas von Berg,Massimiliano Datres,Carlo Kneißl,Gitta Kutyniok*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型后训练量化（PTQ）中量化尺度选择的理论分析。在高斯权重假设和有效秩条件下，证明了逐层重建损失一致收敛到标准高斯的均匀量化均方误差。极限目标具有唯一非退化极小值，其尺度不变曲率随位宽呈近似指数衰减。GPTQ实验在五个LLM上验证了该趋势：尺度选择在2-3位时显著影响困惑度，6位以上影响可忽略；HIP预处理后，解析尺度无需搜索即可匹配最佳搜索规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PTQ方法（如GPTQ）的理论分析多局限于固定量化网格，忽略了量化尺度这一关键参数的选择对性能的影响。常用的max基尺度选择方法在低位宽时性能急剧下降，亟需理论指导。

Method: 1. 理论框架：在i.i.d.高斯权重和校准激活有效秩≥C·log^8(d)条件下，证明归一化RTN重建损失对所有尺度一致收敛到标准高斯的均匀量化均方误差（定理1）。验证宽MLP在初始化时满足有效秩条件（定理5）。
2. 极限目标分析：证明极限函数具有唯一非退化极小值，最优尺度随电平数严格递减，尺度不变曲率κ随位宽呈近似指数衰减（命题1）。
4. 实验验证：在五个LLM（OPT-125M、Llama-1B/3B/8B、Qwen3-8B）上使用GPTQ进行PTQ，对比五种尺度选择规则（Min-max、Shrink-2.4、WMSE、Proxy-static、RTNH）和解析尺度规则。
5. 提出Proxy-static方法：基于GPTQ逆Hessian分解的高效尺度选择目标。

Result: 理论结果：(i) 归一化RTN损失一致收敛于高斯量化目标；(ii) 极限目标的最优尺度严格递减，尺度不变曲率近似指数衰减于位宽。实验结果：GPTQ尺度选择在2-3位时对困惑度影响显著（跨度可达数十到数千），6位以上几乎无影响；HIP预处理后，解析尺度s*(M_B)·σ̂在3位及以上无需搜索即可匹配最佳搜索规则；Proxy-static在无HIP时表现最佳；2位时解析尺度仍差于搜索规则。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了高斯标量量化与分层PTQ之间的严格联系，从理论上解释了低位宽下尺度选择困难和HIP预处理有效性，为未来PTQ方法设计提供了定量参考：降低低位宽下的尺度敏感度是重要目标。然而分析局限于随机初始化网络和RTN量化，未涵盖GPTQ等误差补偿方法，且HIP虽改善高斯性但增加有效秩的变换会牺牲GPTQ的误差补偿能力。

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) methods in the GPTQ family minimize a layer-wise reconstruction error on a uniform grid whose scale must be chosen; the common max-based choice degrades sharply at low bit-widths. We study how sensitive this objective is to the scale. For a layer with i.i.d. Gaussian weights and calibration activations of sufficiently large effective rank, we prove that, as the width grows, the normalized round-to-nearest loss converges with high probability, uniformly over all scales, to the mean-squared error of a uniform quantizer applied to a standard Gaussian; we verify the effective-rank condition for wide, randomly initialized MLPs with odd Lipschitz activations and isotropic Gaussian calibration data. The limiting objective has a unique nondegenerate minimizer, whose scale decreases strictly with the number of levels and whose curvature with respect to relative scale errors decays approximately exponentially with the bit-width. GPTQ experiments on five LLMs show the same trend: the scale rule changes perplexity substantially at 2--3 bits and negligibly from 6 bits on, and a local measure of GPTQ scale sensitivity decreases with bit-width in line with the Gaussian curvature. The Gaussian-optimal scale fails on raw weights; after Hadamard incoherence processing it matches the best searched rule at 3 bits and above without any search, but remains clearly worse at 2 bits.

</details>


### [692] [Looped Actor: Depth-Recurrent Reasoning Models for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37432)
*T. Konstantin Rusch,Tim Seyde,Jared Boyer,Zach J. Patterson,Daniela Rus*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Looped Actor提出了一种基于循环Transformer的深度递归强化学习策略,通过重复应用共享参数块来自适应地分配计算资源。在22个任务上,Looped Actor以16倍少的参数匹配或超越了非共享权重的基线,并通过理论分析和实证研究证明了其自适应计算的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习策略在所有状态下使用固定的计算量,而实际决策难度差异很大。循环推理模型在语言建模中的成功表明,自适应计算可以提高效率和性能,但其在序列决策制定中的潜力尚未被充分探索。

Method: 1)理论方面:构造MDP族证明自适应策略可在相同最优回报下比固定运行时策略使用渐近更少的期望计算;2)方法方面:基于固定点推理模型(FPRM)构建Looped Actor,通过重复应用共享Transformer块细化潜在表征,以动作分布的KL散度稳定化作为自适应停止条件;3)训练方面:在线RL使用PPO,离线目标条件RL使用GCIQL+DDPG+BC,通过时间反向传播训练,无需截断或深度监督。

Result: 1)在Boxoban上,Looped Actor成功率约为参数16倍的非共享基线的两倍;2)在Rush Hour上显著优于Iso-FLOPs和DRC基线;3)在OGBench四个环境的20个任务上与Iso-FLOPs相当或略优;4)潜在表征探针显示后续循环逐步完善对未来最优动作的预测;5)循环次数与Boxoban剩余推箱子数正相关,在成功回合中表现明显;6)95%以上轨迹在16次循环前停止,相对固定运行时节省60%以上计算。

Conclusion: Looped Actor是首个结合循环Transformer骨干和状态相关迭代次数的RL策略,提供了一种简单有效的方式为RL智能体配备自适应计算并增强规划能力,但仍存在未解决的问题:无法保证计算最优性、循环深度与记忆和部分可观测性的交互。

Abstract: Looped reasoning models repeatedly apply a shared set of parameters, enabling more computation without increasing the model size. These models also support input-dependent computation by dynamically deciding when to stop looping. Motivated by the recent success of looped transformers in language modeling and reasoning, we investigate whether dynamic looping can similarly benefit sequential decision-making. We provide a complexity-theoretic motivation for this approach by showing that there exist Markov decision processes in which a state-adaptive policy achieves the optimal return with asymptotically less expected computation than any optimal fixed-runtime policy. To learn compute-adaptive policies in practice, we introduce Looped Actor, a transformer-based policy that repeatedly refines a latent representation toward a fixed point using a shared computational block. This allows the model to allocate computation adaptively by varying the number of loops based on the current state. We evaluate Looped Actor on 22 tasks across six environments, ranging from combinatorial puzzles to robotic manipulation and spanning online and offline reinforcement learning (RL) with discrete and continuous actions. Looped Actor matches or exceeds the performance of an untied baseline with 16$\times$ more parameters, with the largest gains in environments where action selection requires substantial multistep planning. For the Boxoban environment, we find that the computation allocation is structured: the number of loops increases with the number of remaining pushes and future optimal pushes become increasingly predictable from the latent state over successive loops. Together, these results highlight actor looping as a simple and efficient way to equip RL agents with adaptive computation and improve their planning capabilities. Code is available at this https URL

</details>


### [693] [Variational Augmented Invertible Koopman Autoencoder for probabilistic time series forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37435)
*Anthony Frion,Lucas Drumetz,Guillaume Tochon,Mauro Dalla Mura,Ali Can Bekar,Abdeldjalil Aïssa El Bey*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出VAIKAE，一种基于Koopman理论的概率性时间序列预测模型，通过将确定性潜嵌入扩展为高斯分布并结合归一化流，实现显式状态似然计算与不确定性感知的数据同化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经Koopman自编码器多为确定性模型，无法量化预测不确定性，难以处理过程噪声与观测噪声，因此需要一种概率性的KAE架构来同时提供准确预测和校准的不确定性估计。

Method: 在AIKAE基础上将潜嵌入从确定性扩展为对角高斯分布（均值与方差均由增强编码器χ输出），利用归一化流ϕ的可逆性与雅可比行列式显式计算状态似然；训练损失包含预测、线性、正交和似然四项；数据同化提出两种策略（4DVar和4DVar-CRPS），后者联合优化初始潜态的均值与方差。

Result: 在Informer基准（ETTm1/2、Weather、Solar、ECL、Traffic）上，VAIKAE在所有数据集-指标组合上均取得最佳或次佳的MSE/MAE/CRPS；在Sentinel-2卫星图像时间序列上，VAIKAE优于VIKAE、VKAE及KAE集成方法，4DVar-CRPS数据同化显著降低CRPS并获得良好校准（SSR接近1）。

Conclusion: VAIKAE是首个实现显式状态似然计算的概率性Koopman自编码器，结合线性高斯特性能潜动态与归一化流，在长期时间序列预测与不规则采样数据同化任务中均表现出强竞争力与良好不确定性校准。

Abstract: Neural Koopman autoencoder models have been shown to successfully build a latent embedding with linear dynamics for arbitrary dynamical systems, enabling strong performance in long-term time series forecasting. However, these models usually work in a deterministic setting, which does not allow the quantification of the uncertainty of their predictions. Thus, we propose the new Variational Augmented Invertible Koopman AutoEncoder (VAIKAE), in which the latent embedding follows a Gaussian distribution instead of being deterministic. A key property of the VAIKAE architecture is that it leverages normalizing flow models, enabling the use of likelihood computations in the state space of dynamical systems for training a model. We further propose new strategies for uncertainty-aware latent data assimilation with a trained VAIKAE model. The effectiveness of our methods is demonstrated in a series of experiments on long-term time series forecasting benchmarks.

</details>


### [694] [Probability Contracts: Accuracy, Coherence, and Decisions Across LLM Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37470)
*Han Chen,Yingrui Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"概率契约"基准测试框架，在1,000个有限世界中评估四种LLM接口配置（Kev带类型决策头、Qwen3.5-4B基模型、后训练Qwen模型、Jev-1.13.0），同时测量精确后验准确性、概率一致性关系和决策损失三个层面。研究发现一致性不等于准确性、分数改善不等于决策改善，三个评估维度在四种配置间出现排序反转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM概率评估存在三个未被明确区分的问题：(1) 准确性问题——报告与正确后验的接近程度；(2) 一致性与稳定性问题——相关报告是否满足概率恒等式并在等价表示间保持一致；(3) 决策价值问题——应用据此行动产生的损失。现有研究往往将一致性与准确性混为一谈，或将分数改善等同于决策改进，但三者之间存在系统性差异，需要在受控环境中联合评估。

Method: 核心方法是构建"概率契约"框架，包含精确有理算术oracle、10种经验证的概率关系测试（补集、粗化、交集、乘积、排列、渲染、不透明键、元数据、精确重复等）、以及具有拒绝选项的失败感知决策评估。实验设计：1,000个根（每生成器250个），每个根生成12个请求（共11,913个合格请求），采用八分层5,000次配对根自助法估计不确定性。配置包括Kev带类型头、Qwen3.5-4B基模型/后训练模型（似然性读取）、Jev-1.13.0（Noul和Choice接口）。后续分析包括200个世界上的Mistral/OLMo扩展验证。决策评估使用Chow拒绝选项控制器，五固定成本c∈{0.02, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.40}。

Result: 主要结果呈现显著的多维度排序反转：(1) 后验准确性：Kev聚合规范TV最低（0.2350），优于Jev（0.2677）、后训练模型（0.3202）、基模型（0.3740），但Jev在缺失规则等四个分层中胜过Kev；(2) 一致性方面，Kev的补集残差（0.5055）和粗化残差（0.3554）远高于Jev（0.0929和0.1751）；(3) 决策后果上，Jev的Event和Choice接口在c=0.10下对32.8%的有效对产生不同二元动作，后训练模型达34.2%；(4) 不一致仅能认证11-52%的二元对平均错误；(5) 平均化策略相对随机单接口基线在5个配置×成本单元中有3个表现更差，均发生在弱配置中；(6) 所有四种配置均未通过操作契约标准，但失败模式各异。

Conclusion: 概率契约框架量化了一致性或准确性单独无法解析的区分：共享错误、接口引起的动作变化以及成本依赖的调和效应。其核心启示是概率报告的评估单位应包括事件语义、信息集、数值通道和决策规则的联合规范。规范后验准确性不决定独立二元查询的一致性；报告间的协议可能掩盖未被检验的共享错误；具有适当分数保证的调和仍可能因阈值跨越改变而增加选择的损失。该基准在不同成本点上呈现配置间的非平凡排序反转，确立了基于事件的清晰度、覆盖率和决策成本联合指定的重要性，而非追求单一模型排名。

Abstract: A probability used for a decision should refer to the same event across equivalent requests. We introduce probability contracts, a benchmark connecting exact finite-world posteriors, validated event transformations, and failure-aware decision evaluation. Four model-interface configurations are evaluated on 1,000 worlds. Their assessments differ across accuracy, coherence, and decision loss: Kev has lower aggregate canonical posterior error than Jev, but larger complement and coarsening residuals, with accuracy ordering varying by stratum. Jev's Event and Choice interfaces induce different binary actions on 32.8% of valid pairs at defer cost 0.10. A post-hoc analysis finds that disagreement certifies only 11-52% of mean binary pair error across configurations. An elementary action-region characterization explains when averaging changes decision loss relative to randomly selecting one interface. Although averaging cannot worsen that baseline's expected Brier score, its decision effect depends on the cost and crossed boundaries; the observed same-baseline penalties occur in configurations already worse than always deferring. The benchmark makes these distinctions measurable without treating consistency as accuracy or a score improvement as a decision guarantee.

</details>


### [695] [REVO: Rollout-Efficient Off-Policy Distillation via Variance-Guided Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37500)
*Yuxiao Yang,Shangzhe Li,Tianrun Yu,Kaixiang Zhao,Taylor W. Killian,Weitong Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: REVO提出一种off-policy知识蒸馏框架，通过复用student rollout进行多步更新，配合one-step resampling和RKL方差引导的token优先级策略，在仅用50次rollout迭代的情况下达到或超越200次迭代的OPD基线，显著提升LLM蒸馏的rollout效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: On-policy distillation (OPD) 依赖频繁刷新student rollouts，导致高昂的生成成本。生成成本在wall-clock中占主导地位，因此需要通过off-policy rollout复用来分摊成本。然而，有效的off-policy蒸馏面临训练稳定性（prefix mismatch和current-token mismatch）和复用数据学习信号质量两方面的挑战。

Method: REVO框架包含两个核心组件：(1) Off-policy稳定化——通过one-step resampling从当前student策略重新采样token消除current-token mismatch，并使用几何归一化封顶的prefix weight稳定prefix correction；(2) 方差引导的token优先级——利用student与teacher log概率比的方差（RKL variance）量化剩余token级学习信号，采用bounded two-level weighting对高方差位置赋予更高权重。理论分析将RKL variance与局部自然梯度进展联系起来。

Result: 在Qwen3模型族三个学生-教师规模（0.6B→1.7B, 1.7B→4B, 4B→8B）上，REVO仅用50次rollout迭代即匹配或超越训练200次的OPD/EOPD/FiRe基线。在跨域基准（GPQA, HumanEval, MMLU-Redux）上同样表现最佳。消融实验验证了one-step resampling、prefix correction和two-level RKL weighting的各自贡献。wall-clock时间从约10小时（OPD 200步）降至约5.5小时（REVO 50步）。在Llama 3.2和Gemma 3上也验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: REVO通过off-policy stabilization和adaptive token prioritization的结合，实现了显著的rollout效率提升。RKL variance既与自然梯度进展有理论联系（Fisher几何解释），又与有限样本梯度估计的信噪比强相关（秩相关系数0.93），为token级优先级提供了实用代理。bounded two-level weighting优于连续权重方案，表明相对排序信息比原始幅度更有价值。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains language models using dense token-level teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, its reliance on frequently refreshed student rollouts often incurs substantial generation cost. We introduce REVO, an off-policy distillation framework that improves rollout efficiency by reusing each student rollout for multi-step learner updates. REVO addresses prefix-level and current-token policy mismatch through stabilized prefix weighting and one-step resampling from the current student, which enables repeated updates without regenerating full trajectories. To prioritize informative token positions within reused rollouts, REVO uses the variance of the student-teacher log-probability ratio to quantify the remaining token-level learning signal and guide repeated optimization. Across multiple student-teacher scales, REVO with only 50 rollout iterations matches or exceeds OPD baselines trained for 200 iterations on both in-domain and cross-domain reasoning benchmarks.

</details>


### [696] [ScaGNN: a Graph Neural Network for Multiple Scattering Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37509)
*Rémi Marsal,Stéphanie Chaillat,Alexandre Chapoutot*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ScaGNN 是一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的方法，用于近似边界元方法（BEM）中边界积分方程（BIE）的解迹，以加速多重散射问题的仿真。其核心贡献是动态自适应边采样机制，可在 GNN 前向传播中根据节点距离和中间预测的预期误差选择最相关的远程交互边，从而实现关于节点数的线性复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BEM 求解 BIE 是多重散射仿真中计算量最大的瓶颈（存储和求解复杂度分别达 O(N²) 和 O(N³)），且迭代求解器（如 GMRES）的收敛迭代次数随障碍物间强相互作用而急剧增加。虽然快速 BEM（FMM 等）可降低每次迭代成本，但收敛性仍是核心难题。同时，现有基于学习的方法局限于二维问题，无法处理多个不相连障碍物组成的复杂几何。因此需要一种高效的学习方法替代 BIE 求解器，并支持三维多重散射问题。

Method: 1. 架构：层次化 GNN（U-Net 风格），含 L=3 层；底层潜在维度逐级翻倍（d_0=64，扩展因子 2）。  
2. 图结构：边界图 G⁰（每个障碍物的网格）、下/上采样图（基于八叉树）、K=3 个远距离交互图 G_k^{L-1}（动态构建）。  
3. 动态自适应边采样：在每个 Distant Interaction Block 中，中间解码器预测节点的解迹 ŷ 和预期误差 ê；从 C 个随机候选源节点中，依据评分函数 f_score^α = ||p_nd - p_nc||₂ / (Σê)^α 选择 Ne 条入边。  
4. 损失函数：Huber 损失，对最终解迹和 K 个中间预测的解迹及误差进行监督，按 γ^{K-k} 加权（γ=0.4）。  
5. 基准数据集：三维 Laplace Dirichlet、Helmholtz Dirichlet、Helmholtz Neumann 问题；训练集每样本 3 个椭球障碍物；测试集含 3/6/9 个椭球障碍物及 3 个圆角平行六面体（OoD）。

Result: ScaGNN 在所有三个问题上均超越现有最优学习方法（PTv3、Transolver、Transolver++、Erwin、MGN、MuS-GNN）：在 Ne=20 配置下，相对最优基线 PTv3 性能提升 38%，且 FLOPs 更低（29.6G vs 16.8G–160.4G）。在线性复杂度下，推理时间比 BEM 低两个数量级。在障碍物数量增至 9 个（OoD）时仍保持最优性能，且对分布外形状（圆角平行六面体）表现出强泛化能力。消融实验证明自适应边采样是关键贡献。

Conclusion: ScaGNN 通过 GNN 替代 BIE 求解器，结合动态自适应边采样机制，成功将多重散射仿真加速两个数量级，同时在精度上全面超越现有学习方法，并展现出良好的泛化能力。未来工作可扩展至更多障碍物和更复杂形状的场景，并探索自监督预训练或物理信息方法以减少对真值标签的依赖。

Abstract: The boundary element method (BEM) provides an efficient numerical framework for solving multiple scattering problems in unbounded homogeneous domains. By restricting the discretization to the domain boundaries, it substantially reduces computational complexity. The procedure first consists in determining the solution trace on the boundaries of the domain by solving a boundary integral equation. Then, the volumetric solution can be recovered at low computational cost using a boundary integral representation. As the first step of the BEM represents the main computational bottleneck, we present ScaGNN, a learning-based approach designed to approximate the solution trace. It relies on a graph neural network architecture that incorporates a dynamic adaptive edge sampling mechanism for selecting the most relevant interactions to model. Guided by intermediate predictions of expected error and edge length, this mechanism selects, at various stages of the forward pass, the most relevant distant interactions to model. The proposed method is tailored to achieve linear complexity with the number of nodes in the input graph. To train and evaluate our network, we present a benchmark consisting of several datasets with different types of multiple scattering problems. Our experiments show that our approach surpasses existing state-of-the-art learning-based methods on the considered tasks and investigate the generalization capabilities to settings with an increased number of obstacles and out-of-distribution obstacle shapes. this http URL

</details>


### [697] [Graph-Conditioned On-Policy Agent Distillation from Off-the-Shelf Teachers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37522)
*Xiaohan Yi,Wen Luo,Yani Huang,Junfeng Zhan,Asher Qin,Peilin Zhao,Xi Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GC-OPD 提出一种基于图结构的在线策略蒸馏方法，通过利用现成教师模型在训练任务上的多次执行记录（成功与失败轨迹）来丰富教师评分时的上下文，无需对教师进行额外优化即可显著提升学生智能体在多轮任务中的表现，并在多个环境中超越使用GRPO训练教师的基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在多轮任务中，学生会因早期错误偏离教师有效监督范围；同时，使用任务专用或RL训练的教师成本高、内存开销大。论文探索如何仅通过现成（off-the-shelf）教师的重复执行记录（execution evidence）来增强其监督信号，无需额外优化教师参数。

Method: 构建源保持的执行图（source-preserving execution graph）：共享状态定位符关联跨执行的访问，源身份保留完整历史。GC阶段为每个学生决策检索当前状态引用或历史替代方案，结合学生后见之明（hindsight），用冻结的教师对原始思维-动作token进行评分。检索基于共同状态节点，成本最小的成功延续获胜；当前状态无成功参考时回溯至最近有支持的学生状态锚点。完整源记录（动作、观察、反馈、结果）作为教师上下文呈现。

Result: 在ScienceWorld上，使用原始Qwen3-32B教师，4B学生平均成功率从24.70%提升至48.78%；ALFWorld Unseen从53.36%提升至85.26%；WebShop从29.10%提升至37.65%。在匹配学生规模下，GC-OPD在ScienceWorld和ALFWorld上超越所有使用GRPO训练教师的OPD基线。ScienceWorld 1.7B和4B分别超过最强GRPO教师基线7.48和2.12个百分点。消融表明：学生后见之明单独贡献14.54点，外部成功引用贡献12.48点，失败记录额外贡献2.50点。计算成本显著低于GRPO教师训练路线（281.27 vs 1216.59 GPU小时）。

Conclusion: GC-OPD证明了通过执行图将现成教师的多次尝试组织为训练时监督信号，是改进教师评分上下文的有效替代方案，相比优化教师参数，能以更低的准备成本获得更高的小学生成功率，且部署时无需教师调用或图检索。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains compact language agents with teacher feedback on student-generated trajectories. In multi-turn tasks, compounding errors can move students beyond the teacher's effective supervision. We introduce Graph-Conditioned On-Policy Agent Distillation (GC-OPD), which enriches an off-the-shelf teacher's scoring context with execution evidence. A graph indexes repeated teacher executions by shared states while preserving complete successful and failed histories. After each student episode, GC-OPD retrieves current-state references or historical alternatives and combines them with student hindsight to score the original thought-action tokens. Using the same original teachers, GC-OPD improves mean success over vanilla OPD from 24.70% to 48.78% on ScienceWorld (4B student), from 53.36% to 85.26% on ALFWorld Unseen, and from 29.10% to 37.65% on WebShop. At matched student sizes, it also achieves higher mean success than every evaluated OPD baseline using GRPO-trained teachers on ScienceWorld and ALFWorld; the strongest such ScienceWorld 4B baseline reaches 46.66%. GC-OPD requires no task-specific teacher optimization.

</details>


### [698] [Physical Muon: Orthogonalization as an Equilibrium Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37525)
*Yuren Hao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Physical Muon，一种将 Muon 优化器中的 Newton-Schulz 正交化替换为连续时间流平衡的物理实现方法，通过随机探针实现矩阵-向量乘积、互逆读取和局部 rank-1 写入，可在模拟存内计算阵列上执行，从而降低 Transformer 训练能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon 优化器虽在 Transformer 训练上优于 AdamW，但其 Newton-Schulz 正交化依赖密集矩阵-矩阵乘法，而模拟存内计算（如阻性阵列）缺乏该原生操作；SGD 适合模拟更新但在 Transformer 上表现不佳，Adam 族对模拟偏置不稳定。因此需要一个既有效学习又适合物理实现的优化器。

Method: 将正交化构建为连续时间流的平衡态：从零演化辅助矩阵 X，使其遵循 $\dot{X} = \hat{M} - XX^T\hat{M}$，每个奇异模独立趋向 1，达到平衡即得极因子。用随机 ±1 探针（Hutchinson 估计）将密集 Euler 增量分解为矩阵-向量乘积 $p = \hat{M}v$、转置读取 $q = X^T p$ 和局部 rank-1 写入 $\Delta X = \eta(p-r)v^T$，全部通过阻性阵列的互逆读取和局部写入实现。还提供了基于 Frobenius 范数的硬件兼容归一化方案。

Result: 在 10.95M 参数 Transformer 上（FineWeb，2500 步）：密集流相对 NS5 的验证交叉熵高 0.0085（n=9，TOST 等效检验通过，p=2.4×10⁻⁸，单侧 95% 上界 0.0142）；探针实现高 0.0188（n=2）。8×8 ngspice 电路瞬态仿真重现流动力学，与数值探针余弦相似度 0.999983，相对 Frobenius 距离 0.0059。四类合成任务上电路在环训练达到与数字 NS5 相当的性能。GPT-2 124M 工作负载投影显示，60k 阵列通过时正交化能耗 0.45–1.04 J，低于数字 NS5 的 1.38–3.00 J；但 240k 通过时两者范围重叠。设备容差测试显示探针流对 20% 增益误差余弦变化 ≤0.011，而 NS5 在 10% 增益误差时余弦降至 0.40–0.45。

Conclusion: Physical Muon 是首个与模拟硬件兼容的 Muon 正交化实现，通过互逆矩阵-向量读取和局部 rank-1 写入完成。密集流在所选等效边界内保持 Transformer 训练质量，电路在环仿真验证了操作可行性。开放问题包括扩大探针预算到更大矩阵、在测量设备误差下维持闭环训练，以及将优化器与物理梯度计算集成。

Abstract: Physical neural networks and analog in-memory computing could reduce the energy cost of neural network training. Realizing this potential, however, requires optimizers that combine effective learning with physical implementability. SGD fits local analog updates but struggles on transformers, while Adam family is unstable against analog bias. Muon offers strong training performance, but its Newton--Schulz orthogonalization relies on dense matrix-matrix products. To address this obstacle, we introduce Physical Muon, which computes the orthogonalization as the equilibrium of a continuous-time flow. Random probes approximate the flow using matrix-vector products, reciprocal reads, and local rank-1 writes. To test whether this replacement preserves training performance, we evaluate it on a 10.95M-parameter transformer. The dense flow's mean validation cross-entropy is 0.0085 above Newton--Schulz across nine seeds per method; the probe implementation is 0.0188 above the control across two seeds. Circuit simulations further reproduce the flow dynamics and yield comparable training behavior.

</details>


### [699] [Why Adaptive Optimizers Underestimate Rare Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37535)
*Sangsidhya Kar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析了坐标自适应优化器（如Adam、RMSProp、符号下降）为何低估softmax输出层中的稀有token。核心原因是这些方法按坐标的二阶矩缩放梯度，而稀有token的梯度呈现"小正向梯度+罕见大负梯度"的不对称模式，导致二阶矩估计在token出现后最大，从而抑制了关键的上升更新。文章在词汇层面证明均值输出嵌入的守恒律，在单token层面推导了RMSProp的闭式不动点，并指出SGD和AMSGrad保持无偏固定点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型训练主要使用Adam等坐标自适应优化器，但词表token频率呈重尾分布。softmax输出层中，稀有token的梯度模式（小正向梯度+罕见大负梯度）与自适应归一化的二阶矩估计产生不良交互，导致训练固定点偏离数据的真实频率。这一偏差会系统性低估稀有token的预测概率，影响模型对生成分布的拟合质量，但缺乏对其机理和量化影响的深入理论分析。

Method: 1) 理论分析：利用softmax梯度的零和性质(F1)和均值嵌入不变性(F2)，建立了均值输出嵌入的守恒判据（命题1），给出坐标方法的精确步进变化（命题2）。2) 单token单字母(unigram)模型：证明符号下降以恒定速率降低低频token的logit（定理3），推导RMSProp在周期性到达下的闭式不动点（定理4），比值ρ(κ)=κ/(2(e^{κ/2}-1))，其中κ=N(1-β₂)为到达间隔与二阶矩时间常数之比。3) 命题5证明SGD和AMSGrad保持无偏固定点。4) 实验验证：在softmax回归、单token迭代、单字母模型和小语言模型（2048词表Markov链生成）上进行实证。

Result: 1) 均值输出嵌入守恒：SGD/Shampoo/Muon/Coupled Adam保持均值，Adam/RMSProp/Lion/符号下降破坏守恒（Adam使均值偏置降低达0.66）。2) RMSProp不动点：当N≥3时，稀有token的平衡概率严格低于其频率；ρ(κ)随κ增大迅速下降（ρ(1)=0.77, ρ(5)=0.22, ρ(10)=0.03），且不依赖于学习率η。3) 符号下降：出现概率小于1/2的token其logit以恒定速率线性下降，永不出现的不用词表项每秒下降恰好η。4) 经验验证：单token实验在κ≲1时与周期公式吻合，但κ≥2时随机到达的偏差远大于预测（平均偏差-5.88）；小语言模型中Adam/RMSProp（β₂=0.95）对罕见token的r_y=-2.72/-2.65，而SGD为-0.22（反映的是不完全优化的基线）；KL散度排序与此一致：SGD最低（0.094），Adam/RMSProp最高（0.22+）。

Conclusion: 坐标自适应优化器（Adam、RMSProp、符号下降、Lion、Adafactor）由于其二阶矩归一化机制，对softmax输出层中的稀有token存在系统性低估偏置，表现为将稀有token的平衡概率压低到真实频率以下。该偏置与学习率无关，仅取决于参数κ=(1-β₂)/(q_iB)，即token稀有度与二阶矩时间常数的比值。提升β₂、增大batch size、使用AMSGrad的运行最大值机制或Coupled Adam的词表共享二阶矩均可缓解此偏差。在小语言模型实验中，具有偏置固定点的优化器也表现出对生成分布更差的拟合（更高KL），但该现象在大型模型中的实际影响仍待进一步研究。

Abstract: In the softmax output layer, a rare token receives a small positive logit gradient on most steps and a much larger negative gradient on the few steps when it is the target. SGD simply adds these contributions. Coordinate-wise adaptive methods such as Adam, RMSProp, and sign descent instead divide each update by a running estimate of its magnitude, and that estimate is largest immediately after the token appears. This imbalance has two effects. At the level of the whole output layer, we characterize which optimizers preserve the mean output embedding: every method whose update is linear in past gradients does, as do Kronecker-factored and orthogonalized methods such as Shampoo and Muon. Adam, Adafactor, Lion, and sign descent do not, and for these methods we obtain an exact step-by-step expression for the change. At the level of an individual rare token, the same normalization shifts the training fixed point. In the unigram model, sign descent lowers the logit of every token that occurs in fewer than half of the minibatches at a constant expected rate. For RMSProp with periodic arrivals, we can solve the fixed point in closed form: if a token is absent for at least two consecutive minibatches, its equilibrium probability is strictly below its data frequency for every learning rate, and the ratio tends to $\kappa/(2(e^{\kappa/2}-1))$. Here $\kappa$ is the mean number of steps between occurrences divided by the second-moment time constant $1/(1-\beta_2)$. In the same model, SGD and AMSGrad retain the unbiased fixed point. We test these predictions both in a unigram model and in a small language model trained from a known generating distribution. With random arrivals, the bias is larger than the periodic formula predicts; in the language model, the optimizers with the biased fixed point also fit the generating distribution less well.

</details>


### [700] [Benchmarking graph-based models for in-silico toxicity prediction in drug discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37555)
*Noel Suarez-Barro,Manuel Lama,Juan C. Vidal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一、标准化的基准测试框架，用于系统评估基于图深度学习（GDL）的分子毒性预测方法。作者在一致的实验条件下对20多种代表性方法在多个数据集和划分策略下进行了重新评估，并辅以结构化文献分析，旨在解决该领域因数据集、预处理和评估协议不一致而导致的可比性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 药物发现中，毒性相关的失败是临床前和临床阶段损耗的主要原因之一。尽管GDL在毒性预测领域发展迅速，但现有文献中由于数据集、预处理流程和评估协议的不一致，模型之间的比较往往难以解释，阻碍了对方法真实进展的判断。因此亟需一个统一、可重复的基准测试框架来公平评估各类图模型。

Method: 作者采用PRISMA-ScR范围综述方法进行文献梳理（2022年1月至2026年1月），并提出统一的基准测试框架，涵盖：(1) 数据集：使用TOXRIC策划的Tox21、ClinTox、Ames、Carcinogenicity、Hepatotoxicity和Cardiotoxicity (hERG，4个IC50阈值) 数据集；(2) 划分策略：随机、Bemis-Murcko骨架、Maxmin（最大化学多样性）和时间划分；(3) 评估协议：5折交叉验证（适用于random/scaffold）或5次独立运行（maxmin/time），固定训练超参数100轮+早停20轮；(4) 主要指标：MCC，并辅以ACC、F1、F2、AUROC、AUPR、特异性；(5) 统计排名：采用Plackett-Luce模型聚合MCC排名。共重新执行了20个模型（包括15个SOTA方法+3个基线GCN/GAT/GATGCN+2个2020年基础模型AttentiveFP/GROVER）。架构层面，将方法按主要任务（MPP/TP/DS）、输入维度（2D/3D）、数据表示（原子图、线图、基序图、3D信息、指纹、知识图谱）、编码器（GCN、GIN、GAT、LiGhT、HGT、VGAE、Transformer等）、池化（GAP、Max、GRU、注意力、虚拟节点）和学习策略（监督、SSL、对比、多任务、知识驱动）进行系统分类。

Result: 综合排名（Plackett-Luce）显示：KPGT（含知识节点的自监督预训练+线图Transformer）以约0.27的概率排名第一，明显优于其他方法。第二梯队由CD-MVGNN、3MTox和GeoDILI组成，三者性能统计上不可区分。在maxmin划分下，KPGT和KANO表现最强（KANO在ClinTox上MCC达64.53）。在time划分下，GeoDILI和3MTox升至前列（MCC约37-38），KPGT降至第三，但在ClinTox上MCC为负值（-1.21），反映其对少数类（毒性类）极度不平衡数据集的敏感性。Cardio-30和ClinTox等高不平衡数据集扩大了模型间的性能差距；较平衡的Ames和Tox21则差异较小。研究发现：1）大部分新模型相比2020年的AttentiveFP/GROVER基线提升有限（MCC差距通常<3%），改进更多体现在精确率-召回率的权衡上而非全面性能；2）bond-centric表示（线图、键中心建模）在多个数据集上表现出一致的优势，提示键级信息对毒性建模具有化学合理性；3）random和scaffold划分可能因化学相似性泄露而高估性能，与maxmin/time划分相比MCC差异约达10%。

Conclusion: 该工作通过提供统一基准测试和系统文献综述，揭示了图深度学习毒性预测的真实现状：知识增强的预训练方法（KPGT、KANO）在化学空间外推中占优，而几何/基序增强方法（GeoDILI、3MTox）在时间外推中更具竞争力；模型排名高度依赖于划分策略，单一实验设置的结论难以泛化；bond-centric表示是未来有前景的方向；高类不平衡数据集是当前模型区分能力的关键考验。作者开源了基准框架（https://gitlab.citius.gal/noel.suarez/benchtox），以促进透明、可重复的社区评估。

Abstract: Drug discovery is a costly and high-risk process, where toxicity-related failures remain a major cause of attrition in both preclinical and clinical stages. As a result, accurate early prediction of chemical toxicity is essential to reduce downstream costs and improve compound prioritization. In this context, graph deep learning (GDL) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for toxicity prediction, leveraging molecular graph representations to learn directly from chemical structure with improved expressivity over traditional approaches. Despite the growing number of proposed models, current literature-based comparisons are often difficult to interpret due to inconsistencies in datasets, preprocessing pipelines, and evaluation protocols. To address this limitation, we introduce a unified and standardized benchmarking framework for GDL-based toxicity prediction. We systematically evaluate more than 20 representative approaches under consistent experimental conditions and across multiple datasets and partitioning strategies, enabling a fair and reproducible comparison of model performance. In addition, we complement this empirical study with a structured literature analysis to contextualize existing methodological trends and performance claims. Our results provide a clearer and more reliable assessment of the current state of the field, highlighting both the strengths and limitations of existing graph-based approaches. To support transparency and reproducibility, we release our benchmarking framework as open-source software this https URL , allowing the community to evaluate and compare models under consistent conditions.

</details>


### [701] [A Model-Agnostic Physics-Guided Adapter for Few-Shot Transfer of Coastal Flood Prediction Models to Unseen Regions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37565)
*Bilal Hassan,Areg Karapetyan,Samer Madanat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Physics Adapter (PA)，一种轻量级、架构无关的物理引导适配器，通过可微的湿/干响应将地形高程纳入峰值水位预测，与数据驱动分支通过学习门控融合。在K=3少样本设定下，PA将全微调的RMSE降低22.9%、PEFT方法降低15.4%、仅头适配降低11.5%，在12个异构骨干网络上均取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习沿海洪水代理模型迁移到新区域需大量目标域水动力模拟，成本高昂。现有研究未系统考察少量目标样本下模型跨海岸线及海平面上升条件的迁移能力。

Method: 提出Physics Adapter（PA）：包含地形条件化的物理分支（通过可微sigmoid湿/干响应比较高程与学习水位）、数据驱动分支及站点级学习门控。以BatchNorm+轻量头实现，参数极少且架构无关。无PDE损失，仅作为架构归纳偏置。12个骨干网络（GCN/GAT/MGN/Transolver++、CASPIAN/ConvNeXt V2/MaxViT/Swin V2、VM-UNet、Depth Anything V2/Depth Pro、ControlNet）上验证SF与AD两区域双向跨域及SLR迁移。

Result: 在K=3时：全微调+PA降低RMSE 22.9%，PEFT+PA降低15.4%，仅PA头适配降低11.5%。K≥1时所有含PA的方案均优于无PA方案。PA单独微调优于无PA全微调。11/12骨干上FT+PA最佳，排除全微调后9/12含PA方案最佳。域内精度：10/12骨干PA源模型更优或持平。零样本（K=0）时PA略逊于raw源模型（因参考水位η对源域过拟合）。

Conclusion: PA提供了一种架构无关、物理引导的高效少样本迁移方案，仅需少量目标域模拟即可将沿海洪水预测模型推广至新区域。物理结构与参数效率互补，可与PEFT方法组合使用。局限性：仅两区域、SLR迁移仅在SF内测试、无零样本能力、缺乏质量/动量守恒保证。

Abstract: Deep learning surrogates can produce high-resolution coastal flood maps orders of magnitude faster than physics-based hydrodynamic simulators, yet transferring them to new coastal regions remains costly, since generating target-region data for fine-tuning typically requires numerous time-consuming simulations. To tackle this bottleneck, we introduce the Physics Adapter (PA), a compact, architecture-agnostic adaptation interface that enables efficient few-shot transfer of flood prediction models across diverse coastal regions. PA predicts peak water level through a differentiable wet/dry response that compares terrain elevation against a learned water level, and blends this physics-structured prediction with a data-driven branch through a learned gate. Unlike physics-informed formulations, PA imposes no PDE-residual or conservation losses and instead exploits elevation as an architectural inductive bias, adding a negligible number of trainable parameters. We integrate PA into 12 heterogeneous models, and evaluate them on two coastal regions with markedly distinct geometries, topographies, and shoreline protection configurations. The performance of PA is benchmarked against a no-physics baseline, full fine-tuning, and standard parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, considering both within-region generalization to unseen sea level rise values and between-region transfer. In low-shot regime (K=3), and averaged over all backbones and transfer settings, adding PA reduces root mean square error by 11.5% when only the output head is adapted on a frozen backbone, by 15.4% when combined with PEFT methods, and by 22.9% under full fine-tuning, compared to matched configurations without PA. Taken together, the findings of this work offer practitioners a concrete recipe for extending DL-based coastal flood predictors to new, data-scarce regions.

</details>


### [702] [GraphVQ: Structure-Aware Autoregressive Decoding over Context-Quantized Graph Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37604)
*Yuxiang Yao,Zijun Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GraphVQ提出了一种基于VQ-VAE的两阶段自回归图生成框架，通过上下文量化的图token和结构感知的逐对条件解码器，解决了序列化窗口无法生成长跨度边（导致循环结构欠生成）以及单一全局条件无法区分候选边对这两个结构性障碍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图基础模型需要离散token表示，但图的序列化生成面临两个结构性障碍：(1) 任何固定序列化下，跨越窗口的边无法在单次自回归过程中生成，导致单次生成器系统性欠生成循环结构；(2) 单一全局条件（如节点特征均值）无法区分候选边对。现有图token化工作（GQT、GFT等）关注token化或迁移，但未解决解码端如何利用token。

Method: 三阶段框架：(1) Stage 1 — BFS序列化下，每个节点上下文（独热特征+局部边掩码）经VQ-VAE编码并量化到共享码本，解码器用BCE校准的Bernoulli边预测重建；(2) Stage 2 — 两层GRU先验对token序列建模；(3) Stage 3（推理）— Stage A自回归采样节点token并解码特征，Stage B以token派生的逐对特征（两个端点embedding、交互、位置、图级摘要）为条件，对上三角邻接矩阵分块自回归生成边。理论贡献：Proposition 1形式化证明了纯全局汇总条件的不足（在作用域内）。

Result: 在MUTAG、PROTEINS、SYN-COMM、SYN-RING-ROLE四个数据集上，统一80/10/10划分、五个种子、每个种子10,000样本。tokenizer特征重建准确率0.86–0.99，边解码AUROC≥0.89，ECE≤0.007。逐对条件将PROTEINS的orbit MMD从0.248降至0.174（t=-6.1），环应力测试提升3.4×，但在随机标签控制上增益消失——验证了属性-拓扑耦合假设。GraphVQ在PROTEINS上在学到的生成器中排名第一（平均秩2.85），SYN-COMM并列第一（2.40），orbit MMD在三数据集上比单阶段生成提升2.7–17×。MUTAG上无加权边目标导致欠生成（连通性0.11 vs 1.00），如实报告。自举置信区间和配对t检验确认排名非种子噪声。

Conclusion: GraphVQ将自回归图生成的结构控制定位在条件的粒度上：逐对token上下文将量化词汇表转变为分布忠实生成的可用容量轴。增益精确出现在属性承载边相关信号的场合。tokenizer利用率为数据所限，非模型所限，表明K应被视为上界。代码39K参数，CPU上MUTAG尺度图采样6.8ms。未来工作：码本容量扫描、扩散基线、token级预训练、分子键型/价约束。

Abstract: Graph foundation models need a discrete token representation, but casting a graph as a generatable token sequence faces a structural obstacle: edges spanning beyond the serialization window cannot be emitted in one pass--so one-pass autoregressive generators systematically under-produce cycles--and a single global condition cannot tell candidate edges apart. GraphVQ removes both obstacles: node contexts--features plus a local edge mask under multi-order breadth-first serialization--are quantized into a shared codebook by a VQ-VAE with BCE-calibrated Bernoulli edge decoding, and a second-stage structure-aware decoder emits the global adjacency conditioned on token-derived pair features, whose necessity over any global-summary condition is formalized in a scoped impossibility result. The tokenizer reconstructs node features at 0.86--0.99 accuracy and decodes local edges at AUROC >= 0.89 (ECE <= 0.007). Under one same-split protocol on four datasets, pair conditioning improves orbit MMD 0.248 -> 0.174 on PROTEINS and 3.4x on a ring stress test, and vanishes on a random-label control--the signature of attribute--topology coupling--so the gain is claimed exactly where attributes carry edge-relevant signal. GraphVQ ranks first among learned generators on PROTEINS, ties for first on SYN-COMM, and improves orbit MMD 2.7--17x over one-stage generation on three datasets, with seed-level bootstrap intervals confirming the rankings are not seed noise; on MUTAG the unweighted edge target under-generates and is reported as such. These results locate the structural control of autoregressive graph generation in the granularity of the condition: pair-level token context turns a quantized vocabulary into a usable capacity axis for distribution-faithful graph generation and future token-level pretraining.

</details>


### [703] [PHASE: Multi-Regime Modeling of Incompressible Magnetohydrodynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37609)
*Radhika Achikanath Chirakkara,Rajdeep Haldar,Zezheng Song,Jiequn Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PHASE是一个用于二维不可压缩磁流体力学(MHD)的物理自适应可扩展算子学习框架，通过结合迁移学习、状态自适应、物理中心学习和残差修正，实现单一模型跨物理参数范围的泛化，将相对L2误差较先前MHD神经算子基线降低一个数量级以上，并能准确模拟开尔文-亥姆霍兹不稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器学习代理模型在MHD多尺度动力学模拟中效率有限，且需针对每个物理参数设置单独训练，缺乏跨参数泛化能力，亟需一种能跨越不同物理状态（如不同雷诺数、磁雷诺数、磁场强度等）的统一算子学习方法。

Method: PHASE框架整合四大核心机制：(1)迁移学习——从粗分辨率或简单任务预训练并迁移到目标任务；(2)状态感知自适应(regime-aware adaptation)——使模型识别并适应不同物理参数所处的状态；(3)物理中心学习(physics-centered learning)——在损失函数或训练过程中融入物理约束/守恒律；(4)残差修正(residual refinement)——通过学习残差进一步精化基模型预测。该方法以神经算子(neural operator)为骨干，在二维不可压缩MHD湍流上进行训练与评估。

Result: 在二维MHD湍流基准上，PHASE较先前MHD神经算子基线将物理场（速度、磁场、压力等）的相对L2误差降低超过一个数量级；在衍生物理量、谱分析和分布统计等评估指标上均展现更高的物理保真度；无需重新训练即可成功泛化到未见过的参数值；并在开尔文-亥姆霍兹不稳定性(Kelvin–Helmholtz instability)测试中准确模拟MHD不稳定性，验证了方法的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: PHASE通过迁移学习、状态自适应、物理中心学习与残差修正的协同设计，实现了单一模型在多种MHD物理状态下的高精度、可泛化预测，达到了当前MHD神经算子代理建模的SOTA水平，为跨参数范围的等离子体多尺度模拟提供了一种高效且鲁棒的算子学习范式。

Abstract: Magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) is central to plasma modeling in astrophysics, space science, fusion, and engineering, but resolving multiscale MHD dynamics is computationally expensive. Machine-learning surrogates enable fast inference by learning reusable solution operators, yet existing models require separate training for each physical regime, limiting generalization across varying parameter settings. We introduce PHASE, a PHysics-Adaptive Scalable operator with residual Error correction, designed to model incompressible MHD across varying physical parameters with a single model. PHASE combines transfer learning, regime-aware adaptation, physics-centered learning, and residual refinement to improve both physical fidelity and generalization across MHD regimes. Together, these improvements achieve state-of-the-art prediction accuracy on two-dimensional MHD turbulence by reducing relative $L_2$ errors on physical fields by more than an order of magnitude compared to prior MHD neural-operator baselines. Moreover, PHASE generalizes successfully to unseen parameter values without retraining, demonstrating the cross-regime adaptability expected from operator learning. We evaluate PHASE beyond point-wise prediction errors using derived physical fields, spectral analysis, and distribution statistics, consistently observing improved physical fidelity. We further show that our framework can accurately simulate MHD instabilities by testing it on the Kelvin--Helmholtz instability, demonstrating the robustness of our method.

</details>


### [704] [Authority Bias in Language Models: Source Deference and User Agreement Are Not Interchangeable](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37616)
*Abhinav Rajeev Kumar,Paras Chopra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了大语言模型中存在一种与用户迎合(sycophancy)不同的故障模式——"来源服从"(source deference):当错误信息以"已验证来源"形式呈现时,即使是经过反迎合训练的大模型也会大幅改变原本正确的答案。研究通过在5个开源模型和3个闭源API上进行因果干预实验,证明来源服从与用户迎合在模型内部表征上虽然几何重叠很高(余弦相似度0.90-0.99),但可以通过独立的激活方向选择性抑制其中一种而不影响另一种。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前针对用户迎合的缓解训练主要针对"用户说什么模型就信什么"的倾向,但忽视了一种新场景:错误信息以"已验证来源"形式注入(如检索结果、工具输出、grounded搜索内容)。模型可能抵抗用户的错误主张,却仍服从带"verified"标签的错误来源。现有工作未因果性地分离这两种故障,因此需要专门的评估和缓解方法。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件:(1)拟合激活方向——从残差流激活中拟合权威方向v̂_auth、来源方向v̂_src、用户方向v̂_usr和助手轴方向v̂_ass;(2)因果干预——通过激活加法、前景投影移除和归因补丁(attribution patch)三种方式操作这些方向;(3)跨任务迁移测试——在PIQA、SYCON多轮对话以及系统提示、RAG文档块等不同提示格式下验证拟合方向的通用性。还设计了助手轴对照和情感效价/唤醒度对照来排除混淆因素。

Result: 主要结果:(1)行为层面,带"已验证来源"的注释会使7/8模型的基线正确答案翻转45-88%,且服从率随来源权威度递增;(2)因果分离层面,在Qwen3.5、GPT-OSS和OLMo-3.1中,移除来源方向使来源服从降低65-80个百分点,而移除用户方向只降低10-17个百分点;(3)归因补丁通过改变"谁在说话"的信号可在不改变提示文本的情况下双向移动服从率,关闭55-61%的原始差距;(4)迁移层面,移除权威方向在4/5开源家族的trivia和PIQA上降低错误服从率数十个百分点,MMLU-Pro和GSM8K能力评估未检测到下降;(5)相比之下,标准的CAA方法对来源服从的降低效果有限(3-17个百分点),证明需要专门针对来源的干预。Gemini-3.1-Pro是唯一例外(几乎无效果),Gemma-4的行为响应明显但线性干预难以控制。

Conclusion: 结论是来源服从和用户迎合是模型内部可分离的两种故障模式,不能合并评估或缓解。即使两者的激活方向几何高度重叠,因果干预仍能选择性影响其一而不影响另一个,说明重叠部分承载共享的"认可"信号,而差异部分承载说话者特异性信号。在检索增强生成和工具使用日益普及的背景下,针对来源的权威服从需要独立的评估基准和缓解技术,与用户迎合基准并行而非合并。

Abstract: Language models tend to agree with whatever a user asserts, and post-training increasingly targets this sycophancy so that models evaluate claims on their merits rather than deferring to the user. Yet the same models are far more compliant when a wrong answer is attributed to a verified source, which is how retrieval results, tool outputs, and grounded-search content often present information. We measure this gap across five open-weight families and three closed APIs. A single verified-source note endorsing a wrong answer flips 45-88% of baseline-correct responses in seven of eight models, and compliance rises with how authoritative the note sounds. Source deference and user agreement are not behaviorally interchangeable inside the model: on matched items with the same wrong answer, causal interventions can selectively suppress one without equally affecting the other. In three open-weight families, removing a fitted source direction lowers source compliance by 65-80 percentage points while removing a user or assistant direction has far smaller effects, and removing the user direction shows the reverse preference. A separately fitted intervention derived from source-versus-user cue activations moves compliance in both directions while leaving the prompt text unchanged. An authority direction fitted on trivia also transfers to PIQA and multi-turn SYCON dialogues without refitting, and removing it lowers wrong-source compliance by tens of percentage points in four of five families with no detected change in MMLU-Pro or GSM8K accuracy at our evaluation sizes. Source deference and user agreement therefore need separate evaluation.

</details>


### [705] [Procedural Core: A Compact Recurrent Initialization for Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37631)
*Zachary Shinnick,Christian Internò,Hemanth Saratchandran,Anton van den Hengel,Damien Teney*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Procedural Core，一种通过训练小型循环Transformer并将其权重扩展到任意规模目标模型来初始化Transformer的策略，无需重复程序化预训练阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有程序化数据预训练方法虽能提升Transformer性能，但每个目标模型都需重复预训练阶段；作者假设通过循环结构可将习得结构压缩为可迁移的紧凑权重集。

Method: 训练一个具有输入/输出独立块+循环中间块的ViT-Tiny辅助模型（~1M参数）在Dyck语言程序化数据上，通过深度展开（复制中间块）和宽度平铺（保持Frobenius范数）将其权重扩展至任意深度和宽度的目标模型。

Result: ViT-Base（85M参数）在ImageNet-1K上top-1准确率提升2.2pp（77.6%→79.8%）；DINO自监督k-NN精度提升+0.3~0.6pp；FineWeb-Edu和CodeParrot困惑度降低约4%；零样本分割mAP从32.3升至42.9，VOC07 CorLoc从9.9升至18.4，NYUv2 RMSE从1.104降至0.998。

Conclusion: 循环参数化使权重分布在更多奇异方向上，转移性结构集中在注意力的value/output通路中，抑制高范数token异常值，从而改善密集预测任务的表示；证明Transformer无需从空白起点初始化，可通过低成本通用能力初始化。

Abstract: Transformers are typically trained from random initialization, requiring all their capabilities to emerge from large-scale optimization. Recent work showed that a small amount of abstract procedurally generated data can help acquire generic inductive structure at low cost. However, this adds a pretraining stage that must be repeated for every target model. We propose Procedural Core, an initialization strategy that captures this generic structure into a compact set of weights that can be reused across models. We train a minimal recurrent transformer on procedural data, then expand its weights to initialize transformers of arbitrary width and depth. The resulting initialization improves performance on image classification, self-supervised visual learning (DINO), and modeling natural language (FineWeb-Edu) and code (CodeParrot). For image classification, expanding a 1M-parameter core to initialize an 85M-parameter ViT-Base improves ImageNet top-1 accuracy by 2.2 pp over standard random initialization. Our analysis identifies recurrence as essential for learning compact weights that transfer across models. In ViTs, we localize a key benefit in the suppression of high-norm tokens that produces substantial improvements in zero-shot segmentation (ImageNet-S mAP 32.3 to 42.9), object localization (VOC07 CorLoc 9.9 to 18.4), and depth estimation (NYUv2 RMSE 1.104 to 0.998). This demonstrates that transformers need not start from a blank slate, and can be initialized with generic capabilities at low cost with no domain- or task-specific data.

</details>


### [706] [RACE: Relation-Level Counterfactual Explanations for Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37650)
*Yuxiang Yao,Zijun Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RACE为异质图神经网络提供关系级反事实解释，通过精确搜索找到实例级最小关系删除集，并将其精炼为单边恢复不可约的带类型边集；其在ACM、Cora和ogbn-mag上比最强基线CF²-hetero提高反事实成功率+0.8至+2.7pp同时删除更少边，并在四个骨干网络上复现优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图GNN反事实解释方法在异质图上先折叠为无类型边，无法回答领域专家真正关心的问题——"哪种关系类型驱动了该预测？"。此外，软掩码方法依赖随机初始化顺序，结果不稳定（同一骨干上CSR波动6-8pp）。

Method: 1) 保留关系语义的异质图Transformer骨干；2) 关系级精确搜索：对K≤10的关系类型枚举2^K个子集，返回词汇实例级最小关系删除集或显式不可行报告；3) 分层精炼：在归因关系内通过单边恢复扫描生成单边恢复不可约的带类型边集，每步在离散模型上验证；4) 输出契约：每个实例要么获得认证最小解，要么获得显式不可行声明。

Result: 在ACM/Cora/ogbn-mag上对最强基线CF²-hetero：CSR提升+0.8/+2.7/+1.4pp（p=0.002，Holm校正后≤0.062），边成本降低-1.9/-1.0/-2.7pp。在ogbn-arXiv四个骨干（HGT/HAN/R-GCN/RACE-bb）和DBLP上复现优势，CSR增益+0.9至+2.6pp。跨种子关系集一致性0.78-0.89。5%边扰动下关系集一致性保持0.93-0.98。合成SCM实验验证搜索能恢复训练模型实际依赖的关系，并在模型未学习机制时报告不可行而非捏造归因。

Conclusion: RACE首次为冻结异质GNN提供了两个互补粒度的可信赖反事实解释：实例级最小关系删除集的精确确定性搜索，以及归因关系内单边恢复不可约的带类型边集。其核心价值在于决定性（同一骨干给出相同解释）和每实例输出契约（每个翻转在离散模型上认证，不可行实例显式报告），使解释在最关键处保持可信。未来工作将干预单元从关系类型扩展到元路径，用显式结构因果模型支撑关系级精度度量。

Abstract: Counterfactual explanations of graph neural networks identify edge deletions that flip a prediction. On heterogeneous graphs, however, existing methods first collapse the graph into untyped edges, so they cannot answer the question a domain expert actually asks: which relation type drives this prediction? We present RACE (Relation-Aware Counterfactual Explanations), which gives this question an exact, per-instance answer. For every explained instance, an exhaustive search over relation subsets returns the certified minimum relation-deletion set that flips the prediction -- or an explicit report that no such deletion exists; each relation-level answer is then refined into a typed edge set within the attributed relations, verified on the discrete model by single-edge restoration. The relation-level answer is exact and deterministic given the frozen backbone, whereas soft-mask baselines vary by 6-8 pp in success rate across runs differing only in random ordering. On ACM, a Cora-derived graph, and ogbn-mag, RACE improves counterfactual success rate over the strongest baseline by up to +2.7 pp while deleting fewer edges, and attains the highest success rate among all same-task baselines on every dataset; the advantage reproduces across four backbones on ogbn-arXiv and on DBLP, with cross-seed relation-set agreement up to 0.89.
