A synthetic study with known generating mechanisms confirms that the search recovers the relation the trained model actually relies on -- and reports infeasibility rather than fabricating an attribution when the model has learned none -- so the explanations stay trustworthy exactly where explanations matter.

</details>


### [707] [Nonpreemptive Scheduling While Learning Context-Dependent Service Rates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37660)
*Wansoo Choi,Seoungbin Bae,Dabeen Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究非抢占式上下文排队bandit问题，提出LCP算法在已知horizon下达到√(d/T)遗憾，并提出estimated-SEPT算法在未知horizon下跟踪SEPT策略，速率为√(d/t)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的上下文排队bandit工作（如Bae et al., 2026; Bae and Lee, 2026）研究的是抢占式设置，其中最优策略可由简单的myopic规则表征（选择离开概率最大的作业）。然而，许多实际系统（如云计算、通信网络中的计算/通信会话）一旦开始服务就不能中断，即非抢占式设置。该设置下最优动作依赖于剩余horizon和队列状态，使学习和规划问题更复杂。

Method: 1) 定义workload（负载）作为关键工具——所有未完成作业剩余服务时间之和，在work-conserving策略下与策略无关；2) 建立workload的指数尾界和稳态支配性质；3) 对已知horizon提出Learn-Clear-Plan (LCP)算法：先收集样本估计参数，清空队列后按估计的有限horizon Bellman递归做horizon依赖决策；4) 对未知horizon提出estimated-SEPT算法，在忙区间更新估计并按估计的优先级调度；5) 用Le Cam方法和KL散度构建下界，用workload分析证明SEPT跟踪界。

Result: 1) 已知horizon: LCP算法实现R_T^{IA} = Õ(√(d/(λT)))，在T≥d²时与下界Ω(min{1/√d, √(d/T)})匹配（达对数因子）；2) 未知horizon: 不存在anytime策略使R_t^S→0（即使模型已知），因为最优动作依赖horizon；3) estimated-SEPT算法对真实SEPT的跟踪误差为Õ(√(d/(λt)))；4) Bellman递归计算成本为exp(O(log³T))，多项式对数于T。

Conclusion: 本文首次在非抢占式单服务器系统中系统研究了带上下文特征的排队bandit问题，揭示了非抢占式设置与抢占式的根本差异：最优策略不再有简单的myopic表征。LCP算法在已知horizon下达到最优遗憾率（至对数因子），estimated-SEPT在未知horizon下提供有意义的后悔/跟踪保证。未来工作方向为多服务器扩展（面临workload与策略相关的挑战）。

Abstract: We study nonpreemptive contextual queueing bandits in a single-server system. Each job is represented by a $d$-dimensional context vector; in each round, a job may arrive with its context drawn from an unknown distribution $\mathcal{D}$, and its departure probability is determined by a logistic model of that context vector with an unknown parameter $\theta^*$. The server learns from service outcomes while deciding which waiting job to serve and whether to idle, aiming to minimize queue-length regret, the gap between its expected terminal queue length and the minimum achievable by an admissible policy. Once selected, a job must be served until completion, and we refer to this as the nonpreemptive setting. A central challenge is that, even with full model knowledge, the optimal policy cannot in general be characterized by a simple myopic rule, since the optimal action can change with the remaining horizon at the same queue state. Nevertheless, when the model and horizon are known, the optimal action can be obtained through a finite-horizon Bellman recursion. Motivated by this, we propose Learn--Clear--Plan (LCP), which estimates the system and uses the resulting Bellman recursion to make horizon-dependent decisions. LCP achieves $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{d/T})$ queue-length regret, while a lower-bound construction gives $\Omega(\min\{1/\sqrt{d},\sqrt{d/T}\})$ regret for every learning policy on some instance, establishing optimality up to polylogarithmic factors when $T\ge d^2$. When the horizon is unknown, no horizon-independent policy achieves vanishing regret against the finite-horizon optimum. We therefore use SEPT, the policy that serves a waiting job with the highest probability of departure, as a fixed reference, and suggest an estimated-SEPT algorithm that achieves a tracking error of $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{d/t})$ without knowing the model.

</details>


### [708] [Learning Causal Normalizing Flows from Incomplete Data via Observed-Data Likelihood](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37664)
*Trung-Dung Hoang,Alceu Bissoto,Tim Flühmann,David Herzig,Christos Nakas,Lia Bally,Lisa M. Koch*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MissCNF，一种可直接从不完整观测数据中训练因果归一化流（CNF）的方法。它通过蒙特卡洛估计对每条样本中观察到的子集计算边际似然，避免了删除行或构建完整数据集。结合CNF的自回归因果结构，仅需对观察集祖先闭包中的缺失变量进行积分。该工作区分了MAR下的可忽略性与可识别性，并提出了"因果族正性"条件，即使数据中无任何完整记录，仍可恢复完整联合分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准CNF假设训练数据完全可观测，但在医疗等现实场景中缺失数据不可避免。现有两种常见策略——列表删除法和"先填补再拟合"流程——前者会因MCAR以外的机制产生偏差，后者会将填补误差传播至因果建模阶段。因此需要一种直接在不完全数据上训练CNF的方法。

Method: MissCNF通过最大化每个部分观测样本的边际似然来训练CNF。关键洞察是利用CNF的自回归因果分解：计算观察子集O的边际密度p_θ,O(x_O)仅涉及祖先闭包A=anc(O)中的变量，闭包外的变量（barren nodes）积分为1而被丢弃；闭包内的缺失祖先M'=A\O通过对基础噪声u_{M'}采样并按拓扑顺序推流进行蒙特卡洛边际化（算法1）。在理论方面，将MAR下的可忽略性（缺失机制独立于参数）与可识别性分离，提出"因果族正性"：只需每个变量与其因果父节点在某个观测模式中以正概率共同被观察，即可识别完整联合分布，即使所有行都不完整也可成立。该条件弱于完整模式正性。进一步证明MissCNF恢复完整联合的同时，作为副产品也恢复了impute-then-fit所需的任何条件分布。

Result: 在8个合成SCM（Chain、Triangle、Collider、Fork各有线性/非线性版）上，三种缺失机制（MCAR、MAR、自掩蔽MNAR），缺失率高达90%下，对比列表删除法和5种非因果填补器（Mean、MissForest、MICE、KPI、DiffPuter）以及因果填补器O-MIRACLE：非线性MCAR和MAR下，MissCNF在24个任务×缺失率设置中有23个取得最低KL散度；所有非线性MNAR设置下均最优；20/24设置下反事实误差最低。线性SCM上MICE最强，MissCNF在22/24设置下排前二。受控非线性实验证实随着非线性增强，MICE的KL迅速恶化而MissCNF保持稳定。可识别性条件实验中，违反因果族正性时误差确实集中在未识别区域Z_O内、区域外接近零，与定理1一致。计算开销：单次边际密度评估O(KdL)，K=128时KL已收敛，单卡RTX 4090峰值10GB。

Conclusion: MissCNF首次实现了在不完全数据上直接训练CNF，无需删除行或先填补。它将经典的FIML思想扩展到非线性、非高斯场景。核心贡献在于区分可忽略性与可识别性，并证明因果结构使得仅需因果族正性即可恢复完整联合分布，即使无完整行。实证上MissCNF在非线性SCM的所有缺失机制下表现最佳，线性SCM上MICE略优。未来可扩展至DeCaFlow（处理潜在混杂）和TSCNF（纵向数据），但目前仅在合成数据上验证，需要真实数据验证。

Abstract: Causal Normalizing Flows (CNFs) enable causal inference from observational data given the causal structure, but they assume fully observed training data. We introduce MissCNF, which trains CNFs directly on incomplete data by maximizing the marginal likelihood of each partially observed sample, without discarding rows or constructing a completed dataset. Thanks to the causal structure encoded in the autoregressive factorization of CNFs, only missing variables in the ancestral closure of the observed set are integrated out, while the others are dropped without computation. We further establish the conditions under which MissCNF recovers the true joint distribution, and introduce \emph{causal-family positivity}, where identification is possible even when no record in the dataset is ever complete. We compare MissCNF with two common strategies for handling missing data: listwise deletion and impute-then-fit pipelines. Across eight synthetic causal benchmarks, three missingness mechanisms, and missing rates up to $90\%$, MissCNF achieves the lowest KL divergence in 23 of 24 nonlinear MCAR and MAR settings and in all nonlinear MNAR settings, as well as the lowest counterfactual error in 20 of 24 settings. On linear SCMs, where linear imputation performs best, MissCNF ranks in the top two in 22 of 24 settings.

</details>


### [709] [Where Privacy Belongs: Placement Diagnosis and Certified Selection for Private Counterfactual Explanations on Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37667)
*Yuxiang Yao,Zijun Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PrivCFS，一种面向图神经网络(GNN)反事实解释的隐私保护机制，通过"构造即认证"的策略，在固定的数据无关候选空间上用指数机制选择干预集，对完整发布对象提供纯ε-DP保证，并将隐私噪声转化为可定价的公开披露决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有图反事实解释的两种隐私部署位置（先私有化图再解释、在干净图上解释后扰动输出）均存在严重缺陷：前者因预测污染产生虚假翻转，后者启发式方法实际全发布预算远超声明预算（最坏情况AUC=1.0），无法被认证。

Method: PrivCFS从公开先验图与公开特征模式构建数据无关的候选干预集，利用"无操作"语义保证相邻图共享相同的输出支撑；定义有效性门控的裁剪效用函数（全局敏感度Δu≤1，无需优化器敏感度分析），通过指数机制采样释放干预集，从而对完整发布对象提供纯ε-DP保证并支持查询组合。

Result: 在Cora/CiteSeer上，ε=8时隐私噪声仅损失3–17%效用（保留83–97%最优值），最优似然比边推理审计AUC平均0.50、最坏0.59（远低于启发式基线的1.0）；机制可迁移至15K节点图，有效率0.96；损失分解表明隐私噪声是流水线最廉价阶段，公开披露强度是可定价的主要成本。

Conclusion: 图反事实解释的隐私-效用权衡由"部署位置"决定，解释级位置可通过构造即认证的方式实现纯ε-DP；公开披露强度形成可查表定价的价格表，使隐私保护从会计风险转化为数据所有者的可购买决策。

Abstract: Counterfactual explanations for graph neural networks (GNNs) find the minimal intervention that flips a node's prediction--but computing one requires reading sensitive graph structure, and releasing it discloses that structure. Both existing placements fail. Privatizing the graph before explaining corrupts the target on exactly the borderline nodes needing recourse, manufacturing spurious flips that flip the privatized graph but not the true one. Explaining on the clean graph and perturbing the released explanation resists certification: re-auditing the standard heuristic shows an implied full-release budget of 573--753 on Cora and 256 on CiteSeer--orders of magnitude beyond its advertised budget--with worst-case single-entry leakage at AUC 1.0. We propose PrivCFS, which replaces certification-by-optimization with certification-by-construction: counterfactual selection over a fixed, data-independent candidate universe--edge interventions from a public prior graph, feature interventions from a public schema--whose no-op semantics give neighboring graphs the same output support. A validity-gated, clipped utility of global sensitivity $\Delta u \le 1$ released through the exponential mechanism gives pure $\varepsilon$-DP for the complete released object, composable over queries--to our knowledge the first such guarantee on graphs. Privacy noise is the cheapest stage: at $\varepsilon$=8 the release retains 94--97% of its support-restricted non-private optimum on the recourse population and 83--95% on the general one; the optimal edge-inference audit attains AUC 0.50 on average and 0.59 worst-pair, versus the heuristic's worst entry 1.0; and transfers to a 15K-node graph at 0.96 valid rate. The dominant cost is a measurable, monotone price in public disclosure, readable off one table before any budget is spent--turning explanation privacy from an accounting risk into a purchasable decision.

</details>


### [710] [LEMON-ZEST: Evolution-Informed Tokenization for Efficient Protein Language Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37675)
*Biswajit Banerjee,Claudia Alvarez Carreno,Anton S. Petrov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于进化保守性的蛋白质分词方法 ZEST，并基于此构建了仅 200M 参数的紧凑模型 LEMON。该模型在远程同源性检测任务上超越了 600M–3B 参数的 SOTA 基线，证明了进化知识注入分词层可替代大规模参数扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质结构比序列更保守，是一对多映射关系。现有 PLM 主要沿 NLP 范式进行参数和数据扩展，而分词粒度这一维度被严重低估。标准 BPE/字符级分词无法捕捉进化保守模式，迫使模型通过大规模训练隐式重新学习这些先验，造成参数和算力的浪费。

Method: 核心方法分三部分：(1) ZEST 词表构建：从 765,248 个 HMM profile 的共识序列中挖掘保守多残基片段（≥3 残基、非均聚物），MMseqs2 linclust 以 70% 序列同一性聚类，选取 top 31,975 簇，附加 20 个氨基酸和 5 个特殊 token，得到平均 4 残基长度的 32K 词表。(2) Trie-Dropout：基于前缀树的前缀匹配结构，将长 token 在概率 p_drop 下随机退化为较短子 token，保证词表均匀利用并支持测试时增强。(3) LEMON 架构：双头 Y 形结构——共享编码器（RoPE + SwiGLU + Flash Attention 的预归一 Transformer）+ 表征头（对比学习的注意力池化 + 瓶颈投影）+ 序列头（将 token 表示通过全局+局部位置编码广播回残基级别以做 MLM）。在 UniRef90 50%（约 90M 序列）上预训练，在 TEDLH 构建的 5970 万 CATH 层级标注对上进行对比学习微调。

Result: 在远程同源性检测基准上：SCOP fold-level AUROC 在 10%–95% 序列同一性阈值全区间第一（th10: 0.875, th95: 0.904），持续领先 ProtTucker。SCOPe/SCOP/CATH S20 平均 AUROC 0.86、mAP 0.31，超越所有 650M–3B 基线。消融实验中 ZEST 32K 在 ROC-AUC/mAP 和训练速度上同时优于 BPE 32K 和字符级。零样本泛化（CIRPIN、EC、GO MF、Domain Boundary）冻结嵌入下接近或超过 ESM-2/ProtTucker。TTA 在 d∈[0.05, 0.5] 形成稳定增益平台。计算成本：单 H100 一周，推理 5 分钟。

Conclusion: 论文证明将进化保守知识注入分词层可替代参数规模化，开辟了"生物先验驱动的分词"这一新方向。LEMON 在仅 200M 参数下达到远程同源性检测 SOTA，同时具备良好的零样本泛化能力。主要局限：在细粒度残基级属性预测上仍落后于 ESM 等大规模训练模型，这指向未来将 ZEST 风格词表扩展到更丰富训练流程的工作方向。代码、权重和结果以 MIT 协议开源。

Abstract: Protein Language Models (PLMs) have made remarkable progress following scaling laws established in natural language processing across sequence- and structure-based tasks, yet the potential of tokenization remains underexploited. Unlike human language, proteins preserve structure despite extensive sequence variation a property standard tokenization strategies fundamentally fail to capture. We introduce ZEST (Zoned Encoding of Sequence Traits), an evolution-informed vocabulary derived from conserved regions of multiple sequence alignments. ZEST allows embedding domain-level biological priors directly at the tokenization stage rather than learning them implicitly through scale. ZEST natively compresses sequences to an average token length of 4 residues, enabling our model to process 4,000 residues within a standard 1024-token context window. Building on this, we present LEMON (Layered Extraction of Molecular Ordering from Nature), a compact 200M-parameter sequence-based model for detection of remote homology between protein sequences trained on a single H100 GPU for one week. Despite its modest size, LEMON outperforms state-of-the-art models ranging from 600M to 3B parameters. Our results demonstrate that evolution-informed tokenization can substitute for massive parameter scaling, opening a new direction for efficient, biologically-grounded protein representation learning. All code, model weights, and results are publicly available under the MIT license.

</details>


### [711] [Volatility-Clustering Adaptation for Financial Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37715)
*Manh Nguyen,Minh Hoang Nguyen,Huu Hiep Nguyen,Van Dai Do,Hung Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出VCA（Volatility-Clustering Adaptation）方法，通过在金融时序基础模型（如Kronos）的微调阶段，将下一token交叉熵损失与平方收益率自相关函数（ACF²）的可微匹配损失相结合，从而注入"波动率聚集"这一金融风格化事实作为多步训练信号。在CSI300、CSI500和Crypto三个资产集上的实验表明，VCA在fore评价规约下改善了预训练模型的适应效果，收益主要来自方差误差的降低；同时发现按波动率体制匹配的子集在长预测窗口下能以更少的参数漂移匹配或超越全量数据微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序基础模型在新领域（尤其是金融领域）的微调普遍假设"目标数据越多越好"。然而在金融场景中，价格单步变化难以预测，但波动率具有强自相关和体制切换特征；长历史窗口往往混合多种不同的波动率体制，导致更多数据反而可能引入与部署时体制不匹配的模式。因此需要：(1) 在训练目标中显式编码领域特有的时序结构（如波动率聚集），而非仅依赖token级交叉熵；(2) 探索按波动率体制匹配子集微调的可行性。

Method: 核心方法是VCA：在标准下一token交叉熵损失 L_CE 上增加一项 ACF² 损失 L_ACF²，总损失为 L = L_CE + λ·L_ACF²。具体步骤：(1) 使用Gumbel-softmax straight-through估计器实现离散token自回归rollout的可微化（温度τ退火）；(2) 在batch层面（而非单条轨迹）计算平方收益率样本ACF均值 \bar{ρ}_k，以降低方差；(3) 匹配rollout的 \bar{ρ}_k 与真实未来路径的 \bar{ρ}_k^⋆，权重 w_k = e^{-k/γ}；(4) 默认K=1，即仅匹配一阶滞后。命题1（波动率趋势通道）证明该目标对平方收益水平正负趋势 g↔-g 不敏感，只能约束依赖结构而非水平。数据层面，研究按测试期实现波动率匹配的时序切片（前10%/1%或后10%/1%）微调与全量数据微调的对比。基线包括冻结模型、纯CE微调、MSE rollout微调，以及GARCH(1,1)和HAR-RV经典模型。

Result: 主表（fore规约）下，VCA在三个数据集（CSI300、CSI500、Crypto）上均为细调方法中最优平均Score和最高胜率（5/8、6/8、5/8），且是唯一在所有数据上改善冻结模型 σ²-MAE 的细调方法。收益主要由方差误差降低驱动；RankIC提升相对温和。在CSI500上VCA同时优于GARCH和HAR-RV。在vol规约下，VCA在CSI300和Crypto仍最优；QLIKE指标下VCA在CSI300和CSI500最优但Crypto上劣于经典模型。Chronos-T5-small骨干上的复现结果明显不稳定（部分方差爆炸），说明VCA依赖领域预训练良好的骨干。消融实验显示：(1) 体制匹配的10%切片在H=32下能匹配或超越全量数据微调且权重漂移更小，但H=16下短上下文需更广覆盖；(2) λ对RankIC在两horizon上均敏感，过大会严重退化；(3) K=1为最佳选择；(4) VCA产生比CE更大的权重漂移。模拟与实证共同验证了命题1预测的"波动率趋势通道"现象。

Conclusion: 研究结论是：在金融时序基础模型适应过程中，token级预测目标不足以刻画部署所需的领域时序结构；需要注入如波动率聚集等风格化事实作为可微多步信号（类似物理信息学习范式）。VCA的ACF²损失能在不显著增加权重漂移代价下改善多步rollout的依赖结构匹配，主要体现在方差相关指标的提升。数据选择上，长horizon下体制匹配子集可替代全量数据，但短horizon仍需更广覆盖。该工作为金融时序基础模型的适应提供了"目标+数据"双视角的实践指导，并识别了目标函数对波动率水平（而非依赖结构）的盲区作为固有局限。

Abstract: Time-series foundation models are increasingly adapted to new domains through fine-tuning on target data, under the implicit assumption that more target data yields better forecasts. We show that this assumption can fail in financial forecasting, where individual price changes are difficult to predict, but large moves tend to cluster, creating alternating calm and turbulent periods. Using financial foundation models trained on price bars of open, high, low, close, and volume, we argue that adapting to financial domains requires training signals beyond next-token prediction. We introduce Volatility-Clustering Adaptation (VCA), which augments next-token cross-entropy with a differentiable penalty on the autocorrelation of squared returns, the standard statistical signature of volatility clustering. This additional objective provides a multi-step training signal by matching the resulting dependence structure of autoregressive rollouts to those of the realized future. Across three asset sets and two evaluation conventions, VCA improves adaptation over the pre-trained model, with the strongest gains under the primary evaluation (\textsc{fore}), driven primarily by reduced variance error. Overall, our results suggest that effective financial adaptation requires objectives that capture domain-specific temporal structure beyond token-level prediction.

</details>


### [712] [Predictive Geometry of Hidden Trajectories in Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37717)
*Timur Mudarisov,Mikhail Burtsev,Tatiana Petrova,Radu State*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对仅解码器Transformer的中间隐藏状态，提出一种基于终端预测损失的局部预测几何框架。核心是定义逐层损失-to-go函数，并证明在低损失区域，其局部二阶几何由一个回拉Fisher算子 K_ℓ 控制，该算子能区分输出敏感方向与预测零空间方向。同时推导出逐token的Fisher-Jacobian曲率分数 κ_ℓ,s，具有因果支撑特性。实验表明该几何信号在扰动敏感性预测、分层秩分配、token剪枝以及低秩学生模型蒸馏等压缩任务中均有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的隐藏表示几何研究多为经验性描述，未从终端预测损失出发推导哪些隐藏状态方向真正影响最终预测。论文旨在从损失函数本身出发，建立一种"损失感知"的隐藏状态几何描述，为模型压缩和蒸馏提供理论依据。

Method: 方法包括：(1) 定义逐层损失-to-go函数 J_ℓ(X)=ϕ(Ψ_ℓ(X))，通过链式法则得到其Hessian在低损失区域近似为回拉Fisher算子 K_ℓ=J̄_ℓᵀF*J̄_ℓ；(2) 利用K_ℓ的谱定义可观测子空间和预测零空间；(3) 定义token级曲率分数 κ_ℓ,s=tr(P_s K_ℓ P_sᵀ)，证明其等于Fisher加权的目标logit敏感度，且仅在因果祖先集上非零；(4) 通过无矩阵的JVP/VJP乘积实现曲率算子的高效估计；(5) 将该几何信号应用于秩分配、token剪枝和知识蒸馏作为正则化项。

Result: 实验在1B-9B参数的10个decoder-only模型上（WikiText、OpenWebText、FineWeb数据集）验证：(1) Teacher-KL的二次Fisher预测在中等扰动半径下高度有效；(2) 可观测方向扰动比零空间方向导致KL变化大数个量级，有效可观测秩远低于隐藏维度；(3) 几何引导的秩分配在τ=0.05和0.1时优于均匀分配，Gemma 2B、Qwen2.5 3B等模型改善明显；(4) κ-based剪枝与注意力剪枝竞争力相当；(5) 加入几何正则化在9/14的RKL设置和10/14的SkewKL设置中改善蒸馏效果。

Conclusion: 论文建立了decoder-only Transformer中间隐藏状态的预测几何理论框架，证实终端预测损失在成功轨迹附近诱导出稀疏且各向异性的预测相关方向。该几何不仅具有描述性诊断价值，还能在模型压缩和知识蒸馏中作为实用信号，将终端损失目标转化为网络中可操作的结构信息。

Abstract: Decoder-only transformers are trained only through a terminal next-token prediction loss, yet this loss constrains every intermediate hidden state through the fixed downstream computation. We formalize this constraint by studying layerwise loss-to-go functions: the terminal loss obtained by continuing a candidate hidden state through the remaining transformer blocks. Around successful validation trajectories, we show that the local second-order geometry of these functions is governed, up to low-loss residual terms, by a pullback Fisher operator on hidden-state space. Its spectrum identifies output-sensitive directions and approximately prediction-null directions, yielding a local observable subspace of the residual stream. For causal transformers, the same geometry induces a tokenwise curvature score: a Fisher-weighted sensitivity of the target logits to perturbations of each token's hidden state. This score vanishes outside the causal ancestor set of the target and is controlled by downstream Jacobian couplings, making it a loss-aware alternative to attention magnitude. We estimate these quantities using matrix-free Jacobian-vector and vector-Jacobian products and evaluate them across decoder-only language models on WikiText, OpenWebText, and FineWeb. Empirically, the induced geometry predicts perturbation sensitivity, supports nonuniform layerwise rank allocation, yields competitive structured token-pruning signals, and improves low-rank student recovery when added to stronger autoregressive distillation objectives such as reverse KL and skew KL. These results support a predictive-geometric view of transformer computation: near successful trajectories, the terminal loss induces a thin, anisotropic set of output-relevant hidden-state directions that can be measured and exploited for compression and distillation.

</details>


### [713] [Weights Read and Write Features: Scalable Parameter Decomposition Grounded in Activation Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37731)
*Tue M. Cao,Lisiane Pruinelli,My T. Thai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ASPD（Activation-Supported Parameter Decomposition），一种将激活空间与参数空间联合分解的方法，通过共享稀疏表示将权重分量"接地"于其所读取或写入的激活特征，实现了可扩展、可解释、可因果编辑的权重分解，并在Qwen-3-8B等大模型上恢复了经典IOI电路的参数级机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可解释性方法通常单独分析激活空间（如SAE）或参数空间（如参数分解），未能建立"模型表征的信息"与"权重级计算机制"之间的联系。此外，现有参数分解方法在大型预训练模型上难以扩展，分解结果也未与激活特征明确对应。

Method: ASPD通过共享稀疏编码器联合分解激活空间与参数空间：每个权重分量 $P_c = u_c v_c^\top$ 由同一稀疏隐变量同时定义激活特征和门控权重分量激活（$\phi(g^s_c(r_t))$），形成"读取-写入"机制。损失函数包含三部分：内部重建损失 $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{internal}}$（在权重矩阵输出处重建）、激活重建损失 $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{act}}$（通过共享表示实现SAE式特征分解）和BatchTopK稀疏约束。分量间的"读取-写入"交互通过 $\mathrm{Interact}(c_1,c_2)=\mathbb{E}_{X,t}[g_{t,c_2}(X)e_{t,c_1}]\langle u_{c_1},v_{c_2}\rangle$ 评分以构建参数级机制电路。共享门编码器以残差流激活为输入（而非模块内部输入），以提升多样性与可解释性。

Result: 在GPT-2 small、Gemma-2-2B和Qwen-3-8B上的实验表明，ASPD在可解释性（Intruder分数：Gemma上0.62 vs VPD的0.20）、多样性（Jaccard重叠：Gemma上0.03 vs VPD的0.44）和因果权重编辑能力（Qwen-3-8B上ratio=11.1×随机基线 vs VPD的0.8×）上均显著优于VPD基线。在GPT-2 small全72个权重矩阵的联合分解中，ASPD自动恢复了IOI电路的参数级机制，包括重复token检测、归纳、S-抑制和名称移动等已知子电路，并通过直接权重干预验证了S-抑制QK分量对因果关系的有效性。还在第7层MLP中追踪了"具体新闻组织→一般新闻语境"的语义转换路径。

Conclusion: ASPD提供了一个连接激活特征与权重机制的统一框架，通过共享稀疏表示和内部重建信号实现了可扩展至Qwen-3-8B的可解释、语义接地且因果可编辑的参数分解。其"读取-写入"交互范式支持构建参数级机制电路，将机制可解释性从特征层面推进到权重分量层面，为未来研究（如参数差异分析Parameter Diffing）奠定了基础。局限性在于某些机制分解粒度仍较粗，且未在所有模型和提示上充分验证。

Abstract: Activation space and parameter space provide complementary views of model computation. Activations represent information, while weights read, transform, and write that information. Yet existing interpretability methods largely study the two spaces separately, leaving the connection between represented information and parameter-level computation underexplored. We introduce Activation-Supported Parameter Decomposition (ASPD), which jointly decomposes activation and parameter spaces and grounds each learned weight component in the activation features it reads or writes. This grounding constrains otherwise non-unique parameter decompositions using the model's internal activations, while an internal reconstruction objective provides a local learning signal at the weight matrix being analyzed. Together, these properties enable scalable, interpretable, and causally editable parameter decomposition in pretrained large language models, demonstrated on Qwen-3-8B. The learned read--write components can also be composed into parameter-level mechanism circuits. We use ASPD to recover mechanisms underlying the classic IOI circuit and trace semantic transformations through model weights.

</details>


### [714] [HyDI: A hybrid Deep Learning-Inductive Logic Programming ensemble for multi-label classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37740)
*Simon Flügel,Till Mossakowski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HyDI提出了一种神经-符号混合集成架构,结合深度学习(DL)模型与归纳逻辑程序设计(ILP)生成的规则,用于层次化多标签分类(HMLC),在化学领域ChEBI本体上以微小性能损失换取显著的可解释性提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型在多标签分类中性能卓越但缺乏可解释性;层次化分类中高层类样本充足适合DL,而叶类样本稀缺且需要透明决策,纯符号方法又需手工构造规则。动机在于通过神经-符号集成,在保持分类性能的同时为关键叶类提供全局和局部可解释的分类依据。

Method: 1.架构:非叶类由增强图注意力网络(augmented GAT)作为原生多标签分类器预测;叶类由DL或ILP规则中验证F1较高者预测(平局时偏向ILP规则,再以宏F1作为打破平局的依据)。
2.ILP系统:使用Popper(支持噪声、采用"learning from failures"范式),引入三种参数化代价函数ILP-FN(α=3,β=1,偏重召回)、ILP-FP(α=1,β=3,偏重精度)、ILP-REG(α=β=1),生成更广泛的假设。
3.分子表征:将分子转化为逻辑程序,使用原子、键、电荷、氢原子数、CIP立体编码、类固醇位置等谓词。
4.负样本采样:基于ChEBI层级结构进行广度优先搜索,优先选择兄弟类样本。
5.可解释性:全局解释通过算法翻译将ILP规则转为自然语言并与ChEBI类名整合;局部解释使用xclingo追踪变量-原子绑定,高亮相关原子并关联分子图。

Result: 1.ILP规则分析:在825个叶类中,ILP-FN生成666条规则(最可靠),ILP-REG生成636条,ILP-FP生成520条;ILP-FN宏F1为0.680,ILP-REG为0.681,ILP-FP为0.640。
2.集成性能:在ChEBI25-3STAR数据集(1808个标签,825个叶类,51,670样本)上,HyDI集成的微F1为0.914,宏F1为0.731,DL基线分别为0.920和0.737,性能仅下降0.6%。
3.规则选择:314个叶类被ILP规则替代(260来自ILP-FN,30来自ILP-FP,24来自ILP-REG);ILP-FP在51个类上优于其他配置。
4.失败案例:ILP-REG子集存在显著泛化差距;非结构化类(如bioconjugate)及需精确计数的类(如diterpene)难以被当前ILP设置捕获。

Conclusion: HyDI通过在叶类中以ILP规则替代DL预测,实现了层次化多标签分类的可解释性增强,仅带来极小的性能损失(宏F1降0.6%)。该方法在化学领域展示了神经-符号集成的实用价值。未来研究方向包括:引入预定义功能基团和环结构、谓词发明与否定、与人类专家迭代优化规则等。

Abstract: While attaining remarkable results for many applications, Deep Learning models are notoriously difficult to explain. This work introduces HyDI, a hybrid ensemble architecture for hierarchical multi-label classification. It combines a Deep Learning (DL) model with rule-based classifiers generated by Inductive Logic Programming (ILP). For leaf classes of the label hierarchy, the rule-based classifiers replace the DL model, leading to more transparent classification results. HyDI is applied to the Chemical Entities of Biological Interest (ChEBI) ontology, providing ILP-generated rules for 314 classes. For these classes, HyDI can generate global explanations as well as local explanations that combine visual and text-based descriptions.

</details>


### [715] [Optimizer-dependent training dynamics converge to the same one-third optimal data scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37745)
*Hyunseok Lee,Mihir Basil,Yizhou Liu,Jeff Gore*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在一个在线教师-学生模型中证明：神经缩放的训练动态指数（随训练步数的幂律衰减率）依赖于优化器的选择，但最优数据缩放指数（即在最优超参数下损失随数据集大小D的衰减率）在所有优化器上均收敛到1/3。其核心发现是一条动力学指数求和规则 $2\alpha_r + \alpha_t = 1$，其中径向指数 $\alpha_r$（控制权重范数增长）和切向指数 $\alpha_t$（控制与教师方向的对齐）均由优化器决定，但该规则约束了二者，使得调优后的最优损失始终遵循 $D^{-1/3}$。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有理论（如 Liu et al., 2026b; Kühn et al., 2026）预测了在学习尖锐分布时出现 1/3 缩放指数，但这些工作仅适用于 SGD 或梯度流。实际的大语言模型训练使用 Adam、Muon 等自适应优化器，这些优化器在不同训练批次大小和预算下的最优超参数缩放规律各异。本文旨在探究：神经缩放的哪些部分由优化器决定，哪些部分与优化器无关？即优化器改变了模型"每步学多快"还是"每样本能学多少"？

Method: 1. 玩具模型：单层 softmax 教师-学生网络（n=128 类，m=32 维输入），在线训练，使用独热标签；2. 损失分解：将交叉熵损失分解为径向分量 $L_r$（softmax 饱和度/权重范数控制）和切向分量 $L_t$（与教师方向的对齐误差），并对每个分量拟合幂律指数 $\alpha_r$ 和 $\alpha_t$；3. 随机动力学分析：将切向位移建模为 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 过程，利用 Lyapunov 方程的迹恒等式得到切向损失；4. 七个优化器测试：SGD、PowerAdam（a=0.125, 0.25, 0.375, 0.5/即Adam）、Muon、SignGD；5. 参数扫描：8 种批次大小 × 16 种学习率，通过二次插值定位最优学习率，并在 log-log 空间拟合超参数标度律。

Result: 1. 损失分解：SGD 下 $\alpha_r = 0.35 \pm 0.01$，$\alpha_t = 0.33 \pm 0.02$；Adam 下二者分离，$\alpha_r = 0.48 \pm 0.03$，$\alpha_t = 0.08 \pm 0.01$；2. 动态指数关系：七个优化器的 $(\alpha_r, \alpha_t)$ 均落在求和规则 $2\alpha_r + \alpha_t = 1$ 上；3. 最优学习率标度：SGD 下 $\eta^* \propto D^{-0.04}$（近似与数据无关），Adam 下 $\eta^* \propto D^{-0.35}$；批次大小标度：SGD 下 $s_B = 1.01$，Adam 下 $s_B = 0.76$；4. 最优数据缩放指数：七个优化器中六个的 $\alpha_D$ 在 1/3 的 2.5% 以内（SGD 和 Adam 均测得 $0.341 \pm 0.003$），散度仅 0.004；5. 损失比诊断：$L_t/L = 1/3$ 作为最优超参数的判据，无需扫描即可定位。

Conclusion: 神经缩放呈现出与统计力学中普适类相似的结构：不同优化器产生显著不同的训练动力学指数，但所有优化器都受同一求和规则 $2\alpha_r + \alpha_t = 1$ 约束，这迫使调优后的损失按 $D^{-1/3}$ 缩放。优化器决定了模型每步学习的速度（径向与切向通道间的权衡），但不改变每样本所能获得的信息量（数据缩放指数）。要突破 1/3 的渐近极限，需改变问题本身——例如通过边界附近样本密度的消失（margin 密度 $\nu > 0$），此时求和规则变为 $\frac{2}{\nu+1}\alpha_r + \alpha_t = 1$，最优指数加速至 $(\nu+1)/(\nu+3)$，但仍与优化器无关。

Abstract: Neural scaling, in which loss falls as a power law with training, is central to large language models, and one recent proposal is that a $1/3$ exponent emerges from learning peaked distributions. That account describes SGD, but models in practice are trained with adaptive optimizers. Here we separate two exponents the $1/3$ account does not distinguish: how fast the loss falls with training steps along a single run, and how fast the optimally tuned loss falls with dataset size $D$. We show that the first, a dynamic exponent, is optimizer-specific while the second, an optimal data exponent, converges to $1/3$ across optimizers. In an online teacher-student model we decompose the loss into norm growth (radial) and alignment toward the teacher direction (tangential), each decaying as a power law with dynamic exponents $\alpha_{r}$ and $\alpha_{t}$. Under SGD, both are close to $1/3$, so the data exponent is also $1/3$ across different learning rates. Under Adam the two separate: $\alpha_{r} \simeq 0.48$ but $\alpha_{t} \simeq 0.08$. Since the total loss is minimized when these two parts are balanced, the optimal learning rate is optimizer-dependent: $D$-independent for SGD but falls with $D$ for Adam. Yet tuned to that optimum, the loss returns to $D^{-1/3}$ for both. A stochastic-dynamics analysis explains why: the optimizers can trade decay speed between the two channels, but they all fall on a single dynamic exponent relation, $2\alpha_{r}+ \alpha_{t} = 1$, which fixes the optimal data exponent at $1/3$. Across seven optimizers, including Muon, the measured exponents are consistent with this relation, and the optimal-loss envelopes agree with $D^{-1/3}$ across them. The optimizer sets how fast a model learns per step; tuned optimally, it changes the prefactor but not the rate at which loss falls per sample.

</details>


### [716] [Feedback-Calibrated Protein Optimization with Batch-Aligned Tail Arbitration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37808)
*Zefeng Lin,Xianyong Fang,Tianfan Fu,Xiaohua Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BATA（Batch-Aligned Tail Arbitration），一种基于实验反馈动态校准先验informed与task-specific预测器混合权重的蛋白质序列优化方法，通过在batch-aligned的高适应度区域进行DCG加权秩校准，在GB1、PABP、TrpB三个蛋白质适应度景观上实现了最优的平均任务排名（1.67）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有蛋白质优化方法（主动学习、贝叶斯优化、先验引导、排序感知方法）依赖预测证据指导下一批实验，但无法适应预测证据可靠性随测量积累的变化，也无法确保对关键高适应度候选的正确排序。具体而言：(1) 实验测量少时，任务特定预测器训练数据有限且不可靠，需要生物学先验补充；(2) 随测量增加，两种预测证据的相对贡献应动态变化；(3) 全局准确预测不等于批次关键高适应度候选的正确排序。

Method: BATA包含三个核心组件：(1) 同时保留先验informed预测器（基于DCA特征的Ridge集成）和任务特定预测器，将预测转换为百分位秩以统一比较尺度；(2) 通过5折out-of-fold (OOF)预测评估各预测器的当前效用，从已测量适应度学习混合权重w∈[0,1]，每批次后更新；(3) 校准集中在高适应度区域，使用与下一批大小匹配的秩截断kt=min(B,nt)，并采用对数折扣累积增益（DCG）加权q_i=1/log2(p_i+1)，赋予排名靠前的变体更大权重。目标函数L_BATA(w)为加权平方误差，具有闭式解w*_t=Π[0,1](Σq_i·d_i·z_i / Σq_i·d_i²)，其中d_i=r^p_i-r^a_i，z_i=r^y_i-r^a_i。算法流程为：每轮生成OOF预测→计算秩和权重→求解闭式混合权重→在全测量上重拟合→对未测量池计算加权组合得分→选择下一批。BATA证明了两个性质：(P1) 优化秩损失的闭式最优性；(P2) 对预测器分数的单调变换具有尺度不变性。

Result: 在GB1、PABP、TrpB三个Main-35匹配初始化（35个/任务，共525次实验）上，BATA取得最低平均Final@480任务排名1.67和最低平均Query-AUC排名2.00。BATA在PABP和TrpB上获得最高平均Final@480，ALDE在GB1领先。混合权重随测量积累动态下降：GB1从0.466降至0.089（35次中33次下降），TrpB从0.518降至0.163（34次下降），PABP从0.460降至0.403（变化方向不一）。校准目标消融（24组/任务×4目标=288次）：T-DCG-96（batch-aligned cutoff+DCG权重）取得最低平均任务排名1.33，显著优于G-Rank（3.33）、T-Uniform-96（3.00）、T-DCG-192（2.33）。在TrpB上，20成员纯任务特定集成（Fine-only M20）以0.9388 vs 0.9181优于BATA（paired差0.0207，95% CI [0.0045, 0.0364]），但在GB1/PABP/HIS7/GRB2上BATA更优或相当。G20切换规则（先验权重<0.20时切换到Fine-only M20）在独立确认中（10个初始化/任务）取得最低平均排名1.40（vs BATA 1.40并列，Fine-only 2.40）。

Conclusion: BATA将实验反馈的角色从"更新预测器"扩展为"仲裁互补预测证据"，通过反馈校准动态调整先验informed与任务特定预测器的混合权重，并在batch-aligned的高适应度区域进行校准。在三个真实蛋白质适应度景观上验证了反馈校准的有效性，但发现存在任务依赖性增益：当任务特定预测器足够强时（如TrpB上的20成员集成），纯任务特定预测可能更优。提出G20切换规则作为实用补救方案。该工作开辟了反馈校准蛋白质优化的新方向，但仍受限于依赖预测器质量、对实验室约束和测量噪声处理不足、计算成本含重复拟合开销。

Abstract: Protein optimization aims to discover high-fitness sequences under a limited experimental budget. Existing machine-learning methods use task-specific predictors, biological priors, or ranking-aware objectives to guide which variants are tested in the next experimental round. However, these methods cannot adapt to shifts in the reliability of predictive evidence as measurements accumulate and ensure the correct ranking of key high-fitness candidates. To address these challenges, we propose Batch-Aligned Tail Arbitration (BATA), which uses experimental feedback to adaptively combine prior-informed and task-specific rankings for next-batch selection, with calibration focused on the batch-aligned high-fitness region. Across measured GB1, PABP, and TrpB landscapes, BATA achieves the best mean task rank (1.67) in final best fitness after 480 measurements. Controlled comparisons further show task-dependent gains from high-fitness calibration and batch alignment. Our work introduces feedback-calibrated predictor arbitration, where experimental feedback dynamically determines how predictive evidence guides next-batch selection, opening a new direction for protein optimization.

</details>


### [717] [Behavioral Convergence Without Representational Convergence: Persistent Training-History Dependence in Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37836)
*Ertuğrul Mutlu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过配对"共同松弛"实验协议证明：神经网络即使在行为（预测精度）上趋同，其内部表征仍可能保留可测量的训练历史痕迹，即行为收敛不蕴含表征收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络通常以外部行为（如精度）作为等价判据，但优化是序列过程，最终解可能依赖到达路径。研究者旨在回答：在初始权重相同、最终训练分布相同、仅前序任务顺序相反的条件下，两网络行为匹配后其内部表征是否也会收敛？此问题被灾难性遗忘等混杂因素干扰，故需精心控制协议。

Method: 采用"共同松弛"协议：配对卷积网络从相同权重初始化，分别经历反向任务序列 S_{ABC}:A→B→C 与 S_{BAC}:B→A→C，然后在确定性公共分布 C 上以相同优化器设置共同训练。核心指标为表征历史分数 H_repr = 1 − (CKA_{conv2} + CKA_{fc1})/2。设置四组实验：(i) 20 对 MNIST 类分割主实验；(ii) 5 对种子扩展至 50,000 次更新的长视野压力测试；(iii) 冻结 FC1 特征的线性探针测试；(iv) 匹配学习率下的 ReLU/LeakyReLU 机制对照以及同标签旋转 MNIST 对照。

Result: 20 对种子中 16 对满足行为匹配准则，但匹配端点的 H_repr 均值仍为 0.139（95% CI [0.127, 0.153]），预测不一致约 3.1%；将共同松弛延至 50,000 次更新后 H_repr 仍达 0.190（CI [0.161, 0.219]），而精度差距仅 0.18 个百分点；500 样本/类的线性探针下两表征的类别信息可访问性实际等价（TOST 等价检验通过）；旋转 MNIST 对照 5/5 全行为匹配但 H_repr 均值 0.162；匹配 LR=0.04 下 LeakyReLU 在 5 对种子中均降低 50k 更新残差（ΔH_repr=−0.040，CI [−0.077, −0.018]，d_z=−0.97）。

Conclusion: 在受控协议与有限优化视野下，神经网络可呈现行为收敛而表征不收敛的"持续训练历史依赖"现象，与直观上的磁滞相关但不等同。该现象不能简单归因于类分割灾难性遗忘（同标签旋转 MNIST 中亦存在），且在机制上与激活介导的可塑性受限（ReLU 零梯度区）方向一致。作者明确将结果限定为协议范围内、有限视野下的存在性证据，不主张通用永久性或更强的循环磁滞结构。

Abstract: Neural networks trained toward the same final objective can reach similar predictive performance while retaining internal representations shaped by earlier training history. We study this effect using controlled sequential-training experiments in which paired convolutional networks start from identical weights, experience reversed task orders, and then receive the same deterministic common-relaxation distribution. Across 20 paired MNIST runs, 16 satisfy a predeclared behavioral-matching criterion, yet their matched representations retain a mean history score of 0.139 (95% bootstrap CI: 0.127-0.153) and approximately 3.1% prediction disagreement. Extending common relaxation to 50,000 optimizer updates does not erase the measured difference: across five paired seeds, the representation-history score remains 0.190 (95% bootstrap CI: 0.161-0.219) at the end of the measured horizon while the mean accuracy gap is only 0.18 percentage points. Fresh linear probes show that, with sufficient labeled data, the two histories retain practically equivalent linearly accessible class information. A same-label rotated-MNIST control reproduces the effect: all five paired seeds reach behavioral matching while retaining a mean representation-history score of 0.162. Finally, a matched-learning-rate ReLU-LeakyReLU control reduces the 50,000-update representation residue by 0.040 on average in all five paired seeds, providing directional evidence that activation-mediated plasticity contributes to the persistence of training-history effects. These results provide protocol-scoped evidence that behavioral convergence need not imply representational convergence and that optimization history can leave measurable internal traces after prolonged common training.

</details>


### [718] [Counterfactual Probing for Parallel Unmasking with Hidden Forest Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37841)
*Ryotaro Kawata,Satoshi Hayakawa,Taiji Suzuki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究掩码生成模型中并行去掩码（parallel unmasking）的总评估开销问题，针对具有隐藏森林结构的离散分布，提出了一种基于"反事实探测"（counterfactual probing）的采样器，证明了在固定精度下总提交次数和顺序深度均可达到关于序列长度 N 的次线性界（sublinear），并给出了匹配的下界证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码生成模型（如离散扩散模型）虽然支持并行预测多个token，但若不知道token间的依赖关系而盲目并行采样，会忽略依赖导致错误；而逐一揭示token虽然精确但需N次串行评估。因此核心问题是：能否在发现依赖结构的同时，以 o(N) 的总模型评估次数实现固定精度的准确采样？现有方法未能建立包含发现开销的次线性总评估保证。

Method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 共享反事实探测——在固定已提交状态不变的前提下，通过假想性地填充源位置i的不同token值，并比较掩码读出位置j的条件分布变化来检测边(i,j)的存在；多个这样的测试可被"打包"到同一次oracle提交中共享评估开销。(2) 随机着色筛选——使用独立均匀随机着色将位置分组，通过多数投票认证低度邻域是否被正确恢复。(3) 声明式剥离与质心提交——对高度核心进行单点剥离（singleton peeling），最终通过质心提交实现并行采样。整个过程无需完全恢复隐藏森林结构。关键假设包括：森林因子化分解(RT/UEN/RF正则性条件)、词汇量多项式增长(V=N^ν)、边响应下界ω≍(ε²/N)^{1/3}、以及冻结oracle的均匀Hellinger/KL误差界。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1) 上界（定理3.1）：对任意固定精度ε∈(0,1/8]和充分大的N，采样器A_pack的种子平均TV风险≤ε，反事实提交次数Q_cf = Õ(d²(N/ε²)^{1/(3s)})，提交轮数和深度R,D = Õ(N/d)，其中s>1为秩-频率指数。选取d = ⌈(Nω^{1/s})^{1/3}⌉可得平衡界1+Q_cf+R, D = Õ(N^{2/3+1/(9s)}/ε^{2/(9s)}) = o(N)。(2) 下界（定理3.2）：任何满足相同精度要求的不可逆乘积提交采样器，在最坏情况下需要Ω((N/ε²)^{1/(3s)})次反事实提交或Ω(N^{1/3}ε^{1/3})轮提交。(3) 有限规模实验（N=8192至16384）：在四种隐藏森林族上验证了总提交次数与次线性扩展的一致性。

Conclusion: 论文在隐藏森林结构和均匀oracle精度的假设下，确立了并行去掩码的次线性总评估界，证明了包含依赖发现成本在内的总开销可以达到o(N)。共享反事实探测策略无需完全恢复隐藏森林即可识别安全并行批次，可调参数d在探测成本与不可逆提交轮数之间进行权衡。下界表明该上界在多项式因子意义下是紧的。开放方向包括：缩小探测-提交权衡的间隙、理解重掩码在重采样成本下的影响、以及将保证扩展到森林以外的图结构。

Abstract: Masked generative models offer parallel token prediction, but accurate parallel sampling must account for dependencies among tokens. When dependencies are unknown, finding safe batches also costs model evaluations. We study whether total evaluations, including discovery, can be sublinear in sequence length $N$; sublinear sequential depth then follows. We consider discrete distributions with hidden forest structure, accessed through a fixed approximate conditional oracle. Under explicit regularity conditions and uniform Hellinger error bounds, for any fixed target accuracy $\varepsilon\in (0,1/8]$ and sufficiently large $N$, our sampler achieves seed-averaged total-variation error at most $\varepsilon$, with total masked-state submissions and sequential depth both bounded by $O(N^C \varepsilon^a)$ for constants $0 <C <1$ and $a > 0$. These guarantees use polynomial vocabulary size and an edge-response lower bound set by $N$ and $\varepsilon$. The sampler shares evaluations of hypothetical reveals across dependence tests to identify safe parallel batches without requiring full recovery of the hidden forest. A tunable parameter trades probing cost against irreversible commit rounds. In the same class, any admissible irreversible product-commit sampler attaining the same seed-averaged accuracy requires $\Omega(N^c \varepsilon^b)$ counterfactual submissions or commit rounds in the worst case, for constants $c,b>0$.

</details>


### [719] [Delta-Matching: Closing the Final Gap of Native 8-bit Training for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37852)
*Haozhan Tang,Hao Kang,Han Cai,Song Han,Chenyan Xiong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Delta-Matching 方法，识别并解决了 FP8 注意力训练中的"陈旧 delta"数值不一致问题，在多个架构和规模上恢复了与 BF16/FP32 混合精度训练相当的性能，是迈向完全原生 8 位 LLM 训练的关键一步。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管 FP8 在矩阵乘法中速度约为 BF16 的两倍，但现有系统为保证数值稳定性的注意力核保留了更高精度。FP8 注意力训练中，前向和后向操作数的分别舍入会违反 softmax 梯度行和为零的不变性，产生"陈旧 delta"，导致训练动态失真和性能退化，尤其在大模型和长训练中表现明显。

Method: 作者首先从理论上推导出陈旧 delta 如何违反 softmax 反向传播的行和不变式；然后提出 Delta-Matching，使用未量化的 FP32 概率和 FP32 精度下的 FP8 后向操作数乘积构造匹配项 δᵢᵐᵃᵗᶜʰᵉᵈ，以精确恢复不变性；该方法无需架构修改、减小全局批量或额外的前向输出。

Result: 在 GDN/GQA、KDA/GQA、GDN/MLA 等混合模型以及 569M、1.67B、5.29B 三种规模上，Delta-Matching 在训练损失和下游任务表现上均与 BF16/FP32 混合精度参考相当；朴素 FP8（陈旧 delta）在 1.67B 和 5.29B 上出现显著损失上升和下游性能退化；QK 归一化、无位置编码（NoPE）和更大头维度等缓解手段无法根除该问题；Delta-Matching 还可在所有七个注意力核矩阵乘法以及 FFN 中使用原生分块缩放 FP8。

Conclusion: 前向-后向数值一致性是 8 位训练可靠性的核心；Delta-Matching 是一种实用方案，可实现完全原生的 8 位 LLM 训练，是未来高效 LLM 训练基础设施的重要组成部分。作者将开源实现、训练好的模型和数据配方。

Abstract: Reliable FP8 attention remains a barrier to fully native 8-bit large language model training. We derive how forward-backward inconsistencies produce stale delta and empirically show how it distorts training dynamics. Our stale-delta hybrid runs show a modest loss gap at 569M parameters but substantial loss increases and downstream degradation at 1.67B and 5.29B. QK normalization, NoPE (no positional encoding), and lower-learning-rate context extension mitigate or delay degradation without eliminating it. This pattern suggests accumulated optimization error that smaller models and short runs can conceal. We propose Delta-Matching, proving that it restores the softmax gradient's zero-row-sum invariant under the stated numerical assumptions. It enables native block-scaled FP8 in every forward and backward attention-core matmul without architectural changes, smaller global batches, or auxiliary forward outputs. Across tested architectures, scales, and training stages, Delta-Matching matches BF16/FP32 mixed-precision training loss and overall downstream performance. We will release our implementation, trained models, and data recipes.

</details>


### [720] [Storage Is Not Strategy: State-Conditioned Support Control for LLM Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37858)
*Tianhao Qian,Ziming Hong,Chongyang Gao,Kezhen Chen,Lixu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM局部遗忘(Localized Unlearning)中"定位即策略"的隐含前提进行批判，指出存储定位准确性高的参数未必是最佳干预点，并提出两个方法：Intervention Score（基于一阶效应的目标条件初始参数选择）和Selective DIR-R（基于校准探针的检查点依赖支持修订）。在Natural-TOFU、LACUNA等基准上的实验表明方法在多数设置下取得正边际，但GradDiff目标表现出显著的场依赖性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM局部遗忘方法存在两个隐含假设：(1)将定位信号直接当作干预选择依据；(2)优化过程中固定所选参数子集。然而定位准确性与干预有效性并不等价，且最佳干预点会随优化过程动态变化。作者旨在将这两个被混淆的决策分开研究。

Method: 核心方法包含两部分：(1) Intervention Score——利用四个诊断角色（遗忘F、保留R、受保护行为P、中性行为N）的一阶梯度效应定义评分函数 s_int(g) = (e_{g,F} − max{e_{g,R}, e_{g,P}, 0}) / (|e_{g,N}| + ε)，按此排序选择初始支持S₀；(2) Selective DIR-R——在检查点𝒞_t处先用短探针（d步）评估一个候选动作ρ_p，仅当探针信号超过校准阈值τ*时才触发完整候选族的穷举比较；候选族为固定集合 𝔸 = {0, 0.01, 0.025, 0.05, 0.10}，通过等预算替换实现。Static-IV是固定S₀不修订的消融基线。

Result: 受控实验中，存储定位AUROC达0.981但仅在17/36目标上与最佳干预一致，LoRA胜出35/36。Natural-TOFU上与10个基线比较的20组中有19组为正边际。LACUNA上NPO边际+0.431至+0.848，SimNPO边际+0.503至+0.571。DIR-R相对Static-IV在六个评估集上均为正平均差，主四场GradDiff评估+0.165（6胜6平0负），计算开销约1.45×远低于16×穷举参考。但GradDiff目标存在显著场依赖性（Birth City场所有外部方法均优），且三场敏感性结果在复制实验中不稳定。

Conclusion: 研究支持将LLM局部遗忘的"定位"、"初始干预选择"和"检查点依赖修订"三件事分开作为独立设计评估问题。证据表明：定位准确性不等同于干预有效性；初始干预选择应基于目标条件而非定位信号；DIR-R通过选择性触发实现了远低于穷举开销的可用增益捕获，但未宣称全局最优或跨设置统一优越。GradDiff的场异质性表明外部方法排序不稳定，需在更广泛攻击和实测计算约束下进一步验证。

Abstract: Many localized large language model (LLM) unlearning methods select a small parameter subset from a localization signal and keep it fixed during optimization. The parameters most associated with a target, however, need not be the best ones to update, and candidate interventions can change value as optimization proceeds. In a controlled experiment, a storage-localization score reaches an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.981, yet storage identity agrees with the better intervention on only 17/36 targets, while low-rank adaptation (LoRA) wins 35/36. We introduce Intervention Score, which ranks editable groups by the predicted effect of the actual unlearning update while accounting for collateral damage, and use it to form the static intervention-value baseline (Static-IV). We then introduce selective dynamic intervention re-ranking (DIR-R), which revisits that subset only when a calibrated probe justifies the comparison. On the Natural-TOFU dataset, our method has positive descriptive margins in 19/20 comparisons between methods and objectives, although several are near zero. On the LACUNA localization-precision benchmark, our mean terminal utility is higher in all six negative preference optimization (NPO) and SimNPO comparisons: NPO margins range from +0.431 to +0.848, and SimNPO margins range from +0.503 to +0.571. The gradient-difference (GradDiff) objective reveals substantial field dependence. Relative to Static-IV, the primary four-field GradDiff evaluation has six wins, six ties, and no losses, with mean and median paired gains of +0.165 and +0.0025. The evidence supports separating localization, initial intervention selection, and checkpoint-dependent support revision.

</details>


### [721] [Strict-Saddle Landscapes and Multi-Rank Geometry in Low-Tubal-Rank Tensor Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37865)
*Eugene Agyei-Kodie,Longxiu Huang,Shuang Li,Xiao Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了低管秩（low-tubal-rank）张量感知中平衡分解（balanced factorization）的优化景观。在管秩限制等距条件（t-RIP）下，针对任意Fourier多秩（multi-rank）剖面，建立了无伪局部极小值的严格鞍点（strict-saddle）景观；并进一步揭示局部几何由Fourier切片秩而非单纯的管秩决定：均匀秩产生横截解轨道的二次增长，非均匀秩即使因子宽度等于精确管秩仍会因频率方向上的隐式过参数化而产生四次平坦方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低秩矩阵感知已建立良好的非凸优化景观理论，但张量情形（尤其是基于t-积的低管秩模型）因Fourier切片间的耦合而无法直接推广。此外，管秩仅记录最大Fourier切片秩，不刻画完整的多秩剖面，导致即使因子宽度等于精确管秩，在某些频率上仍可能存在过参数化，这种"隐式过参数化"对局部几何的影响尚未被研究清楚。

Method: 1) 通过t-积和离散Fourier变换定义平衡分解目标函数：f(U,V) = ½‖M(U*V* - X*)‖² + (1/8)‖U*U - V*V‖²_F；2) 在(2r, δ)-t-RIP（δ<1/5）假设下，利用对称提升（symmetric lifting）方法建立Procrustes对齐估计和Hessian曲率分析；3) 通过沿对齐误差方向的负曲率证明全局严格鞍点性质；4) 构造均匀秩下Hessian核恰好等于t-正交对称切空间的精确刻画；5) 对非均匀秩情形，构造沿"非活跃坐标"方向的显式四次平坦扰动，证明局部四次增长和三次梯度增长，并给出邻近半径的ϵ^{1/3}下界。

Result: 1) 定理4：所有局部极小值全局最优，所有非全局临界点为严格鞍点，定量严格鞍点参数：ζ=(64rϵ/(1-5δ))^{1/3}, γ=((1-5δ)ϵ²/r)^{1/3}；2) 定理7(i)：均匀多秩ρ_k=r时，Hessian核恰好等于t-正交切空间，二次增长成立，且得到线性邻近半径O(ϵ)；3) 定理7(ii)：存在某个ρ_k₀<r时，存在正交于解轨道的法方向使f沿该方向呈四次增长、梯度三次增长，局部PŁ不等式失败，邻近半径最优阶为O(ϵ^{1/3})；4) 数值实验验证了合成张量中二次与四次增长的对比，并利用真实OCT数据演示了从随机初始化恢复的性能。

Conclusion: 本文证明了低管秩张量感知的优化景观在t-RIP下具有与矩阵情形类似的良性全局结构（无伪局部极小、严格鞍点）。然而局部几何由Fourier多秩剖面而非管秩单独决定：均匀秩情形复现矩阵式的二次非退化行为；非均匀秩情形即使因子宽度等于精确管秩，仍在频率方向上隐式过参数化，产生四次平坦方向和三次梯度增长，导致任何固定负曲率阈值下ϵ^{1/3}阶的邻近半径不可改进。未来工作可推广至含噪测量和近似低管秩模型。

Abstract: We study the optimization landscape of low-tubal-rank tensor sensing through a balanced factorization. Under a tubal restricted isometry condition, we establish a quantitative strict-saddle landscape with no spurious local minima for arbitrary Fourier multi-rank profiles. We further show that the local geometry depends on the Fourier-slice ranks rather than the tubal rank alone. Uniform ranks yield quadratic growth transverse to the solution orbit, whereas nonuniform ranks produce quartically flat directions through hidden frequency-wise overparameterization, even when the factor width equals the exact tubal rank. Numerical experiments illustrate the global optimization behavior and the contrasting local geometries.

</details>


### [722] [TopoEmbedX: A General Framework for Representation Learning on Topological Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37884)
*Florian Frantzen,Ibrahem AlJabea,Ines Henriques-Cadby,Theodore Papamarkou,Mustafa Hajij,Michael T. Schaub*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TopoEmbedX是一个开源Python框架,将单纯复形、超图、细胞复形和组合复形(CC)等高阶拓扑域映射到欧几里得空间以学习嵌入。该框架通过"增广Hasse图"将高阶表示学习归约为图表示学习,并整合了10种算法(5种现有+5种新提出),支持边分类与边回归等下游任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的拓扑表示学习方法主要局限于图结构,缺乏能够系统化嵌入任意拓扑域(涵盖所有维度层级)的通用工具。TopoEmbedX旨在填补这一空白,通过统一的框架将经典图嵌入技术扩展到高阶拓扑结构。

Method: 核心方法是将拓扑域通过"增广Hasse图"转化为图结构:Hasse图编码拓扑域的包含关系(覆盖关系),增广Hasse图在此基础上添加由邻域函数(如邻接、共邻接、关联关系)诱导的额外边。所有单元(细胞)作为节点出现于该图中,随后应用标准图嵌入算法即可得到多维度单元的联合嵌入。具体实现包含10种算法:Cell2Vec(Node2Vec扩展)、DeepCell(DeepWalk扩展)、CellDiff2Vec(Diff2Vec扩展)、HOLE/HOGLEE(拉普拉斯特征映射扩展),以及新提出的ComplexNetMF(NetMF扩展)、ComplexRep(GraRep扩展)、ComplexRandNE(RandNE扩展)、ComplexWalklets(Walklets扩展)、ComplexHeat(热核嵌入扩展)。

Result: 在7个AHORN数据集上的边分类和1个数据集上的边回归实验中,多个拓扑嵌入算法显著优于基线:ComplexWalklets在algebra-questions、MAG-10和music-blues-reviews上表现最佳;ComplexHeat在geometry-questions和madison-restaurant-reviews上最强;ComplexNetMF在vegas-bars-reviews上最优;DeepCell在cooking上领先。边回归任务中,Cell2Vec(MSE=24.07)表现最佳。但实验也表明没有单一算法在所有数据集上占优,基于随机游走、矩阵分解和扩散的方法各有优势,且计算成本仍是重要约束。

Conclusion: TopoEmbedX为拓扑表示学习提供了统一的软件层,使研究者能够在单纯复形、超图、细胞复形和CC上应用、比较和扩展广泛的嵌入算法。增广Hasse图的归约策略灵活且模块化,但未来工作仍需在理论分析、更多基准任务(聚类、链接预测)、系统超参数调优以及任务自适应嵌入技术方面进一步深入。

Abstract: Topological structures such as simplicial complexes, hypergraphs, and cell complexes extend standard graph models by modeling higher-order relationships. These structures appear in many modern datasets and require specialized methods for generating meaningful embeddings. In this paper, we introduce TopoEmbedX, a unified framework for embedding a wide range of topological domains into Euclidean spaces. The package brings together several existing topological embedding algorithms---DeepCell, Cell2Vec, CellDiff2Vec, HOLE, and HOGLEE---and introduces five new algorithms: ComplexNetMF, ComplexRep, ComplexRandNE, ComplexWalklets, and ComplexHeat. These algorithms extend well-known graph embedding techniques to higher-order settings using the augmented Hasse graph of a topological domain. TopoEmbedX provides a clear, consistent, and easy-to-use framework for topological representation learning. Experiments show that the embeddings generated by TopoEmbedX support tasks such as classification and regression across multidimensional data.

</details>


### [723] [Behavioral Capacity Certificates for Quantized Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37887)
*Arian Eamaz,Mojtaba Soltanalian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"行为能力证书"(BCC)，一种基于PAC-Bayes的量化语言模型泛化与稳定性认证框架。BCC按完整实现（权重+激活+缓存规则）共享同一有界损失函数的先验质量总和来计算"行为复杂度"，而非按单一实现的描述长度收费。当量化合并不同实现时，共享质量会降低复杂度惩罚，并给出盈亏平衡定律判定节省是否覆盖验证成本。论文通过三步部署工作流（筛选→认证→部署）进行验证：前向筛选器在质量上接近Hessian引导选择但预处理成本更低；边缘认证单元在OLMoE-1B-7B和SmolLM2-1.7B上证明可同时翻转或剪枝数万级输出头坐标而保持预测；BCC对完整解码器提供非空的人口损失边界，比压缩码路径更紧。实验还揭示KV缓存同等内存下"键精度高于值"的分配偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统直接权重码复杂度边界对相同行为的不同部署收取相同复杂度，并对行为相同的权重码重复收费。量化语言模型中，激活精度、KV缓存精度、缩放与裁剪规则均会改变计算函数但保持存储权重不变，仅靠权重码长度无法准确反映部署行为的复杂度代价。

Method: 核心方法包括：(1) 定义完整实现集合ε上的"行为纤维"F(g)=Π⁻¹(g)，并定义行为质量ν̄(g)=Σ_{e∈F(g)}ν(e)与行为复杂度K_{W,A}(g)=-ln ν̄(g)；(2) 主定理2.1给出行为Occam-KL证书：R₀(g)≤kl⁻¹₊(R̂₀(g), (K_{W,A}(g)+ln(1/δ))/m)；(3) 定理2.4处理构造样本单元到部署实现的独立探针迁移；(4) 命题2.5/推论2.6给出"盈亏平衡定律"，精确判定行为商何时胜过直接编码；(5) 命题4.1通过预测边缘预算构建可认证坐标单元，支持同时符号翻转与剪枝；(6) 命题2.3在固定路由MoE中给出精确纤维分解；(7) 前向筛选器BFMS基于扰动保留率对候选层位宽排序。

Result: 主要实验结果：(a) 三层完整解码器NLL界BCC比压缩码紧2.13-4.91%；(b) W/A/K/V格式族在256个前缀上保留4-token延续时获得4.17-4.86比特条件复杂度节省；(c) GPT-2上16-token预填1,008-token时，K8/V4比K4/V8在NLL、预测一致性和认证比特上均更优(+187.93比特)；(d) OLMoE-1B-7B在K8/V8与K8/V4上27,550个输出头坐标可同时翻转，8,192前缀上预测不一致率上界0.217%/0.260%；(e) SmolLM2-1.7B上21,874坐标同时翻转，K8/V8下0/8192失败，K8/V4下7/8192失败；(f) 1%延续不一致上限下BCC支持32,768坐标共享认证，比激活代价选择高32×；(g) BFMS前向筛选耗时3.40-6.15秒 vs Hessian 17.58-34.13秒，质量相当；(h) QAT构造单元覆盖率86.0% vs PTQ 3.2%。

Conclusion: BCC通过按"行为"而非单一实现收费，使单一证书覆盖认证纤维内所有实现。三步部署工作流（廉价筛选→认证保留行为的变化→约束最终部署的人口损失）得到完整验证。论文给出了盈亏平衡探针预算、非空完整解码器界、可同时操作的权重编辑家族，以及KV缓存中"键优先于值"的工程指导。局限在于密集模型的逐层分解不成立（除非路由固定），构造单元需独立探针迁移代价，未来需在更大MoE与超大规模模型上扩展。

Abstract: Activation and key-value cache precision change what a quantized language model computes without altering its stored weights. Direct weight-code bounds, however, assign identical complexity to deployments that behave differently and charge separately for weight codes that behave identically. Behavioral Capacity Certificates (BCC) charge for behavior using the aggregate prior mass of complete implementations---weights, scales, activation and cache rules---that induce the same bounded loss. When quantization merges implementations, this shared mass lowers the complexity penalty, and a break-even law determines when the saving survives the cost of validating it. BCC supports a three-step deployment workflow, and our experiments verify each step. First, a forward-only screen shortlists per-layer bit-widths by how often candidate perturbations preserve the reference predictions, with quality comparable to Hessian-guided selection at lower preprocessing cost. Second, margin-certified cells identify weights that can be pruned or sign-flipped without changing the deployed behavior: every permitted combination preserves all declared predictions, and on OLMoE-1B-7B and SmolLM2-1.7B, independent probes bound the probability that any permitted combination changes a prediction on new text. Third, BCC bounds the population loss of the deployed model, nonvacuously for complete decoders and more tightly than the compressed-code route. At equal cache memory, giving keys higher precision than values yields lower NLL and higher prediction agreement on GPT-2, Qwen2.5, and SmolLM2, together with a tighter complexity bound in the GPT-2 audit.

</details>


### [724] [Scaling Zero-Order Pretraining through Model Sharding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37899)
*Francois Chaubard,Mykel J. Kochenderfer,Chris Ré*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SOMA（Sharded Optimization Mixture of Assemblies），一种专为零阶优化（ZO）设计的架构。它通过独立训练N个LSTM专家于数据集群上、使用SPSA方法，在不交换梯度或优化器状态的情况下，将相对梯度方差降低至约1/N，从而在相同模型规模下改善训练计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零阶优化（ZO）在前向硬件和非可微损失场景下具有重要价值，但随着模型规模增长，其梯度方差随扰动维度线性增加，限制了大模型训练。现有方法（如EGGROLL）通过低秩结构提高效率，但都受限于扰动维度与方差的关系。需要一种正交方法，使总模型规模增长的同时不扩大每个独立估计的参数块。

Method: 1. 架构：SOMA是N个LSTM专家的集合，每个专家独立训练于一个数据集群，共享冻结的嵌入/解码矩阵E和固定的tf-idf路由器。2. 训练流程：先训练N=1种子模型（1000次更新）学习body和共享head；然后用tf-idf+SVD+球形k均值聚类100B字节FineWeb-Edu语料；每个专家复制种子body并在其集群上独立SPSA训练。3. 优化：使用SPSA（同时扰动随机逼近）配合Adam风格动量，扰动半径ε和学习率从10^-3开始衰减；解码器使用delta-rule精确梯度更新（不反向传播），主体使用SPSA估计。4. 分布式：Fully Sharded Optimization（FSO）每个专家独立GPU；Distributed Data and Perturbation Parallelism（DDPP）分配扰动和批次。

Result: 1. 在8.44M参数和150 GPU小时预算下，SOMA N=2达到1.76测试nats/byte，而单片SPSA为2.00-2.11，EGGROLL为2.21；WikiText-103上分别为2.07、2.25-2.36、2.49。2. 理论证明：独立损失将相对梯度方差降低至约1/N（共享损失的1/N）。SOMA N=256比N=1测得118倍更低的方差，SOMA N=4独立损失降低测试损失0.035 nats/byte。3. 推理优势：SOMA N=256（top-k路由k=4）达到2.36M tokens/s，是SOMA N=8的9.19倍，且测试损失更低（1.68 vs 1.71），但训练计算多59.9倍。4. 在8.44M参数下，sharding对梯度方差的降低效果超过增加n_pert或B。

Conclusion: SOMA在相同总模型规模和训练计算下优于测试的单片ZO基线。独立损失机制是改善学习的核心原因。更深度的sharding（N=256）提供单独的推理优势（更高吞吐量），代价是更大的训练计算量和缺乏跨域联合学习。这些结果支持零阶优化可扩展到更大模型，并激励面向前向硬件和非可微架构的新型训练方法。

Abstract: Zero-order optimization (ZO) trains without backpropagation, making it relevant to forward-only hardware and non-differentiable loss, but its gradient variance grows with perturbed dimension, inhibiting large-model training. Sharded Optimization Mixture of Assemblies (SOMA) trains LSTM experts independently on $N$ data clusters using simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation (SPSA), without exchanging gradients, activations or optimizer state. Its separable loss removes cross-expert perturbation noise at the cost of jointly learned representations across domains. Using 80,000 estimated RTX 5090 GPU-hours, we show modest sharding improves training compute efficiency over all tested monolithic ZO controls. At 8.44M parameters and 150 aggregate GPU-hours, SOMA $N=2$ with 64 perturbations reaches 1.76 test nats/byte, versus 2.00--2.11 for monolithic SPSA at 64, 256 or 1,024 perturbations and 2.21 for EGGROLL. On WikiText-103, these frozen checkpoints reach 2.07, 2.25--2.36 and 2.49, respectively. On a fixed separable objective with equal-size blocks, we prove independent losses reduce relative gradient variance to approximately $1/N$ of a shared-loss estimator's. Holding starting weights, data, perturbations and compute fixed, independent rather than summed losses lower SOMA $N=4$ test loss by 0.035 nats/byte after 1,000 updates across three seeds. Larger ensembles offer a separate inference benefit: at similar model size with top-$k$ routing ($k=4$), SOMA $N=256$ achieves 2.36M tokens/s versus 257k for SOMA $N=8$ ($9.19\times$, including routing), at lower test loss (1.68 versus 1.71), albeit using $59.9\times$ as much aggregate training compute. We release all training and evaluation code and checkpoints.

</details>


### [725] [Overcoming Scaling Limits in On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37915)
*Md. Ismail Hossain,Humaira Kousar,Isidora Chara Tourni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文分析了在线策略自蒸馏(OPSD)在大语言模型数学推理训练中随模型规模增大而失效的原因，发现特权教师的优势集中在失败的轨迹上（不可模仿），并提出OASIS方法，将监督限制在经过验证的在线策略轨迹上，用同题未验证的模型生成尝试替代书面解题过程作为教师上下文，仅需最终答案标签即可训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1) OPSD 随模型规模增大收益急剧衰减（1.7B 提升 3.05 点，8B 仅 0.14 点）。2) OPSD 需要昂贵的书面解题过程，限制了其对仅有可验证答案的数据集的适用性。3) 现有工作多从教师侧分析信号，未探究沿学生轨迹在何处施加监督更重要。

Method: 1) 因子分析：将 OPSD 中"scaffold（轨迹位置）"与"context（教师上下文）"两个角色解耦。2) 设计两类离线诊断探针——信号重放测试与截断续写基准。3) 理论分析：证明特权模仿差距下界为条件互信息 I(A;R|Z)，并分析逐项 KL 截断对梯度的反转效应。4) 提出 OASIS：对每题采样 K=8 条轨迹，验证最终答案，选最短已验证轨迹作为 scaffold，另选一条同题未验证轨迹作为教师 context，沿用 OPSD 的前向 KL 目标。

Result: 1) OPSD 中约 70% 的监督落在未验证的失败轨迹上，其教师特权优势在失败前缀上为 +0.40，在已验证前缀上仅 +0.04。2) 随规模从 1.7B 到 4B，特权优势从 +0.40 降至 +0.17，OPSD 增益相应从 3.05 降至 0.14 点（8B）。3) OASIS 在 Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B 上比 OPSD 平均提升 +0.59/+1.86/+3.05 点（AIME24/25、HMMT25 上的 Avg@12），且增益随规模保持稳定（比基线分别高 3.64/3.84/3.19 点）。4) OASIS 监督的 token 数约为 OPSD 的 72%，但因采样 K=8 条轨迹而生成约 16 倍 token；无需任何书面解题过程。5) 消融实验验证最短已验证 scaffold 与 K=8 为较优选择。

Conclusion: OPSD 的特权教师优势恰在最不可模仿的位置（失败轨迹）最大，而在已验证轨迹上几乎可忽略；OPSD 反而将大部分监督集中于前者，从而随模型规模增大而失效。OASIS 通过将蒸馏限制在已验证的在线策略 scaffold 上并用同题自生成尝试替代书面解题作为教师上下文，在保留密集教师信号的同时消除了对书面解题的依赖，且在三个模型规模上一致优于 OPSD，表明自蒸馏的有效性取决于教师信号能否迁移至学生可观测的上下文。该方法局限于竞赛数学与单一模型族，且生成成本较高，未来可扩展至带单元测试的代码等具有廉价结果验证但无书面解题的场景。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a student to match a privileged teacher distribution along its own sampled trajectory. Standard OPSD applies this supervision to unverified student rollouts while conditioning the teacher on privileged context, typically a reference solution. We separate these roles in a factorial analysis and find that scaffold correctness has a stronger effect on downstream accuracy than context correctness. Unverified scaffolds create an imitation gap because the teacher can use information unavailable to the student. This gap shrinks with model scale, yet OPSD continues to supervise mostly unverified trajectories. In contrast, verified scaffolds remain effective even when the teacher is conditioned on the student's own unsuccessful rollout. Based on this finding, we introduce OASIS, which retains the OPSD objective but supervises mostly verified by label on-policy trajectories and replaces written solutions with unverified model-generated attempts as the teacher context. OASIS therefore requires only final-answer labels. Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and HMMT 2025, OASIS improves over the base model by 3.2--3.8 points on average, while OPSD's gain falls from 3.05 points at 1.7B to 0.14 at 8B. At 8B, OASIS improves over OPSD by 3.05 points, showing that verified on-policy scaffolds preserve the effectiveness of self-distillation as models scale.

</details>


### [726] [Search Dimension in Unlabeled Projection Pursuit: A Scaling Law for Subspace Restriction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37917)
*Rares Dimitrie Grozavescu,Mark Girolami*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究无标签投影追踪（最小峰度）在高维线性-高斯逆问题中的搜索维度效应。通过理论分析和受控实验，证明无约束搜索会因高斯补空间产生伪最小值（精确退化至峰度下界-2），而将搜索限制在已知前向算子的列空间可在负峰度分支上无损失地消除该失效。基于充分界推导出协方差尖峰估计（PCA）与四阶矩搜索（KPP）的标度分别为 ς⁻⁴ 和 ς⁻⁸，实验测得固定搜索维度下阈值比以 (n/p²)^0.156 坍缩，接近预测的 1/8 指数；但搜索维度变化的实测指数 0.325 显著偏离 1/8，且下游误差准则下标度消失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投影追踪在含高斯补空间的高维观测中存在系统性失效：经验峰度目标可被完全无信息的正交方向最小化，导致方向恢复失败。需要厘清该失效的本质，并比较已知信号子空间限制与数据驱动子空间估计的代价。

Method: 理论层面：建立白化线性-高斯逆模型，推导精确稀释恒等式（κ(u)=κ_a λ(θ)²）、跨搜索子空间的统一浓度界（Theorem 1/2，含截断与非截断版本）、样本量充分条件（Corollary 1）。实验层面：在两成分各向同性潜变量模型中，用角向容差定义阈值 ς_PCA 与 ς_KPP，跨 11 组配置拟合幂律指数，并通过附加噪声维度、样本切分、算子扰动等方式验证。

Result: 固定搜索维度时，KPP/PCA 阈值比按 (n/p²)^0.156（95% CI [0.118,0.174]，R²=0.965）坍缩，置信区间覆盖预测的 1/8。搜索维度变化时实测指数为 0.325（[0.259,0.399]），与 1/8 差距大，幂律/对数/线性形式无法区分。阈值交叉位置对角向准则（变化 4 倍）、最强尖峰选择（变化两个数量级）敏感。样本切分不能修复搜索受限的程序。无约束搜索在 p-r≥n-1 时精确达到 κ̂=-2。

Conclusion: 可恢复性与可发现性是不同问题。当观测模型确定信号子空间时，将无标签投影追踪限制于该子空间可在负峰度分支无损失地消除高维失效模式。固定搜索维度下阈值比遵循预测的 1/8 增益指数，但搜索维度依赖性呈不同形式。交叉位置取决于标定与模型配置，不能作为通用常数。搜索-限制程序在下游分类准则下标度基本消失，表明该比较针对方向恢复而非预测性能。

Abstract: Projection pursuit searches for a direction along which the data look least Gaussian. When the observation space contains a large Gaussian complement, the empirical objective can be minimized by a direction that carries no signal, with empirical kurtosis as low as at the truth. Sample splitting exposes rather than repairs this failure. Appending coordinates independent of the latent regime degrades the search while leaving Bayes recoverability unchanged. Restricting the search to the column space of a known forward operator removes the failure exactly on the negative-kurtosis branch. Estimating a principal subspace from the data is the alternative. In a controlled two-component model, the leading sufficient scalings differ in the gain with which the operator transmits the discriminant: $\varsigma^{-4}$ for covariance-spike estimation and $\varsigma^{-8}$ for fourth-moment search. At fixed search dimension, the measured threshold ratio collapses onto $n/p^2$ with exponent $0.156$, close to the predicted $1/8$. This is an empirically supported scaling motivated by sufficient bounds, not a proved asymptotically tight law. When the search dimension is varied, the measured exponent is $0.325$, substantially larger than $1/8$, and the tested range does not identify its functional form. The crossing location also depends on calibration and model configuration. Under a downstream excess-error criterion, the scaling largely disappears.

</details>


### [727] [Pattern Formation in Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37921)
*Erkan Turan,Gaspard Abel,Maks Ovsjanikov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将模式形成理论（pattern-formation theory）引入Transformer架构的理论分析，提出"矩阵色散关系"（Transformer Matrix Dispersion Relation），揭示Transformer在避免秩坍缩后会自发放大特定的token-feature联合结构（驻波、行波、特征旋转等），并证明这些"动力学先验"可通过位置编码、OV矩阵和FFN可控地设计，从而加速学习并提高数据效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Transformer表示理论要么关注秩坍缩（rank collapse），要么在简化假设下证明自注意力驱动token形成聚类。这些理论无法解释完整Transformer（包含位置编码、多头注意力、FFN）中观察到的丰富结构。当完整架构避免秩坍缩时，它如何在token表示中构建结构？这些结构先验是否可以被控制和利用？

Method: 1. 将Transformer块视为Lie-Trotter分裂：传播算子（MHA，跨token耦合）+ 局部算子（FFN，逐点非线性），类比反应-扩散系统。2. 推导Transformer矩阵色散关系 J(q) = C_*(I + D(q))，其中D(q)=Σ_h λ_h(q)M_h 是矩阵值谱滤波器，证明位置编码解除频率简并、多头注意力工程化该关系。3. 导出振幅方程（amplitude equations），刻画FFN和内容注意力非线性对饱和、相位漂移、模式竞争的控制。4. 模式分类：驻波（ω_c=0）、行波（ω_c≠0）、特征旋转（非对称OV）、聚类。5. 实验验证：标量模型相图、受控序列任务、CIFAR-10上的ConViT。

Result: 1. 理论：位置编码决定哪些token空间结构被选择，OV矩阵决定特征方向，FFN Jacobian整体缩放；单头只能选谱边（q=0或π），多头可组合实现中间频率。2. 非线性：聚类振幅 u*=√(μ/β_cl)，行波振幅R*=√(μ/Re(β_tr))，相位速度受Im(β_tr)修正；竞争由β_cross vs β_self决定共存或赢家通吃。3. 实验：标量模型振幅预测中位误差近阈值3%，不稳定区域14%；观测波数匹配96%；竞争预测匹配97%。4. 受控任务：任务对齐初始化在三种形态（周期/平移/旋转）上均显著优于不匹配和随机初始化。5. CIFAR-10：-I+sharp pos初始化达到91.5%测试准确率，t_90从92 epoch降至69 epoch。

Conclusion: Transformer并非在避免秩坍缩后就是结构无序的；其前向传播在每个token频率上乘以矩阵值增益J(q)，选择性放大特定联合token-feature结构。这种"动力学先验"将二元的传播-坍缩图景细化为模式分辨的图景。非线性理论揭示哪些结构饱和、漂移或共存。将先验与任务对齐可加速优化并提高数据效率。这为理解负OV初始化和ConViT局部核的有效性提供了统一框架。

Abstract: What are the inductive biases of a Transformer architecture? Existing theory on how the forward pass shapes representations either considers whether Transformers escape from rank collapse or demonstrates that self-attention drives tokens toward cluster patterns. The latter view arises from an elegant dynamical systems perspective, but relies on simplified architectural assumptions, and does not explain the rich structures observed in practice. This leaves a major open question: when a full Transformer escapes rank collapse, how does it structure token representations? Using pattern-formation theory, we show that the dynamical view of Transformers can account for Positional Encoding, Multi-Head Attention, and Output-Value geometry. We demonstrate that a full Transformer architecture imposes an inductive prior by selectively amplifying a rich set of previously unreported patterns, including traveling or rotating waves among others. We characterize the role of each architectural component in controlling which pattern is amplified, which ones stabilize, compete, or coexist. Finally, we show that these structures can act as a controllable dynamical prior that facilitates learning. By choosing both task-aligned positional encoding and weight initialization, we demonstrate improved data efficiency and accelerated optimization on controlled sequence tasks and with ConViT on CIFAR-10.

</details>


### [728] [Time-Anchored Diffusion Language Models: Latent-Space Caching for Fast Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37924)
*Joel Anto Paul,Litu Rout,Aditya Akella,Sanjay Shakkottai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出时间锚定扩散语言模型（TADM），通过将昂贵的锚点网络计算结果缓存在潜在空间中，并在多个反向去噪步骤中复用，同时用轻量级的融合模块结合当前状态，实现自监督的潜在空间缓存。框架包含两种实例：TADM:Post-train（对预训练DLM进行时间锚定化，仅训练3.1M参数的融合模块）和TADM:Pretraining（在预训练阶段学习可缓存的时间锚点）。在DiffusionGemma-26B上，Post-train版本在多个基准上实现49%-79%的吞吐量提升；Pretraining版本相比标准单阶段DLM减少高达38%的Transformer层计算，相比ADLM吞吐量提升高达73%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）虽然支持双向注意力和并行生成，并能在生成过程中进行修订和纠错，但其需要跨去噪步骤进行重复的模型评估，导致推理成本远高于自回归解码。现有的锚定扩散语言模型（ADLM）虽然通过预测重要锚点token来引导去噪，但需要任务相关的监督来指定哪些token作为锚点，限制了其通用性。此外，现有的KV缓存方法虽然利用了相邻扩散状态的相似性，但这些局部、层级特定的表示并非为时间复用而训练。因此需要一种新的机制，使DLM能够以自监督方式学习并跨多个扩散时间步复用潜在表示。

Method: 核心方法是将去噪网络分解为四个组件：(1)轻量级共享网络S_θS，用于编码当前扩散状态；(2)昂贵的锚点网络A_θA，周期性计算并缓存深层潜在表示h_{t'}；(3)小型融合模块Φ_φ，通过门控残差机制h̃ = h_{t'} + g(c_t, h_{t'}) ⊙ Δ(c_t, h_{t'})将当前状态c_t与陈旧锚点结合；(4)轻量级去噪器D_θD，基于融合表示预测干净token。在推理时，锚点网络每K步评估一次，其缓存表示在中间步骤中复用。训练目标为时间锚定负证据下界（T-ANELBO）：L_T-ANELBO = L_NELBO + γL_Anchor，其中γ控制锚点监督强度（γ=0时为完全自监督）。TADM:Post-train采用rollout训练策略近似推理分布（仅训练3.1M参数融合模块），TADM:Pretraining从零开始训练，使用解析生成的前向状态而非rollout。锚点表示对应于理想化图模型中保持不变的"上层父变量"，其语义内容在扩散时间上持久。

Result: TADM:Post-train在DiffusionGemma-26B上：(1)吞吐量提升1.49×–1.79×（K=3时），相当于49%–79%的加速；(2)在GSM8K、HumanEval、LCB-v6上精度略有提升（+0.16pp至+2.09pp），在GPQA-D、AIME26、MMLU-Pro上精度下降不超过1.11pp；(3)仅训练3.1M参数融合模块，基础模型保持冻结。TADM:Pretraining（224M参数，在OpenWebText上预训练1M步）：(1)相比标准DLM减少高达38%的Transformer层计算；(2)相比ADLM吞吐量提升高达73%（1.73×）；(3)在T=2048时MAUVE得分0.650，高于ReMDM的0.610，使用更少的Transformer评估次数；(4)零样本似然泛化能力与MDLM相当；(5)在缓存年龄扫描实验中，TADM相比ADLM在K增加时退化显著更小（如T=1024时ADLM在K=8的Gen PPL从25.97退化到144.97，而TADM仅从23.18变化到30.52）。主要限制是较大锚点刷新间隔下生成质量会下降，且Post-train精度受限于冻结的预训练骨干网络。

Conclusion: TADM建立了时间锚定作为DLM潜在空间缓存的通用框架，通过学习语义内容在扩散时间上持久存在的潜在表示，实现了显著的推理加速，同时通过自监督方式（γ=0）避免了对显式锚点token监督的依赖。两种实例化方式（TADM:Post-train和TADM:Pretraining）分别适用于已有预训练模型的适配和从零训练场景，证明该方法是加速扩散语言模型的有效且通用的途径。未来工作方向包括延长有效缓存复用时间以及突破冻结预训练骨干网络的精度限制。

Abstract: Recent work on anchored diffusion language models improves denoising by shaping an intermediate latent space with supervised important-token targets. In this work, we introduce time-based (self-supervised) anchoring, which learns and reuses latent anchors without requiring such targets. Our key observation is that anchors encode persistent properties of the clean sequence, such as its semantic intent, global structure, or intermediate plan. Although their hidden representations become stale as the token canvas evolves, their semantic content remains useful across nearby diffusion times. This is implemented through a two-stage architecture consisting of a relatively expensive anchor network that generates the latent cache state and a lightweight denoising network that intelligently combines the cached latent state with the current state at each reverse step using a fusion module. This gives anchoring a latent-space caching interpretation: the anchor network is evaluated periodically, while its cached representation is reused across multiple reverse steps. We instantiate this framework as TADM:Post-train, which time-anchorizes pretrained DLMs, and TADM:Pretraining, which learns time-based anchors during pretraining. Applied to DiffusionGemma-26B, TADM:Post-train improves throughput by approximately 49% to 79% on several math, code, and STEM benchmarks (GSM8K, AIME26, GPQA-Diamond, LiveCodeBench-v6, HumanEval, MMLU-Pro). TADM:Pretraining reduces Transformer-layer computation by up to 38% relative to a standard single-stage DLM, achieves up to 73% higher measured throughput than ADLM.

</details>


### [729] [Learning When to Update: A Near-Optimal Timing Bandit Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37932)
*Qiulin Lin,Junyan Su,Liyuan Wang,Minghua Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将动态系统中模型/数字孪生等的更新时机选择问题建模为一种新型的"时机多臂赌博机（Timing Bandit）"问题，提出了BCAE算法及其乐观增强变体OE-BCAE，实现了$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$的近最优遗憾界，显著优于标准多臂赌博机算法的$\tilde{O}(K\sqrt{T})$。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 资源密集型系统（如机器学习模型、数字孪生）在动态环境中需要及时更新以维持性能，但更新频率过高浪费资源，过低则导致性能退化。当退化模式未知时，平衡这一权衡面临在线学习的根本挑战。

Method: 提出"时机多臂赌博机（Timing Bandit）"框架，识别出三个独特结构：时序决策（一次选择占用多步）、成本组合（每步退化成本+固定更新成本）、连续反馈（较长区间揭示较短区间的反馈）。设计BCAE算法利用：(1) 更紧的置信界（成本组合）；(2) 平衡连续反馈中的置信间隙；(3) 锚点轮设计确保i·m_i在候选臂间平衡。此外提出OE-BCAE在前向窗口内集成LCB原理以增强经验适应性。

Result: BCAE实现$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$遗憾，与问题下界$\Omega(\sqrt{T})$仅相差对数因子。相比之下，未利用问题结构的算法达到$\tilde{O}(K\sqrt{T})$。OE-BCAE保持同阶理论保证且经验性能更优。仿真和基于北欧电网频率真实数据的远程监测实验验证了算法在臂数和更新成本变化下的稳定性和优越性。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了在线更新调度在未知随机退化模式下的理论空白，证明了利用问题特定结构可将遗憾界从$O(K\sqrt{T})$降至$O(\sqrt{T})$，并通过真实数据集验证了方法的实用性。未来工作可扩展到非平稳/上下文赌博机设置。

Abstract: Systems operating in dynamic environments require timely updates to sustain performance. For resource-intensive systems such as machine learning models and digital twins, strategically timing updates is essential. Updating too frequently wastes resources, while updating too infrequently leads to costly performance degradation. The problem is particularly challenging when the system's degradation pattern is unknown a priori, as is common in new operating environments. We formalize this challenge as a novel \emph{timing bandit} problem, where each arm represents a candidate update interval with a fixed update cost and an unknown, stochastic degradation cost. Three structural properties distinguish this setting from standard multi-armed bandits: selecting an interval commits the learner to multiple time slots before the next update; arm costs are composed of per-step degradation costs and a fixed update cost; and selecting a longer interval naturally reveals degradation at every intermediate step, providing consecutive feedback relevant to shorter intervals. By exploiting these structures, we develop Balanced Consecutive Arm Elimination (BCAE). BCAE achieves $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret, improving upon the $\tilde{\Omega}(K\sqrt{T})$ regret of standard bandit algorithms in this setting, where $K$ is the number of candidate update intervals. We further propose an Optimism-Enhanced variant (OE-BCAE) that integrates lower-confidence-bound principles to improve empirical adaptivity while preserving the same regret order. Moreover, the regret bound achieved by our algorithms matches the theoretical lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Simulation results demonstrate that our algorithms achieve low regret and remain stable as both the number of arms and the update cost vary.

</details>


### [730] [An Efficient Machine Learning Approach for Degradation Forecasting in AEM Water Electrolysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37941)
*Marco Veneriano,Ani Gjergji,Sebastiano Bellani,Andrea Riva,Vito Paolo Pastore,Matteo Santacesaria*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对阴离子交换膜水电解器(AEMWE)的单电池电压退化预测，提出了一套面向异构工业数据的数据驱动框架。核心方法是将24小时电压观测窗口作为输入，构建多步长(3/6/12/18/24小时)单变量时间序列预测任务，并采用留一组交叉验证(LOGO-CV)协议。系统比较了从线性基线、岭回归、随机森林到浅层神经网络、LSTM和1D-CNN等模型，结果显示浅层正则化神经网络在数据稀缺和噪声条件下表现最为稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AEMWE是绿色制氢的重要技术，但膜的长期稳定性有限，限制了其大规模部署。现有基于深度学习的退化建模研究主要针对PEM系统，且多聚焦准稳态短时预测；针对AEMWE早期瞬态、异构、小样本场景下的中时域退化轨迹预测研究不足。需要一个能在工业异构数据稀缺条件下稳健泛化的预测框架，以支持运维决策。

Method: 1. 数据集：来自Antares Electrolysis的12次异构恒电流老化实验(40–100小时)。2. 预处理：高斯平滑→三次插值→以5分钟均匀重采样。3. 滑窗构造：窗口L=24小时、步长f=1小时，逐窗口局部标准化。4. 任务定义：直接多步长预测，目标为预测区间末1/4段的均值。5. 评估协议：留一组交叉验证(LOGO-CV)以严格防止数据泄露。6. 模型族：全局线性趋势外推、岭回归(α=1)、随机森林(300树)、浅层ReLU网络(128单元+Dropout)、1D-CNN(16滤波器,核5)、LSTM(8单元)。

Result: 在所有5个时间步长上，浅层神经网络(Norm MAE: 1.730@18h、1.471@12h、0.970@6h、0.675@3h)整体表现最稳健且标准差最小。1D-CNN表现接近且稳定，LSTM在长时间步长上具有竞争力但在短步长上退化。岭回归是线性方法中最强基线。在物理单位下，误差在所有步长上均保持在稳定量级，未随步长增加而显著恶化，表明模型学习到物理上有意义的退化信号。

Conclusion: 在严重的低数据和高噪声条件下，简单的强正则化模型比复杂时序模型更可靠。浅层神经网络提供了最佳的稳定性-表达能力权衡；1D-CNN在不同预测范围上具有竞争力；LSTM对模型容量和训练选择更敏感。所提出的训练与评估框架可推广至工业部署场景。

Abstract: This study provides a data-driven analysis of a novel dataset of single-cell Anion Exchange Membrane water electrolyzers (AEMWE), operated under constant current load across multiple heterogeneous experimental campaigns. We train and evaluate a range of machine learning models with different complexity, including linear baselines, LSTMs and CNNs, to perform medium-term forecasting of the cell voltage degradation curve. The models are assessed within a rigorous training and evaluation framework specifically designed for heterogeneous industrial data.

</details>


### [731] [Scene-Consistent Illumination Transfer for Inserted Advertising Graphics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37951)
*Rameshwar Mishra,Bishshoy Das,A. V. Subramanyam,Guan-Ming Su*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Ad-Relight，一种无需训练的推理阶段流程，用于将广播画面中场景光照迁移到待插入的广告图块中，解决几何贴合正确但光度不一致（亮度梯度、阴影）导致的视觉脱离问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 广告位替换中，仅做几何透视粘贴无法再现目标表面的亮度渐变和阴影，导致插入图块"漂浮"。由于横幅样本稀缺且 logo 不可更改，训练专门模型不切实际，需利用预训练扩散先验进行推理阶段光照迁移。

Method: Ad-Relight 流程：(1) 区域预处理——对原区域亮度 Y_O 与贴图亮度 Y_L 分别做高斯低通分解为缓变阴影 S 与结构分量 R，将 S_O·R_L 替换贴图亮度以继承宿主低频明暗；(2) 微分光照探测——对冻结预训练扩散 relighter 分别以"含原区域"与"抑制目标区域"的背景作两次查询，取差值 ε≈T_φ·L_O 作为目标区域光照贡献的残差信号；(3) 受导再光照与接触衰减——用平滑亮度场 G 稳定残差得到 B_ε 作为光照条件编辑贴图 L*，再结合 Otsu 阈值导出的连续衰减场 d 软混合得到最终亮度。关键超参 K=99, K'=21, α_ε=0.4, α_s=0.2, α=0.3。

Result: 在 560 组（80 帧×7 横幅）测试上，Ad-Relight 取得 SSIM 0.95、LPIPS 0.03、ILL-SIM 0.92，全面优于 warp-only（0.89/0.12/0.82）、直接 relighting（0.91/0.07/0.77）与 shadow-guided（0.92/0.09/0.79）基线。消融表明差分残差 ε 对感知相似度贡献最大，阴影迁移阶段对结构与光照分数影响最强。GPT-4o 成对偏好中相对几何基线达到 90–100% 胜率；25 名受试者 324 次人评在强光照梯度场景下最一致地倾向 Ad-Relight。

Conclusion: Ad-Relight 将横幅合成重构为光照测量任务，通过两次查询冻结 relighter 提取区域光照残差并作用于原始图块，无需训练即可在地板等平面、非均匀光照场景下显著提升场景一致性。局限在于仅处理单帧，依赖局部线性假设与输入掩码/单应性精度；未来需扩展到时域稳定化与几何-光照联合优化。

Abstract: Replacing a visible advertisement in a broadcast frame is geometrically straightforward but photometrically delicate. A pasted graphic can have the correct perspective and still appear detached when its brightness, shading, or shadow disagrees with the surface beneath it. This paper presents Ad-Relight, an inference-only procedure for transferring scene illumination to a supplied advertising graphic without collecting a banner-specific training set. The procedure first separates slowly varying shade from graphic structure, then probes a pretrained diffusion relighter with two nearly identical backgrounds to isolate the contribution of the target region. A final pass combines this residual with a smoothed luminance field and a soft attenuation mask. Across 560 generated placements, the approach improves structural similarity, perceptual distance, and illumination agreement over geometric compositing and direct relighting baselines. Human judgments and an automated preference study show the clearest gains on floor-mounted graphics with nonuniform lighting. The current study is image based; temporal stabilization remains an open extension.

</details>


### [732] [Kolmogorov-Arnold Classifier Systems as Universal Approximators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37958)
*Hiroki Shiraishi,Hisao Ishibuchi,Masaya Nakata*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Kolmogorov-Arnold分类器系统（KACS），通过维度分解打破基于规则的机器学习（如LCS）的维度诅咒，将最坏情况规则数从O(m^n)降至O(mn²)，并证明其为连续函数的通用逼近器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统学习分类器系统（LCS）在高维函数逼近中面临可扩展性瓶颈：规则数和参数数随输入维度n呈指数级增长（O(m^n)），限制了其处理高维问题的能力。

Method: 基于Kolmogorov-Arnold表示定理，将n维连续函数分解为有限个一维函数的叠加。KACS将目标函数分解为一维子问题，为每个子问题分配专用的规则集，从而实现维度分解：一维局部模型每条规则仅需2个参数（与n无关）。并首次构造性地证明了KACS作为LCS是紧致域上连续函数的通用逼近器。

Result: 在相同条件下与直接的n维输入空间划分方法对比，KACS在许多设置下达到具有竞争力的准确率，同时仅使用2%至40%的参数数量。

Conclusion: KACS通过维度分解有效缓解了基于规则机器学习的维度诅咒，显著降低了规则和参数复杂度，同时保持函数逼近能力，为高维规则学习提供了新的可扩展范式。

Abstract: As the input dimension $n$ grows, rule-based machine learning, such as Learning Classifier Systems (LCSs), faces a fundamental scalability bottleneck for function approximation: both rule count and parameter count grow exponentially with $n$. Traditional LCSs partition the $n$-dimensional input space directly, requiring $\mathcal{O}(m^n)$ rules for adequate coverage, where $m$ is the per-variable resolution. This article breaks from this paradigm by reorganizing rules dimension-wise, guided by the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem: any continuous $n$-dimensional function can be expressed as a finite superposition of one-dimensional functions. The proposed Kolmogorov-Arnold Classifier System (KACS) decomposes the target function into one-dimensional subproblems and assigns a dedicated ruleset to each, reducing the worst-case rule count from $\mathcal{O}(m^n)$ to $\mathcal{O}(mn^2)$ and replacing $n$-dimensional local models with one-dimensional models requiring only two parameters per rule, independent of $n$. We also provide the first constructive proof that an LCS, namely KACS, is a universal approximator for continuous functions on compact domains. Evaluated against a direct $n$-dimensional input space partitioning approach under otherwise identical conditions, KACS achieves competitive accuracy in many settings while using only 2\% to 40\% of the parameters. Our implementation is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [733] [TabFM: A Zero-Shot Foundation Model for Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37959)
*Weihao Kong,Erez Louidor Ilan,Shuxin Nie,Taman Narayan,Rajat Sen,Yichen Zhou,Deqing Fu,Samet Oymak,Abhimanyu Das*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TabFM 是一个400M参数的表格基础模型，将有监督表格预测建模为上下文学习（in-context learning），通过结构因果模型生成的合成表进行预训练，在 TabArena 基准上零样本表现领先，并可通过推理时集成（TabFM+）和LLM引导的特征工程（TabFM-Auto）进一步提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统表格机器学习依赖针对每个数据集的优化流程（如GBDT或AutoML），缺乏跨任务的知识共享。论文旨在构建一个表格基础模型，通过上下文学习实现零样本预测，避免重复的训练调优过程，并解决表格Transformer在数据规模、列混合类型处理等方面的挑战。

Method: TabFM 采用四阶段架构：(1) 频谱单元嵌入——通过二元特征分组和傅里叶频率库处理数值和类别特征；(2) 交替的列式Induced Self-Attention Block (ISAB) 和行式Self-Attention Block (SAB)，降低复杂度至 O(THmE)；(3) CLS标记池化将可变特征数压缩为固定行表示；(4) 24层ICL预测器以1024维宽度处理上下文。模型完全在基于结构因果模型生成的合成表上预训练，采用四阶段课程学习将上下文从2048扩展到16384实例。TabFM+ 通过K=32多视图集成（交叉特征+SVD特征）和NNLS堆叠进一步提升；TabFM-Auto 则将冻结的TabFM与Gemini-3.8-Flash结合，通过闭式程序合成循环进行数据集特定的特征工程。

Result: 在TabArena 51个基准数据集（38分类+13回归）的评测中：零样本TabFM在两类任务上均居默认基础模型首位（分类1768.6 Elo，回归2055.2 Elo），优于调优的AutoML流程。TabFM+ 通过集成进一步提升至分类1838.0 Elo和回归2189.2 Elo；TabFM-Auto 取得最佳成绩，分类1940.7 Elo、回归2392.4 Elo，并在41/51数据集上改进，其中回归任务实现0%预言机可改进性。模型支持最多16384个实例和100列的上下文。

Conclusion: TabFM 证明了通过纯合成数据预训练和上下文学习实现通用表格预测的可行性，在无需任务特定调优的情况下达到领先性能。推理时集成和LLM引导的特征工程进一步释放了冻结模型的潜力。未来工作包括扩展到百万行千列规模、融合真实表格语料与多模态数据（文本、时间戳）、处理关系型模式，以及将合成的特征工程管道蒸馏回预训练过程中。

Abstract: Tabular machine learning typically relies on per-dataset workflows, fitting tree ensembles or running AutoML searches from scratch for every task. We present TabFM, a 400M-parameter tabular foundation model that formulates supervised tabular prediction as in-context learning. TabFM produces calibrated zero-shot predictions in a single forward pass without task-specific tuning. Trained entirely on synthetic tables generated from structural causal models, TabFM learns general tabular representations that transfer zero-shot to real-world tasks. Across all 51 benchmark datasets in TabArena (38 classification and 13 regression), zero-shot TabFM ranks first among default tabular foundation models and outperforms tuned AutoML pipelines. Two extensions over the same frozen weights improve performance further on both tracks: multi-view feature expansion with ensembling and post-hoc calibration (TabFM+), and LLM-guided, dataset-specific data processing and feature engineering (TabFM-Auto).

</details>


### [734] [TabFM-Auto: Self-Evolving Pipelines for Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37989)
*Deqing Fu,Huangyuan Su,Rajat Sen,Taman Narayan,Sujay Sanghavi,Abhimanyu Das,Weihao Kong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TabFM-Auto将冻结的表格基础模型(TabFM)与LLM编码代理相结合，代理通过迭代搜索数据清洗、特征工程、上下文选择和后处理四个阶段的流水线来减少TabFM的预测误差。在TabArena基准(51个数据集)和MLE-Bench-Tabular(8个Kaggle竞赛)上均达到最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型(TFM)虽然在合成表上预训练后具备较强的零样本能力，但其注意力层仅关注浮点数值和类别索引，无法理解列名背后的领域语义(如"systolic_bp"代表收缩压、ICD9编码的层级结构、0代表缺失值等)。另一方面，现有的MLE代理从零训练模型，同时搜索特征、架构和超参数噪声大且容易过拟合。本文旨在结合两者的优势：用LLM的领域知识理解列名和任务描述，同时利用TFM的快速前向推理避免模型重训练噪声。

Method: 方法核心是将流水线搜索空间P = (Φ_clean, Φ_feat, S_ctx, Ψ_post)分解为四个模块化Python函数(preprocess、engineer、sample、postprocess)加上TABFM_KWARGS配置字典。TabFM-Auto在隔离沙箱中通过3折交叉验证迭代编辑这四个函数，而TabFM保持冻结。四个阶段分别解决：Φ_clean处理缺失值占位符和目标变换(对偏态目标取log(1+y))；Φ_feat注入领域知识(物理无量纲数、临床指标、ICD-9编码分组)和统计/结构特征(关系图度、频率编码、奇异值分解)；S_ctx处理超过16384行的大表(多视图分层采样少数类)；Ψ_post对分类做对数几率先验校准和对回归做目标逆变换。代理以恒等流水线P_0为起点，仅保留相对P_0提升验证分数的编辑。

Result: 在TabArena全部51个数据集上，五种TabFM-Auto配置占据前五名，最佳配置(Codex+Claude Opus 5)将TabFM从1785.3提升至2013.0 Elo(+227.7)。其中：分类38个数据集提升+197.6 Elo(G-Mean误差降低4.19%-5.05%)；回归13个数据集提升+467.0 Elo至2512.9(G-Mean RMSE降低3.11%-3.15%)，所有13个回归数据集均有改善。配对胜率显示对TabFM胜率74.3%、对AutoGluon 1.5胜率91.3%。发现的流水线无额外搜索即可迁移到TabPFN-3、TabICLv2、EXAONE-Tabular等其他冻结TFM，提升+69至+143 Elo。在MLE-Bench-Tabular的8个Kaggle竞赛中，TabFM-Auto (Claude Code+Opus 5)以1827 Elo排名第一，胜率86.7%，获得4枚Kaggle奖牌(含2金2铜)。

Conclusion: 研究证明LLM编码代理可以通过演化冻结TFM周围的数据流水线来弥补合成预训练遗漏的语义信息。TabFM-Auto在TabArena和MLE-Bench-Tabular上均排名第一，验证了"冻结基础模型+演化数据流水线"范式的有效性。局限性在于匿名表上的增益较小，且每次搜索需要重复验证评估。未来方向包括：将发现的公式、清洗规则、目标变换和关系特征纳入预训练以构建schema感知的TFM，以及将搜索扩展到多表关系数据库和辅助文件场景。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models achieve strong zero-shot accuracy on structured data by pretraining on synthetic tables, but they ignore the column names, task descriptions, and auxiliary files that carry dataset semantics. Meanwhile, self-evolving machine learning engineering (MLE) agents train models from scratch on each dataset, yet jointly searching over features, architectures, and hyperparameters is noisy and prone to overfitting. We introduce TabFM-Auto, which pairs a tabular foundation model, TabFM, with a language model agent that evolves the data pipeline around it. Guided by dataset metadata and validation feedback, TabFM-Auto iteratively refines data cleaning, feature engineering, context selection, and post-processing to reduce TabFM's error. Across all 51 datasets of the TabArena benchmark, five TabFM-Auto configurations with different agents and language models take the top five overall positions, and the best raises TabFM from 1785 to 2013 Elo. The discovered pipelines also transfer to other frozen tabular foundation models (+69 to +143 Elo) with no further search. On the 8 tabular competitions of MLE-Bench, TabFM-Auto ranks first overall among MLE agents.

</details>
